tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 12 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/ gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

༄༅rti/ dpe skrun gsal bshad/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i de pe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug lang gis bsgrigs sbyong 'di sa dnge/ skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun nga/'i dpe rnying dnge/ tshos sa shig yin 8la/ nge/ yang mkhas dbang gzan da rka/ra rin ngo che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dang 'a brtsegs bong yi/ga dnge/ rnying zhib 'jug spang gis nye ba'i lo bcu cam gyi ring 'a 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas/ gang sar bzhugs nga 'i bod yi ga dpe rnying po ti brir longs nga/ rang byung dang mi 'i gachod 'tshes 'jig 'a nye ba'i snyen /ba las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab dnge/ thum gsol/ dpe sgro ma ba/zhengs te srung skyob ma/jad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod nga/ ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi ma bo 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin 'a sa gal ren zhig red/nye char dpa' brtsegs bod yi ga dpe rnying zhib /rijug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhibagros byas mthar/ sro la rgyun rig gnas srung skyo ba dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig kyur brog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dnge/ skrun byed bzhin yod nga/ dang / da char yang dmags yul nga gos pa gcis gyur thog 〈re/sa po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di ning par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig nga/ dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/ —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya rgo skabs legs po nged cag dpe/ skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa 'ib 'jug lte gnas kyi nga bu khrid ngang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du ma sa gdeng 'jog dang ma/thong chen gyis skul ma ya nga thob/〈me/sa po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pa/sa/ ma dpe/ gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba ring shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yi/ga dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis 'o mang ring nyams khyo nga bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gas/ra rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnam/sa kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yong pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gas la bshad du gzigs pa ra zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag nga ra du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khring lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ra/ rin kro che rma/chog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang rma dzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib /'jug spang thi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lha ga bas ma/ dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rngams la snying thas pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ta cang myon tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas cho da/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'dug mi nyung ba yod srid nga/sa dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dnge/ skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu spungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo digs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe/ ma dzod chen po yodang/ra ma zad/ye bad sgo ḍā/dā rje sdeg gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde/ cha phyo ngang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bonang/ rma kra shing tsho rta chen ngo/ bco bseng ces pe sde gang yig ‘rir 7ra rwa rke 7 rwa bo rje do :dro ni sto ra dzo da jadang gang yan pa' nga sprad mad tsam zhu na/ yang — skad du/ 'jam mgan kang sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang khrog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes nga/nga / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud nga// /shangs pa 'i byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas nga shad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes/ 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi ya ba re/sa gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs/ nga/ rme da par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan ba nge/'i dpal la nga/migs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po ma/tha' ya/sa pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen ngo/ sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/ —2—

— rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgri la ba dang chabs cig tang si yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros/ te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 3go khrid dang rtsa 'dzu1gas gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dnge/ skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyam/sa nga/ sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'kho sa bstu na gyi sri zhu sgrub nga/'i ska snyel ba bzang ngo/'i dpal la longs su spyad du yo/da pa'i stabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged ca gi ra bsed nams kyi dra go skal du lha sa yod pa rnams la gces spras chen jo sa sru/nga skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gya tshos gnang ba'i 'a/sa/ 'gazho yin snye/ra ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob cha rdzongs sa 'a bya bar legs skyes 'bul rma khan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la ma/tshon na/ rang re'i phri ga ngar bab pa'i gzhan drang chi/ 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla rme 'ang ra ba'i bros 'gan mchos tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs ngang ris su rma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rngam/sa byas ljas//sa rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab / pa kya da sgrub shing rta bca brgyad 'a sa grub nga/'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chas/ 'byu/nga dang sa din rabs / rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod ngang snyan ngag /rtsis dang sar / / rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnam /sa bsdus/ chad nga/ rbems bas ba/ nyam sa pa rnam sa ra tshe gzags/ shan lnga grags nga/ rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chas sa su/nga ra du pa skru po rnga/ dang zhebaskrun rtsas 'a sa — 3 —

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba rma/khyen mkhyen/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam/ dkar bya ba dang du len/ lngad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi 'a rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni rme thong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan la khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007nga/'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

brdi/ sgrag gas‘5 nga yand/bsdu sgrig gsal nga khrig da/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da ‘lam dngose su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me/ 'brug (spya lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum/ pa'am/ yang lugs gcig snyel dmar ngo/ sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa ba'i nga/ bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khore sngags phreng da/nga skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs ce bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras skrungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong 'a/ sa/sung/rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste nga/ra mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta /bong gi gsung rtsom rnams/ kha tshang ba na cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa/ 'ing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdu/sa pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ dkar chag dwangs gsa' me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis ngang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhug/sa/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis kro da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug spru 'a/ skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom/ ga/ nang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang — 2 —

spo—— —————gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgya'/ gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / ngo da grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yo/da pa'i r+shaphyar/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shang par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs/ gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yo/da pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan4 3la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod nga/ gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/— 3 —

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dnge/ gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi/ 'dra ba cung zad yod nga/ ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug nga/ rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sprungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang nga/ra ma/'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su ga sgyu bkad nga/ dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bzhas mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus/ tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan1 21la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang /ri bras sprungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma/ gnyis char med pa/ 'bras skrungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung — 4 —

— ba bcas/ la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i (lwagrang gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis jo/ ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dnge/ gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags/〈〈dza 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di / 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po nga 'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcis rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod nga/ dang / khrong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnam sa/ su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang ngo/ zhis/ — 5 —

khrong/spyadas nang ba dag kyang rang ser bzhag yod/ ———ge—da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs/ pa nas zhus shing / nga/ra skrun char lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ char brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyi na bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song cwa 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi ma/thun rkyen las/ da la che sheng ngam su par du bskrun thub pa tsung ste rgya che'i klog nga/ po rnams/ kyi spyan lam/ du rmu /la ba yi na/'a sa gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pong/ bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang rme nga/pe btsal rogs ngang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod na smu/sa don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi ro rgas ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dang/la lda na rgya mtshos zhu dag gi cal so ko spyi'i thugs 'gan che 'ebs gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ / dpal brtse gas bod yig dpe rnying 'ib 'apyis bang 'eng karma bde /dre gas kyis /— 6 —

rje btsun tā ra nā rnge 5 7 rna~X ༵ra mdor bsdus/khong ni slob dpon chen tre 1 shwe cu 1 6 3 'byung duganas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos 'o/ tsā ba/ kha rag sgom/ chung sogs skyes/ chen ma/nga pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang chan /ba rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo cho kha rag ces rna 'i 'dabs / chu bo chen po lo nyi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par she bya myo pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa 'a/sa shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i ga dung brgyud/ sngags ‘re chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung 'o bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575 ) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i lngas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gso/la/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsar/ nas/ gsung byan/ te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes 8nal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang spyin bang ga / nye ga skos sogs kyi/ zlo / rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma ku/na dga' gro'/ ma chog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung le bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam/ 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yi ga thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad nga sa mkhyen rdogs/ rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gang mas glegs bam gyi lu nga zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums sto da zla ba'i tshes/ lnga (spyi 'o 1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thos/ tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgya8pa mchan dpa'/ bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/ chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nāng zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzo gas/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug khu smra ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang / ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang / rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhud bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug lha hi smad lnga/ dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rā pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu rma/nga po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591 )la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom nga/ bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang ngo/'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'bor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/gzhan yang dge ba'i bzhas gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'a snang gas gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang /rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang /grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags/ po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung nga/ dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung nga/ rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sa da de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pu chu nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni ba ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus/ pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang ngo/ byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos la bor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen do'/ po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla sal nas pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgya/la gyis chos gzhis dang lha 'ang ngas sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba 'a sa/dpal rtag brtan nga/ma chos gling nges don da/ga 'a ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa bcugs te/ phyi gtsug lag /bang dang grwa khang brgya phrag cam lcags ri dang bcas nga// nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum/ chen rmo// dzam/ bha la sogs gser tsho zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'a/bor lo sdom/ pa'i sku zha'/ phyag yo ngas rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs ma/chod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha /bang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub nga/ sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan ya/nga lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal so/gas nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa ngang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsa snyel pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan rngu yir ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang ngo/ gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / ya ra klung lo cwa ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis — 8 —

ge ge' / dug dus sko po spror rgyud/ kyi dpe/ de dbus phyogs nas snga mo 'ig tu lag ba ye snye khe ye son byung ba dang / 'gre'/ pa 'di ska/ bas su rnyed rnga/ la ya mchan chen po byung ste brengs rme/nga bklags pas zung sbyor 'a/ yang blo skyed chen po byung / ga 'an yang nga/bang mdor bsta na gyi 'gre' pa don da rma/ bsdus pa'i ma dzad byang 'a/ nā ro pa/'i rma tshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kya tsho mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yong/ pa sogs rme nga po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang nga/ sde srid kyis so ga ngo 'i steng dud mag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'a/bor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe / khong ni rje tsong /h+phu—pa chen ge tshe rnga/ra lhas tā dad pa che ba dang / khyad pa ra du chos sde cha myo po rdo re pras sbungs 'a/ snye se mas kyi bag chags tha'e tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen ngo/ nge nyid dar zheng rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas/ zhi ba'i smo/na 'a ma btab kyang / nus rnga/ ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyas ka las ngan gyi dab pa gis ded pa lnga/ g.yol thabs bral 'es sa sungs/ de nas dpal 'bor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam/ gnyis// thar pa/ gling / rtag brtan chos 'phe/la sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs/ spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re ka cig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing pas/ (spyi lo1635 ba) snyel/ rtag ba/rtan ram rlos gla/nga nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi sa/ngan sa 'jam/ dbyangs/ spru /la sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho 'a / sa/tad de/ chos lung rtse nga 0 zo—mo ji—nga du dus/ /brid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs — 9 —

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang ngo gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rkyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rbem rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang ngo / tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa// dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha/ri yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod phyoms/ mi pham nga/kon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang rmo /gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan ya/nga bstan pa'i sbyan bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—

bcom/ ldan 'das gshin rje gshed po'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams spyo/ spro/ba thabs/ bsdo kyi spu/tra// 1'jam dpal gsang ldan gyi dkyil chog bzhugs/ 181dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor dang 'grel pa drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor chog gi ngag 'don bzhugs/ 240gtor chog khams gsum zil gnon gyi lhan thabs lde'u thung gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos bzhugs/ 279bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs/ mdzad chen po'i chos skor la med mi rung gi gal po che bzhugs/ 305bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sgrub thabs rdo rje 'bar ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 346rdo rje 'jigs mjad kyi bsreg blugs bsdus pa sogs bzhugs/ 378bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i tshogs rtu5cedzu tshong do rngu ku ( /kyispraṭa/spros// 388u ṣ+ṭi ṣa rwa lugs kyi ngag 'don rgyun khyer bzhugs/ 392

rab 'dra/mas kyi sgrab thabs 'phrin las kyi nyi ma 'bu ( 5 / gyi gzi brdzing/ ces bya ba bsdo/gas//oX sta sti/ bcom lda na 'das gshin rje gshed po'i nga ku' 'khor rab 'bru che/sa kyi sngub thabs 'phrin las kyi nyi rma 'bum gyi gzi brjing khyar 'es bya ba/ bla ma dang bcom/ ldan 'angs dang/la gshin rje g.ye/da kyi lha tshogs thams cad la phyag 'tshal/ 'o / /'od gsal rdo rje 'bar ba'i snang bas/ phyogs cha 'gengs/ /ma lus bdud sde 'i tshogs pa be+e myo brgyar 'jo gru sa mjad nga / /bla med bla ma 'bor lo'i rma/gon la gus pa sa 'dung/ /srid 'ji bas sdo/na rje'i 'jigs pa che las bsku ba ṭi gsol/ /phyi nang 0/sang ba'i sa than rje 'jo che4 sa rma jad lha/ /rnam pa du ma/'i sku dang gsung thugs kyi/ /ma/tha' yas rol nga rdo na myosang da dkyil 'khor pa/ /de ngas rnam sa pa/re nga gus pas phyag /re chal le/ /rdo shī 'dzin pas rab ( ro / ra/sa rgyud sde sa /sngags dang dkyil sga bor che ga dpag ya/sa gsung ru / /de sdu/myo skye bo rbems la gsal ba'i phyir/ /sngags rig rma nga pos las re e cho ga pa ce rngo sa/ /'as/ chogs 'khru/la 3bor gru/thar thug sto myo pa 'i rgyud/ /dmar nag 'jigs/ sa sum 'es grags rgyung 'ang ༄ / /rma/khas grub du mas gsal bsdo da mjad nga rnam sa/ /mtha' dag rtogs phyir 5dag sis ngal ba bya/ bsta na bcos mtha' ngag rnyed dpo' bas / /lugs brgya gsal byed nyung ngu'i gtarme// /don rab rgya rer rab gsal ba/ /mtha' dag lta ba'i me 'o/nga yin/ bco gru ldan 'das gshin rje gshed nga mar po la phyag 'chal lo/ —/༷/ra ngang por nga kyal 'khor chen ngo/'i rdo rje smo pa

tshogs rjes yi rang / /rjo gas sangs rgyas dang dam pa'i chos/ /tshogs mchog bcas la skyabs su mchi/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /rang si lus 'di dbul bar bgyi/ /dam pa'i chos kun ston pa yi/ /sgra dbyangs mdzes pas bzhugs su da tshes sa la / /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /de sras lam/ gyur sbyin so gas tshul/ /sku gsum ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /rab tu dad nga/sa bsten nga ra bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don sgrub phyir/ /rjo gas pa'i byang chub sem/sa bskyed bgyi/ /bsod nam/sa kun nas gang bsags pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed du/ /gyur nas bdag gis 'gro phan bgyid/ /ces lan sa sum/ brjod/ oX āXhūX badz+ra muX zhes gshegs su gsol/tshad med ba/zhi spyi dang mthun/ rang bzhin dang bra'/ stong pa ste/ /rgyu yis kyang ni mtshan ma/ med/ /rnam par rtog dang bral nyid kyis/ /smon nga/ rnam par spangs pa'o/ /oX hūṃ n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa/ ko3haX/ chag stu/'i sgru ba thabs su/ skabs 'dir nā da 'jog pe ra bshad pa ni gzhan mang po dang mthun cing / dam pa'i man ngas 3 na pa sa spyir mi 'gog kyang / lugs 'di'i rgyud gzhung las mi gsal bas mi dgos (ra / 'dir yi ger lnga 'jos rnga/ra 'dod pa ni gsang 'dus zhabs lugs kyi rgyas bkab ha cang tha‘ra ches pa'o/ /sto/nga nga/'i ngang las aX las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ huX las byung ba'i rdo rjesngon po rtse lnga pa/ de las rdo rje'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/thad kar rdo rje'i khor yug gi nang du rwa ba/ steng du rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ mang 'i dra ba/ phyi nang phyogs thams cad du ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo rab tu yangs shing rgya che ba dang bcas par gyur/ skabs 'di —3—

dag dang 'brel ba la pad+ma srung bas mdzad pa'i nag po'i sgrub thabs sogs/ nag po'i phyogs 'gag zhig tu/ dur khrod bshad pa dang rig pa ma/tshungs khro/'i phyir/ da rma ra po la ya nga dur khrong yod na legs rbe⑪ /dmar nag gi gzhung pha la cher las dur khrod mi 'byu’nga ba ni/ ska'/ ba nga/nga mi snan pa tshogs pa'i nang du dur khrod :/ 'bri bar gsungs pa dang gnad gcig pe sa/ rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa de tsam du zad la/ des na gsang sngags nang pa'i khro bo chen po'i dkyil 'khore yin pas/ bri ba dang bsgom pa gnyis ka la dur /brod yod na byin rlabs che zhing bzang la/ med kyang chad pa'i nyes pa chung ba ni yin te/ phyis phal cher gyis ma mdzad do/ /'on kyang 'ji dag gi gzhung du gto5 nas ma gsungs pa ni ma yin te/ skye bos dben phyogs dur khrod sogs/ /zhes gnas kyi khyad par gsungs pa'i zur gyis 'phangs par yang shes so/ /de la dur khrod kyi mtshan nyid ni spyi dang 'dra la/ 'dir de yi phyi rol mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/ ces brjod/ yang dur khrod kyi mngon rtogs 'bring du bsgom par 'dod na/ phyi rol tu gtum drag la sogs pa/ dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung zhing zhes pa nas/ mchod rdzas sna tshogs pas gang ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar rdo rje /snang gas byed kyi sgru ba thabs snying po bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /rgyas pa la mos na/ shing dang phyogs skyong dang /zhing skyo/nga dang / klu dang / sprin la the(gas pa spyi dang mthun par gsal btab kyang legs la/ nga /nga 'e rwa ba'i lugs ltar shar nas phyogs g.yas sko/ra dang / me nas mtshams g.yas skor gyis/ ga/tshur/ drag drag tu rgod pa dang / /drag po mun byed ca co sgrog /bi bhi ṣa ṇa 'bar ba'i rigs/ /dmyal sogs dbyibs can dur khrod brgyad/ /na ga ge sar pa dhi nga / /rno~Xskyong aṭ+wā dhi ༵dhi ////ra ṭa dang rmi rnyi hūṃ//ja yan ta 1 dnga~Xrdo—4—

dponang rngu pre la rna/rgedza na cos na tris cernga / ra ba bod pa/ gshin rje dam ra po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs kyi rjes su sna brangs nas pa sha 'den car brjong pa ra bya sgyu sna/ /nge la skyabs 'gro sems/ nga skyad yig brgya bdud rtsi myang pa rnam tre/ snga myo du btang je rang ste/sna cig gis gshin rje dam ra ngo/'i skur sa/sa 'a ba'i snying gar/ paṃ/ las nga/khyu dang / aX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du / yaX yi ga gi dbus su hūṃ dam/ra po/ de las 'od ('phros rang bzhin gyi gnas myos/ gsha myo/ rje gshed ngo/'i sna bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'bar/bla ma rdo rje 'chang sangs/ rgyas byang chub sems dang/'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun kyi nam/ tshu/༈par byon nga/ra kyu/ ra/ sto nga nyid snying rje gcig nga/'i sku/ /srid sa/su/ma/ bde chen ngo bo nyid/ /spros pa'i dri mas rma/ gos pa'i/ /bla myog/ rdo rje can zhabs/ ri dud / / /bdud ba'i po na rnam nga/ra 'joms/ /dang/'a bo gdul dka' 'dul ba ngo / /gsan rje mthar byeng phyag 'tshal 'ing / /dkyil 'kho1ra lha tshogs rnam/sa 'a /spru dud/ /ci6 kā sogs lha mo rnam/sa/ kyis mchod nga/ra bsam/sa te/ oX ar+ghaṃ pra tisnro sngu/ha/ sde brdo can du ngu bye/ oṃ— ba dro pur+sha āXthiX/ de bsto du dha pe nas/ sha lta' bar du sbyar/ lko ba po redi dag tu hruXsriXhaXsogs/ byed pa/ ya nga spyir shin tu les ji shi spre / sngas sa nge gzhon rje g.yer kyi sbo ru rtsos kyang yi rme rnge/da/ lugs 'di'i ra/chod pa yin tshad la bzang mdog ston pa'i phyi ra/ nge 'ba' zhig rang ngo ma/tham/ du sbyor mi dmas te/ dkyil 'khor mchod nga/ dang gtor ma dang sbyin sre sa ༄ sa po/mu pa 'i /zud nga ra gyi skabs 'ga' zhig tu nges par bya yi/ tshogs/ zhing cam dang ma/chod pa phra cho rngam/sa la ja lta ra 'os nga/ sbyar bas chog go /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sdig /bgyis ngang de bzhin bgyid stsa'/ gang / /gang yang rjes sda/ yi rang ba/ /de kun dus gsum stso ma ba|na la nga yan gas/ /rje rdogs sangs thre)sa dang de yi sras/ /'phags/ rnam sa dge —2—

'e/sgo—ta/ /sna jum dang lha'i 'khor de sgo/—/u ca ya rnams lus phyed thon/ /sgrog byed ser po ldog byed sngo/ /'jigs byed dkar ngo/ 'khor byed se ra/ /'gengs byed dmar po char 'bebs sngo/ /gtu' / pa nag po 'thug po dkar/ /nor rgyas ser po pad+ma dkar/ /stobs rgyu nag po 'jog po dmar/ /hu lun ta sngo rigs ldan ljang / /dung skyong ser po pad can dkar/ /'es pa ltar bsgo mas kyang rung la/ zhing skyong rnams yum dang bcas pa 'khor mkha' 'gro rigs drug drug gis bskor ba yang yong ngo/ /yang na zhing skyong brgyad ni/ shar du gtum ngo/ ser po spyi blugs thod pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor dpal 'jin dam ra ngo 'phreng ba/ lhor rnams 'jigs nag po dbyug nga//lho nub tu drag ngo mun byed ser ngo/ gri gug nub tu 'od kyi ‘sna phra nga ba ca'atsho dkar po sbru' zhags/ nub byang du ca co sgrog pa sngon ngo/ rlung ras sngo skya/ byang du gha ba ta ra ser po rdo rje/ byang shar du gad mo cher sgrogs pa dkar po rtse gsu smag nga/nga thod bi 8'dzin pa/ thar/sa cad kyang spya na gsum drag po'i lus can no/ /'ji sno/ba dpon la ma nga/ rak+ṣa tas nag ngo/'i sgrub thabs su gsungs pa'i lugs/ yin/ dur khrod kyi rma ngan nga ra rdo/ ngabs nga snye3di/ 'dir bstan gshin rje gshed kye sgrub thabs thams cad 3 / 'byer par bya'o/ /de nas 'di skad ces bya ste/ srung ba'i /3khor le'i rmang du/ nga da zla la gnas pa'i saX/ las/ rdo rje saX gyes mchan nga/ las/ chos kyi 'khyu/nga tsho gnas gru gsum phyi dkar la nang cung zang dmar ba/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du bstan cing gdengs ka che nga gyen du da dzi phyas sa pa/kun tu bzang po /pab yum gyi ngo bo/ de'i nang du paX las sna rtsogs pad+ma dang / hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje brtse gas rnga/'i lte bar/ zle las 'bor lo dkar ngo/ rtsi bas bcu gnyis nga/ bhuX gyis ma/cha'i ni pa yongs su gyur pa las/ sangs rgyas rnam par —5zhe

snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin gzhal med khang grub par gyur/ ces so/ /chag lo dang bla ma chos kyi rgyal po dang / shong blo brtan rnams kyis skabs 'dir rnam snang zhal phyag gi rnam pa can mi bskyed nga/ nyid bla ma'i man ngag tu snang zhing 'jug pa bde la/ mkhas mchog bu'i rnal 'byor bzhi gsal sogs phyi ma rnams las rnam snang skyed par mdzad pa yang / rtag pa'i yan lag yang dag byung / /zhes dpal 'dzin gyi gzhung gi dgongs par ni gsal 'e sto /gzhan yang sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig las/ kun tu bzang po zhal phyag gi rnam pa can bskyed nas/ de zhu ba las chos 'byung dgod pa dang / sa bon las bskyed pa'i 'byung ba bzhi gcig tu 'dus pa las/ rnam snang du skyed pa dang / de zhu ba las gzhal yas khang bsgom pa yod cing / sgrub thabs gzhan 'ga' las kyang / de dang phyogs mtshungs su bshad pa dang / nag po'i rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa dang / dmar po'i rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa 'di dag gsang ba 'dus pa'i rjes su 'gro ba'i rgyud kyang yin mod kyi/ gsang 'dus ni rgyud rgyas pa yi na zhing / de la cho ga'i spros pa yang rgyas pa 'chad cing 'os kyang / 'byung bzhi ni gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs la'ang med la/ 'di ni rgyud bsdus pa nyid kyi phyir/ cho ga yang cung zad bsdu sa pa sbyor rigs pas/ don gyi rkang 'dra ba la bsdus pa 'thad pas/ chos 'byung dang gzhal yas khang gi rgyur lha sku mi bsgo ma par/ de dang de lha'i ngo bor mos pa byed pa nyid legs shing /gzhal yas khang gi rgyur 'byung bzhi bsgom pa ni/ dmar po'i rgyud las lha lnga'i phyogs la gsungs kyang / bcu gsum ma'i phyogs nas rag po dang mtshungs dgos pa'i phyir dang / rgyud de las de mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ rgyud kyi dbongs pa'i bstan tshod thob thang dang bstun na/ dmar po bcu gsum ma'i skabs 'dir bsgom mi dgos so/ /de lta na yang slob dpon dpal 'dzin nyid kyi bzhed gzhung srong na/ chos 'byung gi skabs su/ sa byung rdo rje bzang po yi/ /yan lag chos 'byung zur gsum dkar/ /zhes rdo rje'i yan lag ste/ rdo rje'i gzugs las byung bar bshad pa dang / gzhal yas khang la 'khor —6—

——lo'i yan lag ces ri/ gsungs par/ rtag pa'i yan lag gces 'byu1nga bas/ rnam/ snang zhu ba las gzhal yang khang ba sbom nyid gzhung de'i lugs la dgos par gsal lo/ /'dir dang/la 'dzin gyi bzhed gzhung rjes su skyong na de'i rang lugs yin pas rnam pa gcig tu na sgom pa'i lugs legs ‘ra// gnyis sun chos 'byung gi skabs dang dod snyoms shing rgyud na mi gsal ba nyid rgyu rma/chan mo / /de ya nga 'di ltar/ thar pa chen po'i khang bzang gzhal yas khang rin po che sna lnga las rdzogs par grub pa/ thub pa'i dbang po'i 'od zer gyis mtha' yas pa'i phyogs kun tu khyab nga// gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig nga/ rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu dmar ngo/sa bskor ba'i steng na gser kyi ske rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha na 'phyang ba'i dra ba dra phyed/ de'i steng du bya 'dabs las 'phyang ba'i shar bu/steng du mda' yab mchod rten gyi dbyibs can gyis yongs su bskor ba (pa/ rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la se(gas pa rgyan thams cad kyis rnam/ par brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi 'gram 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la/ bzhugs stangs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gzungs ma rnar/sa kyis mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du/ bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs kyi rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mos brgyan pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud gyi phyi mtshams dang / grwa bzhir zla phyed la gnas pa'i rin po che la rdo rjes mtshan pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du bum pa bzang po dang dpag bsam gyi shing dang / rgyal srid sna bdun dang / sprin gyi gseb nas —7—

byung ba'i lha/ mo me tog gi 'phreng ba thogs pa rnams 'khord nga// gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi gzhi la sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa/ rdo rje'i rwa rnams dang / gzhal yas khang bi steng 'og gzhi rnams/ shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus sngon po'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba gru bzhi la/ mtha' nas rdo rje sngon po'i 3phreng bas ye bskar ba/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbus kyi lte ba dang / shar gyi rwa rtsa ngang /rdo rje rwa'i mtshams kyi grwa bzhi po rnams su/ zla ba'i gdan/ rwa'i rtsa ba gzham gsum dang / sgo bzhir nyi ma'i gdan/ nyi zla tham/sa cad kyang sna tshogs nga/bla'i lte ba la sa/nas pa'o/ /de yan chad ni rna' 'byor ba 'asnye re sngon 'gro'i chos yi na yang / rnal 'byor dang po'i khongs su bsdu bar bya'o/ / dbus kyi gdam gyi steng du/ a/ ā / 6/ yī/ u mū/ṛ rī/ '-i lī/ a i/ e au/ aX aX phrag gnyis zhu ba la sa byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar po/ de'i steng du/ ra la ga gha nga / ca tsha ja dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa sgye ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha rma// ya ra la wa pho/ ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa bha/phrag gnyis rnams zhu ba las/ byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dgru ra po/ de ltar zla ba gnyis kha sbyor ni me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de gnyis gcig tu 'dres nga/ ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so / /nge'i steng du huX yig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa ni so sor rtes/ nga 'i ye shes so/ /'dir dar/ra ngo/ bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ chas 'gyur pas/ mnyam/ pa nyid ni de gcig 'id/ /so sor kun rtog de byung hūX/ /'es zla gnyis gcig tu 'dres pa de las byung ba'i huX yig ces rnga/'i don du snang ba/ dmar ngo bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs la chag lo sogs bod snga phyi pha 'a/ cher de 0zhin du 'dod/ 'on kyang nga pa la 'dzin gyi nag po'i sgrub thabs/ 'gyur rnying rngams su/ nge/ das gcig gyur rma/nyam pa nyid/ /der skyes huX ni so —8—

spre lte bsnye shad dod dod dod dod don rtse sor snye rtog/snye dag cha ces bcwa / rab dgas par mthong 'a/—des na—ru 'dar yang/ de byung zhesang// der byung zhes gnas gzhi'i sgra yong par byas nas// zla ba gshis zhu ba'i steng du sa/ bonā dang phyag ra chan bsgo gru pa ra byas na/ sa shan rje gshed bcu gsum/ 'a/bor 'o 'i rgyud gzhung ga6the tham/sa ci dud dang mthun cing //tabs (skugs sogs ngang ya nga rme chungs sdo par 'gyur bas de bzhin dā byas na legs so snyem pa ni bang ri/ gi rnam rtog yi zhin zhang / bla rma ches kyi rgyal ngo/sa kyang bshad do/ /dam/ra jo bcu gsum ma la / dā na shwe la dang glo/ bo le che ba'i 'gyur yod 'dug pa/ rnyeng 'e brtag par du la / cha kya lu gas la 'pho gas smor gyi rigs 'gre byung ngam/ snyam mo/ /de las dbyus nga/ dkar ngo/ rdo rje'i rtse cho/ can mi ma/go rlon pa ser jo/sa mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su nyi ma/ la hūṃ da mar pos mtshang sna par gyur/ oX badz+ra daṇ+ḍa at+pa/ ko3haX/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdas/ nyid rgyu rdo rje 'chang dpal bde pa chen po rdo rje se mas dpa' gshin rje gshed sku mngog dkar la yid cam nga tswa/sna ba'i ma/ngangs can/ rol ṭā4 ) khro bo chen ngo/ spya/na gsum/ pa dbu skra gyen skyu4/rdzes stan/ lpags nga/nga sbru༄ gye na can/ phyag g.yas nga/sa thod dbyug dang /sa / 5 na ri/si/ thod /drag 'ji myo rnge// nga/da zla 'a/ g.yo/na brkyang gi stabs kyis pa8nugs sgong / shes rab kyi pha to( 5 tu phyin pa'i ngo bo/ rang snang gi yum/ gyis 'a/rtsud rnga/'o / /'di ni sku che/nges shing ro la pe 'i /bro bo yin pa dang / ma/ sta'i gang na meng cing sku bye dos/ bi khyad par cam ma gtogs/ ga/ nan khyad par ye ma/ gsu ngas pas ches gzigs su/ yangs pa'e mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis kyang / 'ang/ sgeg pa'i khro bo yin pas/ dbu skra dmar se ra gyer brdzes dang sma ra med/ thod pa skam rlon dang stag lpags sbrul rgyan sogs mi/ rung ngo gsung ba ni/ kyai rdor bde mchog sos/ru/ he ru ka sgeg khros chen po rnams la ji ltar yod pa thugs kyis snyel pa'o/ /de —9—

dag ni mngon byang lnga las rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa rdzogs rnga/ ste/ rnal 'byor bzhi las rnal 'byor dang pho/ /de nas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i rkyen gyis yab kyi thugs ka'i huX las ye shes kyi 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'gro ba thams cad sangs/ rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan du byas te/ thams cad kyang bde ba chen po'i ngo bor zhu ste/ rang nyid la thim/ rang sems kyi snang ba'i gtso bo nam mkhar gnas la/oX āXhuX hoX dmar po gnyis kyi mtha' brten par gyur nga/'i yi ge lnga ngo/ de nyid skar mad/'a 'pho ba ltar byon te/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku la zhugs/ gzhi la gnas pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang 'dres/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma'i nang du chud pa tsam gyis/ dpal bde ba chen po yab yum gyi sku yang / de dag dang ro gcig par byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste/ 'ong/ gsal ba'i rang bzhin thig le'i ngo bor gyur to/ /'di chag lo'i sgrub thabs na/ ya/ba yum zhu ba nyid yi ge lngar gyur nga/ dang /gzhung las skar mda' 'pho ba lta bur gsungs pa'i rdon ya/nga yi ge lnga po gcig la gcig thim/ nas mthar thig ler gyur pa la 'chad do/ /lo tsā ba de ni ma/khas bcun bzang ba'i tshad du phyin nga/ ngang /rgya bal paṇa grub kyi man ngag phyin ci ma log pa mnga' ba dang / rgyal ba'i bstan pa gces par 'dzin pas rang bzo mi mdzad pa'i phyir/ lugs de spong du ni mi rung yang rgyud dang gzhung gi dgongs pa ni dkyus su bshad pa nyid yin zhing / ye shes zhabs lugs sogs phyogs mthun gyi rgyab rten rnams dang yang mthun no/ /yang / thig le las sprul pa'i tsartsi kā la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhi po rnams phyogs bzhir 'khode nas/ 'od gsal las bzhengs par bsku' ba ni/ thugs rje'i khro bo rje btsun nyid bzhengs shig /sa gsum mtha' das —10—

rmongs pa bsal mdzod cig /jo bo bdud bzhi po 'di las rgyal ba/ /sems ni g.yengs so rje btsun nyid bzhengs shig /'dir sems ni g.yengs so zhes pa shong blo brtan gyis/ dgyes pa'i thugs kyis zhes bsgyur ba don legs pa 'dra'o/ /'jig rten mgron gnyer stong nyid bzhugs sam ci/ /rje btsun 'jig rten bsod nams nyid kyis bzhengs/ /byang chub rang bzhin 'jig rten mgron gnyer nas/ khyod ni stong nyid sems shing ci la bzhugs/ /zhes bskul bas byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le'i phung po cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha shas gcig cha gsum du gyur cha shas dang po/paX las sna tshogs pad+ma/ yang cha shas gnyis pa aX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ra/yang cha shas gsum pa maX las ma he dmar po dregs shing khros pas sdang ba dang gdug pa thams cad gsod cing dngangs par byed pa/ smin rdzi dang sma ra rab tu 'bar ba/ me lce 'bar ba'i rwa brdar zhing / rmig pa brdabs pas 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par byed pa/ mi rus kyi 'phreng bas brgyan par gyur/ gdan de rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du/ byang chub sems kyi phung po steng ma cha ci shos de hūX yig dmar por gyur/ de las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su gzugs brnyan shar ba'i tshul gyis nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūX dmar po'o/ /de las 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros/ 'phags pa rnams mchod/ sems can thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po/ dpa' bo chen po nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang mtshungs pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa gar dgu'i nyams kyi ro dang ldan pa/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor ma —11—

lus/༄rtse ge geg pa zo ri spud pa'i ye shes kyi me nga/ngu/rnar ge ge spo dod dod dang dug 'phro ring rib pa'i/ dza sde ge dbus 'a bshugs pa/ 0ku nas cag pyas sa nyas/ / ga na si 'jis ren po/su ma 'dul bar byed pa'i dbyug pa dar/si rdzong ma pa rdo rja / / rtse glo/ ca phyo/༈ rmi — 8 go ridzin myo/ rja / ser ri tshe pa / sa/ slo cha phyo pa steng du 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod pa dkar ngo/ ye /shwes/ nga dud rtsi rna4/ rnga nge sa gang ba thugs ka'i thad kar 'jin pa'i tshul gyis yum la 'khyu/da pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum drag po'i lta stangs kyis sa/zigs shing me 'od 'phro ba/ drag tu 'bar ba'i mche ba gtsikas shing ljags skyod pa/ bzhin shin tu 'gyu/ra ba'i khro gnyer 'jigs su rung zhing / rma/grin pa 'uX gi sgras gang ba/ sma ra smin ma/ dbu skra khams ser gyen du brdzes nga// zhabs spru/ji shwa ru/ bskum g.yon brkyang pa'i gyad chen po'i 'dor stabs kyis nga/bla nyi ma ma/ he gdong g.yas su bstan rnga ri/ rnam/ru brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ gshin rje nag ngo/ da sdug nga/ ngang 'gas pa/ thogs nga/ kha bub tu bskyel zhing brjis pas de brgya 'di/ 'ing rmyo sa/ rnga// sku spo/ma zhing thung ba/gsus khyim che ba / bdud ba'i bsgral ba 'a sdi / nga/gas rtsogs la yer pa ba/ stag gi lpags pa'i tsho smad dkris cung zang grol 'ing / mi —gru/so skam/ po lnga'i dbu rgyan ngang /rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shan la can// klu'i rgyal ngo/ mtha' ya sa sgro 'e ngo/sa/ dbu sgra bcings shing / 'jos/ ngo/ da mar ngo/sa rbe rgyan byas/ pa/ rigs lnga/na khra bos/ dpung pa brgyan cing / dung skyong ser pos phyag sa/dub byas nga / pad+ma dkar pos mgul ba brgyan cing / stobs kyi rgyu ljang khus mchod phyir gro /gas byas pa/ nor rgyas kyi bu bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bus ske rags bcings pa/ pad+ma chen po dkar pos zhabs gdub byas pa/ thams cad kyang gdug pa'i sbrul nor bu'i gdengs —12—

— spo ba — spo ba sde spo spo sde tho spo 4sde——— tho ba rderderderderderderderderderderderderderderdelo dpa/ lce gnyis 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba can no/ /de la 'khyud pa'i bcom lde na 'das ma 4/nga sku mdog dang / phyas mtshar dang / rgyan rnams bcom lda phyo/ 'das dang myo 5 chungs pa las/ gcer lca mi mgo skam po'i do shal can/ tshangs skud spa ngas pa/ phyag gnyis ya/ba kyi mgu ku pre nas 'byud cing / 'bas ga ji(/dra brkyang si sdabs kyis gru/nyam par sbyor ba/ khro cher blo dbang phyug mchog gi cha byad rdzob/sa ༵ ༵ ༵༵rni/ sna~X/༵t+yā ༵tshan ༵rdo ༵༵ rlo~X /༵dhi/ ༵rdo~Xji : rdornyi/༵rnyi~Xs+ho~Xrdo~X'o / /rno /ḍi ༵ ༵༵ ༵ ༵ri tshore ༵༵ ༷༵ ṭā/ ༵ḍi ༵ ༵ bskyad spre ri dra wo rbo sprun rkyo/ra mi chi ba0da pa 'i bo ri9 ) yi na snyenang ngon du gtso bo yab yum dang thugasaka'i se ma sa dpa' sa/'is rna6chi mu/ dus gcal tā ji/nga nga yi/3 nga sa tsho/ cho ga snga phyi'i rim/ pa phyog yi/na pa /tāphyir/ dmags rnga/sa de lke zong bsgor dbos pa/ rmo ra ngas bi brjong tshur snga byi 'a khwad re/nga ngo ༵bkun ṭa kya~Xrdzu~X sna ri chi rkya da / rdo / tsho rjo ༵ ༷ / / ༵༵ rdo ༵༵gā~Xrnyi~X ༵ ༵༵rdoba'i ze 'bru bu sa/ ra phaṭa hūṃ ru klo cha phyo pa / / oṃ sarba ta thā tsho a nu rā sa ṇa badz+ra swaphadaga' ༵spya/ zhi'i kyi ༵snyo ni/ dzhai~Xrwa pa~Xngo ༵/hūṃ/༵༵/rte / rta / sgo ri~Xtshor / ༵༵ gyi lterdoba'i 'og tu pad+ma da dru/ra po'i lte bar / hru yis dmar ngo/ / rang gi spyi bo'i bdud rtsi las 'thon pa'i re ༄ dag pa ra po pad+ma'i snal gru/ lta bu/ hru 0 yag gi rtse mor 'bab bzhan par gyur/ 'ji la shes rab 'phel ba'i cho ga zhes bya'o//—13—

de nas byang chub mchog gi nga rgyal dang bcas pas/ tseX( dharmā dha tu sla bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/zhes brjod te/ de ltar rjes chags kyi rgyu bde ba bsgom pa dang / bar srid zhugs pas zhu ba dang /glus bskul ba dang / sems dpa' gsum brtseg tu bzhengs pa dang / rjes chags dang / shes rab skyed pa dang / byang chub mchog gi nga rgyal bzung ba ste/ don tshan bdun po de ni rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ rang gi /zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma spros te/ byang chub kyi sems kyi cha gcig gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i lha'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ cha gcig cha bcu bdun du gyur pa/ de rnams ya snye ma me da/ ya smo ni rā dza sa do sa ṇa yo ni rā rnams su gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du ya las bcom ldan sna das zhe snga nga gshin rje gshed dmar po/ dpa' bo chen po nas/ khro mo'i dbang phyug mchog bi/ cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /snying po'i shar du snye las 'khor lo snyes mtshan pa las gti mus gshin rje gshed sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas na 'khor lo bsnams nga/sto/ lho ra rma 'a/sa rin po che mas mtshan pa las/ phra ma gzhan rje gshed ser po g.yas rin ngo/ che 83dzin pa/ nub tu me las pad+ma mes mtshan pa las/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po g.yas na pad+ma 'jin pa/ byang du da las ral gri das mtshan pa las/ phrag dog gshin rje gshe/da ljang khu/ g.yas ral gri bsnams pa/ shar sgor ya las/ tho ba yas mtshan pa las/ tho ba gzhin rje gshed mthing kha/ /phyag sa yas rdo rje tho ba rwa nyi shu pa bsnams pa/ lho sgor ts+tsha las dbyug pa :rdzo mtshan nga/ 'a/sa/ dbyug pa bzhen rje —/4—

gshe/da dkar po/ phyag g.yas thod dbyug 'dzin pa/ nub sgor ni las pad+ma ni sa mtshan pa las// pad+ma gshin rje gar/da dmar po/ phyag g.yas pad+ma 'dzin nga//byang sgor rā las ral gri rus mtshan pa las/ ral gri ru gshan rje gshed ljang sngon/ phyag g.yas ral gri 'dzin pa/ de ltar khro bo brgyad po rnam/sa rang snang gi shes rab ma la 'khyu/da pa/ lhag ma gtso bo dang rnam pa mtshungs nga/'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i grwa bzhir shar lhor dza las nor 'khar lo dzas mtshan pa las/ tsartsi kā dkar mo skem/ zhing khros/ pa / phyag g.yas snyen ra lo 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu sa las rdo rje sas mtshan pa las/ phag mo sngo sangs phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa/ drag mo chen mo phag bi gdong pa/ can/ nub byang du do las pad+ma dos mtshan pa las/dbyangs can ma dmar mo phyag g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zhi zhing sgeg la chags pa'i nyams kyis/ brgyan pa'i khro mo'o/ /byang shar du ru las ral gri rus mtshan pa las/ go rī ljang khu phyag g.yas ral gri 'dzin pa/ phag mo dang rgo riganyis sbom zhing thung 'a lto ba rgyas pa ste/ gti mug gshi/na rje gshed dang lha mo bzhi zla ba'i gdan/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la g.yo ni brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas shing /thams cad kyang phyag g.ye7na pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnam pa/ lha mo rnams kyang mchod phyir thogs spangs shing lhag ma rgyan dang na bza' sogs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi grwa bzhir/ ṇa yo ni ra/ yi ge bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma la gnas pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi'o//nag gtso dzi ༵ ༵ ༵ //pag rdi med ḍi/ sgro ༵ dhi sbyi~X kyi bcom ldan ༵sna ༵ /5—

gtsakre tshe dang bcas nga/'i ba spu' bus/ nas phyar phyung/ shege she mkha' dbyings thams/ /)rdze sde cang deyongs su gang / sems can thams cad kyi don mja nga// khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa zhe sdang sbyangs/ 'e sdang ṣ+ka'i/ myo rje gshed kyi go 'phang /rā b.rad/ chur 'dus gcig tu 'dres/ dkyi'/ 'khor gyi gtso bo rang nyid kyi thug sa kar thim/ bde tsho stong sa nyas su meng nga/ pa gsum ye shes lā'i bang/ga 'ing 6 gar/ oṃ ji na dzo / 7) /ri ri/ / 9ga ri nga ri ri 7 / ༷/pe phu zhesdu ka/ swāhā/ mkha' nang ga thugs ta mug gsan rja kla/zhad dang/ga tā mad nga spros/ phya/ dbyibs/ kyi bcom ldan 'das ma gtso bo dang bcas ri/'i ba spu'i bu ga nas byi ra byung / rla/kha' dbyings thams cad khrongs su gang / gta mug po/ thin rje ga sdo/spyad kyi go 'phang la/ bkod/ chur 'dus gcig tu 'dres/ sems/ ca phyo/ thar/sa byod kyi don ma/jad/ /byad par du yang nyon cho/ngas pa gti mug sbyangs / phyi'i gzhal ya/sa khang chen ngo 'i nang gi sna tshogs rdo rje'i shar gyi rwa'i rtsa bar pad zla'i gdan la 'khod nga/ra gyur/ oṃ rat+na dhika swāhā/ phra rma gzhin/ rje gshed bye khyad pa/ྈ du nga rgya'/ dang ser sna sgo phra ma gshin rje gshed kyingu nang gi stsa/ tshogs rdo rje'i lho'i rwa'i rtsa bar nga/da nyi : oṃ a ro nal ka swāhā/ ‘re dod chags gshin rje gshedangu khyad nga ra 'jo/nga/ chags kyi rnam rtog sngo 'dod chags gshin rje sa—sked ku tsho bye nub kyi ra'i rtsa nga/ra rngo.oṃ pradz+nyā dhika swāhā/ phrag dog na gzhan rje gshed: khyad nga/ra phrag da tshes ri dgaci kla/ nyes/ panguphrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi: byang sga pa oṃ mung ga ra dhi mo / swāhā bro ba blos shan rje gshed rjo phung po'i bdud bcom/ dang nga/'i stebs la bkod/ shar sgor pa oX daṇ+ḍa khu dha ka swāhā/ dbyug pa gsha myo/ rje gshad ze nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs la bkod/ lho sgor bye —༷/༷ —nga/rla dhika swāhā/ pad+ma gshin rje gshe/da5

'chi bdag rgi bdud bcom/ dran pa'i stobs/ la bkod/ nub sgo: lkoX kha dru dhika —swāhā/ ral gri gshin rje gshed: lha yi/ bu'i bdud bcom/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs la bkod/ byang sgor pad nyi 'a ngu oX mo hā ra ti swāhā/ lha mo tsartsi tshu khyad par sa/'i ༈spam sa sbya ngas/ byams nga/ chen po la bkod/ sna tshogs rdo rje 'i shar lho 'i grwar pad zla la 'khod/ oṃ dī ṣa ra ti swāhā/ lha mo rdo rje phag glo/sngo chu'i lam/sa rgyo snying rje chen ngo/rgyo sna tshogs rdo rje'i lho nub kyi grwar pad zla la oṃ rā ga ra ti sru/hā/ lha cho/ rdo rje nga byangs can ma: rme 'i lams dga' ba chem ngo/rgyo nub byang gi grwar pad zla 'a// oX bsha ra ti swāhā/ lha mo rdo rje go ru rlung gi kham/sargyobatang snyoms chen pa sgo byang shar gyi grwar pad zla la: tseXdz+nya āXhūṃ/ lan bzhi/ thong nga/ bzhi gdan dang bcas pa: khyad par yul drug gi dri ma sbyangs/ mngon par shes nga drug 'a/ bkod/ phyi'i grwa bzhi las pad+ma'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ oX āXcingaX/sa zhal yang khang : khyad par snod kyi 'jig rten sbyangs/ dag pa'i zhing khams rme bkod/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i ga 'al ya/sa khang la thim/ zhes so/ /ma/ngal du gzhal rnga5sa khang bskyed pa spro ba 'di chag los ma/ ṅgā dzad/ 'di'i sgrub thabs mjad pa po bod nga la cher gyis che dzad ceng / de ya nga rgyung sa 'a ༄ nga gzhan chems dang mthun pas snrir btang du legs/ pa ra ma/nga myo pa lder jung dir lā chi nga ba tshing do /'on kyang dmar nag gi sgrub thabs dpal 'jin gyis ma/dzad pa na/ ma/ba 'a nang du ga 'ad mi rngu nga lang mi bskyed pa nyid de/ gzhung bsdus pa'i phyogs la de yang shin du 'thad cing rag tra5 nga/ rni dgyes rdo rngo/ra ba 'phyo/ te/ de lta bas na ji ltar cho/sa nga/ de ltar bya'o/ /de ltar sangs rgyas rnams sku 'a sa zhug pa dang / mkha' nang du dkyil 'kho/ra bskyed pa ngang / spro bsdu'i sgo nas phyi rol tu 'god pa ste/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spro ba shin tu rnal 'byor ro/ /lha —/7—

tham sa cad kyi mig tu snyiX las 'khor lo khriX gis mtshan pa las/ rdorje mig ba༈( mug gshin rje gshe/da lta bu/ rna bar dziX las rdo rje dziX gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje rna ba nag po rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ snar khaX las rin ngo/ che khaX gis mtshan pa la sa/ rdo rje sna phra ma gshin rje gshed lta bu/ lce la gaX las nga/bla gaX bis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje lce 'dord chags ston rje gde/da lta bu/ dpral bar ski la sa ral gri skoX this ma/chan pa las/ rdo rje lus phrag dog gshi/na rje gshe/da lnga bu/ lde bar saX las rdo rje se gis rma chan pa las/ rdo rje yi da dkar po rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin nga// thams cad kyang pad zla la gnas shing rol ba'i khro bo'i chul can rno//thugs kar raX las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ thugs rdo rje na kyi ngo/ rdo rje nga/nga thod khrag 'dzin nga/'i thugs kar rigaX sngon ngo// 'dir chag lo chos rgyal shong gsum/ gyi ba'e da nga/ dang ma/thun par/ thugs rdo rje phyag rma/chan 'di ltar 'thang la/ sgrub thabs/ rnal 'byor ba'i gsal sogs las/ sku mdog sngon po phyag mchan gtso bo dang 'dra bar bzhed pa/ gzhung gi nag ri dad rma/dzad pa yin yang cung zad mi legs so/ /'o na dmar po'i ga‘nung las/ snyi nga gar rdo rje 'i nga kyal gnas huX/ /rdo rje ra caX las/ thugs rdo rje/ /dus dgra'i sku mdog phyas ma/chan ldan/ /'od zer sngon po 'bar ba'o/ /zhes bshad pa ma yin nam snyam na/ da lta 'i gzhung de ha nga 3du/da cho da/ 'ad na dpal 'dzin gyis gde/da nag gi sgrub thabs dang por ma/jad nas// de 'a 'don pa spo sa nas gsheng dmar gyi sgrub thabs mdzad pas/ 'di'i thad kyi 'don nga bsgyur dgos rgyu de/ ma/ bsgyur bar lus pa'o/ /de yang nag po'i gzhung 'gyur rnying las/ snying gaྈ hūX la sa/ rdo rje'i nang / /thuX dang rdo rje 'od sngon byung / /thugs rdor zhe sdang gshin gshed kyi/ /mdog dang rma/tshom cha yang dag ྅ na/ /zhes 'byung ba dang / dmar cho/'i gzhung chag 'gyur sngar drangs pa gnyis/ tshig 'gyu/ra khyad ma gtogs don cung —/8—

zad kyang khyad ma byung zhing / nag po'i sgrub thabs la zhe sdang gshin rje gshed/ mthing ga yin pa'i phyir dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag mtshan rdo rje phyag na yod pa'i phyir/ thugs rdo rje'i mtshan nyid chang ba der 'dug /'dir de 'dra byas na zhe sdang gshin rje gshed dmar po yin pas/ dus dgra'i sku mdog ces pa dang / 'od zer sngon po zhes/ pa ya nga nang rig la bar 'gyur la/ phyag mtshan dbyug pa bsnams par byas nas/ phyi ma gnyis kyi phyag mtshan las dpags te zla stobs kyi shugs las thod pa dang mi 'grig pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dmar ngo/'i lugs kyi thugs rdo rje'i rigs la/ dbyug pa'i mtshan ma 'byung ba sgos kyi khyad chos yin no snyam na ni min te/ de yin na rdo rje'i rna ba dang yid kyang dbyug pa 'dzin dgos par 'gyur ro/ /des na rdo rje sa sum gyi sku mdog phyag mtshan spyi la grags pa nyid yin pa'i phyir thugs rdo rje ni rdo rje thod /brag 'dzin par bya'o/ /mgrin par āXlas pad+ma āXs mtshan pa ‘las/ gsung rdo rje 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu'i thugs kar āXdamar po/ spyi bor lkoX las 'khor lo oX gyis mtshan pa las/ sku rdo rje gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu'i thugs kar oX dkar po/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ gdod nas grub pa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs rgyal ba kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid thams cad spyan drangs te mdun du bzhugs par gyur/ oX badz+ra purmye āXhūX/ nas/ sna we t+ya'i bar gyis ma/chod/ thugs gsung sku rdo rje'i lha tshogs thams cad rang gi gnas gsum gyi rdo rje gsum/ 'a/ thim oX sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra su bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ lkoX sarba ta thā ga ta lka po badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya badz+ra swa bha wa at+pa ko3lha/ rang thi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa ya ba yu ma/sems dpa' sems ma khro bo yab yum gyi tshogs ngang bcas nga// mdun gyi nam —/9—

mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX dang pu zhe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta kyi sdo bhi ṣañtsa tu maX/ slob dpon rdo rje 'chang chen ngo/ra gyur pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis tshigs bcad dang dbang bskur ba'i dgongs/ nga / mjad/ sems dpa' yab yum rnams kyis bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs le/na cing / sna chogs pa'i rol mo sogs mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod/ khro bo yab yu ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ tsar tsi kā la sogs pa yum bzhi po rngams kyis/ bum pa dkar ngo tsho bdud rtsis gang ba thos/sa te/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen ngo/ ni/ /bams gsum kla yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas byung spyin nga/ra bya/ /oX sarba ta thu ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/de ltar dbang bskur bas lha thams cad kyi sku lus bdud rtsi 'i chu rgyun gyis gang /sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ ye shes lnga mngon du gyur/ chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba 'a/sa/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems—dnga' nga/nga / 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis/ dbu brgyan/ yang gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon 'a/sa 'od zer 'phro rba // rangabazhin gyi gnas nas gsham/ rje gshed dam ra po'i dkya /la ri sgyu kar gyi 'khor lo ye shes nga badz+ra sa ma jaX oṃ āXbastan ta kri be hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes bags sa/bskrad/ tsheX ā/༷sa hāXpra wa ra sa ta ka ra tshu/ ar+ghaX pra ti rte swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ngu zhe/ gi ༷༷hūṃ/ nas bshas 'a bar gyis rme/drod/ o mung ga ra jaX oX/ daṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma baX/ oX kha mi hoX dam tshig se mas/ dang/'i dkyil 'khor dang ye ḍā/sa sems/ dpa'i dkyil ri/spor gnyis/ su med par gyur/ yang rang gi snying ga nas ra red zer 'phros/ sa/ngas rngu/ sa nga nga byang chub sem/sa/ dang/(sna thams cad spya myo/ drangs// 'dod yon dang bcas/ nga/ bkug ste rang gi —ge ()—

skul cha rtse ge zhugs/ thugs kar rjes/ za/sa kyi me/ḍā/ yel go zhe shadage byang chub ྅se / mas su zhu / /rdorje pho re la/ma nas 'thon/ yum/ gyi pad+ma'i ze 'brur se/te zho pa// mchod pa'i lca myo ) / sna tshos sa par gyur te/ mchod rdzas sna rtsos sa dra/ thogs pa mkha' nang nas phyir spro sa te/dkyil zhal ra gyi lha tshogs tham/si cang/ rma chod nga/ra gyur/ oṃ āXrū nga/ badz+ra huX/ de bzhin du shag/ ga rnye/ ra sa/ spar she/ oX āXdharma dh+wa tu brna hūṃ/ a yo/ kye kye gshin rje gshed dmar po/ /bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin/ /byod mthong kho bo rlam par /'jigs/ /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spo ngas// khyod kyis gar rma jad sa steng dang / /sa bla dang ni sa 'og sa ya/ / chags pas brgyan pa khro bo/'i stu nga//gar mdzad khyod ni ro 'a ngas lags/ /sku—lus sbom thung dmar ba ste/ /rnam nga/ sna tshos/ sa gzugs sprul pa/ /rdo rje dbyangs can rma/ yis btud/ /gar mjad khyod ni bde ba che/ /hiXsgyiX'i gsang sngags dag gis khyod/ /sa gsum po yi 'khra/la nga/ sel/ /thugs rje'i khro bo rje btsun khyod/ /gar ma/dzad 'gro ba yongs pa gzigs/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū ja badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko ྅ haX/ de nas gco bos kyang 'bor rnali/sa la/ gti/ mu ga rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gsan rje khu shang ngo/ shin du 'jags/ /sdon nga/ sangs rgyas kun rang brdo na na/ /sku yi da rnga rje byong phyag 'cha' //ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyong/ /sa phon rje gshed ngo/ shin tu—'jigs / sem/sa kyi jo/ rje rab cha bsal/ /rin chen rdo— rje khyod phyag /spru chal/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang ba 'an khyod/ /khyab bdang/ chags/ pas rtsos (ra sbong gnas/ /dbyangs gru/cheg kun gyi mchos gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'chal/ /pras dog rdo rje'i rang nga/'i/na khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las ku myo/ byed/ /sku stu rdo rje ra bsgyugs la —2/

ba/ /phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal/ /yang 'khor rnams kyis gtso bo la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sa ngas rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal//zhes bstod par bsam mo/ /'dir mchod bsto da gnyis yan lag so sor mi bgrong bar/ mchod pa'i rnal 'byor zhes gcig tu sdom pa nyid gzhung gi dgongs par 'dug pas/ bstod pa'i nga rgyal logs su bzung ba gzhung na med la/ chag lo sogs kyis mdzad pa ltar na/ gzhung gzhan dang mthun pas mi legs pa'ang ma yin pa/ ji ltar mos par bya'o/ /nang ma/chod la/ oX āXbisnrun ta kri ta huX huX gis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX 'a/sa me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du oX āXhūX las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum/ de'i steng du a las byung ba'i ka pā la'o/ /de'i nang du bi ra shu ma muXlas byung ba'i bdud rtsi lnga/ bhuX aX dziX khaX hūX rnams las byung ba'i sha lnga/ huX las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po 'og gi rwa lngas thod pa'i steng nas bkag pa/ de'i steng du cung zad ma reg par/ hūX ‘pas skyes pa'i rdo rje dbyug pa dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba nyi ma 'char ka'i ltem dag can du gyur cing / de'i 'od kyis rdo rje sngon po yang zhu zhing thim/ rdo rje dbyug pas rdzas rnams yang dang yang du dkrugs nas/ de nyid du zhu zhing 'dres nga sa/ bdud rtsi dkar zhing bsil ba/ kha ngog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs nga/ra gyur/ de'i steng gi nam/ mkha' la oX dkar po /de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes/ kyi —22—

bsde ge khe bdud༄ ngh+ru/— shengs/ nas oX 'a/ thim/ oX yig lhung ba sngar gyi bdud rtsi dang 'drang/ nga sa// jon dam bde ba chen po'i ye shes ma/chog gi bdud rtsi lnga'i rgya ra/tshor gyur/ oX ā/༷༷huX/ lan lnga sogs mang du brjod/ nang mchod byin rlabs lta bu phran tshegs kyi zags/ la/ la la sgrub thabs 'di dang 'chang 'gyur gyi sgrub thabs gzhan rnams la lugs so so'i khyad ches phran tshegs yod pa rnams 'grub na rang lugs bzhin byed dgos mod/ de lta bu ma 'grub na gcig nyid kun tu sbyar bas kyang rung ngo / /lha rnams kyi ljags thiX las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po'i 'od zer gyis bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bas tshim/ zhing mnyes/ nga/ra gyur/ oṃ āXhuX/ zhes bdud rtsi myang ngo / /de nas rang gi snying gar sem/sa dpa' gsum brtse sa rgyas bsdus gang rung cig bsgoms nas/ hūX gi 'od kyis khar/sa gsum/ snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor bsgyur la/ bdag nyid kyis bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la bsdu/ rang gis bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yang gzung 'jin gyi 'khrul pa dang bral ba/ don dam gyi sems yongs grub chen po'i ngo bor shes bzhin pas/ gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'kho1ra bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar yang gzhung las/ gang phyir 'khrul pa gnyis la gnas/ /zhes gzung 'dzin gnyis 3brul snang yin pa dang / 'khrul pa'i ngo bo de nyid min/ /zhes gzung 'dzin gnas tshul la ma grub pa dang / sems ni rtag tu 'khru/la ba med/ /ces don dam gyi sems gzung 'dzin las grol zhing / 'di las gzhan du de nyid min/ /zhes dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo de ka don dam gyi sems yin zhing / gzung 'dzin kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad ni de yang rma yin/ de las gzhan du yang ma grub ste/ rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir ro zhes pa'o/ /chag los skabs 'dir rdzogs rim sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'ju ga gi tha snyad mjad pa ni/ lo paṇa rnams 'phags skor la —23—

blo byang ba'i rnam 'gyur du zad kyi/ dpal 'dzin gyi lugs ni zhabs lugs—/rkyang be spu pre da cung zad rma/ de'agrig la/ gzhung nan 'da' thad kyi man ngag rngams 'gyung ba'i man ngag dang bcang sku pa tre ri kra tri sdu bar nag po'i sgrub thabs rdo rje 'od zer du bshad zin to/ /'dir mchog tu dag4sna za/tre phyog/char nyam rdo zhes pa dang / bde ba dam pa'i gzugs can bsgoms / /zhes pas/ bskyed rim/ gyi lha sku deng ra bde stong du shar ba zhig dgos par bstan to/ /de ltar na/ skye mched byin rlabs dang / rdo rje gsum/ byan rlabs dang / dbang bskur rgyas btab dang / ye shes dgug gzhug dang / mchod bstod dang / bdud rtsi myang ba dang / dkyil 'khor spro bsdu ste/ de dag ni rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /'di'i skabs su bsgom/ rgyu'i rdzogs rim ni rnal 'byor bzhi rim mo/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa rnams kyang sgrub thabs rngo rje 'o/ da zer du bshad zin pa ltar/ 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs bzhin yin pas/ dpal 'dzim gyi gzhung la nag po'i sgrub thabs su/ ye shes lam/ las skyes pa dgod/ /ces ye shes se rme/sa dang/'i gdan sa'i dkyil 'kho1ra dgros pa tsam las gzhan ma gsungs kyang / des mtshon nas sku rdo rje'i gdan rlung dang / gsung la chu dang / thugs la me rnam/sa kyang dgos so / /dngos bstan ltar na zhabs lugs dang 'di la rdo rje bzhi'i gdan dang / thugs ka'i sa bon bzhi'i gdan gyi khyad byung mong kyang 'dam ka'o / /bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ tseX( hiXsgyiXwi kri tā na na thiX hūX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/zhes yi ge bcu bzhi pa snying po'o/ /oX ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me du ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra yak+ṣi ya/ yak+ṣi yasnro ni rā ma ya hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ni 'khor lo'i las kyi sngags so/ /bla ma dam pa 'ga' zhig yi ge bdun pa'ang bzla bar bzhed la/ 'kho/ra gyi sngags ni/ tseX( āXdzi na dzika hūX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ tseX( āXbadz+ra ra ti huX phaṭa swāhā/zhes pa'i bar du rang rang so so'i spro ba'i sngags rnams la de nyid lnga spel byed pa nyid do/ /de nas thun bsdu bar 'dod na/ dag pa dran pa ni/ mi mnyam med pa gru bzhi ste/ /dran par nyer —24—

geb sdig cha rtse cha dodage can gzhag rngon ra gyi sgo/ lho sgo yang dag spo spra pa bste / /—rderde rje/ 'phrul khe sde bar long pa rin/ )ge sde ba po/ —/dbang sto bas/ byang gi sko ru brjod/ /bas mtsho gtan bzhi yi rta babs dang / tsā/ting 'jin ba'i yi kha khyer te/ ༈gzungs ngang lha mo'i tshogs yi na no/ /dril bu'i sgra tre dugs yan 'a ga da sdi// /rgyan rnams byang chub yan lag ste/ /'phags lam brgyud kyi rka ba'o/ /rnam thar brgyad po rnam dag pas/ /sna tshos sa rdo rje'i zur nga/nga logs/ /rwa rnam/sa 'jig lta nyi shu 'joms// /rdo rje'i/ thig ni ༷cas 'khor bskor/ /nyes pas ma gos nga/bla dang / /smin dang sning rje nyi zla'i sa dan/ /ye shes lnga jo yongs rdzos sa pa/ /phung po nyon mongs lnga dag pas/ /bsde gshegs /bro bo rigs lnga'o / /bdud bzhi sgrib pa bzhi bcam/ zhing / / lta ba bzhi spangs stobs bzhi'i dngos/ /sgo skyong gshe/da ngo/ nga zha rlams so/ / 'byu/nga ba bzhi rnams rnam/ nga/sa cing / /pha rol phyir bzhi tshad med dngos / da / / ri/ shes lnga mo bzhi rnar/sa so / /rnam dag gzugs sogs ngo bo nyid/ /pha rol phya'atshi drug rab rjo gas pa/ /ye shes bdud rtsis sang ba'i snod/ / dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings/ nyid do/ /zhes so/ /3 'i rnal 'byor zin nas bzlas pa rjo gas shing / thun mchams la 'jug par 'dong na/lkoX āXrū pa badz+ra huX/ nas/ dkyil 'bor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'es pa/ 'i par mchod bstod dang / snye nga ngo/'i ra/thar oṃ ā/༷༷hūṃ/ btags pas bdud rtsi myang / stabs 3dir dmar nag gi sgrub thabs dang nga/pal 'dzin gyis/ ma/jad pa gnyis dang / gar+sha/na rje gshe/da 'byung ba sogs sa zhung 'gang 'ig gi 'a 0ska dre na 'a/ bang ga bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol bar bsha/da cing / bod phal cher phyag len 'a/ ya nga mjad nga ru// slob dpon de dag gi lugs ltar na/ yig brgya chi kya gyi ma/thar bzod par sa so/la nas/ tseX( āX3/༷༷zhes ye shes nga/ po/zhegs/ su gsol ba yin —25—

—yang / lugs de ni rnal 'byo/ra gyi rgyud kyi cho ga'i shan 'dres pa ste/ slob dpon de rnams nyid kyi 'khru/la pa'i cha shas su sna nga / kha cig de pha rgyud kyi rang lugs yin nam snyam pa la dug kyang de 'dra ma yin pas/ bla med kyi lugs la bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mi ba/shegs nga/ nyid bzang bas rang lugs la gshe/gas/ gsol byed mi dgos so/ /de nas 'di lta ra bya sne/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gyur/ 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'kho/ra lo la thim/ de 'od du zhu sta chos 'byu1nga la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu ste gzhal yas /spang la thim/ gzhal yas khang 'od du zhu ste lha/ tshogs rnams la thim/ 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang rig ma gtso bo'i thugs kar thim/ de yang rim gyis 'od gsal du zhugs par gyur/ sde nas thun mcha rma sa kyi lnga skur langs te/ gnas/ gsum byin gyis brlabs nas dge ba bsngo'o tsho/ /bzlas pa nas/ de'i bar/ rnal 'byo ra chen po nga ngos ra/ yin yang / de'i yan lag yin pa'i phyir/ gzhud 'a sa rnal 3byor chen po'i khongs su bsdus so/ /gtor ma'i cho ga la/ lha lnga'i sgrub thabs su bsha/da pa rnams phal cher blo la dran pa ra byas nas/ gtor ma byin rlabs ni gong gi nang mchod byin rlabs bzhin nam/ rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa'i dngos bstan sgra ji bzhin pas kyang chog go /de la slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyi dmar po'i gtor chog logs/ na yod pa dang / nag po'i dkyil chog gi nang na yod pa'i gtor chog rbi 'gyu/ra khyad dang / nag po'i skabs su lha rnams phyag mang byed nga/'i khyad ma gtogs khyad gzhan ye me/da 'a / de gnyis ka ru gtor ma byin rlabs 'di lta'o zhes/ gsal bar me/nga kra/ ni/ sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i bdud rtsi byin rlabs dang 'dra bar dgongs pa yin no/ /sngags rnying ma bar grags pa rnams gtor ma dang bdud rtsi byin rlabs mi 'dra bar byed pa shas che yang / rgya sar nas bsgyur nges pa'i gsang —26—
