sngags nang pa'i lugs phal cher la de gnyis 'dra bar byed pas 'dir yang de ltar 'os pa yin la/'on kyang dpal 'dzin gyi gtor chog 'di dag /dmar po'i rgyud kyi le'u bcu gcig pa gtor ma'i le'u la brten par ni snang ste/ tshig rigs kyang phal cher gcig pa lta bur yod pas so/ /rig 'a zhig cung zad mi 'dra ba'ang snang ba ni 'dam kha yin par shes par bya'o/ /de yang tseX( āX'achi basnrun+ta spo ta nas tseX( āXhūX/ lan lnga'i bar gong nang mchod ltar gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gshin rdze gshed dmar po'i dkyi' 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaX tseX( hiXsgyiXhaX la sogs pa'i mchod pas mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sogs kyis bstod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo 'es pa nas/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sku shes rab ma rnams gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'byud pa'i skur gyur/ ces 'don pa spo/rgyas pa la mos na/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin rlabs dang / dbang bskur nas gshin rje gshed pos rgyas gdab pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ cung zad bsdu na/ nge thams cad kyi dpral bar nas/ bhe da bhe da hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes nga 'i bar gshed dmar lha lnga'i gtor chog dang 'dra bas kyang chog go /de rjes dmar ngo/'i gtor chog na yang nag ngo dang 'dra bar/oX in+t+ra ya hriX zhes sogs 'byung ba dar/ra nag gi 'jig rten pa'i gtor snga gas 'dra bar byas myo zor yang ba'i dgos pa yod pa la dgongs la/ rgyud las 'byung tshul rni nag ngo 'i rgyud du gtor sngags la/ na maXzhes pa med/ dmar po'i rgyud na yod pas so so la rgyud lngar byas/ na le/gas so/ /de rjes chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod nas gzung / badz+ra muX zhes pa'i bar yang lha ru lnga' gtor chog dang 'dra'o/ /rjes su smon lam btab/ dge ba bsngo'o/ /bcu gsum ma'i skobs/ 'dir dang/'a bo bzhi'i rma/tshan sngags dang rna' 'byor ma bzhi'i gtor sngags logs pa mi mdzad de/ rgyu —27—

———— ———snye rderderde—————rderderderderde————kha —————rderderde— ——ba————rderde —————chi———snye—lte—— mtshan ni dmar po lha sdi 'i skabs sa tor sngags ring mo rak+ta zhes sogs sngags ngon dang rme/thun par gtso bo zhe sdang rdo rje shes rab ma/ dang bcas/ pa bo na la sbyor zhing phyogs skyong la'ang byeng pa'i skabs༈ shis/ yod pa de yang / zhe sdang rdo rjer bsgyur zin pa'i dbang du byas la/ nga kyal 'khor bca bcu po la yang ze re bzhin thun mong ma yin pa'i gtor sngags/ de sbyor ba'i lugs yin pas/ de ltar byed pa shin tā 'os la/ 'jir mi 'byu/rdeng ba ni tho ba gshin rje gshe/rded sos sa /ra/ sngags logs pa me/da pas de phyir rigs ba'i yum/ bzhi la yang gtor sngags legs nga/ nges pa dgos pa ma myo zhing / 'khotsho ra bcu gnyis po la skabs 'di'i bya byed rig pa mtshungs par bya ste/ gal che chung gi dbye ba/ mi shes pa'i phyir dang / thams cad gtse bo'i rigs su gcig pa'i phyir/ gtor sngags ring rmo la 'dus par dgongs pa/'o / /yang rgyas par spro na/ phyogs skyong dgug pa'i skabs snyel yi ge bcu bzhi pa'i phaṭa phaṭa kyi mthar/ hu sarba du gi rde an+t+ra sa pā ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dza swāhā/ in+d+ra zhes rnga/'i gnas su sdo / / ben dra 'a/ sogs pa so so'i mtshan bcug pas dgug pa dang / yang phur 'debs kyi skabs su phaṭa phaṭa kye rjes su/ husarba dun in+t+ra sa pā ri wā ra ki la ya hu phaṭa swāhā dang / sngag rde ben+da la so gas ri gzhan rmams kyi rma/cha' sngags spel bas phur bus 'a sdebs so/ /rngal 'byo rder gyi yan 'a/ga ga/sgan rnams ni spyi dang 'dra zhing / bla gru/ snga ma rnams kyi sgrub thabs na yod nga/ ltar shes nga ra bya/bro/ /slob dpon ngang 8la 'dzin nyid kyi lugs ga 'ar bzhag pa la po/ji / na rje gshe/rded zhog po'i sgrub thabs kyang / /rid snyid 'jo/myo nga/ rmyos pas rung gas 'dre bar nus te/ de las shes rab skyed pa'i cho ga ni/ nag po'i rgyud la sa ma/ gsungs shing / dmar po'i rgyud las 0sungs nga/ nyid kyi phyir༈ dmar ngo ri thun rnge/nga spru/ stu/zho par ‘sngur la/ dmar po'i sgrub thabs 'dir ma/spa' gsang byi na rlabs rje tra/ cha rgas kyi nga rgya' dang bcas nga / rjes su rna'/ 'byo ra du bsdu bar mdzad cing / ye shes se rlo/sa ngang 'a dang / ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' bsdu/sa nga/ yang / na bas de dag 'bre / ra bar 'byung la/—28—

—— rde—————— rderderde ——— ————— rderderde ——— rderde—snye—— rde—— ——— snye —— snye——ba—nag ngo/'i sgrub thabs kyi dngos bstan la/ sems dpa' gnyis dang rjes chags 0nas slabs sang du bsgom mi gsal yang / rjes chags ni rgyab brten ye shes zhabs lugs sas sa snri 'gros ngang bstun na/ byang chub mchog gi nga rgyal gzung zin pa'i rjes su/ rang snying sa bon 'od kyis dgug /ces sogs kyi gong der spa skong gi tshul gyis bcug nas / rjes su rna‘rmi 'byo ra la rngi/ sdud par shin tu rnal 'byo ra gyi cho gar bsdu dgos so/ /se mas dpa' sa sum brtseg spyi ni ba sbo gru dgos par shin tu gsal te/ ye shes 'od kyis snying gar dgod/ /ces pa dpa / ye shes la gru las skyes par dgod/ /ces pa gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang gnas ske/bas gang du bsto sna ri/ mi gsal ba la/ dmar po bcu gsum ma la lha lnga da nga phyogs ma/chungs kyi dbang8pas / bsdus pa de gtso bo bzhengs ma thag tu mdzad/ nag po la ni /spa skong bi tshur du gsum brtseng brdi si pa ske bas/ de'am/ rdo rje gsum byin gyis brlabs pa dang dbang bskur gyi ma/tshams su/ sdu/ra sa dpa 'a gsum brtseg rgyas pa nyid bsgoms kyang rung ngo / /'on kyang 'dir 'bras bu gshin rje gsheng gzhengs ma thag tu/ sems dpa' gsum yod na de la 'dus/ med na thus sa kar sa bon bsgom pa 'a med dum/ rung bas nges pa dgos shing / sa bon yang yi ge bcu bdun gyi nga bye bas/ mal ri da kun la gyi gtse bo'i1 sa bon ya yig yin yang / 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skabs 'dir ni ya yis/ dzung pa sdang yod rnge/da ha ca yig kho na gtso che bar ma/ngam rno/ /yang gshin rje sar/ nga dmar po'i rgyung (pe'u 'e/ra gnyis pa 'a sa/rgyu ldo rje 2dzin pa ldogs mtshar/sa nyid du/ sa che/sa/ ngang tu ri sa su6ri/ brtseg bsdus/ nga ji snang / ga/ba snas sa nga byin rlabs ngang bcas rngo pre'i rjes chags dang / shes rab 'tho ci/ pre ri/’ma/ ji tsho kyi ri—con du sa su ci cha rin snye3 bcu gsum ma'i skabs sna dar/ 'bras bu jo rje (re jin nga/ rdzos ra sa sgrus ༷ dung tre ma// sang du pas myo / pa'i dus skabs mi 'dra ya nga / rtsos gsum po nge'i go rim lced nge sna kho sungs pa dang rma/thun nga/ra bstan pa sde dmar po la rim kla de ltor byeng za 'i rgyu mtshan de yi na tā / nag po la de ltar ma nges so //— 29—

༈ dpal gzhan rje gshed nag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da ni de la 'don pa spo tshul brjod par bya ste/ rang skad cig gis bzhan rje gshed nag po'i skur ces dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yaX yig mthing nag de las 'od 'phros zhes dang / mngon byang bzhi pa'i skabs/ de las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ huX dkar pos mtshan par gyur/ oX badz+ra ut+pa ko3haX/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus zhes pa dang / sbrul rgyan can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod nga 'dzin pas yum la mkhyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ pad zla la g.yon brkyang zhes dang / maX las ma he nag po dregs shing zhes dang / byang chub sems kyi phung po steng ma cha gcig shos de hūX yig nag por gyur/ de las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa/ rwa gdengs shing 'bar 'phreng 'khrug pa'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i huX nag po'o/ /de las zhes dang / rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed nag po dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ smeg pa la sogs zhes dang / zhal gsum phyag drug gi mdun ma gnyis/ sdang ba ma lus pa 'joms par mdzad pa'i gri gug 'bar ba dang / bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyung/ nga// gnyis/ nga/ na 'bar ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa gsor bas 'jig rten gsum 'du' ba/ gsum pa na mi bzad pa'i ral gris gdug pa can ma lus pa 'joms par ma/dzad pa/ g.yo/na gyi gnyis nga/ na 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad nga/ bskor bas gnod pa dang sdug bsnga' mtha' dag zhi zhing bzlog par mdzad pa/ gsum pas pad+ma dmar po sdong bu dang bcas nga/ bsnams pas brtan g.yo mtha' dag —3/kye—

'gugs shing dbang du byed pa/ rtsa zhal nag po mi bzad pa'i khro sa nyar bsdu sa pas sde brgyad gshin rje'i tshogs thams cad dngangs shing snying 'gas nga ra byed pa/ g.yas 'kha dkar po bde ba dam pa'i 'od dkar gyis phyogs/ cha 'gengs shing / ga sku kā༈ dmar po gdangs shing bzhad pas ri rab bsgyel zhing 'jig rten gsum skyed nga/ra ma/rdzad pa/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum rnga/'i zhes dang / yum gyi skabs ce ba'i phyag gnyis/ yab kyi mgul nas zhes dang / cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /gtso bo'i thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' gshin rje gshed zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ pad nyi'i gdan 'a/ bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'jin sems dpa'/ nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje sngon ngo/ rtse lnga pa'i lte bar yang nyi dkyil la gnas nga/'i huX mthing nag 'bar ba'i 'od kyi sna/nga bas phyogs kun khyab par byed pa'o/ /oṃ dharma dh+wa tu sogs brjod/ yab kyi gsang gnas stoX zhes pa nas / mngon du byas par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas nga/ spyan drangs zhes sogs brjong de/dar/ra po bcu gsum ma'i skabs las go rim cung zad bsgyur ba'o/ /ya las zhe sdang gzhan rje gshed nag po/ dus mtha'i sprin ces pa nas/ mchog gi cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /snying po'i shar du zhes dang / gti mug gshin rje gshed sku mdog dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis dang po gnyis gri gug dang thong pa 'dzin pas rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis na 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa zhes dang / phra ma sa zhan rje gshed ser po/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ dang po gnyis 'dra/ g.yas gnyis na —31—

———— zil —— ga ba——ga spro spro sgo ———— rderderderde —— rnor bung nga ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na 'kho rder lo dang pad+ma ces dang / 'dod chags gshin rje po/she / da dmar po/ dmar nag dkar ba'i: g.yas gnyis na pad+ma dang ral gri/ da las yan gnyis na 'khor lo dang nor bu/ zhes dang / phrag ngang ca gshan rje gshed ljang khu/ ljang nag dkar ba'i: g.yas gnyis na ral hūṃ da la bor lo/g.yon ba nyas na nor bu dang pad+ma/ thob shi sbyo/na rje sa khang mthing kha/ nag dkar dmar ba'i spya g.yas gnyis na rdorje thob na rwa nya shu pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na nor budang pad+ma/ zhes dang dbyug pa kra/:/na rje gshed dkar po/ dkar nag dmar kra'i: g.yas gnyis na dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na 'khor lodang pad+ma/ 'es dang / pad+ma gshin rje g.ye/da dmar po sogs/ 'dod chags gshi/na rje gshed ngang 'dra/ ral gri nab / sbyo/rden rje gshed ljang sngon nam ljang nag sogs/ phrag dos gsham rje gshed dang 'dra/ lugs 'di la gzhung las/ cung zad sngon po khyad par ro/ /zhes sa sungs pas/ ljang sngon nam ljang nag dgos te/ gzhan du na sku mngog gi khyad par cung zad 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /yang na sgo bsrung bzhi ngo/ de rnams la/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa thugs kar bsno la ba/ zhes yab rkyang gi skur bsgoms/ kyang rung rdeb yin no/ /dpal 'dzin gyi dmar po'i gzhung las/ rigs lnga'i skabs su/ gnyuṇ+ḍa/rderde ma'i shes rab gnyis med 'khru/da/ /ces dang / sbo ba ba len sna skabs su/ rang snang shes rab yan lag sbyor/ /zhes gsungs// nag po'i sgrub thabs su ngas sa lnga la yum/ gsungs pa dmar po dang 'dra 'ing / sgo ba bzhi yab rkyang du byung bas/dam/ra nag gnyis/ la thob thang gi sgo nas/ sbo ba bzhi la yum yod med kyi khyad par med cing /skabs 'dir rgyud tshig la'ang khyad par med pas dmar nag gnyis ka la sgo srungs bzhi yum can dang / yab rkyang 'dam khar dgongs pa'o/ /de yang dpal 'dzin gyi gzhung gi dbang du byas kyi/ spyir —32—

thams/ cad rang snang gi thang rnga4 yis phan chun 'byur pa'i kha sdor gyi sku kho nar byed nga dang / tre|nga du smos pa'i 'dam kha gnyi ru/ ngang 'bor tshogs thams spring khri/ba rkyang yum rkyang du byed pa ste chi 'dra ba bzhi byung zhing / ma/tshar sa kyi thong rwa4 bzha' dong dā rngi ma rtso/ ra snyel ngo/ byeng pa so/sa/sa sna tshogs byung yang / rgyud don 'a/ 'gig phyin bla ma/'i ma/na bor tshogs/ rnar ri/sa dru/dz+wa/sa ’blo 'as spro ri ra ring da kla ngas/ 'ang pyu ma yul du drung ba ni :ri mthad do zhes rgyud kyi 'gre' de ra khro 4 kag nga/ 8snar yi ra te/ (lte sna dang pa/ de chur nge/ 'dra yo rngan pa kun snyi nga gi lugs yin na cha se /ma rmo / /nga ni dkyus la 'jug ste// tsar ci kwa dal/ra cho skem zhing khros pa dkar na rnga—/ da che rasogs gti mug sa r+sha/'a rje tso snang ngang /snye/ phog dru / rde sngo na mo sngo nga por nga ru / ri spre ri ku tsho)dz+wa ro a stsu / sa gi ru/ ral zhol rnga dze dang ra snye pa gri/ g.yon sa nyas na ring 'asgyu par /khrod ri rnga che/ rngo —/— skyo ṭā rtsedire/ ri du pa'i 8zhal h+phu ka thi gdong pa'o/ /dbyangs rke ) 0 ci 4di da hā/ ra dh+ra3 dang —ra masase gas —/ nga ded chags gshan rje gshed dang snye3dra/ 'i 'i/nga ri ri / / gang na hwa40sho sa nu nga nga / sgo nga ri ljang /spyalja/za zhog dpo/ra sogs phrag dog gshin rje bkas ri dang 'dra / tri / ga mo dpa myo rī nas pa zhos/ga(zhal yas khang 'a/ thim gya bar shin tu rnga / pa nga byor hūṃ ‘ la rderdzo sa rngam si/ dar+sha phyo/sa ring na tshul la /khyad par med do/ /skye mched byin rlabs kyi smabs su/ rdo rje rna po ma po / ༷༷ zhe sdang gshan/ rje pe/tre gad dang 'dra ba las/ ma he ngang rnga/shi/myo rje'i gang na spangs nga/ nyes dang / rdo tsho rje yid da7ra po rgyu'i rdo rje sems dpa' dngan mtshungs pa/ wo/ da5 / rdo rje—gsum byin —33—

rlabs kyi skabs su/ thugs rdo rje nag po zhe sdang gshi/na rje gshed lta bu'i thugs kar hūX sngon po zhes 'don pa spo/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gshin rje gshed myog ngo/'i dkyil 'kho/ra 'es dang / kyai gshi/na rje gshe/da nag po/ ces dang / chags pas/ rgyan sogs kyi dod du/ nag po mig sman bcag 'dra yi/ /zhes dang / sku lus spom thung nag nga/ ste/ /zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /huX riX rdo rje stobs po che/ /rab 'jigs mi mthun zad mdzad pa/ /rdo rje sku dbyer med pa'i lha/ /tho ba rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje kun tu bzang / /mnyam pa'i rdo rje mi bskyod pa/ /rdo rje gsang ba dbyings chen po/ /ye shes rdo rje phyas 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dam tshig rdo rje gsu nga / /rdo rje dbyangs ni zab mo che/ /'dod chags rdo rje nyid mchungs nga///skyan tsho bral rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje las ni brtson 'grus/ che/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /las mthar mjad pa'i thub chen ngo// /rdo rje brtson 'grus byong phya ga 'chal/ /rdo rje zhi ba byang chub sems/ /gti mug rde rje nyid dbyer me/da/ ༈skros/ kyi dbyings kyi bdag chen mo/ /rdo rje car tsi kā phyas 'tshal/ /mi/ bskyo da rdo rja ya shes che / /'e sdang bdag po thugs dbyer med/ /mi phyed rngam rtog rab gcod rme / /rdo rje phag mo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje gsung ni ye shes/ che//pad+ma shes rab pha rol phyin/ /'jod chags chen po nyid sbyong ba/ /rdo rje dbyangs can khyod la bstod/ /las kyi rdo rje kun sgrol ma/ /phrag dog rdo rje dbyer med sku/ /thams cang rdo rje btang snyoms nyid/ /rdo rje go rī phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa 'di gshe/da nag gi lha bcu gsum so so'i sgrub thabs dī paX ka ra dz+nyā nas mdzad pa/ kor ni ru pas bsgyur ba na yod/ lar nas rgyud kyi tshig yin rigs su 'dug /gshed skor ba rnying ba gzhan gyi —34—

————snye—ka—lugs la mi 'dug kyang / bu ston man chad phyis byon ci rigs pa rnams mdzad kyin 'dug pa bzhin/nga mar nag 'jags byed bcu gsum ma lugs ga‘na myo/ rnams la'ang / bstod pa'i skabs kha bsang bas legs par 'ong / deng yang bdag bskyed kyi ma/chod bstod bdung rtsi myang ba la mi dgos kyang /mdun bskyed kyi bstod nga la ci rigs su sbyar ro/ /bdud rtsi byin rlabs kyi skabs// de'i steng du cung zang ma reg pa ra/ hu las skyes pa'i rdorje dkar po/ ces dang / rdorje dkar pos rdzas rngams// 'es 'don nga spo zhing / gzhung las kyang de kho na yod mod spyir nas nag po la yang dbyug ba dkar gro mi 'gal te/ de ni lha'i phyag ma/tshan gyi dbang du byas pa min bdud rtsi'i don du kha ṭā ga dkar ngo/ nyid kyis so/ /gtor chog gi skabs gtor ma byin rlabs nang mchod kyi skabs kho na dang 'dra/ sa tor ma/gron phyos sa skyong rnams (pa phur bus btang/ zin ma thag /ye shes par bsgyur ba'i skabs su dam ra po'i lugs la lha tshogs thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yin zhing / gshi/rden rje gde/rded kyi phyag mtshan/ 'dzin dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ phyogs skyong so/ so'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa meng la/ de la yang phyogs skyong so so rang mdog dang mthun par/ mthar byed rigs lnga so sor skyed du rung rmo da kyang / tham sa cad gtso bo'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba nyid kyi phyir/ 'jug pa bde bas/ zhe sngang bshan rje gshe/da dmar po'i rnam pa khonas rang rang gi bzhon pa la gnas nga/ ba sbom pa yin la/'dir yang bsdus pa la dga' bas des rigs bsgres na rung ngo / /'on kyang lcogs na nga kyal chog las/ gas la ba ltar/ so sor bskyed na bzang ste/ phur bus btab pas byang chub kyi sems kyi thig ler gyur/ thig le rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du hrī dang rdo rje las byung ba'i dbang po dmar ser/ dud sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thong/ pa 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo—35—

dzab shel rjed rde na rtse ye dzong ra 9 5 gri/ cha do sna de kyis ge bor lo dang nga/bla lhor spyi thaX bsgo pa dod dod dod don ge dang ri dbyu 1 gang /rde —kru sa/ sa shi dru/ rje sngo myo ngo ci sngo dkar dmar ba/ g.ya sa gnyis dbyus pa dang ra 'a chigri g.yo na nge dang 'dra/ nub tā ji dang dzi3 zhags las/ chu lha bkar ngo na/gar nas dmar/ g.ya/sa sa/nis dzi pa nags dang ral gri/ g.yo/ na snga ma dang re dra byang dukri dang bi rnga ngu —ra 'a/sa// gnong sbyin se ra ngo/ se/ ra nag nga/ska/ ra ba/ sa yas ku /lhi sa/ bi dza ja/tsho rlo dang ral gri/ g.yon 'dra/ byang kyar du ta dang rtse rdzo/྅ the (1༄ tri ri ༈/ nga dang sde3 da’zhan dro nge/ dkar nag da 'a /ra/ g.yas/ sa ris nyas rtse 0su rma dang ra ri tswa de gī/ lha/du (sna/8da yin nyas 'khor 'o dang no—ra sgu/ rang 'ong kyi dri/spo rī 'phyu/ da khri ko skya/rnga ri lco ra sa twang re thab las// me lha da kar ngo/ dgru ra mas/ dka/ra / g.yas sa 'asdo / spyo blugs/ kyi rngong ྈ0/ gri/ ba gli/ston sa nyas nor bu dang pad+ma / 'o/ nub tu ra dang gri gug la ru / sri na rngo /nas ngo/ zizu snga/ nga co /shin rje las pa ( lta snyi 'am / g.ya sa/ ma klus/ ra ra gri ding jo rje chi skus chi hūṃ nu/ro/ byang du 'o pa dang rlung ‘ rlon / las/ rlud lha lnga/nga bu ldang nang ga da rka/ ra/ sa ya bro ri/ sa/nyis ba da phyo/ ngang ral gri / ka yan ga/ sdo ye sa nga/blu ngang da tshe na ra ci ngu// sde nga ji ga6 rdon du hūṃ dang me tospre sa/ ku mu ta 'a sa// zla ba dkar ngo rtso dal ra nag nga/mar/ g.yas/ sa nas/ ku ru/ to ngang ra 'a/ gri/ / sa/yo 'e sa nyas/ sna kho hwa— 'o dang nor bu 'dzin rngag / sdeng thi ga( ji/4ri su hūṃ dang pad+ma las/ 'i ma dmar jo/ nga/ri/ra zhog nga kar ba g.ya/sa mi/nyas ḍo dra dang ra snye pe gri/ ldo /yo na sa nyas / 'che rngor 'o/ dang sna ra bu'o/ ba ci sa la 'bor le/༷ jo da du pad+ma 'o/ /steng ji thi nga ngus su nga/ ṭas dang nga/gra/nga sna phreng las/ tshangs pa ser po ser sna phyog nga/kar po/ rka khu ris/ sa/nyis bgra’ rnga—'phrong dang ra 'a gri/ g.yon gnyis nga d+ma dang rlor bu 'dzi myo nga ca/ 'os tu phaṭa dang ji / myo / pa myur si/ sa'i lha mo ser mo/ ser myog nga sna kar —3()—

rme—/ —sa yas gnyis bum pa dang dar la ga dzo/ bcas sdu—rgo/ na tshonas / cha spo rdal pa rta du rngodang po rig(dza / ba/ ༄ge zhe ste po — las shum nga/'i dod du snye ge bor sgo rna / / /de'i sa/ yas su sru dang ral gri sprel/sa / gra sgos bzang ra ru / sngon ngo/ sngo dkar dar/ra ba/ g.ya sa sa gis ral gyi nga ri rdo rje/ g.yo nas/nyis pa/bla dang 'khor lo / shar gyi g.yon du hā dang sa da'i dbyus nga/ pa ris / khyab 'jug sngon ngo// sngo nga/kar da rma/ra/ g.yas ka nyas dbyus nga/ dang ra 'a spri sa yan gnyis rnga dra dang 'khor 'o / gachod spyin sa gu tsho g.yon du hwa dang dgra sta 'a /rbo/ tshogs/ bdag dkar ngo sna ste/ 'al rma/ngog nga/ zangs kar (sna gyur snyems/ dkar se ra nga che ri ra tsho par sgyu byung myo / snang /yi ge ma/ ngas/ pa ra mngon te/ 'ad dang ‘3rngos pa ye zhes zhabs (rī/gas ༷/ lā snye na sgo sa su ra pa/ smi rnga/sa la /spa dog zes can ye snad pa ngang snye3gal ba'i phyir ro / /nges na 'gyung sa 'e phyo ༄ sa snye sna byung pa lhor/nga kar na ro / dmar ba/ sa ya sa sa/nyis dgra tsa sta dang ral gri/ g.yo na gnyis nga/tra dang 3/bor lo 'o/ /gsan rje ngang srin jo ches/ cher khro4/ pa'i ༈snye bo/'i cha cor rdzas ru / pa/ sa zhan rna4 si/ ro pa pa/'i khro bo'o/ / nge gnis/ dang thas ru / bzang ris dang re 8lha nyi rma/ rnem/sa nyi rma 'i trodan ca/ gnas/ shing / sa 'an rngams/ zla/ ba'i kadan la gnas pa / nga bang dro/ chu lnga sa chod ngh+ru zho rnam po/ ran ngo/ che skya cod pa phyo can/tham/sa / ru cang kyang gshir/ rje sa/sheng ngo 'i lha tshogs rnam/sa dang cha byad ma tshungs shing /rngong 'dra' ya ra/ dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ g.yo myo brkyang gi sta/bas kyis/ rang ra pa tre/ pa'o5 zhe ri gra / gnas nga 'o/ /zangs kar snye3gyur kā‘sa/ brgya sbre na nga smu ra skya 'es 'byung ba dre rgya zi se ho rwa (hres rnga nga bar po ngang ser ngo/ skabs theb so so sa 8snar ga/ chu pa ma nga ri / skabs 8ri dar se nga dwor nga sgyur di gos/ hūṃ skye bor bsgyu ra bas chor ba dang / nag che (re gyur 'a/sa / khyob 'jus bi phyas sgo pa cham gsang sdib shing du bskrur ba ya nga re gyur no ra ba sde// ga nga/ chi nga byung/ rnga hring gro/ nga mar ngo tog can —37—

cig gi ming yin no/ /'di'i thad kyi phyag mtshan la dnge/ mi mthun pa cung zad 'dug kyang dpe mang po la gshugs te/ dag par byas mod gdod nas kyang ye shes zhabs lugs khungs ma dang mi/ mthun pa cung zad snang ngo / /thams cad kyi skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab byas te/ gshi/na rje g.ye/da kyis dbu brgyan/ yang na brgya sgyin me lha ru gaṇa/na rje srin po khyab 'jug rnams la mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ tshangs pa dang sa lha dang thags bzang ris la rnam snang / chu lha gnod spyin tshogs bdag rnams la rin 'byung / dbang ldan zla ba nyi ma rnams la 'od dpag med/ rlung lha la/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan par byed pa'am/ rigs kyi rim pa de las rigs lnga khro bos rgyas btab kyang pung ngo / /'di ni skyed chog rgyas pa'i lugs te/ 'dus pa zhabs lugs kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin no/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags ni/ oX hiXsgyiXwi kri tā na na i daX ba ling gro sna grot+na sarba du : na sa ma ya mu dra pra bhañdza ka /ma ma shwarnying rak+ṣa tsa ku ru ku ru huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes gtso bo dang / 'khor rmam/sa la'ang so so'i bzlas pa'i sngags kyi nang du gtor sngags bcug /tseX( āXdzi na dzika i daX ba ling sogs sbyar ba'am//yi ge bcu bdun pa'am yi ge so gnyis pa'i mthar/ i daX sogs sbyar bas gtso 'khor thams cad la dus gcig tu 'bul/ gshed dmar la phyogs skyong gi gtor ma'i snga gas kyi mjug tu/ ha hi huX phe rnams gsum gsum yod kyang / 'dir de dag gnyis gnyis kho na'o/ /de tsam rma gtogs sa zhan ni khyad med do/ /de ltar na gshin rje gshed 'byung ba'i rjes 'brang / dgra nag zhang lugs/ su grags pa ni logs su bshad zin la/ gzhan rwa lugs/ dang mal lugs so gas kyi yi ge rnying nga/ rmam sa na phran tshogs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs su yod kyang / don gyi rkangs mi 'dra ba med cing gnad gcig par yod la/ kho bos zhang lugs kyi lag len dbang bskur logs su thob cing / brgyud rnga gyu gzhan rnams —38—

——snye—snye—kha————la de ngang de dag gi yig rnying so so'i steng nas/ 'a ga len tha ngang dwa ma/ thob kyang / bu ston chen jo 'a/ so/gas pa/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis brgyung pa rnying ra ci sgo so/ tha 0nga pa/ pha'/ cher gsam cing /gcig tu dril ma ru tham sa cad kyi legs cha ngaXsi shang / gtso bor slob nga phro na nga pa/snyel 'dzin gyi skru ba dkyil la/ gzhung bsrangs pa'i yi ge brtsam shing lag len mdzad nga ltar/ brgyung pa kun 'dus/ snri/ 'gros kyi lugs de thob pa sa/ de la sngon gyi lugs srol mtha' dag gi byin rlabs brgyud nga 'dus pa yin la/ 'dir ni bo bos slob dpon gzhan gyi gzhung mi 'dra ba sna tshogs ngang / bod rnying pa 'i/ 'dod tshul tha dad pa sna tshogs dang / bar skabs su byung ba'i blo bzo rgyas༈ bkab sna tshos sa spangs te/slob dpon dpal 'dzin nyid kyi bzhed pa gtsang mar bkod nga/ yin mo/ /bar smabs kyi yi sge ma nga por so so'i zhal gang mas man ngag gi khyad par rnams spangs nas/ dpal 'dzim gyi gzhung kho 'e la blo brtad 'cha' bar 'dod bzhin du/ gzhung 'ji dang ma 'brel ba'i dpe sna sna tshogs ba4 nga/skya bcos btab pas/ rtsa ba'i rang gzhung dang 'gal bar gyur ba dag rme/thong ste snyi nga pos dber no/ /des na brgyud pa yod med kyi gzhung sna tshogs nas bsdu phyin chad/ brgyud pa yod pa'i man ngag tu 'dod pa rnams spang dum/ rung la/ khungs gas la can gyi gzhung nyid gtso bor 'jog phyim/ 'dod pa tha dad pa'i gzhung sna tshogs phyes sa gcig tu sdeb pa dgos pa med pas/ de dag gang byed rung rtsa ba'i sa zhung dang 'gal na ni cir yang mi dra5rde bas 'bad de spang par bya'o/ /dmar nag bcu gsum ma 'di gnyis kyi dkyil chog ni/ rdo rje slob dpon dpal 'dzin nyid kyis gnyis ka la dkyi'/ chogatshomadzad pa de'i steng nas sgrub dgos mod/ phyogs skyong gi gtor chog yo da med sogs phran tshegs dang / 'gyur /khyad ma gtogs jon la khyad ci yang med pas dbang bskur dkyil 'kho ra gyi cho ga gcig khe1nas chog go /da ni gshin rje gshe/da kyi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa 'di das gi sbyang bya sbyong byed kyi rim nga —39—

——— — —ge— rderde—————snyen— rderderderderderde ———spo ——snye—snye—————rderderde———snye sgron——— rdecu pa zad nga rjod na de 'a/nga cho ྈsi rten ma/chos ngam myo gnyis la tshogs bsag pa ni / sngon rol kyi skye ba'i chi/hūṃ—sa na/ phyis kyi skye ba 'a skyu/na byed kyi 2ci5/ gsas rnga ngang /sna dra nge las kyang rang lha ra rgas la pa dang spugs rka'i sa bon ni / skye pa blangs nas chus hra rnga si pa 'i bza dang che/tshungs / 'ong jer spro ba sbrag phyo chad hri 0ser jo/'i gnas skabs na las sna tshogs la 'jug pa ngang /3dra—gro/ /ye shes tshogs skyugs4 9ka 2 de dus gyi phungs ngo dor nas/ / sems 'chi ba 'od gas༄ la zhugs/ pa nan 'dra sde / sngo phyo rol kyi skye ba che/pa skyug das tu/ skye sa 'tsho 'chi ba gsum gyi rim/ pa / phrugs/ mi/ gcis nga/ ya nga yang byung mod kyang / skye si gyu 'tsho 'chi ba sa su che mi/ gyi rnam par mthun pa'i phyir/ sbyang bya gnas skabs/ du rma/ drems/ sbyong spu ga dir ris sa nga gcag bis sbyong nga/'i dbang du byas so/ /des nas sbyang bya skyes 'tsho 'chi gsum/ ni/da lā 'a ri/nga sa shing tsā byi/sa rim rdza gi sdig nga ra 'gyur ba'i skye ba de'i gnas/ sno da kyi 'jag rten rma/ grub nga/'i sdi myo rel na yang 'a sa 'a zhig yod snyel/ gnas ni grub pha ma ma grub nga 'i dus zho'ang la 'a das/ yodacocing / ji/sa kyi skye sreng de la ldo sa ri/'i nga ma'i lus grub pa'i gnas smabs na yang 'ga' zhig kye rdod ro da kyi/ sbyong byed pam gyi dgru/sa/sa ji/'i skobs 'dir/ thog rme/'i sdugs bas/ga nge bo nas / sde tham/sa cad kyi sbyong byed snyen gru/ba pa'i phyar/ ga(nal yas bang dang lhan cig rma dzā / rgyu rdo rje 'chang—nga pa rusgyulha na cig tu snga rol kyi skye 'tsho 'chi gsum sbyong byed 'o/gas pa bsgom chi dgos/ so// /srung 'bar ga(sgal yas ༈spang lnga'i gang na ngang bcas pa bsgom rngu ni/ gang du skye ba ler 3gyur gyi gnas snod kyi 'ji ga rten sdi dang / thum cho nga rme yin pa'i khyad par rnams grub ke ri dang 'dra zhing / srung tā/bor be skye ba 'e 'e pa'i mi/ mthun phyogs rnams bcor/ pa dang 'dra'o 'es kha cig go /mngon byang snye lnga las rgya'i rdo rje sem sa dpa' grub pa ni/ srid nga/ skye ba'i zim pas skye ba'i rgyu rkyen pha ma/ gnyis kyi /rus rdzags nga sbyong ngo / /de la zla ba gnyis ni pha ra 'i 4/za pho rma/ gnyaru lus /pa gnas pa'i khams dkar ngam ra dang / gcig tu 'dres pa ni dkar dmar de rnga/nyis ma/:tre mngal rngan nas su 'dzoms pa dang / hru yi ga —4()—

rbi pha ma de dag nyid kyi bar jo'i rnam shes dang / phyag mtshan ni der skye ba gzung ma/ thag pa dang / spro bsdu gcig 'dres ni mngal du lus rdzogs pa dang / sku rdzogs pa ni/ mngal nas btsas te lus rdzogs pa'i bar ro/ /'di ni skye srid 'byung 'gyur de'i dngos kyi pha mar ma zad/ la sa mthun pa'i mes yang mes phyi mo yang phyi mo sogs mtha' med pa'i bar du/ de thams cad kyi lus grub tshul rnams dmigs pa 'di gcig pus sbyong ngo / /de dag pha mar 'gyur ba'i las rang la yod pa rnam/sa sbyong bar ma zad/ rang nyid 'gro ba gzhan gyi pha ma sogs su 'gyur ba'i las rnams kyang dag par byed do/ /de rjes gshin rje gshed dmar po sgrubs thabs su/ snod bcud dag par byas nas bde ba bsgo gru/ yod pa ltar na/ pha ma de dag yul sna tshogs dang 'dod pa thams cad la longs spyod nga/ ma/tshon cing / nag po'i mngon rtogs na rang gzhung la med kyang dmar po nas 'di kha bskang na legs par 'gyur la/ gzhung gi dngos bstan ltar ma byas kyang chad par mi 'gyur te/ 'di'i dag sbyor rnams rdo rje sems dpa' spa sbyor gyi sku nyid la 'dus par blta'o/ / yi ge lnga ni skye srid len 'gyur gyi bar do sbyong byeng dang / de nyid rdo rje 'chang gi sku la zhugs te zhu ba ni/ bar srid de nyid mngal du skye ba blangs pa dang / glus bskul ba ni mngal gyi gnas skabs 'phel ba dang / thig le sa bon phyag mtshan 'od zer spro bsdu rnams/ mngal gyi gnas skabs rdzogs pa dang / 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs pa ni mngal nas btsas pa dang mtshungs pa yin la/ 'di man chad la 'dus pa zhabs lugs sogs dang mthun rung du sgrig pa'i dbang du byas nas snga rabs pa mang po zhig 'di skad ces 'chad de/ sems dpa' gsum brtseg ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi mthu rdzogs par gyur gyi bar la sbyor/ gzhan yang sems dpa' gsum ni/ rags pa dang / phra ba dang / shin tu phra ba'i rim pas/lus dang rlud dang 'od gsal mtshon par gsang 'dus lugs gnyis las 'chad pa ltar yin no/ /gshed dmar la skabs 'dir rjes chags bsgom pa ni/ thig le rdzogs pa dang / shes rab 'phel ba —41—

ni/ rim gyis blo nus rdzogs pa dang / byang chub mchog gi nga rgyal yang / sngon 'phangs pa'i 'bras bu rnams rdzogs pa ste/ gsum po 'di lo bcu drug lon pa'i mtha' dang sbyor ro// nag ngo 'i mngon rtogs ltar na byang chub mchog gi nga rgyal bzung ba yan chad/ lo bco lnga tshun chod du sngon gyis 'phangs pa'i rnam smin la gtso bor spyod pa dang sbyar nas/ rjes chags ni lo bcu drug gi mthar/rigs dang myo/thun pa'i bag ma blang ba sogs sbyong byed do/ /de'i tshe pho mo gnyis sbyong byed la lha yab yum gnyis so sor yod kyang / gnyis ka'i bar do dang / mngal na gnas pa sbyong byed ni/ nga migs pa phrugs gcig po des chog pa'o/ /shin tu rnal 'byor ni/ de nas bu dang bu mo sogs skyed pa sbyong ba dang / skye mched byin rlabs ni de rnams kyi mig sogs kyi nus pa rgyas pa dang / rdo rje gsum byim gyis brlab pa yang sgo gsum gyi nus pa rdzogs pa dang / dbang bskur rgyas btab ni/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bya ba la gnas pa dang / mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba ni 'dod yon la longs spyod pa dang / nyer bsdu ni 'chi ba sbyong ba dang / thun mtshams kyi lha sku ni slar yang skye ba len pa sogs sbyong bar byed do/ /zhes pa 'di ni snga ma rnams kyi bzhed tshul yin la/ ka ma la rak+ṣi ta'i sgrub thabs dang 'grig par 'gyur ro/ /bdag gi rnam par rtog pa ltar na/ skye mched byin rlabs nas dbang bskur rgyas btab kyi bar gtso 'kho(ra thams cad lhan cig tu sgrub pa'i lugs dpal 'dzin dang la li ta sogs kyi srol ka 'di la/ bshad ma thag pa de cung zad mi 'grig pa ltar stsang la/ skabs 'di na gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs sam/ bde mchog nag po'i lugs kyi dkyil 'kho1ra rgyal mchog dang / gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'di'i rnal 'byor phyi ma gnyis dmigs pa 'dra rung du yod kyang /gcig gis gcig la rgyas mi khebs te/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs pa nas/ mngal du dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i bar la/ rim pa gzhan mang po yod med kyis sgo nas cho ga rgyas bsdus khyad shin tu che ba'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di ltar bya ste/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs ma thag pa —42—

ni mngal nas btsas pa dang / de ma thag tu rlung dang khams spro ba'i gzhi legs par grub pa ni/sems dpa' nang ma gnyis dang dharma dh+wa tu ni chos kyi dbyings te rgyu'i don yin pas de'i nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ sngon kyi las kyis 'phangs pa'i bde sdug myong ba'i 'go brtsams pa sbyong ba dang /gshed dmar ltar na bde ba dang / blo nus 'phel pa'i 'go brtsams pa yang yin la/ nag po ltar na rjes chags ni/ lte ba'i gtum mo'i nus pa rtsa gnas kyi rlung g.yo ba dang / sangs rgyas rnams zhugs shing mkha' dkyil du gyur pa ni/ phyi rol kyi rlung nang du zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis rtsa gnas thams cad du rlung g.yo zhing 'bab pa dang / dkyil 'khor spro zhing dgod pa ni/ de ltar rlung babs pa'i rkyen gyis phung khams sogs rdzogs pa mtshon te/ phung po lnga rigs lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi yum bzhi/ sgo skong bzhi lus kyi yan lag /thod pa bzhi dbang yul rnams so/ /mngal du gzhal yas khang bsgom 'ing de 'a dag sbyor byed na/ skra sen gyi mthar thug pa'i lus kyi khog pa spyi la sbyor dgos/ te/ 'on kyang ga/shung las ma bshad pas ma sbyar kyang chog /de ltar na de dag gi byis pa btsas nas mi ring ba'i gnas skabs sbyong byed dang / de rjes dbang po drug gi nus pa 'phel ba ni/ skye mched byin rlabs/ sgo gsum gyi nus pa 'phel ba ni rdo rje gsum byin rlabs/ 'phel ba rdzogs nas rang rigs kyi bya ba la gnas pa ni dbang bskur rgyas btab dang / yul sna tshogs pa bsten pa dang las sna tshogs la 'ju ga cig bde sdug myong ba ni/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba dkyil 'khor spro bsdu dang bcas pa'o/ /lhag ma sngar dang 'dra ste/ de dag kyang bdag kho na'i rnam rtog gsar pa 'ba' zhig ma yin te/ sa bon phal cher bla ma dam pa gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsungs las byung ba'o/ /sbyangs 'bras kyi dag pa la/tshogs bsag dang po ni/ bskal pa grangs med gsum du bsod nams tshogs bsags pa dang /tshogs bsag gnyis pa las thog mar stong nyid kyi don bsam pa yang / lam dus su ye shes kyi tshogs sgrub pa nyid dang sbyor zhing phyis shā n+ya ta'i sngags brjod pa nas brtsams te/ yi ge lnga bskyed —43—

pa'i bar du rten gyi dkyil 'khor du rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa'i skabs/ so so thad kha der rang rang gi nga rgyal yod mod kyang / nga rgyal gyi gtso bo ni sem sa stong nyid du zhugs nga de la chos kyi sku'i nga rgyal 'jug dgos nga/sa/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyi ngang la gnas pa'i skabs de ni/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku mtshon pa'o/ /gang du sangs rgya ba'i zhing khams/ ni/ srung 'khor gzhal yas khang gda' dang bcas pas lam du byed la/ srung 'khor ni bdung/ bzhi bcom pa'o zhes phal cher smra ste/ de ltar sbyor na ni/rdo rje gdan du bdud btul/ ba'i mdzad pa tshul ston tsho pa de dang shin tu 'grig pa ma yin pas/ nam sangs rgyas pa na sgrib gnyis spangs pa nyid la bdud btul ba zhes bya ste/ 'di dang sbyar na 'grig bo /myo / ngo myo byang snga chi ye shes lnga dang / ā li kā li ni mtshan dpe ste zla ba sku dang / sa bon gsung /r+ya/ga mchan thugs/ 'od zer spro bsdu 'phrin las te/ de dag dang ldan pa'i rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa ni longs sbyo nga rdzogs sku'o/ /de nas yi ge lnga las/ 'bru gsum ni rdo rje gsum/ ho gnyis ni snying rje chen dro/ dang thabs la mkhas pa ste/ de sku la zhugs pa ni/ thugs snying rje chen po'i dbang du gyur pa dang / snyi nga rje chen po de yang dmigs pa med pa yin pa ni zhu ba dang / stong nyid snying rje dbyer med kyi byang chub kyi sems de la gnas pa de tshad med bzhis bskul ba ni glus bskul ba ste/ de ni longs skus sprul pa sprul par mjad pa'i rgyu yin la/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs pa ni sprul pa'i sku'o/ /sprul sku de rtsa ba'i sprul sku yin la/ byang chub mchog mchog gi nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ de yang chos sku'i rnam rol tu shes pa'i phyir dang / rjes chags dkyil 'khor spro ba dang bcas pa ni/ 'dod chags chen pos gdul ba la chags lam ston pa dang / yan lag gi sprul pa'i sku sna tshogs pa 'a sbyo/da par mdzad pa'o/ /skye mched byin rlabs ni yon tan mtha' yas pa mnga' ba dang / rdo rje gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad ye shes mnyam nyid du 'dres pa dang / dbang bskur ni 'khor 'das thams cad kyi 'dren par gyur pa ste/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba ni mchod pa'i —44—

————————rderderderderde —————rderderde—snye ————— rderdebakod pa dang / spro bsdu ni mdzad pa sna tshogs pa dang / bzla/sa/ pa/ chos sto myo pa dang / dkyi' 'khor nyer bsdu ni la lar sprul nga/'i sku mi snang bar 'gyu/ra ba ngang / thun mtshams kyi lha sku ni phyogs ga len du sprul sku snang bas mdzad pa rnams so/ /yang rdzogs rim gyi smin byeng/ rngo sri 'gyur tshul ma do tsar/ du brjod na/ ye shes tshogs gsog ni stong phyogs kho chi rdzogs rim gyi smin byed dang / dkyi' sor la nyer bsdu ni gsal ba lha'i 'khor lo 'od gas la du 94jug rwa dang / rdo rje sems dpa' zhu ba chi/bde bas khyad par du byas pa'i stong nyid te/ gsum po de stong pa'i phyogs kyi rdzogs rim smin bying yin la/ rten gyi dkyil 'khom ra bskyed pa dang / thos ma/tha' gnyas ri su thun mtshams kyi lha sku bsgom pa ni/ rgya che ba snang phyogs kyi rdzogs rim smin par byed/ mngon byang lnga ni kham/sa dkar da rma ra gyi 'du 'phrod las/ rlung 'gags nga/ dang / rnam rteg thim nga/ dang / phung kham sa dag pa dang / dngos 'bras ye shes kyi sku rdzogs pa ma' cing / zhu ba bskul te 'bras bu rdo rdze 'dzin khro ra ba'engs pa yang / rtsa 'kho/ra lo bzhir rlung sems 'gags pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i 0das nyid kyi ye shes skye ba mtshon pa dang / sems dpa' gsum brtseg ni snying ga'i mi shigs pa'i this le/'i smo ra dang / thin tu rnal 'bya ra ni nor bu thig le rjes dran dang bcas pa dang / skye mched sku gsung thugs dbang bskur rnams dga' bral sprul pa'i thig le'i skor dang / dkyil 'bor spro bsdu ni mi/ shigs thig le chen ngo/ snang bcas rjes gzhig ye shes sku'i rim pa sogs te/ snang stong zung dul jug pa'i rdzogs rim dang /mchod bstod sogs ni rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi smin byed jo/ /de la gshin rje g.ye/rded nag po'i rgyud le'u bco brgyad can nas/ nag po lha bcu gsum/ gyi dkyil 'khotshor gsungs pa rnam sa dang /dmar po'i rgyud le'u bcu dgu yod pa nas/ dmar po bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor ston byed kyi tshig rnams/ phal cher 'dra ba yod cing / dmar po'i phyogs la rgyud gnyis ka nas sna lnga rgyas par nga khrind cing / nyer gnyis pa las bcu gsum ma gsungs pa med la/ rgyud le'u bcwa/rde dgu pa las lha —45—

bcu gsum ma 'i sgrub thabs 'di/ 'thor thabs su gsungs so/ /dmar po bcu gsum ma la ni/sgrub thabs dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa 'a 'ad kho na las gzhan ma 'gyur bas/ da lta lag len du 'debs pa la/ dpal 'dzin gyi gzhung la mi brten pa'i thabs med la/ nag po la yang dpa' 'dzin gyi gzhung 'di dag grags che shos yin mod kyi/ gshin rje gshed 'byung ba dang / ka ma la rak+ṣi ta'i sgrub thabs sogs/ rgyu gzhung bzang po gzhan yang mang du yod cing / rwa lugs kyi sgrub thabs rling pa dang / nā ro pa'i man ngag klog skya lugs dang / na ri pa'i man ngag mal lugs gcig tu 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs sogs rgyud rkyang man ngag gi lugs legs po yang mang du yod do/ /gshed nag gi sgrub thabs rgyud kyi bstan tshod dgongs don ji tsam yin pa de las lhag chad kyi skyon thams cad dang bra' ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo chos rje kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung las rtogs par bya'o// // ༈ bcom ldan 'das dpal /bro bo'i rgyal po sa shan rje gshed zhal drug pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyud sdom gsum pa las 'byung ba ltar/ 'jam dpal khros pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya rnams sngon du btang / rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed po'i skur gsal ba'i snying gar āXlas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūX yig nag po/ de las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ rdo rje khro bo chen po 'chol pa/ gshin rje gshed po lha nyer gcig gi dkyil 'khor/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ gang gi drin gyis sogs dang /zhal drug 'jigs pa'i hūX sgra sgrog/zhabs drug skyil krung g.yon brkyang gar//phyag drug mi bzad mawo cha 'dzin/ /lha chen drug 'joms de la 'dud/ /oX —46—

an+taX pra titsā swāhā/ nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod pa dang / lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sdig sogs rgyun bshags dang / shā n+ya ta'i sngags don bas ma pa'i bar/ gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /'dir paṇ+ḍi ta klu byang gis snying ga'i hūX gi 'od zer gyis gdug rnga / can bsreg par bshad pa ni/ tshogs zhing gi cho ga'i yan lag tu skabs su mi bab cing / yan lag bdun pa gur nas 'byung ba bzhin mdzad pa ni mi legs pa ma yin no/ /stong par sbyong ba la yang / dang por hūṃ n+ya ta dang / rjes su swa bhā wa byed par bshad de nges par dgos pa ni ma yin la/ go rim yang de cung mi legs so/ /stong nga/'i ngang las paX las nga/khru dang / raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'a/bor gyi steng du/ hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa de las 'ong zer phyogs bcur spros/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ zhes nga/ nas/ kun tu bzang po yab yum gyi ngo bor gyur/ ces pa'i bar yang / dmar po bcu gsum ma'i skabs bzhin las/ srungs 'bor gye mtshams su/ oX badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hū ཾ ༷/ zhes brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /chos 'byung gi nang du/laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ljang ser grwa bzhir rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mchan nga//de'i steng du paX las sna tshogs pad+ma dang / huX las sna tshogs rdo rje brtsegs pa zhes pa nas / bhuX gyis mtshan pa 'byung bzhi pad+ma rdo rje 'khor lo/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las sangs rgyas rnam par nas/ me tog gi 'phreng ba thogs pa rnams kyis brgyan pa/ zhes pa'i bar gzhal yas khang bskyed tshul yang dmar po bcu gsum ma'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /gzhal yang khang gi steng 'og gi —47—

gzhi rna ( 5 lnga/ ḍā/ the/ra dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus sngo ba/ rtsig pa'i nang rol tu lha snam gyis bskor ba'i dbus kyi gzhi la/ 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa/ 'khor lo'i lte bar paX las/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du/ raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ 'bor lo'i rtsibs shar du zla ba/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/byang du rdo rje rgya gram gyi gdan/ mtshams kyi rtsibs bzhi dang / phyi'i grwa bzhi dang /mang gi grwa bzhi ste bcu gnyis su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan re re'o//dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ a ā/ i yī/ u ྅ / ṛ nā/ '-i lī/ e yī/ o au/e aX phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga / ca tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa lha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa lha/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /skabs 'dir rgyud las/rma sogs spangs pa min pa nyid/ /gsum pa'i gnyis pa bzhi pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ ya ra la wa ḍa bha ston pa'i tshig go /rgyud las mngon byang gnyis pa nyi mar bshad cing / lha 'byung gi sgrub thabs na yang rgyud bzhin du yod/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho na yod pa de dang bod kha cig zla ba spa sbyor du 'dod mod kyi/ rgyud sdom gsum pa las brten nga/'i skabs 'dir nyi ma nyid do/ /de gnyis kyi bar du huX las byung ba'i rdo rje tho ba huX gis mtshan pa dang / āXlas byung ba'i gri gus āXs mtshan pa ni/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes// de las 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros/ 'phags pa rnams mchod/ sems can thams cad ga tha/na rje ba/ned kyi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te thim pa ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so/ /de dag yongs su gyur pa las sku rdzogs pa hruXyig dang bcas pa ni chos kyi —48—

———spo dbyings kyi ye shes te/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje sku mdog nag po dus kyi mun nga/ ltar gnag cing ngam za ba/ sgeg pa 'a sogs pa sar dgu'i nyams kyi ro dang ldan nga// bdud kyi dkyil 'bor ma lus pa sreg par byed pa'i ye shes kyi me dpung drag tu 'phre7 zhing 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ dpal gyi mgur nas hru yig gi sgra sgrog pa/ zhal drug phyag drug zhabs drug dang ྅ na pa/ rtsa zhal nag po rab tu khros pa/ 'bru1ga stong ldir ba lta bu'i gad rgyangs car//g.yas zhal dang po dmar po ljags 'gril zhing bskyod pa/ gnyis pa ljang khu khro gnyer bsdus pa/ g.yon zhal dang po dkar po 'dzum zhing bzhad pa/ gnyis pa ser po rnam par gtsigs pa/ steng zha la nag ngo rab tu 'jigs shing zhal gdangs pa'o/ /steng zhal gyi dbu skra lhag nga ra 'bar zhing / zhal gzhan rnams kyi dbu skra rtsa ba'i phyogs nas bcings pa la/ mi/ mgo skam po'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje tho ba rwa nyi shu pa 'phyar ba'i thabs kyis 'dzin pas gnod byed 'byung po ma lus nga/ thal bar brlag nga/ra mdzad tu/g.yon gyi dang po zhags pa dang bcas nga/'i sdigs 'dzub kyis mi srun pa thams cad sdigs par mdzad pa/ bar pa gnyis kyi g.yas 'bar ba'i ra 'a gris ma rungs pa rnams dum bur gtub cing / g.yon gtun shing bsnams pas sdang ba thams cad phye mar mdzad pa/ tha ma'i phyag mdun ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas/ bar pa gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas/ ma he nag po dregs shing khros pa mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du/ gzhan rje pho mo nag po'i stobs —49—

kyis brdzis pa/ rgyab ma gnyis/ g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa/ 'dir paṇ+ḍi ta klu byang dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtshor/ dang po gnyis sems skyil du 'dod kyang / da lta yod pa'i rgyud dang de ba ā ka ras rdor skyil du 'o da nga ltar bya/ zhabs 'og gi gshin rje pho mo la/ rgyud rgya gzhung na dmigs bas/la med/ bod snga phyi rnams la byi chings su bsnol ba dang / byin bcings su bsnol ba dang / mkha' gsang sbyar ba dang / kha gsang sprad pa sogs yi ge'i 'khrul gzhi la brten pa'i 'dod chul sna tshogs yod kyang / g.yas bskum pas pho kha bub dang / g.yon brkyang bas mo gan kya' du mnan pa yin no/ /zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / bzhin shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ mche ba rnon po zangs yag tu gcigs nga// sku spom zhing thung la gsus khyim 'phyang ba/ khro bo rdo re chol ba'i cha byad can/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris dang / seng ge nga/gas pas se ral kha byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug rgos/ brgyan pa/ khrag 'jag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra bcings pa zhes pa nas/ 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba can gyi bar/gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i skabs bzhi/ de la 'khyud pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje ro langs ma/ sku mdog mthing kha/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spya na gsum pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug cung zad 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas thod pa khrag gang 'dzin pas yab kyis mgul nas 'khyud pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga sogs rgyan dang cha byad bcom ldan 'das dang phal cher mtshungs shing / thod pa skam po'i do shal gyis khyad par du byas/ pa/ zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung gis thabs shes —50—

snyoms par 'jug pa/ khro mo'i dbang phyug mchog gi cha byad rdzogs pa'o /gtso bo'i thugs kar ra pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdorje rtse lnga pa'am/ tho ba hru yig gis mtshan pa dang / yum gyi thugs kar yang pad nyi la gnas pa'i gri gug gi yu bar a yig go /'dir dbu re re la thod skam gyi dbu rgyan bod snga ma phal cher gyis mdzad pa ni/ spyi 'gros dang mthun mod kyang / thod skam gyi 'phreng ba dbu skra 'chang byed du rgyud nyid las bshad pas de ni nges par dgos shing / de phyin thod skam gyi dbu rgyan med kyang chog par mngon la/ zhal mdog la rwa shar pa rnams dkar dmar mthing gsum nyis brtseg tu mdzad/ rong pa sher seng sogs bar skabs kyi mang po zhis g.yas zhal dkar po nyis sgrigs dang / g.yon zhal dmar po nyis sgrigs su mdzad pa dang / zhang lugs dang rwa lugs kyi mna' chan 'ga' na dbus zhal gsum brtseg steng 'og gnyis nag cing / bar ma dkar ba dang /g.yas ser g.yon ljang rgyab dmar zer ba dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i nang du 'byung ba la/ nag sngo dkar ser dmar nag par bshad pa yang yod pa da tshes mas kyang / man ngag dang ldan na mi 'gal lo/ /de lta na yang zhal khrar byed na/ go/nga du ba po/da ma thag pa ltar bya zhing / yang na zhal drug kha dog mthing nag 'ba' zhig tu byed na'ang shin tu legs te/ rgyud las steng zhal nag por gsungs shing /g.yas g.yon gyi kha dog ma gsungs nga/ shugs la go ba'i dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /'es bshad kyang rung ngo / /klu'i byang chub ces pa'i paṇ+ḍi tas mdzang/ pa'i sgrub thabs las/ 'jar/ dbyangs zhi ba'i skabs thor tshugs kyi rtse mo brgyan rnga/ra mund de/ nga ltar 'gyur ba'i rgyud na/ zhi ba'i dbu rgyan mi/ gsal zhing / 'og tu rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan ‘rind dgos pa dang mi/ 'grig go /steng (nal rma/ gtogs pa'i dbu skra yang / rtsa ba nas sor bzhi tsam yar gzhal mtshams spyi bor bcings shing / de la ma go —51—

bo mang po'i phreng ba ring pos mang du dkris pa las/ dbu skra rtse mo gyes pa kha g.yel ba'i rnam par bya'o /phyis kyi 'ga' zhig yum rang dang 'dra bar 'dod pa dang / kha cig dkyil 'khor gyi lha mtshan la yum gyi phyag mtshan gri gug bsha/da pa dang 'gal gyi dogs nas/ gzhan rang 'dra las phyag mtshan dang ngo gri gug zer ba ni mi/ 'thad de/ rang 'drar 'dod pa la yum zhabs drug pa byas na sbyor stangs shin tu mi bde la/ phyag mtshan gcig par 'dod pa la gri gug gis gnod cing / phyag mtshan dang po gri gug tu bsgyur ba dang / zhal drug pa la zhabs gnyis mar byas na ni/ rtog bzo bo nar song pa'i phyir ro/ /rgya myo sogs 'dir dkyus su bkod pa ni/ snga ma rnam/sa kyi phyag len gyi rgyun tsam/ yin la/rgyud las / bstod pa/'i skabs su/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa/ /zhes dur khrod kyi rgyan tham sa cad yod par gsungs shing / dus gsum khra rgyal he ruka yi thugs/ /zhes he ru ka yin par yang bshang pas rus rgyan nges par dgos pa dang / glang lpags mi lpags sogs kyang rung bar mngon cing / 'chol ba'i khro bor bshad pas/ dbu skra bum lho 'am res 'ga' co reg dang zur phud sogs sam/ khrag zhag gi thig le dang / rgyu ma'i do shal dang / rus dum gyi 'phreng bas brgyan pa sogs kyang byas na legs pa ni yin no/ /'di la gzhal yas khang mi byed par ga sdu rkyang ngam lha lnga bskyed pa dang / ga 'al yas khang gi nga/bus su gtso rkyang bsgom pa'ang yod pa/ gal te gtso bo 'ba' zhig bsgom pa yin nam// skabs 'dir ye shes sems dpa' spyan 'dren rgyas btab byed cing / dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgo gru/ pa yin na/ skabs 'dir ye shes pa bsre ba mi byed de/'os tu gtso 'bor thams cad lhan cig tu byas pa nyid kyis cho ga la spyir ye shes pa bsre na lan mang du byung yang skyon du 'gyur ba ta nam yang ma yin mod kyi/ cung zad cho ga bsdus pa'i lugs 'a/ zor yang ba nyid legs pa'i dbang du byas so/ / 'og gi ye shes pa gzhug mtshams ni nges pa can yin la/ 'dir ni phyag rgya bzhi'i snga phyi gang du byas kung rung mod kyi/ spyi la yongs su grags pa'i phyag rgya —52—

bzhi'i rgyas btab rnams/ ye shes dgug gzhug gi rjes la 'brel chags su bsgom pa dang / chos skad go bstun te paṇ+ḍi ta klu byang gis bshad cing lha 'byung zla ba'i gzhung du yang / phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab kyi tha snyad mi byed mod/ rags bshad du don la 'dra bar snang bas gtso bo dam tshig pa bskyed ma thag tu ye shes dgug gzhug byed pa'i dbang du byas na/ thugs ka'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed zhal drug pa/ gdod nas grub pa'i ye shes sems dpa' 'khore bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaX.ar+ghaX nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ oX badz+ra aX gu sha dzaX oX badz+ra pā sha hūX/ tseX( badz+ra spro ṭa baX/ oX zo a be sha hoX de rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje bsdams pa las 'dzub mo gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul dang / khu tshur lag gnyis bsnol te mkhrig ma'i rgyab sprad pa dang / rdor nga snga mas las mtheb 'dzub rtse sprad pa lu gu brgyud du byas pa dang / rdor bsdams nang du mthe bong bcings pa rnams so/ /gong du bshad pa ltar mngon rtogs rgyas pa'i dkyus la skabs 'dir ye shes bsre ba de mi dgos kyang gtso rkyang la dgos pa go bla ba'i phyir 'dir smos so/ /de nas phyag rgyas gdab pa ni/yi ge bcu bzhi pa'i mthar/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maX/ zhes brjod de/ snying ga dang / dpral ba dang /lkog ma dang / spyi bo rnams su gshin rje gshed ngo 'i dam rgyas reg ste ro mnyam du bya ste de yang rdo rje thal mo las/ mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar gnyebs/ /'dzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu cung zad bskyang ba'o/ /de ni dam tshig gi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /rtsa zhal gyi ljags kyi steng du/ hūX las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa/ lte ba la gnod 'joms kyi yi ge hūX gis mtshan pa'o/ /de ni chos kyi phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa'o/ /rdor bsnga3ri/sa las kung mo gnyis bsgreng ba/ sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag pa dang / rdor bsdam sa las gung mo dang 'dzub mo brkyangs shing / 'jub mo'i tshigs gnyis pa bcag pa/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag pa dang / rdor —53—

bsdams/ las gung mo rin po che ltar byas pa/ rin chen rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya g.yas kyi rna ltag tu bzhag pa dang / thal mo ka pu ta las/ gung mo gnyis pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar byas pa/ chos kyi rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya ltag par bzhag pa dang / rdo rje thal mo las/ mthe bo gnyis mnyam par sbyar/ gung mo'i tshigs gsum pa la gung mo'i rtse mo sbyar ba las kyi rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya rna ltag g.yon du 'jog pa rnams rim pas bya ste/ de rnams kyi sngags dang / oX badz+ra sa tu hūX a bhi ḍa ye lco maX/ spyi bor mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa/ tseX( bud+dhā a bhi ta kwa mi maX/ dpral bar rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ tseX( rat+na a bhi ta sdo ni maX/ rna ltag g.yas su rin chen 'byung ldan ser po mchog smyen gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ྅lde ni maX/ ltag par 'od dpag med dmar po teng nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ oX karma i bhi ski nyu maX/ rna ltag g.yon du don yod grub pa ljang khu mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa ste/ de ltar rigs lngas dbang bskur bar gyur/ yang na skabs 'dir phyag rgya kho nas dbang bskur te/ rigs lnga'i sku mi bsgom la/ 'og tu lha tshogs thams cad la rgyas 'debs byed pa'i skabs/ mi bskyod pa'i rgyas btab byas na'ang mi legs pa ma yin zhing / lha 'byung yang jon gyis 'di ba'i da pa mngon no/ /de ni phyag rgya chen pos rgyas btab pa'o/ /bsdu na des tsam gyis chog /spros pa byed na/ rdo rje khu tshur kha phye ba gnas dgur reg ste/ oX kruX/ zhes go bgos la/ oX badz+ra tu yi heX zhes thal cho/ rting ba brdabs pas dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur ro/ /'di ni phyag chen gyi rjes 'brang ste/ paṇ+ḍi ta klu byang zhes pa nges bshad kyi rgyud las mi gsal/ gzhung gzhan las kyang mi 'byung ngo / /rang gi thugs ka nas sgeg mo la sogs pa lha mo brgyad sprul te/ sna tshogs pa'i mchod nga/sa mchod par gyur/ gar pad sngon du btang nas so so'i phyag rgya bcas te/ tseX( badz+ra satwa su saX gra ha ta/ oX badz+ra la sgyu huX/ oX badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta raX/ oX badz+ra mā le truX/ oX badz+ra dharma gā ya ni/ oX badz+ra gī ti hiX oX badz+ra karma ka rod —54—

bha we/ oX badz+ra n-i kyi a/ oX badz+ra satwa su: oX badz+ra dh+wa pe hūX/ oX badz+ra rat+na: oX badz+ra pur+sha truX/ lkoX badz+ra dharma: oX badz+ra ā lo ke hruX oX blo dz+ra karma kaX: oX badz+ra ga rnye aXlha mo brgyad po rnams rang nyid la thim/ de ni las kyi phyag rgyas rgyas 'debs pa'o/ /de dag ni dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /gtso rkyang bsgom par 'dod na/ gzhal yas khang spangs pa'am/ yod kyang rung ste 'khor gyi gdan spangs nas 'di yan chad bsgom/ gtso bo'i bstod nga sa bstod nas/bzlas pa la zhugs pas kyang / lugs 'di'i bskyed rem cha chang ba 'grub pa yin rno/ /dkyil 'khor rgyas par bsgom par 'dod pas/ gtso bo'i ye shes kyi snang ba las byung ba'i 'khor gyi lha tshogs grub par gyur nga/ ni/ lkoX dzi na dzika swāhā/ 'bor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs la/ gti mug rdo rje sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas 'khor lo 'phyar zhing / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ lkoX rat+na 'a dha ka swāhā/ lho'i rtsibs la ser sna rdo rje sku mdog ser po/ g.yas rin po che 'phyar zhing / g.yon de'i lkoX a ro lika swāhā/ nub kyi rtsibs la 'dod chags rdo rje sku mdog dam/ra po/ g.ya/sa pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu 'phyar zhing / g.yon de'i cha oX pradz+nyā dhika swāhā/ byang gi rtsibs la phrag dog rdo rde sku mdog ljang khu/ phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar zhing /g.yon de'i/ sogs gong bzhin/ de ltar rigs bzhi ni khro bo srin po'i cha byad 'chang ba'o oX lo tsa nā huX/ shar lho'i rtsibs la/ sa rdo rje ma dkar mo gti mug rdo rje lta bu/ oṃ ma ma gī tāX/ lho nub kyi rtsibs la/ chu rdo rje ma ser mo ser sna rdo rje lta bu/ lkoX paṇ+ḍa ri hiX nub byang gi rtsibs la/ me rdo rje ma dmar mo 'dod chags rdo rje lta bu/oX tā re a/ byang shar gyi rtsibs la rlung rdo rje ma ljang khu phrag dog rdo rje dang mtshungs pa/ 'on kyang / yum bzhi po de dag ni rol ba'i khro mo ste phyag g.yon pa —55—

rnams kyis thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa ni khyad par ro/ /'khor lo'i gru chad bzhi la nang gi lha mo bzhi spro ste/ oX badz+ra lā gya huX/ shar lhor sgeg mo dkar mo phyas gnyis rdo rje khu tshur dkur bsten pa/ oX badz+ra mā le truX/ lho nub tu 'phreng ba ma ser mo/ phyag gnyis rin po che'i 'phreng ba 'phyar te 'dzin pa/ oX badz+ra girti sdiX nub byang du glu ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis pi wang rdung ba la brtson pa/ oX badz+ra dra ti aX byang shar du gar ma ljang khu/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa re re 'dzin pas gar byed pa'o/ /lha snam gyi grwa bzhi la phyi'i lha mo rnams spro ste/ oX badz+ra dhū pe huX/ shar lhor bdug spos ma dkar mo/ bdug spos kyi snod 'dzin pa/ oX badz+ra pur+sha truX/ lho nub tu me tog ma ser mo/ g.yon me tog gi snod 'dzin cing / g.yas 'thor ba'i tshul mdzad pa/ oX badz+ra ā lo ke hiX nub byang du mar me ma dmar mo/ mar me'i gong bu 'dzin pa/ oX badz+ra gar+bhe āX byang shar du dri chab ma ljang khu/ g.yon pas dri bzang gis gang ba'i dung chos 'dzin cing /g.yas pas de nyid byug pa'i tshul mdzad pa'o/ /sgeg mo la sogs pa brgyad po de dag /'dzum zhing bzhad la dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhi ba'i nyams shas che zhing yid tsam khro ba/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra nag po/ bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba'o/ /'di rnams sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bzhed pa mang yang / dus 'khor lta bu'i dmigs bsal yod na ma gtogs/ gtso 'khor gzhan rnams kyi zla stobs las rtogs nus pa'i phyir/ bzhengs pa nyid yin par gsal lo/ /sgo skyong bzhi spro bar bya ste/lkoX badz+ra aX gu sha dzaX rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po phyag g.yas pas lcags kyu 'phyar zhing / 6khas g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ oX badz+ra pā sha hūX/ lhor —56—

—sgor rdo rje zhags pa ser po g.yas rdo rje zhags pa 'phyar zhing / zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ o badz+ra slo ṭa ba/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar rnge sto phyag g.yas lcags sgrog 'phyar zhing / zhabs sa ga'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ o badz+ra ā be sha ho byang sgor rdo rje dril bu ljang khu/ phyag g.yas dril bu 'a tu gyel zhing / zhabs zlum po'i stabs kyis gnas pa/ de bzhi phyag g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs 'dzu/ba mdzad pa ste/ sgo ba bzhi po yang khro bo chen po'i cha byad can no/ /de ltar khro chen brgyad po rnams ni/ stag lpags dang /sbrul rgyan dang / mgo bo'i phreng bas skra bcings dang / do shal can/ bcom ldan 'das nyid dang sku'i nyams mtshungs pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de ba ā ka ra'i sgrub thabs na/ glu ma dkar mo sogs sku mdog mi 'dra ba cung zad yod de/mi rung ba med la/ sgrub thabs der yang rdo rje lcags kyu sogs kyi dgug gzhug byed tshul cam las/dkyil 'khor gyi gang du 'god mi gsal lo/ /klu byang gis ni/ sna tshogs kyi mngog can 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba'i 'od kyi khro bo rnam/sa phyag na mchan ma lnga bsnams pa/ zhes rigs lnga bsgom tshul zur tsam ma gtogs/ dkyil 'khor la lha gzhan mi 'god de/ rdo rje lcags kyu sogs kyis dgu0 sa/zhug dang / sgeg sogs rnams mchod pa'i skabs su yud tsam 'god par gsal/ yum bzhi'i gleng brjod med do/ /gong du drangs pa'i tshig de gtso bo'i mngon rtogs kyi dkyil na yod pas de'i don ni/ khro bo gdong drug pa nyid gzhan 'dra ba las/ sku mdog dang phyag g.yas kyi tha ma'i phyag mtshan rigs so so'i mtshan mar bsgyur ba zhig bsgom par gsal lo/ /'on kyang rgyud kyi dgongs pa ni dkyus su bshad pa nyid do/ /sgo skyong bzhi po 'di rnams la ro gdan phyung na legs par sems shing / rwa ye shes seng ges mdzad zer ba dang / rong ba sher seng dang / rgya ston gyi sgrub thabs na mgrin gcig —57—

par byang gi sgo srungs phyag mtshan me long 'dzin pa dang / mtshan yang rdo rje me long zhes 'dogs/ sgo srung bzhi ka yang phyag g.yon dril bu 'dzin par bzhed do/ /de gnyis rwa shar nub so so'i srol 'dzin chen po re yin las/ ngag sgros mthun par byung bas/ rwa lo'i man ngag ma nor ba yin par ni gsal lo/ /de'i lugs ltar na rdo rje 'bebs pa'i phyag g.yas me long 'dzin par 'dug /me long yang lha rnams mnyes par byed pa yin pas/ dgug gzhug bcing mnyes kyi rim pa dang mi 'grig pa ni med/'on kyang sgrub thabs kyi gzhung rnams las/ 'bebs pa'i phyag rgya spyi 'gro ltar dril bu'i phyag rgyar bshad cing / rwa ba rang gi lag len la yang mdzad pas/ rwa lugs pa rang gis lugs la rni/ sgo skyong gzhan gsum/ gyi phyag rma tshan g.yas gtso che ba dang / rdo rje 'bebs pa'i phyag mchan g.yon sa/tso che bar 'chad dgos mod/ spyir dkyus su bshad pa nyid 'thad do/ /de dag ni 'khor gyi lha tshogs sprul pa'o// dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi mig tu khriX las/ sa'i snying po dkar bo 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rna bar dziX las/ phyag na rdo rje nag po rdo rje 'dzin pa/snar khaX la nam mkha'i snying po ser po rin po che 'dzin pa/ lcer gaX las spyan ras gzigs dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ dpral bar skaX las sgrib pa rnams sel ljang khu rdo rje rgya gram 'dzin pa/ spyi bor oX las sku rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ mgrin par āXlas gsung rdo rje dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thugs kar hūX las thugs rdo rje sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhi ba dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ pad zla la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan thugs kar 'jog cing / g.yon dril bu dkur brten ba'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ mchod pa du mas yang dpo/ par mchod de/ lha thams cad kyi gnas gsum/ gyi rdo —58—

rje gsum la thim/ tseX( sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa ko3haX/ de bzhin du bāka dang tsit+ta la yang sbyar/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed po'i ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oX ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ mchod yon/ pra wa ra sa t+pa ra pra titsā swāhā/ zhabs bsil/ 'di'i phyag rgya rni khu tshur mtheb 'jub gnyis kyis me tog sogs blangs te/ gung mo sogs bkrol te kha gyen du bstan pa'o/ /de nas spyi dang rme thun par/ pur+sha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ oX badz+ra ang gu sha sogs sgo ba bzhi'i sngags rgyas/ dgug gzhug bcings mnyes gong du bshad pa ltar bya/ slar yang thugs ka'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khore dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX purmye la sogs pa nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ a bhi tiñtsa tu maX sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /sogs kyi mthar/ lkoX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye huX/ zhes dbang bskur/ lha thams cad kyi sku lus bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang / sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ ye shes lnga mngon du byas/ chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa'am/ sngar rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan bsgoms yod na/ gtso bo'i dbu rgyan rigs lnga la thim pas/ lhag par gzi byin rgyas par gyur cig cing / 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la/ shar dang shar lho pa rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ lho dang lho nub pa la rin chen 'byung gnas/ nub dang nub byang ba la 'od dpag med/ byang du byang thar ba la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ nge/ dag ni rgyas btab kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta bha ga wān shrī ya mun+ta ka sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ nas shasta'i bar du sbyar bas —59—

mchod/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /zhes pa nas/ pu dza badz+ra gyis nga rgyal bzung ba'i bar bya/ huraX/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam bzhugs pa'i/ /zhes sdang skyon rje rdo rje ni// spros med nam mkha' lta bu las/ /snying rje thabs kyis sku sprul pa/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa'i/ /dud pa mun can sku la 'dud/ /gar dgu nyams dang ldan pa yi / /gti mug rdo rje gshed rje gshed/ /skye med don dam ngang nyid las/ /thabs kyis sprul pa'i skur bstan pa/ /'jigs byed drag po'i cha lugs can/ /zla ba nya 'dra khyod la 'dud/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba yi/ /ser sna ga thin rje rdo rje ni/ /'dzin pa po las grol ba yis/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bor sprul/ /gter 'chang ser sna grol mdzad pa/ /btso ma gser 'dra khyod la 'dud/ /chags pas ma lus dbang mdzad pa'i/ /'dod chags gnyen rje rdo rje ni/ /skye mched rnam dag chos dbyings las/ khams gsum pa dag khro bor sprul/ /ma chags spyan ldan thugs rje can/ /brgyu lta bu'i sku la 'dud/ khres rab thabs ldan he ru ka /phrag dog gshin rje rdo rje ni/ /rnam rtog dpe dang bral ba las/ /thugs rje sprul pa'i khro bo ni/ /'gro don brtson nga/'i ral gri can/ /sna tshogs mdog can khyod la 'dud/ /thams cad skyed pa'i lha mo che/ /dbang po lta bur bsgyur mdzad pa/ khams gsum gzigs pa'i spyan dang ldan/ /rnam snang can gyi bdud bzhi 'jigs/ /bde ba chen ngo/sa rtag tu dgyes/ /ye shes spyan can khyod la 'dud/ /kun sdud lha mo rin po che/ /bdag rtog skyon las rnam grol yang / /dus gsum bde gshegs bdag gir byed/ /rin chen tog can mdzes pa'i sku/ /don dam thugs chud 'khor ba sel/ /ma lus kun gyi bdag la —60—

'dud/ /'dus byas ma lus sreg byed pa/ /rnam rtog zhi ba'i rang bzhin las/ /khams gsum ma lus sgrol bar byed/ /'od dpag med kyis rab mdzes pa ma chags phyag na bsnams pa yis/ /'phrin las dag byed can la 'dud/ /thugs rjes g.yo ba'i rang bzhin can/ /'jig rten gsum dag sgrol bar byed//gnyis med bde chen ngang nyid las/ /'phrin las grub pa'i rang ba'i na can/btang snyoms bzhugs pas 'gro ba 'dul/ /kun tu las kyi rgyal la 'dud/ /stu ti badz+ra gyi nga rgyal bzung / de rjes dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi sgrub thabs snying ngo/ra nga shad pa ltar bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs te/ sngags rnams kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas myang / a mṛ ta swa das nga rgyal bzung ngo / /'dir rgyud las bdud rtsi myang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ces pa nas/ 'phros pas bkug ste tshims par bya zhes pa'i bar thams cad bdud rtsi myang ba'i gzhung yin te/ stoms kye skabs su/ yang dag byin gyis brlabs pa dang / /bdud rtsi myang bar bya ba dang / /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyal ba rigs lnga gdan bcas bsgom pa/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs kyi skabs nyid dang 'brel bas na/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs kyi cho ga rwa lugs 'di/ rgyud sdom gsum pa'i dgos pa phyin ci ma log par snang ngo/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin to/ /de ltar snang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yang rmi lam lta bur yongs su shes pas/ spro ba dang bsdu ba la bslab pa ni/ las rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin to/ /ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar sngags 'phreng bkod pa sogs dmigs pa rnams gshed skor spyi dang 'dra bar gsal btab ste/ oX hiXspriXbi kri tā na na hūX hūX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla zhing / yi ge so gnyis pa dang ā li kā li de nyid lnga spel du byas pa dang /gong du bshad pa'i 'khor gyi lha skyed pa'i sngags rnams kyang / ji ltar 'os par bzla'o/ /thun bsdu —61—

bar 'dod na/ gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rgo/gtso bo bcom ldan 'das ni/ kun tu khyab pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes go /tshad med pa rnams mnyam pa nyid ni/ rdorje rol ngas mgo /gti mug rdo rje la sogs pa ni/ me long lta bul sogs pa ye shes bzhi'i ngo bo nyid sgo /lha mo bzhi ni oṃ med pa bzhi'i bdaganyid rdo/ /sgeg mo la sogs pa brgyad ni/ spyin pa la sogs pa brgyad kyi dngos po'i tsho/ /sgo ba bzhi ni bdung/ bzhi yang dag par bcom pa'o /zhes dag dran byas te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ khams gsum sne nod bcud sogs dang / dge ba bsngo ba'i bar yang / gong gshed dam/ra gyi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra/ gtor chog la/ gtor ma byin rlabs ni nang mchod byin rlabs dang 'dra zhing / 'bul ba'i sngags ni/ 'jig rten 'das pa la/ dgra nag dpal 'dzin lugs kyi skabs su bsha/da pa dang 'dra zhing / phyogs skyong rnams ye shes par bsgyur ba'i skabs gtso bo nyid dang mtshungs par bya la/phyogs skyong gi gtor sngags kyang dgra nag dang 'dra zhing / yang na 'di la phyogs skyong rnams sku'i rnam pa ma bsgyur ba nyid kyang legs par mngon no/ /spyir gaṇa/na rje gde/da gdong drug sdom gsum pa'i rgyud 'di/ zhor byung tsam ma gtogs gtso bor lag len du byed pa rgya bod gnyis car du nyung bar byung 'dug pas/ sgrub thabs gnyis kho na las dgongs 'grel rgya gzhung gzhan/ mar 'gyu/ra la/rgyud la'ang rgya 'grel med/ bod kyi'ang rwa lugs kyi yig sna gcig yod cing / gzhan sa bcad dang rgyud gzhung la mchan bu thar thor ma gtogs bod kyi yig rnying yang dkon par yod do/ /rgyud rang gi ngo bo zhal gsal po'i rigs su 'dug kyang / dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos nyungs pa sa/ ji bzhin du 'chad dkar bar gyur te/ bod kyi bla ma bar skabs su byung ba phal cher/ lha sngags tsam/ ma gtogs/ dgra nag bcu gsum ma kho na 'don pa spo bar mdzad pa dang / lo tsā ba rin rnam yang —62—

gzhan rnams de dang 'dra ba las/ phyag rgya'i rgyas btab klu byang gi gzhung nas kha skong ste/ rgyas btab byed pa de ni legs kyang / skyed chog dgra nag ji bzhin du byed pa de thams cad spyir man ngag yin na mi 'gal mod/ rgyud gzhan gyi cho gas sgrub pa'i lugs su song gi/ rgyud 3di nyid kyi dgongs pa ma yin te/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / zhu ba glus bskul dang / 'khor tshogs mab 'a nang nas spro ba rnams rgyud las zur tsam ma yang gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /sgrub thabs gnyis 'a sa kyang de 'dra ma gsungs so/ /des na gtso bo ma/ngon byang lnga bskyed dang / 'khor rnams snying po'i sngags kyis bskyed pa nyid/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan yin par bsnyon du med do/ /dgra ston dus dgra nag pos sbyar zhes 'byung ba'i yi ge las/ gtso 'khor thams cad mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa dang / de'i rgyu mtshan rgyud las/ rdo rje tho sogs so sor rtog /ces pa'i sogs khongs nas 'khor gyi phyag mtshan dang / mngon byang dang po'i skabs/ 'bor lo la sogs sa bon yin/ /zhes gti mug rdo rje la sogs pa'i mngon byang yang bstan pas so/ /zhes zer ba ni rgyud don ma yin te/ tho ba sogs kyi don sogs khongs nas yum gyi phyag mtshan 'don pa yin la/ 'khor lo la sogs kyi don/ phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan pa sogs/ mtshan bzang pa'i sa bon du bstan pa'o/ /dgra ston ces bya ba de yang gong ma/ tshes lnga pa'i gab ming yin zhes grag go /gang ltar na'ang de 'dra ba'i yi ge mthong na/ rang lugs la the tshom za ba gyur gyi dogs nas/ de'i lugs la'ang dpyad par byas kyi/ spyir de tsam la dpyad kyis mi lang ngo / /'di'i dag sbyor gyi snying po ni/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa yan chad dmar nag bcu gsum ma'i skabs dang 'dra/ sbyang bya'i skabs pha ma bu sogs kyis dbye ba mi/ byed par/ mngon byang lnga las gtso bo bskyed pa ni/ mngal skyes dang sgong skyes kyi srid pa sbyong bskyed rim spyi'i rim pa dang mthun cing / nad sogs bar do sbyong byed la logs par med kyang / skabs 'dir hūṃ yig dang por skyed tsam nyid/ bar do sbyong byed yin la/ skad cig gnyis pa la mngal du zhugs pa mtshon/—63—

spyir cho ga bsdus pa'i lugs la/ bar do sbyong byed logs su med pa yang shin tu mang po/ /sems dpa' gsum brtseg sngar dang 'dra/ phyag rgya bzhi ni rim pas sems dang ngag dang lus dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'o/ /gtso bo la ye shes dgug gzhug logs su yod pa ltar na/ de yang sems rdzogs pa'i nang du 'du'o/ /'khor gyi lha tshogs sngags/ tsam las bskyed pa ni/ rlung gi skye gnas can rdzus skyes sbyong byed dang / mig sogs dang rdo rje gsum gyi lha sa bon las skyed pa ni/ drod gsher skyes sbyong ba dang / rdo rje gsum byin gyis brlab pa dang / ye shes dgug gzhug ni/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs dang / ye shes kyi nus pa rdzogs pa dang / dbang bskur mchod bstod sogs kyang spyi dang 'dra'o /de bzhin du mngon byang lnga ni/ rtsa a wa dhū tir /bams dang rlung gi 'du 'phrod las/ rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skye ba dang / phyag rgya bzhi ni rnam rtog thim pa dang / rlung thim pa dang / khams kyi sgrod pa spyi bor thim pa dang / rtsa brgyad dag pa'i mthu las 'dod yon bde bar shar ba'o/ /'khor tshogs spro ba ni/ phung po dang / khams dang / dbang yul dang / dbang rten khog pa rnams rim gyis rnam par dag pa'i ye shes so/ /mig sogs byin rlabs man chad spyi dang mtshungs/ yang 'bras bu dang sbyar na mngon byang lnga ni ye shes lnga/ phyag rgya bzhi ni sku bzhi/ 'khor tshogs rnams ni phung khams sogs dag pa'am stong nyid nyi shu'i ye shes/ gzhan rnams la spyi dang mtshungs pa'i dag sbyor bya'o/ /'di la sgos kyi dkyil chog rgya gzhung med pas/ rwa ba dang skyo ba ni rang rang gi lugs rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil chog 'don pa spo la/ zhang pa yang nag po'i dkyil chog 'gyung ba dang sbyor/ sngon gyi mal lugs pa yang rang bzhed kyi nag po'i dkyil chog dang sbyor bar grags/ 'on kyang 'dir ni bar skabs byon pa'i chen po rnams kyis lugs rnying pa thams cad gsan nas gcig tu gril ba yin pas 'don pa bsgyur dgos kyi khyad par rnams ma gtogs/ dmar nag gi dkyil chog dpal 'dzin gyi lugs de kha sbyor rgyu yin no/ /rgyud 'di'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha'i byin rlabs kyi —64—

——stobs las bshad pa bya ste/ bod kyi yi ge 'kho da pa gang na'ang rgyud don bzhin med de/ ma bshad pa dang log bshad dag kho na'o// klu byang gis cung zad bshad pa de yang shin tu mi gsal lo/ /des na 'di ltar go dgos te/ dkyus dang logs su thig brgyad brgyad btab pas/ re mig bzhi bcu zhe dgur bya/ yang na zlum skor rim pa bzhi byas nga/'i 'khor lo zlum po la'ang 'grig tsam 'ong ste/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa ni gru bzhi nyid do/ /de yang phyi'i zur bzhi la ṛ '-i bzhi/ bar ba'i zur bzhi la a sogs bzhi/ nang ma'i zur bzhi la e sogs bzhi/ phyi skor gyi steng gi re mig lnga la ka ste/ g.yon gyi lnga la tsa sde/ 'og gi lnga la ṭa sde/ g.yas kyi lnga la ta sde/ rim pa bar ba'i steng gi gsum pa la pha ba/ g.yo/na gyi gsum la bha ma ya/ 'og gi gsum la ra la wa/ g.yas kyi gsu/rme/ la sha ṣa sa/ nang ma'i phyogs bzhi la g.yas skor gyi/ ha dang ā ring po dang / nga ro rnam bcad rnams 'god par bya'o//nang gi re mig dgu'i phyogs bzhi dang bar pa'i mtshams bzhi bor ba'i re mi ga bcu gnyis la/ ya sogs yi ge bcu bdun 'god/ phyi skor nyer bzhi la/ zur dang por oṃ dgod par brtsams te/ bar du re mig re re bor bar yi ge bcu bzhi pa 'god de/ hu gnyis dang phaṭa gnyis re mig re re la 'god do/ /lte bar ya'i dbus su k+ṣa 'god cing / de'i nang du'ang ming yig bri/ ga‘to rnams mgo phyir bstan yin na/ dbyangs gsal phyi dang / nang bstan yin na sngags 'bru rnams phyir 'god/dbyangs gsal rkyang pa yod pa'i re mi/ga nyi shu la/ dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge'i 'og tu/ hi yig gam hū gnyis kyi mtha' brten pa'i ming yig 'bri ste/ dper na steng du ka dang / 'og gi sdi 'am hū gnyis gsum tshoms su byung ba ni/ rgya yig i dang 'dra ba ste/ sum skor gyi don yin pa/ 'di la'ang 'khrul 'khor ri mor bris pa dang mthun pa'i sngags bzla tshul sogs bya dgos so/ /'dir smras pa/ sngon rabs 'ga' yis 'di don rtogs srid kyang / /yi ge'i lam du 'khode pa gcig kyang med/ /phyi rabs dus dang deng sang rgyud 'di'i don/ /ji bzhin ma nor smra bar nga min su/ /'di ni 'khrul —65

'khor gyi khyad par thun mong ma yin pa yod—tshul skal ldan don gnyer rnams 'a/ 'phrin bskur ba tsam yin gyi/ lag len bla ma dam pa las rtogs dgos pa kho na'o// //lhe/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po la phyag 'tshal go /de la 'jam dpal khros pa lha bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i bdag nyid kyi sgrub thabs mdzad pa po la li ta badz+ra zhes bya ba 'di/ nag po skor gsum gyi rgyud spyan 'dren pa po'i la li ta badz+ra ma yin par shes la/ ro langs brgyad skor gyi sgrub thabs rgya gzhung mdzad pa po dang / dgra nag gi gzhung skyon rje gshed 'byung ba mdzad pa po yang / rgyud spyan 'dren mkhan gyi la li ta min par nges shing / gzhung 'di dag mdzad pa ngo/ gang zag gcig rang yang yin nga/ra ma nges pas/ la li ta'i mtshan can mang du byung bar gsal/ rgyud spyan 'dren pa po la la li ta che ba dang /gzhan rnams la la li ta chung ba zer yang / chung ba la gcig kho nar nges bzung med la/ la li ta badz+ra dang / lī la badz+ra yang / bod skad du bsgyur na rol nga/'i rdo rje zhes bya bar gcig kyang rgya skad mtshan tha dad pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan nges can gzhan yod na ma gtogs/ so so yin par gsal sgyu sto /skyo lugs pa rmams la li ta'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs sgeg pa'i rdo rjer bzhed mod/ spyir de ltar mi 'gal yang / 'jam dpal gsang ldan mdzad pa po dang ni ye mi gcig go /'dir la li ta chung bas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/'jigs mdzad chen po zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs mdo tsam bshad par bya'o /de la thog mar rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' rkyang rwa lugs kyi sgrub thabs snying po zhes bya ba kho bos sngar sbyar zin nga/ dang / de'i dkyil chog sngar sbyar zin pa'i bdag —66—

bskyed dang mdun bskyed kyi skabs kyi tshig don rnams blo la 'jems par byas nas/ bya ba'i rim pa dang tshig rigs gcig gis chog pa rnams/ der kha 'phangs te 'dir mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams brjod par bya'o/ /skyabs sems yig brgya sogs song nas/ skad cig gis rang dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur pa'i snying gar pad+ma dang zla nyi la/ hūX nag po mchog tu 'bar ba'i zhes dang / oX badz+ra la phya sogs kyi dod du/ an+taX nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod pa gong dmar po'i skabs bzhin du bya/ rgyun bshags sdom bzung tshad med bzhi dang / swa bhā wa'i sngags don gyi bar yang sgrub thabs snying po dang 'dra/ 'on kyang 'di la skyo pa rnams tshogs zhing la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ rgyun bshags tshig lhug pa byed/ de ni mi legs pa'ang min la/ 'dzims pa rin be'i sgrub thabs dang / la li ta'i rjes 'brang du 'dod pa phyis 'byung thams cad kyis/ rgya gzhus gi tshig/sdig pa rnams ni bshags par bya/ /skyes zhing 'byung ba rnams ni bsal/ /mi byed par yang spyan sngar brjod/ /ces sogs brjod pa ni mi legs te/ de dag ni bshags pa la sogs pa de dang de bya'o zhes go ba ston cing 'chad pa'i tshig yin gyi/ ngag nas 'don rgyu'i tshig ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /tshig de nyid kyi thog mthar/ mchod pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /ces dang / chad med bzhi yi khang bzang lam/ /mchod pa bdun ni rab tu bya/ /zhes sogs dang 'dra ste/ de 'don dgos na de yang 'don dgos par 'gyur ro/ /de nas swa bhā wa'i rjes su/ oX hūṃ n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha zlum po'i steng gi dbus su/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dang /a las zla ba'i gdan la yi ge dhīXlas rang nyid 'jam dpal gzhon nu sku mdog sngon po'am gser gyi mdog can yid tsam khro ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes —67—

mtshan pa'i ral gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon sdigs 'dzub mdzad pe / zhabs rdo rje'i skyi‘pa krung gis bzhugs shing / dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing mtshan dpe thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de'i thugs kar a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis 'jam dpal gyi sku zhu ste nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'od kyi rtse mo la 'jam dpal gyi sku dpag tu med pa sprul/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad thams cad bsad bskrad dbye rmongs rengs brgyal ba la sogs pas tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus nyi ma la thim/ slar yang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rig pa'i lha mo dang / khro bo dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs te nyi ma la thim/ gdug pa thams cad sreg par byed pa'i 'od zer mtha' med du 'bar bas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dpag tshad 'bum du khyab par gyur/ skyo ba'i yig rnying 'ga' las/ skabs 'dir 'jam dpal nyi ma snyel thim par byed kyang gzhung nyid dang cung zad mi mthun no/ /de lta bu'i 'od kyi 'phreng ba las skad cig gis/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me dpung dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor grub cing / dbus su bhuX las sna tshogs rdo rje'i gzhi la gnas pa/ rnam par snang mjad kyi rang bzhin gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rin po che sna lnga las grub pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du/ nag ljang dmar ser dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du pha gu ser po dang /dra ba dang / dra phyed 'chang ba/ rin po che'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa/ steng mda' —68—

yab mchode rten gyi rnam par mdzes pa/ pu shu'i khor yug la gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan bsgreng ba/ myong gi lha snam shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang / dbus sngo ba/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bris pa/ dbus su dkyil 'khor zlum go de'i nang re mig dgur gyur pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu 'a4 mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams dang / sde stobazhi'i thad ka nas/ ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs rnams kyi rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang / ri dwags dang gdugs kyis mtshan pa/ khyams la mchod pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /nge'i phyir ro' tu gtu'/ drag la sogs pa nas/ sna tshogs pas gang ba'o ma /zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs snying po ltar ro/ /dkyil 'khor nang ma'i re mig dgu dang / phyogs bzhi'i lha snam la lha'i gnas brgyad brgyad dang / sgo bzhi dang / grwa bzhi ste lha'i gnas bzhi bcu rtsa dgur/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor brtsegs pa'i gdan re re gnas par gyur/ de nas lha bskyed pa la/ skabs 'dir gzhung las/ thog rma phyag mtshan rnams bkod nas/ de zla bar bsgyur dgos pa 'dra ba zhig yod cing / phyis kyi dpyad pa che ru re ba kun yang / skabs 'di'i don 'dzug tshugs bshad rgyu med nas zol 'jog byed cing 'bros par snang ngo / kha cig 'dir rlung gi dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe dgu bsgom par 'dod pa ni/gzhung dang mi mthun la snga rabs pa su yang mi 'dod cing / ham shur brjod pa tsam mo/ /de la gzhung gi don ni/ las dang po pas dkyil 'kho(ra bsha/ra sgom byed pa sogs/ bsnyen pa rkyang ba'am bdag bskyed rkyang ba'i skabs su/ skabs 'dir phyag mtshan bsgom dgos pa'i don min/ sgrub pa sgrub chen la bdag mdun dbyer med kyi skabs su/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed pa phan chad —69—
