song nas/ thog mang dkyil 'khor la bris pa'i lha mtshan rnams yid kyis gsal btab nas/ de nyid zla bar bsgyur ba sogs kyi don yin zhing / sgrub thabs 'di yang rtog bdun gyi rtog pa dang po'i don 'grel du shes par bya'o/ /lar bya ba'i rim pa la ltos pa'i bsnyen pa nyer sgrub sgrub pa sgrub chen 'di dag ma go bas/ gshin rje gshed la mkhas rlom phyis byung ba rnams shin tu 'phongs par gyur gda'o/ /da ni dkyus la 'jug ste/ lha'i gdan thams cad kyi steng du/ a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re gnas par gyur/ de rnams kyi steng du chu las chu bur brdol ba'i tshul gyis/ sa bon gyi yi ge re re byung ba ni/ dbus kyi zla ba la dhīX re mig brgyad la/ oX aX dziX khaX saX raX dhaX kaX shar gyi lha snam la/ baX khaX smo maX dz+nyāX waX tsaX dz+nyāX/ lho'i lha snam la/ baX yaX muX dhaX raX taX haX dzaX/ nub kyi lha snam la/ bhaX maX rāX raX sāX raX snyuX baX/ byang gi lha snam la/ ko haX gaX dz+nyāX saX saX aX aX/ sgo bzhir/ aX pāX spaX ghaX/ grwa bzhir/ suX uX huX aX rnams so/ /zla ba dang yi ge de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas slar 'dus te thim pa so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur nga las/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'jam dpal gzhon nu sku mdog sngon po/ 'od zer gyi 'phreng bas phyogs kun khyab par byed pa dang / re mis dgu la shar nas g.yas skor gyis/ gti mug rdo rje phra ma rdo rje dang / /'dod chags rdo rje phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /de bzhin me nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis/ /sems ma rdo rje rin chen rdo rje ma/ /chos rdor rje ma las kyi rdo rje ma'o/ /byang shar nas brtsams g.yas skor lha snam la/ rdo rje rnon po rdo rje ral gri dang / /byams pa dang ni 'jam dpal ye shes sku/ /ngag gi dbang phyug dang ni zla ba'i 'od/ /ye shes mtsho rnams shar gyi lha snam la'o/ /rdo —70—

rje las dang rdo rje gnod spyin dang / /rdo rje khu tshur dang ni rdo rje chos/ /srung ba dang ni rnon po rdo rje rgyu/ /dra ba'i 'od rnams lco yi snam bu la'o/ /rdo rje smra ba rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rdo rje rgyal po chags pa legs pa dang / /rdo rje rin chen rdo rje nyi ma'i 'od/ /rdo rje nyi ma rnams ni nub phyogs su'o/ /rdo rje tog dang bzhad pa spos kyi glang / /ye shes tog dang thams cad thabs kyi 'gro/ /rgya ma/tsho'i blo gros blo gros mi zad pa/ /bdud rtsi'i 'od rnams byang gi snam bu la'o/ /shar sogs sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu dang / /rdo rje zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'o/ /me sogs mtshams bzhir gnod mdzes gtsug gtor dang / /huX mdzad dang rbi gzhan gyis mi thub pa'o/ /de ltar na shar dang shar lho pa rnam dkar po/ lho dang lho nub pa rnams ser po/ nub dang nub byang pa rnams dmar po/ byang dang byang shar ba rnams ljang khu/ thams cad kyang yid tsam khro ba nas/mtshan dpe tham/sa cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur gyi bar gong bzhin/ 'on kyang lha mo bzhi rni dbu skra phyed bcings shing / bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'o/ /skabs 'dir skyo lugs pa rnams dang / phyis kyi rnams phal cher/ dbus kyi gtso bo 'jam dpal dmar ser/ shar phyogs kyi lha rnams nag por 'dod de/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung zhang 'gyur bo na las gzhan ma mthong bar zad la/ zhe dgu ma 'di skyo lugs su grags na yang 'di rtsa ba zhang lugs la thug pa yin pas/ skyo ba rnams zhe dgu ma'i gzhung zhang 'gyur kho na byed do/ /zhang 'gyur las ni/ gtso bo 'jam dbyangs kyi sku mdog snga phyi gnyis kar du mi gsal la/ shar gyi phyogs pa thams cad nag /ces 'byung yang gti mug rdo rje dang sems ma rdo rje ma nag por mi 'thad cing / rong zom 'gyur las/ thams cad 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i gzugs/ /dbus kyi gtso bo sku mdog sngo/ shar gyi phyogs pa thams cad dkar//—7/—

zhes sogs 'byung bas/ gzhal yas khang gi phyogs mdog kyang / dbus sngo zhing shar dkar ba sogs rdo rje'i rigs kyi spyi'i 'gros la yod pa dang mthun pas legs la/ tshig snga ma gnyis po de zhang 'gyu/ra la chad pas/ gtso bo sku mdog tu ma zad/ 'kho ra gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi phyag mtshan la yang / 'dod pa mi mthun pa dang the tshom gyi dpyad pa mang du byung mod/ rong 'gyur du 'jam dpal gzhon/ nus gzugs zhes phyag mtshan dang sku'i dbyibs gsal bar bstan to/ /yang skabs 'dir gzhung las/ de nas yi ge a la sogs/ /yi ge ha yig mthar thug pa/ /'di dag thams cad yongs gyur las/ /gong gi lha ru bsam par bya/ /zhes 'byu/nga ba la/ kha cig zhi ba'i lha tshogs 'di rnams mngon byang lnga las skyed zer ba ni/ gzhung gi don min zhing rgya mkhar ka bcu ba sogs gzhan dag tshig de bong du bshad pa'i/ tso du e sogs sa bon de rnams ā li kā li las byung ba'i don yin par 'chad pa ni/ smra rgyus 'phongs par zad cing / ngor pa sogs mang po zhig ni zhe dgu ma'i bsngags brjod yang skyor mang po byed kyang gzhung 'di dag la mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin to /'o na 'di'i don ci zhe na/ gong du/ 'di dag sa bon yi ge ni/ /e lte a ji rdo sogs gsungs nas/ de nas yi ge a la sogs/ /zhes 'byung ste/ sa bon gong du smos pa rnams sam/ yang na a yig las gtso bo 'jam dpal bskyed pa nas/ hā yig las gzhan gyis mi thub skyed pa'i bar/ sa bon 'dam khar gsungs pa yin te/ k+ṣa spangs nas/ yi ge bzhi bcu zhe dgur gsung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no/ /lha zhe dgu la 'jam dpal gnyis byung yang gtso bo 'jam dpal ni rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bo ste rdzogs pa'i sa/ngas rgyas yin la/ shar gyi lha snam gyi 'jam dpal ni/ byang chub sems dpa'o/ /rdo rje rnon po gnyis byung ba ni/ snga ma rdo rje'i rigs dang / phyi ma pad+ma'i rigs kyi sgo nas tha dad yin la/ spyir ni rnon po nyid 'jam dpal du bshad pa/ sogs yod pas/ rgyud gcig dang tha dad sogs kyi dpyad pa mi 'jug la/ mtshan tha dad dang rigs tha dad las lha so sor 'jog dgos pa'i skabs shin tu mang —72—

ngo / /yang / lha thams cad kyi thugs kar yi ge a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'a/bor re re ri / /de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa 'khore dang bcas pa dang/ga tu med pa spyan drangs/lha rbems kyi thugs ka'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams la thims pa'i rkyen gyis/lha rnams nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nyid la 'dres pas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa bzhi bcu rtsa dgur gyur/ yang 'od zer ‘da tshe sna phras 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi steng du/ khro bo'i sa bon rnams grub pa ni/ dbus/ su huX sngon po/ re mig brgyad kyi phyogs bzhir/ oX 'a hāXsnriXbi/ mtshams bzhir/ kṛ tā na na/ shar kyi lha snam la// yak+ṣi yasnro ni rā ma ya/ lto'i lha snam la/ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ nub kyi lha snam la/ ya me du ru ṇa yo da ya/ byang gi lha snam la/ ya da yo ni ra ya lte ya/ sgo bzhir/ ya mun ta kagrwa bzhir/ huX oX hūX phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge phyogs kyi mdog can rnams su gyur/'dir zhang 'gyu/ra gyi dpe rnams la/ oX gsum oṃ bzhi huX gcig phaṭa gsum sogs sna tshogs zhig snang ba/ bod dpe ring du brgyud pas ma dag par mngon/ rong zom 'gyur gyi dpe kha cig na/ yi ge hūX oṃ suX yig phaṭa/ ces 'byung ba'i suX yig ni gnod rma dzes kyi sa bon du bsams nas bod kyis bcos par 'dug dpe dag pa rnams las/ yi ge huX oṃ huX yig phaṭa/ ces 'byung ba ltar yin te/sngags gsum gyi yi ge las lha tshogs bskyed dgos pa'i phyir/ suX yig 'byung ba mi bde la/ rtsa sngags dang snying po'i oṃ gnyis gcig tu sdoms/ phaṭa gsum gcig tu sdoms/ hūX gsum las snying po nye snying gi hūX gnyis 'dir bkod pa yin la/ rtsa sngags kyi huX ni gtso bo'i sa bon nyid do/ /sa bon de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams —73—

cad khyab/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / khro bo'i dbang po dang / rig pa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/yig 'bru rnams la thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus kyi gtso bo'i gnas su/ rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa rwa gdengs pa'o// re mig brgyad la/ shar du mgo bo/ lhor lag pa/ nub tu rgyu ma/ byang du rkang pa/ shar lhor thod khrag /lho nub tu thod tshal/ nub byang du ro ras/ byang shar du skyes bu gsal shing gis phug pa'o/ /shar gyi lha snam la gri gug dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa dang / gshun shing dang / chu gri dang / ka ṇa ya dang / lcags kyu dang / ma he dang / ba lang rnams so/ /lto'i lha snam la rim pa bzhin/ sta re dang / mda' dang / dgrag pa dang / kha ṭāX ga dang / 'khor lo dang / zhags pa dang / phag dang / bong bu'o/ /nub kyi lha snam la/ rdo rje dang / cang te'u dang / phub dang / gzhu dang / dril bu dang / rlung ras dang / rnga mong dang / khyi'o/ /byang gi lha snam la/ sdigs 'dzub dang / ba dan rtse gsum pa dang / glang lpags dang / tho ba dang / mdung dang me thab dang / lug dang / lce spyang rnams so/ khar sgor bya rgod/ lho sgor lug pa/nub sgor bya rog /byang sgor seng ge /shar lhor bya khra/ lho nub tu bya chen po/ nung byang du khyim bya/ byang shar du bzhad dkar rnams so/ kha cig phyag mtshan 'di rnams la'ang phyogs mdog byed pa ni/ sa bon la phyogs mdog byed pa'i rigs 'grer 'dug kyang / bya rog dmar po sogs bzhad gad kyi gnas mang po 'byung ngo / /des na 'di rnams rang mdog tu bya la/'og tu gtso bo'i zhabs 'og gi srog gzugs 'chad pa'i skabs na phag med kyang / rgyud kyi gtor ma'i skabs na yod la/ kha cig seng ge ni ha ri zhes pa ne tso'i skad dod/ seng ger bsgyur bas 'gyur —74—

nor ba yin zer mod/ ha ri kha dog ljang khu la 'jug pa yod kyang / ne tso'i skad dod min/ ne tso ni/lha mo dpal chen mo mtsho ni cing / seng ge yang dpal chen mo'i bzhon pa yin pas dod mtshungs pa 'a dgongs pa'i phyir mi 'gal bas/ 'dab chags kyi sdebs la gcan gzan byung ba ma dag go snyam/blo bzo'i los mi bya'o/ /yang / de rnams las 'od zer gyi tshogs chen po dang / lhan cig tu rdo rje phra mo mang po dang / sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i gzugs dpag tu med pa spros/ sdang ba dang / gdug pa rnams tshar bcad/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la bkod/ zhing khams dag par byas/ zhes pa nas/ 'jig rten gsum pos lta bar yang mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ ces pa'i bar/ sgrub thabs snying po bzhin du brjod pa las/ zhabs 'og gi lha'i skabs su/ gzhon nu gdong drug dpa/ tshogs kyi bdag po dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma rnams kha bub tu bskyel nas gnon pa/ zhes lha chen brgyad du brjod na/ gzhung las/ gzhon nu bi nā ya ka sogs/ /zhes pa'i don dang mthun par 'gyur la/ gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon gyi zhal drug ni 'di la nges par 'khor zhal yin/ de yang gzhung las/ g.yas kyi dang po'i zhal ni sngo/ /de'i g.yas dmar g.yon ser po dang / /zhes 'byung bas/ zhe dgu ma'i skabs 'dir mdun nas mu ded yin par gsal lo/ /'dir de ltar yin yang spyir rwa zhal dang / brtsegs zhal dang / 'khor zhal nyid la yang / g.yas g.yon gyi dang po ni/ g.yas g.yon gyi dbus ma la ngos 'dzin pa sogs kyang / rgyud gzhung rnams las ci rigs pa 'byung zhing / 'ga' zhig man ngag yin la/ rgyud dang yang 'gal ba med do/ /phyag dang po gnyis kyis glang lpags 'dzin pa dang / 'og gis 'dzin pa'ang mi 'gal mod/ /dkyus dang 'dra bar byas kyang legs so/ /re mig brgyad la shar du rdo rje mgo go lhor rdo rje lag pa go pa nas/ nub byang du rdo rje khyim bya/ byang shar du rdo rje bzhad dkar/ wo pa'i bar du —75—

phyag mtshan dgod pa'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ ming thams cad kyi thog mar rdo rje zhes pa re 'jug cing / re mig gi grwa bzhi'i lha la/ shar lcor rdo rje thod khrag mo zhes sogs lha mo'i mtshan 'jug go /yum bzhi ni/ khro mo lha zhal can phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/gzhan rnams ma he'i zhal can/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan cing / ling ga rgyas pa/thams cad kyang sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rang ming dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan 'phyar zhing / g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa bdud : sa gang ba 'jin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang nga/sa mi/ ro'i sang na snyel gnas pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs/ dbu skra khams ser gyen du brjes pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal ras la blta ba/ ches cher 'khrugs shing h+pha kyi sgra dang bcas pas rgya cher bzhad pa/thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang / mgo rlon gyi do shal dang / gdug pa'i sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ bcom ldan 'das dang de'i rigs las skyes pa'i tshul gyis/ 'bar 'phreng 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /'dir gzhung las/ bcom ldan ji bzhin thams cad kyang / /zhes 'byung ba'i don/ gong ma phal cher/ ma he'i zhal ston byed du bzhed pa ltar/ bla ma'i ngag sgros dang man ngag mi spong ba'i phyir 'dir yang de ltar bkod do/ /'on kyang gzhung nas 'khor rnams la ma he'i zhal ston byed gsal bo med cing / bcom ldan ji bzhin zhes pa yang nyams dang cha byad rags rim 'dra ba la dgongs pa shas che bas/ 'khor thams cad khro zhal du byas kyang legs so snyam pa ni/bdag gi rnam par rtog pa'o/ /zhe dgu ma'i lugs 'dzin pa kha cig /gzhan pho mo thams cad ma he'i zhal du byed cing / rgyud las sgo mtshams brgyad du ro langs 'bri bar bshad pas/ brgyad po khro zhal du bya dgos te/ ro langs la ma he'i zhal mi bde bas so zer ba ni/ don shin tu ma rtogs pa ste/—76—

spyir rgyud kyi dngos bstan phyag mtshan gyi dkyil la bor dang / ro langs brgyang bkod nga/ yan yang /'e dgur byed pa ni la li ta chung ngus bla ma'i mam ngag bkod pa yin gyi/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan mi na la/ man ngag 'di la brten nas rgyud don 'chad pa'i tshe/ sgo gru/tshams kyi ro langs brgyad ngo/ lha 'i gdan yin gyi lha ma yin no/ /des na 'kho ra gyi ro gdan thams cad ro langs yi na yang / rtse gzhan rnams la gdan mi 'god par phyag mtshan 'god/ sbo mtshams rnams 'a gdan lha mtshan du 'khod kla yin par 'chad dgos pa ma shes nga/ dang / ro langs brgyad skor gyi nga kyil 'khor ra 'chad pa ltar na/ro langs kyi don mi ro langs pa kho na ma yin gyi/ ro langs kyi las byed pa'i lha 'a/ zer ba yin pas/de la gdong brnyan byung yang 'gal ba ye med do/ /'a/bor rnams kyi phyag mtshan 'a spa cig phyag gnyis kas mgo bo la sogs pa re re bsnams par bzhed na/ de yang gcig tu 'ga'/ rnga med rmo nga /kha cig rang de ltar smra bzhin du/ gzhan lha mtshan la 'bod nga/'i lag pa dang rkang pa gnyis gnyis byed pa la dgag pa gtong ba ni/ rje dngos kyi dbang las nang 'gal spra ba yin la/ mtshon cha rnams ni stong pa dang / /snying rje dag ni bcu drug gnyis/ /'es phyag mtshan gyi/ das nga thams cad sa sungs zin pa'i rjes su/ lha rnams nyid kyi rang ming ni/ /dang ngo ra lko/ dang hū ཾ phaṭa ma/tha‘3/ :thong/ nga ra cha ba dag pa'o tsho/ zhes lha zhe brgyad kyi mtshatsa/ sngags rngam par dag pa/ thod pa btung rdeb dang bcas nga ra bar+sha/da pas na/ lha thams cad kyi phyag tu thod pa btung bas gang ba dgo/sa te/ gzhan du na/ mtshams kyi thod pa bzhi la sbyor na sngags zhe brgyad dang sbyor ba'i dag sbyor de la 'brel chen ngo/ mi 'byung ba/sa so/ /des na mtshams bzhir thod pa bzhi yang dkyal 3khor 'di la mi dgos so/ /phyas rma tshan ma/go bo ni gzhung 'dir yang / tshangs mgor bshad pa zur tsam yang med pas/ zhe nga gu ma/'i skabs 'dir yang mi mgo kho na go /'o na rgyud las dkyil 'kho(ra gyi dbus su mi ro 'bri ba de/ zhe dgu ma'i skabs 'dir/ ro langs kyi rig pa mtshungs pas gdan bkod par byed dgos na/ gtso bo'i gdan mi ror —77—

'chad pa mi 'grig go zhes dogs nas/ gtso bo'i gdan ni byol song bcu drug dang / lha chen brgyad sogs rnam grangs mangs pa'i phyir/ thams cad dgod mi nus pas/ de dag thams cad kyi spyi gzugs mi ro'am/ yang na zhabs g.yas kyi dang po'i 'og gi mi gzugs bkod pa yin no/ /zhes pa rnams kyang zhe dgu ma'i lugs 'di la nges par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su skye mched/ sku gsum thugs byin gyis brlab pa/ sgrub thabs snying po nas 'byung ba ltar byas na'ang legs la/ 'di nyid kyi rang gzhung las mi 'byung bas med kyang chog go /'ga' zhig skabs 'dir sems dpa' gsum brtseg byed kyang / gzhus las sa bon tsam 'a sa ma bshad pas rang lugs la 'di ltar bya ste/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ de rnams kyi steng du gtso bo'i thugs kar huX/ 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar/ oX hiXsgyiXbi kri tā na na ya spu ya ts+tsha ni rā ma ya ya ma rā dza sa to me ya ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya ya da yo ni ra ya spu ya ya mun ta ka hūX oX huX phaṭa/ rnams mar me ltar 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'bar ba'o lha thams cad kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po lha bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaXhuX baX hoX lan lnga bcu sogs mang du brjod/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ 'dir snga phyi kha cig rdo rje bya rgod la sogs pa'i mtshan sngags kyi dgug gzhug byed pa ni/ khyad chos su rlom pa'i rtog bzo thal zhes pa yin la/ oṃ badz+ra ang gu sha jaX sogs byed na ni mi legs pa ma yin no/ /yang gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūX 'a/sa 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha 'jigs mdzad chen po rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo'i lha tshogs 78—

rnams mdu myo/ gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX oX pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes sbyar nas/ ar+ghaX dang pur+sha sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ skyo pa'i yig rnying las skabs 'dir phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa byed pas bshad/ mgon po de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas dag ni thams cad kyi/ /skye bas thob pa'i dbang bskur ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis lha yi chus/ /dag pa lha yi chu dbang bskur/ /oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi khiñtsa hūX/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /zla ba zhun ma lta bu'i bdud rtsi'i sku lus thams cad gang / chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa// shar dang me mtshams kyi lha la rnam par snang mdzad/ lho dang bden bral gyi lha la rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub dang rlung mtshams kyi lha la 'od dpag med/ byang dang byang shar gyi lha la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ 'dir skyo lugs kyi man ngag las/ dbang lha rdo rje 'jigs byed rigs lnga dang bcas pa zhes 'byung zhing / de'i don yang khro bo rigs lnga la/ dbu rgyan nam thugs kar zhi ba rigs lnga bzhugs pa yin la/ de thams cad kyis dbang bskur bar bzhed do/ /phyis kyi kha cig gzhung zhang 'gyur du/ sngags pas yang ni gcig pu ni/ /dbang bskur ba yang bsgom par bya/ /zhes pa'i don du bsams nas/ gtso bo gcig pu la dbang bskur ba dang / gzhan dag rong 'gyur las/sngags pas yang rbi gcig tu bya/ /zhes pa'i don du bsams nas/ rdo rje gsum dang ye shes pa lan gnyis 'jug par 'dod de/ gzhung gi dgongs pa ni/ sngags pas yang ni gcig tu bya/ /zhes pa yin yang / de'i sngon du/ gzhug dang bcing dang mnyes par bya/ /'es gsungs pa'i 'jug sdom yin pas tshig snga ma dang don gcig pa'am/ yang na dus 'bor ltar/ ro mnyam gyi don yin gyi/ bskyar —79—

nas ye she/ bro / pa nga rdong gcig tu byeng pa'i/ don ma yin no/ /oX badz+ra bhi ra wa maṇ+ḍal de ba ta sa rī ri wā ra byuX zhes thog mar sbyar myos/ ar+ghaX nas shabha pra tisnro swāhā/ bar gyis mchod/bstod nga/ ni / tsaX/ drag po chen po drag shul che/ /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par byed/ /rkang pa'i sta/bas kyis sa gzhi gnon/ /lha dang lha ma yin rnams la/ /sdigs pa'i phyag rgyas bsdigs ma/dzad pa'i/ /zhal dgu pa la zhabs bcu drug /phyag rgya sum cu rtsa bzhir ldan/ /phyag rgya mang ngo/ 'bar zhing 'khrug /'jigs pa ma rbe'i gdong pa can/ /bskal pa'i me dpung lta bu yi/ /lha mchog rnam par gtsigs nga/'i zhal/ /ljags 'gril mche ba gcis sa pa yi/ /lha dang lnga ma yin rnams dang / / gdug can dgra rnams shes sa la/ bar mdzad/ /dbu skra khams nag gyen du brdzes/ /drag po chen po g.yon brkyang pa'i/ /stobs kyis gnod cing rma/tshan ma bsgreng / /gsus khyim che zhing ljags bskyod pa/ /mi mgo lnga bcu'i 'phreng bas brgyan/ /phyag rgya drug gis mdzes par spras/ /thod skam 'bar ba'i dbu rgyan mtho/ /'jigs byed che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nyid kyi sku gsung thugs las sprul/ /'jigs byed khro bo'i tshogs rnams dang / khro mo rnams dang dur khrod gnas/ /bsrung ma dam can tshogs ‘pa'ang bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ de dag ni lugs 'di'i srol 'dzin rnying pa rnams kyi lag len ltar yin zhing / rgyas par na rtags bstod la sogs pa bya'o/ /sgrub thabs 'di dgra nag gdong drug gshed dmar rnams kyis kha 'gengs mi mdzad pa'i lugs su 'dug pas bstod pa 'di nyid 'os mod/ bod la sgrub thabs rnying par bshad pa ltar gyi mchod bstod sna tshogs pa dag kyang 'gal ba med do/ /de rjes dag pa dran pa ni/ dam/ pa'i don du rnam nga/ga pa/ /dus ni dpa' bo chen po'i gzugs/ /zhal —80—

——— ——brgyad thun tshod brgyad yin te/ /zhal dgu thun tshod spyi yin no/ /phyag ngang rwa ni / ༵ s+ho ༵ ni zha /༵dho sa/ sna ༵ rno/za~X hūṃ kau~X / shes / / smra/ rlo // bzhin sgo sbyar / ma / rngon zha rngu spros chan shu/sa ni dho~X dang snying bhe dag /sgi dī~X dru nag gnya na sa /de/ smi~X bar ༵rdo~X ༵ gtso sngu /rdo/ dog/ nag po~X mas kau ༵ lgi ༵khro ༵ dzā /ni/ mi 'gyu/rder ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor lha ni thams cad dag/rang bzhin 'byu/nga ba'i dus dag go /dus gsum dag pas sku gsum mo/ /lha rnams nyid kyi rang mi/nga ni/ /༵༵ ༵rā ༵ dzogs ༵ na no lab//༷ ༵ je san+ta ka |mdog sna /s+ho rdo dhi/ spru/ḍā/gas pa ste/ /dag pa thams cad shes pa sna ( / /zhes brjod cing don bsam/ dag dran 'di gzhung gi dngos bstan la/ thun mtshams kyi spyod nga 'i yang 'jug na yod mod kyi/ de ni ngald pa'i go rim cam las/ skabs der bsgom dbos nga 'i don min la/ des ni 'ji bzlas pa'i thog rme tha' gang wo du bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa ni/ o ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo ༷ khye hūṃ/ |/ / / ༷/ ༷ hūṃ /rdo bye rdeX rdo ༷ ༷/ / ༷ rde/rde—81—

ṣa/ ka rta ri lhin di pā la/ mu ṣa la/ tshu ri ka /ka ṇa ya/ ang gu sha /ma hi ṣa/ mṛ gā la/ ku khyu ra/ sha ra/ ga da/ kha ṭāX ga /tsakra/ ba sha /bā rā ha/ gde bha/ yang oX badz+ra badz+ra hūX phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ ḍa ma ru ka /pha ska/ dha nu/ lha ṇ+ḍa/ ba ta pas/ ut+ta/shwa na/ tardza ni/ tri ba tā kaXje /ga dza tsarma/ mud ga ra/ kun+ta/ asni kuṇ+ḍa/ ma lgaja sbu ka /gro dh+wa/ u lu ka /kā ka /ha ri/ ma rnyi/ se na/ sha ku ni/ oX badz+ra sā ra sa hūX phaṭa/ ces pa rni 'khor gyi sngags so/ /yang 'di dag la/ oX tseXrtso badz+ra shi ra huX phaṭa/ oX hruXbadz+ra hasta huX phaṭa/ ces sogs dang / oX ya badz+ra ka rta ri huX phaṭa/ oX snye badz+ra bi de pā la huX phaṭa/ ces sogs dang / tseXdz+nya ya badz+ra kṛ dha hūX phaṭa/ tseX( mun badz+ra u lu ka hūX phaṭa/ ces so gas dang / kun gyi mthar/ oX phaṭa badz+ra sā ra sa hūṃ phaṭa/ kyi bar du/ sa bon dang spe la nas/ bzla ba zhang lugs kyi man ngag tu 'chad de/ nag po zhang lugs dang mthun cing /'khor gyi snga gas la rtsa 'don byed phyin chad/ shin tu bzang bar yang mngon no/ /gzhung las/ mchod pa sna tshogs/ mchod par bya/ /zhes sogs dang / sha rnams thams cad bza' ba na/ /zhes sogs 'byung ba ni/ sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'a/ mchod pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa kho na ston byed ma yin mod kyang rig pa mtshungs pa'i phyir/ bzlas pa'i tha mar yang / gong bzhin mchod pa dang / 'dud nyi shu'i bstod pa dang / bdud rtsi myang ba so/gas byas pa'i mthar/ rang bi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ dge ba bsngo ba'i bar/ ga sheng dmar gyi skabs dang tshig don 'dra ba las/ rang rig ma zhes pa mi dgos so/ /spyir rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma sogs / 'khor tshogs mngal 'byin gyi cho ga yod pa'i lugs rnam/sa la/ rtag tu 'khyud pa'i yum bsgom pa 'os shing legs pa yin yang / zhe dgu ma dang ro la ngas brgyad bskor sogs la/gsang ba'i mchod pa'i skabs lta bu dmigs pa yud re bsgom nga/ la 'khyud yum dgos pa'i skabs —82—

yod kyang / dang po skyed chog gi skabs nas/ rtag tu 'byung ni yum bsgom pa ni mi rigs rte/ rang rang gi gzhung dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ yi ge bcu pa dang / a mṛ tas bsangs/ sa bhā wa'am/ a kā ros stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum gyi dbus su/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum ‘sna bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dum bu gcig pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar/ de'i steng du a las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan dbus dre kyi na las mi'i sha dang mu las byung ba'i dri chu brtsegs pa/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha /lhor ku las khyi'i sha /nub tu da las rta'i sha /byang du ha las glang bo ( tshe'i sha /shar lhor bhuX las dri chen/lco nub tu aX las rak+ta/ nub byang du dzi las byang sems/ byang shar du khaX las klad pa rnams su gyur/ rlung g.yos me sbar sha lnga bdud rtsi zhu zhing khol/ raX yig dmar po'i 'od kyis kha dog dang dri ro ngan pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/a yig dkar po'i 'od kyis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la oX āXhūX/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs spros shing bsdus nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste thim pa dang / 'dod yon dpag tu med pa'i char phab par gyur/ oX āXstoX/ de rjes rgyas nga/ la mos na/mdun du dkyil 'khor bskyed de gtso bo cho ga gsum ba3sgrid dang / gzhan rnams sa bon cam/ las bskyed do/ /de rjes ye shes spyan 'dren dang dbang bskur rgyas btab byas myos/ mchod bstod cung zad rgyas pa sngon du 'gro bas gtor ma 'bul/ mdor bsdus pa la dag ri na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor sangs snye83—

rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ bstong/ pa gang rung gis bstod/ ljags hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oX hiXsnriXbi kri tā na na riX phaṭa/ shrī badz+ra bhe ra wa/ a ti pa ti/ i maX ba ling / kha kha/ ji hi ji hi hūX phaṭa swāhā/ lan bdun la sogs pas gtso bo la phul/ sngags gsum gyi ma/thar/ i maX ba ling / sogs btag pas 'khor tshogs rnams la phul/ ar+ghaX la sogs pas smya/chod cing 'dud bstod bya/ la li ti'i gtor rmo kha chung ngu ni zhe dgu'i sgrub thabs kyi cha lag yin pas 'dir sbyor dgos so/ /rang bi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sa 'og sa steng / sa bla na gnas nga/ dang / sku gsung thugs kyi las byed rnams dang / 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi la dbang 'byor ba'i phyir/ phyogs bzhir rgyu ba'i dam can rnams dang / phyogs skyong ba bcu/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ yi ge bcu pa'i ma thar/ sa ma ya stuX/ gyis dam la ba theg oX dh+wa tsa rā nāX/ya pā tā 'a / tsa rā ya/ mun khe ca rā /tā / ta purba di gwa nāX/ ka dak+ṣi ṇa dwo gā ya/ hūX pañtsa ma dī gwa nāX phaṭa ud ta ra di bā ya/ oX i hiXya hi ba/ bi k+ṣa kri ka tā ye na a na de huX bhaXphaṭa sarba bhā te byuX i maX/ ba ling kha kha khu hi khwa hi hūX phaṭa swāhā/la myo gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'jom/sa/ /sogs la/ dam can bsrung ma'i tshogs la bstod/ /ces 'don pa spo/rdo rnge 3rdzas sa rma dzad/ 'khor bcas rnams/ /ma/chod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nas/ kun 'grub shog /ga'an yang zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ /bla ma/ smod/ nga/ra byed pa dang / /dkon mchog sa sum la gnod pa dang / /bstan pa 'jig par byed pa —84—

dang / /sems can yongs la 'tshe ba dang / /sngab/sa rgyud smod par byed pa'i mi/ /'di rnams khyod kyis sgrol ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la brtse bar mdzod/ /ces las gzhol/ rjes dngos grub blang ba dang / yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshe/gas gsol/ smon lam bkra shis rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /sgrub thabs 'di'i sbyang bya sbyong byed la bsrung 'kho ra dang gzhal yas khang gi dag sbyor ni/ rgyud sde spyi dang mtshungs shing / zhi ba'i sa bon bzhi bcu zhe dgu bsgom pa nas brtsams te/ lha ma/nga nyung 'a ga khyad par tsam dzo 5 gtogs/ dag sbyor thams cad dpa' rkyang gi sgrub thabs kyis rigs 'gre la/ lha rnams kyi dag pa ni/ re mig gi lnga dgu phung lnga 'byu/nga bzhi dag cing / ye shes lnga dang tshad med bzhi'i ngo bo yin la/ snam bu'i lha rnams phyi nang gi zos ngang 'pho ba dag cing / bde stong so gnyis dang / mtshan rmis gnyis kyi ngo bo yin la/ sgo ma/chams brgyad po rnams/ rnam shes brgyad dag cing / dbang phyug brgyad kyi ngo bo'o/ /dngos sgrub thabs lugs 'di rgyud rkyang man ngag gi lugs min/ sgrub thabarngo5 rgya gzhung kho na gtso bor byed pa yin yang / 'gyu/ra byed bod kyi srol ka'i dbang du byas na/ 'a:pegs mdzad zhang lugs kyi tha snyang/ kyang chos 'di la 'ju ga par 'gyu/ra zhing / skyo pa'i rjes 'brang phyi ma rnams/ bod kyi brgyung pa gzhan la ma ltos pa legs snya ma nas/ a mo gha la brgyung/ pa 'ded kyang / chos 'di ni skyos a rmo lhe la ma gsan zhang la gsan pa yin pas/ skyo lugs zhang lugs zhes so sor med do/ /des na 'di'i dbang chog la/ skyo lugs lha dgu'i dbang chog sbyo ra ba mi legs te/ brgyud pa so so'i lag len bzhin byed phyin/ dgra nag zhang lugs la 'don pa spong ba nyid mchog /hūṃ bzang ngo // // ༈ nga ni dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po khro mo brgyad skor gyi sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /'di la gnod sbyin mo brgyad skor dang / gshin ’ji cho/ brgyad skor dang / skyo lugs lha dgu zhes1 kyang grags te/ don du mthun rung gi ming yin la/ ngo shrī pa rnams na re/ 'di la lha bcu bdun —85—

ma zhes bya/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi srol 'dzin bod du byung ba la bzang shos mthar thug ni mal lugs yin pas de la 'gran zla med/ de 'og na skyo lugs kho na ngo mtshar che/ skyo ni rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag yin/ skre' slob brgyud gnyan rin chen brtan ba'i khyi ka yang bshad sgros shin tu bzang / rwa lo ni mthu che yang rgyud don 'chad mi shes so zhes sgrog cing / khong pa rang tsho shin tu bsngags brjod che ba'i skyo lugs de ji ltar yin 'chad pa na/ 'di skad ces/ skyo lugs pa rnams ni/ sgrub thabs rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa zhes bya ba 'jigs byed bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs a mo gha badz+ra kyis mdzad pa 'di dang / rtog gsum gyi las tshogs kho na gtso bor byed/ yang zhe dgu ma'ang rtsal 'thon lag len byed ces smra go /'di ni cha med kyi rgyus gtam kho na ste/ sngon gyi ngor ba de dag kyang skyo lugs kyi gzhung man ngag kyang phyag len rnams shes pa'i phyogs su lta ga la phyin/ chos skor ji tsam yod dang / nyams lem gyi mthil gang yin tsam yang ngo ma shes pa'i ham gtam shugs bskyed de/ mtha' 'khe(ba kyi blun po rnams dang / mtshan nyid pa phyogs zhen can rnams mgo bskor ba la zhugs pa kho na yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di lta ste/ sems nga pa' bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs 'di la/ tshig sna ring thung mi 'dra ba'i rgyas bsdus gnyis yod cing / dpe la la na mdzad pa po don yod rdo rjes bsgyur ro bya ba 'dug kyang / dpe rnying la la na 'jam dpal ye shes kyis mdzad ces pa'ang yod/ don yod rdo rjes bsgyur bya ba dang / rong zom gyis bsgyur bya ba yang yod/ sgrub thabs 'di ni rgya gzhung rtsod med du byed kyang rgyud gzhan la brten pa'am bla ma'i man ngag tsam yin gyi/ rtog bdun la gtso bor brten pa min la/ 'di 'a/ khyed rlams kyis bcu bdun ma'i tha snyad sbyar 'dug pa'i tha snyad rang yang don dang mi mthun nga/sa mi/ 'thad de/ nga kyal 'khor la lha dgu las med pa'i phyir ro/ /sru nga 'bor la gshin rje pho brgyad yong/ pas so snya ma na/ 'o na khyed rang rnams kyi lugs la yang / kyai rdor gyi mngon rtogs bsgom pa'i tshe/ srung 'khor gyi gtsug —86—

gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du/ dkyil 'khor bsgom pa na/ kyai rdor lha nyi shu ma dang / 'khor bsgyur zhu zhing sbyangs pa'i shul du bsgom na/ kyai rdor lha bcu dgu mar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /sems dpa' bsdus pa 'di a mo lhas mjad par yang ma nges la/ mdzad kyang che chung su yin cha med pas/ nges pa med bzhin du de rgyu mtshan du 'a’god pa dang / de la thag chod byed pa yang blun rtags yin no/ /skyon chen po ni rtog pa bdun pa'i skyu ni gongs don skyong mkhan mchog cig don la'ang yin zhing / khyed rang yang de ltar khas len na rtog rnga/dun gyi bstan pa 'dzin mkhan grag shos rang de nyams len gyi mthil rtog bdun gyi lugs la mi byed pa shin tu mi rung ba'i phyir/ skyo pa'i nyams len gyi mthil sems dpa' bsdus nga ga la yin/ skyo lugs kyi sgrub thabs rnying pa dang /sems dpa' bsdus pa sdur la ltos shig yang sems da : pe' bsdus pa dang rtog bdun ji ltar mi mthun snyam na/ rtog bdun las ni skyed chog 'jam/ dpa‘pa dang / nyi ma dang / sa bon dang / phyag mtshan gyi rim pas bskyed par gsungs la/ sems dpa' bsdus pa las ni/ bde mchog dril bu lha lnga dang / mai tri bcu gsum ma ltar gzhal yas khang skyed zin pa 'i rjes su/ ā li kā li la ldos pa'i nyi zla sa bon gcig 'dres kyi rim pa mngon byang lnga yongs grags 'di las/ gtso 'khor thams cad dus gcig tu skyed par mjad pas na de gnyis shin tu mi 'dra bas so/ khyed rnams rwa lugs la rtog gsum mi 'dod ces zer ba ni/ khyed rang rnams kyang dpya:ne pa ma zhugs par rwa lo'i gsung du khas len thag chod byed pa'i rwa pod kyi kar chag tsam yang rje rdogs par ma mthong ba'am/ mthong yang gzhig pa ma chug par zad la/ skyo pa rnams las tshogs rto:ka gsum kho na la gtso bor mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan yang med de/ rtog bdun gyi 'khrul 'khor nyid rtsal du 'don pa'i phyir dang / 'khrul 'khor de yang rtog bdun gyi lugs rwa lugs dang phal cher mthun bye) rtog gsum gyi lugs ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de na skyo 'od 'byung ni/ bod du byon pa'i a mo gha bcadro chung ba de la gsan pa'i rgyud kyang man —87—

ngag gi lugs nyid nyams len dang phyag len gyi mthil du mdzad pa yin zhing / phyis zhe dgu ma sogs zhal lugs kyi nag po skor gsum dang / rong zom lugs kyi rtogs gsum dang / sems dpa' bsdus pa sogs kyang / rgyab brten gyi tshul du bod kyi bla ma rnams la gsan nas nyan bsad ci rigs la mdzad par ni snang mod/ zhe dgu gtso bor rtsal du 'don pa ni min no/ /nyams len gyi mthil rgyud rkyang gi man ngag de yang / phal cher zhi ba ye shes kyi gzhung dang mthun la/ 'khor khro mo brgyad po kho na sems dpa' bsdus pa dang mthun gyi/ gzhan ma yin no/ / lugs 'di'i mngon rtogs dkyus kyi nyams len skabs srung 'khor la gshin rje pho brgyad kyang med de/ khyed dag gi ni skyo lugs kyi yig sna rnying pa rnams ma mthong bar ma zad/ shin tu grags che ba 'dzims pas byas pa'i sgrub thabs tsam yang ma mthong zhing / gzhan la rgyun du ngom ngom 'phyar 'phyar ba'i gnyan ṭīka la yang ma ltas par zad do/ /'on kyang skyo ba rnams gzhal yas khang gi nang du ma mo brgyad/ dur khrod du gshin rje pho brgyad bsgom pas bcu bdun ma'i tha snyad 'thad do snyam na/ de lta na dur khrod du phyogs skyong dang klu la sogs pa'ang yod pas lha so gsum ma la sogs par yang 'gyur ro/ /'di'i dur khrod du gshin rje brgyad dang / yum brgyad kyang yod med don la zhing skyong dmyal srung brgyad rgyud gzhan du bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /yang khyed dag gi nang tshan ku ke rgyu 'gul ba grags rgyal gyis/ bya ba bsdus pa'i lugs kyi sgrub thabs kha 'gengs sna tshogs can cig brtsams nas/ 'di la rgya gzhung ma gtogs bod yig med do zer te/ skyo lugs de ni bod du chos brgyad shin tu dar ba'ang yin zhing / khyed dag gi 'dod pa ltar de dag gi lag len gyi mthil bya ba bsdus pa la byed pa yin na ni/ bod kyi yig rigs ci yang mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/ bod yig gtan nas med na/ skyo lugs yin par yang mi 'gyur te/ sems dpa' bsdus pa ni skyos ma byas la/ skyos byas pa'i yi ge gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar rdzun dang ham pa'i 'tshang stib zin nas/ da ni yin tshul rnams bshad —88—

par bya ste/ lugs 'di'i brten so'i gzhung ni/ rgyud kyi rigs la rtog bdun rtog gsum/ rtog pa gcig pa dang chos kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa rnams yod la/ da tre|ngas 'grel gyi rigs la zhi ba ye shes kyi sgrub thabs chen mo dang / bsnyen pa kho na'i yan lag tu do na yod rdo rje chung pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa dang gtor chog gnyis/ 'jam dpal ye shes dang / do zu yon rdo rjes mdzad skad pa'i sgrub thabs sems dpa' bsdus pa che chung gnyis/ don yod rdo rje che bas mdzad par grags pa'i dkyil chog /yang 'jam dpal ye shes gzhan zhig gis mdzad par rnga skugs pa'i sgron ma drug gi gzhung / a mo lha'i zhi ba las bdun dang / drag po las bdun rnams 'a4 nyan bshad nges par byung la gzhan yang yod srid do/ /rtog bdun la skyo chen po nyid kyi khyi ka dang / rtogs gsum la yang / gsungs bgros la brten pa'i rti ka 'ga' re yod/ man ngag gi yi ge ni chog sgrigs nyams kyi zhal gdams/gnas kyi lhan thabs/ drag po'i ga'u skor ba'i man ngag rwa gle bha dra'i lugs/ 'khrul 'khor gyi 'grel chung / zhu ba ye shes kyi sgrub thabs gsal byed/ spogs ji'i cho ga /sngags bskye'i byin rlabs tshigs bcad ma tshogs mchod dang bcas pa che chung gnyis/ tsha tsha gdab pa'i tshul mar me mdzad zla bas mdzad pa/ yi ge'i sgra don bshad pa la li tas mdzad zer ba gcig /'khor lo bzlog pa'i rgyu bshad pa/ 'khor lo'i dbye ba bstan pa/ gtor sngags kyi zhal rnga/zhes/ 'khor lo rkyang pa'i man ngag 'phros dang bcas pa/ bris sku'i rab gnas/ sgrub pa'i yis chung / byang chub kyi sems bza' ba'i gdams ngag/ral gri/ mig sman/ ril bu/ 'byung po dang/nga du byed pa/ ro langs sgrub pa/ srin po/gnod spyin/ klu rnams dbang du byed pa/ klu la gtad rnga/ zhu ba'i bsam gtan dang / a mo lha'i zhal gdams/ 'di gnyis rdzogs rim yin/ gtor ma dra tsho/na rlabs kyi zhal gdams/ nang mchod kyi zhal gdams/ tshogs 'khore gsal byed/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ dbye ba/ dbang sdud/ dgug pa/ mnan pa/ bskrad pa/ bsad pa rnams kyi yig chung re re/ 'khong lo kha sbyor gyi man ngag /phur pa can gyi —89—

gdams ngag /ba srog gnyis kyi yig chung / ba srog gnyis kyi yi ge che ba/ 'di gnyis gshin rjer sgrol gyi gdams ngag yin/ phyag mtshan dbab pa zer pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi yi ge gcig /yang phyag mtshan dbab pa'i yig sna gsum/ 'khor lo'i zhal shes thor bu gzhan yang mang du snang / las mkhan gyi bstod bskul che chung sogs 'phros don gyi yig chung du ma dang bcas pa yod do/ /sngar bshad pa'i rgya gzhung de rmams la bsdus don mchan bu yig sna thor bu re dang bcas pa yod cing / lha dgu dang / zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs/ dbang chog /sbyin sreg /rab gnas sogs sbyar byang yod med ci rigs pa sna tshogs dag yod do/ /yig chung de dag phal cher la sbyar byang med cing / 'ga' zhig skyo chen po dang / phal cher skyo kham pas mdzad do zhes grag go //bo bos mthong ba ni de 'dra la da dung lhag po yod srid do/ /des na lugs 'di la sgrub thabs sems dpa' bsdu sa pa'i lugs kyi/ dbang bskur rkang tshugs su byed pa'i srol ma byung bas/ ngor pa rnams 'di la der rlom pa ni/ mun rdo 'phangs pa 'ba' zhig ste/ sems dpa' bsdus pa ni 'khru/la 'khor lag len sogs rgyab brten gyi gzhung yin gyi/ sgos su dbang bka' tsam yang med pa la nyams len mthil yin no skad smra ba 'di las rdzun che ba ci yod/ da ni lugs 'di'i sgrub thabs brjod par bya ste/ de yang bsnyen pa la 'jug na/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dkyil 'kho ra tshom bu dgu pa can bya la/ rgyun gyi nyams len la maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa med kyang chog /gang ltar yang rung ste bris sku'i mdun du mañdzi la dpal gtor chen po ba dan dang bcas pa bsham/sa/ de'i mdun du dmar gyis gang pa'i ka pā la/ gtor snod dang mtho dman mnyam par bzhag /phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ de las cung zad dma' ba'i steng / thod chen nam/ tshal bu'am/ ma rnyed na snod gang yang rung ba rak+tas gang ba bzhag /gzhan thod pa dam rdzas kyis gang pa dang / ma sa'i lha bsgo(sa dang / zhi drag gi mchod pa rnams spyi dang 'dra bar bsham/ thun gtor ya/nga dgos/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas yo byin rlabs dang / nang mchod byin rlabs —90—

rnams kyang bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya rnams sngon du btang / rang nyid dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sems dpa' gsum rnga/rtsegs kyi skur gyur/ oX nga ni nga hūX/ gro hā gro hā hūX/ gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya hūX/ ā nā ya ho bha ga wān du rā dza hūX phaṭa/ ces pa'am/ yang na bde mchog gi zhal bzhi pa lha re sngags lta bu byas kyang drang / skye( gha gha gha ta ya gha ta ya/ sarba ṭa : ༷da phaṭa/ ki la ya gī 'i4 ya sarba pa paX phaṭa/ hūX huX hūX badz+ra gī la badz+ra dha ro ā dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bisnrun kā phya4 waka tsit+ta badz+ra gī la ya hūX phaṭa/oX badz+ra mud ga ra badz+ra gī la ā ko ṭa ya hūX phaṭa/ yi ge bcu pa lan gsum/ brjod de/bgegs thams cad bskrad par bsam/ bsrung ba 'di bsnyen chung gi sgrub thabs a mo gas mdzad pa la brten par snang yang / gang du sgom pa'i gnas skabang sdo dang cho ga dngos kyang cung zad mi 'dra ba ni/ man ngag dbang btsan par byas pa'o/ /skad cig gis rang rdo rje 'jigs byed ces pa nas/ sa mya dzaX tseX( sarba ta thā ga ta pā da ban+ta bye / ka ro mi/ zhes phyag 'tshal/ snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mje sbod par gyur/ gong ma rnams 'og nas 'byung ba'i mchod bstod rgyas pa skabs 'dir mdzad/ 'a:sdoms pa rin shes skabs 'dir bsdus pa legs gsungs te/ da lta'i 'gro ba la lag len zor (5nga pa 'phrod par snang bas/ 'dir yang 'dzims pa bzhin bya'o/ /oX badz+ra bhi ra ba pra wa ra rba/ta kā ra pra titsā swāhā/ zhabs bsil dang / oX ni ri te hūX khaX/ mthor mthung dang / oX ar+ghaX pra tisno swāhā/ mchod yon dang / oX pad+ma ka ma la stuX/ gdan phul/ oX badz+ra pur+sha hūX/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke ga rnye/ sna wi ti/shasta/ phyi'i mar pa'i/ lkoX rū pa badz+ra pū ji te hūX/ de bzhin du/ shap+ta/ ga rje/ rā sa//spar+sha/ nang gi mchod pa'o/ /lkoX āXhuX/ lan gsum/ gyi1so bdud rtsi dbul te bla na med pa'i mchod pa'o/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ gsang ba'i mchod —91—

pa'o/ /na mo dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi gzugs brnyan/ sku'i sprul pa/ gsung gi dbang phyug /dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs so 'tshal la/ bdag lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /gzhan yang bdag cag gi thog ma med pa'i dus nas dug gsum gyi dbang gis sdig pa mi dge ba ci dang ci bgyis pa rnams ni so sor bshags shing / slad chad kyang sdom par bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu'i 'phags pa rnams dang / 'gro ba dag gis bsod nams skyed do 'tshal la/bang/ga rjes su yi rang bar bgyid do/ /ston pa 'jig rten gyi sgron mer gyur pa/bskul ba'i sa la ba ( nyugs so 'tshal/ de dag la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ /bde bar gshegs pa gang dag bskul ba'i dus la bab pa log par lta ba rnams sun dbyung ba'i phyir/ thabs kyis mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa rnams la/ 'khor ba ji srid par don mdzad par gsol ba 'debs so/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag dang / gzhan yang bdag dang 'gro ba kun gyis bgyis so 'tshal gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /ji ltar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang bral ba/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam pa spangs pa/ chos bdag med pa la mnyam pa nyid rang gi sems gdod ma nas ma skyes pa/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du thugs bskyed pa de ltar/bdag gis kyang sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /bdas gis 'phags pa rnams la lus phul te/ sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho na gnas pa rnams bsgral ba'i —92—

ched du bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje bsgrubs te/ sems can thams cad mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsu 3 4 rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang 'dra/ dmigs pa ni/ thugs ka nas 'od dmar ljang dkar ser bzhi spro ba yin te/ phaX thing pa'i man ngag dang phyogs 'dra'o/ /de nas rjes gzhig gi rim pas// snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdu ba'i dmigs pa bsgom/ oX swa bhā wa bi shudha sarba dharma swa bhā wa bi shu khyo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i kha 1dog can gyi steng du/ sdiXlas sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar/ aXlas zla ba la dhīXlas ral gri dhīXs mtshan pa yo ngas su gyur pa las/ 'jam dpa‘5 gzhon nu sku mdog gur gum gzhon nu'i me tog rgyas pa ltar dmar ser/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / g.yon thugs kar me tog ut+pa la sngon nyu po'i sdong bu bsnams pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa zhes pa nas/ sngags 'phreng rnams spyan drangs te thim pas nyi ma'i steng du/hūX nag po 'od zer lnga ldan du gyur ces pa nas/ phyag g.yon gyi phyag mtshan skabs/g.yon lhag ma rnams kyis tshangs pa'i mgo rtan/ phub zlum/ rkang pa zhes pa dang /drag po ste bdud bzhi la sogs pa rnams kha bu rnga pe tu bskyel nas mnan pa/ zhes pa nas/ de'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' ma he'i zhal can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje'i lte bar ti1nga nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūX nag po'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gzhan rnams sgrub thabs snying ngo/ra bshad pa dang 'dra/ 'dir a mo gas rme/dzad pa'i sgrub thabs chung ngu las/ 'di'i de ma thag mchordo da bstod dang bzlas pa la 'jug ste/ skyo pa rnams kyi bzhed pas/ bsnyen rkyang gi skabs de tsam :smyes chog ste/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rgyu'i dus na nyi ma dang / sa bon dang / phyag mtshan gsum yod pas 'grub la/ skye —93—

mched drug byin gyis brlabs pa'i dod ni/ g.yas g.yon gyi zhal drug gis thub/ ye shes pa bstim pa yang sngar rgyu'i dus kyi spro bsdu lan bzhi la 'dus shing / rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs kyang 'jam dpal gyi zhal la tshang bas/ bsdus pa la dga' na 'di tsam gyis chog cing / spyir rgyas pa 'gog pa ni ma yin no/ /dpal 'dzin gyi sgrub thabs kyang skabs 'di'i don la de dang 'dra zhing sgrub thabs der/ dam rdzas sogs byin gyis brlabs nas bsten par bshad pa nyid mchod pa yin pas/ bzlas pa'i sngon gyi mchod bstod kyang med mi rung ma yin par bzhed do/ /yang gtso rkyang kho na bsgom zhing /mchod bstod skabs 'dir mi byed na/ skyo ba'i sngags pa rnying pa rnams bzhed pa ltar tshogs zhing gi skabs su mchod bstod rgyas pa byed pa bzang ngo / /zhi ba ye shes kyi sgrub thabs las ni/ skabs 'di na sku gsung thugs byin rlabs dang / dbang bskur rgyas btab nges par byed par bzhed cing / dam ye bsre ba'i gsal kha med/ yig rnying las ni skyed mched byin rlabs kyang byed la/ ye shes spyan 'dren ni 'og tu dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i skabs kyi de dang lhan cig tu byed pas skabs 'dir mi mdzad/ 'dzims nga/sa dbang gi lha nyid ye shes pa bstim par mdzad de gcig tu mi legs pa'ang min no/ kho bo ni 'di ltar sems te/ zhi ba ye shes kyi sgrub thabs kyi dngos bstan ltar/ dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i skabs/ sku gsung thugs dang skye mched byin rlabs dang / dbang bskur rnams mi byed na skabs 'dir de dag byed dgos la/ 'og dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su de dag byed pa/ skyo pa snga ma 'ga' re dang / 'dzims pa sogs bzhed pa ltar na/ spyir mi legs pa ma yi na mod/ de ltar na skabs der bdag dang mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs lhan cig tu de dag byas pas chog pa'i phyir/skabs 'dir de rnams mi dgos so snyam mo/ /zhi ba ye shes kyis kyang / skabs 'dir gnas gsum/ byin rlabs dang dbang bskur mdzad/ ye shes spyan 'dren pa med pa dang / 'og dkyil 'khor gyi skabs de gnyis med ye shes spyan 'dren yod pa yang de dag lan gnyis mi dgos pa la dgongs so//—94—

de lta na yang / 'dzims pa rin she yo ga la bag chags brtarnga/ pas/ bdag bskyed kyi skabs 'di rmal 'byor rgyud kyi bdag rdzogs kyi dod thub par bsams na1so/ de'i yan lag tu ye shes spyan 'dren dbang bskur rgyas btab dgos par bsams pa dang / che/dun bskyed kyi skabs/ rang 'og min du phyir pas mos zhes dang / rjes su 'og min nas babs ‘nis zer ba ni dgos nus med cing bsre bslad kho na yin pas mi legs so/ /skabs 'dir sku'i ( rnom 'gyur la/ sgrub thabs sems dpa' bsdus pa las/ rwa g.yas nga/ la gnas pa'i zhal dang po mtheng ga zhes dang / g.yon la'ang de bzhin du gsungs pas/ gzhung der rwa zhal du bzhed pa yi na la/ zhe ba ye shes kyang rwa zhal du bzhed de/ ji skad du/ zhal g.yas kyi dang po sngon po/ gnyis pa dmar rngam gsum pa ser po ste/ rwa mchan na gnas nga/'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ rwa mchan ni rwa'i ngos la gnas rnga/'i don no/ /skyo pa rnams brten so mjad pa'i gzhung gi dbang du byas na rwa zhal bshad pa de gnyarnga5 yin la/ gzhan dz+nyā na ka ras mdzad pa (las kyang / g.yas pas rwa la brten pa'i zhal/ /dang rnge/tshe mthing ga 'jig par byed/ /ces dang /g.yon pa'i rwa la brten pa'i zhal/ /dang po dkar po rmong tha sdo par byed/ /ces sogs bshad pas bod phal cher rwa zhal la khungs med par 'dod pa ni hal le snyu rte ler spyod pa kho na yin la/ de lta na yang skyo pa rnams nyid kyi lag len la/ a mo gha chung ba'i gzhu ri chung dang / zhe dgu ma'i gzhung gi rjes su 'brangs nas/ man ngag gi skabs 'khor zhal kho na ma rngad cing / de'i yang nang tshan rtsa zhal gyi g.yas dang g.yon du rim 'ded kho na mdzad ngo/ /da ni da / spyi sa la 'jug ste/ rang gi spyi bor oX las 'khor lo dkar po lkoX gyis mtshan pa 94sa sku rdo rje sku mdog dkar gogayas 'khor lo 'dzin pa'i thugs kar yang / 'khor lo'i lte bar goX mgrin par āXlas pad+ma dmar po āXs mtshan pa 'a/sa/ gsung rdo rje sku mdog dmar po tsho g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa'i thugs kar yang rnga pre d+ma la āX thugs kar huX las rdo —95—

rje hūX gis mtshan pa las/ thugs rdo rje sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs kar yang / rdo rje'i lte bar hūX ngo / /thams cad kyang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ rol pa'i khro bo chen po'o/ /spros pa la mos pas skye mched byin wos byed na/mig tu khriX sogs sgrub thabs snying por bshad pa ltar bya/ dbang bskur ba ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūX las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ spyi bor 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar zhe dgu ma'i skabs dang 'dra/ dbang bskur byed pa po'i dkyil ge bor gyi lha tshogs kyang rang la thim/ dzaXhūX baX hoX zhes bya'o/ /'di ye shes bsre ba zhor thabs tsam yin gyi/ rkang tshugs min la rang la mi stim par dbyings su gshegs kyang chog go /de'i rjes su dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya ste/ 'di bdag nyer sgrub bam/bsnyen sgrub sbrags pa'i lugs su byung yang / skyo pa rnams kyi bzhed pas/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor la ma brten par/ bris sku tsam la dmigs pa'am/ ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig gis kyang drang ste/ bdag bskyed kyi yan lag tu dkyil 'khor bsgom ste/ bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma dang / dmigs pa bsgom tshul phyogs 'du mod kyi/ 'di ni bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma ma yin/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bsnyen pa yin zhing / bdag mdun gnyis yod pa ni/ grogs po lta bur bsnyen pa yin gyi sgrub pa'i don min la/ 'di la goms na bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma mi dgos par sgrub pa la zhugs chog pas 'jug pa bde ba la yang dgongs so/ /zhi ba ye shes kyis kyang 'di bsnyen par bshad pa yin gyi sgrub pa yin par ma bshad la/ sgrub pa las sbyor logs su yod pa ltar yin pas/ rgya mkhar bka' bcu pa sogs 'di sgrub pa'i dbang du byas zer ba ni/ 'ol tshod tsam ste/ gzhung 'di nyid rdzogs par ma bklags pa'i skyon no/ /zhi ba ye shes kyi sgrub thabs 'di ni/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum la le'u re re yod cing / rtog bdun gyi brjod bya'i gtso bo mtha' dag 'a spyin nus pas/ rgyud kyi don 'grel du —96—

gyur pa zhig ste/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs bod du 9khyur ba la don bzang ba zhig yin par snang yang / phal cher gyis ma shes par mtshan ming bzang po la kha g.yar ba'i rjes su rgyug kyin/grub chen la li ta/ grub chen a mo gha zhes bzlas brjod byed kyis/ sa skya pa phyi ma dang dge ldan pa mang po zhig sha thang chad par gyur to/ /spros pas chog go /de rjes 'di skad ces bya ste/ su bhā wa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ e las jo8/nga ba'i chos 'byung gru gsum/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ gdengs ka gyen du phyob/sa pa'i nang du/ ye las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zla gam ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas ma( tsan pa/ de'i steng du baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshang ni pa/ de'i steng du laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du sro las ri'i rgyal po ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 9yen phras/ rdo rje'i sa gzhir rwa gur bla re dang bcas pa/ phyi rol rdo rje'i mes gta3/sa par gyur/ oX badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ta hūṃ hūX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus blo/ zlaX las rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin gzhal med khang / zhes pa nas/ sna sna can se pas gang ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gong zhe dgu ma'i skabs bzhin no/ /'dir zhi ba ye shes kyi sgrub thabs dngos bstan las/ sgrub ba'i skabs bris pa'i dkyil 'khor yang zhor la rtogs pa'i dngang du mdzang nas/ gtso bo'i gnas su mi ro'i gdan la/ srog chags gnas pa sogs bshad kyang / bsnyen pa'i skabs su de mi dgos shing /sgo ba bzhi khro bo dang / mtshams ma bzhi mchod lhar mdzad kyang / skyo pa rnams gzhung de'i brdar —97—

der mi mdzad cing / de ji ma ji bzhin du mi spyod de/ a mo gha chung ba'i man ngag gi dbang du mdzad nas/ 'khor gzhin rje mo brgyad du mdzad la/ de nyid rgyud las kyang / ro langs brgyad du gsungs pas kyang ston cing / rgyud kyi 'jug tu gal te smras na dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis dang / gzhan yang rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis za'o/ /zhes 'khor gyi gtso bo smos pa de mkha' 'gro ma 'byung bas gnyis po sdebs pas khro mo brgyad skor gsal bar bstan par bzhed do/ /des na 'di ltar bya ste/ dbus kyi gtso bo'i gnas su pad+ma dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan/ sgo mchams brgyad du yang mi ro'i gdan rnams so/ /nang gi re mig brgyad la/ shar du tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ lhor lag pa/ nub tu rgyu ma/ byang du rkang pa/ shar lhor thod pa/ lho nub tu thod tshal/ nub byang du ro ras/ byang shar du skyes bu gsal shing gis phug pa'o/ /skyo pa dang / zhang pa rnams nag 'jigs gnyis la re mig dgu bzhed tshul ni/ thig bzhi btab pa'i mig mang ris ma yin gyi/ pad+ma'i thig 'dra ba lta ba zlum po zhig mdzad do/ shar gyi lha snam la/ gri gug dang / 'phang mdung dang /gshun shing dang / chu gri dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / lcags kyu rnams so/ /lho'i lha snam la/ sta re dang / mda' dang / dbyug pa dang / kha ṭāX ga dang / 'khor lo dang / zhags pa rnams so/ /nub kyi lha snam la/ rdo rje dang / cang te'u dang /phub dang / gzhu dang / dril bu dang / rlung ras rnams so/ /byang gi lha snam la/sdigs 'dzub dang / 'phan rtse gsum pa dang / glang lpags dang / tho ba dang /mdung dang / me thab rnams gnas par gyur/ skyo pa rnams dbang bskur dang / sgrub thabs kyi dkyil 'khor la mi 'dra ba'i khyad mi bzhed pas/ sgrub thabs la'ang phyag mtshan nges par bzhed la/ lugs 'di'i bris thang rnying pa kun la'ang phyag mtshan bkod pa kho na yod cing / 'jigs —98—

mdzad gtso rkyang ngam lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la bod rjes ma phal cher phyag mtshan mi 'dod pa ni/ ri bong gi cal bzhin du song ba yin zhing / phyag mtshan mi 'a:god na/ gzhal yas khang ye med pa'am/thod mkhar tsam byed pa yin no/ /lugs 'dir yang skabs 'dir phyag mtshan skad cig gis bskyed pa'am phyis gtso bo'i sku las spro ba gang byas kyang 'dra'o/ /1dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ huX las khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa nag po hūX gis mtshan nga// 'jig dus kyi me ltar 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa/ de las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa9rnga thams cad mchod pas mnyes par byas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dang sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyangs/ sdang ba dang gdug pa'i sems can ma lus pa thams cad tshar bcad/nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad gam rnga rje 'jigs mdzad kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ rdo rje huX yig dang bcas pa la gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs/ byed ces pa nas/ huX nag po'i bar sems dpa' gsum brtsegs bdag bskyed dang 'dra'o/ /rngo/tso bo'i thugs ka na ya brgyad spros te/ sgo mtshams brgyad na gnas pa'i baX chen gyi gdan rnams kyi steng du 'khod pa de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ da sri/ bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad pa sngon du 'gro ba'i 'phrin la bro/ rnam par bzhis sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shar sgor gshin rje lcags kyu ma bya rgod la gnas pa/ lho sgor bzhan rje zhags pa ma 'ug pa la gnas pa/ nub sgor gshin rje lcags sgrog ma bong khra la gnas pa/ byang sgor gshin rje 'bebs pa ma bya rog la gnas pa/ shar lhor gshin rje pho nya mo chu —99—

skyar la gnas pa/ lho nub tu gshin rje mche ba ma mthing ril la gnas pa/ nub byang du gzhan rje be chon ma kang ka la gnas pa/ byang shar du dus kyi mtshan mo rma bya la gnas pa/ zhes pa 'di ni skyo pa'i man ngag yin la/ sems dpa' bsdus pa'i dngos bstan la/ mtshams la bya rgod sogs dang / phyogs la chu skyar sogs gsungs pas gang mos bya'o/ /thams cad kyang rngam zhing khros la mi gdug pa cher khros pa'i cha byad can/ lang tsho gsar du bdo zhing gcer bu nu 'bur rgyas pa/ mche ba zangs yag tu gtsigs shing / drag tu bzhad pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum/ dbu skra dmar ser lhug par grol ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon pas mgo thod dmar chen gyis gang ba 'dzin cing zhal du gsol ba/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing / phyogs bcu'i gdug pa can thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa/'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po phyag gnyis pa re res dbu la brgyan pa'o/ /'di rnams la zhabs kyi bzhugs tshul thams cad mtshungs par rol stabs sam/ mtshungs par g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ngam/ ma/tshungs par g.yas brkyang ngam/ yang na mchungs par ba tshe' pa so so la chibs pa sogs gang la mos pa de ltar bsgom la/ chol bar bsgom du ni mi rung ngo / kha cig dbu rgyan rigs bdag mi bskyod par 'dod pa'ang wo tsam yin la/ 'dzims pa sogs 'jam nga/byangs zhi bas mdzad pa'ang spyir legs mod kyi dkyus su bshad pa nyid ches ma/chog go /de bzhin du mkha' 'gro ma lta ra sgrub na/ thod skam thod rlon rus rgyan sogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / gshin rje mor byed na rgyan spangs pa'o/ /phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad la gshin rje chen po brgyad gnas pa ni/ shar du ya ba ti/ lhor chos kyi rgyal po/ nub tu tel pa nag po/ byang du glang mgo can/ me mtshams su mig dmar/ lho nub tu phya sangs/—100—

nub byang du smigs pa/ byang shar du ral pa tsha rdo dgu rnams rang rang gi chung ma dang bcas pa'o /gzhan yang gshin rje dpa/ ma mo dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang /srin po dang / 'byung po dang / ro langs dang / phyag brnyan gyi tshogs thams cad kyis yongs su gang bgo /zhes brjod do/ /zhi nga/ ye shes kyi sgrub thabs dngos bstan la/phyag mtshan so gnyis 'god pa'i gsal kha med kyang / da kyel 'kho ra nang ma la re mig dgu bshad pas/ dgongs don la yod pas 'god dgos shing / lnge/ tshe rje 'jigs mdzad kyi sgrub thabs la/gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi bsha/da pa'i rgya gzhung 'ga' zhig tu'ang tshig zin la phyag mtshan mi 'byung mod/ don du rdo rje 'jigs byed 'a gzhal yas kha:pa rgyas pa bsgom la rtog bdun lugs su rlom phyin de dag bsgom dgos te/ gzhan du na rgyud las 3gongs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /des na rwa lus sa su rlom pa dang / rma/la lugs su rlom pa'i ro la:pas brgyad bskor byed pa kha cig dang / skyo lugs gshin mo brgyad skor ba snga phyi kha cig de dag mi phye’ne pa zab khyad du 'dod pa ni/ dgos nges shes pa chad pa'i 'khrul pa la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i khya/da chos su rlo pa pa ste/ thog mar byung ba'i nyes bshad kyi dug chu gcig gis mang po zhig bslad pa'o/ /de yang gang snyam na/ rtog bdun gyi 'grel pa slob dpon mi bskyod pas byas pa ni rgya 'grel dzo 5 yin par nges shing / ma nang lo tsā ba go ru ba chos shes byas pa yin yang / bod kyi mkhas par 'a ce rdod pa rnams sangs rgyas kyi bka' yin pa cam du rtsi bar snang ste de las byung ba'o/ /rgyas pa la mos na skabs 'dir gtso 'khor thams cad la sems dpa' gsum brtseg dang / sku gsung thugs byin rlabs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ dbang bskur mkhan rnams rang la ye shes pa'i tshul gyis gzhug pa rnams byed ces zhi ba ye shes kyi gzhung gi mchan bu rnying pa las 'byung zhing / 'dzims pa yang bce/da ngo/ /da ni 'di ltar bya ste/ rang nyid dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen go drag cing rnga pe zod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid —101—

can/ dkyil 'khor chen po de'i lho sgo nas zhugs te/ de'i thad ka'i lha snam la 'khod par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i huX yig las/'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rigs thams cad kyi bdag po 'jam dpal khro bo gshin rje gshed po dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can bsrung ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaX hūX/ 'jam dpal rang bzhin chos rnams kun gyi dngos/ /gnas med 'gro 'ong bral ba nam mkha' bzhin/ /dus kyi mkha' bzhin thugs rje 'gro 'ong bral/ /sprul pa 'gro 'ong bral ba'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /'gro dang 'ong ba'i mtshan nyid mi mnga' yang / /chu zla bzhin du gang dmigs der snang ba'i/ /deng 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ba'i lha/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir 'jigs byed gzhan rje gshed/ /ye shes thugs las sprul pa'i lha mo bskor/ /las byed sprul pa gshin rje'i 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs brtan par bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /oX hruXha bho mahā kro dha/ ā ga tsā smog asma ta pū dza pra ti gro dha skye pra sā dha me dhī mā na ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX badz+ra ang ku sha dzaX sogs sam/ bsdu na/ dzaXhūX baX hoX lan mang du brjod/ bdag dang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis ka la thim/ gnyis med thun mong ma yin khyab pa'i sku/ /kun la snyoms mdzad rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /chos kyi dbyings gyur rgyal ba kun gyi yum/ /ye shes sems dpa' rgyal ba kun gyi sras//phyag 'tshal 'jam pa'i dpal gyur rdzogs pa khyod/ /chos kyi sku la byams sdang mi —102—

mnga' yang / /srid gsum gdug pa ma lus 'a : rdul ba'i phyir/ /thugs rje thabs 4 kyis khro rgyal skur bstan pa/ /'jigs byed ge ni na rje gshe/da la phyag 'tshal lo//dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes ni/ /chos rnams kun dang rang bzhin dbyer med pa/ /sgrub mchog bdag gi sems rdo kyang de lags na/ /de don mtshon phyir rtags kyi skur bstan pa/ /thugs la gan:so pa'i ye shes 'phros pa'i phyir//ye shes sems dpa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde/ gshegs kun gyi yon tan rmad po che/ /bsam 'das brjod bral dpag tho shos mi lang yang / /mi phyed rdo rje gsum du 'du sa bstan pa/ /sku gsung thugs kyi lha la phyag 'tshal 'o sto /bde gshegs thams cad mnyam nyid chos kyi sku/ / (nga bzhin rnam dag rigs brgyud mi mnga' yang / /rnal 'byo(ra sgrub pa mtshon sbyo tsho/ra rgyas btab pa/ /dbu rgyan rdo rjes mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes snang skyo ped chags pa'i rdul bral zhing / /'dod pa'i khams kyi sems can 'dul slad /du/ /thabs la mkhas pas 'dod yon gzugs su sprul/ /mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di zhi ba ye shes kyi lugs nyid kyi dbang du byas pa yin/ dkyu rje pa ltar na mchod pa'i sogs kyi dod la/mtshams kyi khro mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal ‘go /zhes 'don pa spo/ chos dbyings spros bral dbyings kyi pho brang du/ /gzung 'a : ngon bral ba'i ye shes blo 'jug phyir/ /'khri/la pa'i bgegs tshogs 'du la ba‘re skur ston pa/ /gzhal yas sgo skyong bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan chos rje 'jam dbyangs spyan lam du/ /bdud 'dul bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /las kyi gshin rje ma mo mkha' 'gro ma/ /'byung po ro langs ci bgyi rnga/ka' mnyan tshogs/ /phyi nang skyong —103—

ba'i dam can ma lus la/ /bdag ni re ba'i sems kyis bdud cing mchis/ /zhes phyag 'tshal/ rgyal ba rnams ni gtsang gyur cing / /sme yi rtog pa mi mnga' yang //srid zhu'i tshul gyi yon chab 'di/ /bde gshegs rnams la sku khrus gsol/ /oX hruXsgyiXhāX mchod yon no/ /tshigs bcad de nyid dang / oX huX riX phaṭa/ bsang gtor ro/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi yo na tan mchog gi sku/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i dri ngad ldang / /oX bi kri tā na na/ du giX satwa da ma ka gaXgaXgaX byang chub yan lag rgyan pa me tog mdzes/ /oX ku ma ra rū pi ni dza dza dza/ ye shes pho brang mtshan gyi me tog spos/ /oX hiXhaXhe phaṭa/ ma rig mun pa bral bas ye shes gsal/ /oX di rto lo tsa na bi kri tā na na mahā aṣ+ṭa ṭa na di na di stu ya swāhā/ nor bdun yon tan chos kyi bdud rtsi'i zas/ /oX kā la rū pa sarba du ni satwa da ma ka ni we te pū dza ya swāhā/sgyu ma'i chos la ye shes mnga' bsgyur zhing / /rang bzhin rnam dag chags rdul mi mnga' yang / /bdag cag srid zhu gus pa'i tshul gyis su/ /dri dang me tog bdug pa mar me bshos/ /dag cing gtsang mar bshams te phul ba 'dis/ /bsod nams yan lag yongs su rdzogs gyur cig/mchod pa'o/ /huX/ 'jam dpal mkha' las byung ba'i gser mdog can/ /'jam dpal thugs las chos kun rang bzhin gsal/ /'jam dpal gsung gi dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'jam dpal bdag ni re ba'i sems kyis 'dud/ /thugs mchog 'jam pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul phyir gshin rje gshed/ /'jigs byed chen po 'jigs pa'i skur bstan pa/ /mi bzad dus mtha' bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /zhal gdangs khro gnyer smin ma glog ltar 'phyug /spyan —104—

bgrad mche ba gtsigs shing rab tu 'bar/ /rdo rje rta skad drag po ha har bzhad//mkha' 'gro bsdud pa'i h+pha skad gnam du 'don/ khros pa'i stabs kyis zhabs brdabs khams gsum gnon/ /sdigs 'dzu/ba gnam du gdengs shing lha chen 'dul/ /ljags 'gril 'bar ba'i zhal gdangs khrag gis myos/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten zhal du gsol/ /bgegs chen ko rlon thod pa'i 'phreng bas brgyan/ /gcer bu 'jigs byed dbang phyung/ chen po'i tshul/ /'jigs byed ma he khros pa'i zhal gdangs shing / /zhal dgu 'bar bas srid gsum za bar rngub/ /sna tshogs 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyag rgya 'a1per/ /bdud rigs kun gnon zhabs ni brkyang bskum gnas/ /'jigs byed (tshen po'i sku la rtag tu 'dud/ /dbu dgu 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /g.yang rga kyi zhal gsum gdangs pa ni//mthing ga dmar dang ser ba'i zhal/ /g.yon gri)/ zhal gsum gtsigs pa ni/ /dkar dang dud kha gnag pa'i zhal/ /dbus kyi ‘nal gsum 'bar ba ni/ khro dang chags dang zhi ba'i tshul/ /phyag rgya 'od zer 'bar ba ste/ /g.yas kyi phyag mtshan bcu drug ni/ /brdeg cing 'joms pa'i mtsho zu/ cha gdengs/ /g.yon gyi phyag mtshan bcu drug ni/ /rol zhing stab pa'i mtshan mas mdzes/ /brjid gnon zhabs kyi tsham rngam las/ /g.yas kyi zhabs brgyad bskum pa ni/ /dregs pa'i lha brgyad thabs kyis 'dul/ /g.yon gyi zhabs nga/rgyad brkyang ba ni/ /dregs pa'i lha mo brgyad la rol/ /'dod chags chen po 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rtag tu ling ga rgyas pa'i tshul/ /drag po'i tshul gyis zhe sdang 'dul/ /'dul byed sku khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /dur khrod chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /bdud dang gzhin rje thabs —105—

kyis 'dul/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdud/ /dbang phyug che la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dbang phyug chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /dbang med dad pas 'dus pa dang / /ye shes sprul pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /'khor bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /ji lta bur ni sprul gyur kyang / /rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos te/ /mnyam nyid sku la phyag 'tshal lo//yang mchod yon dang / oX badz+ra sha rto āXhuX/ oX dharma ra ṇi ta sogs kyis rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /nang mchod yi ge bcu pas bsangs/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dum bu gcig pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ de'i nang du pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan/ de'i steng dbus su na las mi'i sha shar du go las ba lang gi sha /lhor ku las khyi'i sha /nub tu da las rta'i sha /byang du ha las glang po che'i sha /de rnams kyi steng du/ dbus su huX las dri chu/ shar du bhuX las dri chen/ lhor aX las rak+ta/ nub tu dzi las byang sems/ byang du khaX las sha chen gyi dwangs ma rnams su gyur/ steng du hūX las byung ba'i rdo rjes kha bcad pa/ de'i lhe bar yang nyi ma la huX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu zhing khol/ kha dog dri ro ngan pa rnams bsregs shing sbyangs/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la oX āXhuX/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ sku gsum thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs spros shing / khams gsum snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs bcud rnams dang / ye shes —106—

༵sdo gyur/ snro u hā/ hūm̐ shā ༷rjod/ ༵ ba/ ༵ snro ༵ni ༵༵ kyi dzī da pa zhenas ba re rjo / / ༵༵/ sngags gsum gyi mthar 'bru/ gsum btags pas/ bdud rtsi myangs te lha rnams tshims par bsam/gzhung las skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul bar bshad pa rtor 'dir byed na/ yang gong bzhin nang mchod ltar gtor ma byin gyis rlob pa'am/ nang mchod dang lhan cig byin gyis brlabs kyang rung la/bzlas pa'i rjes su gtor ma 'bul na/ byin rlabs kyang skabs de nyid du bya yi/ 'dir mi bya'o//gtor ma 'bul ba dngos ni/ sngags gsum po re re'i mthar ri / i da a rlu tā mahā swa ra hu/zhes btags pa lan gsum la sogs pas gtso bo bcom ldan 'das nyid la 'bul/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha thams cad la thun mong du 'bul ba ni/ oṃ kā la rū pa sarba sdo ྅ nas / / bye ༵ hūṃ rte pha sna dzhai dho hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐ ba dang /ba ༵ ༈ji s+ho gas pa sna bsnye/ ༵ ༈ /༵ lto gtor sngags so/ /kā la rū pa'i sngags dang / tse( in+t+ra ya sogs de dang 'dra ba las/ de'i tra rni sa nā na / ༵ /༵ ༵ /ha/ ༵ s+t+ri ma ra /kau bhe dzhai/ dho~X /u sbyi / ༵/ dhi ༵ rga kyib/ ༵/ spya rdo ༵ ༵༵ dhi/ pa'i ༵ ༵// hā di ༵༵kau ༵ nyu pa rdo gā/ /i li~X / rdo sde ༵'i zhes 'don / snye |/pye shaṃ/ she nar thu'u pa / shad dod da gi snga po ha ha groṇ+ḍa khram shwa ri ༷ l+lī rdo spyu/ ༷ / she ༷ ma tsas ṭī ༷ shaṃ / / khamar —107—

pri yaX bhak+ṣa ni i daX ba liX a smra ta swa da ya/ gro hā gro hā ji hi ji hi bhañdza ho/ rak+ta ar+ghaX gro hā gro hā sku hi ji hi/ pi ba ho/ i daX a ti kra ma/ sa ma ya hūX huX huX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ las sbyor gyi gtor sngags so/ /gtor sngags gsum po 'di/ thob thang ni bsnyen sgrub las gsum so so'i skabs su sbyor rgyu yin yang / lag len la dkyus kyi nyams len skabs/ bsnyen pa'i gtor sngags lan bdun re dang / ngag byang ba'i phyir sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi gtor sngags kyang tshar re re dkyus la yang 'don par byed do/ khyad par gyi 'phrin las bskul ba'i phyir/ dur khrod gnas pa'i gzhin rje la 'bul na/ ya ma rā dza ya ma rā dza ya ma rā dza/ lkoX kwa la rū pa nas/ gro hā pā ya swāhā/ zhes btags pa dang / de bzhin du/ sa do me ya sa do me phya/ sa do me ya/ oX kā la rū pa sogs btags pa dang / des mtho te/ ni rā ma ya'i bar du sbyar ro/ /de bzhin du gshin rje thams cad kyi spyi bo las kyi gzhin rje 'khor bye ba ther 'bum dang bcas pa la dmigs nas/ ya ma snying sha sha dzāXdzāXdun/ ya ma snying hūṃ pa sha /ya ma ā kar+ṣa ya huX phaṭa/ ces pa la tseX( kā la rū pa'i sngags btags pa lan bdun gyis ri rab chen po'i 'og rgya mtsho'i gting nas gnas pa'i chos kyi rgyal po la 'bul lo/ /skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor dang pho nya bskul pa byas na'ang rung mod kyi/ bzlas pa'i gzhug tu byed pa nyid gtso che'o/ /'dir dkyil 'khor nang gi gshin rje mo brgyad ni/ ye shes kyi khro mo/ ro langs ma la sogs pa brgyad gdul bya ma mo brgyad dang / gshin rje mo brgyad kyi tshul bzung ba tsam yin la/ de dag la gtso bo dang lhan cig tu gtor ma phul bar mos pas chog gi sgos su med kyang chog /phyogs skyong gi gtor sngags kyis dur khrod gnas pa thams cad la 'bul ba yin pas/ sngags de la 'jig rten pa spyi'i gtor sngags zhes bya la/ ma gshin bcu drug kyang de'i khongs su 'dus pas mdor bsdus pa'i tshe de tsam gyis kyang chog cing / a kā ro ni 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa gnyis ka'i thun mong ba/—108—

sgo rgyud gzhan las 'byung ba drangs pa yin yang / 'jir ma zad/ la li ta chung bas kyang myog po'i skabs su bshad do/ /de lta na yang khyad par gyi 'a myo 'a/sa sgrub nga 'i don du/ khro rgyal khus na rje gshed kyi bka' nyan thun mong ma yin pa nyid kyi phyir/ ma mo gshin rje'i sgos kyi gtor ma yang nges par byed dgos pa ni yin no / /de rjes bzlas pa'i dmig rnga 5 pa gsal btab la/ bdag mdun zhal sprod kyi tshul du sngags gsum ci nus su bzla zhing / gtso bor lha'i rnal 'byor gyi ting nge 'dzin bya'o//skyo lugs phal cher du rtsa sngags la hu gnyis phaṭa gnyis/ snye sna yi / da/ swāhā me da la/ la lar swāhā ya nga yong pa dang / kha cig tu hu gcig dang phaṭa gcig dang / 'ga' ‘neg tu hu med par phaṭa gnyis byas pa ring snang ba/ rgyud kyi sngags btu'i dpe mi 'dra ba dang / sngagabro/ btu med pa dag 'a/ rten pa las byung ba yin nam sems shing / 'jigs mdzad kyi rgyud rgya myog gi yul na bzhugs pa la yang sngags btu'i le'u med ces grags so/ /da lta bod du 'gyur ba'i rtog bdun la dpe ma dag pa la tshad mi 'jog /gzhan zhung 'gyur/ rong zom 'gyur/ rwa 'gyur/ mal lwa/ra/ dpe dag po thams cad na/ 'gyur byang med pa'i tshigs bcad ma rnams na/ mchog gi dbang phyug ces 'byung bas ri yig yod pa kho na yin pas/ hū yig mi byed pa ni ma dag par sems la/ gzhan ni rang rang gi lugs bzhin bya'o/ /sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi skabs su/ dmigs pa'i khyad par mi 'dra ba dang / sngags zhwa ga rma bu 'dogs tshul sogs gnad ces pa 'ga' re yod kyang / skabs 'dir ma bshad do/ bo bos ni lugs 'di'i dbang bskur dang / man ngag gi yig lung sob/sa chos skor cha tshang ba tsam ni bla ma/ las thob/ 'dza/ba khrid zhal gdams dang lung mtha' dag zhu ba / re yul ni ma rnyed kyang / rwa lugs/ sogs brgyud pa gzhan gyi lugs kyi gdams ngag gis gung kheng/sa shing / sand rig pa na des lde mig thob ste/ lug 'di'i rgyud bshad dang / man ngag gi yi ge 3/thong bas kyang don rtogs par gyur nyo /gang dag man ngag gab ste bzhag pa'i spyi khog tsam pa/ dang/ra na 'dzims pas byas pa'i sgrub dkyil —109—

lta bu dang / rti ka sna re tsam mthong ba la blo brtad bcas/ rgyab rten du 'gro la re nas/ bstan 'gyur nang gi rgya gzhung 'ga' re la/ rdul sprugs dang mur nyed dum re byas nas/ kho bos spyir gzhin rje gshed skor shes so/ /sgos su skyo lugs shes so/ /mal lugs shes so/ /snga ma g.yin gyi lugs la ma ltos par/ rang rkang tshugs pa shes so/ /zhes sogs kha pho rbad shod 'don mkhan mang po bar skabs su byung mod kyang / blun po'i tshogs pa mgo bskor ba las snying po cung zad kyang yod par ma mthong ngo / /'dir ni kho bos thog ma rang nas smra ba la rings par ma byas te/ skyo pa rnams nyid kyi bzhed tshul gang yin pa de la ring du sbyangs pa na phyis khong du chud nas cung zad cig smras so/ /'phros don don no/ /bzlas pa'i mthar slar yang oṃ hṝXljoXhaX sogs kyis phyi mchod nang mchod phul/ gtor ma gsar pa'am gtor kha gsos nas sngon bzhin gtor ma phul na'ang legs/ bsdus pa la mos tshe bzlas pa'i gong du phul na 'dir mi dgos la/ 'dir 'bul na gong du mi dgos so/ /sngar bshad pa'i phyag 'tshal lam bstod pa gang rung zhig gis bstod/ mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs bya ste spyi 'gros yin/ de nas bskul ba bya ste/ hūX/ dkon mchog gsum gyi sku dgra sogs/ /sgyu lus phung po'i gtor gzhong na/ /don snying rnam lnga'i gtor mas bkang / /rnam shes brgyad kyi me tog bkram/ /mdangs kyi mar me dbugs kyi spos/ /chu ser dri chab sbyar ba dang / /dmar chen ar gyur bcas pa dang / /rang byung bdud rtsir lngar bcas 'di/ /'jam dpal nag po'i mchod rdzas te/ /rol gcig gsol cig nag po'i tshogs/ /'jigs mdzad che la mchod par 'bul/ /mchod par bzhes shig dngos grub stsol/ /hūX/ bcom ldan 'jam dpal khros pa yi/ /sku las sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ /ye shes khro bo rngam pa'i tshogs/ /bye ba grangs med bsam las 'das/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la —110—

bab/ /yang sprul pho nya ma drangs pa/ /ma/spa' 'gro ma dang srin po dang / /ma mo gshin rje 'byung po'i tshogs/ byod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /gsum sprul pho nya gdug pa can/ /mi bzad bya dang gcan tra/zan dang / /rwa can dzil gdug sre rtag chags tshogs/ /mkha' dbyings khyab pa'i dus la bab/ /lco byang shar dus kyi mtshan mo ni/ /gcer bu mthing nag ral pa g.yo/ /zhal gcig phyas gnyis ljags kyang bskyod/ /phyag na gri gug the de/ pa bsnams/ /chibs su rma bya 'od ldan chibs/ /gdug can ma lus 'gug spre5 mdzad ma/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bka' mnos nas/ /gsod byed chen po dgra a4 yā/ /spyo nub byang gshin rje be con ma/ /gcer bu mthing nag: /zhal gcing ka/ phyag na /chibs su kang ka mchu rings chibs/ /gdug can: /'jam da pa re / gsod byed chen mo dgra la yā/ /de gnyis kyis 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre/ rje rdo/ lco nub gzhan rje mche ba ma gcer bu mthing nag: /zhal gcig / phyag shu na: / chibs su mthing ril sngon mo chings/ /gdug can /'jam dpa'i: / myos byed chen mo dgra la yā/ /bh+yoshar lhor gshin rje pho nya ma/ /gcer bu mthing ri nag: /zhal gcig: / phyag na:/ chibs su nya khra skya mo chings/ / gdug can/ 'jam dpa'i / myos byed chen mo dgra la yā/ /sbyo shar phyogs gshi/na rje lcags kyu ma/ /gcer bu mthing nag /zhal gcig:/ phyag na pa /chibs su sha za bya rgod chibs/ /gdug can: /'jam dpa'i khrag 'thung chen mo dgra la yā/ / sbyo lho phyogs gshin rje zhags pa mo /gcer bu mthing nag: /zhal gcag / phyag na: /chings su mun mthong 'ug pa chings/ /gdug can: /'jam dpa'i / khrag 'thung chen mo dgra la yā//—111—2

sbyo nub phyogs gshin rje lugs brgyud ma/ / gcer bu mthing nag /zhal gcag / phyag na: / chibs su gsod byed hor pa chibs/ /gdug can: /'jam dpa'i: /'khor byed chen mo dgra la yā/ /zlo byang phyogs gshin rje 'bebs pa mo/ /gcer bu mthing nag /zhal gcig: / phyag na: /chibs su bya rog rngam pa chibs/ /gdug can: /'jam dpa'i: / 'khor byed chen mo dgra la yā/ /rnga pang na mtshams ma bzhi bya rgod sogs dang / phyogs kyi bzhi skyar mo mthing ril kang ka rma bya dang sbyar ba'ang wo ngo / /'jigs chen lco phyogs dur khrod nas/ /sku dgra sgrol byed pho nya ni/ /gsod byed gshin rje drag shul can/ /gad rgyangs chen pos stong gsum 'gengs/ /sprul pa gnam sa khyab par spro/ /sngon gyi dam tshig dran byas te/ /rngam stabs chen pos rgyug cing 'ong / /pho nya bran g.yog tshogs dang bcas//dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /glo ka 'di gnyis 'og ma kun la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /lho phyogs zhes nub phyogs sogs su 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /yā/ chos kyi rgyal po'i dus la bab/ /ya mun ta ka'i pho nya ste/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa la/ /g.yas pa dbyug to 'bar ba 'phyar/ /g.yon pa mi thod snying bcas 'dzin/ /chibs su ma he sngon nag chings/ /rgyu ma mi mgo'i do shal can/ /khams gsum srog la dbang byed pa/ /'khor ni ma mo 'bum gyis bskor/ kha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /dgra bgegs byad ma dbang du bsdus/ /dam nyams dgra bo 'di long cig /dus la bab po sa ma yā/ /swe/ mgo dgu brtsegs pa rkang brgya mo/ /chos kyi rgyal ngo/'i chung ma ste/ /srog dbugs kun gyi mnga' bdag ma/ /'gal byed ma lus 'a ra 'a hi/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /bdud pho —112—

bcu yis khram la thob/ /'chi bdag 'khor lo'i phyag tu gtod/ /gying chen bco brgyad las la bskul/ /sa ma yā/ nub phyogs spya /yā/ tel pa nag po'i dus la bab/ /ya mun /sku mdog smug nag dug gi 'od/ /phyag g.yas 'byed byed be con bsnams/ /g.yon pa 'bigs byed mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /chibs su rnga mong gwa pa chibs/ /dug can 'bar ba sprul gyis khu/ na/ khams gsum / 'khor ni:sha khrag: dgra bgegs: /dam nyams: /dus la: /swe/ khros ma chen mo phag mgo can/ /yab gcig tel pa'i chung ma ste/ shes da ni khrag bdag chen mo yin/ /'gal byed: /bstan pa: /bdud pho /'chi rkyo zad ga: /gying chen5 /sa ma yā/ /byang phyogs: /yā/ a wa glang mgo'i dus la rnga/ba/ /ya mun: /sku mdog dud kha khyab pa la/ /phyag g.yas 'dzin byed lcags rdo spya thogs/ /g.yon pa 'ching byed zhags pa bsnams/ /chibs su dre rta rkang gsum chibs/ /rlung nag 'khya / la ba'i nang nas bzhengs/ khams gsum: /'khordo ra :ri/ : sha khrag /dgra bgegs: /dam nyams:/ dus la: /swe/ kha brgya chen mo ma thu mo che/ /a wa glang mgo'i chung ma ste/ /nad dang rims kyi bdag mo yin/ /'gal byed/ bstan pa: /bdud pho: /'chi bdag: /gying chen: /sa mā ya/ shar phyogs: /yā/ srog bdag ya ba ti yi dus la bab/ /ya mun /sku mdog sngo skya rab tu 'bar/ / phyag g.yas srog zhes cad ral gri thogs/ /g.yon pa dgra sta dam nyams sgrol/ /chibs su chu glang khros pa chibs/ /phyogs bcu/ kun tu khyab par 'gro/ khams gsum: /'khor ni: sha khrag: dgra bgegs: /dam nyams /dus la /swe dkar mo chen mo shel mig ma/ /ya ba ti yi chung ma ste/ /srog gi bdag mo rtse —113—

gsum thogs/ /'gal byed /bstan pa: /bdud pho: /'chi bdag /gying chen /sa ma yā/ shar lho: /yā/ gshin rje mig dmar dus la bab/ /ya mun /sku mdog dmar po me 'od 'dra/ /phyag g.yas gcod byed ral gri bsnams/ /g.yon pa dam nyams mgo lus 'brel/ /chibs su lkug pa lug la chibs/ tan /khrag rlon pa za bar byed/ khams gsum /'khor ni /sha khrag dgra bgegs: /dam nyams: /dus la /swe/ mig stong 'bar ma mthu mo che/ /srog bdag mig dam/ra chung ma ste/ /'phrog ma chen mo ma rungs ma/ /'gal byed /bstam/ nga rngo /bdud pho: /'chi bdag: /gying chen /sa ma yā/ lho nub /yā/gshin rje phya sangs dus la bab/ /ya mun /sku mdog thal skya rab tu 'bar/ /phyag g.yas 'khor lo 'bar ba bskor/ /g.yon pa che srog bum pa bsnams/ /chibs su nyi zla'i 'khor 'o/ chibs/ /mi mgo rlon pas lus la brgyan/ khams gsum spya //'khor ni kha khrag /dgra bgegs: /dam nyams2 /dus la— /swe/ma mo dred kyi ab gsham can/ /rgyal chen phya sangs chung ma ste/ /smyo byed chen mo mkha' dbyug thogs/ /'gal byed: /bstan pa /bdud pho tsha /'chi bdag /gying chen— /sa ma yā/ nub byang : /yā/ gshin rje smigs pa'i dus la bab/ /ya mun /sku mdog ser nag 'bar ba la/ /phyag g.ya/sa dbang bsdud zhags pa bsnams/ /g.yon nga/ 'joms byed mdung thung 'dzin/ /chibs su smyo 'gros sha ba chibs/ /pha rol gzhan gyi srog gcod mkhan/ khams gsum /'khor 'an /sha khrag: /dgra bgegs /dam nyams: /dus la: /swe/ mgro dgu 'bar ba'i lag brgya ma/ /yab cig smigs pa'i chung ma ste/ /dbang po lnga dang bcud kyi — 4—

bdag /'gal byed /bstan pa /bdud pho: /'chi bdag: /gying chen / /sa ma yā/ byang shar: /yā/ ral pa tshar dgu'i dus la bab/ /ya mun: /sku mdog lja nga nag mun ltar gtings/ /phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram shing thogs/ /g.yon pa rgyu zhags glog ltar 'phen/ /chibs su dug sbrul nag po chibs rol pa chen po gshin rje gshed/ /rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs bzhin du 'khrug /sbal pa nag po mi zan bsnams/ /dug can lus la 'phyang phrul brgyan/ khams gsum /'khore ni: kha khrag: /dgra bgegs: /dam nyams: /dus la : / /swe/ ma mo ri nag 'khyil pa mo/ /ral pa tshar dgu'i chung ma ste/ /phung byed bdag mo thod khrag 'dzin/ /'gal byed: /bstan pa: /bdud pho /'chi bdag /gying chen: /sa ma yā/ gshin rje'i rgyal po khyed rnams kyang / /tshangs pa dang ni 'jug sred po/ /lha gdon drag po ma rungs pa/ /bskul zhig bskul zhig las la chos/ /sdig can bstan dgra ngan sems can/ /tshe srog rkus la lus sems phrol/ /dbang po sdoms la gnad du gzir/ /lha dang phrol zhig brlag par bgyis/ /huX yā 'jigs byed chen po'i bka' byung gi /gdug byed gzhin rje pho mo las la yā/ /'di nas byang phyogs ri rab lhun po'i rmad/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rum nas//dpag tshad brgya khri 'das pa'i 'og /rgya gram rlung gi bar dag nas/ /thod pa lcags kyi mun khang nas/ /ya ma rā dza gshegs su sa so la/ /bye ba gung ring su mi bzlog /srin mo dug hrul gnyis med rol/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la//rgyu ma mgo 'phreng lus la dkris/ /mi lpags shun chen sna tshogs dang / /ro ras nag po gos su gyon/ /g.yas na gsod byed ral gri 'phyar/ /g.yo na pa 'khor —115—
