lo zhags pa 'phen/ kha nas me 'bar thog ser 'bebs/ /bdud po mi bzad skye 'gro'i bdud/ khyod ni gshin rje'i sde dpon te/ /bam chen phung po'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gsod byed dregs pa kun gyi spyi la gnas/ /pho nya gyad chen khyed kyi dgyes bde mo/ /bdud mo khrag gi ral pa can/ /srid gsum lto na 'chang ba mo//sha khrag srog dbugs bdag mo ste/ /las kyi rlung dmar zhon nas rgyug /'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad gtong ma/ /phyag na thod pa thogs te khrag la rol/ /da 'dra'i btsun mo sras dang blon po dang / /g.yog 'khor bye ba stong dang bcas/ /sde brgyad ma lus bran du 'khol/ /yi dwags ma mo pho nyar 'gyed/ /zas su dgra bgegs srog dbugs za/ /las su 'gugs dang gsod la dga'/ khyod la 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /gang na 'dug kyang myur du khug /khram la thob cig ltong la rgyus/ khrag mda' bu yug char ltar phob/ /thar med khri mon chen por chub/ /myos par gyis shig srog dang phrol//'chi bdag gshin rje las la yā/ /dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs//bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces bskul/ ga po yang phyogs skyong ba bcu bskul ba sogs byas nas/ sgrub pa'i skabs yin na/ 'drub khung bskyed cing ling ga dgug gzhug sgrol chog zhal du bstab pa/ slar yang mar pa/ bstod dang / 'jigs mdzad chen po'i g.yas pa yis/ /zhes sogs slar yang pho nya bskul 'o / /bsnyen pa'i skabs de rnam/sa mi dgos so/ /bsnyen sgrub gnyis ka kyir ra thar thun gtor sa tor stegs kyi khar skyel ba'am/ /zor du 'phang ngo / /bsnyen pa'i skabs las kyi gshin rje'i sngags bzla ba nges par dgos pa min yang / cung zad cam bzla bar spro na/ gong bzlas pa'i 'jug tu'am skabs 'dir bya ste/ de yang rtsa sngags kyi mthar btags te bzla zhing / de —1/6—

la tshe spel sngags btags te yang bzla'o/ /slar yang hṝXljoXhaXl sogs pa'i phyi mchod dang /bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i nang mchod phul/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi ngo bo/ dpal chen po rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis/ bdag la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal1 du gsol/ zhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ de nas yig brgya bzod gsol bya/ spros med mkha' ltar khyab pa'i sku mchog ni/ /mi gnas ri phyir na gshegs pa mi mnga' yang / /srid zhu'i tshul gyis gshegs su gsol ba sku 'dis/ /bdag dang gzhan bcas sgrib pa bral gyur cig /oX dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ bi shwa rū pa dha ri/ ga smo ga smo su bhā wa naX/ kri ta na tī na ta thā ga smo sarba brnya rwa bi sa dza ya/ ma ma kar+shaX ku ru swāhā/ zhes mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi 'das ma 'das kyi lha tshogs gsar du spyan drangs pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gyur/ces pa nas/ gzhal ya/sa khang 'od du zhu ste/ mdun bskyed dam tshig kra/'i lha rnams la thim/ lha mo brgyad gtso bo'i thugs kar thim/ mdun bskyed sa/tso bo yang rang gi thugs kar thim/ de ya nga rim gyis 'od gsal du zhugs pa nas/ dge ba bsngo ba'i bar gong bzhin no/ /'di'i sbyang bya sbyong byed sbyor chul ni/ gzhan rnams nga pa' bo gcig pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor rni rang dang las mthun nga/'i gnas grogs 'khor rnams sbyong la/ ye shes pa lhan cig bstim pa ni/ phyi don du snang ya/nga rang sems kyi rnam 'phru' yin pa mtshon no/ /gong gi gtor chog nyid la mdun bskyed kyi gtor rma rgyas pa ra 'dus pas/ thun mtshams kyi gtor ma logs pa mi dgos so/ /'on kyang 'dzims pas ni/ thun nang du gtor chog —117—

rgyas pa skyo pa'i man ngag lugs de mi byed par/ thun mtshams gtor ma'i dus/ la li ta chung bas mdzad pa'i gtor chog zhe dgu ma'i cha lag de kha 'dir sbyor la/ yang phyis kyi 'ga' zhig /oX ya ma du tī nī hūX phaṭa/ oX ya ma heXrme nī hūX phaṭa/ oX ya ma da sbyi nī hūX phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma kā la rā tri huX phaṭa/ tseX( ya ma ang gu shā huX phaṭa/ ma rna ya ma kā la pā shā huX phaṭa/ tseX( ya mā shri kha lā hūX phaṭa/ glu( ya mā a be shā huX phaṭa/ ces pa'ang gtor ma dang mchod snga gas la spyor ba gnang ba gzhung dang man ngag gi khungs yod na ni legs kyang / rgya bod kyi yig rnying na 'dug pa bdag gis ni ma mthong ngo / /'jam dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i sgron me drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzhu pa zhig yod de/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ spogs chog /'jig rten lha/ sgom bzlas/ rdzogs pa'i rim/ pa ste le'u drug go /de'i drug pa ni rwa rtse sems 'dzin ston byed yin la/ dang po ni/ rwa g.yas gnas pa sngo dang dmar/ /zhes rwa zhal gsal ba tsam dang / lnga pa na 'khor zhal yod pas/ slob dpon de 'khor zhal dang rwa zhal gnyis ka gdam ka bzhed par mngon la/ dang po dang lnga pa gnyis kar nas mngon rtogs re ston pa/ mdun du dkyil 'khor rgyas pa skyed mi skyed kyi khyad ma gtogs/zhi ba ye shes dang gung 'grig ste/ bris sku sogs la dmigs shing / bdag mdun zhal sprod grogs po lta bu'i tshul gyis bsnyen pa yin no/ /skyo lugs pa rnams kyi sgrub pa'i lag len rnams/ 'di'i le'u gnyis pa la gtso bor brten nas mdzad cing / rtog bdun gyi dngos bstan thun mong ma yin pa'i 'bor lo/ snyos rwa skyo gsum gyi phyag len mdzad pa 'di yang / gzhung 'di'i le'u gnyis pa nyid na gsal bar yod pas/ mkhas pa chen por rlom pa rnams de la khungs med pas sems pa ni/ rgya gzhung yin nges bstan 'gyur du ma chug pa rnam/sa ma mthong zhing / rgyud kyi tshig don la go ba ma rnyed pa'i rnam 'gyur du snang la/ 'di'i le'u bzhi pa 'jig rten pa'i lha ni/ las gzhin gyi sgrub thabs yin yang / skyo pa rnams 'di la phyag len cher mi mdzad cing / zhi ba ye shes kyi gzhung na bsnyen pa'i —118—

skabs bka' sdod la bsnyen pa med/ skyo lugs kyi sgrub thabs man ngag lugs dkyus nyid yi dam dang bka' sdod chos skyong sbags sgrub yin pas/ 'di'i lugs la las gshi/na gyi waṃ/ba thabs logs pa med kyang cha lag ma tshang bar ni mi 'gyur go/ lugs 'di'i sgrub pa dang las sbyor rnams/ rnying ma'i gshi/na rje gshe da kha thun nag po dang phal cher gung mthun yang / phan tshun bsre bslad ni min te/sems dpa' bsdus pa dang / zhi drag gi las bdun sogs nyid las 'byung ba'i ma/na ngag len yi na pas skyon ma yin/ phan tshun gcig gi dpang po cig shos kyis thub pa'i yon tan yin mod/ de lta na yang de gnyis 'phags yul du sngon byung ba man ngag gi rtsa ba gcig las byung ba ni yin srid do/ /des na snyem mdo shākya dpal bas byas pa'i zhe dgu ma'i sgrub dkyil dang / ngor lugs pa dang / phyis dbus phyogs su byung ba'i/ sems dpa' bsdus pa'i rjes 'brang gi sgrub thabs ci rigs pa byung ba sogs/ skyo pa'i lugs dang mi mthun pa la skyo lugs su kha g.yar nas/ khungs che che ltar sgrog cing nga pho 'don pa'i rdzus ma rnams sun dbyung ba'i phyir/ skyo lugs kyi sgrub thabs chog khrigs cung zad zhib cing gsal bar brjod pa yin gyi/ man ngag ni kun gyi spyod yul ma yin pa'i phyir 'dir rme bris so/ /lugs 'di'i dbang chog ni bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mang du mdzad yod cing / de yang phal cher don yod rdo rje'i dkyil chog la brten pa yin no// //༈ da ni jo bo nā ro pa dang jo bo na ri pa'i man ngag gung spros te/ rtog bdun gyi don bshad pa las byung ba rkyu/da rkyang gi lu/gas/ 'jigs byed mal 'u/gas su grags pa'i sgrub thabs bsha/da par bya na/ 'di'i chings ni shrī bha dra dang bag tsam mthun mod de'i lugs ni min no/ /de yang spyir zhal drug pa'i rgyud la ni/ bod skad nyid la yig 'bru 'chu/gas pa'i tshig zur 'dra min phran tshegs ma gtogs pa 'gyur mi gcig pa med la/ rong zom rwa skyo mal snyos sogs lugs so so'i rjes 'brang rnams/ lo tsā ba de dang des bsgyur ro snyam pa 'ga' zhig la yod srid na'ang / rang rang gi 'dod pa —119—

'jo ba tsam du zad/ des na 'di ni snga dar gyi dus sam/ snga dang phyi dar gyi bar la 'gyur ba zhig yin zhes 'ga' zhig 'chad pa don la gnas par mthong / de 'dra'i rgyud gzhan yang yod de/ zla gsang thig le dang rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud da lta yod pa 'di la sogs pa'o/ /snga dar dus rgyal blon la gsangs te bsgyur ba 'ga' zhig chad pas 'jigs te/ lo paṇa gyi ming 'gyur byang ma smos pa dang /bar mtshams su bsgyur ba 'ga' zhig snga dar bzhin du bkas bcad kyi sgrigs med cing / phyi dar bzhin du gzhan la mig ltos ma bcol bas/ bsgyur ngos shes pa la 'gyur byang med pa dang /brtsams rgyud la 'gyur byang byas pa sogs nges pa med pa'o/ /'dir gdong drug gi rgyud la/ dpe rnying yid ches pa'i 'gyur byang med cing / 'di la nyan bshad byed pa'i lo tsā ba thams cad kyis kyang 'gyur rnying gcig kho na'i steng nas 'chad do/ /nag 'jigs kyi rgyud gnyis la 'gyur mi gcig pa mang ste/ mal lugs pa dang / de'i rjes 'brangs lugs rnying pa ni/ nag po'i rgyud nag tsho 'gyur la klog skyas bcos pa'i steng nas 'chad/ rtog bdun la klog skya'i 'gyur med pa lags te mchi/ yod na mal 'gyur yang de la 'gyur bcos yong thang ba la/ mal lo nyid kyi 'gyur byang yod pa 'di/ pu rangs pa khyung po chos brtson gyi 'gyur la mal los bcos pa yin zhes mchan bu rnying pa las 'byung ngo / /mal gyis kyang pham thing pa chen po nas brgyud pa/ dang por klog skya dang / phyis pham thing pa phyi ma la yang gsan par grags la/ na ri pa nas brgyud pa ni ha du dkar por grags pa'i bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta ba ren+da ru tshe la yang zhus so/ /mal lo la sa skya bla chen gyis gsan te/ bla chen gyis rtog bdun la mchan bu dang / dka' 'grel du grags pa'i spyi don de mdzad cing / sras sku mched kyis dka' 'grel la chan bu dang / bstod pa sogs mdzad/ nag po la rje btsun chen po'i sgrub thabs yod pa 'di rgyud don la shin tu 'byor ba'i yang dag pa zhig snang / rgya gzhung dpal 'dzin gyi sgrub thabs tshig 'bru legs shing byin rlabs los kyang che/ rgyud don la 'byor tshabs de bas kyang 'di —120—

ngos che na yang grags ni chung ngo / /g.yin mdzad byang med pa'i nag po'i rgyud kyi mchan bu dang / sa bcad dang / yig sna thung thung 'ga' re dang / dngos nag po'i dkyil chog yin pa la/ rdo rje 'jigs mdzad la yang sbyor rgyu'i dkyil chog gnyis yod/ gcig ni nā ro pa nas pham thang pa la brgyud pa'i lugs te/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i skabs su 'don pa spos pa ma ga rtabs/ mal lugs kyi 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil chog ji lta ba bzhin/ gcig shos ni slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyi man ngag yin gsung ste/ na ri pa'i lugs yin/ 'di la rdo rje'i dbang gi dod du ral gri'i dbang bskur ba sogs spyi dang mi 'dra ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mang du yod pa'i dbang chog ngo mtshar can yid 'phrog pa cig snang / dbang chog de gnyis mdzad byang med cing / sa chen gyi gsung 'bum nang du ma chug kyang / mdzad pa po bla chen rang yin par grags/ lugs 'di ni rgya bal gyi paṇ+ḍi ta'i ngag rgyun gtsang ma/ bsre bslad chung zhing gam gtsang ba legs po cig yod cing / sgrub dkyil de rnams shin tu ya mtshan che bar 'dug /spyi don dang tshig don gyi bshad pa ni rgya chen po rang med cing / gdams ngag rnam grangs mang po'ang mi snang ngo / /'on kyang bshad pa'i skabs rgyud nyid mngon rtogs su bslang ba'am/ rgyud kyi phur bu 'don tshul gyi 'chad lugs gnad che rab yang yod do/ /las mkhan spyon pa 'jigs byed khra'i gdong can sogs mkha' 'gro ma bzhi skor gyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi gzhung na ri pas mdzad pa dang / de'i gsal byed bla chen gyis mdzad pa cig sngon yod nges par 'dug na'ang kho bos ma mthong / deng sang de mthong thos skad pa yod yod mi 'dra'o/ /gdong drug gi rgyud la'ang /lugs 'di la sa bcad dang / mchan bu than thun tsam las yig sna dang sgrub thabs rnying pa yang ma mthong ngo / /de dag la gzhan yi ge rnying pa dang / bar skabs su byung ba'i yi ge ni mang po med la/phyis ngor lugs pa rnams kyis brtsams pa 'ga' re yod na'ang / g.yin phal cher cal col du snang /skyed lhas pa bdag po blo gros pas brtsams pa zhig yig rnying dang mthun pas cung zad legs pa —121—

tsam du rga'o/ /yang lugs 'di skyong bar khas mche ba'i ngor pa rnams 'di skad ces smra ste/ mal lugs 'di la dgra nag gi rgyud la/ dpal 'dzin gyis 'grel pa btab pa'i bshad pa rgyas pa yod pa dang / sgrub dkyil yang dpal 'dzin gyi rjes su 'brang zer ba dang / rgyu mtshan bla chen gyi dka' 'grel las/ dkyil chog ni nag po'i dkyil chog tu shes par bya zhes kha 'phangs pa'i nag po'i dkyil chog ni/ dpal 'dzin gyi dgra nag dkyil chog yin pas so/ /zer ba ni tshod dpogs tsam ma gtogs shin tu blun te/ dgra nag gi sgrub thabs dpal 'dzin gyi lugs dang / lugs 'di mi gcig par sgrub thabs rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa de mthong ba tsam gyis kyang go nus na/ sgrub thabs de gzhag 'brel chug po tshar gcig tsam yang ma sgrags pa'i skyon du 'dug cing / dbang chog dpal 'dzin gyi lugs yin zer ba ni/ 'di'i rang lugs la dbang chog yod pa tsam yang ma tshor bar/ rdzun gtam 'ba' zhig smras par 'dug la/ spyir dpal 'dzin gyi lugs mal dang bla chen gyis ma gsan no mi mkhyen no zer ba ta ma yin mod/ lag len du 'debs shing bshad pa mdzad pa'i lugs de ni/ rgyud rkyang man ngag gi lugs yin te/ dpal 'dzin gyi gzhung 'grel la mi mdzad do/ /lugs 'di'i dgra nag gi mchan bu dang yig sna rnams kyang / dpal 'dzin gyi 'grel ba dang bshad sgros mi gcig cing / 'jigs mdzad kyi sgrub thabs dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa dang yang lugs 'di shin tu mi 'dra'o/ /dgra nag gi rgyud la dpal 'dzin gyis 'grel pa btab pa'i bshad pa rgyas po yod zer ba'ang shab shob kho na ste/ 'grel pa de kho nas 'chad pa yin na/ bshad pa rgyas rgyu cang med la/ mtha' chod dang kha skong rgyas po yod na ni/ de 'dra ba'i yi ge de yang ngos 'dzin dgos na/ de 'dra ci yang med pa'i phyir/ sngon bshad pa rgyas pa byung ba/ phyis khyed rnams kyi mngon shes kyi mthong ba yin la rag /mdor na dbang chog gang yin tsam yang cha rgyus med bzhin du/gzhan las ches mchog tu gyur pa'i rnam gzhag yod skad shes skad byed cing rtsal du thon thon skad du —122—

rgya cher smra ba ni/ slob ma rnams bslu ba'i thabs 'ba' zhig dang / mkhas pa rnams zhe nas khrel ba'i rgyu kho na'o| /de dag las kha cig /lugs 'di'i sgrub thabs rtsom pa na/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su gtso rkyang kho na byed pa ni/ le'u bzhi pa'i spyi don gyi thad kho na la gdong 'dod byas par zad/ kha cig gis ro langs gri thod 'dzin par byas/ 'ga' zhig lha dgu bsgom kyang dkyil 'kho ra la phyag mtshan mi 'god pa dang / mdun bskyed la 'god bdag bskyed la mi 'god pa sogs ni/ spyi don dang rgyud kyi mchan bu tsam yang sdom ma shes pa dang / go ra bsod seng ba sogs kha cig dkyil chog dpal 'dzin gyi lugs la brten nas/ rig pa'i dbang lnga la zhal dgu pa rigs lnga bsgom pa sogs ni rang bzo 'ba' zhig yin te/ de 'dra de dpal 'dzin gyi lugs dang yang 'gal/ 'di'i rang lugs kyi dkyil chog dang mi mthun/ dka' 'grel dang mchan bu sogs las kyang ma bshad/lugs g.yin gyi dkyil chog tshad ldan gang la'ang med pa'i rdzun chos yin la/ da lta na yang 'di ni bla chen gyi dka' 'grel na/ las tshogs kyi skabs/ rtsa zhal gyi kha dog bsgyur ba'i 'jigs mjad rigs lnga zhig bshad pa/ de tsam zhig mthong nas 'di rig dbang sbyar na mtshar po zhig 'ong ngo snya ma dran rkyen byas pa'o/ /bdag bskyed la 'khor mi skyed pa dang / bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la phyag mtshan mi 'god pa ni/ bla chen gyi dka' 'grel dang 'gal te de las 'di skad ces/ rtog pa bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs ltar/ stong pa nas dam tshig sems dpa'i bar du bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug /ces mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i skabs su bshad pas/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang / bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus rnam pa la khyad med par bstan/ dkyil 'khor de yang rtog pa dang po'i dkyil 'khor gyi skabs yin/ de las phyag mtshan dang ro langs 'god par gsungs pas so/ /bod 'ga' zhig phyag mtshan 'god pa dang ro langs 'god pa so sor byed kyang / de 'dra de spyir yang rgyud kyi tshig don dang 'gal bas shin tu mi 'thad/ sgos su mal —123—

lugs pa rnams mi 'dod de/ rgyud 'dir dkyil 'khor gcig kho na bstan pa yin par bzhed pas pas so/ /des na lugs 'di la rtog pa dang po dang / bzhi pa bsres pas bdag mdun gang la yang lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor phyag mtshan gyis brgyan pa de kho na yin par shes so/ /ro langs gri thod 'dzin par bsgom pa ni rdo rje grub pa sogs kyis bshad pas spyir bzang zhing 'thad na'ang bla chen gyi mchan bu dang dngos su 'gal bas/ sa lugs ni ye ma yin no/ /dgra nag dpal 'dzin gyi lugs bzhin byed zer ba'i rgyu ni/ mal lugs kyi rang bzhin ni ye ma go /spyir dpal 'dzin grags che/sgos su bu ston chen po tsam nas gzung / phyis kyi gsar ma'i gshin rje gshed pa phal cher zhigadapal 'jin kho na la/ yid brton par byas pas/ de thos nas lugs de gzhan pas rngams che ba zhig yod par 'dug snyam nas/ mtho 'grogs kyi lugs su byas te brdol thabs su smras pa kho nar zad do/ /de dag ni lugs 'di la bsnyad nas rdzun gyis gzhan mgo bskor ba rnams kyi 'tshang zur tsam smos pa'o/ /da ni dkyus kyi don la 'jug par bya ste/ rgyud pa 'di pa'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor kun la sgrub rma chod dam maṇ+ḍal mchod chog yod na ma gtogs/ mngon rtogs gyi sna gor sngon 'gro gtor ma mi mdzad pa rang shas che/ bris sku'i mdun du phyi mchod nang mchod gtor ma gnyis bshams/ spro na smyon pa 'jigs byed kyi gtor ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa'ang zur du bshams/ oX ya mun ta ka huX phaṭa/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur/ mchod pa rlams rtsa sngags kyis bsang bar ba'e da mod kyi/ de lag len mi bde bas/ 'dam spa la yod pa ltar/ hṝXljoXs bsangs/ ngon la'ang bsang ba thams cad rtsa sngags kyis byed nga/ ha cang thal ches so/ /swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun gyi nang du huX bdun las/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/—124—

mar me/ dri myong/ zhal zas dang / gzhan yang mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis gang bar gyur/ oX badz+ra ar+ghaX āXhūX/ tseX( badz+ra ngu yiXsnye āXhūX/ tseX( badz+ra pukhre/ āXhuX/ dha pe/ a 'e1 ke /ga rnye/nai wi te/ sha lta āXhūX/ oX badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ṭa sogs brjod/༄de rjes skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya rnams bya/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ tseX( āXhuX/ zhes gtor ma la gtor te srung ba bya/ yang 'khru gsum gyis bdud rtsi myang / de nas sum+bha lan gnyis kyis tsham rngam dang / oX me dhi ni badz+re bha wa ban+ta hūX sogs/ sngags drug gis srung 'khor dgod/ oX gha gha sogs dang / mud ga ra sogs kyis phur gdab bya/ bsrung 'khor 'di dka' 'grel dang mchan bu na med kyang / 'di nyid kyi dkyil mchog na yod cing / 'og tu stong par sbyangs pa'i de ma thag tu/ srung 'khor bsgom pa med pa'i phyir/ 'di med na lugs 'di la srung 'khor chad par 'gyur bas nges par dgos so/ /phyis rten brten pa dus gcig tu bskyed pa'i skabs 'khor yod snyam na de tsam gyis go mi chod de/ rgyu'i 'jam dpal sogs dngos gzhi skyed chog gal chen mang po la ma khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /tshogs zhing gi skabs 'dir khro bo'i thugs kar huX dang / zhi ba'i thugs kar dhīXbasgom pa 'dam kha yin yang / lag len khro bo la mdzad/ skad cig gis rang rdo rje 'jigs byed ces pa nas/ phyag 'tshal 'dud kyi bar sgrub thabs snying po dang 'dra/ tshig zur phran bu tsam la nges pa med de/ gang snye ltar byas kyang 'dra bas so/ /lkoX sarba ta thā ga ta shrī badz+ra bhe ra wa ar+ghaX pra tisnro swāhā/ de bzhin du pu duX/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta shrī badz+ra bhi ra wa badz+ra pu spre āXhuX spru hā/ de bzhin du sna wi te'i bar dang / rol mo la ya nga sbyar/ bdud bzhi po ni nas / lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /ces bstod/ oX sarba bid pū ra nas/ ho'i bar brjod/bdag gi skye ba thogs ma med pa nas/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa dang /—125—

bgyid du stsal ba dang / bgyid pa la rjes su yid rang ba de dag so sor bshags par bgyi'o/ /bla ma dang dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pa la skyabs su mchi'o / thun mong dang khyad par gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams blang zhing bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / nyan thos dang / so so skye bo'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o /bdag gis sems can 'khore ba'i rgya mtsho las/ ma rgal ba rnams sgra la bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi/ dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bgyi'o /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul bar bgyi'o /'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol bar bgyi'o /bdag gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bzlas bsgom gnyis la gnas par bya'o/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /ces so/ /de ltar na/ bshags pa skyabs 'gro dam tshig yi rang bzhi/ /smon sems bskul dang gsol 'debs 'jug sems bzhi/ /'jug bsngo ba ste yan lag dgu yin no/ /de rjes gnang ba mnos pa ni/ de ltar sgrub pa ni lam legs pa la gnas pa yin no zhes gsung bar gyur/ bar 'dir yid kyis phyag dang mchod pa tsam bya ste/ ngag nas mi brjod/ tse ( badz+ra mu zhes tshogs rten gshegs su gsol/ tshang med bzhi ngag nas brjod tshul spyi dang 'dra ba las/ dmigs pa ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer phyogs mdog can phyogs bzhir spros pas/ bde ba la bkod pa sogs byas par bsams/ 'di dag nas mi brjod ces dka' 'grel gyi mchan bu las 'byung mod/ brjod kyang chog /de mal lugs nyid kyi pū yi pa dang —126—

'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas tha mal pa'i yid dang / gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnams rnam par dag par mos te/ swa bhā wa dang / bas shudha dang / yo ga shu khres/ sngags rnams brjod do/ /phyis kyi sa lugs yin rlom 'ga' zhig /sngags bar pa mi byed pa ni/ dka' 'grel gyi yig chung ma mthong bar zad do/ /stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i dbus su/ ya las rlung gi dkyil 'kho ra du ba'i kha dog can gyi steng du a las zla ba la/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje'i gdan gyis bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /'dir nyi ma mdun dang thugs kar bsgom pa skabs thob kyi 'dam khar yod kyang / mdun du bsgom pa gtso che ste dkyus su spund pa'i phyir ro/ /de las/ 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ 'bum du khyab par gyur/ nyi ma de nyid hu yig nag po 'od zer lnga dang ldan par gyur/ 'dir dkal 'grel du/ nyi ma de nyid las hū nag ngo 'od zer lnga dang ldan par bsam/ zhes 'byung ba'i don ni/ nyi ma de nyid slar yang hū du gyur pa'i don yin zhing / nyi ma dang hū gi bar du 'od zer spro ba sogs ye ma bshad pas/ mal lugs yin gyu ba ngor lugs pa'i mngon rtogs dang bshad pa rnams su/ nyi ma las 'od zer me'i tsha tsha lta bu 'phros/ sdang ba tshar bcad/ ces zer ba dang / nyi ma rang gdan du bzhag nas chu las chu bur brdol ba'i tshul du hūṃ nag po steng du 'thon pa 'dod pa dang / bshad pa'i skabs su skyo lugs dang / dge lugs pa'i bshad pa dam dum rna bar bzhag nas/ mngon byang lnga'i spros bshad byed cing / lugs 'di mngon byang lnga las rten dang brten pa dus gcig tu bskyed pa yin pas sgong skyes sbyong zhing / sgong skyes sbyangs pas skye gnas gzhan rnams kyang zhor la 'byo/ngas pa'i phyir/ sbyangs gzhi lugs 'di kho na rgya che'o zhes dran rkyen dang / kha mkhas kyi smra brjod mang ste/ mal los yid la ma dran pa'i mal lugs dang / sa skya gong ma lngas rna bar ma tshor ba'i sa lugs gtsang ma 'dres med de 'dra ngo mtshar can rang yin par —127—

snang ngo / /hūX las 'od 'phros/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ huX yig de nyid rdo rje chen po mthing nag rtse lnga pa/ rwa gdengs pa/ lte ba la huX gis mtshan par gyur/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa dang rdo rje phra mo mtha' yas pa spros/ sdang ba dang / gdug pa rnams tshar bcad/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la bkod/ zhing khams dag par byas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas de rnams dang / 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor tshad med pa spyan drangs te/ de dag thams cad gcig tu gyur pa las/dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla re/ phyi rol rdo rje'i mes gtams pa'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i/ gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa zhes pa nas/ sna tshogs pas gang ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar zhe dgu ma'i skabs bzhin/ re mig dbus ma'i gnas su bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed ces pa nas/ mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ ces pa'i bar brjod/lugs 'di la'ang g.yas g.yon gyi zhal drug 'khor zhal spyi dang mthun pa kho na yin zhing / zhabs 'og tu bdud bzhi kho na byed pa skyo lugs lha dgu dang 'dra/ spyir ni bdud bzhi ni mtshon byed de/ lha chen po rnams gnon pa yin pas/ lugs thams cad la gang ltar byas kyang mi 'gal zhing / yang cig tu na srog chags bcu drug nyid lha chen pho mo rnams kyi ngo bo yin pas/ byol song bcu drug kho na zhabs 'og tu mnan pa'i chog pa'i skabs kyang yod do/ /de ltar na yang don yod rdo rje mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs bstod pa las/ g.yas su brgya byin tshangs pa dang / g.yon du khyab 'jug drag po mnan pa dang / phyag g.yon gyi dang po na tshangs mgo 'dzin par bshad pa 'di/ bod kyi 'jig byed mkhan —128—

po kun la grags che bar 'dug go /re mig brgyad la shar du tshangs pa'i mgo bo zhes pa nas/ me thab rnams gnas par gyur gyi bar yang gong skyo lugs bzhin/ sgo mtshams brgyad du ro langs chen po brgyad/ sku mdog nag po rang gi mgo bo bcad de lag pa g.yon du bzung ba/ rgyu mas brgyan te gar byed pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la gnas shing / 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa rnams su gyur/ rang gi thugs kar hruXlas pad+ma dmar po dang / āXlas nyi ma la sa bon hūX/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor/ rgyal ba sras bcas kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid oX badz+ra sa mā dzaX bdud bzhi po ni sogs dang / tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ dzaXhuX baX hoX mang du brjod/ rang gi dpral bar zla ba la oX dkar po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i ngo bo/ mgrin par pad+ma la āXdamar po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo/ snying khar nyi ma la hūX nag po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo'o/ /'dir yang ngor lugs pa rnams dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa/ sku gsung thugs byin rlabs nye bsnyen/ ye shes pa gzhug pa sgrub pa zhes tha snyad sbyor ba ne/ gshin rje gshed kyi skabs 'dir/ sa skya gong ma rnams kyang de 'dra mi bzhed de/'di ni kyai rdor gyi bshad ya mas cig gis 'dres yi na la/ rtog bdun dka' 'grel gyi mchan bu'i ka ka mtho ma mthong bar zad de/ ji skad du/ de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes sems dpa' sbyan drangs shing gzhug /ces dkyus la byung yang / de gnyis ka ka mthos gong 'og bsgyur yod pa dang / ye shes sems dpa' zhes pa'i gong du/ sa bon gyi 'od kyis zhes mchan bu btab yod pa'i phyir/ gnas gsum byin rlabs sngon du song na/ de'i huX las 'od spros pas chog —129—

pa'i phyir/ sa bon gyi zhes pa smos mi dgos bas so/ /des na dam ye bsres pa brtan byed du gnas gsum byin gyis rlob pa yin no/ /yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oX badz+ra sa mā dzaX oX na mo pañtsa ku la ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wa ra khyuX thes phyag 'tshal/ oX badz+ra ar+ghaX sogs nas/ni we te'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /sogs kyis gsol ba btab/sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /sogs dang / oX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūX/ 'dir yang ngor ba rnams badz+ra u ta ka'i sngags byed pa ni/ dka' 'grel gyi ma rman bu ma mthong ba'i 'ol tshod do/ /gong gi 'phros las/ 'di skad ces zhes gsungs shing /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rdo rje ma rnams kyis mchod pa phul/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang / sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ skabs 'dir mchod bstod byas na bzlas pa'i rjes la mi dgos shing / bzlas pa'i rjes la mchod bstod byed na skabs 'dir mi dgos zhes gsung pas spyir gang rung cig gis chog na'ang skabs 'dir byed pa gtso che'o/ /des na gong bzhin mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ dang por sngags mchod ni/ rtsa sngags snying po nye snying sogs sngags gsum brjod pas gtso bo dang / spros pa la dga' na ya mān ta ka tshar brgyad kyis ro langs brgyad la mchod/ bsdu na gtso bo kho nas chog go/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar phyi mchod phul ba'i rjes la/sngags kyi mgo 'dra ba las/ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pu dzi ta hūX/ de bzhin du/ par she'i bar du snar/ sngags gsum gyi tha mar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/ dur khrod rgyan gyis —130—

sogs dang / spro na mi thung sgeg po sogs kyis kyang bstod do/ /bzlas pa dngos ni/ 'jigs mdzad kyi sgrub thabs spyi dang 'dra/ gtso bor yi ge bcu pa nyid bzla/ thun gyi 'jug tu huX dang yi ge bcu pa mi dmigs par byas la/ ya'am ma'i mthar rtsa sngags kyis bskor bar bsgom ste/ rtsa sngags brgya rtsa sogs bzla/ de yang mi dmigs pa'i shul du/ ya'am ma la nye snying gis bskor bar bsgom/nye snying yang brgya sogs ji ltar 'os pa bzla/ mthar/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du 'jam dpal mchog rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs/ de rjes dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing thun mtshams su ldang ba ni/ gong ma rnams dang 'dra'o/ /sgrub thabs 'dir sbyang bya sbyong byed kyi rnam bzhag ni/ rwa lugs dpa' rkyang gi zhor la rtogs par 'gyur la/ gzhal yas khang 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed pa ni/ skye ba blangs pa na las mthun pa'i gnas 'khor longs spyod rnams grub pa mtshon no/ /de nas thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba'am/ yang na gong du bzlas pa'i rjes la mchod bstod byed na de'i rjes dang / mi byed na bzlas pa grub ma thag tu/ gtor ma phul na yang shin tu legs so/ /gtor ma rtsa sngags sam snying pos bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaX las rlud raX las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/dbus su na las mi'i sha sogs/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su mu las dri chu sogs/de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūX chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du oX me long /lhor truX mnyam pa/ nub tu dzi so sor/ byang du khaX bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ 'di gnyis la sdiXdang aXyong shing yang mi gsung / de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' —131—

la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba/ de'i steng du hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lhe ba la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba'i rlangs pa steng du song ba/ oX dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hū ཾ ༷ la phog /de dag las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ hruX las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thod pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba du ma spyan drangs te/mdun gyi thod pa la thod pa thim/ bdud rtsi la bdud rtsi thim/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur te/ kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oX āXhūX/ lan mang du brjod/ yi ge kho pa brjod la bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal gsal btab/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed nas/ bdag nyid du gyur/ sngar dkyil 'khor bsdus zin pa'i thun mtshams yin na/ sku'i mtha' skor du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ ro langs chen po la sogs pa bka' sdod srungs ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba dang / gtso bo'i g.yon gyi phyogs su smyon pa 'jigs byed sku mdog dmar po/ phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag gam zhags pa 'dzin pa/ 'khore mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' nod pa'i tshul du bzhugs shing / zhing skyong ba sogs dur khrod kyi bdag po rnams kyang gsal bar 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po las byed dpag tu med pas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX oX —132—

ya mun ta ka badz+ra bhe ra wa/ pad+ma ka la ma ya stuX/ ni grwan+ta bhe ra wa a gra tiṣ+ṭha tilgabadz+ra bhe ra wa a gra tiṣ+ṭha tilga shā sha na a dhi pa ti a gra tiṣ+ṭha la de nas sngags gsum cung zad bzlas te/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu'i 'od kyis gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ rtsa sngags kyi rjes su/ tseX( bhe ra wa spo hā i daX ba liX ma ma kar+yaX sma dha ya swāhā/ lan gsum sogs kyis bcom/ ldan 'das la phul/ oX gi zhwa snye dzhai ra wa ra ba liX gro hā spo hā ma ma kar+ya sā dha ya swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis smyon pa 'jigs byed dang / aṣ+ṭa sma sha na taṣ+ṭha bzhi shā sa na rak+ta n+tu sarba gro hā gro hā i daX ba liX ma ma sarba kar+yaX sā dha ni swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis dur khrod kyi bdag po rnams la 'bul/ de nas gong bzhin phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa rnams bya/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs dang / gong bzhi 'dod don gsol btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol rnams bya/ oX khyod kyis sems can sogs kyis gshegs gsol dang / thun mtshams kyi skabs yin na/ gnas gsum du 'khru gsum gyi bdud rtsi'i thig le bya/ smon lam dang bkra shis tsam brjod/ bdag bskyed ma bsdus pa'i skabs yin na/ ye shes pa gshegs gsol byas ma thag tu/ mdun bskyed kyi dam tshig pa dang / dkyil 'khor lhan cig tu bdag la bsdu/ thun mtshams kyi lha skur langs pa'i rjes su smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/ /lugs 'di'i dbang chog ni/ bar skabs su dpal 'dzin gyi cho ga la brten pa ma gtogs/ rang lugs ma rnyed par snang yang da lta rab lugs gnyis po de rnyed pas gnyis po'i nang nas na ri pa'i lugs la bya'o// //༈ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha bcu gsum mar grags pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs bsgom par 'dod pas/ 'di ltar shes dgos te/ de la —133—

ngor pa rnams na re/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma la rgya gzhung gi khungs med/ ces dang / 'di rwa lo kho na'i rtog bzo yin gyi gzhan la ma grags zhes pa dang / rje btsun tsong kha pas/ rwa lo dang gnyos los bcu gsum can mdzad do zhes bshad pa la/ de khyed gzigs rgya ches ba kha thal ba yin zhes btings tshig smra zhig gnyos lugs la lha dgu las med do zhes dang / 'brog mi lo tsā bas kyang gshed skor mang du bsgyur ro zhes smra'o/ /de ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ khungs med ces pa 'di rtog bdun gyi dngos bstan ma yin pa tsam la zer na ni/ zhe dgu ma dang khyed rang rnams bcu bdun mar 'dod pa'i dkyil 'khor de yang khungs med du thal te rgyud kyi dngos bstan ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dgongs 'grel rgya gzhung gi khungs med do snyam na/ mthong rgya shin tu chung ste/ slob dpon pad+ma srung ba ste ka ma la rak+ṣi ta'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa dang / rnam snang srung ba ste be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ti'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa ste sgrub thabs rgya gzhud gnyis yod la/ rtog bdun gyi 'grel ba so na shrī 'am/ rdo rje grub pas mdzad pa las kyang shin tu gsal zhing / de yang dpal 'dzin gyi man ngag yin par 'chad pas/rdo rje slob dpon chen po dpal 'dzin yang 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma bzhed par gsal lo/ /spyir ni rwa lo rdo rje grags pa yang / rgya bal gyi paṇa grub mang po'i thugs bcud rma na ngag longs shing /khong gi bshad sgros dang man ngag la bod kyi bsre bslad med ces dus mnyam gyi mkhas pa chen po nyi zla ltar grags pa rnams kyis bsngags pa'i phyir/ man ngag khungs ldan du grub pa kho nas kyang / rgya gzhung gi khungs than thun yod med la rag ma lus la/ de bas kyang ches lhag pa/ khong nyid rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i gnas thob ste/ ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa brnyes/ yi dam lhag pa'i lha zhal gzigs dpal nag po chen po dang / lha mo re ma ti dang / gzhan rje chos kyi rgyal po dang / lang ka'i bdag po la sogs pa/ ches che ba'i lha rnams bran du 'khor la mi dang mi ma yin rnams la las bzhi thogs med du 'grub pa'i sgrub pa po rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug yin pa'i phyir/ khungs gzhan —134—

las 'tshol mi dgos so/ /de ltar na rwa lo chen po de ni/ mkhas pa'i phyogs nas kyang bod /bams kyi dge bzhas thams cad slob mar 'du ba dang / nus/ mthu'i sgo nas rgyal khams thams cad 'dar bar byed pa zhig yin no/ /mal 'brog mi skyo la sogs pa ni/ spyir mkhas grub rmad ru du byung pa yin mod kyang / rwa lo la ltos na ni/ de dag phag phug gi sngags pa chung ngu tsam du zad na/ phyis/ byung ba tha na chos rgyus tsam la yang mi mkhas shing nus pa phra mo tsam yang med pa khyed dag gis/ skyes chen de 'dra/ ba 'gog pa la zhugs pa na/ khyi ltogs rgyags pas seng ge'i gnya' ral la 'ju zhes skye bo rnams la grags pa de kho na ste/ shin tu blun cing chos kyi bsod nams zad pa'i ban+dhe dang mi dpon mang rab kyis las kyi dbang gis khyed dag la bshud pa na/ khyed cag nga rgyal gyis dregs nas bag med du yan te/ glen pa'i rang 'tshang rgyud ma nas rgyud mar ston pa'o/ /rje 'brog gis gshed skor bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus/ sngon mkhas rmongs su la'ang ma grags mod/khyed 'ga' zhig gis bstan 'gyu/ra bltas pa na/ 'jug mdzad kyi sgrub thabs dz+nyā na ka ras mdzad pa de la/ 'gyur byang med par mthong ba na/ 'brog mi'i zhen du bsams nas/ 'di rje 'brog gis bsgyur ro zhes/ mi shes pa rnams kyi mgo bo brdzun gyi skor bar byed do/ /gzhud de legs rab yod kyang bdag po med par 'khyams pas tha na mdzad pa po rang yang cha rgyus su la'ang med de/ dz+nyā na ka ra yin nam/ dz+nyā nā ka ra yin yang bshad rgyu med la/ gzhan yang 'brog gshed skor mi mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan mang du yod do/ /'jigs byed bcu gsum ma rwa lo min pa gzhan la med pa'ang min te/ khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i lugs la'ang shin tu grags che ba dang / gyi jo la sogs pa gzhan la'ang yod par grags pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyos pa la rigs bzhi yum bzhis bskor ba'i lha dgu ma gtogs bcu gsum ma med zer —135—

ba ni/ khyed kyi rje kun bzang bas/ dpe mdzod rnying pa 'dra g.yengs pa na/ slob dpon bsod nams rgyal pos byas pa'i/ gnyos lugs lha dgu'i sgrub thabs de rnyed yod par 'dug /gzhan gnyos lugs kyi yi ge cha tshang ba ma mthong mod/ de ma thag gnyos lugs ni lha dgu kho na yin no snyam nas/yi ge gzhan tshol long dang blta log med par tab tob tu gzhan la 'phya bar zad do/ /gnyos lugs bcu gsum ma ni/ slob dpon dpal seng dang / 'bri phyug pa'i sgrub thabs kyang yod par 'dug cing / rgyal ba lha nang ba'i slob ma/ 'gar chos sdings pa'i sgrub dkyil ni kho bos kyang mthong ngo / /der ma zad gnyos lugs la ro langs brgyad skor yang snang bas bag yod par bya'o/ /yang rwa lo skyes bu bzang zhing bla ma'i man ngag dang ldan du chug kyang / rgya gzhung gi khungs med na yid mi ches so snyam na/ bcu gsum ma la ta rgya gzhung gi khungs kyang gong du bstan pa ltar yin mod/ spyir de ltar 'dod na khyed rang rnams mi tshe hril por sgril ba'i kyi rdor man ngag lugs de ji ltar yin/ rdza'i dos khur nas rdo 'thab ma byed cig /khyed rnams shin tu mi mkhas pa'i steng du/phyogs 'dzin phrag dog gi gdon zhud chen po btab nas spyon pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa 'di la/kho bos snying brtse ba'i bslab ston byas pa yin no/ /bu ston sogs pa mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis/bstan 'gyur gzigs nas sgrub thabs so so la khungs 'tshor ba dang dpyad pa'i sgo mang du byas pa de/khyed rnams la than chen por byung 'dug ste/ de dag gis de ltar byas pa na/ khyed kyi bla ma 'gram chu langs brdabs zhogs 'phrod de bstan 'gyur ci rigs pa bltas pa na/ za zi langs na nyes bshad dang log par bshad pa'i ser ba drag po zad pa med pa khyed slob ma rnams kyi blo gros la bdud du gcer gyis babs pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir smras pa/ la la'i mthong rgya rgyan yin te/ /la la'i mthong rgya byur chags yin/ /mkhas pa mthong rgya che na bzang / /ngor pa'i mthong rgyas rang nyid brlag /ces so/ /ngor pa zin bris kyis —136—

phung ngo zhes/ dus de nyid nas phyogs kun tu grags go /gzhan yang kho bo cag ni/ 'di skad ces/dgra gdong 'jigs gsum phan tshun phyogs mthun gyi rgyud yin yang / dngos po la rtsa bshad kyi rgyud du gnas pa min/ cha mthun yin pa'i phyir/ phan tshun kha skong ba'i rdon du/ bla ma'i man ngag gi sgo nas/ rtsa bshad du sbyor ba'i lugs mang du byung / de yang 'os shing rigs pa yin gyi nor ba ni min zhes smra'o/ khyed rnams ni dgra gdong 'jigs gsum dngos po'i steng nas rtsa bshad kyi rgyud yin par khas blang nas/ phan tshun du kha skong bar 'dod bzhin du/ 'jigs mdzad la nag po'i 'khor mi rung bar 'dod pa ni/ shin tu nang 'gal ba'ang yin no/ /da ni 'di dpyad de/ 'dir mang po zhig 'jigs mdzad kyi sgrub thabs yid bzhin gyi gter mdzod dang / de'i dkyil chog dang / sgrub thabs chung ba bzhi la sogs pa ni/ rwa lo chen po'i gsung du 'dod cing / de la bsams nas dgag pa'ang gtong ba mang mod kyi/ khungs dang ldan pa'i gtam las/ rwa shar ba dkon mchog seng ges mdzad do/ /zhes 'byung ba nyid 'thad de/ rgyu mtshan lar mang mod gcig dpe tsam du smros na/ sgrub dkyil 'di dag tu/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /sogs dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /zhes/ sogs 'byu/nga na/ tshig bcad 'di ni 'brog 'gyur yin gyi rwa 'gyur ma yin no/ /rwa 'gyu/ra las ni/ gsang ga sdo/ma gnas las byung ba yi/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po 'di/ /byin cig sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro /de lta na yang ngag sgros 'khrugs pa re re tsam ma gtogs/ phal cher rwa lo'i man ngag ma nor ba ni yin no/ /de ltar go na'ang mi mang po zhig la skur 'debs dang mun nag che tshad zhig sangs 'gro bar gdog go /dkyil 'khor 'di la sgrub thabs 'byer bde ba kho bos sngar sbyar ba zhig yod na'ang da lta ma rnyed pas/ da ni 'dir sgrubs thabs snying po la 'don pa spos na 'grub ste/ skyabs 'gro —137—

sems bskyed rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren/ phyag mchod/ rgyun bshags/ stom bzung / tshad med bzhi/ stong par sbyang ba/ srung 'khor sgom pa rnams sgrub thabs snying po bzhin bya ba las 'dir chos 'byung gi tshig bor te/ stong pa'i ngang las hūX las sna tshogs zhes sbrel lo //de nas phaṭa swāhā/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du pad zla'i steng du/ saX las kun tu bzang po dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i sdil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ de zhu ba las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ gde/ngas ka gyen du phyogs pa/ de'i nang du paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba la gnas pa'i bhuX las 'khor 'i ) kar po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa bhuX gyis mtshan pa/ de las byung ba'i rnam snang dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag sa'i sa ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung yi/sa pa zhugs shing dar dang rin po ches brgyan nga// de zhu ba las byung ba'i gzhal med khang / gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi pa/ rin po sna lnga las grub pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du/ nag ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du pha gu ser po dang / dra ba dra phyed 'phyang ba/rin po che'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa/ steng mda' yab mchod rten gyi rnam par mdzes pa/ pu shu'i khor yug la gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng ba/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang ba/ dbus kyi gru chad kyi 'og gzhi rdo rje'i gzhi la/ steng du rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ de'i dbus su mi mgo skam po'i ra ba zlum po sgo gcig pa/ phyi nang gi sa gzhi thams cad khrag zhag 'khrug pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis —138—

ming mangs ris su bris pa/ nang re mig dgur gyur pa'i steng phyogs keng rus kyi ka gdung gis phug pa/ g.yas gzhi'i bla bre dang / rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi la sogs pas brgyan pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu 'a mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams dang / sgo bzhi'i thad ka nas ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs rnams kyi rtse mor/ pad+ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang / ri dwags dang / gdugs kyis mtshan pa/ 'khyams la mchod pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o//de'i phyi rol tu gtum drag sogs pa nas/ sna tshogs pas gang ba'o/ /zhes bya'o/ /rwa lugs kyi man ngag rnams la yang dkyil 'khor nang ma ril gyi thod mkhar du byed pa dang / re mig dbus ma'i nang du thod mkhar byed pa lugs gnyis byung ngo / /de gnyis 'dam kha yin yang nang bi dkyil 'khor zlum po rel gyi thod mkhar du byad pa 'di ngos sgom stabs bde bar snang ngo / /'dar ngor pa dag na re thod mkhar las spra khog blang ba ma gtogs/ gsar ba'i rgyud gzhung gi khungs med zer zhing / gzhan mang po zhig kyang de ltar sems par snang mod/ gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa rab zhi ye shes kyis mdzad pa dang / rgya 'grel mdzad byang med pa zhig dang / mnyam sbyor he ru ka'i sgrub thabs 'ga' re na yang yod la/ 'dir rtog bdun snyelas/ dpa' bo'i gnas la gnas pas zhes dang / dkyil zhakhorwar gyi grwar khrag gis chag chag gdab ces gsungs pas gsal bar bstan cing /zhang 'gyur ltar na/ thod pa brtsegs pa'i rtse mo mthon po 'jigs su rung ba/ zhes pas kyang bstan to/ kho bos ni ma mthong yang dam pa 'ga' zhig gis gzigs pa/ lī la badz+ra gyi dkyil chog las kyang / zlum po re mig dgu pa ste/ /thod pa skam rlon 'phreng gis brgyan/ /zhes yod par grags so/ /yang khyed spra khog blang ba zhes pa khro bo rnam rgyal gyi rgyud la zer na ni/ de las ni thod mkhar ston byed —139

kyi tshig ye med na/ khyed kyi mnal lam la byung ba lags sam ci/ yod pa dag mi mthong la med pa dag rma/thong a re re zhes bya'o/ /dbus kyi re mig tu/ rlung gi dkyi(pa 'khor la mi ro mgo dang rkang lag bral ba/ de'i steng du paX las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa dang / re mis/ brgyad la/ shar du mgo bo/ lhor lag pa gnyis/ nub tu rgyu ma/ byang du rkang pa gnyis/ shar lhor thod pa/ lho nub tu thod tshal/ nub byang du ro ras/ byang shar du skyes bu gsal shing gis phug pa'o/ /de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du pa da zla/ lhor pad nyi/ nub tu pad ma'i steng du nyi ma 'od dang bral ba/ byang du pad+ma la rlung dkyil/ mtshams bzhir pad zla'i gdan/ shar gyi lha snam/ la// sgo'i g.yas su gri gug /'phang thung / ga stun shing / g.yon du chu gri/ka ṇa ya / lca gas kyu/ lho'i lha snam la/ g.yas su sta re/ mda'/ kha ṭāX ga/g.yon du dbyug pa/ 'khor lo/ zhags pa/ nub kyi lha snam la/ g.yas su rdo rje/ cang te r+sā phub/ g.yon du gzhu/ dril bu/ rlung ras/ byang sgo'i g.yas su sdigs 'dzub/ 'phan rtse gsum pa/ glang lpags/ g.yon du tho ba/ mdung / me thab bo//shar sgor tho ba/ lho sgor dbyug pa/ nub sgor pad+ma/ byang sgor ral gri rnams nyal thabs su gnas pa bzhi po de'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/ grwa bzhir/ro langs nag po mgo gsum/ lag pa gsum/ rkang pa gsum gar byed pa'am/phyag gnyis g.yas thal mo 'phyar zhing / g.yon thugs kar thal mo byed pa bsgoms kyang rung ngo / /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ a las zla ba la dhīXlas ral gri zhes pa nas/ rtse dgu pa/ rwa gdengs pa/ 'od 'bar ba/ lte ba la huX gis mtshan par gyur/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa zhes pa nas/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri —140—

—— snye———ga———————rde ——— rde——spre——— gug ga nge/ngas shing / thod pa khrag gis gang pa thugs ka'i thad kar 8re jin tsang sa yum la khudzi cu/da pa/ g.yas lhag ma zhes pa nas/ ye shes sems nga/pa' 'jam/ dpal gzhon nu/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ rdorje rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la hu nag po 'od zer 'bar ba'o/ /zhes so / /rwa lu gas la ga ji5sa sa yan gyi /sgal drug po rwa zhal du bzhed pa dang / brtsegs zhal du bzhed nga dang / 'dam khar bzhed pa sa su ma yo da pa/ spyir 'dam kha yin mod kyang / rwa lo chen po'i spra pre byed pa rwa zhal gtso che'o / /bcom ‘skrom/ 'das de'i sku la 'byud pa'i yum khro mo'i nga/bang phyus rdo/ rje ro langs ma/ gcer bu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcis phyag gnyis/ g.yas gri gur 'phyar zhing /g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas/ snye sna khyud pa/ khro sgeg lang tsho 'argya bab cing / dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ phyas/ rgya ‘sngo dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ thod pa skam po'i dbu rgyan dang / do sha' can// 'bas sa yon bskum/ g.ya sa/ brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bcom ldan 'das dang mnyam par sbyor rtse bsna /de ya na chad ni rla pa 'byor bzhi'i dbang du byas nas/ rnal 'byor dang po dang rje ru/ su rlal 'byorna ra yin yang nag ce1'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rnal 'byor dang po gnyis ji lta ba ba'i na/ 'di la 'grig dka' bas tsā rnying 'dzin gsum dang sbyar nas/ de yan chad dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge ‘re dzin du bya la/ lugs 'di 'a mkha' nang nas dkyil 'khore spro dgos pa'i phyir/ 'jigs mdzad yab yum/ kha sbyo ra gyi sku can nges par bsgom dgos la/ kha cig yum can bris sku la brir mi drang zer ba tom tshol tsam yin pas/ ྈnga gang la yi dam du byed pa de nyid brir rung zhing / khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i yin thang la yang yu ma ca 'a du bris yod la/ 'on kyang lugs de la yum rdo rje phag mo dmar rmo yin zhing / 'jirngo ro langs ma nag cho phyag gnyis pa mdzad pa ni/ gdong drug dang rjes su mthun pa yin no/ /ji5ba kyi gsang gnas mi —141—

nga/migs/ te stong pa'i ngang las/ huX las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa huX gis mtshan pa dang / yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ āXlas pad+ma dmar po ze 'bru/ la āXs mtshan pa/ gnyis pa'i bu ga phaṭa yig gis bkag pa'o/ /yab yum snoms par 'jug pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems nga/pa' thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ srog dag pa'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa thig le bcu bdun du gyur/ de rnams lha so so'i sa bon du gyur/ dbus su ya las rdo rje yas mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed nas/ mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ 'dir yum ma bskyed kyang chog /bskyed par spro na bcom ldan 'das de'i sogs gong bawo bya/ shar du snye las 'khor lo snyes mtshan pa las/ gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug sis/ dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang snang gi yum la 'khyud ji// lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lho ra ma las rin po che mas mtshan pa las/ phra ma gshin rje gshed ser po ser nag da/kar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug /dang po gnyis gong dang 'dra/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub tu me yig las pad+ma me yig gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las / 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po/ dmar nag dkar ba'i: phyag dang po gnyis 'dra/ g.yas gnyis kyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang nor bu/ byang du da yig las ral gri da yig gis —/42—

mchan pa:yongs su gyur pa las/ phragang/ga gshin rje khen snyeg cha khe gshed ji/nga khu / / snang nas dkar ba'i lhag ma g.yas 'ganyam kyis ra 'a gri dang 'khore lo/ g.yon gnyis/ kyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ shar ljor ja 'a/sa 'bor lo jas mtshan pa las rdo rje tsartsi kwa dkar mo/ dkar nag dmar ba sogs gti mug gzhan rje gshed dang 'dra ba las/ gri gug dang thod nga/ 'dzin pas rang gi thabs la 'khyu nga/ pa/zhes brjod/ lha mo gzhan gsum la'ang phyas dang po gnyis rigs 'gre'o/ / lho nub tu sa las rdo rjes sas mchan pa las/ rdo rje phag mo sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum rtsa zhal gyi steng du phag gdong can/ g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ra 'a gri/g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma/ nub byang du do las pad+ma do yig gis mtshan rnga / las/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma dmar mo dmar nag /sogs 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dang 'dra/ byang shar du ru las ral gri ru yig gis mtshan pa las/ bo ri ljang khu sogs phrag dog gshin rje gshed dang / de dag gi phyi ngos shar phyogs su ya las tho ba yas mtshan pa las/ tho ba gshi/na rje gshe/da nag dkar dmar/ sos sa/rig ma dang mnyam par spyor ba/ g.yas gnyis na tho ba rwa nyi shu pa dang ral gri/g.yo na gnyis na nor bu dang pad+ma/ lhor tsa la dbyug pa tsa yig gis mtshan pa las/ dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i/ sogs/g.yas gnyis na dbyug pa dang ral gri g.yon gnyis na 'khore lo dang pad+ma/nub tu ni las pad+ma ni yig gis mtshan pa las/ pad+ma gshi/na rje gshe/da dmar po sogs 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dang 'dra/ byang du ra las ral gri ra yig this mtshan pa las/ ral gri gshi/na rje gshe/da ljang khu sogs phrag dog gshin rje gshed ngang —143—

'dra/ lte mo bzhi rnams ma drod phyir thogs spangs shing bud med kyi mawo nyid can// khro bo brgyad se ral kha dang bcas pa/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum mche gtsigs dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ stag lpags dang mgo 'phreng du rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ cha byad tham sa cad bcom/ ldan 'das yab yum dang mtshungs shing / gti mug gshin rje gshed dang lha mo bzhi zla ba'i 'od can dang / gzhan rnams nyi ma'i 'od can/tham/sa cad kyang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / mtshams bzhir/ṇa yo ni ra rnams las thod pa khrag gis gang ri ba bzhi po rnams kyang 'khod par gyur/ mngon rtogs yid bzhin gter mdzod na/ thod pa bzhi'i gsal kha med kyang / bcu gsum ma'i phyogs la nges par dgos so/ /oX hṝXsgyiXbi kri tā na na huX phaṭa/ mkha' nang gi gtso bo yab yum dang/ga tu med pa spros/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtso bo dang bcas pa'i ba skru'i bu ga nas phyir byung / mkha' dbyings thams cad yongs su gang bar byas/sems ca myo thams cad kyi don mdzad cing / khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa zhe sdang sbyangs/ zhe sdang gshin rje sa/sheng po rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i go 'phang 'a bkod/ tshur 'dus gcig tu 'dres/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang nying kyi thugs kar thim/ bde stong gnyis su med pa sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid du gyur/ oX dze na dzika huX phaṭa/ mkha' nang gi la /ti mug gnyen rje gshed dpag tu med pa spros/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtso bo dang bcas pa'i ba sbu'i bu ga nas phyir ci byung / rma kha' dbyings tham sa cad yongs su gang bar byas/ sems can tham sa cad kyi don rma dzad cing / /byad nga ra du yang sa/ti mug sbyangs/ gti mug —14lha/—

gshi/na rje gshe/da kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus gcig tu 'dres/ shar gyi re mig tu pad zla'i gdan la 'khode par gyur/ oX rat+na khu dha ka huX phaṭa/ phra ma gshin rje gshed5 khyad par du nyon cho/ngas nga/ nga rgyal dang ser sna: phra ma gzhin rje gshe/da kyis/ po re mig tu pad nyi la: lkoX a ro lika huX phaṭa/ 'dod chags gshin rje bshed nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi rnam rtog 'dod chags gzhin rje gshed kyi: nub kyi reg mig/ tu pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma 'od dang bral ba'i gdam/ la: oṃ prarnyo lha ka huX phaṭa/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed: nyon mongs pa phrag dog gi nyes pa: phrag dog gzhan rje gshed kyi: byang gi re mig tu pad+ma dang rlung dkyil gyi gdan la oṃ mo hā ra ti hū ཾ ༷ phaṭa/ lha mo rdo rje ca rtsi kā: khyad nga/ra du sa'i khams sbyangs/ byams pa chen po la bkod/ shar lho'i re mig tu pad zla'i gdan la 'khod: oṃ dre ṣa ra ti huX phaṭa/ lha mo rdo rje phag mo chu'i khams snying rje chen po: lho nub kyi reg mig gi pad zla oX rā gar ti huX phaṭa/ lha mo rdo rje dbyangs can: me'i khams: dga' ba chen ngo/: nub byang gi re mig tu pang zla:oṃ badz+ra ra tī huX phaṭa/ lha mo rdo rje go rī: rlung gi khams: btang snyoms chen po:byang shar gyi re mig tu pad zla: oṃ mud ga ra dhika hūX phaṭa/ tho ba gshin rje gshed phung po/'i bdud bcom/ dad pa'i stobs la bkod/ shar sgor pad nyi'i gdan la 'khode par gyur/ oṃ daṇ+ḍa dhika huX phaṭa/ dbyug pa gshi/na rje gshe/da:nyon mongs pa'i bdud: brtson 'grus kyi stobs: lho sgor pad nyi: oṃ pad+ma dhika huX phaṭa/ pad+ma gshi/na rje gshe/da: 'chi bdag gi bdud: dran pa'i stobs: nub sgor pad nyi: oṃ khad ga dhika huX phaṭa/ ral gri gshin rje gshed lha'i bu'i —145—

bdud ting nge 'jin gyi sto bas dkyil ge ngor chen ngo/'i byang sgor pad nyi la 'jordo rnga ra gyur/ oX u yiXhuX/ lan bzhi/ thod pa bzhi gdan dang bcas pa khyad par du yul drug gi dri ma/ sbyangs/ mngon nga/ra shes pa drug la bkod/ lha snam kyi grwa bzhi la/ rdo rje ro langs bzhi'i mdun du pad+ma'i gdan re re la 'khod par gyur/ tshwar yid bzhin gter mdzod las/ ma/kha' nang du gtso bo mi skyed par/ phyi dkyil gyi gtso bo spro bsdu byas pa rni/ gsung bgros 'chugs pa'i don la nor ba yin la/ mkha' nang du thog mar sa zhal yas lang mi skyed pa 'i lu sas su byas/ kyang / sgo skyong bzhi skyed pa'i skabs su/ shar sgor zhes jo sas smros pa ni yi rge 'byugs nga/ra gsal lo/ /spyir ma/kha' nang du gzhal yang khang skyed cing spro nga pa 'gal ba med mod kyi/ cung zad bsdus kra 'i nga bang du byas te ga 'al yas khang mi bskyed pa nyid rang lugs so// /sgrub thabs de las/ sgo sna bcu gsum rme/ gtogs thod pa bzhi med na'ang / yi ge bcu bdun gyi nges/ pas thod pa bzhi dgos shing / nges par de mi byed na/ ro langs bzhi thog mar mi bskyed pa skabs 'dir ṇa yo rne ra la sa skyed de dbyung dgos so/ /lha thams cad kyi rmi ga tu snyiX las 'khor lo khriX gis mtshan pa 'a sa sa'i snying po/ gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu/ rna bar dziX las rdo rje dziX gis mchan pa las/ phyag na rdo rje steng zhal spangs pa'i rdo rje phag mo lta bu/ snar khe las rin po ches khaX gis mtshan pa las/ nam mkha'i snying ngo/ phra ma gshin rje gsheng/ lta bu/ lce la gaX las pad+ma kaX gis mtshan pa las/ spyan ras gzigs 'dod chags gshi/na rje gde/da lta bu/ dpral bar skaX las ral gri skaX gis mtshan pa las/ sgrib pa rnam sel phrag dog ga sdo/na rje gshe/da lta bu/ lte bar saX las rdo rje saX gis mtshan pa las/ kun tu bzang ngo/ dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug phyag mchan rdo rje phag mo —146—

lta bu'o/ /spyi bor oX las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ sku rdo rje gti mug gshi/na rje gshe/da lta bu/ mgrin par āXlas pad+ma āXs mtshan pa las/ gsung rdo rje 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu/ thugs kar stoX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa las/ thugs rdo rje steng zhal spangs pa'i rdo rje phag mo lha bu ste skye mched drug dang rdo rje gsum ste/ lha dgu po rnams kyi thugs kar yang / rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa'o/ /de nas dbang bskur ba ngang / ye shes pa gzhug pa bsdus pa ltar na/mngon rtogs snying por bshad pa bzhin bya/ cung zad spros pa la mos na / rang si snying ga'i tingatshonge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po lha bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX oX badz+ra pur+sha nas/ nai wi te āXhuX/oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra dzaX oX badz+ra daṇ+ḍa huX/ oṃ badz+ra pad+ma baX/ oṃ badz+ra khat+pa hoX yang riX las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / khro bo'i rgyal po rnams rang rang gi rigs kyi btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ dbang gi don du badz+ra sa mā dzaX.ar+ghaX nas shabha 'a bar gyis rma/chod/ sangs rgyas rnams la rdor 'chang gis/ /dbang bskur bzhin du 'gro ba rnams/ /bsgral phyir yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /de bzhin bdag la gnang ba zhu/ /tseX( a bhi bta do〉 tu maX sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gso la ba btab nga/sa dbang bi lha rngams kyes/ gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po 'di/ /byin cig sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams —147—

kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol cig /oṃ/ sarba ta thā ga a bhi ṣe ka ya sa ma/ ya shri huX/ zhes gsungs shing / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur/ tsar ci kā la sogs pas rdo rje'i glu len/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas yang dag par mchod/gur gum 'a/ sogs pa me tog gi char dang / rnga bo che la sogs pa rol mo'i sgra bsgrags te dbang bskur bas/ lha rnams kyi sku lus bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis khyab ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang spyi bo nas zhus sa/ bad/ga nyid sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byas/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ gti mug rdo rje tsar tsi kā/ /tho ba gshin rje gshed rnams la rnam snang / ser sna rdo rje/ phag mo dbyug pa gshin rje gshed rnams la rin 'byung / 'dod chas sa jo rje/ dbyangs can ma/ pad+ma gshin rje gshed rnams la snang mtha'/ phrag dog rdo rje/ go rī/ ral gri gshin rje gsheng rnams la don yod grub pas dbu ba smyen/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ bāka dang / tsit+ta la yang sbyar/ de rjes rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas gams gsum du gtugs pa nas/ bstod pa'i nga rgyal gzung ba'i bar snying po bzhin bya la/ de nas/ mi thung sgeg po sogs kyis bstod par 'dod kyang / nges par dgos pa min 'a / 'khor gyi bstod pa ni/ gti mus/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin byo/ da/ /sogs blo/ ka bzhi dang / ཿnga bzhi rnam dag tshad med bzhi/ /'phrin las bzhi lda na sku bzhir ldan/ /'gya tshong bag lda na pa lha yi tshogs//brnyes mdzad yum bzhi'i sku la 'dung/ /bdud bzhi sgrib pa bzhi sbyong zhing / /lta ba bzhi las rnal gro' ba/ /dgug 'dzin 'ching sdom gzir byed pa/ /sgo skyong —148—

bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstorwa da/ /ces pa rnams kha bskang / tseX(āXhūṃ tseX(sarba nas/ dgeb debyang chub tu bsngo ba'i bar 'dra ba las/ gzhal yas khang la thim/ de 'od du zhu/ lha rnams la thim/ 'khor bcu gnyis po dang yum yang rang nyid la thim/ zhes brjod/bdud rtsi myang ba yan chad dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog yin la/ las rgyal mchog ni gdong drug gi skabs su bsad pa dang 'dra'o/ /la bor gyi bzlas pa byed par spro na yum la/ tseX( badz+ra be+e ta lī ā ga smo ā ga smo hūX dza swāhā/ zhes pa dang / 'khor gyi 'byin sngags rnams bzla'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga yang / sgrub thabs snying por bshad pa de kho nas chog pa las/ blta bar mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid/ gti mug gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i 'khor gyis bstor par gyur/ ces dang / mi bskyod pa dang / 'khor rngams la/ gtso bo nyid kyis nga bu brgyan/ ces 'don pa spo/ lha so so la gtor sngags logs par dgos pa ni min/ byed par spro na re re'i sngags kyi mthar/ sarba ba smin sogs btags pas 'bul/ spros pa la dga' na/ dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par skem/ zhes pa'i rjes su mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ mchod bstod rgyas bsdus ji lha ra 'os pa/ dkyil chog dang drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor chog (pas drangs te byas kyang mi rung ba med do/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i ris/sa la/ rgya sa zhung gnyis na dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang lha'i gdan dang bcas pa dgra nag ji bzhin du mjad do/ /de las pad+ma srung ba'i lu/ gas 'di la'ang re mig dgu dang phyag ma/tshan 'god pa byas na legs te/ gzhan du na 'di rtog bdun gyi rjes 'brang yin pa la rtog bdun nyid las bshad pa dang cung zang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /ting nge 'dzin cho ga'i rim pa la/ be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta'i de 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skabs zhal gsum phyag drug rtsa zhal ma he'i zhal can du byed pa dang / dkyil 'khor rgya' mchog gi rme kha' nang gi gtso bo zhal dgu pa bsgoms nas/ de spros te rang la bsdim pas rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed —149—

phyag mang du 'gyur bar bzhed/ rgyu rdor 'dzin gyi skabs rnams ma gtogs/ gzhan cho ga thams cad dgra nag bcu gsum ma sgra ji bzhin yin pas 'di ni lha 'jigs mdzad yin pa kho na las rtog bdun dang bstun pa ma yin pas re mig dang phyag mtshan med par dgra nag kho na ltar byas na de'i lugs yin pas skyon med do// ka ma la rak+ṣi ta'i de yang phal cher de dang 'dra ba las glus bskul lhag por yod gzhan rgyu'i 'jam dpal las 'bras bu rdo rje 'jigs byed du bskyed pa'i bar rtog bdun dang bstun/ de man chad dgra nag nas kha bskang ba yin pas rwa ba'i lugs 'di dang mthun shas che'o/ /rgya mkhar bka' bcu pa sogs la cig bcu gsum ma la gzhal yas khang dang 'kho/ra tshos ru dgra nag kho na dang ma bstun na khungs med par 'gyur bas/ nges par mthun dgos/ de'i tshe phyag mtshan 'gog pa mi dgos shing / grwa bzhir ro langs kyang mi dgos zhes zer zhing / rwa lugs 'gog ste 'di skad ces/ mgo bo la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi ste/ slar lha 'god pa mi rigs te/mgo bo la sogs pa 'god pa ni/ phyag mtshan de dang de 'dzin pa'i lha mgod pa'i don yin gyi/ gti mug gshin rje gshed 'a sogs pa bkod nas/ mgo bo sogs yod don med de/ de dag lha mtshan yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes sems kyang smra'o/ /'di ni gsang sngags spyi 'gros la bsgom rgyu phyag mtshan de dag 'dzin pa'i lha yin yang / bri ba'i dkyil 'khor la phyag mtshan tsa dru / 'bri ba'i spyir gtang tsam phyogs mthong go yang / rgyud sde 'og ma mang po dang mnyam sbyor sogs bla med la ya nga / phyag mtshan kho nas lha'i go chod nga/'i gnas skabs mang du yod pa dang / khyad par gshin rje gshed la phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor rtsal du 'a ngon nga/'i skabs rma nga du yod pa'i/ rang lugs kyi dmigs bsal rnams mgo ba'i skyon te/ rgyud las/ 'khor spo'i dbus su phyag rgya'i mchang rma 'o/ /zhes gsungs/ phyag rgya chi phyag rgya chen po ste/ lha nyid yin la/ rme tshan ma ni gtso bo'i phyag mtshan te/ phyag mtshan nyid lha sku phyag rgya chen po'o/ /zhes pa'i don yin mo /g.yin phal cher du yang / lha rmams kyi phyag mtshan lha'i —150

ngo bo tsam yin mod de/ lnga sku phyag rgya chen po ni zhal phyag gi rnam nga/ can kho na la zer ba mang yang /'dir phyag mtshan nyid lha sku phyag rgya chen ngo/ yin par stan snye8 / gzhan du na gzhan rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya'i lha tshogs rnams la/ de dag phyag tu 'dzin pa'i lha gzhan gang zhig skyed bsam dgos so/ /gzhan yang 'jigs byed la mgo bo sogs phyag mtshan bkod nga/ ni/ zhe dgu ma'i dkyil 'khor kho na'i dbang du byas pa yin/ ro langs brgyad bskor ni phyag mtshan med pa'i dkyil 'khor gzhan yin la/ bcu gsum ma ni de gnyis ka ma yin par/ /'i bor tshogs rngams dgra nag nas kha bskang phyin/ lha'i gdan sogs kyang dgra nag kho na dang bstun dgos shing / de'i yang gzhung dag shos dpal 'dzin gyi gzhung yin/ gzhan rnam sa la ni yid brtan mi thub po snyam du sems par 'dug na/ 'di ni dgra nag dang phyogs mtshungs pa yin gyi/ dgra nag ji lta ba yin par rma/ nges mod/gal te 'khor tshogs nag po'i rgyud ji bzhin du byed pa yin du bcug nas/ de yin na/ gdan yang de kho na las gzhan du 'khyom gas par mi rung na/ bzhugs gnas gzha' yas khang yang de kho na lta ra byed dgos par 'gyur bas/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma la re mig dgu med par/ dbus kyi lha dgu sna tshogs rdo rje la mgod dgos par 'gyur zhing / yang na 'jigs byed la re mi ga dgu yod pa ltar/ nag po la yang re mig dgu pa byed dgos par thal bar 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma srung ba dang / rnam snang srung ba 'jigs byed la yang gdan sna tshogs rdo rje 'dod cing / zhang lugs pa rnams dgra nag la yang re mig dgu 'dod mod kyi/ khyed ni de lta bu nam yang mi 'dod pas so/ /rgyud las dbus kyi re mig la mgo bo sogs 'god par bshad kyi/ gti mug sogs ma gsungs la/ der mgo bo sogs ma bkod na/ rgyud las gsungs pa chad pa'i skyon du 'gyur zhing / rgyud las gsungs pa ma chad pa'i steng du/ grub thob rgyun ma chad pa'i man ngag gi lhag po snon pa mi 'gal yang / rang gi rgyud nas gsungs nges shes pa chad nas/ ma bshad pa'i lhag po'i kha skong gis ci zhig bya/ de bzhin du —151—

khyed kyi lugs la gzhal yang khang rtog bdun gyi rgyud dang mthun par bsgom na ni lha snam yod cing phyag mtshan yang 'god dgos so/ /lha snam la don kyang gri gug sogs zhe dgu'i skabs yin gyi gzhan la mi dgos snyam na/ lha snam stong pa'i 'khor yug gi ci zhig bya/ dpa' bo gcig pa lta bu lha gcig yin na ma gtogs/ lha tshogs rnams dbus su spungs/ 'khor sa stong par bzhag pa shin tu mi mdzes pas so/ /gal te lha snam la gri gug sogs 'god na/ re mig la mgo sogs ma bkod pas/ rgyud las gsungs pa'i phyag mtshan tshang ba mi 'god par tho re long nge ba bkod par 'gyur bas/ la la 'god la/ la la mi 'god pa rang bzo kho nar 'gyur ro/ khyu mtshan de'i phyir na/ phyag mtshan mi dgod cing / re mig dgu pa byas pa 'di ni dgra nag lugs kyi gzhal yas khang yang ma yin la/ rtog bdun lugs kyang ma yin pa'i 'dra men bong lto yin no/ /des na rang lugs ni/ slob dpon so so'i 'dod tshul gyi rjes ma ded/ man ngag yin zer ba la skyabs su ma song bar/ rtog bdun gyi rtog pa dang po'i dkyil 'khor bri ba'i skabs su gsungs pa'i sgra don ji lta ba'i dngos bstan gyi dkyil 'khor ni gcig kho na yin te/ dkyil 'khor gnyis pa ston pa'i tshig cung zad kyang med pas so/ /des na re mig dgu dang lha snam dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ dngos su bshad pa'i phyag mtshan so gnyis 'god/ ro langs brgyad kyang dkyil 'khor de kho na la 'god de/ dngos su bzhad pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di kho na yin/ ro langs dang mi ro 'dam kha'am don gcig par ga the ne nu zla bas bshad pa sogs kyang 'gal ba med la/ gang ltar na'ang zhe dgu ma dang / lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor kun rtog bdun kho na la brten pas na 'di skabs kyang rgyud dang ma 'gal ba dgos shing / bcu gsum yang rtog bdun gyi rjes 'brang du byed na/ sngar bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi steng du/ lhag po snod kha rgyab na dag par 'gyur gyi/ rtog bdun gyi rjes 'brang du rlom bzhin du rtog bdun dang 'gal na cir yang mi rung ngo / /ci ste gzhan du na gtso bo kho na 'phos pa ma —152—

gtogs nag po'i dkyil 'khor bzhin du byas te/ re mig dgu med par sna tshogs rdo rje de tshe b.rad na rgyud g.yin gyi cho gas bsgrubs pas lugs su 'gyur la/ de 'dra ni rtog bdun gyi dgongs pa min yang man ngag dang ldan na spyi tsam nas mi 'gal lo/ /des na 'dir rwa ba'i bzhed pas/ re'i mig phyag mtshan rgyud nas gsungs pa ltar ma chad pa'i steng du/ nag po nas 'byung ba dang mthun par rigs lnga yum bzhi bkod/ ro langs chen po brgyad ni/ rgyud las ro langs zhes pa tsam ma gtogs gsal kha med pas/ lugs gcig la lha'i gdan du 'chad pa dang / de dang brtun pa'i man ngag zab mo yang yod cing / yang ro langs zhes pa ro langs kyi lha la 'chad pa shas che bas de'i lugs kyang yod pa/ rgyud kyi rdo rje'i tshigs gcig la bshad rgyud kyis bkral ba'am grub thob kyi man ngag dang ldan na/ don gyi rnam grangs du ma 'gal med du 'gyung bas/ bshad tshul gnyis ka rnam grangs mi 'dra ba tsam ma gtogs 'gal ba ma yin la/ skabs 'dir ro langs kyi lha'i dbang du byas te/bcu gsum ma'i skabs dang sbyor na/ lha de yang 'das ma 'das gnyis su 'gyur ba las/ ma 'dasapa bzhi ni zur du 'god la/ 'das pa ni tho ba gshin rje gshed la sogs pa bzhi ste/ skabs 'dir 'di dag ro langs kyi dngos grub stsol ba po'i lha yin pas/ ro langs nyid yin gyi ro langs kyi dod tsam ma yin no/ /de'i phyir zhal phyag gi rnam pa can gyi lha'i sku la/ lha zhes kun la thun mong du grags shing / phyag mtshan ni lha yin par gsang sngags pa nang phan tshun du ci rigs par grags mod kyang / kun la thun mong du ma grags pa dang / yang rims kyi bdag po'i ro langs kyang zhal phyag can yin mod/ ye shes lha rnams dang dod ma snyoms pas 'jig rten grags pa'i dbang du byas nas dngos su 'das pa'i lha bcu gsum yod pas lha bcu gsum ma zhes brjod do/ /gshin rje mo brgyad skor yang ro langs kyi lha nyid yin pa'i phyir/ ro langs brgyad skor nyid yin wo / rgyud las/ ro langs zhes pa ma gtogs pho mo'i dbye ba ma gsungs pas/ gnyis ka 'byung du rung ngo / /—153—

gzhan yang rgya mkhar ba sogs rwa lugs bcu gsum ma la 'dod chags rdo rje'i gdan nyi ma 'od dang bral ba dang / phrag dog rdo rje'i gdan rlung dkyil sogs dgra nag la med pas ma dag zer ba yang / man ngag mi shes pa'i gtam ste/ 'dir zugad pa'i 'khor gyi lha bcu gnyis po rnams ni/nag po'i rgyud las 'byung ba dang phal cher 'dra ba'i dbang du byas nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la dgra nag gi 'khor gyis bskor ba zhes go bde ba'i tshig nyung ngur brjod pa yin gyi/ don la 'khor bcu gnyis po rnams rtog bdun las ma bshad kyang 'jigs mdzad nyid kyi 'khor yin pas/ dgra nag las blangs pa kho na rang yang min no/ /'phags yul du bcu gsum ma thog mar byed pa po'i grub thob rnams kyis kyang / 'jigs mdzad chen po'i 'khor de ltar 'dug par mngon sum gyis gzigs pa'am/ rgyud rgyas pa mkha' 'gro'i phyas na bzhugs pa rnams kyi don rtogs nas gsungs pa'am/lngag pa'i lhas 'khe(ra rnams zhal phyag 'di dang 'di lta bu sgoms shig ces/ lung bstan pa la brten nas brtsams pa yin gyi/ khyed rnams kyi go yul ltar na/ 'jigs byed mkhan po sngar rtog bdun lag na yod pa cig gis/ phyis dgra nag gi rgyud rnyed pa na/ sngar 'jigs byed 'khor gyis 'phongs nas/ khas ma chad pa zhig pa yod pa de skabs der srog stor ba rnyed pa bzhin/ 'di snyam du dgra nag 'di rgyud khungs ma yin par 'dug nga/sa/ de'i 'khor rnams 'dir sbyar na shin tu 'dzem mo snyam ste bcu gsum ma brtsams pa lta bu'i go ba cig shar 'dug ste de 'dra ga la yin/ yang der ma zad yi dam mam grub thob cig gis slob ma la ston pa na/ rtog bdun gyi sgrub thabs 'chad 'phro la/ dgra nag gi rgyud dpe la 'dzub mo btsugs nas/ 'di'i 'khor rnams 'di nas yong ba lags so zer gyin/ lung 'dren nar tsam nar tsam byed pa'i go ba cig kyang khyed rnams la shar 'dug ste/ so so skye bo phal ba'i rgyas 'gebs 'phags pa la byed pa 'di ga skyon che bar gda' 'o/ /yang zhal gzigs dang lung bstan dang / rgyud rgyas pa la brten pa sogs la dpal 'dzin gyi lugs kyi dgra nag ji —154—

bzhin du yong ba'i rgyu tsho mtshan med cing / ci ste dgra nag gi rgyud las gsungs pa yin du chug kyang /dpal 'dzin gyi rjes 'brangs ma yin pa rnams la/ dpal 'dzin gyi gzhung kho nas zhus dag byed pa ni/ blo gros kyi 'jug pa gu dog pa las kyang ches dog pa'i u tshugs thabs rdugs su song / des na 'dir dpal 'dzin mi bzhed pa'i gdan gyi khyad par mi 'dra ba de ga dang phag mo'i phag zhal steng snyen la du byed pa dang / dpal 'dzin 'dod pa'i tsar tsi kā skem khros dang / dbyangs/ can ma zhi ba dang /ral gri gshin rje gshed ljang nag sogs mi byed par thams cad kyang nyams mtshungs par byed pa sogs 'di nyid kyi rang lugs yin pas/ lugs gzhan gyi zhus dag ga la dgos/ dper myo pad+ma srung ba dang / rnam snang srung ba gnyis kas/ phag mo ser mo bshad pa'ang / dgra nag gi rgyud dang mi mthun mod/ de gnyis kyis dgra nag gi rgyud gzhung ma mthong bar/ dgra nag dang 'dra ba rtsom ma shes pa ga la yin/ de rnams nyid kyi rang lugs yin no zhes go dgos so/ /da ni 'di ltar/ 'di la dag spyor ni/ bla ma snga rabs pa rnams kyis gsal bar ba thad pa med la/ bar skabs pa rnams 'di ltar 8sna chad de gzhal yang khang bskyed pa man chad spyi dang 'dra/rgyu'i 'jam dpal nas 'bras bu 'jigs byed du bzhengs pa'i bar gyis bar rdo dang rma/ngal gyi gnas skabs sbyong zhing / sku'i dag sbyor gyis mngal gyi gnas skabs 'phel ba sbyor tshul yang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs spyi dang mtshungs/ sems dpa' gsum sems kyi mthu rdzogs pa dang /mkha' gsang byin rlabs ni bsde ba rdzogs pa dang / sangs rgyas rngams zhal du 'jug pa ni khams kyi 'phel sna grab dang / 'khor gyi bar dor sbyong / snyen bor tshogs spro ba rni rigs rgyud spro ba dang / spro bsdu ni de rnams nyid kyi mngal gyi gnas skabs dang / skye mched byin rlabs ma na chang zhebs lugs dang mthun rung sngar ltar 'dod mod/ sems dpa' gsum/ brtseg man chad nag po'i skabs rang lugs bshad pa ltar sbyar na legs so snyam mo/ /de la rwa pa rnams las rab 'byams sgrub pa la rno zhing —155—

myur ba dang / ro langs sogs kyi dngos grub la ro langs kyis bskor ba nyid rno zhing zab la/ rgyud las gsungs tshod kyi rtsa dkyil yang ro langs brgyad bskor yin mod/ dang por smin byed kyi dbang dang / rab gnas chen cho/ sogs 'jigs mdzad nyid la brten nas sgrub phyin/ bcu gsum ma nyid dge zhing bkra sdo/sa la/ rgyud smin tshabs che ba yin zhes 'di la gtso bor mdzad la/ bar skabs kyi rwa pa rnam sa chos sgri sa/sa la'ang bcu gsum ma gtso bor mdzad cing / dag sbyor rgya che ba'i phyir/mchog skrub pa la'ang 'di zab ces rdo rje 'jigs byed nyid kyi rtsa dkyil rang yin pa lta bur lag le na ci la 'debs rgyu'i gtso bo bcu gsum ma/ la mdzad pa shas che zhing / don la gnas pa la yang rgyud kyis bstan tshod kyi rtsa dkyil rang ni min yang da lta'i bar du byin rlabs kyi 'jug sbo chen po dang ldan pa /zhig rga /ngor ba rnams dge ldan pa'i bcu gsum ma la tshig pa zos pas rwa lo cwa ba la skur pa 'debs pa ni/ sbrang bu bsad par 'dod pas pha'i klad skor rdo bas bcom pa'i dpe dang 'dra'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor la/ man ngag sna re dang bshad sgros sna re tsam shin tu legs pa sa/zhan ci rigs yod srid kyang / byin rlabs kyis bka' babs dang lag len 'gran zla med pa rwa lugs yin la/ rwa lu gas la mos shing dkyil 'khor yang rgyas par bsgom pa ra 'dod na/ dkyil 'khor 'di la 'jug par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir blor ma chug nga 'am/ dbang ni ma thob bsdus pas yid ma tshim pa'am ga(zhan la ngoms pa'i phyir rgyas pa dgos pa byung na/ rkangs de rwa lugs la bcol nas bdag bskyed la yang ga(nal yas khang rgyas pa la ro langs brgyad dang / phyag mtshan 'god pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa byed cing / u nyi ṣa rwa lugs sogs kyang sgrub thabs kyi nang du 'debs pa dag yod de/ de dag ni bsre bslad yin pa'i phyir mi bya ste/ uṣ+ṭha ṣa sogs thun mtshams su bsgom par bya yi/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi cho ga'i yan lag rma yin pas mngon rtogs kyi dkyil du bcug na zab tu 'gro ba dka' zhing / gzhan 'ga' sems dpa' bsdu sa pa'i bsrung 'khor rtog —156—

bdun lugs kyi cho ga'i gseb tu 'debs pa yang de dang 'dra bas/ de bsgom na thob thang la sems dpa' bsdus nga rang bsgom dgos kyang / de la dbang rgyun dang lag len gyi rgyu na logs pa med pas/ srung bzlog dgos pa la de nyid logs su bsgom na bzang ngo / / gshin rje gshed dmar po lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa chi/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin/ a nu pa ma 'arak+ṣa ta/ rat+na ā ka ra shwarnyi/ dharma ā ka ra shān+ti/ rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po na ya ka pa/ bi yi ta de ba/ dwa na shi la/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba/ rong nga rga lko rong pa sher seng / skyi ston grags rgyal/ kun mkhyen chen po/ sa bzang pa ca chen/ theg chen chos rje/ drag thog pa bsod bzang / rje kun dga' rnam rgyal ba/ rig pa'i glog 'phreng / rgya ston byang dbang / shākya kun dga'/ bla ma dam pa ye shes dbang go de la bdag gis nod pa lags so/ /yang na/ 'jam dbyangs gshin rje gshed po birnya pa/ /rnge bi pa dang bram ze dpa snye sna/ ‘re dzin dang / /bi ra ḍi pa blo gros bzang po dang / /ni ska laṅga ra ban+di pa dang / /glo bo lo tsā bla chen 'phags pa dang / /dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje brag phug pa/ /bsod nams mtshan dang theg chen chos rje'o/ /de man chad gong dang 'dra mod/ glo bo lo tsā bas dar ban la gsan nam brtag dbros so/ /'di glo bo lo tsā nga nas brgyud pa ste/ birnya rnge bi gnyis 'jug pa ni/ lha lnga dang bcu gsum ma gnyis ka'i brgyud la tshang pa'i dbang du byas pa 'dra zhing / dpal 'dzin lugs kyi phyir zlog srung 'khor gyi brgyud pa ni rnal 'byor bzhi rim dang 'dra'o/ /yang chag lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ ra ben dra pa yan chad de dang 'dra ba las/ chos rje dpal dang rgyal mtshan dge ba dang / /shong lo blo brtan mang ma/khar lo tsā dang / /dpal ldan seng ge bu stonacachos rje dang / /sgra tshad pa dang nam mkha' mchog grub dang / /rin chen dpal grub mkhyen rab chos rje dang / /rig 'dzin rgyal po chos ris/ rgyal mtshan dang / /bsod nams dpal 'byor bkra shis —/57—

rgyal mtshan dang / dpal ldan chos bzang zhabs las bdag gis 'khums/ dwa na shī ka'i lugs la ni/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod seng / ze dmar ba sangs rgyas ye shes/ de la kun mkhyen chen po dang bu ston chen po gnyis kar gyis gsan 'dug pas de bzhin du ded kyang chog go /gshin rje gshed nag po'i dbang gi brgyud pa las/ rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī pa ka ra ra ta/ rwa rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge /rwa 'bum seng / rje btsun rga lo/rong pa sher seng / dpal ldan seng ge /bu ston chen po man chad/ rje byang gling pa rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan pa'i bar du dmar po chag lugs kyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ mkhas mchog byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /'di dang gdong drug la mal lugs dang zhang lugs dang skyo lugs kyi brgyud pa'ang 'dus pa yin mod kyi 'dir ma bris so/ /'dir rwa ba rnams dgra nag gi la/ ti li pa/nā ro pa/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta/ bal bo thugs rje chen po zhes brgyud pa 'ded pa dang / gdong drug la ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ nag po spyod pa pa/ bha dra pa/ dha ma pa/ de ba pa/ dze tā ri pa/ a nang ga pa/ dharma a ka ra ma ti/ bal po thugs rje chen po zhes brgyud pa 'ded pa ni/ rwa lugs kyi dgra gdong 'jigs gsum tshang ma la 'dam kha'i tshul du sbyor rgyu yin gyi so so la nges can sbyor ba ltar byed pa ni/ sngon cig gis mkhas khyad du byas pa de/ dpyad pa med par phyis mkhas rmongs kun la khyab pa yin no/ /spyir rgya gar na rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs dang nus mthur ldan pa dang thog ma'i srol 'byed kyi gzhung bzang ba la 'dam gyi/ bar skabs kyi brgyud pa la rtsad gcong chung bas brgyud yig so so na 'khod nga/ rnams la'ang / paṇa grub gcig nas brgyud pa'i chos gcig la'ang lo tsā ba so so'i 'dod pas nge gong gi brgyud pa mi 'dra ba du ma byung ba yin no/ /'di bod mkhas rmongs kun gyis nan tan du go dgos so/ /—158—

rdo rje 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma dang / khro mo brgyad skor gnyis ka la/ deng sang phal cher brgyud pa 'ded lugs 'dra bar byed de/ rngo/ rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ 'jam/ dpal bshes gnyen/ a mo gha badz+ra che ba/ a mo gha badz+ra chung rba / de la sngon skyo nag 'brom ston zhes bya ba phyis skyo 'od 'byung du mtshan grags pa'i skyo chen pos gsan/ de la sras sku mched gnyis te/ che ba 'jam dpal dang / chung ba pad+ma zhes bya ba la/ mgyogs ming du skyo 'jam re/ dang / skyo ba'ang der grags so/ /mched de gnyis la 'jam me'i sras skyo kham pas gsan/ de nas gnyan rin chen brtan pa/ gnyan 'od srung / gnyan chos rgyal/ 'dzims pa rin she khar pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ la ru ba bsod nam sa seng ge /klog skya grags chen/ spang khang pa grags pa dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ sa bzang pa slob dpon zla ba rgyal ma' 'a/ blo gros grags nga// byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ shes rab rin chen pa/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la stsal/ lo/ /de lta na yang khro mo brgyad skor gyi brgyud pa ni de yang yin la/ yang na/ skyo chen po/ nyi ma shes rab/ lho nag smon lam tshu /khrims/ lho ba kun mkhyen/ rin chen bzang po/ rngog seng ge grags/rngog tsha byang chub bsod nams/ mkhas grub rdo rje bzang go thar nga/ gling pa ār+ya de ba/ grub chen kun blo/ dge ba rgyal mtshan pa/ skyes mchog rgyal ma myong/ skyes mchog rin chen/ ye shes rin chen/lha chung ba/ rje byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /sems dpa' bsdus pa'i srung zlog gi brgyud pa'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /zhe dgu ma ni/ zhang dge smu dun bzang po la skyos zhus par snang bas/ de yan chad dgra nag zhang lugs bzhin brgyud pa ded na legs so/ /zhe dgu ma zhang lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal ye shes zhabs dang mar me mdzad/ /la —159—
