li ta dang so su ra pa dang / tan na pa dang a ba li na pa/ /gu ṇa bha dra ngag dbang grags pa dang / /lha 'byung zla ba co gru shes rab bla/ /dge 'dun bzang po dbang bsod rdo rje rtse/ /nyi ma 'od dang rin chen grags pa dang / /bsam gling rdor 'od 'dzim pa rin she dang / /nyi ma bshes gnyen e ba mkhon ston dang / /dkon mchog bzang po nam mkha' smon lam dang / /nam mkha' bzang po mkhas grub chos bzang dang / /sangs rgyas dar dang blo gros rin chen dang / /dngos grub rgya mtsho shes rab rgya mtsho dang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen te/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed mal lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ pham thing pa'i lugs ltar na/ rgya bal gyi bla ma rnams bde mchog ྅ yi pa'i brgyud pa sgra ji bzhin du 'ded/brgyud pa gnyis pa ni/ 'jam dpal ye shes zhabs dang mar me mdzad/ /dza ma ri pa rnal 'byor na ri pa/ /mi mnyam rdo rje'i khol dang yi rang pa/ /blo gros grags dang snying po rtse mo dang / /grags pa'i mtshan dang paṇa chen khu dbon dang / /a snyan dam pa dga' ldan kun bsod dang / /rdo rje dpa' dang kirti gsang chen pa/ /ma ti paṇa chen theg chen chos rje dang / /grags pa rin chen grub chen kun blo dang / /dge ba rgyal mtshan shes rab zla ba dang / /kun spangs chos rje 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan/ /brgyud pa'i rim pa de las bdag gis mnos/ /yang sa paṇa/ gan pa chos rgyal chos rin/ rin rgyal te gsum/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma chos dpal shes rab/ rgod phrug grags pa 'byung gnas/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan pa/ skyes mchog rgyal mtshan man chad skyo lugs bzhin no/ /rwa lugs 'jigs mdzad bcu gsum ma'i brgyud pa ni/ ro langs brgyad skor gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud pa dang 'dra bar byas kyang rung la/ rwa chos rab/ rwa dkon mchog seng ge /sto seṅge/shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rgya dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/ dwangs ma ba —160—

brtson 'grus byang chub/ chos rje bsod nams yon tan/ bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dkon mchog dpal ba/ 'phags pa bde 'byor pa/ rwa paṇa chen pa/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rwa tshul khrigs rnams rgyal/ des bdag la'o/ /yang bsod nams yon tan/ dge legs bzang po pa/ 'phags pa bde 'byor pa byas kyang chog go /yang na rwa shes rgyal/ kham pa dkon ma/chog rin chen/ bla ma 'bro mkhar ba/ bla ma gzi brjid pa/ bla ma rin chen rgya mtsho/ yang brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ rong pa sher song / 'jam dbyangs nyag gcig/bla ma dkon bzang ba/ yang na/ bzhi thog rin rgyal/ dgu rus dkon rgyal/ bag ston pa/ tshul rgyal pa/ dkon bzang tshul rgyal gnyis la 'jam ral gyis zhus/de rjes 'dzam gling nyi ma/ rwa kun dga' seng ge /paṇa chen pa man chad sngar bzhin/ yang rgya ston/khams pa yon tan 'dum/ mchod rten dkar po pa sangs rgyas skyabs / lha bsod nams rin chen/slob dpon bsod nams rgyal mchog /rje bsam rin/ rwa kun dga' seng ge sogs gong bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /bcu gsum ma'i dbang bskur ba jo gdan tshogs pa chos lung ba'i mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal ba'i dbang chog steng nas phyag len rgyas pa dang / khrom yon pa'i khyi ka'i lung sogs lung bka' mang rab dang bcas pa mkhan chen rin ngo/ che lung rigs rgya mtsho'i drung du'ang thob mod/ brgyud pa zhu ba ma byung ngo / /yang bla ma/ ma/nyam meng grags rgyal/ gzungs kyi dpal ba/dge bzang ba 'es ded kyang chog go /rje grol mchog gi gsan yig na/ mnyam med pa/ gzungs pa/dge bzang ba/ bla chen chos dpal ba/ bla ma nam mkha' rdo rje/ rwa ston pa/ rje byams gling pa dpal ldan tshul /brims la/ rje grol ma/chog gis gsan gsung ba de dngos su ro langs brgyang/ bskor yin rgyu gcig byung na yang / bu ston gyi ro langs brgyad bskor cher ma rma/dzad pa 'dra bas bcu gsum/ ma/'i brgyud pa yin nam sems/ de lta na rje dpal tshul pa la grub mchog rdo rje 'chang rtsa ba'i bla rma sa gsan 'dug /bdag gis kyang bklags/ chog gi dbang thob pa/ brgyud pa rtsad gcod gnang ba ma —161—

——— byung bka' stsol yong/ kyang de ltar byas pas chog gam snyam mo/ /yang sngags 'chang kun dag paṃ zla bas kyang ro langs brgyad bskor bdag bskyed la yod pa/ dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs byas pa na/ khong gis dge bzang pa la zhus pa rgya ston la brgyud pa ded 'dug sde/ dge bzang pa la bcu gsum ma nga/nga / ro langs brgyad bskor brgyud pa tha dad nas brgyud pa yong kyang khong gis 'dres pa 'dra'o/ /mal lugs ngor pa nas brgyud pa'ang / rje dkon mchog lhun grub la/ mkhas mchog byams pa'i mtshan can gyis gsan 'dug /spyir de 'dra'ang yod mod 'dir mi 'dod do/ / yang bcu gsum ma la rwa 'bur seng / rga lo/ gru gu mkhar sngon pa/ rwa ban chos dbyings pa/ chos bsam 'khru/ba/ chos bkra shis/ shes rab seng ge /kun dga' seng ge /chos kyi seng ge /'jam dbyangs blo gros/ rnab/ khrims rlam rgyal/ zhes/ brgyud pa ded na'ang byin rlabs brgyud pa yin pas legs so/ /brgyud pa'i rim pa bstan pa'i skabs/ so// //༈ da ni nyer mkho yan lag phra mo dag brjod par bya ste/ slob dpon li la badz+ra gyis mdzad pa'i ro langs brgyad bskor gyi sgrub thabs las/ khro bcu zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i dru nga 'khor cig bshad kyang / deng sang de la rgyun dang man ngag med cing / lar yang de 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lus sa las blangs pa yin gyi/ gshe/da skor rang lugs min no/ /zhabs lugs la byed phyin u zhi ṣa gnyan lugs kyi man ngag zab la rgya che ba yod pas de sgom pa mchog yin zhing / de yang dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi mngon rtog kyi gseb tshags su 'debs na mi rung bi logs su bsgom par bya'o//urdzi ṣa rwa lugs kyang 'dus pa zhabs lugs dang / rdo rje gur gyi ma/na ngag gung spros pa/ bzlog pa zab la rgyas pa yin yang / gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs la dkyus su 'ju ga rgyu min/ logs su bsgom par bya ba yin mod kyi ngag 'don zhig logs su bshad zin la/ urdzi ṣa lugs gnyis ni rtags thon thon pa bya ba byas byas pa yin par grags pa don la'ang de ka'i tshul du snang ba de'i man —162—

ngag ni yig ning las shes par bya'o/ /da ni rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs bya ba'i rim pa sems dpa' bsdus nga/ las 'byung ba/srung 'khor gyi cho ga ni 'di yin te/ spros pa la dga' na/ skyabs sems yig brgya tshogs zhing rgyun bshags sdom bzung tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du btang / mdor bsdus na skyabs sems tsam sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi ni/ oX su bhā wa: oṃ shā n+ya ta: stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan nga /de'i steng du raX las mi'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/de'i steng du baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/de'i steng du laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suX las ri'i rgyal po ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du paX las sna tshogs pad+ma dang / raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du huX las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la riX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ khor yug thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng du gur dang bla re/ phyi rol tu mda'i dra ba dang / me ri 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+re bha wa badz+ra brgyu huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ glu rdzo badz+ra pra ka ra huX baX skyoX/ oX badz+ra pañtsa ra huX baX khruX/ oX badz+ra bi tā na hūṃ baX huX/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la traX saX traX/ oX badz+ra dz+wa la a na lwarka hūX hūX hūX/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du paX las pad+ma dang / raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/bhuX las 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi gnas 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ g.yas skor du bar med du 'khor ba/ 'khor lo'i lte bar paX las pad+ma dang / raX las nyi ma'i steng du bdud bzhi'i gdan/ rtsibs brgyad la —163—

rte /d+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ shar du dbang po/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/byang du gnod spyin/ byang shar du ཿnga po/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/nub byang du rlung lha rnams bsgyel ba'i baX chen gyi gdan re rer gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du a ā/ i sī/ u mū/ ṛ grwa/ '-i lī/ e i/ o au/ aX aX/shu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long ye shes/ de'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa lha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ji pa ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaX rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du siX las tho ba huX gis mtshan pa dang / paX las gri gug paX kyis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po gnyen rje tham sa cad mthar byed pa/ sku mdog dus kyi mun pa ltar gnag cing / char sprin ltar ngam za ba/ nyi ma 'bum dang mnyam pa'i gzi brjid 'bar bas 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par byed pa/ zhal drug /phyag drug /zhabs drug pa/ rtsa zhal nag po rab tu khros shing rgya cher bzhad pa/ g.yas zhal dang po dkar zhing / gnyis pa ljang khu/ g.yon zhal da/nga po dmar thing gnyis pa ser po/ steng zhal sngon po rab tu gdangs shing steng du phyogs pas gnam du gzigs pa'o/ /phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje tho ba/ gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ gsum pa na be con dkar po/g.yon gyi dang po na pad ma/ gnyis pa na rin po che/ gsum pa na ral gri bsnam pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang / mgo rlon gyi do shal dang / gdug pa'i sbrul —164—

gyis sku la brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris can/ zha' re re la dmar la zlum pa/'i spyan gsum gsum dang snan pa/ ljags 'gril zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sma ra smin rma/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ tshangs rnga/ dang / dbang po dang / nye dbang dang / drag po ste bdud bzhi brdzis pa'i ma he nag po dregs shing khros pa'i steng na/ zhabs g.yas gsum bskum zhing g.yon gsum brkyang ba'i stabs kyis/ bzhugs pa/ de la 'khyud pa'i yum bcom ldan 'das ma gshin rje mthar byed ma yang / bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa las/ phyag dang po gnyis dang zhabs dang po gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar rdo rje'i lte bar huX/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed po badz+ra sa mā dzaX oX hi ha bho nas/ ku ru swāhā/ dzaXhuX baX hoX rang gi dpral bar oX/mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ rang gi thugs ma nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong gshin rje brgyad bkug /phyogs mtshams kyi gdan brgyad la mkhod pa ni/shar du ya ba ti lcags/ kyu dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ lhor chos kyi rgyal po rtsis byang dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/ nub tu tel pa nag po sbu gri dang thod khrag 'jin pa/ byang du glang mgo can lcags kyu nga/nga rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ byang shar du ral pa tshar dgu me'i 'khor lo dang / zhing dbyug 'dzin pa/ shar lhor gshin rje mig dmar ral gri dang / zhi pa chu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu phya sangs rtse gsum dang / bum pa 'jin pa/ nub byang du smigs pa lcags sgrog dang thong/ khrag 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing nag pho nya drag gtum gyi cha byad 'dzin pa'o/ /lkoX ya ma rā dza ā ga smo ya hūṃ dzaX zhes la myo/ mang du brjod/ rang gi ba spru'i bu ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od —165—

zer gyi rtse la/ rdo rje phur bu rnams spros te/ phyogs skyong gshin rje rnams la reg pa tsam gyis gcig tu 'dres nas/ thams cad kyang gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs su gnas gyur/ oṃ hṝXljoXbi kri tā na na ya ma rā dza gī li gī la ya/ huX phaṭa/lan brgyad brjod/ shar du gti mug ya mun+ta ka dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lhor ser sna ya mun+ta ka ser po rin po che 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'dod chags ya mun+ta ka dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du phrag dog ya mun+ta ka ljang khu rdo rje rgya gram 'dzin pa/ byang shar du ral gri ya mun+ta ka ljang khu/ shar lhor tho ba ya mun+ta ka nag po/lho nub tu dbyug pa ya mun+ta ka dkar po'am ser po/ nub byang du pad+ma ya mun+ta ka dmar po/ de bzhi po phyag g.yas rang ming gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yon brkyang gi stabs can/ g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'phyar zhing / g.yon sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i sbrul zhags 'dzin pas/ gdus pa can ma lus pa sdigs shing 'ching bar mdzad pa/ gtso bo bzhin du khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyogs mtshams skyong ba rnams bsgral ba'i steng du g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /bdag nyid gshin rje gshed po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad/ ye shes sems dpa'i don du oX badz+ra sa mā dzaX oX hruXha bho nas/ me dhi mā na ku ru ku ru snyu spyo bar lan gsum brjod pas spyan drangs/ ar+ghaX nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ de thams cad gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi pad+ma ra spros te/ mthar byed chen po brgyad kyi rnam pa can du gyur/—166—

mkha' nang nas phyir spros te rtsibs kyi lha tshogs rnams 'a thim/ lkoX badz+ra ang gye sha dzaX sogs dang / dzaXhūX baX hoX mang du brjod/ 'dir gong ma rnam/sa ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa so so'i spyi bo nas thim par bsgom/ nga rgya gzhung gi don du mdzad/ yang / rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa/ rma dzaX lkoX pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra khyuX sngon du 'gro ba/ ar+ghaX na5ri na shasta 'a bar gyis mchong/tseX( a bhi khi ྅ / hwa / maX sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ lkoX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye huX/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang /dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ dang / 'bor rnams la gshin rje gshed phyag gnyis pa res dbu brgyan par gyur/ dngos/ su bshams pa'i mchod pa yod na skabs 'dir byin gyis brlabs/ oX hruXsgyiXhiX sogs kyis 'bul dgos pa las/ 'di nyid kyi gzhung las/ mchod yon gsang gtor dri chab me tog bdug spos gtor ma mar me zhes 'byung ba/ zhal zas gtor ma'i nang du 'dus pas logs su mi dgros pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin/ 'on kyang / rgyal ba rnams ni gtsang gyur cing / /zhes nga/ nas/nai we te pu ja ya grwahwa'i bar gyis mchod pa 'bul tshul 'jigs mjad khro mo brgyang bskor gyi skabs dang 'dra/ gdug pa skrag byed 'khor lo me ltar 'bar/ /dus gsum bro/ rgyal he ru ka yi thugs/ /las rnams kun byed phrag dog rdo rje ste/ /ma lus chems gcod gsol ba sku yi ngang / /hūX dang phaṭa gyi gdug rtsub sbyor ba'i gsung / /kun gyi rang bzhin khyod kyi gzhin rje yi/ /ltor 'dzud nges kyang bka' 'a sa mi 'ang/'a zhing / /phyogs bcur sprul pas ma lus gnas myos 'gugs/ /ma lus kun byed 'khor lo che mchog la/ /bdag ni gzhan gyi don phyir phyag 'tshal lo/ /—1()7—

khyod ni dpa' bo mthu chen kun gyi bdud/ /nga yi lam bstan bdud rnams mi byed kyang / /dam las 'da' zhing log pa kun skyed pa/ khyod kyang bka' las ma 'da' las rnams sgrubs/ /tshe dang srog bsdus yan lag rnam par chings/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis rnal 'byor nga la 'dod sgrub na/ / ngas ni spyin bya khyod ni dam las ma 'da' cig /ces pas bstod/ 'khor lo g.yon bskor du 'khor ba dang / dgra bgegs byad ma gtub pa'i dmigs pa man ngag bzhin byas la/ oX hṝXljoXbi kri tā nā na huX/sarba sha trun nā sha ya staX bha ya phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa nyid drag tu bzla/ 'di snying po'i sngags su gsungs te/ rgyun gyi bzlas pa dang srung bzlog gnyis kar byed/ rtsa sngags yi ge so gnyis pa'i sbo nas bzlog pa byed na/ oX ya ma rā dza dgra dang bgegs dang byad ma zhes pa 'am/ nai mo nā sha ya staX bha ya huX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ sa do me ya nas/ ni ra ma ya'i bar la'ang de bzhin du sbyar/ 'di 'di nyid kyi gzhung du gab nga 'i man ngag yin/ oX hruXkā la'i sngags ni nye snying dang / oX hruXkruX ni mchog gi snying por bshad/ sngags 'di gnyis ni gtso bo'i thugs rgyud bskul ba dang srung ba yin gyi bzlog bsad gtso mi che'o/ /bzlas pa'i mthar gtor ma byin gyis rlob ste/ khro mo brgyad bskor kyi skabs bzhin/ oX kā la ru pa sarba du / zhe sngags kyis gtso 'khor thams cad la dus gcig tu phul/ bsdu na gong bzhin bstod pa gcig pus chog de rjes thal mo brdab cing dmod nga/ bya'o/ /spros pa la dga' na bstod pa rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa byas/ nas bskul te/ bcom ldan dpal chen khro rgyal gzhin rje gshed/ /'jam dang/la rdo rje 'jigs mdzad sprul pa ni/ /dam nyams dgra bo mna' zan bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nyi ma bzhi pa'i dzil pa las la ya/ khar phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas/ /brgya byin dri za bsgral ba'i gdan steng nas/ /'khor —168—

byed chen po gzhan rje ya ba ti/ /g.yas pa rdo rje lcags kyu 'bar ba yis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa dmar nas drongs/ /g.yon pa rdo rje ral gri 'bar ba yis/ /dgra bgegs gnod byed mgo lus dum bur gtubs/ /thod tshal dum bu mang po kra la la/ /sdang byed dgra bo'i klad pa 'khor du chug /nyi ma bzhi pa'i sprul pa las la ya/ /thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma ya/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'/ /bsgrub phyir gshin rje'i rgyal po dgra la ya/ /glo ka rting ma 'di kun gyi 4ga tu sbyar/ lho phyogs 'khor lo:/ yi dwags gshin rje bsgral ba'i khrag 'thung chen po chos kyi rgyal po ni/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na skye 'gro'i rtsis byang bsnams/ /dam nyams dgra bo thus la 'jug par mdzad/ /g.yon pa rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar ba bsnams/ /dgra bgegs gnod byeng/ dbang po sna lnga 'don/ /bu ga dgu nas khrag rgyun cur ru sa /sdang byed dgra bo khong khrag skyug tu chug /nyi ma bzhi pa'i sogs/ nub phyogs /klu gnyan chu bdag: /khrag 'thung chen po gshin rje tel pa ni/ /g.yas pa skru gri me ltar 'bar ba yis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog gcod nyal la la/ /g.yon pa thod khrag khol zhing 'bar ba bsnams/ khrag rgyun dron mo zhal du gsol bar mdzad/ /sdang byed dgra bo khong khrag skyug tu chug /nyi ma bzhi pa'i sogs/ byang phyogs:/ gnod spyin bdud tshogs: /myos byed chen po gshin rje glang mgo can/ /g.yas pa 'gugs byed mi zad lcags kyu thogs/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i snying gi dkyil nas drongs/ /g.yon pa rdo rje rgyu zhags 'phen cing rdog /dgra bgegs gnod byed dbang po yan lag chings/ /myos shing drag tu brgyal ba'i las mdzod cig /sdang byed dgra —169—

bo smyo ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /nyi ma bzhi pa'i sogs/ byang shar: /bgegs rgyal 'byung po bsgral ba'i gdan steng du/ /gsod byed chen po ral pa tshar dgu ni/ /g.yas pa me lce'i 'khor lo drag tu 'khor/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i mgo lus dum bur gcod/ /g.yon pa ro langs zhing gi dbyug tho bsna mas/ /dgra bgegs gnod byed lus kun thal bar rlog /snying nas bkas shing sha khrag dum bur 'thor/ /sdang byed dgra bo bsad pa'i las mdzod cig / nyi ma bzhi pa'i sogs/ shar lhor: /me lha drang srong : /gsod byed chen po gshin rje mig dmar ni/ /g.yas pa rdo rje chu gri 'bar ba yis/ /dam nyams dgra bo brgya stong dum bur gtubs/ /g.yon pa zhing dbyug keng rus 'bar ba yis/ / dgra bgegs gnod byed lus sems 'brel bar mdzad/ /mi ro rta ro mang po rdza ltar bsnyil/ /sdang byed dgra bo rtsad nas chod la shog /nyi ma bzhi pa'i sogs/ lho nub: kha za srin po: /'khor byed chen po gzhan rje phya sangs ni/ /g.yas pa rdo rje tri shu 'bar pa yis/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs lus ngag yid gsum choms/ /g.yon pa tshe srog bsdud pa'i bum pa bsnams/ /dgra bgegs gnod byed bla srog sbar gyis thob/ /sdang byed dgra bo 'khrul zhing 'khor bar mdzod/ /nyi ma bzhi pa'i sogs/ nub byang 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas/ /dkrugs byed rlung lha bsgral ba'i gdan steng nas/ /smyo byed chen po gshin rje smigs pa ni/ /g.yas pa thod rlon 'bar ba bsnams pa yis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i dbang lnga zhal du stobs/ /g.yon pa rdo rje lcags sgrog 'debs mdzad cing //dgra bgegs gnod byed lus kun sdom par mdzod/ /dran rig shes pa med pa —170—

mun ltar 'byams/ /sde nga byed dgra bo smyo shing 'bag tu chug /nyi ma bzhi pa'i sprul pa las la ya/ /thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma ya 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'/ /bsgrub phyir gzhin rje'i rgyal po dgra la ya/ /zhes drag tu bskul lo/ /las tshogs drag po sgrub pa'i skabs/ ling ga 'gugs 'dren bsgral chog/zhal du stob pa'i bar bya/ dkyus kyi rim pa la de dag mi dgos te/ gtor ma zor du 'phangs/ gi zhi ṣa rwa lugs su bshad pa ltar dmod pa drag tu 'debs shing / thal mo gdab bo/ /yi ge brgya pa dang bzod gsol gyi mthar/ lkoX dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ sogs brjod de/ ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying gar bsdu/ rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis dge ba bsngo/ 'di'i gzhan rje brgyad po'i phyag mtshan sna skyo pa'i man ngag gi nang nas/ sems dpa' bsdus pa'i gzhung gi man ngag ltar yin la/ yang zhi ba ye shes kyi bzhung dang 'brel ba'i skyo lugs kyi man ngag rgyun 'byer gye lugs ni/ gong khro mo brgyad bsko ra gyi stabs kyi bskul du bshad pa bzhin no/ /yang de gnyis ka la mdor bsdus la dga' ba'i ngor/ gshen rje pho mo thams cad bzhon pa spangs shing / sku mdog mthing nag sha stag /pho rnams dbyug pa dang thod khrag gam/ dbyug pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ mo rnams ral gri thod khrag gam/ ral gri zhags pa 'dzin pa/ yang pho brgyad nag po dang mo brgyud dmar mor byas kyang rung / pho brgyad sngo skya thal mdog dang / mo brgyad nag mor byed pa'ang yod/ de dag ji ltar bde bas chog go /gong du smos pa bzhin srung bzlog gi cho ga 'di/ sems dpa' bsdus pa'i cho ga'i yan lag yin zhing / de'i lugs ltar 'jigs mdzad kyi mngon rtogs bsgoms na/ tshogs gsog dang gzha' yang khang gi bar du bsgom rgyu'i srung 'khor de 'di yin yang / sems dpa' bsdus pa'i lugs mi bsgom phyin/ dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub thabs gzhan rnams kyi nang gi srung 'khor gyi skabs su/ 'di bcug —171—

ste bsgoms kyang bsre bslad dang rang bzor 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de ltar mi byed par 'o gas su bsgom pa nyid bzang la/ 'on kyang spros pa la dga' bas/ skyo lugs dang sdeb na skyabs sems yig brgya song mtshams tshogs zhing spyan 'dren rma byas pa'i gong der/ 'di yongs rdzogs bsgoms nas thun mtshams kyi lha sku langs/ slar so so'i tshogs zhing man chad la zhugs na/ snga phyir dkyil 'khor mi 'dra ba gnyis so sor bsgom pa'i lugs dang byad med pas/ bsre bslad du mi 'gro zhing ma 'brel ba yang min la/ chog khrigs spros pa la dga' ba rnams/ kyi blo tshims pa /zhig kyang 'ong bar snang ngo / /de'i tshe huX bzhi pa'i sngon du 'di'i dmod pa yan chad rdzogs par bya'o/ /srung bzlog 'di spyir gshed skor kun gyi yang cha lag tu 'brel ba tsam yin mod kyi/ 'jigs mdzad skyo lugs dang lhag par 'brel re ba yin no// //rmya/ sdo ba dpon dpal 'dzin gyi phyir bzlog man ngag drug gi nang nas/ phyi'i byad ma sngags kyis bzlog pa zhes bya ba/ bsgom bzlas kyi bsrung bzlog 'di lta bu zhig kyang gsungs te/ skyabs 'gro se gru/sa bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du btang / swa bhā wa dang / yo ga shud dha dang / hūṃ n+ya ta ste sngags gsum gyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e yig las chos kyi 'khyu rdong gnas sdo/ gsum pa/ dkyus kyi las tshogs la dkar dmar dang drag po'i las la mthing nag tu bya/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs pa'i nang du paX las pad+ma dang / raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba/ lte ba la hūX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/'khor yug thams cad rdo rje rwa ba dang dra ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar bas gang bar gyur/ oX badz+ra —172—

rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūX hūX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ srung ba'i 'bor lo'i nang du/ bhuX ser po'am sngon ༄ḍā las 'khor lo ser po'am sngon po rtsibs/ bcu pa/ rtse mo glo ba khog nga sto nga nga/ yangs shing rgya che ba/ go skabs meng/ par gyur/ eXrna badz+ra cakra rak+ṣa hūṃ hūX smyoX/ 'khor lo'i lte bar paX las pad+ma raX las nyi ma/ maX las ma he nag po dregs shing khros pa'i steng du/ ya las gshin rje bsgyel ba'i gdan la/ rang sems huX las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sem/sa can gyi don byas/ dgra bgegs byad ma gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ nga/bus su rang nyid khro bo chen po khams gsum rnam rgyal dang gnyis su me da pa'i bcom/ ldan 'das gzhan rje gshed po sku mdos mthing nag /phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod dbyug 'phyar zhing / g.yon dur kyi 'gas rnga/ dang bcas nga/'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ thugs ka nas hāX bcu spros te/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu la 'khod pa ni/ shar du gzhan rje mthar byed nag po tho ba 'dzin pa rnam snang gi dbu rgyan chi can/ lhor shas rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan can/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can/ byang du bgegs/ mthar byed ljang khu rdo rje 'dzin pa don yo da grub pa'i dbu rgyan can/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba sngo skya ral gri 'dzin pa rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ lco nub tu 'dod rgyal sngo dmar lcags kyu 'dzin pa snang mtha'i nga/bu rgyan can/ nub byakra du dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ byang shar du stobs po che dud nag rtse gsum 'dzin pa rnga sgra'i dbu rgyan can/ steng du gtsug tor —173—

——tu ga no / mdzes ༵ ༵ ༵ / ga ༵ //༵ rjo na ri sna ༵ spya ༵ skyo / stsu ldi~X ༵/ ༵sna/ yang na thams cad mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can du byas kyang rung ngo / /gtso 'khor thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/sma ra smin ma rab tu 'bar ba/ phyag rgya drug dang klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris can/ ga sku1na brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing / phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cang/ tshar gcod par mdzad pa'o tsho /lha //༵rjo ze sdi 'phros/ba~X ༵ ḍā dzhai ༵/༵ nas rnyi bo ༵ ༵ /cig ༵nga dī s+t+ri 'khor lo dang bcas pa la/ rgya' ba sras bcas thams cad khro bo bcu gcig gi ༵ hūṃ ba o ༵ rdo lha na tshe lnga spra / ༵ḍi ༵sna ༵ ༵༵ ༵/ ༵ /brdo bskur ༵rta/ bsdu na/ gong du bshad pa ltar dbu rgyan rang chas kho nas chog go /gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'dod nga 'i rgya'/ po grangs med pa sprul/ na ma sa rma dha kā ya lwaka tsit+ta badz+ra ṇa/ oṃ ṭak+ki /bung rna~X/ ༵ ༵rde~X ༵kau rde~X sna~X/ dho rnyi ༵dhi dī ༈ /༵ ༵sa ༵ rdo ༵ ༵ ḍi/dru~X badz+ra mud ga ra sogs kyis tho bas brdungs/ pho nya rngams rang nyid la thim/ rang gi snying gar kyā ༵ ༵ la ༵ ༵ dzī/ rdze rin rje spyod ༵ na ༷ra me dī ༵dī kau ༵ rde ༵ sid khre/ hūm̐ gshe/da/ gsang bar da las phrag dog gshi/na rje gshe/da rnams rang snang gi yum —174—

dang bcas pa'o/ /tshogs mar dza las tsar tsi kā/ pho bar sa/ las phas mo/ rkang mthil g.yas su do las dbyangs can ma/ rkang mthil g.yon du ru las bo rī/lag mthil g.yas su ya las tho ba gshin rje gshe/da/ g.yon du ma las dbyug pa gzhan rje gshed/ pus mo g.yon du ni las pad+ma gshin rje gshed/ g.yas su ra las ral gri gshin rje gshed do/ /de ltar sgo skyong bzhi'i smu/dun du/ ṇa yo ni ra las thod pa bzhi'o/ /snying gar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dang/'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' nyi ma la gnas nga/'i sngaX yig go /de la bsrung bya rnam man ngag bzhin du bkod/ skabs snye ri dar mchod bstod bya/ de nas 'bor lo bskor ba sogs spyi dang mtshungs/ hṝXgaXyi ge bcu bzhi nga/'i sngags dang / chi bzla ste gtso bo'i sngags yin/ oX āXya mun ta kri ta huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ sogs khro bo bcu'i mtshan sngags bzla ste/srung ba'o/ /'di'i bzlog pa dang bsad pa la gtso bo 'pho ba mi dgos/ hṝXljoXl dgra bshegs byad ma thams cad nā sha ya staX bha ya/ zhes spel ba nyid sa tso bor bzla/ spro zhing nus na/ rdo rje gur las 'byung ba'i khro bo bcu'i 'phreng sngags kyang bzla zhes snga ma rlams bzhed/ khyad par bzlog pa'i skabs u 〉 ṣa dang / bsad pa la dbyug sngon gyi 'phreng sngags gtso bor bzla zhes gsung ngo / /de nas gli/ra yang gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ urdzi ṣa rwa lugs nas skor grang ba ltar dmod pa drag tu gdab/ gal te gtor ma 'bul na/ bzlas pa dang mchod bstod kyi bar der bya'o/ /skabs 'di'i khro bo bcu zhal gsum phyag drug tu ma/dzad pa yang yod mod/ gzhung gi mchan bur rdo rje gur bzhin du byed gsung ba ltar dang / gtso bo phyag gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor rnams kyang phyag gnyis pa 'os pa ltar bkod pa yin no/ /gal te phyag mangs su byed na yang / phyogs glang gsar ma'i yi ge na yod pa de me legs kyi 'dus pa zhabs lugs dang bshun na legs shing gong du smos pa'i gzhung gi —175—

mchang na bu de yang glo bo lo tsā ba nyid kyi mchan bu yin zhes grags pas gur dang mthun par legs/gtor ma byin rlabs gshed dmar lha lnga dang / bcu gsum ma gang ltar byas kyang 'dra/ thun kyi skabs bdag bskyed la 'bul ba yi na na de ma thag phul bas chog /thun mtshams mdun bskyed la 'bul ba yin na/ rang sga snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bcom lngan 'das gzhan rje gshed yab yum/ lus dkyil lha bcu gsum/ khro bo bcu dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX hṝX༈༷༷'i hūX gi gong du/ i daX ba ling gro hā gro hā sarba sdo ྅ na sa ma ya mu dra pra bhañdza ka /ma ma shwarnyiX rak+ta ñtsa ku ru ku dra/ zhes bcug pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtso bo la phul/ ya ma me da spu rā dza sa do ru ṇa yo ni ra ya tsa ni'i mthar gong bzhin spel tshigs dang / hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ sbyar bas sku lus kyi lha rnams dang /h+ma( ā ya mun+ta kṛ ta i daX/ sogs spel tshig gi mthar/ huX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ sbyar bas/gzhan rje mthar byed sogs khro bo bcu la 'bul ba rigs 'gre/ mthar ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ khro bo zhe sdang gnas las skyes/ /sogs kyis bstod/ mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ smon lam/ bkra shis rnam/sa bya'o/ bro bo bcu gcig lus dkyil dang bcas pa la/ sbyin bsreg phul bas kyang spyir las thams cad dang / sgos su srung bzlog bsad gsum/ thogs pa med par 'grub ste/'di'i cho ga ni slo ba dpon chen po dpal 'dzin nyid kyis/ dmar nag gi nga/kyil chog sam/ dam ra po'i spyin bsreg bzhin du bya'o/ /'jir gzhung las/ rdzas kyi phyir bzlog gi skabs su/ sa bon sngags las bcu gsum lhar bskyed nas/ bcu gsum gnas su bzhag /hūX snye ma me da/ dza sa do ru r+ṇa yo ni ra/ ya tsa ni ra/ snying ga mig dang rna ba sna / kha dang lte ba 'og sgo gnyis/ /brla gnyis phrag pa gnyis dang ni/ /de bzhin spyi —176—

bo'i gtsug la reg /ces gsungs pa'i sa bon bcu gnyis dang / lus kyi gnas bcu gsum/ gyi go rim sbyor tshul de ni rdzas kyi bsrung ba'i skabs yin zhing / de dang 'dir snye sna dgod tshul cung zang mi mthun yang / gnas skabs tha dad pa yin pa'i phyir 'gal ba ma yin no/ /bsrung bzlog gi man ngas 'di yang / gzhin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor thams cad dang 'brel ba yin mod kyi/ dpal 'dzin gyi man ngag tu mtshungs pa'i phyir/ dmar nag bcu gsum ma gang rigs gcig dang sbrel nas bsam/ na 'brel che'o/ /da lta'i phyir bzlog drug gi gzhung 'di glo bo lo tsā kho nas bsgyur ba yin/ khong nag po la lag len mi mdzad pas de'i shugs brdas te/ ga 'an chos kyang po/zhed dmar 'ba' zhig gi cha lag tu sbyor gyin 'dug kyang / dmar po kho na'i khyad chos yin par ma nges so/ /'dir gtso bo sku mdog nag po phyag gnyis par gsungs// de la bla ma snga ma mang po sku mdog ma gtogs/ gshe/da dmar bcu gsum ma'i gtso bo yab yum sgra ji bzhin du bzhed mod/ 'on kyang gzhung de dmar nag gnyis ka'i thun mong yin pas 'di ltar shes dgos te/ nag po la brten nas byed na/ gtso bo gshe/da nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa bsgom pa/ dang / de'i tshe 'khore rnam/sa phyag gnyis pa'ang rung la/spro na zhal gsum phyag drug pa gsang 'dus zhabs lugs dang mthun nga/'i khro bcur byas kyang chag /khro bcu'i sngags kyang gsang 'dus ltar byas na legs/ gshed dam ra dang sbre' na gtso bo'i sku'i dbyibs bcu gsum ma'i gtso po ji bzhin du byas phyin/ drag po'i las yin yang sku mdog nag por bsgyur mi dgos te/ gshed dmar gyi sku mdog dmar po ni rtsa ba'i skra mdog yin gyi/ dbang gi las mtshon byed ma yin nga/'i phyir/ bzlog bsad kyi las dang sku mdog dmar po mi 'gal lo/ /bla ma snga ma rnams kyi bzhed pa de yang spyir mi 'gal mod/ gzhung gi dngos bstan sku mdog nag po ni/gshed dmar sku ma/dog nag po bsgyur ba ma yin gyi/ gnyen rje gshed gang la sbyar kyang 'ju ga pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ rtsa ba'i gshi/na rje gshe/da du grags pa'i skur bsgom pa'i dbang du byas par —177—

gsal te rnam pa ni gong du bshad pa nyid do/ /gzhud di las/ dbus su rang nyid gzhan rje gshed/ /mdog nag khros pa ma he'i steng / /zhes pa'i thad kyi mchan bu las/ sgrub thabs rgya mtshor bshad pa ltar gyi zhes 'byung ste/ gshe/da dmar du sgom/ na/ rang gzhung rgyas pa yod phyin/ sgrub thabs rgya mtshor kha 'phang mi dgos la/ dbyibs spu/ged dmar dang 'dra ba la/ sku rma dog nag po rgya mtsho na med pas/rgong du bsha/da nga/'i phyag gnyis pa de kha dang 'dra ba/ rgya ma/tsho na yod pa de la kha 'phangs nga/'o/ /de 3 ra na skabs 'dang dpal 'dzin lugs kyi gshi/na rje rngo/zhed dmar nag gnyis dang / zhal drug pa dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed lha zhe dgu rma dang / 'jigs ma dzad khro mo brgyad kyis bstar ba'i dkyil 'bor dang / ro 'a ngas brgyang bskor gyi rigs mal lugs su grags pa dang / 'jigs mdzad bcu gsum ma ste/ gshin rje g.ye/da kyi dkyil 'kho/ra chen po'i sgrub thabs bdun/ bsrung 'kho1ra gyi sgrub thabs gnyas te rim pa dgu bshad zin to/ /bzlog pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di gnyis gshi/na rje gde/da kyi dbang thob pa kho nas bsgom du rung bas/ bka' logs pa mi dgos mod/ nge/ lta/ na ya nga bla ma'i zhal lung ngam klog lung gang drang rdezhig thob par bya'/ /de dag las/ gzhan rlams la/ bka' sdod chos skyong 'di lta bro'o rde 'es pa'i dmigs bsal med la/ gdul bya'i gtse bo yin pa'i rgyu ma/tshan gyis/ chos kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa logs su yod pa nyid cha la/ga tu sbyor ba'i sro' na mal lugs/ ma/ gtogs gzhan kun la byung bar snang / ma' lugs la smyon pa 'jigs byed yi na nga/ra 'chad kyang da lnga nger zang 'a / skyo lugs ni yi dam chos skyong sbags sgrub yin te/ de yang las byed kyi gtso bo ma cho/ dang zhes than rje kho na yin rno/ /rwa lugs la ni thog ma nas yi dam bka' srung sbags te mi sgrub nga/ra dang por chos kyi rgyal ngo/'i rtos nga/ la sogs pa phyag brnyan gyi sgrub thabs rnams lo gas su gtan la phab nas/ bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas ye shes lha dang sbrel lugs ni dgos shing / bka' nyan gyi gtso bo ni las kyi gshi/na rje —178—

dang / nag po chen po dang / ma mo dang / drag po dbang phyug chen po ste dregs pa gtso bo bzhi po 'di dag yin la/ cha lag tu gshi/na rje dmar nag gzhan rngams kyang sbyor bar mdzad do/ /mgon po las mkhan du sbyor ba/ slob dpon 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs las kyang bshad/ ngon la nag ngo chen po ni/ ro langs brgyad po gang rung cig dang gcig pa dang / 'jigs rma/dzang chen po'i gdul bya'i gtso bo drag po dbang phyug chen po khros pa ni 'jis rten las ma 'das pa'i 'jigs byed chen ngo nyid yin pas/ las byed mchog tu 'gyur zhing / lha mo nag mo rje bol 'di rnams/ dngos su btan na rje'i lcam la/ nag po chen po'i yum yin zhing / res 'ga' 'be bzlog pa sgrub tshul yang yed pa ltar/ gshi na rje mgon po gnyis ka dang 'brel bas/ gshin rje gsad po'i dab pa drag gtso bor gyur pa'i 'phrin las kyi rno khyad thams cad/ dus kyis mtshan mo dang gnyis su med pa'i lnga mo ri ma tī la rag las pa lta bur yod do/ /de ltar na mgon po ma mo dbang phyug gsum po ni/ gshi/na rje gshed gzhan pas kyang 'di la lhag par 'brel che ste/ rdo rje 'jigs/ byed kyi las mkhan mchog re re yin par rwa lo chen po yab sras bzhed cing / don thog tu khel ba'i gnad chen po yin yang / bod kyi rdo rje 'jigs byed mkhan por rlom pa/ phyis byung gzhan rmams lta zhog /rwa lugs pa yin pa nga rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang ma go ste/ de tham sa cad chos rgya' gyi rtog pa tsam mam/ 'ga' zhig de bas kyang 'gangs chung ba'i/ snye brgyud yin zer ba re ci tsam 'a/ yid brtan 'cha' ste/ da dung man ngag rig pa rnams yun ring du bsten dgos pa yin no/ /de tshe ra na sgrub pa'i thabs /'a snad dang 'di lnga bu ngag bla ma dam pa las thob par byas nas/ de'i rjes su legs par brtags la/ blo sna mang ngo/'i sna tshogs sgrub 'dod spangs nas/ rang nyid mos shing skal ba dang 'tsham/ kra gcig /ngam tshis ma/ nyam/sa 3nga rab tu gsang ba'i sgo nas bsgrubs na/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don tham/sa cad dang /'phrin las rab 'byams thun mo pa dang mchos si dngos grub dang bcas pa/ bde ba da4/ pas thob —179—

par 'gyur ro/ /dpal ldan gshin rje gshed po'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /sgrub thabs rab 'byams de dag gzhung don dang / /sbrel phyir go don mtha' chod ci rigs pa'ang / /legs par 'god 'di sngon med dge ba yin/ /nag po zhang lugs gshed dmar lha lnga dang / /rtog bdun dngos bstan rwa lugs gtso rkyang gi /sgrub thabs dkyil chog gzhan du bshad zin cing / /'dir bshad dgu ste 'di tsam kho nas kyang / /rnal 'byor bla med gzhan rje gshed rgyud kyi/ /dbang dang sgrub thabs bka' yod lhad med pa/ /gangs can 'di na da lta yod pa kun/ /ma 'dres ji bzhin gsal bar rtogs pa nus/ /de skang smra ba tā ra nā tha ste/ /blun po grags pa'i rjes 'brang mi mgu yang / /rig 'dzin mkhas pa kun gyi dga' ston 'dis/ /rnam dpyod bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar byas/ /zhes pa bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed po'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byam/sa kyi sgrub thabs/ 'phrin las kyi nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can zhes bya ba 'di yang / yon tan mngon par mtho ba du ma dang bcas pa'i bla chen ye shes rgya mtsho ba sogs/ bsgo/sa gnyen gsang sngags rig pa 'ga' zhig gis bskul nas/ kun dga' snying pos me pho stag dgra bgegs bdud sde nyes skyon mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zad pa'i lo/ dpyid zla ra ba mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes la sbyar ba'o// //dge legs 'phel/ zhus dag /ma ṅga la// //—180—

oṃ spru sti/ rgyud thams cad kyi bdag po mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las 'byung ba'i man ngag /slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gzhung sgrub thabs gsang ldan dang dkyil chog yon tan 'byung gnas las 'byung ba ltar sgrub thabs dang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mdo tsam brjod par bya'o/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid/ /rigs kun bdag po ye shes sku/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje mgon po dang / /bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /de la dang por bsnyen pa'i cho ga ni/ skyabs 'gro sem/sa bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du btang ste/ tse( pra kṛ ti pa ri shurnya/ sarba dharmā pra kṛ ti pa ri shudhe ྅ha/ lan gsum/ o badz+ra mahā kro dha hū/ rang sked cig gis 'jam dpal gshin rje gshe/da/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ral gri dang / sdigs rma/dzub can/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs thing / zhabs ga sku1na brkyang gi stabs can/ cher khros pas bgegs thams cang 'joms pa/ hū bi sgra drag po sgrog pa'i/ mig gnyis su ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba la hu gis mtshan pa/ spyan dbus ma nyi zla 'dres pa ste/ spyan gyi 'od zer gyis bgegs tham/sa cad bskrad par gyur/ tse( ya mun ta ka hū phaṭa/ spros pa 'a mos na skabs 'dar khro bo spya na 'dren dang bka' bsgo bya/ snying gar nyi rma/ la sprin sgra'i nga ro hū yig ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ lta stangs kyis bgod pa dang lhan cig tu/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rwa ba dang dra ba/ steng thams cad gur dang bla re/ de'i phyi rol phyogs bcur ra yig bskal pa'i me 'od —181—

lta bu las me 'bar bas/ mtshams med cing dum bu gcig tu gyur la/ 'bar ba'i 'phreng bas bskor ba gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ta hū/ lan gsum/ o mnyu shrī/ dz+nyā na satwa hu/ rang nyid khro bo las zhi bar gyur pa ni/ 'phrin las kyi 'jam dpal sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon nor bu 'dzin pa/ gzhon nu'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /lkog mar sdi las pad+ma dang a las zla ba/ de'i steng du hu las byung ba'i rdo rje'i lcer gyur/ o mnyu shrī bi rma le dzi hā gra sa ye| dha ni badz+ra dzi hwa hu/ lag pa gnyis su a las zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i lag nga/ra gyur/ o mañdzu shrī pad+ma hasta pu rna ka ro dhi re bi ma le badz+ra hasta hu phaṭa/ snying khar paṃ las pad+ma dang / ā las zla ba la ga myo/sa pa'i dhī o mnyu shrī/ bi ma le badz+ra tsit+ta skyo/ sgrub thabs las bar skabs 'dir spyin sreg bya bar gsungs pa ni/ slob ma'i don gyi bsnyen pa dang / rang don dngos grub sgrub pa'i dus su dgos pa yen yang / rang don gyi bsnyen pa dang / cho ga dkyus la nges nga/ra dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /rang gi lag mthil gnyis su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ ga ya sa g.yon gyi mthe bong la ā mjub mo la skyo/ gung mo la tru/ srin lag la sdi mthe chung la a ste/ g.yas rnams sangs rgyas lnga dang / g.yon rnams yum lnga'i/ ngo bor gyur/ yab yum thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje khu chur gye mdzub mo dang rma the'u chung 'dud de/ la gyen du phyogs pa 'khror lo'i phyag rgya bcas te/ o mañdzu shrī maṇ+ḍa8pa badz+ra tsakra hū/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'bo/ ra chen po sprul par gyur/ e ma ho yan lag 'dus pa yi/ /sbyor ba 'di ni gsum las byung / zhes so/ /de nas yan lag bcu pa bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams/ —182—

ma lus na/ /rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs pa rnams/ /bdag la dgongs nga/ra bya ba'i phyir/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang de sku gsung thugs ldan pa'i/ /'jam dpal de la spyi bo yis/ /kun nas lus ngag dang ba'i yid/ /de la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtson 'gru/sa stobs 'i kya tshos dge bsags pa/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtu7/sa par/ /mchod sprin tshogs kyis gang gyur te/ /sras dang bcas la mchod par bgyi/ /tse( sarba ta thā ga ta ar+gha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ya hū/ zhes pa nas/ shasta 'a bar du sbyar/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas/ /zhon mongs dbang gis sdig bsags shing / /lus ngag yid kyis spyad pa rlams/ /mgon la lan gsum batsha/gas par bgyi/ /sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas dang / /rgyal sras 'gro ba'i don bzhugs dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal skye bo yi/ /bsod nams byed la yi rang ngo / /'gro kun ldongs pa/ra mi 'gyur zhing / /bdud bzhi zil gyis mnan pa dang / /byang chub rnam gsum thob bya'i phyir/ /'khor lo bla med skor bar bskul/ /'jig rten bde la 'god pa dang / /srog chags byang chub rgyu yin phyir/ /rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rgyal sras rnams la bdag 'bul gyi/ /bdag ni dus gsum thams cad du/ /so sor khyed kyis bzhes su gsol/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /ji tsam dus nas gzung nas su/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /nam zhig byang chub snying po la/ /yongs su mchis kyi bar dag tu/ /bdag gis byang chub mchog gi sems/ /ma lus par ni bskyed —/83—

par bgyi/ /thugs rje che dang ldan pa yi/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /'gro ba'i don kun mdzad pa la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces pa'i bar du brjod de/ bshags pa man chad tshar gsum bya'o/ /de ltar na phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa/rnga'i nags pa/ yi rang / bskul ba/ gse(la 'debs/ bdag 'bul/ sems bskyed/ skyabs 'gro// stso rdo pa bzung ste bcu'o/ /rgyun gyi nyams len skabs/ bsdus pa la mos na gur nas 'byu/nga ba'i rgyun bsha/gas tsam bya'o/ /de nas 'di ltar/ bde ba las 'khrungs rdo rje 'chang ba yi/ / dngos dang dngos med 'byung gnas chen por mkhyen/ /dang po gang du rnam par snang mdzad che/ /dag cing dri med blos ni o du sprul/ /gzugs mang 'phreng ba'i tshul du skor ba yi/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de ltar bstod pas lha rnams dgyes te/ legs so legs so rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byas so zhes gsungs par gyur/ de nas slar yang drin lan gyi tshul du bstod pa ni/ lugs 'di la mchan brgyar grags pa'i/ byang chub sems ni rang byung ba/ /zhes pa nas/ pha rol phyin bcu'i gtso la 'dud/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstod par gsungs pa ltar/ chog khrigs sogs kyi skabs dang / spros pa la dga' na de ltar bya la/ bstod nga/ de yang 'og tu 'chad do/ /bdag nyid nyams len gyi skabs mdor bsdus pa la mos na/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /sogs 'dud nyi shus bstod par bya'o/ /de yan chad ni rgyal mchog spyor ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ dang po'i ting nge 'dzin te sngon 'gro'o/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya nywa ka tsit+ta pra ṇa me ṇa badz+ra ban+da nā ka ro mi/ga ta ༵༵/ satwa/ sdu dzhai ༵ hūṃ dī ༈ rdo rni dī smyu/ na/ ༵ /ḍi sti shā ga ta rdo je tshi dz+nyā rnyi kwa —184—

ya/ ut+pa nāX nir+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a ghi khri hā maX/ lho nas so // oX sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra brnya na ya/ ut+pa nāX nir+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma pra brnya yā mi/ nub nas so/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma ṇi/ ut+ta nāX ni bya ta yā mi/sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru maX/ byang nas so/ /oX a ā aX a pra kri ti pa ri shu khyu/ sarba dharma ya du ta sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oX huX hri bha ga wān dz+nya na murnyi ba gi shwa ra mahā pa tsa sarba dharma ga ga na ma la su pa ri shudha dharma dh+wa tu dz+nyā na gar+bha āXzhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi snying gar thim/ de dag ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsog pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o/zhes rab stong pa nyid de dang /dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyu dang rkyen du gyur te/ zung 'jug gi mes rnam smin gyi phung po sregs/ ye shes kyi skur gyur pa ni/ 'jam dpal sku mdog dkar po zhal drug phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can du gsal bar gyur/ rang sems gsal la rtog pa med pa me long ye shes so/ /de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can mgon med skyabs med pa rnams/ sdug bsngal las bsgra' te gnas 'di 'a/ dgod par bya'o/ /bdag gzhan chos thams cad stong pa nyid du ro gcig pa/ mnyam nyid ye shes so/ /de ltar ma rtogs pa'i zhes pa nas/ dgos par bya lo bar gong bzhin/ oX a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharmā ṇaX/ a rgyu nu skron twa ta/chos thams cad so so gdod ma nas ma skyes pa/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sogs/ gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i rang sems ngo bo nyid kyis 'od gsal ba/ chos dbyings ye shes so/ /de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sogs/ dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du sems can gyi don lhun gyis grub par 'gyur ba ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /de ltar —/85—

ma rtogs pa'i sogs/ de dag ni ye shes kyi tshogs te yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /de ltar sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba de nyid/ a yig skar ma'i phung po lta bu nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ de las spros pa'i hu yig sngon po khro bo'i tshogs 'phro zhing 'od zer 'khrug pa'o/ /yang de las rigs bdun la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa smru/la/ zhing khams thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad/ sems can thams cad yongs su sbyangs/ slar 'dus te hu yig khro bo dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing drug khyab pa'i tshad can/ rwa rnams phyogs kyi mdog dang mtshungs pa gyen du langs pa'o/ /lte ba'i phyi ngos la gnas pa'i khro zhal drug las bzhi phyogs kyi mdog can dang / shar stod shar smad gnyis dkar po'o/ /rdo rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /rdo rje lte ba'i nang du/ bhu las mchod rten chen po phyogs kyi mdog can stong gsum gyi tshad dang mnyam pa'o/ /mchod rten chen po'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /de yi bum pa'i nang du sdi las chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa/ stong par ma'i tshad dang mnyam pa'o/ /chos 'byung chen po'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /de'i nang du ā las sna tshogs rdo rje stong spyi phud kyi tshad dang mnyam pa'o/ /rdo rje rgya gram gyi ting nge 'dzin no/ /de'i lte bar bhu las thar nga/ chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu dang / pha gu dang / dra phyed dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab kyis mdzes pa/gser gyi ka bas brgyan pa/ rta babs kyi rtse mor/ pad+ma dang / 'khor lo dang /gdugs dang / ri dwags la sogs pas mdzes pa/ de'i nang gi phyed du gzhal yas khang nang ma gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi rta babs sogs mtshan nyid thams cad tsho phya che sri/ —186—

dang 'dra ba las/ lha snam gyi dbus su rdo rje'i 'phreng bas skor ba la 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa'i lte bar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dang / ya phubs phyur bu'i rnam pa/ rtse mor tog dang bcas pa'o /gzhal yas khang phyi nang gnyis kar ya/nga /sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ steng 'og gi gzhi dang 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang / gzhal yas khang nang ma'i dbus kyi gzhi dang 'khor lo'i lte ba kha dog dkar ba/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i dbus kyi lte bar sa las seng ge'i gdan phyogs kyi rtsibs bzhi la/ shar du ga las glang po che/ lhor a las rta/ nub tu ma las rma bya/ byang du kha las mkha' lding ste/ srog chags de rnams kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri re re/ de'i steng du pa las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ dar gyi glo gdan rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan dang / lha gzhan rnams kyi gnas su pad+ma nga/nga zla ba'i gdan re re grub par gyur/ de dag ni gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i a yig babs te yongs su gyur nga/ las/ rang nyid gzhi'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad chen po/ sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi pa/ ral pa'i con pan can/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa/ dar gyi 'e bza' can/ rgyan spangs pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i dhī yig dkar po yongs su gyur nga/ las/ dang po'i sangs rgyas 'a 'a/ lnga pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ sku lus dang steng zhal dkar ba/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yas ser/ rgyab dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/ phyag g.yas bzhis ral gri/ g.yon bzhis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis —187—

bzhugs pa/dar gyi na bza' dang bcas nga/'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i rtsibs bzhi phyogs mdog dang /shar stod shar smad kyi rtsibs dang / lte ba dang / phyi rol dang / nang gi mu khyud bzhi rnams dkar po/ de'i lte bar yang a yig dkar po'o/ /de'i 'od zer las sprul pa'i yi ge ni/ nang gi mu khyud dang po la/ oX sarba dharmā ā bha wa swa bhā wa bi shudhe badz+ra tsak+ṣu a ā aX a/ mu khyud gnyis pa la/ a ā i yī gi / mū e i tse( 6( aX a/ rtsibs drug gi shar rtsibs 'a// oX duXkha tshe da ya te na maXsngon po/ lho rtsibs la/ lkoX wā gi shwa ra ya te na maXser po/ nub rtsibs la/ oX badz+ra tik+ṣa ya te na maXdam/ra po/ byang rtsibs la/ oX dz+nyā na kā ya ya te na maXljang khu/shar stod la/ nyoX pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mu rta ye ya te na rma ༷༷dkar po/ shar smad la/ oX a ra pa tsa na ya te na maXdakar ngo// phyi rol mu khyud gsum pa la/a āXsarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya/ ha ra ha ra/oX huX hiXbha ga wān dz+nyā na murti wa gi shwa ra mahā pa ca sarba dharmā ga ga ṇa a ma la su pa ri shudhe dharma dha tu dz+nyā na gar+bha āXmu khyud bzhi pa la/ ka kha ga gha nga /tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ṭa ṭha ḍa lha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha/ 'khor lo'i lte ba'i a yig yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal zhal drug pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ sku lus dang steng gi zhal nyis rtsegs dkar ba/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yas ser rgyab dmar g.yon ljang ba/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yas pas gi khyu la dmar po dang / g.yon pas sngon po'i rtsa ba 'dzin cing / sdong po g.yas g.yon du rgyas pa/me tog snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na po tis mtshan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil —188—

mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' dang / in+t+ra nī la'i gtsug phud la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ nyi ma 'char ka lta bu'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ sku'i mgrin pa man chad long bu yan chad du/ sprul pa'i sku dpag tu med pas bltams pa'o /de'i thugs kar yang zla ba'i dkyil 'a/bor gyi steng du skye med kyi ngo bo a yig dkar go mi shes pa'i ri bo 'jom/sa par byed pa/ a yig de las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa'i sku gang / phyir 'phros te rim pas shes rab kyi 'khor lo dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas dang / gzhi'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gang / zhal bzhi nas spros te 'jig rten gsum snang bar byas/ gzhal yas khang dang rgya gram dang / chos 'byung dang /mchod rten dang / rdo rje chen po'i nang gang / khro zhal drug nas 'ong/ zer kha dog drug ldan du 'phros/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par byas/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can tham/sa cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'jam dpal rigs bdun gyi go 'phang la bkod/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs/rdo rje chen po la skor ba lan gsum byas te/ khro zhal drug nas zhugs/ji ltar spros pa'i rim pa rnams lugs las zlog pa'i tshul gyis zhugs nas/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i a la thim nga/ra gyur/ de dag ni byang chub rdzu 'phrul dang po sbyor ba'i rim pa'o/ /da ni dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la/ bla ma snga ma rnams 'od zer spro ba'i sgo/ mjad pa mjad pa'i sgo/ slar bsdu ba'i sgo/ brtan par 'khod pa'i sgo/ phyag mtshan thugs kyi sgo/ phyag chen sku'i sgo/spros shing phyung ba'i sgo/ zhes pa don tshan bdun gyi skyed par byed kyang bdun po mi dgos la/ bzhi pa —189—

la yi ge spro ba'i sgo/ zhes byas na legs par 'gyur ro/ /slar yang ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i a las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ shes rab kyi 'khor lo nas/ rdo rje chen phi bar du rim gyis gsal bar byas shing / dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par gyur to/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i sems can gyi don mdzad/ sgrib gnyis thams cad yongs su sbyangs te/ 'jam dpal lha lnga bcu nga bdun gyi go 'phang la bkod/'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad mchod pas mnyes par byas so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs rnams/ 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur bsdus/ ro gcig tu 'dres/ sngar gyi lam las 'ongs te/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i a yig dang gcig tu gyur/ slar yang a yig las byung ba'i 'od kyi phung po de lī sa sa bon yig 'bru rnams su gyur/ thugs ka nas phyir spros dang po'i sangs rgyas dang gzhi'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs ka nas kyang phyung / so so'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa ni/ shar du khru/ lhor a/ nub tu 'a hā byang du ā shar lhor a/ lho nub tu ā/ nub byang du i/ byang shar du yī/ 'khor lo phyi ma'i rtsibs rnams la/ a ā i yī u mū e i tse( oṃ( a a a ā e i/ nang gi grwa bzhi la/lā mā gī snu/ gzhal yang khang phyi ma'i gra bzhir/ dhu bu a ga /phyi'i lha snam la/ a yig bcu drug /sgo bzhi la/ dza hū ba ho rnams su gyur to/ /sa bon de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rim pa bzhin du/ rdo rje rin chen pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /lag nyal nor bu 'dam skyes rgya gram khra bo dang / /rdo rje lcags kyu mda' gzhu se go'/ phyag rgya dang / /rin chen nyi ma/ rgyal mtshan so'i 'phreng ba dang / /pad+ma —190—

ral gri 'khor lo rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lja gas/ /sna tshogs rdo rje go khrab mche ba khu tshur dang / /rdo rje 'phreng rgyud pi wang rdo rje rtse gsum dang / spos sno da me tog phor pa gong bu dung chos dang / /rdorje bzhi dang nor bu bzhi dang pad+ma bzhi/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bzhi ste lha snam dag la gnas/ /sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'o/ /phyag mtshan rnams las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can gyi don rdzogs par byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod de/ slar 'dus shing thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dkyil 'kho/ra gyi lha lnga bcu rtsa gnyis yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ lko a ā sa/rba ta thā ga ta hri da ya nas/ dz+nyā na gar+bha ā 'khor 'e1'i rtsibs brgyad las shar du mi bskyod pa sngon ngo/ g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ snyane a ā nas/ dz+nyā na gar+bha ā lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po/g.yas mchog sbyin dang / ga skus na mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ de ba 'phyo du gzhan rnams la yang sbyar te/ tse( a/ ā sogs sngags re brjod cing lha re gsal btab bo/ /ṭa/ba tu stu(da dpag med dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ byang du don yodatshogrub pa ljang khu/g.yas skyabs/ sbyin dang / g.yon mnyam gzhag ma/dzad pa/ bzhi ka'ang rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing / dbu brgyan rdo rje rin po ches spras pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rigs sngags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs so/ /shar lcor sems ma rdo rje ma/ dkar mo rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu rin chen rdo rje ma sngon mo rin po che 'dzin pa/nub byang du chos kyi rdo rje ma dmar mo pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang shar du las kyi rdo rje ma ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ 'khor lo phyi ma'i shar gyi rtsibs bzhi la/ rdo rje —/91—

sems dpa' g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rdo rje rgyal po g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje chags pa phyag gnyis mda' gzhung 'gengs pa/ rdo rje legs pa phyag gnyis se gol rtog pa ste/ shar phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi sngon po'o/ /lho'i rtsibs bzhi la rim pas rdo rje rin chen g.yas rin po che 'dzin pa/ rdo rje gzi brjid g.yas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ rdo rje tog g.yas rin po che'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ rdo rje bzhad pa phyag gnyis so'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa ste lho phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi ser po'o/ /nub kyi rtsibs bzhi la rdo rje chos phyag gnyis pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rdo rje rnon po g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba/ rdo rje rgyu g.yas 'khor lo ser po skor ba/ rdo rje smra ba rdo rje'i ljags 'dzin pa ste/ nub phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi dmar po'o/ /byang gi rtsibs bzhi la rim pas rdo rje las g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rdo rje bsrung ba phyag gnyis rdo rje'i go khrab 'dzin pa/ rdo rje gnod sbyin phyag gnyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i mche ba 'dzin pa/ rdo rje khu tshur phyag gnyis dam tshig gi khu tshur 'ching ba ste byang phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi ljag bu'o/ /nang gi grwa bzhir shar lhor sgeg mo sngon mo rdo rje rtse lnga pa snyems pa'i tshul gyis dkur brten pa/ lho nub tu 'phreng ba ma ser mo rin po che'i 'phreng rgyud 'phyang ba/ nub byang du glu ma dmar mo pi wang rdung ba/ byang shar du gar ma ljang khu rdo rje rtse gsum pa gnyis snams nas gar sgyur ba/ phyi'i grwa bzhi la shar lhor bdug spos ma sngon mo spos snod 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu me tog ma ser mo me tog gis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ nub byang du mar me ma dmar mo mar me'i kong bu 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dri chab ma ljang khu dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ o —192—

a ā sogs tshar bzhi brjod la/ byams pa spos kyi glang po dang / /'jam dpal ye shes tog ste bzhi/ /sngon po rdo rje sems dpa' 'dra/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi lha snam skol 'o /yang sngags bzhi dang / bzang skyong blo gros rgya mtsho dang / /blo gros mi bzad spobs pa brtsegs/ /ser po rdo rje rin chen 'dra/ /lho yi phyogs kyi lha snam la'o /sngags bzhi bzlas/ mthu chen ngan song kun 'dren dang / /mya ngan 'joms pa dra can 'od/ /dmar po rdo rje chos dang 'dra/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi lha snam la'o/ /yang sngags bzhi/ zla 'od gzhon nu bdud rtsi'i 'od/ /nam mkha' mdzod dang sgrib sel rnams//ljang khu rdo rje las dang 'dra/ /byang gi phyogs kyi lha snam la'o /phyi'i shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lto sgor rdo rje zhags pa ser po zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar po lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang sgor rdo rje 'bebs pa ljang khu dril bu 'dzin pa/ o.a ā nas/ dz+nyā na gar+bha ā sems ma rdo rje ma nas rtsams te de thams cad rang rigs gyi rgyal ba'i cod pan gyis mdzes par byas pa'i rgyan dang cha lugs can/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang / dar gyi na bza' gso la ba/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs shing phyag g.yon na po tis mtshan pa'i ut+pal bsnams pa/dmigs bsal can rnams ma gtogs/ phyag g.yon pa rnams kyi khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /yang lugs 'di'i rgya gar gyi bris sku khungs ma 'ga' las ni/ rigs lnga nas rtsams te lha thams cad la/g.yon na ut+pal la gnas pa'i po ti dang / g.yas phyogs su ut+pal la brten pa'i ral gri bris pa'ang snang ngo / /'di'i lha rnams kyi bzhugs tshul la yang rdor dbyings kun snying lugs kyi rigs 'dre mi 'gro la/ lha tshogs rnams byung rdzogs su spro ba skyed chog cung zad bsdus pa 'di/ 'di nying kyi rang lugs yin gyi re re bzhin rkangs 'thon du spro zhing / lha so so'i dag pa cung zad gsungs pa dang sbyar —193—

nas/ so so'i dgos kyi mdzad pa sogs sbyor ba ni/ spros pa la dga' ba tsam mtshon par byed do/ /rgyun gyi nyams len dang mdor bsdus pa'i skabs/ lha thams cad la dmigs nas/ rtsa sngags tshar gcig kho na brjod de/ de rjes gas/la btab pas kyang chog go /de dag ni dam tshig bskyed pa ste/dkyil stsor rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ 'jam dpal sku mdog ser po byung te las rnams mdzad par gyur/ mchod rdzas rnams la dmigs te/ oX badz+ra yak+ṣa hruX phaṭa/ dri bzang gi chus gtor/ bgegs rnams bsangs par bsam/ oX badz+ra shi ṣa re ru ṭa ma ṭa hūX phaṭa/ ces thams cad dag par byas par bsam/ oX su bhā wa shu zhi sarba dharma swa bhā wa shu khro3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oX las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog / bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oX āXhuX/ oX āXhuX/ oX badz+ra pur+sha hūX/ de bzhin du dhu pe/ ā lo ke ga rnye/ ne we te/ shasta rnams la yang sbyar/ lkoX badz+ra a be sha ya hūX phaṭa kyi sgo dbye/ lkoX badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoXsnying ga'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad nam mkha'i dbus su spyan drangs par gyur/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs nga/ yi/ /'phags pa 'jam dbyangs bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren pas/ /deng 'dir sangs rgyas kun gshegs te/ /dngos grub 'dir ni stsal du gsol/ /oX e hre hi bha ga wān/badz+ra ang gu sha dzaXhuX baX hoXs ma ya stuX/ bcom ldan thugs rje byon pa legs/ /bdag ni bsod nam skal —194—

bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oX ar+ghaX pū ja me gha sa mu dra sla ra ṇa sa ma ye skyoX/ ji ltar bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i ye shes lha/ /gzung 'dzin dri ma mi mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i don du sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra wa ra sa ta kā ra pra tisnro swāhā/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oX badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha hūX/ de ltar mchod yon zhabs bsil/ gdan rnams phul nas/ oX mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ oX badz+ra aX gu sha dzaX oX badz+ra pā sha skyoX/ oX badz+ra sbo ṭa baX/ oX badz+ra ā be sha āX zhes pas ye shes sems dpa' sgo bzhi nas bcug/ces man ngag dang lag len las 'byung zhing /dkyil chog gi dngos bstan la/shar sgo nas 'jug pa kho na las med do//oX ya mun+ta ka huX phaṭa/phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ badz+ra ban+ta skyoX/ gis sgo bcad/ lkoX a āXnas/ dz+nyā na gar+bha a/ sbru khyi sa ma ya stuX ā haX/ zhes pas bdag dang ye shes sems dpa' dang dam tshig sems dpa' rnams phan tshun du bltas/ yang / oX a āXnas/ gar+bha āX dro shu dzaXhuX baX hoX sa ma ya stuX/ ā haX/dam tshig sems dpa' dang ye shes sems dpa' dbyer meng/ du gyur/ oX phro satwa skyoX/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar pad zla la āX lkoX a āXnas/ gar+bha ā ༷༷ oX badz+ra karma oX/ a las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang gzhan yang 'phags pa thams cad kyi yon tan dang 'phrin las rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur bsdus/ a la thim/ de sna tshogs rdo rje as mtshan par gyur/ las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /gong bzhin rtsa sngags de nyid kyi mthar/ oX badz+ra dharma hiX lha thams cad kyi mgrin 195—

pa'i gnas su pad zla la sdi dmar po/ de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa rnams kyi gsung gi ye shes thams cad tshur bsdus/hi la thim pa las/ pad+ma dmar po as mtshan par gyur/chos kyi phyag rgya'o//yang rtsa sngags kyi mthar/o badz+ra tsakra go lha thams cad kyi spyi gtsug tu pad zla la o las 'od 'phros/sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa thams cad kyi sku'i ye shes rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur bsdus/ o la thim pas 'khor lo lko gyis mtshan par gyur/ phyag rgya chen po'o/ /yang rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ o badz+ra satwa hū/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar pad zla la hu las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi ye shes rnams tshur 'dus/ hū la thim pa las rdo rje hu gis mtshan par gyur/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs che ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung yang yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku che ba/ /sangs rgyas/ kun gyi thugs la gnas/ /gtso bo chos kyi sbyin bdag ste/ /phyag rgya bzhi ba'i don ston pa'o/ /de dag ni phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab bo/ /dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khore dang bcas pa o badz+ra sa mā dza lko pur+sha hū/ sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/ o a bhi khi ྅ mi tā ma sarba ta thā ga ta/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ pra kri ti pa ri shudha sarba dharma ya tu ta sarba ta thā ga ya dz+nyā na kā ya/ mnyu re ri pa ri shu khyu/ ta mu pa da ya tī a a/ sarba ta thā ga ta mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣañtsa ma/ zhes dbang bskur bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang / skal bzang bcu drug la rin po che'i cod pan no/ /gzhan rnams la rang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ 'dir yo ga spyi'i chog sgros sbyar nas las bcol byed pa'i srol yod kyang mi dgos te/ rang gzhung las ma bshad cing / des dod thub gzhan 'chad 'gyur ltar yod —196—

pas so/ /gtso bo'i thugs ka'i a yig las 'od zer 'phros/ shes rab 'kho ra lo nas/ rdo rje chen po'i bar gsal bar byas/ sems can gyi don byed pa dang de bzhin gshe/gas pa rnams mchod pa'i bya ba byas te/ yang snying ga'i a yig la bsdu/ de ltar spro bsdus yang yang byed pa ni las la sbyor ba'i dod do/ /de ni sgrub thabs kyi gzhung las/ sgra las 'phel te rgyad bshang pa/ /zhes pa'i don yin zhing / ye shes spyan 'dren dang / phya ga rgya ba'i dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab sogs dkyil chog las rgyas shing gas la bar 'byung ba ni/ sgrub thabs su/de nas las kyi khyad par yang / /bskyed pa'i zhar las 'byung ba ste/ /zhes pas na don bstan to/ /de nas dkyil 'khro ra gyi lha tshogs la rma/chod pa ni/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ /lha rdzas dam nga/'i me tog 'di/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /o na ma sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pukhye/ pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hū/ 'og ma rnams la'ang des rigs 'dres te/ nags/ tshal bcud ni yid 'ong ba/ /lha rdzas dam ba'i bdug spos ni/ / thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /ci bde /badz+ra dhu pe shu/ dza/ snang ba'i khyad/ par gang yod pa'i/ /lha rdzas ngam pa'i mar me 'di/ /thub dbang : /bdag dang 'grol thugs brtse'i phyir/ /ci bde / ā lo rke /a kar tsan+dan la sogs chu/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i dri mchog 'di/ /thub dbang :/bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /ci bde /ga rnye/ ro mchog brgya dang lngan pa yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zas mchog 'di/ /thub dbang jo /bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /ci bde: /ne we te/ tshangs pa'i gsung ltar snyan pa yi/ /lha rdzas nga/ma nga/'i sil snyan 'di/ /thub dbang : /bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i —197—

phyir/ /ci bde /badz+ra gī ti rā ga shasta pū dza/ deng nas rtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras dang bcas pa rnam rol zhing / /rdo rje snyems ma'i rab sbyor gyi//dga' ston bde bas mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra lā phya hu/ sgeg dang bcas pa'i 'phreng ba 'phangs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /de ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur/ /'phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /o badz+ra mā le tru/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya/ /des ni bde gshegs dngos grub ni/ /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /o badz+ra gī ti sdi de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'dul ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar bgyis/ /o badz+ra dra ti a/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis rni tshim par gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra dhu pe skyo/sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa/ /mtshan dang nga/pe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur/ /o badz+ra pur+sha skyo/chos kyi me rbi legs spar bar/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru /sems can ma rig ldongs pa la/ /ye shes sgron me sbar bar bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke spru/ rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yis/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ /oṃ badz+ra ga rnye ā de nas/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan 'phreng ldan/ /sogs 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa 'bul te/ sngags rnams kyang rū pa pū dza me gha sogs gong mas rigs 'dre'o/ /spros pa chung ba la mos pa'am/ /bdag nyid thun bzhi'i nyams len sogs kyi skabs su/spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol —198—

mchod pa'i tshigs bcad rnams bor te/ sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis kyang chog go /de nas dril thabs dang bcas te/mchog sbyin rdo rje sogs lpod nyi shus bstod/oX sbi to hri di dz+nyā na mu rta ra haX/ burnyo bo dhi naX tru dho brti naX/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis/ rang nyid las kyi 'jam dpal ser po gsal ba/ gzhi'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad gangs can mtsho la phyag byas te thugs kar zhugs par gyur/ oṃ sgri to sogs kyis/ dang po'i sangs rgyas la phyag byas te de'i yang thugs kar zhugs par gyur/ oX sbi to sogs/ shes rab kyi 'khor lo la phyag byas te/ 'bor lo'i lte bar phyin par gyur/ oX snyi to sogs/ ye shes sem sa dpa' la phyag byas te/ de'i thugs kar thim nas thugs ka'i a yig ngang gnyis su meng par gar/ 'ad kyal 'khor gyi / / / / / ( / 'a spu me ༄lja'akhor lo thams cad sgyu ma ltar shes par byas la mnyam/ par bzhag cing / thig le'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa'i man ngag rnams kyang spro na skabs 'dir bsgom mo/ /de nas bzlas pa ni/ lha thams cad dam gtso bo kho na'i thugs kar zla ba la a yig gi mthar/ gang bzla ba'i sngags kyi 'phreng bas skor ba sgom/ spro bsdu'i rim pa gong—du bshad pa rnams kyis rigs 'dres te/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ngang ldan pas bzlas brjod bya'o/ /i tshe sarba dharma a bhā wa swa bhā wa bi da shu khyu/ badz+ra ca ku a a aX a/ zhes pa ni yang snying ngo / /a ā sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya/ ha ra ha ra oX hiXbha ga wān dz+nyā na murti wa gī shwa ra/ mahā pa tsa sarba dharma ga ga ṇa a ma la su pa ri shudha dharma dh+wa tu dz+nyā na gar+bha āX zhes pa ni rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oX badz+ra tik+ṣa du kha ts+tsha da pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mu rta ye/dz+nyā na kā ya wā gi shwa ra a ra pa tsa na ya te na maX zhes pa ni rigs bsdus pa'i snying po'o//'jam dpal gyi snying po yi ge drug pa gzhan yang bzlar rung zhing / mtshan yang dag par brjod pa nyid 'don pa'ang bzlas pa'i rnam grangs su 'gyur ro/ /thun 'jog pa na/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ dang por/no —199—

mchog spyin rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ mchod yon zhabs bsil nyer spyod lnga po rnams gong du bshad pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas phul/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya la 'don pa spos te/ tse( mañdzu shrī sa ma ya/ zhes dang / mnyu phy-i/ te no zhes dang / sarba ta thā ga ta mañdza phy-i/ mā me muñtsa zhes pa rnams so/ /de ltar lan gsum bzlas pas brtan par byas te/ ye shes sems dpa' dang lhan cig byon pa'i mgron rnams la dmigs nas/ ma 'byar pa dang nyams pa dang / /sogs dang / o khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra mu zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ thugs ka'i a las 'od zer 'phros/ dkyil 'khore thams cad /byab ste/phyi ma phyi ma 'od du zhu nas nang ma nang ma la thim/skye med a yig spros pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur/ slar yang dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o/ /'dir phyag rgya dgrol ba mi dgos te/ lag pa'i phyag rgya ma bcings pa'i phyir ro/ / bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol pa yang mi dgos te/ rang gzhung las ye ma bshad cing / don gyis thob pa yang min pa'i phyir ro/ /'di yo ga'i lugs yin pa'i phyir de dag dgos so snyam na/ khyab par yang ma nges la/ lugs 'di rgyud sde bzhi'i zlas phye ba'i rnal 'byor rgyud kyi cho gar byas pa'ang ma yin no/ / des na 'di rnal 'byor chen po thabs rgyud du bkral ba'i lugs yin te/ rgyu mtshan rgyas par bla ma'i zhal las rtogs dgos shing cung zad 'og tu 'chad pa la lta bar bya'o/ /'di ni bsnyen pa rgyas pa yin zhing / bsdus pa ni dang po sbyor ba tsam yin la 'di rigs bsdus yin zhing / rigs so so ba la ni/ mi bskyod pa'i thugs kar dang po'i sangs rgyas/de'i thugs sa kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad la/ o du kha tshe da ya te na ma lte bar hū las rdo rje'i rigs kyi 'jam dpal sngon po/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs kar yang hu sngon po gi /de bzhi du/ rin chen 'byung —200—

ldan gyi thugs kar dang po'i sangs rgyas/ de'i thugs kar shes rab kyi ge dur lo rtsibs brgyad pa la/ oX bā gī shwa ra ya te na maX lte bar truX ngam aX las rin chen rigs kyi 'jam dpal g.yas ral gri dang g.yon rin po che 'dzin pa'i thugs kar zla ba la truX ngam aX ser lnga'o/ /'od dpag med kyi thugs kar yang dang po'i sangs rgyas/ de'i thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ lkoX badz+ra tik+ṣa ya te na maX nye bar hiXlas pad+ma'i rigs kyi 'jam dpal dmar po/g.yas ral gri dang g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa'i thugs kar yang zla ba la hruXdamar po'o/ /don yod grub pa'i thugs kar yang shes rab kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ oX dz+nyā na kā ya ya te na maX lte bar las kyi rigs kyi 'jam dpal ljang khu g.yas ral gri dang g.yon rgya gram 'dzin pa/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i āX'o/ /rnam snang gi thugs kar yang shes rab kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad pa/oX pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mu rta ye ya te na maX lte bar oX las 'jam dpal dkar po g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ thugs kar yang zla ba'i steng du oX mo/ /srog chags lnga car gyis bteg pa'i khri gcig gi steng du/ dar gyi glo gdan dang /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la/ aXlas byang sems rdo rje dkar po/ rdo rje sems dpa' spyi dang 'dra ba'i thugs kar dang po'i sangs rgyas/ de'i thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa la/ oX a ra pa tsa na ya te na maX 'khor lo'i lte bar a las byang chub sems kyi 'jam dpal dkar po/ ral spi dang po ti 'dzin pa'i thugs kar yang āXdakar po bsam/ de ltar de rnams thams cad la 'khor lo'i kha dog lha'i mdog dang mtshungs la/mu khyud la sogs pa gong du bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /'di rnams gtso bo go —201—

'pho ba'i tshul gyi sgom pa ste/ rigs so so'i sgrub pa pos nyams su blang bar bya ba yin mod kyi/ de dag gi cho ga'i khyad par mi 'dra ba rnams dang / lha tshogs kyi dbye ba'i khyad par rngams/ ni/ yi she mang ba'i phyir 'dir ma bris/gzhan yang khrus kyi rnal 'byor dang / chu sbyin dang / maṇ+ḍal dang / phyag dang / tsha tsha gdab pa dang /skor ba dang /gtor ma dang /sbyin sreg ste/rnal 'byor gyi yan lag brgyad po rnams la'ang nan tan du bsgrub par bya'o/ /yang sgrub thabs kyi sa zhung las sgo phrag gnyis ma dang / dkyil chog las mtshan gyi lha rnams bkod pa'i sgo phrag gsum ma yang gsungs shing / dmigs pa mdor bsdus la dga' bas ni/ dkyil 'khor sgo rkyang yang rung ngo zhes shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la/ sa'i cho ga /sta gon gyi cho ga /dngos gzhi'i cho ga ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshang bar byas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang /gnas yo byin rlabs/ rgyud sde 'og ma rnams dang thun mong gi cho ga spyi'i lugs dang mthun par btang / oṃ pra kri te pa ri shudha nas/hūX gi sgra drag po sgrog pa'o/ /ya mun+ta ka'i sngags bzla zhing / bsang chus phyogs thams cad du gtor bar bya'o/ /de ni mi shis pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad spyir bsang ba yin te/ sa chog gi sngon 'gro'o/ /oṃ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ tshom bu'i steng du baX las sa'i lha mo ser mo zhi ba phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa 'dzin pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaXdzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi khri phu khoX/ rin po che'i cod pan gyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ oṃ pri thi bī de bī badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar nas/ badz+ra sdi khye huX nas/ shasta huX gi bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma 'bul na/ na —202—

ma sarba ta thā ga ta rje/ sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas phul/ skra(ba pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod nga/'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ shwakya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde 'a sa/ /rgyal bar byas nas dkyil 'khor 'bri/ /lan gsum/ phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig /ces gnang ba sbyin/ o badz+ra u sni ṣ+ṭha sa'i lha mo nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur// de ni sa blang pa'o/ /de nas drag po dang /zhi ba'i spyin sreg dang /rkong sbyangs bya ba sogs kyang bar 'dir bshad do/ /de ni sa sbyang ba'o/ /'on kyang da ltar lag len de dag mi byed de/ meng kyang chog rgo/spos kyi chu dang yungs kar sogs kyis sa la gtor/ a a sogs rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas/lag ma/thil sa la mnyam par reg ste/ tso rna mañdza phy-i/ sa ma ya sogs lan gsum bzlas te sa bzung ba'o/ spyode nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbus su 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro nas rtsams bzlas nga 'i bar dang / bstod mchod yig brgya rnams gong bsnyen pa'i skabs su bshad pa bzhim bya la/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi snying gar skad cig gis bsdu/ kha dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi stong pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hu hū las sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/deng du bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam par/ /'gyu/ra bar bdag nyid the tshom med/ /byang chub sems dang sems gcig par/ /mi zlog par ni bdag gyur te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su ni/ /deng bdag skye bar the tshom med/ /deng bdag nyi ma dam pa ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren pas/ /bdag gi mchod spyin bla na med/ /deng bdag 'dus pa'i mchog yin no/ /zhes brjod de/sa gzhi byin gyis rlab pa'o//—203—

snye snye——snye rderdede nas bdug spos thogs te dri' gsil dang bcas pas/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas thams cang/ dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ / 'jam dpa'i dbyangs kyi dkyi/ la 'khore 'bri/ /sangs rgyas la sogs kun 'byon 'tshal/ /dngos grub 'dir ni stsal du gsol/ /ces pa ni dbang po spyan 'dren pa'o/ /a ā sogs rtsa sngags ci rigs par bzlas te/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal brtan por skyed pa ni/go cha byin gyis rlab pa'o/ /slob ma phyag na rdo rje zhi ba sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin nga/'i skur gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dkyil 'khor che/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo sna tshogs 'chang / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor ra chen por bsad du sa sol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin po/degs pa kun gyi sa/myos/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las byung ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gso la/ /rgyud chen sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ /rdo rje 'chang chen gsang sngags 'chang / /dpag med rnams kyis dga' bzhin du/ /dkyil 'khore gtso bo bshad du gsol/ /ces pa ni slob mas gsol ba btab pa'o/ /'dir dpe 'ga' zhig las/ zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / / zhes sogs bris pa ni/ rang bzo mkhan gyis bcug pa'o/ /de nas/ tse( sarba ta thā ga ta pā da ban+ta na ka ro mi/ rang nyid khro bo gshin rje gshed kyi skur gyur/ mig gnyis su ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba hū gis mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su hū las rdo rje rgya gram 'od 'bar ba/ dbus nas dbang ldan du song zhing / de nas g.yas skor du g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang gi 'gros kyis bcags shing / nga ni rang nyid rdo rje can/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje rang nyid/ /nga ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /stobs chen sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid/ /bdag po chen po rdo rje'i bdag /byin —204—

gyis rlabs pa mi 'dor ro/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i dod da sa/gzhi la po / nas pa'i// sna la sogs pa bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /gnas 'dir 'jam da pal ro brang dkyil 'khor 'bri/ /bgegs kyi rigs tshogs gang yin byer bar gyis/ /'es brjod cing / gzhin rje gshed dang bdud rtsi 'byil pa'i sngags drag tu bzlas/ rol mo'i sgu/bya'o/ /rgyas par spro na deng sang phyogs nam mkhar ltar zhes sogs tshig lhug pa'i bka' sgo yang bya/ shar du g.yas brkyang / lhor g.yon brkyang / nub tu zlum ngo / byang du sa ga'i stang stabs rnams kyis sdung bgegs bskrad do/ /bsdu na bka' bsgo tsam gyis kyang chog ste/ nge dag ni brgegs sa zhom pa'i bya ba'o/ /de nas phu ra bu/ swa bhā was stong bar sbya ngas / stong pa'i ngang las siX las byung ba'i phur bu khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ rdo rje dang sngas sa/ mdzub mdzad nga// ut+pal sngon po'i mdog can/ lte ba man chad phur ba'i dbyibs 4/ gnas par gyur/ oX badz+ra ki li gī la ya sarba bisnrun ban+ta hūX phaṭa/ ma/nga du bzlas/ hūX 'a sa/ byung pa'i rdo rje tho bar gyur/ snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros bgegs thams cad bkug ste/ rma tshams bzhi dang dbus su drag ngo/ 'brub /khung gi nang du bcug /phur bus brtab cing tho pas brdungs par gyur/ tseX( gha spru gha ta ya gha ta ya/ sarba sdo : ༷da phaṭa/ gī la ya ki la ya sarba pā paX phaṭa/ huX hūX riX badz+ra gī la badz+ra dha ro udz+nyā khro/ ya ti sarba bisnrun kā ya bka tsit+ta badz+ra gī la ya huX phaṭa/ dbus dang grwa bzhir gdab bo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbus su huX yig dang / de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og thams can rdo rje 'i sa gzhi/ phyogs mtsham/sa thams cad rwa ba dang dra ba steng thams cad gur dang bla re/ phyi rol 'bar ba'i phreng bas skor bar gyur/ oX badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huX/ yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i sa'i lha mo bkug ste/ sa —205—

sa zhi'i steng du gnas par gyur/ gong bzhin ma/chod yon la sogs pas mchod/ chos kyi dbyings nga/nga dbyer med/ lha mo ni/ /rnam dag sa gzhi sangs rgyas spyan ma'i ngang / /bdud 'joms sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /sa yi lha mo 'khor bcas bstod par bgyi/ /sa'i lha mo 'khor bcas dkyil 'khor gyis sa gzhi la thim/ de das ni sa srung ba'o/ /de ltar na sa chog gi sko ra 'a 'ad rnams/ gang dag lugs 'di nyid kyi gzhung srong bangs yod na de dag la dgongs par mthong nas/ rang gzhung ji lha ba bzhin du bkod pa yin la/chos chu' 'di zhar byung du byed pa rnga gru/sa kyis ni/ gsang ba spyi'i cho ga ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med do//gnyis nga/ lhag gnas la/ ldo lngag par gnas pa ni/ skya thig tsam btab la/ lha rnams kyi gnas su dri bzang thi thig le bko/da/smu/tha' rma chod pa/ sa skor/ya mun ta kas bsangs/ oṃ pra kri te pa ri shudha sarba bam pra kri te pa ri shu 〉 ྅haX/ oX sla bhā wa shudha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shurnyo ྅ haX/ stong pa'i ngang las hruX yig las srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du a las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lhe bar bhuX snyelas thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang / zhes pa nas/ gdan re re grub par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rnam snang chen po dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas dang / ye shes sems dpa' dbyer med pa/bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal zhal drug pa zhes pa nas/ dpag tu med pas bltams/ nga/'o/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad la shar du mi bskyod pa sngon po zhes pa nas/ khu tshur dkur brten pa'o/ /zhes ba'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin las/ a ā sogs rtsa sngags kyis lha 'god pa mi dgos/ mchod rdzas rnams/ skye( badz+ra yak+ṣa huX phaṭa kyis bsang ba nas/oX badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha huX phaṭa kyi bar dang /oṃ badz+ra ang ku sha dzaXnas/sa ma ya stuX ā haX/chu dang —206—
