thang las skyes pa yi/ /zhes pa nas/di ge ge ge 'dud ci rdo ru/bstod pa'i bar ya nga bdag bskyed bzhin cho//de nas spos dang bcas pa'i rdor dril 'dzin pas/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo rdo rje che/ /rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal 'o// /dkyil 'khor thus sa rje'i bdag nyid can/ /sogs spyi dang 'dra ba las/ 'jam dpal rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba sbyang phyir bri bar bya/ /zhes 'don pa spos te/snyan gsan dbab pa lan gsum bya/bar 'dir dkyil 'khor khang ba'i phyi rol tu song nas 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma chen mo gtong ngo / /de nas bum ba lhag gnas ni/ bsdus pa'i dbang du byas nas bum pa gnyis bsham/ rnam rgyal bum pa la rigs drug gi mtshan ma dang / las bum la sna tshogs rdo rje 'bri/ bum pa 'cha' tshul spyi dang 'dra/ yang / yak+tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong nga/'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i steng du/ baX las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang lha rdzas kyi chu bos yongs su gang ba lha so so'i gdan dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa grub par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/rnam snang chen po dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas dang / ye shes sems dpa' dbyer meng/ pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal zhal drug pa/ zhes pa nas gtams pa'o/ /shar du mi bskyod pa sngon po nas/ ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ de'i phyi rol shar du rdo rje sems dpa' nas/ sngon po'o/ /lho phyogs su rdo rje rin chen nas/ ser po'o/ /nub phyogs su rdo rje chos nas/ dmar po'o/ /byang phyogs su rdo rje las nas/ljang khu'o/ /shar lhor sgeg mo nas/ gar sgyur ba/ de'i phyi rim la shar lhor bdug spos ma nas/ dung chos 'dzin pa/ shar du byams pa spos kyi glang po nas/ byang gi phyogs kyi lha snam la ce'i bar la/ lha snam zhes pa/ gnas la'o/ / zhes 'don pa sgyur ba —207—

dang / de'i phyir rol shar du rdo rje lcags kyu nas/ khu tshur bkur brten pa'o/ /las bum gyi nang du pad nyi'i steng du sno las 'jam dpal gzhin rje gshed nas/ sgra drag po sgrog pa'o tsho /o badz+ra yak+tas bsangs pa nas/ shag hū gi bar/ e( badz+ra sa mā dzanas/spyan drangs par gyur/ dza hū ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ o na ma sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ar+gha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hū/ de bzhin du/ sha lta'i bar du sbya ra te mchod/'dud nyi shus bstod/ gshin rje gshed po bgegs kyi rgyal/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs la dpa'/ /dpa' bo bdud dgra bdud 'dul ba/ /bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal brnya dod/ /gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ rtsa sngags ci 'khru/ba tu bzla/ las bum la/ tse( ya mun+ta ka hu phaṭa/ brgya rtsa sogs bzlas/ thun mong du/ ā bhi che ka bzlas pa'i mthar/ 'jam dpal gyi yi ge brgya pa bdun la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pa brjod nas/ rlam rgyal bum pa la mchod yon phul te/ tse( ar+gha pū dza me gha sa mu dra sa ma ye hū/ lha rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bor zhu bar gyur/ las bum la yang sngags des phul nas/ ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs thams cad bzlog cing / las tham sa cad sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ces brjod/de nas gzhung las skabs 'dir slob ma lhag gnas bshad pa yin te/'og tu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor zhag gi bya ba ni/ mchod pa tshar gcig bshams/ gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs te/ar+gha nas sha tswa'i bar sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis mchod pa phul/ 'dud bstod bya/ 'jam dpal gyi yig brgya lan gsum/ 'jam dang/la rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams ni spyan drangs pa'i tshe 'dir byon te/ dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa dang / bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ o —208—

badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūX/ thig skud/ ya mun ta ka'i sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ thig skud sngon po la skyoX/ ser po la truX/ dmar po la sdiX ljang khu la āX dkar po la aX rnams kyis mtshan pa/ yig 'bru rnams sde bzhin gshegs nga/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin no/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi lha rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas/ yig 'bru lnga 'i tshogs dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang yig 'bru lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs/ thig skud kyi yig 'bru lnga la gnyis su med par thim/ hūṃ truX sdiXgi aX/ zhes mang du bzlas la/ yig 'bru rnams zhu zhing thig skud la thim nga/sa/ ye shes kyi srad bur gyur/ a āX sogs rtsa sngags brjod la sgra snye pa/ me tog la sogs pa nyer spyong/ lnga sngas sa tsam gyis mchod/yang rtsa sngags bzla bzhin du phyogs thams cad mnam nga/ nyid du cho/sa spro choX'es thig skud kyi sne grogs la gtad/ oX badz+ra sa ma ya mū tra mā ti kra ma hūX/ zhes brjod cing ye shes kyi thig chen brgyad po spyi dang 'dra bar btab/ de'i 'og tu las thig btab nas cha dbye bar bya'o /mthar thig skud la nyer spyod lngas mchod nas/ badz+ra muXs/ ye/ bes pa gshegs su gso la/ rdu'/ tshon byin gyis rlabs pa yang des rigs 'gres te/ tha dzig skud dang srad bu zhes pa'i gnas su/ rdul tshon zhes pa 3jug /sgril ba'i tshab tu mtheb srin gyi mnyes nas/ oX badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ye hūṃ/ mang du bzlas te/ 'di rne chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgro la byed/ /rgyal ba 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi bdag /zhes brjod de slob dpon gyis dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bris pa snod kyis bkab par bya la/ nge/ nas tshon ci bder 'gyed do/ /snye lha mtshan gye skabs gtso bo'i mtshan ma la 'khor lo dang / ral gri dang / ut+pal dmar po po tir bcas pa rnams sum rtseg tu 'bri bar bshad la/ gsum kar bri bar ma nus na/ ut+pal dang —209—

bcas pa'i po ti kho na 'bri/ mthar rdul tshon mchod de ye shes pa kra/zhegs so/ /jo bo spo tis mdzad pa'i sa sang ldan gyi 'grel par thig gi rnam/ gzhas la/ thig snri dang rngi/ 'dra ba zhig ma/dzad pa ni/ khenang nyid kyi bzhed ji/ yin gyi/ smeg pa'i rdo rje'i bzhed pa yi/na par ma nges pas/ thig rnams spyi dang 'dra bar btab pas rung la/ ma bo ra gyi lha mtshan rbi sgru ba thabs bzhin rno/ /da ji dngos gzhi'i rim pa la dkyi'/ 'kho/ra gyi mthar ra chod pas mdzes nga/ra byed pa ni nges nga ra dgas/ la/ phur bu dang / ma/da(re dang / ral gri ngang / tshom skung dang / re long la so/gas/ pas brgyan nga/ra bshad pa ltar 'grub na bya cho da/ ma grub kyang 'a po/'a/ ba re/da do/ /slob dpon gyis ldo rje gsor ji'/ bu dkrol zhing 'jar/ dpa8pa gyi yi ge brgya nga/ bzlos rnga dang ci bcas nga/sa/ dbang sgo snan nas sdu mas/ nge sa phya/sa su smor ba lan bdun bya'o/ /rnam/ rgya'/ bum/ pa dbus su bzhag kla ra cho/sa te dkyi3/ ra pa khar gyi shar du bzhag /la6ri/ bur/ dkyil 'a/bor gyi lco phyogs su bzhag go /rdu' tshon gyi dkyi'/ 'a spang la bgegs sbyang ba dang / sdig pa sbyang ba dang las bum ma/ma/ khrus bum gzhan gyis khrus sa so snye pa ba'i ji rma sbyang ba dang shis brjod ji ltar 'os/ nga ra bya'o/ /skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor sgrub pa' skros la nga kun la chog yon ta'o 'byung gnas las/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub nga/ra bya ste/ 'khor lo dang po'i ting nge ‘snaje na nas/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i ting nge 'dzen gyi par du bsgoms la/ bzlas pa/'i rngal 'byor rdzogs rnga dang ras zung du sbyar ba lha rnams la/ tso rna ā chi badz+ra bsta hūṃ/ zhes bya bas/ dbul lo/ /zhes sa sungs te/ de snyel 'bor lo dang po'i ting nge 'dzin zhes nga rme༈ gu chi/ mchog dang po'i la bor lo sbyo ra ba'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya/ sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro'i ming yin gyi dang ngo/ sbyor ba rma/ yin la/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ dngos sa zha ting 'dzin gsum/ gyi mi/rnga ngo / /de ྅ ra na gzhung gi dgangs/ pa ni bdag mdun dbyer rme/da du grags pa/ bdag bskyed la brten nas gzugs brlan gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i lugs yin te snga rabs pa mang po zhig kyang de ba ben du —210—

bzhed do/ /phyis kyi kha cig 'di skad ces/ dkyil 'khor sgrub par bya ste/ 'khor lo dang po'i teng nge 'dzin gyi bar bsgoms la/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor rdzogs pa zhes lung 'dren ma dag par mngon zhing / 'khor lo dang po'i ngos 'dzin dang po sbyor ba la byed de/ sgrub thabs gsang ldan dang dngos su 'gal ba'i spyi tol skyed nas/ rdo rje 'byung ba'i rgyas bkab byed nga/ 'di ni mi legs so/ /yang snga phyi mang po zhig sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor la phab pa'i rjes su dkyil 'khor sgrub ste rnam pa cig tu na de la 'gal ba med kyang / 'di nyid kyi rtsa ba'i gzhung rnams nas ma bshad cing /rdor 'byung sogs gzhung gzhan la skrun pa kho nar snang bas/skabs 'dir nge 'dra dgos pa ma yin no/ /des na sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ skyabs 'gro sems skyed tshad med bzhi rnams song ba na/ oX pra kri ti zhes pa nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor ra lo rang gi snying gar thim/ de nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ya mun+ta ka'i sngags kyis bsangs rtsa sngags lan gsum bzlas te/ bdag nyid rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khore gyi dbus su gnas par gyur/ oX swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ shes rab stong pa nyid de dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo zhes nga/ nas bzung ste/ phyag g.yon pa rnams kyi khu tshur dkur brten pa 'o/ /'es pa'i bar dang sbyor ba dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog rdzogs par byas te/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i a yig las 'od zer 3phres/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad lkoX badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX oX ya mu ste ka hūX phaṭa/ kyis bgegs bsal/ tseXr+sha na maXsarba ta thā ga ar+ghaX pū ja me gha sa/ mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye huX/ de bzhin du shasta 'a bar gyis mchong/ 'dud nyi shus bstod/ a āXsogs rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ khru sh+ya dzaXhūX baX hoXs ma ya stuX ā hāX/ lan gsum gyis/gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor dang / ting nge 'jin gyi dkyi'/ 'khor dang / sta —211—

gon gyi dkyil 'khore rnams ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ de rjes/ dkyil 'khor gyi gces bo'i thugs ka nas 'jam dpal sku mdor ga ser po zhes pa nas/ myong badz+ra 'a taṣ+ṭha bye/ de nas/ lha la tre dugs nga/ dri'i rdzas/ / zhes sogs tshigs/ bcad sbyar ba'am/ sngags rkyang pas cer spyong/ rol cho dang bcas pa phul/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo nas/ yang / snying ga'i a yig la bsdu'o/ /zhes pa'i bar bya/ nge/ nas mchod pa kha gsos te slar yang gong bzhin byin rlabs bya/ oṃ yan lag brgyad ldan lha rdzas arga'i rgyun/ /sems nyid rab tu dang ba 'od gsal dang / / zhing kun khyab par rab tu sprul nas kyang / /'jam dpal dkyil 'a/bor lha tshogs ma bye rdod par bgyi/ /tse( myo ma sarba ta thā ga ta ar+gha sogs/dri zhim zhabs bkru spos kyi chu bo 'di/ /sems nyid sogs/ grong bzhin/ pu du/ chu dang thang 95sa skyes pa yi/ /zhes pa nas 'dod yon lnga rdzogs pa'i bar/ las rgyal mchog bzhin byas nas/ cung zad spros ji/ la mo/sa na/ spyi dang ma/thun par rgyal srid sna bdun dang / mgo/na lnga1 thugs rje chen pos byin rlabs pa'i/ /bsod nams rgyu las byung ba'i 'khore lo 'di/ /'jam/ dpa‘ra rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs 'a// /phul bas 'gro kun bla med thob nga/ra shog /ga(zhan 'dra ba las/ dri me/nga/ shin tu mdzes pa'i dang/la be'u 'di/ /rin chen bcud kyis bar+sha gru/sa pa'i bum pa 'di/ /yi da 'ong 'dam gyis ma gos pad+ma 'di/ /sgra dbyangs phyo gas bcur sgrog pa'i dung dkar 'di/ /thogs med kun tu rgyu ba'i sa/ser nya /na rid/ /gdung ba ma lus skyob byed gdugs mdzes 'di/ /mi ma thun phyos sa las rgyal ba'i rgya' rma/chan 'di/ /zhes 'don pa rlu/ nge bzhin sngags kyang rim pa bzhin du/ mthi la tsakra/ mtho la shrī bta sa/ mtshu/ la gha ṭa/ ma sgo la ka ma la/ma ṅga la she /ba/ ma ṅga la rma/ta gya/ ma ṅga la tsha tru ga /ma sgo la dh+wa dza/ zhes 'don rnga/ spo/ de —2/2—

—nas mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod par byas te/ byang chub sems ni rang byung ba'i/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /don chen yi ge dam pa 'di/ /mchog spyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad che/ /gti mug blo ste gti mug sel/ /mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug ste/ /rdo rje 'chang ba khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ gdong drug mig drug lag drug pom /mche gtsigs gdong brgya kun 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /yang dag bdag med de bzhin nyid/ /stong nyid smra ba'i khyung de snam chag ste / /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang ba/ /med pa las byung /khyod la ‘sna dud/ /'dod pa 'i jo —ga krub ngan song sbyong / /mgon po nyon mongs dra ba 'joms// /sa gzhi tshangs gnas rkang pas gnon/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rtogs bya ba//thig le chen po yi ge med/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku kun gyi rgyal/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /khong nas khro byung ba skye ba med/ /sems ma/ rdo rje khyod 3/ 'dud/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /a ni 'gyung ba 'gog pa ste/ /tshig tu brjod pa rnam spangs pa/ /rin chen 'byung ma khyod la 'dud/ /so sor kun rtos ngo bo nyid/ /a ni brjod pa/'i rgyu yin te/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /chos kyi rdo rje /byod la 'dud/ /bya ba nan tan ngo bo nying/ /a ni yig 'bru sa sa la bar byed/ /tshig kun gsal bar byed nga yi/ /rdo rje dra ba khyong la 'dud/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin 'dod chags che/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyi nyid ma grub bde ba che/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gnyis ka med pa bde ba che/ /sangs —2/3—

rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /gtong ba'i don ldan mgu ba che/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /gzugs che lus kyang che ba ste/ / sangs rgyas 'dza / ma pa khyod la 'dud/ kha dog che la gzi brjid ldan/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud//ming che mtshan bzang rgya che ba/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud//bzhad cing dkyil 'khore las khyab pa/ /sangs rgyas bzhad pa khyod la 'dud//chos kyi shes rab mtshan 'chang ba/ /sangs rgyas gsung la phyag 'tshal 'dud//nyon mongs dra ba 'joms pa'i mchog /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /drag po rdo rje rgyu yi bdag /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /snang ba chen po gsal ba che/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /mkhas shing sprul 'chang rdo rje las/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po go cha sra/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul bdag nyid gnod sbyin gtso /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul khu tshur bstan cing bsdu/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /spyin bdag gtso chen gtso bo ste/ /rdo rje rnye ga mo khyo de la ‘re dud//tshul khrims chen po 'chang ba'i mchog /rdo rje dpa' 'phreng khyod 'a 'dud/ /bzod chen 'chang ba brtan pa po/ /rdo rje dbyangs mkhan khyod la 'dud/ /brtson 3grus chen po rtul ba yin/ /rdo rje gar mkhan khyod la 'dud/ /bsam gtan chen pom ting 'dzin gnas/ /rdo rje me tog khyod la 'dud/ /shes/ rab chen po lus/ 'chang ba/ /rdo rje bdug spos khyod la 'dud/ /smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho ste/ /rdo rje mar me khyod la 'dud/ /stobs po che la thabs che ba/ /rdo rje dag byed khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje lcags/ kyu 'dren nga/ ste/ /rdo rje 'gugs byed khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje zhags nga/ rlam —214—

par rgyal/ /rdo rje 'dren byed khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog 'dzin nga/ che/ /rdo rje sdom byed khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje 'bebs byed rnam par rgyal/ /rdo rje 'bebs pa khyod pa la 'dud/ /byams chen rang bzhin dpag tu meng/ /snying rje chen ngo/ blo yi mchog /shes rab chen po blo/ chen lngan/ /ma/khas pa chen po thabs che ba/ /ye shes cha drug sems dpa'i tshogs/ /stong pa nyid kyi sgor gnas pa/ /bag la nyan la ba byang sems ldan/ /shes rab snying rje ldan la 'dud/ /rdzu 'phru' chen po stobs chen ldan/ khri1gas chen mgyogs pa chen po ste/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po cher grags nga// /stobs chen pha rol gnon nga/ jo rke /stobs bcu rdzu 'phrul bzhi ldan pa'i/ /goms shu/gas ye shes bzhi grags pa/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing stobs/ kyis gnon/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs nga/ khyod la 'dud/ /srid pa'i ri bo chen ngo/ 'jom/sa /'khrigs shing rdo rje chen po 'chang / /drag po chen po mun pa 'jam/sa/ /'jigs chen 'jigs par byed pa po/ /phung ngo/ lnga bdag lha chen 'du pa/ /mi/ shes ri 'jom/sa sra pa po/ /mya ngan kun sel drag po ste/ /che bas che ba khyod la 'dud/ /mgon po rigs mchog chen po ste/ /bla ma gsang sngags che ba'i mchog /theg nga/ chen po'i tshul la gnas/ /theg nga/ chen po'i tshul gyi mchog /'khor ba mya ngan skyob pa'i bam nu/na/ /theg pa'i tshul mchog lam/ gnas pa'i/ / phyag rgya ma/chog tu sgrub byed pa/ /pha rol sa bcu gtso la 'dud/ /de lta/ra bstod pa byed nga/ de/ //'khor lo 'dus pa'i gtso mchog grub/ /ces pa'o/ /gzhan yang mchod nga/ ngang / bsto nga pa ji lta ra mos shing spro ba dag bya'o// //༈ o sdi to hri di/ ces pa nas/ a yig dang gnyis su meng nga/ra zhes brjod cing /—2/5—

sngags gsum po brgya rtsa sogs bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ mtshan brjod yongs su rdzogs pa tshar gcig nges par 'don dgos la/ tshar mang du byas na bzang ngo / /de nas lha rnams gos zung 'bul ba yang spyi dang 'dra ba las/ gzhug tu rtsa sngags lan lnga tsam gyi mthar/ tse( ā hū badz+ra bsta hū/ zhes pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i dbang du byas te/ lan lnga bcu nga gsum mam nga lnga brjod do/ /de nas gsol ba btab ste/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la thugs brtse bar mdzod la/mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bde blag tu stsal tu gsol/ gnas skabs su yang 'phags pa 'jam/ dpal nyid kyi zhal mngon sum du mthong ba dang ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs dang / rnam par thar pa thams cad gong nas gong du thob pa dang / bar chad ma lus pa thams cad zhi ba dang / bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad gegs med du 'khru/ba par mdzad du gsol/ mthar thug dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal nyid kyi go 'phang thob nas/ 'gro ba drug gi sems can thams cad kyang bla na med pa'i gnas de nyid la 'bod nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces pa'i mthar rje btsun gyi yig brgya ci rigs par bzla'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor kyi phyi rol tu song nas/'jig rten pa'i tshogs la gtor ma sbyin dgos na/ 'di'i phyi rol gtor ma ni cha gsum du grags pa nyid mdzad pa'i rgyun snang ngo / /de yang bod snga ma rnams kyi ni gsang sngags phyi pa yin pas bsams pa la snang mod/ 'on kyang mi 'gal te/ 'og ma'i cho ga thun mong mang po zhig gong ma la sbyor ba 'gal ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i yang 'byung gtor dang phyogs skyong gtor ma lta bu re res kyang chog par snang zhing / phyogs skyong bco lnga'i gtor chog bla med spyi 'gro lugs sbyar na legs par 'gyur ro/ /—216—

'on kyang re zhig 'gal ba med phyin gong ma rnams kyi lag len dang mthun par byed pa bzang ste/ cha gsum du grags pa nyid bya la/ de'i cho ga ni gzhan du shes so/ /de nas slob dpon gyis nye reg byas kyang legs la ma byas kyang rung ste/ 'gru/ba na dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de'i rjes su/ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ /sogs kyis me tog phul/ o badz+ra uta gha ṭa pra be sha ya hu gis sgo phye'o/ /de nas bdag 'ju ga ni/ 'ju ga pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul/ ya mun+ta kas bsangs/ ā kha bī ra ri/lan gnyis kyis mig dar bcings/ me tog 'phreng ba gtad/ bu khyod dngo rnga 5 grub ci la dga'/ /skal bzang bde ba mchog la bdag dga'o/ /zhes dri lan bya/ dga' chen /khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ bu tshur sgo/ga cig theg chen po'i/ /zhes pa nas/ blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces pa'i bar gyis spro ba bskyed/ tshe rabs rtswa1ga ma med pa nas/ /zhes pa nas/ khyed kyis bzhes su gse/la/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi rgyun bshags kyang spro na bya la/ bsdu na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs kyis rgyun bshags byed/ gtso bo bdag la sdom pa gal stsa'// /thub pa nyi ma ma lus pa/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ / lan gsum/r+ghaṃ mo zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin cing / /dam tshig sdom dang gsang ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor ra 'dir ni 'ju/ga par 'tshal/ /gsang ba chen po rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ gsang ba chen po rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dri lan byas nas/ sdom pa sgrag pa ni/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /kyi —2 7—

'di rni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes sgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin dpa mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / / 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen rnga ri/ la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /zhes so/ /ma/dor bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ rgyas/ pa 'a/ dga' na/ de las gzhan ya/nga bcu bzhi ni/ /zhes pa nas/ khyod kyi rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /zhes pa'i bar yang sgrag go /de nas/ sdom pa bzung ba ni/ slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' ྅ni'/ pa/ /de ltar bdag kyang bgyid par 'tshal/ /ji snye ltar dus gsum ma be ston po rnams/ /nas/ mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /lan gsum// de ya na chad yol ba'i phyir 'jug yin/ de nas/ ā kha bī ra hūṃ/ zhes nang du zhugs/ par mos/ de rjes dam tshig gsang mnan zhes bya ba/ sems bskyed pa ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po/ rtse lnga pa/ o bodhi tsit+ta u pa ta ya mi/ me/ tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snyi/nga gar ba'ag ste/ su ra te sa ma stu/ ho sirnyi badz+ra ya tha su kha/ de nas gsang bar gdams pa ni/ dus 'di nyid du khyod nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas rigs su chud pas na/ /tshul 'di gzhan la ma brjod cig /gal te smras par gyur pa na/ /'jam rnga 'i —218—

rdo rje rab khros nas/ /'ga' la smra ba'i klad pa 'gems/ /dam la bzhag pa ni/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig srungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /o badz+ra u ta ka ṭha/ deng nas rtsams te bu khyod kyi/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje nga yin gyis/ /nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /khyod kyis skyo ba med par gyis/ /gang yang nga la rlus par mi/na/ /de bzhin mos par ma byas na/ /bdud kyis bcom nas dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas dam tshig la gnas byos/ /ye shes dbab pa ni/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje bdag la dbab du gsol/ lan gsum/ rang nyid ye shes sems dpa'i skur gyur pa'i snying gar a yig skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ ye shes sems dpa' 'di la 'bab par gyur cig /rang gi rkang mthil du ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i shugs kyis rang lus gyen du ldegs shing skyod pa/ spyi bor o dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros te/ lus kyi nang gang lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang bla ma dbyer med pa'i thugs ka nas pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba'i rdo rje phra mo dpag tu me/da pa byung / rang bi lus la thim pas sangs rgyas tham/sa cad kyis rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ badz+ra ā be sha yā a a a a la myo brgya 5 brgyang brjod / ya nga jo rje bsngam/sa pa las sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag dral zhing / badz+ra satwa ā ā ā/ ā/ dkyil 3ṇi1ra gyi gtso bo sum sbrags kyi thugs ka'i yig 'bru rnams/ las 'od zer dmar ngo/tshodapag tu med pa byung / rang gi lus la zhugs pas/ sdig sgrib ma lus/ bsregs —219—

shing dag par gyur/ /su pra tisnro badz+ra/ zhes spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste brtan par byas/ 'di ltar bdag gis slob ma 'di/ /dkyil 'kho/ra du ni legs bcug na/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang / /bsod nams de yang ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /'dir slob ma dbang bskur skabs nam mkha'i kha dog dri dgos/ dkyus la rang gi las 'grub pa'i ri gru1 pa dang mthun par/ nam rme/kha'i ba dog mthong bar gyur/ 'di yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /de bzhin du ni 'bab par sgo(ga /pra ti rta badz+ra hoX zhes me tog dor/ oX pra ti gro hā stuX i maX sa twa mahā ba la/ tseX( sarba dharma a bhā wa/ sogs yang snying gis me tog de mgo la bcings/ rdo rje chags ba deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mjad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur te/ /rdo rje mig ni bla na med/ /he badz+ra pā khyo/ gdong g.yogs dgrol/ thar pa chen po grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /me tog gang du lhung gyur pa/ /de ni khyod kyi 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bdag bis 'jam dpa' rdo rje dbyings kyi rten dang brten pa/'i dkyil/ 'bor thams cad/ mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur/ zhes brjong/ slob ma la dbang bskur na skabs 'dir lha ngo bstan to/ /de nas dag par brjong pa ni/ dkyil 'khor rim/ pa gnyis thabs dang shes rab bo/ mu khyud rnams ni thug pa med nga/'i chos nga byangs mthar thug nga 'o/ /chos thar/sa cad rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir gru bzhi mnyam pa'o/ /ga 'al yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag pa'o/ /gtso bo rigs lnga ni byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig pa'o/ /rnam thar bzhi ni yum bzhi'o/ /stong pa nyid bcu drug ni rdo rje sem/sa dpa' la sogs —220—

pa bcu drug go /sems dpa' chen sde stong bcu drug ni byams pa la sogs pa bcu drug go /lha mo brgyad ni sbyin pa la sogs pa brgyad do/ /sgo ba bzhi ni stobs dang ye shes thabs dang shes rab kyi rnam par phye ba'o/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga rnams so/ /de nas bum pa'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyabs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdorje deng bdag stsol/ /lan gsum/ skabs 'jir me tog gang phog gi lhar bskyed par bshad kyang / deng sang lag len mi byed do/ /des na 'di ltar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bdag nyid a las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje sku mdag dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan pa/ rang gi thugs kar dang po'i sangs rgyas dkar po thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo o a ra pa tsa na ya te na ma'akhor lo'i lte bar 'jam dpal dkar po ral gri dang po ti 'dzin pa/ thugs kar a dkar ngo// spyi bor o mgrin par ā thugs kar skyo/ thugs ka'i thi las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa ma dza dza hu ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ steng du bla re dang mtha' skor du mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam/ gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar gyur/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa blangs te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /sogs kyi mthar/ tse( ya mun+ta ka hū phaṭa/ tso rna sarba ta thā ga a bhi ṣe rka ta sa ma ya shri ye hū/ o badz+ra pur+sha hu/ sogs nyer spyong lnga rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa 'i mchod —221—

yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rigs pa'i lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dbang gi don du badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ oX badz+ra pukhye hūX/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab/bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa/ /grags pa'i bkra shis snyan grags dge/ /dbugs 'byin chen po dga' ston che/ /dga' chen rol mo chen po ste/ /bkur sti rim gro phun sum tshogs/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i grags bdag dpal/ /mchog ldan mchog sbyin gtso bo ste/ /skyabs kyi dam pa skyabs su 'os/ /'jig rten dgra ste rab kyi mchog /'jigs pa ma lus sel ba po/ /zhes brjod de/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs kyi shis brjod bya/ swa bhā sogs/stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid hūX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rang gi thugs kar dang po'i sangs rgyas sngon po thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo/ oX du kha tshe da ya te na maX 'khror lo'i lte bar 'jam dpal sngon po ral gri dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/ thugs kar huX sngo na po/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ thugs ka'i hūX las 'od 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim 'khor gyi bum pa bcas yod na/ skabs 'dir bum chu rnam rgyal du bsdu'o/ /sku gsum dam tshig las byung ba/ /ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med/ /bcom ldan mi bskyod rdo rje yis/ /dag pa lha yi chu dbang bskur/ /a āX nas/ gar+bha āX oX mañdzu ldi/ badz+ra a bhi sa ṣañtsa hūX/ zhes dbang —222—

bskur sku gang dri ma dag/chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbu rgyan/ de ltar na chu'i dbang bskur bas/ kun gzhi rnam shes gnas gyur te me 'o nga lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas so/ /oṃ swa bhā wa so gas/ stong pa'i ngang snyelas rang nyid tru 'a sa rin po che t+yā gis mtshan pa las/ rin chen 'gyung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rang gi thugs kar dang po sangs rgyas ser po/ thugs ka'i shes rab kyi 'a/bor lo/ o bā thi shwa ra ya te na ma 'khor lo'i lte bar 'jam/ dang/la ser ngo/ ral gri ngang rin po che 'dzin pa/ thugs/ kar hṝ ser po/ snri/ bor zhi mgrin par ā thugs kar hūṃ/thugs ka'i hu las/ 'od 'phros ye shes sems dang/'a badz+ra sa nā/ dza dza hu paṃ hoganyis su med nga/ra tham// oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ dbu rgyan mi dmigs te/ stong nga 'i ngang las o hu tru na hā ā las rgyal ba rigs lnga'i skur gyur/ ye shes/ sems nga pa' rgyal ba rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dza dza khu ba ho slo hūṃ tru hru ā la na rme/nga du bzlas / thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang / /dar dbyangs dbang bskur sdin par bya/ /a ā nas/gar+bha ā o rat+na ku la mu ku ṭa a bhi khri3 tru/ de ltar na cod pan gyi dbang bskur bas/ nyon yid gnas gyur te/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas so/ /de bzhin du/ o swa bhā wa sogs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje'i mi/ dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las hru las nga/khru hru sa mtshan pa las 'od dpag rme/da dmar ngo// rme/nyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rnge rje skyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin ngo/ —223—

che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rang gi thugs kar dang po'i sangs rgyas dmar po/thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo/ oX badz+ra tik+ṣa ya te na maX 'khor lo'i lte bar 'jam dpal dmar po ral gri dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thugs kar hiXdamar po/ spyi bo oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar skyoX/ thugs ka'i huX las 'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med zhu ba las rdo rjer gyur/a ā sogs/gar+bha āXsangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs/ /oX badz+ra a dhi pa ti stuX/ a bhi rdzi yi hūX tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa mā ya/ de ltar na rdo rje dbang skur bas yid kyis rnam shes gnas gyur te so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas so/ /swa bhā wa nas/ bdag dang dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te/stong pa'i ngang las a las rgya gram as mtshan pa las/don yod grub pa ljang khu g.yas skyabs spyin dang / g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/rang gi thugs kar dang po'i sangs rgyas ljang khu/ thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo/ oX dz+nyā na kā ya ye te na maX 'khor lo'i lte bar 'jam dpal ljang khu ral gri dang rdo rje rgya gram 'dzin pa/ thugs kar a ljang khu/ spyi bor oX/ mgrin par āXthugs kar hūX/ thugs ka'i hūX las 'od 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa zhu ba las dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ a ā nas / gar+bha āXshes rab thabs dang ldan pa yis/ /'gro don mnyam med byed pa dang / /mchod pa'i las rnams rdzogs pa'i —224—

phyir/ /rdo rje las kyi dbang bskur ro/ /oX a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharma ṇaX a du nu tru sno twata/ zhes dril bu 'brol lo/ /de ltar na dril bu'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ dbang shes lnga gnas gyur te/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas so/ /oX swa bhā wa sogs/stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid oX las 'khor lo oX gyis mtshan pa las/rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po/ phyag gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rang gi thugs kar dang po'i sangs rgyas dkar po/ thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo/ oX pradz+nyā dz+nyā marnya ye ya te na maX 'khor lo'i lte bar 'jam dpal dkar po ral gri dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ thugs kar āXdakar po/ spyi bor oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ thugs ka'i hūX las 'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā jaX dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ rnam snang kyi rang bzhin ming tshig gis kyang dbang bskur bar gyur/ rdo rje'i ming gi dbang bskur bas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /cis kyang mi chod mi shig pa/ /rdo rje'i ming du rab tu sgrags/ /a ā nas/ dz+nyā na gar+bha āX lkoX badz+ra satwa twaX/ a bhi ṣañtsa maX/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal 'jam nga/'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /de ltar ming gi dbang bskur bas/ gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed rnams gnas gyur te/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas so/ /de dag ni rig pa'i dbang lnga ste slob rme/'i dbang bskur ba'o/ / gtso bo khyod kyi bka' drin gyis/ /bdag dang gzhan don byed pas na/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /thugs rje'i bdag pos bdag la stso'i// /ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/ 'grub na dngos su —225—

dbang stegs sgo gcig pa bsham/ ma grub na dmigs bsam gyis rung ste/ dkyil 'a shes ra gyi shar phyogs su khrus kyi khang pa gzhal med khang sgo gcig nub tu bstan pa/dbus su dbang stegs khrus gdan gyi steng du/ pad+ma zla ba dar gyi glo gdan rnams kyi gdan la rang sems a yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid gzhi'i sa/ngas rgyas rnam par snang mdzad chen po zhes pa nas/ sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi pa ral ba'i con pan can/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil cho/ krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar gyi na bza' can/ rgyan spangs pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i dhīXyig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ dang po'i sangs rgyas zhal lnga pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ sku lus dang steng zhal dkar ba/rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yas ser/rgyab dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/phyag g.yas bzhis ral gri/ g.yon bzhis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang bcas pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i rtsibs bzhi phyogs mdog dang / shar stod shar smad kyi rtsibs dang / lte ba dang /phyi rol dang / nang gi mu khyud bzhi pa rnams dkar po/ de'i lte bar yang a yig dkar po'o/ /de'i 'od zer las sprul pa'i yi ge ni/ nang gi mu khyud dang po la/ oṃ sarba dharmā a bha wa/ su bhā wa bi shu khyu/ badz+ra tsak+ṣu a ā/ aX āX mu khyud gnyis pa la/a ā i yī u mū e e tse( 6ṭī aX aX rtsibs drug gi shar rtsibs la/ skye( duXkha tshe da ya te na maXsngon po/lho rtsibs la/oṃ wa gi sho ri te na maXser po/nub rtsibs la/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa ya te na maX dmar po/ byang rtsibs la/ oṃ dz+nyā na ka ya ya te na maX—226—

ljang khu/shar stod la/ oṃ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na musti ye ya te na ma dkar po shar smad la/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na ma dkar po/ phyi rol mu khyud gsum pa la/ a ā sarba ta thā ga sogs nas/ dz+nyā na gar+bha ā mu khyud bzhi pa la/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa khyu ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/sha ṣa sa ha/ 'khor lo'i lte ba'i a yig yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpa pa zha'/ drug pa/ phyag gnyis la sku lus dang steng zhal nyis rtsegs dkar ba/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yas ser/ rgyab dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yas nga/sa ut+pal dmar po dang / g.yon pas sngon po'i rtsa ba 'dzin cing / sdong po g.yas g.yon tu rgyas pa/ me tog snyan gyis thad kar kha phye ba'i steng na po ti 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' dang / in+t+ra nī la'i gtsug phud la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa nyi ma'i 'char ka lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros pa/ sku'i mgrin pa man chad lung bu yan chad du sprul pa'i sku dpag tu med pas bltams pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar yang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du skye med kyi ngo bo a yig dkar po mi shes pa'i ri bo 'joms par byed pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar dang po spyor ba bzhin no//chu dbang nas/'dis bar du snying ga'i sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa 'di rnams gzhud las mi gsal mod man ngag las 'byung ba byin rlabs kyi sgo gal po che yin pas ma chad par bya'o/ /rang gi steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs dkar g.yon du rgyal mtshan mtha' skor du dung dang rnga bo che la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung pos stibs par gyur/ dbang ge lha rnams kyis shis pa brjod de/ 'di ltar —227—

—sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung / /a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /don chen yi ge dam pa yin/ khong nas 'byung ba skye ba med/ /tshig tu brjod pa spangs pa ste/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /tshig kun rab tu gsal bar byed/ /mchod pa chen po 'dod chags che/ / sems can thams cad dga' bar byed/ /mchod pa chen po zhe sdang che/ /nyon mongs kun gyi dgra che ba/ /mchod pa chen po gti mug che/ /gti mug blo ste gti mug sel/ /mchod pa chen po khro ba che/ khro ba chen po dgra che ba/ /mchod pa chen po chags pa che/ /chags pa thams cad sel bar byed/ /'dod pa chen po bde ba che/ /dga' ba chen po mgu ba che/ /gzugs che lus kyang che ba ste/ kha dog che zhing lus che ba/ /ming yang che zhing rgya che ba/ /dkyil 'khore chen po yangs pa yin/ /shes rab mtshon chen 'chang ba ste/ /nyon mongs lcags kyu che ba'i mchog/ grags chen snyan grags chen po ste/ /snang ba chen po gsal ba che/ /mkhas pa sgyu 'phrul chen po 'chang / /sgyu 'phrul chen pa'i don grub pa/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po'i dga' bas dga'/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po mig 'phrul can/ /spyin bdag chen po gtso bo ste/ /tshul khrims chen po 'chang ba'i mchog /bzod chen 'chang ba brten pa po/ /brtson 'grus chen po brtul ba yin/ /bsam gtan chen po ting 'dzin gnas/ /shes rab chen po'i lus 'chang ba/ /stobs po che la thabs che ba/ / smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho ste/ /byams chen rang bzhin dpag tu med/ /snying rje chen po blo yi rme/chog /shes rab chen po blo chen ldan/ /mkhas pa chen po thabs che ba/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs dang ldan/ khri/gas chen mgyogs pa chen po ste/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po cher grags pa//—228—

stobs chen pha rol gnon pa po/ /srid pa'i ri bo chen po 'joms/ / mkhregs shing rdo rje chen po 'chang / /drag po chen po drag shul che/ /'jigs chen 'jigs par byed pa go /mgon po rigs mchog chen po ste/ /bla ma gsang sngags che ba'i mchog /theg pa chen po'i tshul la gnas/ /theg pa chen ngo/'i tshul gyi mchog /ces pa'i bar brjod pa/ o pun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs ngang : dril bu dkrol/ me tog gtor/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ lko mañdzu shrī/ badz+ra a bhi ṣañtsa spru/ 'khor gyi lha so so'i bum pa yod na/ sgom pa'i bar du rim/ pa sa dbang bskur ba bya la/ rnam rgyal bum pa las med na/ tshigs dang sngags sogs gong du bsha/da pa ྅ bu'i mjug tu/ hu ā sdi a badz+ra a bhi ṣañtsa/ a ā i yī badz+ra a bhi khiñtsa a ā i yī u mū e i tse( e/ a a a ā e i badz+ra a bhi ṣañtsa/ lā mā gi : badz+ra a bhi 'a ṣañtsa/dhu pū dī ga badz+ra a bhi ṣañtsa a/ bcu drug gi mthar/ badz+ra a bhi khri nyu dza hū ba ho badz+ra a bhi ski nyu/ de nas bdag 'jug la 'jam dpal gyi sku gzugs spyi bor bzhag par mos pas chog la/ slob ma dbang bskur la nga/ngos su 'jug dgos/ dkyil 'khore gyi lha tshogs rnams las lha tshogs gnyis pa chad nas de rang la thim/ o mañdzu shrī/ mahā su kha/ badz+ra satwa dza hū ba ho su ra te sa ma ye stu/ de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis / /de nas dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ni/ hu las byung ba'i rdo rje/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya/tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa stu dha ra ya mi/ ha ha ha ha hi hi hi hi hū/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo —229—

rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /oṃ mahā badz+ra ri/ a las byung ba'i dril bu/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyings kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ri/ rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/ / srid pa dag pa mchog tu byed/ /o badz+ra lha rnye a/ rdo rje dril bu snying gar bsnol/ rang nyid lha sku phyag rgya chen po thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug tu gyur/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsnga' chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni khyod kyis longs/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /ci 'dong/ par ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra pur+sha skyo/ sogs mchod pa lngas mchod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swāhā/zhes me tog dor la rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /de ni rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang dngos yin la/ mtha' rten dang rjes gnang ni/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsa'/ ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a nga/ ha ra ba ṭa la hi zhes mig thur dang / chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la nog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ / 'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skyes/ /me long dang /a las skyes pa'i dril bu/thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang yang —230—

mnyam sbyor bas/ /thams cad mchog gi mnyam nyid gsal/ /zhes dril bu dang /ho las byung ba'i mda' gzhu/ de bzhin gshegs pa tham/sa cad rjes su chags par byos shig /'jam pa'i rdo rje me long ltar/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med//sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin gyis/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /o mañdzu shrī a/ zhes me long gnyis pa rdo rje'i gzugs brnyan can dang / o badz+ra he tu ma/ o badz+ra bhā ga ta/ a las byung pa'i po ti ā de ring phyin chad 'jig rten la/ / skyob pa rnams kyis 'khor lo bskor/ khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /kun nas yongs su gang bar gyis/ /bsngags brjod tshul gyi cho ga yis/ / skyes bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / khyed la rtag tu srung bar mdzad/ /ces chos bshad/ 'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ / chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /rdo rje: /rin chen: / pad+ma: /las kyi 'khore lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes pas khyad par rjes su gnang ba sbyin no/ /de ltar na/ chos bshad dang / khyad par gyi rjes gnang gnyis ni/ rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi yin no/ /lung bstan pa ni/oṃ 'di ltar ngas khyod lung bstan te/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ / kyai rdo rje rmi mo zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa r+ghaṃ mo snur bhu wa snyu/ gsang ba sgrogs pa'i dbugs dbyung ba ni/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ khyod kyi nam yang ma byed cig /—231—

o mahā sa mā ya ha na hū phaṭa/ bar 'dir slob ma la sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba/ bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin dgos la/ bdag 'jug la ni rtsa sngags lan gsum bzlas pa'i chog go /khyod kyis mi mkhas gang zag la/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ma bstan cig / de yis spyod na som nyi za/ /gnyis ka ngan song nyid du ltung / /de nas gzengs bstod pa ni/sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur ba'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ /de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can kun la rjes brtse bas/ khyod kyis nan tan skyed nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris/ /chos rnams kun las ser sna dang / /sems can rnams la mi phan pa/ /nyam nga shin tu che na yang / /bu khyod kyis ni mi bya'o/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bcug pa dang ni mthong bas kyang / /sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yongs med de/ /mi thub tshugs par yongs min pas/ /cis kyang ma 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las 'das pa'o/ /zhes brjod la/ spro na/ byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos ni sun mi dbyung / /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /de nyid nges par bstan mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rang gi bdag nyid yongs spangs nas//dka' thub kyis ni ma gdung zhing / /ci bde bar ni bde bar bzung / /'di ni ma —232—

byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de ring khyod nying/ dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin nga/ra/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par dgongs/ / sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ khyod kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor//zhes brjod do/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /de dag ni slob dpon du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o/ /yang gsang dbang gi maṇ+ḍal phul/byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /sogs lan gsum/rang nyid ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon po ti 'dzin par gyur/ dam tshig gi rdzas la dmigs te/ o hū tru sdi ā de rnams las 'od zer 'phros 'khor 'das snod bcud brtan g.yo thams cad kyi/ dwangs ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi tshur bsdus nas 'bru lnga la thim/ de rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsir gyur/ o ā hu/ lan mang du bzlas te byin gyis rlabs/ji ltar 'jam dbyangs rgyal po yi/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur bzhin/ khyod/ la gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni mnyam pa'i ros/ /nyon mongs lnga ni dag par byed/ /ye shes lnga yi dbang bskur ro/ / o sarba dharma nas/ e a/zhes yang snying brjod/ dam rdzas lce thog tu bzhag par mos/ slob ma la dbang bskur na/ rdzas lnga po tshogs par byas/ o las a ka ru nag po/ hu las gla rtsi/ tru las mtshal/hru las mu thig /a las tsan+dan dmar po rnams yi ge de rnams nyid kyis mtshan pa/ sa bon lnga po brgya stong du bzlas te yi ge rnams zhu bar gyur/ de dag zhib mor btags nas 'o ma 'am/ zho 'am/mar ram/ mngar gsum ji ltar 'os pa'i khu ba dang sbyar nas/ rin po che'i snod dam/ nya phyis sam/—233—

dung bor sogs su blug go /de nas gong ltar bdud rtsi 'gugs pa'i dmigs pa bcas te 'bru gsum mang du bzlas te dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su bzhag pa ni dam rdzas zhes bya ste/ dngos su slob ma la sbyin rgyu'o/ /rdzas lnga po de gsang sngags nang ba'i lugs kyi bdud rtsi lnga'i brda yin pas gong gi bya ba ma grub na/ bla med spyi 'gro'i bdud rtsi ril bus kyang chog par mngon khro/ /de dag ni gsang dbang ngo / /yang shes dbang gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /sogs kyis gsol ba bto/ 'di khyod gzugs bzang brtan pa yis/ /dam pa'i bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /rig ma'i rnal 'byor sdom pa yis/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ / ces brjod de/rig ma gtad do/ /skabs 'dir dkyil chog yon tan 'byung gnas las/zhes bya ba 'dis sbyin par bya'o/ /dge slong dang / byis pa dang / ma ning dang / rgan po la ni lus kyi gnas bzhir 'khor lo rnam bzhi bsams la/ zhes pa'i don sbyin par bya zhes pa yid kyi rig ma sbyin par bya ba'i don dang / dge slong sogs kyi don spyi dbang 'di chags lam gyis kyang dbang bskur ba yin mod kyi/ de la mi mos pa dang mi nus pas grol lam la brten nas bskur na 'khor lo bzhi pa 'di sgom pa zhes pa yin pas/ dkyil 'khor 'dir dngos kyis rig ma brten nas nges pa'i dbang bskur ba'ang yod pa dang / grol lam la ma brten kyang yid rig btad pas lha kha sbyor gyi rnam pa can sgom dgos pa dang / de tsam gyis nyams myong skye nus pa dka' bas/ nyams myong skye ba'i don du 'khor lo bzhi sbyor sgom dgos pa dang / de ni gsang sngags nang gi gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi pa yin pa/ gong gi gsang dbang yang grol lam kho na la brten pa yin mod/ gsang sngags phyi rgyud lugs ye ma yin pa dang /dge slong dang zhes sogs kyi skal ba dang ldan na/ nges pa'i dbang chags lam la brten nas bskur —234—

ba yod par bstan pas/ chags lam la brten pa'i gsang dbang yang yod par shugs la 'grub ste/de'i phyir chos skor 'di/ skabs 'ga' zhig tu rnal 'byor phyi rgyu dang / chog bgros mtshungs pa ci rigs dang /lha sku'i rnam 'gyur mtshungs pa tsam yod mod kyang nge tsam gyis yo ga phyi ba'i lugs su mi 'grub pas 'di ni bla med kho na yin gyi rgyud sde 'og ma'i lugs ma yin no/ /de phyir bla med pha rgyud la rigs gsum las/ gti mug rigs kyi cho ga ni 'di lta bu yin par shes par bya'o/ /da ni dkyus la 'a sdug ste/ rkang pa'i mthil du yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngo ljang gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ sum mdo'i gnas su raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum mo/ /rang nyid rigs kyi bdag pos ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal dbyangs la rigs kyi yum sangs rgyas spyan mas yang dag par 'byud pa/ rang gi sku la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi 'od kyi rang bzhin du grub par gyur/ rkang mthil gyi rlung g.yos/ gsang ba'i me sbar/ rtsa a wa dh+ra ti'i lam nas zhugs/ spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i thig le sum cu rtsa gnyis zhu/༄de la theg le bcu drug mgrin pa'i 'khor lor babs/ de las brgyad snying gar babs/ de las bzhi lte bar babs/ lus thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis yongs su gang bas/ sems bde gsal spros pas dben pa'i lhan skyes mngon du byas par gyur/ sa mchog bcu gnyis thob gyur pa/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs mi rgya/ /'khor lo bzhi po mnyam pa'i ros/ /srid pa gsum ni dag par byed/ /de bas khyod kyi 'di dang ni/ /nam yang 'bral bar mi bya'o/ /oṃ snyi to hri di dz+nyā na murnyi ra haX/ brnyo bzhi naX/ tri bhā brnyi naX/ oṃ āXskyoX/ de dag ni nges pa'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /skabs 'dir bzhi pa'i dbang ni mi gsungs te/ man ngag la ltos pa'am/ rgyu 'bras kyi khyad —235—

par ma gtog ngo bo gcig par dgongs pa yin par rtags nga ra bya'o/ /de rjes/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang / gtang rag gi ma/ṇa la dang / deng nas brtsams te sogs/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba rnams bya'o/ /de nas slob ma gzhug pa'i rdon du gnang ba nod par bya ste/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub che/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /slob ma rnams chi/ 'ju ga par 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /gal te slob ma dbang bskur bar 'dod na/ bum pa sta gon gyi rjes sam/ ji ltar skabs su babs pa'i dus la/ slob ma lhag gnas bya ste/ ma/ṇa la phul la/ dga' chen khyerdo da bdag rke(na pa ste/ /sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ bu tshur tho/ga cis thes chen po /sogs kyis spro ba bskyed/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdig pa thams cad ser sor brna/gas/ /sogs man chad gur gyi tshig dang mthun kra/tre/ rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma ye shes sems dpa' dkar po/ ral gri dang po ti 'dzin pa'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje/ sa ma ya a/ su ra ta stu/ sa ma ya ho / badz+ra satwa ya tha sdo/ kha/ zhes nang gi sems bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang /mchod pa bzhi 'bul ba spyi dang / ya mun ta ka'i sngags kyi so shing ster/ tso tshe pra kri te pa ri shudha/sarba dharma pra kri te pa ri shurnye 7 ྅ha/ ces pa'i sngags kyis khyor chu sbyin/ ku sha yang / ya mun+ta ka'i sngags kyis ster/ bsrung skud yi ge 'bru gsum las bskyed de/ rje btsun gyi yi ge brgya pas bcings shing brten par bya ste/ khyad par de rnams ma gtogs spyi dang 'dra/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /ces sogs zab mo'i chos bshad/ yang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ mi ldog 'kho7ra lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /mgon po'i bdag la stsal nas kyang / /'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon 'phrin las yongs su gsungs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa bla na med pa stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /—236—

—snye— bdag ni rtag tu stso1ba dpon khu5gyu/ra/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rmi lam/ brtag cing ngan na srung ba'ang spyi dang mthun no/ /gal te rmi lam/ bzang ngam 'bring na/ nge'i sa nga nub nga bang dngos bskur bar bya ste/ gong du bsha/da pa'i bdag 'jug slob ma 'i do phyo du gsol ba btab nga/ yan chad tshang bar byas nas/ bdag nyid kyis ji lta ra blangs pa ltar/ slob ma/ la dbang bskur ba nying yi nan 'don pa bsgyur dgos/ khyad par phra mo rnams ni rdogs par bla'o/ /slob ma dbang bskur ba'i rjes su/ tsā ru'i bza' ston rgya chen po ya nga byed par rnga ri nga bar+sha/da la/ mthar rjes chog ni mched nga/ spa gsos/ 'gru/ba na gsar nga/'ang bsha/mas/ gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'ji/ /mchog tu dad pa'i 'bul lags kyi/ / ci bde bar ni bzhes su garbedor// mo na ma sarba ta thā ga ta ar+gha pu dza sogs/ gzhan 'dra ba la/ zhabs bsi'i5/ pu du/ ṭa/ dang thang 95 sa tsū/sa pa yi/ /me shen ga dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pa'i sos sa/ pukhre/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pa'i sogs/ dhu pe/ mun nga/'i tshogs rnams 'joms byed cing / /phyogs kun gsal byed mar me 'di/ /du//na mkhyen ye shes thob phyir 'bul/ /ci bde /ā/ lo ke /lhan cig skyes/ dang sbyar las byung / /dri yi mchod pa 'di dag ni/ /rang byung nyid la 'bul lags kyi/ /kun bzang bde chen bzhes su gsol/ /ga rnye/ /spa dog dri dang ro ldan 'ing / /bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bsgo/rdes 'ji/ dag /chos dbyings ye shes brnyes la 'bul/ /nai wi sgo/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i dom ston zhing / /shes rab mchog gi rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra/ /bdud kyi 'khe1ra lo gzhom phyir dbul bar bgyi/ /don dam dbyings la mnga' brnyes bzhes su gso'// /—237—

shasta/ de rjes 'dud nyi shus bstod/ phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyis/ /lus bshud pa yis rnams kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas spyi nga/nga mthun par gsol ba btab cing dngos grub blangs/ yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang / sogs kyis bzod rnga/ra gsol/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'jam pa'i rdo rje 'khru/ba gyur sogs dang / rten rnams la brtan bzhugs bya/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs nas/ tse( badz+ra mu rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdu ba'am / yang na dam ye dbye ba med par dkyil 'khor thams cad rang nyid la bsdus kyang rung ngo / /slar yang smon lam btab/ yig brgya dang dge ba bsngo bar bya/ hu bzhi pa'i sngags kyis phur bu phyung ba dang / a kā ro'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor dbye zhing / rdul tshon chu bo spyan 'dren pa dang / shis brjod sogs kyang spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gzhan yang gshin don gyi cho ga dang /sgyin bsreg dang rab gnas chu la sogs pa yo da de/ gzhung las rtogs par bya'o/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang / /sgeg pa'i rdo rje nyi ma seng ge ngang / /chos kyi rdo rje mu dra sirnyi dang / /lha yi dngos grub smri ti dz+nyā na dang / /tshor sde ngag dbang bye ma lung ba dang / /sur+ya sirnyi shes rab rdo rje dang / /rngog ston chos rdor de sras mdo sde dang / /gtsug ston dar rgyas dum bu la pa dang / /bzang mo ba dang rngog ston rin chen bzang / /chos rgyal ba dang bla ma sangs yon pa/ /byang chub dpal dang byang chub dpal grub dang / /bkra shis dpal grub blo gros dpal bzang dang / /ye shes rdo rje rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ /gzhan yang chos tshul 'di la brgyud pa yi/ /rim pa gsum ldan bla ma'i man ngag can/ /rgyud 'grel gzhung bcas legs thos legs par sbyangs/ /legs par go nas mdo tsam 'di sbyar ba'i/ /dge bas 'gro ba drug gi sem sa can rnams/ /ye shes sems dpa'i go 'phang thob par shog /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par —238—
/ma bla laX

drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor chog gi ngag 'don khams gsum zil gnon zhes bya ba bzhugs rbo(/ /oṃ sru sti/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i khro rgyal gshin rje mthar byed chen po'i rigs sngags kyi las/ tshogs dang 'brel bas bsgrub par bya ba/ drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma'i cho ga khams gsum zil gnon zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag bde chen dpa' bo dus kyi dgra/ /srid zhi'i mtha' la khros shing cher 'khrugs pas/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sgyu thabs kun 'joms la/ /gus pas bshud kyis bdud bzhi'i dkyil 'khor chom/ /rab 'jigs ye shes 'khor lo ni/ /brtan g.yo'i snyems pa phrogs las slar/ /rab 'byams 'phrin las spro ba yang / /mchod spyin chen pos bde blag 'grub/ /de la dang por bsrung bzlog gi las la bsngags pa'i dbang du byas nas/ cung zad drag po'i 'phrin las dang 'brel ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /de la yo byad bca' gzhi bya tshul dang /cho ga dngos so/ /dang po ni/drag ngo/'i las dang mthun pa'i gnas sam/ sgrub khang sogs yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ sa gzhi la dug khrag bsres pa'i thig chas kyis thig chen brgyad btab/ gnas khang yangs dog dang bstun pas dkyil 'khor gyi tshad nges pa med kyang / 'grub tu rung na/ thig skud khru gang gis bskor ba las chung ba mi bya/ gang ltar yang zlum por bskor la/ bskor thig dang lho'i tshangs thig 'phrad mtshams nas bzung ste/ shar dang / byang shar gyi thig gi bar bskor thig steng nas cha gsum du bgos pa'i cha —240—

gnyis shar thig dang / cha gcig byang shar gyi phyogs su yod pa'i mtshams nas thig sna drangs te chos 'byung gi g.yon gyi logs thig btab/ de bzhin du nub dang / nub byang gi bar la thig sna drangs te g.yas kyi thig btab/ de gnyis kyi rtse sbrel bas rgyab kyi logs thig 'byung ngo / /de nas zur gsum du sor gnyis re mnan pa'i rtse rnams sbrel te mu ran bya/ de'i phyi la me ri gru gsum du 'bri ba'i sa gzhi bya ste/ tshad nges pa mi dgos/ rgyas pa la dga' na de'i phyir du rdo ra me ri dur khrod kyi thig rnams kyang bskor/ bsdus pa la ni chos 'byung gcig pus chog go /yang chos 'byung nyis rtsegs su byed pa'i lugs kyang yod pa rung bar mngon cing / chos 'byung gi nang du zlum thig nyis bskor nang le'u tshe dgu pa zhig bya/ rdul tshon dgye ba ni/ chos 'byung gi nang nag po/ mu ran dang re'u mig gi gzhi rnams nag po/ me ri dmar ser/ rdor sogs bskor na/ gru bcad la khrag mtsho/ rdo ra me ri spyi ngang mthun/dur khrod phyi nang gang du bris kyang 'dra/ re'i mig dbus ma la nyi gdan gyi steng du tshom bu nag po/shar gyi re'u mig la ser po dang / de'i phyi ru yang ser po/ shar lce'i re'u mig tu dmar ngo / lco ru mthing kha/ lho nub tu mthing nag gam dmar nag nub tu dkar ngo// de'i rgyab tu ser po/ nub byang du ljang khu/ byang du ser po/ byang shar du dkar po'o/ /ches/ ‘lwagrang gi rtse mo spyi ra btang la lho phyogs su ston par 'dod cing / de yang sgrub pa po kha lhor lta pa'i dbang du byas pa yin/ gnod byed nges pa can yod na de'i phyogs la bsan/ gang ltar yang 'di dngos grub bsgrub pa'i chos 'byung dang mi 'dra ste/drag po'i 'brub khung yi na pas rtse mo rang la mi ston par bzhed cing / cho ga byed mi/ mang pos mtha' bskor ba'i skabs su yang rtse'i drang thad du sgrub po su yang gdan mi 'cha'/ slob dpon phyogs la nges par 'brub khung si rgyab logs ston dgos pa yin no/ /rdul tshon ma 'byor ba dang bri long med na/ me thal lam sol bas bri ba'am/ ras bris la sogs pas kyang rung ngo / /de'i rtse mo'i phyogs sam/ nga/bus su mañdzi la drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sgrub gtor bshams/ rtse ngos kyi stegs ma/tho ba zhig la —24/—

————rderde rings gtor chen po bang nams/ dgos nga/ yin la/ de yang bris sku yod na bras sku'i mdu myo dang / med na ze 'a/ tsa rka li'am gzus sa sngags btsugs/ mdun du khras gi ar+gha dang / mchong pa gzhan rnams g.yon bskor ram/ g.yas g.yon du phyed mar bsas te phul kyang rung ngo / /sde'i mdun nam g.yas g.yo 'e rang rung du chos 'byung gru gsum gcig la/ mdzi' sdeng du gshan rje chos kyi rgyal ngo gtor ma ba ngan myos rngo ngang bcu dus pa bzhag /sgos ma/chod zhig kung bsham/sa/ dgru/ rdzas rdzogs/ par tshang na rab rdu/myo/ pas ri pa ra tha khrag dang / myer byeng kyi mchod pa/ sa rngi cha'o/ sgrub nga po'i rma/nga du ho cang mi ring bar 'brub bung dngos sa rma/ bris nga'i nang du/ ling ga dbang po dod pa/ 'ig bzhas sde khebs4 kyis/ brkab/ ga len yang ro pa ro/ kyi rma sogs nga/'i yo byad ngang / phyag rma tshan rnam sa dang / rma chod pa'i khyang par ngam sas pa ra thun nga/ra bsham/sa/ nga dang / thun byed na snong gnyis su skam thun/ rlon thun sogs kyang ring rngo ma nga ra bya'o / /sgrub gtor ni gru gsum ri rtsa glo/ mi rme/gos mtshan pa/ ling ga'i snying jo can du thus kung cheg / yang snga ma/ rnams kyi phyas bzhes ltar na/ zan le ba gru sa sum/ 'a/ zur nas dras pa sa gru gsum ba tshon ra (3gyur/ bzhi kro/ de sde bzhin du dras pas bcu drug tu 'gyur/ de rnam/sa/ kyang de bzhin du dras/ pas༄ drus cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /de rnam sa rtsi ga lugs la 'a/ga len mi 'dra ba du ma yod cing / ma/spar thabs kyang zur drug pa dang / brgyad pa dang / ba ce gnyis pa ngang / bcu drus nga sogs 'dod nga/ rngo da kyang / zur dgu pa'acha / drug pa gang rung bya sde/ dbus su hor/ nga gi dre che nga 'byung ba/ dgu ngo/ re re yang yang bdun bdun brtsegs pas lhas ma/ cig 'arda grang bas 'brub khung gi ba bcod la/ sde'i sdeng du gru gsum chung ngu zhig bzhag par bya'o/ /de 'a mi rma go'i rgyal rma/tsha' ngang / rgyu rlom gyi lnga ldi sas sa kyis brgyan/ gzhan yang 'jigs su rud ba'i rgyan gru༈na pos/ rlam par brgya'o mo /sdegs mtho bar gtor ma lnga tshar yang bsham sa dgos la / 'das gtor chen ngo/ na zlu gru/ gtor ram/ gru gsum/ snyi nga sa zugs ra/ gang rung 'a/ nga nga 'a ngar mas sa/ 'jugs thang / gshin rje'i gtor ma ni mtha' jo kyeg tu —242—

zur gsum kho na bya'o/ /de bzhin du drug cu rtsa bzhi btab gtor dang / sgos kyi mchod pa cung zad dgos pa rnams dang / sngon 'gro gtor ma sogs ma tshang ba med par bsham mo/ /'di dag gi rgyu mtshan ni gzhan du bshad par bya 'o/ /gnyis pa la sngon 'gro/dngos gzhi/rjes chog ste gsum las/dang po ni/sngon 'gro gtor ma/ya mun+ta ka'am/ oX badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūX phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs su bhā was sbyangs/ tseX( āXhuX ha ho sdiXs byin gyis brlab/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags sam/ skye( in+t+ra ya sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi dgongs pa bskang ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa mtha' dag mnyes par bya ba dang /ma lus pa'i sems can gyi khams rnams theg pa mchog gi bde ba la 'jog pa'i ngo/na du/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyal po srid pa gsum las rnam par rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i dkyil 'khor las brtsams te/ 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas mchod gtor rgya chen po sgrub par bgyid na/ phyogs skyong ba bcu la sogs pa dkar po'i phyogs la mngon nga/ra dga' ba'i tshogs rnams kyis bar chad bsrung ba dang /'phrin las rnam pa bzhi sgrub cing dngos grub gyi stongs grogs dam/ pa mdzad du gso la/ nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs rnam/sa sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig /ces rol mo'i sgra dang bcas phyir dor/hṝXsgyiXdang bgegs mthar byed kyi gzungs bzlas la bgegs bskrad/ yang gnas dang yo byang —243—

bsangs sbyangs/ gnas khang stong pa'i ngang las/ bhu las byung ba'i dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid tham sa cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ phyi rol bsrung ba'i 'khor los yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ o.ā hū zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/gzugs sgra/ dri ro rag kyi bya la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po rnams shin tu rnam par dag pa dbang sgyur ba'i rnam rig gi rang bzhin zag pa med pa'i ye shes dang / smon lam rgya mtsho'i mthu las grub pa/ phyogs bcu rab 'dra/rma/sa nam mkha'i gtos thams cad yongs su gang ba/ srid pa ji srid kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par 'ju)ga par gyur/ tse( badz+ra ar+gha swāhā/ pu du/ skye rna badz+ra pukhre/ ā hū/ dhu pe/ ā 'e1 ke /ga rnye/ ni wi te/ shasta ā hu/ tse( badz+ra lha rnye ra ṇi ta sogs la na gsum gyis rol mos byin dbab bo/ /tshogs pa mang zhing 'khore lo'i mchod pa dang bcas pa dang / tshogs pa rnams gus pa'i tshogs kyi gtso bo yod cing spro na zhu 'bul bya༈ phyag tshan bco lnga pa'am// phyag bco brgyad pa'am/nyer gcig pa gsum rgyas bsdus/ kyi khyang/ cam ma gtogs don 'dra bas/ ji ltar byas kyang rung ngo //tshogs kyi gtso bo mthun nga med pa ngang / tshogs pa med dang / 'khor los mchong/ pa med cing mi spro na/nyu 'bul rngi/ dbo/sa phong / spyir de dag 'dzom na yang / zhu 'bul ma byas pa'i cho sa chad par mi 'gyur zo/ /gnyis pa dngos ga'i la/ rnal 'byor bsgrub pa dang / las la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po la bdag bskyed bsgom bzlas dang / mdun bskyed sgrub mchod do/ /dang po bdag bskyed ni/ bdag dang —244—

'grob nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i zhes pa nas/ de 'od du zhu rang nyid la thim/ zhes pa'i bar rdzogs par bsgoms/ bzlas pa'i skabs bzlas pa'ang ci 'gru/ba bya'o/ /gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ chos 'khyu/nga gru gsum/ zhes pa nas/ ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ra gyi steng du/hrulas rdorje chen po mthing nag rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa 'od 'bar bar gyur/ de las de bzhin spru/zhegs pa zhes nga nas/ blta bar yang mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid dugyur/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las/ bdag nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ mig tu sta nas/ dkyil 'khore badz+ra sa mā dza hu/ 'jam dpal khros pa'i dkyil 'aper nas/ /srin po'i gzugs su sku sprul pa// /gdug nga/ can kun 'dul ba'i phyir/ /'jigs pa'i khro rgyal gshe gas su gsol/ /o tshur byon tshur byon 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ khro bo gshi/na rje gshe/da po'i tshogs/ /'jam dpal khro bo mi bzad pa/ /mthu rtsal drag po spru/skegs su gsol/ /ye shes khro bo spru/skegs nas kyang / /rdzu 'phru' dngos grub stsol/ ba'i phyir/ /rtags dang rma /tshan ma bstan pa ngang / /'gro ba'i don kun mdzad du gsol/ /o/ 'a hā ha sbyo mahā kro dha ā gasnro ā ga hā / ut+pa ta pū dza pra ti grot+na ṇ+ḍa pra sa da/ me dhi man ku ru ku ru swāhā/ o badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra titsā swāhā/ puspro nas sha lta' bar gyis ma/chod/ hū 'dir bzhugs 'dir bzhugs 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ khro bo gar+sha/na rje gshed po'i tshogs/ /'jam dpal khro bo mi bzad nga// /mthu rtsal drag po bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma ka ma la ye stu/ bcom ldan de bzhin rngo/she/gas pa kun/ /zhes pa nas/ o badz+ra lha rte ho'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin dang / de ltar na 'di ni mdun bskyed kyi rtsa ba ye shes khro bo gtso rkyang gi dbang du byas pa yin la/—245—

shin tu bsdu na thod mkhar ma bskyed par dur khrod kho na'i dbus su bzhugs par byas kyang chog /cung zad rgyas pa la mos na/ gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi ro langs brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbang chog gi mdun bskyed bsgrub pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar byas kyang legs pa yin no/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo las khro bo lcags kyu dang / zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/phyogs skyong thams cad bkug par gyur/ oXhṝXsgyiXbi kṛ tā na na huX phaṭa/ oṃ in+t+ra sarba du niX sa pā ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaX in+d+ra zhes pa'i gnas su/ ya ma ya/ wā ru ṇa/ ku be ra/ yī sha na/ asne ye/ ni ri kyi/ wā ya we/ brad+ma ya/bā su sgo ri ṇi/zhes pa rnams bcug pas spyan 'dren/de ltar na phyogs skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa rnams phyogs bcur 'khod pa ni/ shar du brgya byin ser skya mig stong dang ldan pa/ rdo rje dang sdigs ma/dzub can glang po che la zhon pa/ lho ru gshin rje nag po cher khros pa dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub can ma he la zhon pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa brang 'gro la zhon pa/ byang du gnod spyin ser po/ lus sbom pa/ bi dza pu ra ka dang ne'u le 'dzin pa rta la 'on pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pas rgo tsho rī la 'khyud pa/ mig gsum pa ral pa'i thor cog can khyug mchog la zhon pa/ shar ltor me lha dam/ra po bgrang 'phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa ra skyes la zhon pa/ lho nub tu bden bral nag po mi bzad cing cher 'khrugs pa gri gug dang thod pa rbon ro langs la zhon pa/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang khu rlung gis bskyod pa'i ba dan 'phyar ba ri dwags ser po la zhon pa/ steng du tshangs pa ser ngo/ gdong bzhi pa phyag g.yas gnyis spyi blugs dang skyabs sbyin g.yon gnyis dbyug dgu dang bgrang 'phreng 'dzin nga/ ngang —246—

pa la zhon pa/ 'og tu nor 'dzin ma ser 3bum pa 'dzin pa pad+ma la gnas pa/thams cad kyang rang rang gi 'khore tshogs dpag tu me/da pa dang bcas te 'khod par gyur/ o da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa rī/ ri wā ra byu badz+ra ar+gha pra tisno swahā/ 'es pa nas / shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ ri sto/ gang 'dul tshul gyis 'gro/ ba'i rdon/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sku sprul pa/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam mi /byab/ /phyes sa skyong 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /o badz+ra sa mā ya tsū/ zhes rdo rje rtse lnga nga/'i phyag rgya bstan la/ sgrub po bdag rgi yid la brnag nga/'i ngon /snad sto bas dang ldan nga/ra grub nga ra mdzod cig /thogs nga/ re/da par grub par /mdzod cig /gegs me/da nga/ra grung nga/ra mdzod cig /ces brjong/ yang rang gi snying ga nas khro bo phur bu thogs nga/ nga pag tu med pa spros/ de rnam/sa kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ oṃ hṝ sgyi bī kṛ tā na na hūṃ pho/ṭa/in+t+ra ya sarba dun sa pā ri wā rā na badz+ra gī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sde ba 'be du/ ya rma/ nas/ bā su dha ri ni'i/ bar 'a/ ya/nga sbyar/ grub pa'i dngul tshu'i bcud kyis reg pa na/ 'es/ pa nas/g.yon brkyang gis bzhus sa pa'o/ /bsdu na de cam gyis kyang chog la/ spro na/ mig tu hū ཾ nas/ mi bskyod nga/sa dbu brgyan/ dza hū ba ho sde nas rma/chod nga gong bzhar byin gyis/ brlabs pa las/ gnas khang bskyed chog bor ba yin te/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a/ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi sogs/ shasta ā hūṃ/ de nas dbyangs dang bcas pas/ sam/ med kyang rung ste/lhe/nga ga sdo/ma ban+ta rab yangs bar/ /sna tsho/sas rak+ta rgya mtsho khyor bskyi'// khrag chen sdi glu 'phreng cher 'khra/gas pa'i/ /ar+gha mchog gi mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ hṝ ga ha drag po'i spos dang sbyar ba'i chu/ /thod pa'i snod du rab btags pa/ /stsong gsum khyab nga/ra gar sgyur ba'i/ /zhabs bkru'i ched du 'bul bar bya/ /oṃ hu hūṃ phri/ṭa/ tsher ma —247—

rtsub cing cher 'jigs pa/ /mi zad dri ldang sbrang rtsir bcas/ /rdo rje rigs kyi me tog tshogs/ /kun tu char bzhin 'bab gyur cig /oX ku mā ra :pi ṇi dzaXdzaXzhing bcu bsgral ba'i sha dang tshil/ /gsur chen dam tshig 'dus byas la/ /bdug pa'i sprin tshogs gtibs par gyur/ /gnyis snang bsreg pa'i mthu thob shog/oX hiXha he phaṭa/ mar khu chen po'i sgron me ni/ /dur khrod me yis rab tu sbar/ /srid gsum khyab par 'od gsal ba/ /snang gsal chen pos mnyes gyur cig /lkoX dwa lta lo tsa ni bi kṛ tā na na mahā aṣ+ṭa khye hā sa na di na hi lta swāhā/ khrag dang mkhris chen yang dag sbyar/ /bdug pa'i dri mchog kun dang ldan/ /brtse bas gdungs shing khros pa'i thugs/ /dri zhim byugs pas rim gro bgyi/ /oX bi kṛ tā na na du giX sa tu da ma ka gaXgaXgaX nad gdon dgra bgegs tshar bcad las/ /mkha' dang sa steng rgyu ba'i sha /sna tshogs ro dang sbyar ba yang / /zhal zas bdud rtsi chen por 'bul/ / lkoX kā la rū pa sarba satwa da ma ka /mahā bhā ta a dhi pa ti i maX ba liX gra hā pa ta ye swāhā/ sna tshogs rol mo'i khyad nga ra ni/ ༄/thod rnga la sogs 'jigs pa'i sgra/ /ro langs 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /yan lag rgya mtsho 'byung 'gyur cig /lkoX badz+ra shabha āXskyoX/ oX badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi ra ni sogs rol chen bya/ de nas nang mchod 'bul te/ spro na bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan nas smros shing 'bul/ bsdu na/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi bdag nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oX āXskyoX/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar 'bru gsum btags te gtso bo la 'bul/ oX kā la rū pa hūX phaṭa/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i zhal du oX āXskyoX/ oX hri tsa na zhe huX phaṭa/ oX āXskyoX/ de bzhin du/ oX in+t+ra ye swāhā/ oX āXhūX/ ya ma ya/ wā ru ṇa —248—

ya/ ku be ra ya/ yī sha na ya/ asna ya/ ne ri tu/ bā ya be/ brad+ma ṇa ya/ bā su dha ri ne/ zhes pa rnams la'ang 'bru gsum sbyar bas 'bul/ gzhan yang lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/gza' chen po brgyad/rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams kyi zhal du oX āXhūX/ gzhan yang gnod spyin srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/sha za/ smyo byed/ brjod byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oX āXskyoX/ 'gro ba rigs drug /lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshim nas myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /oX sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ de nas bstod pa ni/ rol mo'i sgra dang sbyar zhing dbyangs dang bcas pas dkyil chog nas bshad pa ltar/ mi'u thung sgeg pa sogs sam/yang na/ skyoX/ 'jam dpal mkha' las byung ba'i gser mdog can/ /'jam dpal thugs las chos kun rang bzhin gsal/ /'jam dpal gsung gi dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'jam dpal bdag ni re ba'i sems kyis 'dud/ /thugs mchog 'jam pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul phyir gshin rje gshed/ /mi bzad dus mtha'i bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// zhal gdangs khro gnyer smin ma glog ltar 'khyug /spyan bgrad mche ba gtsigs pa rab du 'bar/ /rdo rje'i rta skad drag po ha to bzhad/ /mkha' 'gro bsdu ba'i pho skad drag po sgrog /khros pa'i stabs kyis zhabs brdabs khams gsum gnon/ /sdigs mdzubs gnam du sgreng zhing lha chen 'dul/ /ljags 'dril 'bar ba'i zhal gdangs khrag gis myos/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten zhal du —249—

gsol/ /bgegs chen korlon thod pa'i 'phreng bas brgyan/ /gcer bu 'jigs byed dbang phyug chen po'i tshul/ /'jigs byed ma he khros shing 'ji/ra ba'i gdong / /zhal dgu 'bar bas srid gsum za bar mdzad/ /sna tshogs 'bye1 ba 'dul ba'i phyag rgya 'bar/ /bdud rigs kun 'joms zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gnas/ /'jigs byed chen po'i sku la rtag tu 'dud/ /hūṃ/ dbu dgu 'bar ba'i dkyil 'bor nas/ /g.yas kyi zhal gsum bgrad pa ni/ /mthing nag dmar dang ser ba'i zhal/ /g.yon gyi zhal gsum gtsigs nga/ ni/ /dkar dang dud kha nag da lo pa'/rde zhal/ /dbus kyi zhal gsum 'bar ba rni/ /bro dang chags dang zhi ba'i tshu'// /phyag rgya 'ong zer 'bar ba las/ /g.yas kyi phyag rgya bcu drug ni/ /brdeg cing 'joms pa'i mtshon cha gdengs/ /g.yon gyi phyag rgya bcu drug :/ /rol zhing stob nga/'i mtshan mas mdzes/ /brjid gnon zhabs kyi tsham/sa rngams 'i/sa/ /g.yas kyi zhabs brgyad bskum pa ni/ /dregs nga 'i lha brgyad thabs kyis 'dul/ /ral g.yan gyi zhabs brgyad brkyang ba ni/ /dregs pa'i lha rmo brgyad la rol/ /'dod chags chen pos 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rtag tu la d+ma rgyas pa'i tshul/ /drag ngo/'i tshul gyis zhe sdang 'dul/ /'dul byed sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dur khrod chen po'i dkyil 'a/bor nas/ /bdud dang gshin rje thabs kyis 'dul/ /ma mo gru/spa' 'gro dbang du bsdud/ /dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal 'e|/ /dbang phyug chen ngo 'i dkyil 'kho ra du/ /dbang med dad nga/sa 'dus pa dad / ye shes sprul pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /'khor bcas khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal / /ye shes thugs/ kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /ji lta bur ni sprul gyur kyang / /rnam ras —25()—

dbyings las ma ga sku1sa te/ /mnyam nyid sku la phyag 'tshal 'e1/ /zhes pas bstod/bstod pa 'di rgya gar mar grags shing / sngon gyi rong zom/ rwa skyo gnyos pa kun la grags pa/ byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma can yin nges shing / 'di tsam rgyas bsdus 'tsham par snang ngo / /de nas 'kho ra gyis bstod pa ni mdo tsam gyis chog pas/ gang 'dul tshul gyis sogs dang / phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor ra ma lus nga// /rdzu 'phrul chen pos mnga' mdzad nas/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa/ /gnas srung rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha dang lha min la sogs pa/ /'gro/ ba drug na gnas pa yi/ / gdug pa can kun tshar gcod pa'i/ /'joms byed sku la phyag 'tshal lo /tshe dang bsod nams 'byor pa dang / /bde ba dam pas sems can skyongs/ /skye 'jigs 'byore rgud mi mnga' ba/ /ye shes sprul pa rnams la bstod/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i sgrub po la/ /dngos grub thogs pa med stso'i/ zhing / /bar chad ma lus sel ba dang / /'phrin las kun grub rnams la bstod/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dge bas kyang / /gsang sngags lha rnams rma/nyes gyur te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob nas/ /'gro kun smin cing grol bar re rdzog /ces so/ /de nas gzhin rje chos kyi rgyal po bskyed cing spyan 'dren pa ni/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bcom/ ldan 'das kyi sku'i drung du rak+ta'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ thod mkhar 'bar ba'i gzhal ya/sa khang keng rus kyi thog phub pa/ de'i dbus me rlung 'tshub ma'i nang na/ pad nyi 'a gnas pa'i ma/ he nag po dregs shing khros pa dgra bgegs kyi bam chen brdzis pa'i steng du/ ya las dbyug pa yas mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po sku mdog rma/thing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma he'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas rdo —251—

rjes mtshan pa'i thod dbyug nag po 'phyar zhing / g.yon zhags pa nag po dang bcas pa'i sdigs 'dzu ba mdzang/ pa/ skra khams pa gyen du brdzes shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu ling ga gyen du bsgreng ba/ rab tu 'jigs pa'i nyams can rgyan spangs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum ga sku1na brkyang bi stabs kyis me rlung ku ye thob ma'i klong na rma/ hre'i gdan la zhugs pa'o/ /g.yon du rtsa las yum tsa muṇ+ḍi nag mo skra dam/ra ser sil bur grol zhing nu ma 'khu/nga ba/ ba lang gi pags pa dang /bos nag gyon cing / tri shu la dang thod pa thogs pa cher khros pa' /mtha' bskor du/ ya ba ti be con 'jin pa/ phya sangs 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rmig pa gsal shing 'dzin pa/ ral pa tshar dgu mdung thung 'dzin pa/ gshin rje pho nya lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ dus kyi zhags pa bdud zhags 'dzin pa/ ya ma rda spyi mche ba 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ gzhan yang dus mtshan mo dang / gsod pa mo dang / nag mo dang / nam gru sha ka lī la sogs pa gshi/na rje nga/nga / ma mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'ong/ zer 'phros/ pas/ lho phyogs rim/ pa bdun gyi sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer sgo med lcags kyi mun khang bcu drug nas/gshi/na rje chos kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza rus sbal gyi 'dug stangs bcas la/ rdo rje bsdams pa las srin lag brkyang ba'i gshin rje'i dam rgya g.yab cing / khu/ 'di nas lho yi lte phyas sa rol na// /dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha rol na/ /rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og na/ /thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer na/ /yi dwags kun gyi sde dpon po/ /ma mo kun gyi tshogs rje'o/ /gson gshin kun gyi zam/ kha pa/ /gson po bkos la 'debs pa po/ /shi ba kun gyi gshin bu rje/ /dge ba can gyi stangs 252—

'dzin pa/ /sdig pa can gyi chad pa mkhan// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /legs nyes chos bzhin gcod pa po/ /chos rgyal gshin rje zhes bya ba/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu rlabs can/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /hṝXsgyiXmathar/ ya ma rā dza sa pā ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaX zhes spyan drangs/ gong gi dam rgya de nyid dam/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi gung mo brkyang pa dbyug pa'i phyag rgya 'phyar bas kyang rung ste/hṝXsgyiX'i mthar/ ya ma rā dza sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ya stuX/ zhes dam la bzhag /ar+ghaX nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod pa bsdus pa zhig phul/ gshin rje'i rgyal ngo/ 'khor bcas la/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'dir brtan bzhugs/ /mchod pa tshul bzhin bzhes nas kyang / /las grub bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /oX ya ma rā dza sa ma ya pad+ma ka ma la ye stuX/ dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par bstim/ lag pa g.yas be con gyi phyag rgya bcas/ g.yon pas so so'i phyag rgya bcas pa'am gtor snod dam bzed zhal du mchod pa bstabs la/hṝXsnriXmathar/ ya ma rā dza sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra tisnro āXhuX/ de bzhan du/ pu duX/ badz+ra ngu khye pū dza sa ma ye hūX/ de nas/ sna wi t+ya'i bar rigs 'gre/ rol mo'i sgra bsgrags shing / oX badz+ra shasta āXskyoX/ zhes brjod/ bcom ldan chos rje 'jam dbyangs spyan snga sa /bdud 'dul bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /las kyi gshin rje ma mo mkha' 'gro dang / /'byung po ro langs ci bgyi bka' gnyan sogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam can ma lus pa/ /bdag gi re ba'i sems kyis 'dud cing mchis/ /zhes bstod/ de nas gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/oX āXb snrin+ta krita huX phaṭa/ces pas bsangs pa nas/rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oX āXhuX ha ho hiX zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ byin rlabs 'ji snga phyi'i gtor ma thams cad la chabs gcig tu dmigs pas chog /lha thams cad kyi ljags/ hūṃ —253—

las byung ba'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/sngags gsum ka'am snying po'i mthar/ sarba bisnrin sha krun mā ra ya i dam ba ling ta kha kha sku hi ji hi huX huX phaṭa/ ces lan bdun la sogs pas gtso bo la phul/ tsho( badz+ra lā phya hūX/sogs kyis mchod/snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /zhes pa nas/ dud kha mun can khyod la 'dud/ /gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun grub tre(ga /zhes pa'i bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/yi dam gzhan la gtor ma 'bul na'ang skabs 'dir bya ba nyid do/ /de nas/ oṃ in+t+ra ya sgruX ya ma ya sgyiX bā ru ṇa ya bi/ ku be ra ya kṛ/ yī shwa na ya ta/ asna ye a/ nai ri kyi na/ bā ya be na/ h+ma ya skyoX/ bā su dha ri rne ya phaṭa/ sarba bhā te smyo ha ha/ hi lha/ hūX hūX h+pha h+pha phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/zhes pa lan gsum mam bdun gyi bar gang 'os kyis phyogs skyong rnams la tshul/ oX da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra khyuX zhes pa la ar+ghaX nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ hṝXsnriX'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul mdzad pa/ /gnyen rje mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas la 'dud/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs 'phrin las bcol/ oX kā la rū pa sarba bisnrin sha krun mā ra ya i dam ba ling ta kha kha 'a hi 'a hi swāhā/ oX hiXca muṇ+ḍi sarba bisnrin sha krus sogs sbyar ba ste/ de ltar lan bdun gyis gshin rje lcam dral la gtor ma phul/ oX badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ nas/ shas 'a bar gyis mchod/ 'chi bdag dam can gzhin rje ni/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi phyag brnyan te/ /ma gshin 'gyung po tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag —254—
