kyang 'tshal/ /rgyal po 'khom ra dang bcas pa rnams/ /mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun sdo/batsha|rdeg /ces pa'i bar gyis 'phrin las bcol te/ bzlas pa cung zad bya'o/ /chos skyong gzhan gyi gtor ma dang bskang ba sogs byed par spro na 'jir bya ba yin mod/ rnam grangs ha cang mang grags pa rang ni mi legs so// de dag ni las ci lta bu 'ig sgrub kyang nges pa dgos pas/ rtsa ba'i gtor 'bul zhes bya'o/ /phyis kyi lag len rlams la rtsa ba'i gtor 'bul dang / las bcol gyi gtor 'bul so so ra mi/ byed pa shas che mod/ spyo bur las bcol gyi gtor ma/'i skabs 'ga' zhig tu de lngar byar rung ba'ang yin mong kyi/ thog mar rtsa ba'i gtor ma/ 'khru/rdeb na/ las gang la yang stobs che zhing bkra shis nga yin pas/ long stabs yo da na so sor bya ba kho na le/gas so/ /gnyas/ pa las 'a sbyar ba la/ las sbyor gyi sngon du bya ba gnyis/ las/ sbyor dngos kyi bya ba bzhi'o/ /dang po la gnas kyi dang po gnang ba zhu zhing snyan gsan dbab pa rni/ hūṃ/ bcom lngan 'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje po khri'/da/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang 'chi bdag nyi ma'i bu/ /ma ni1/gshin rje srin po mkha' 'a spru 9 ( byen gas/ /thams cad ma lus bang ga la snyan gsan zhig /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs kyi mdzong 'dzin pa/ /rtsa brgyung bla ma thams cad dgongs su gsol/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems ma lus la/ /bdag ni drag po'i las kyi gnang ba zhu/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das nga/'i dam can dang / /dkar phyogs skyong ba mthudang rdzu 'phrul ca'/ / srid gsum sa nas pa thams cad 'dir dgongs shig /gzung dang dang/nga mdzod (zhal lce bcad dug sol/ hūṃ/ gtum/rde po ma rungs sdig pa can/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed dang / /sems can yongs la 'tshe bar byed/ /rdo rje slob dpon smong pa —255—

dang / /theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang / /sngags dang rgyud la 'phya byed pa/ /'di dag sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ / ngan 'gro'i sgo mang bcad du gsol/ khyad par dgra bo sdig can 'dis/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang smad/ /gsang sngags rnal 'byor yongs la brnyas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di yis bshig /rgyal khams 'di yis phung bar byas/ /yi dam lha tshogs khyed rnams la/ /log lta can 'dis bskur ba btab/ /bka' bsrung rnams la phod btsugs so/ /rig 'dzin rnams la do bsdos so/ /lha la mthu med zer nas brnyas/ /rnal 'byor lha med zer nas brnyas/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcu 'di la 'tshang / /'di lta stobs dang spro ba che/ /rang 'dod che la chog mi shes/ /bzang po thams cad khyad du gsod/ /bsam pa ngan la sbyor ba rtsub/ /brtse bar 'os pa'i nyams chung min/ /nga rgyal can 'di'i stangs chog cig /bdag cag chos la rten rnams kyi/ /mgon skyabs dkon mchog khyed las med/ /sngags 'chang rig 'dzin tshogs rnams kyis/ /zhi ba'i thabs ni sna tshogs pas/ /bzlog kyang log sred can 'di ni/ /thabs kyis sdig las bzlog ma nus/ /dgra 'di yun ring 'tsho gyur na/ /skye bo yongs la gnod byas nas/ /rang nyid mi bzang ngan 'gror ltung / /des na bsgral ba'i gnang ba zhu/khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po yi/ /mthu stobs zad pa mi mnga' bas/ /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ /rnam dag zhing du sgrol bar zhu/ /pho nya phyag brnyan mngags pa dang / /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad rnams/ /drag po'i las la sku bskyod cig /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ /chos kyi rgyal po gzhin rje ni/ /sa 'og mun pa'i smag rus nas/ /gshin rje bye ba ther 'bum bcas/ /mngon —256—

——rje rdod 'phrin las dus la bab/ /zhes bskur pas/ rang la gnang ba stsal zhing / dgra bgegs la thugs cher 'khru/gas pas drag po'i las la mngon du phyogs pa'i tshul du bzhugs par mos/ dgra bo dmigs bsal yod cing / bsgrub pa dang 'brel ba'i drag las gal che ba'i skabs yin na/ gnang ba zhu ba'i gzu dpang rgyas pa logs su yod pa ltar byas la/ dmigs bsal gyi yul med na/ khyad par dgra bo zhes sogs bar gyi tshig nyer brgyad bor bas chog go /de nas gnyis pa pho nya spro ba ni/ tse( badz+ra bhe ra ba ā ha/ zhes brjod/ lha'i nga rgyal drag po bskyed la/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed kyi sku dang / zhabs 'og gi srog chags rnams las dgra bgegs 'gug 'dren mdzad pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa spros par bsam/rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/'di skad ces gyer ro/ /hū/ 'jigs rma dzad chen po'i g.yas pa yi/ /zhabs brgyad las spros pho nya ni/ /ya ba ti dang chos kyi rgyal/ /gtel ba dang ni glang mgo can/ /mig dmar dang ni phya sangs dang / /rmig pa ral pa tshar dgu rnams// mi dang ma he khyu mchog dang / /bong bu ga dmar rnga mo dang / khyi nag lug dang ce spyang zhon/ /gdong brgyad gzhin rje brgyad po yang / /zhal nas bskal ba'i me yang spro/ /mche ba gtsigs shing ral pa sprug /dbu la 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis brgyan/ /shin tu drag por bskul ba'i tshe/ /mgo bo 'khor dang khrag tu skyug / rnam shes myos dang gsod par mdzod/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje bka' byung gis/ /gum gum chum chum las kyis shig /'jigs mdzad chen po'i g.yon pa yis/ /zhabs brgyad las spro/sa pho nya ni/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog ma/ / 'bebs pa mo dang pho nya mo/ /mche ba mo dang be con ma/ /dus mtshan ma dang brgyang po yang / /bya rgod 'ug pa khra dang ni/ /bya rog rne tso khyung chen dang / /ri skeg bzhad la zhon nas —257—

rgyug /nad bdag ma mo brgyad po yang / /zhal du sha khrag rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /mche ba gtsigs shing ral pa sprug /dbu la 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis brgyan/ /shin tu drag por bskul ba'i tshe/ /bstan pa 'jig pa nad kyis thob/ /myos dang bsod pa'i las mdzod cig /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bka' byung gi /gum gum chum chum las kyis shig /ya/ mi rgod ro langs bzhon pa la/ /gshin rje mi rgod mgo can zhon/ /gsod cig rgyob cig mi rgod gdong / /na ra mu kha'i dus la bab/ /ya/'jigs rung ma he'i bzhon pa la/ /gzhin rje ma he'i mgo can zhon/ /rwa rtser skyon cig ma/ he'i gdong / /ma he'i mu kha'i dus la bab/ /ya/ gdug rtsub glang gi bzhon pa la/ /gshin rje glang gi mgo can zhon/ /brdung cig brdzis cig ba lang gdong / /bri kha mu kha'i dus la bab/ / ya/ bgrod byed bong bu'i bzhon pa la/ /gshin rje bong bu'i mgo can zhon/ /zo zhig brod cig bong bu'i gdong / kha ra mu kha'i dus la bab/ /ya/ rdzu 'phrul rnga mo'i bzhon pa la/ /gshin rje rnga mo'i mgo can zhon/ /rdul du lhogs cig rnga mo'i gdong / /u spyi mu kha'i dus la bab ya za byed khyi yi bzhon pa la/ /gshin rje khyi yi mgo can zhon/ /rmugs zhig btub cig khyi yi gdong / shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ /ya/ gti mug lug gi bzhon pa la/ /gshin rje lug kyi mgo can zhon/ /brdungs zhig tshir cig lug gi gdong / /me ṣa mu kha'i dus la bab/ /ya/ kun 'gro ce spyang bzhon pa la/ /gshin rje ce spyang mgo can zhon/ /hub kyi thob cig ce spyang gdong / /phya la mu kha'i dus la bab/ /ma/thogs med bya rgod bzhon pa la/ /gshin rje bya rgod mgo can zhon/ /spyi bor phug cig bya rgod gdong / /kṛ dha mu kha'i dus la bab/ /ma/ mun mthong 'ug —258—

———pa'i bzhon pa la/ /ma mo 'ug pa'i mgo can zhon/ /klad khrag rngubs cig 'ug pa'i gdong / /u lu mu kha'i dus la bab/ /ma/'byin byed bya rog bzhon pa la/ /ma mo bya rog mgo can zhon/ /mig nas phyungs cig bya rog gdong / /kā ka mu kha'i dus la bab/ /ma/ 'dren byed ne tso'i bzhon pa la/ /ma mo ne tso'i mgo can zhon/ /rgyu ma drongs cig ne tso'i gdong / /su ka mu kha'i dus la bab/ /ma/ brlag byed khra yi bzhon pa la/ /ma mo khra yi mgo can zhon/ / don snying thod cig khra yig gdong / /phye na mu kha'i dus la bab/ /ma/ rlabs chen khyung gi bzhon pa la/ /ma mo khyung gi mgo can zhon/ /phye mar brlogs shig khyung gi gdong / /ga ru mu kha'i dus la bab/ /ma/rno ngar re skeg bzhon pa la/ /ma mo ri skeg mgo can zhon/ /bshig cig phye cig ri skeg gdong / thu ro mu kha'i dus la bab/ /ma/mdzes dkar bzhad kyi bzhon pa la/ /ma mo bzhad kyi mgo can zhon/ /phug cig gtubs zhig bzhad kyi gdong / /sa ra mu kha'i dus la bab/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po khyed rnams dang / /ma mo'i dbang phyug khyed rnams kyang / /phyag mtshan mtshon cha'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs/ /sprul pa'i tshogs kyis stong gsum 'gengs/ /pho nya drag gtum sprin ltar gtibs/ /nyams pa'i dgra bgegs 'dir khug la/ /ling ga 'di la myur du chug /bcing zhing brlab pa nyid du mdzod/ /gzhan yang zhing khams kun khyab par/ /sna tshogs don spyod rdzu 'phrul can/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang ma mo brgyad/ /ming po gsum dang sring mo bzhi/ /lha dang klu dang dri za'i tshogs/ / gza' dang rgyu skar 'jigs byed dang / /phyogs skyong bcu dang rgyal chen bzhi/ / 'bar ma dang ni dbang phyug ma/ /pho nya sum brgya drug cu dang / /drang srong grub pa 'phrog ma —259—

dang / /gnod spyin srin po ma rungs tshogs/ /gdon chen bco brgyad la sogs dang / /lha dang lha min rdzu 'phrul can/ /lha srin sde brgyad dus la bab/ /gshed byed byad byed bsam sbyor ngan/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod byed bgegs/ /bzung shig chings shing rnam par sdom/ khug shig drongs shig dbang du bsdus/ /gsod cig skrod cig rengs par gyis/ /phye cig gnod cig rmugs par gyis/ /thul shig choms shig rnam par bshig /phob cig btubs shig rnam par rgyob/ /dkrugs shig g.yengs shig rnam par chom/ /bdag gis bsgo ba kun khug la/ /srung skyob mgon dang bral bar mdzod/ /gsang sde brgyad dang phrol la shog /lo dang zla bar ma bzhag cig /zhag dang za mar ma 'jog cig / ma thogs myur du khrid la shog /bdun brgyud tshun chad khug la shog /stangs 'dzin rgyab rten phye mar bzhag /da lta nyid du 'dir khug la/ /gzugs brnyan 'di la myur du phob/ /'khor dang spyo zhing khrag tu skyugs/ /rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod//dus la bab po sa ma ya/ /zhes drag tu bskul lo/ /gnyis pa las sbyor dngos kyi bya ba la/ ling ga 'gugs sgrol/ drag po'i mchod gtor/ las gtad bskul ba/ gtor zor 'phang ba ste bzhi'o/ /dang po la/ ling sa bskyed pa/ dgug gzhug /lha dbye/ bsgral chog ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ 'brub khung gnam lcags kyi rang bzhin rgya che la gting zab pa/ mi bzad pa'i mun pa chen por mtshon cha'i bu yug dang / nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i na bun 'thul ba/ rgyob gsod kyi sgra dang / drag po'i 'brug sgras nag phyogs kyi snying 'gas par byed pa/ thar pa'i go skabs med pa'i gnas su gyur/ de lta bu'i nang dpag tshad —260—

——brgyad khri'i gting du/ rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor la ṇa 'am tri las dgra bo'am bgegs lus rid cing nyam chung ba/ dbang po dod pa/ lcags sgrog dang / zhags pas bcing zhing / bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag pa/ lus rma shu'i 'phreng bas khyab cing kyi hud kyi sgra sgrogs pa sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa'i sems dang ldan pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/gnyis pa ni/ hū mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas shing / cung zad g.yabs la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyirgyo lung dang rtogs pas bsdus pa dam pa'i chos rnams kya theg pa gsum la gnas pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi: yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi: sde bzhin gshes sa pa dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / las kyi rigs su zhugs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kya snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags ngang / rigs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi: dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje khro rgyal chen po gzhan rje gshed po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi: bka' sdod phyag brnyan dam can bsrung ma'i tshogs kyi chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i: kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i rnal 'byor pa bdag cag gi sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang / bden pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs kyis/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jigs par byed pa/ sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe ba/mi dbe ba bcu dang / mtshams med pa lnga la tre thogs pa sdig pa'i las la rtag tu —261—

spyod pa/ dkon mchog gsum la brnyas shing mtho 'tshams pa ma rungs pa thams cad dang / khyad par du rnal 'byor bsgrub pa po bdag cag la zhes pa'am/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa khyad par can 'di lta bu la zhes sogs skabs su bab kyi mtshams sbyar nas/ dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas gnod par byed pa'i snga dgra lag la bdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la bsams pa/ da ltar sngon du gyur pa'i las ngan gyi dgra bgegs/ dngos grub dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / bsam pa la bar du gcod par byed pa dang / thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / bsgom pa la log par sgrub par byed pa dang / tshe dang / 'byor pa dang / dbang phyug dang / bde ba dam pa la mi mthun par rtsom pa/ mdor na chos dang 'byor ba'am phan pa bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod par byed pa gang yin pa de dag mtho dma' dbus gsum/ nye ring bar gsum/ sa 'og /sa steng / sa bla gang gnas kyang rung / las mkhan pho nya'i tshogs khyed rnams kyis da lta nyid du ma thogs par myur ba nyid du 'dir khug cig /rgyab rten mo gon skyabs kyi dbang du ma gtong / las kyi rnam par smin pa la khag mi bzhag /phyi ma la dus ma 'debs par 'tshor ba med par 'dir khug cig /las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas ded cig /mun pa nag pos mdun nas bsus shig /gshin rje'i lcags kyus snying nas drongs shig /'chi bdag gi zhags pas ske nas chings shig /las ngan gyi dug gis spyo bar gyis shig /srog bdud kyi mtsho ni chas lus la btab nas/ rab tu bsdigs te skad cig thang cig sbya/rdo sna ༵ ༵ dhi ༵ sna sna hā~X dzi ༵kā lti mi badz+ra/ kā rnyi shā ༵ ༵ ༵/rdzu ༵ —262—

sha skyo/ tse( badz+ra snre( ṭa ba/ e( ā be sha a/ zhes rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas/ te lan gsum dgug gzhug bya'o//gsum pa ni/ de nas mchod pa gcig yi ge 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ ar+gha nas shabha'i bar gyis sngags dang phyag rgyas dgra bgegs kyi kha sbyor bzhi'am gsang sde'i lha la phul/rnam ri mi rtog thugs rje'i bdag /lus ngan 'di la ma bzhugs shig /mkha' dbyings chos sku'i klong dkyil du/ /lha dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /ces mchod pa steng du gtor zhing dmigs pa drag tu gtad do/ /bzhi pa ni/ de nas phyag mtshan rnams rim gyis 'debs tshul du byas nas/ hū/ zhe sngang gis mnan 'gro gzigs nas/ /zhe sdang gshi/na rje gshe/da gzugs su/ /bcom ldan snying rje'i dbang mdzad pa'i/ khro rgyal khyod kyi dus la bab/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /myur du khug la las mdzod cig /hū dza bka' bzhin spros nas ni/ /ṭak+ki hū dza myur du khug /rdo rje lcags kyu'i tshogs spros pas/khug cig badz+ra a ku sha /rdo rje zhags pa'i tshogs: /chings shig badz+ra pā sha ho /rdo rje lcags sgrog tshogs: /sdoms shig badz+ra spro ṭa ba/ /rdo rje dril bu'i: /phob cig badz+ra lha ṇ+ḍi ho /rdo rje phur bu'i tshogs spros pas/ /thob cig badz+ra gī la ya/ /rdo rje tho ba'i: /brdungs shig badz+ra mut+na ra/ /rdo rje dgra stu'i: /chod cig badz+ra pa ra shu// rdo rje rtse gsum: /gzir shig badz+ra tri shu la/ /rdo rje ral gri'i: /gtubs shig badz+ra kha lha ho /rdo rje gri gug: /rdul du rlog cig ka rta ri/ /zhes so/ /skabs 'dir thun brdeg par 'dod na man ngag bzhin du brdeg pa yin/ phyag mtshan thams cad 'debs pa'i lugs kyang / 'dug pa spyir mi 'gal mod/ gong ma rnams kyis 'di tsam kho na mdzad do/ /de nas/lha spyi'i sngags dang / sarba bisnan sha —263—

chun mā ra ya spel nas bzla bzhin du/ ling ga dum bur chi/ gnyis pa drag po'i mchod gtor 'bul ba la/ drug cu rtsa bzhi 'bul ba dang / mchod bstod rgyas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de'i phud nas 'das gtor sogs sgrub pa'i gtor ma rnams la sgron/ cha shas nas mchod pa gzhan la'ang bsre/ dgra bgegs rnams gtor ma la bstim pa'i dmigs pa yang yang byas la/ btab gtor drug cu rtsa bzhi sha dum drug cu rtsa bzhi ling ro lhag ma rnams dang bcas pa/ tshan pa re re zhing la/ chu dang khrag dang chang rnams blug la/ bsangs sbyangs/ o ā hū/ gtor ma dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi phung po chen por gyur/ gong gi yi dam gyi gtor sngags sam/ hṝ sgyi kho na'i mthar i dam sogs sbyar ba tshar gcig gi rjes la/ o in+t+ra ya hrisogs ji ltar 'os pa sbyar bas phul/ tshan pa re re'i mthar mkhar thabs kyi gtor ma la 'debs pa yin la/ 'on kyang zhag mang por bsgrub pa la ni snod gzhan du spungs pa nyid lag len bde'o/ /ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas rol mo dang bcas te/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /zhes sogs bstod pa dang 'phrin las bcol/ drag po rkyang pa'i skabs su las bcol yang drag po kho na byed/rkyen bzlog rim gro drag po'i skabs yin na/'dod gsol dkyus ma de yang byeng cing /mthar/ dgra dang bgegs dang log 'dren dang byad ma thams cad ni bā ra ya phaṭa/ rkyen ngan bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad phyi la bzlog par gyur cig /ces thal mo brdab bo/ /'di la phyogs skyong gi gtor sngags tshar bzhi bzhir bcad nas/ tshan pa bcu drug byed pa dang / brgyad tshan brgyad du gcod pa dang / bcu drug pa'i tshan pa bzhir byed pa rnams/ lag len rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi khyad par yin la/ gang ltar yang tshan pa mang nyung gi khyad ma gtogs/ tshan pa re re'i mgor byin rlabs gso ba dang / 'das gtor gyi sngags tshar gceg rnams spyor zhing / mjug tu mchod bstod 'dod gsol rnams byed pa la khyad par med —264—

— ——— ———— rde——spo——do/ /mgron gyi gtso bo ni phyogs skyong yin yang / phud yi dam dang / zhor la 'dir gtogs kyi chos skyong mtha' dag la bsngo ba yin no/ /gnyis nga/ mchod bstod ni/ drag po'i mchod pa gsar du'ang bshams/ rnying pa rnams kyang kha gsos/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las byung ba'i ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ o ā hu dang / ra yig las byung ba'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag gi mchod yon dang/ zhabs bsil/ dbang po lnga'i me tog / tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris chen dri dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/thod rnga'i rol mo/ g.yang gzhi'i 'phan gdugs/ skra'i rnga yab/ nang khrol gyi lda ldi/zhing chen gyi rgyal mtshan/ thong/ pa skam rlon gyi do shal/ ni ra su'i phyag rgya la sogs pa drag po'i las kyi mthun rdzas sa dang bar snang nam mkha' thams cad khyab par gyur/ ar+gha sogs sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ hū/ stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na/ /dgra bgegs ma ྅/sa bsgral pa yi/ / khrag zhag ar+gha la sogs pa/ /mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa rnams/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /gshi/na rje gshed po'i lha tshogs la/ /gus pa'i sems kyi bdag 'bul gyis/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas kyang / /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don/ /ma lus par ni grub par mdzod/ /o shrī badz+ra bhi ra wa ya sa pā ri wā ra ar+gha pra tisnro swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ dbang lnga'i pulpe la sogs pa/ /me tog ji snyed mchis pa rnams/ /zhes pa dang / badz+ra pukhre/ zhes 'don pa spo/ tshil chen dhu pe/ bdug spos ji snyed/ dhu pe/ zhun chen di pe/ snang gsal/ ā lo ke /mkhris pa'i lha rnye/ dri —265—

mchog /ga rnye/ sha rus bza' ba/ zhal zas/ sna wi kha ༅ / thod rnga rkang gling / rol cho /sha rto zhes sbyar/ ri/ g.yang gzhi'i bla re nam/ mkha'i rgyan/ /rgyu rlon lda ldi bar snang rgyan/ /keng rus zhing chen sa gzhi'i rgyan/ / phyag rgya rnam drug sku yi rgyan/ /'jigs byed chen ngo/ mnyes byed pa'i/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /bcom lngan rdo rje sogs/ a li dri ta/ myos byed stong gi bcud bsdus pa/ /lcags kyu lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang rab sbyar ba/ /ye shes lnga ru byin gyis brlabs// kha dog dri ro nus par ldan/ /dngos grub pad+mo 'byung ba'i gnas/ /mkha' 'gro ngang pa 'du ba'i gzhi/ /gsang ba bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di/ /bcom ldan rdo rje /badz+ra a mṛ ta/ de nas skabs 'dir spro zhing shes na/ 'jam dpal khros pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /zhes sogs/ ma drangs dgra bgegs thams cad zo/ /zhes pa'i bar du bstod pa rgyas pa bya zhing / bsdu na/ dur khrod rgyan gyi sogs dang / phyogs skyong dang / chos rgyal la'ang gong gi bstod thung rnams kyis bstod/ gsum pa las gtad cing bskul ba ni/ hū/ sangs rgyas bye ba phrag 'bum gyi/ /mtshan nas brjod pa'i bsod nams las/ /'jam dpal lan cig ches mchog tu/ /gsungs kyi bdag la byin gyi brlobs/ /rdo rje khros pa'ang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / mthong na lag cha lhung gyur na/ /gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /dgra bgegs ma lus myur du bsdigs/ /dregs pas khros pa khro bo'i bka'/ /bsgos pa gal te mi byed na/ /rgyal ba'ang za bas bsdigs byed na/ /dgra bgegs ma lus myur du zo /'jig rten gshin rje khros pas kyang / /thal bar byed na 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ khros pa smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /dgra bgegs rdul phran bzhin du mdzod/ /bdud sde kun gyis dus gsum gyi/ /sangs —266—

rgyas mtshan ni thos pa bas/ /'jam dpal lan gcig thos pa nyid/ /lhag par 'jigs kyi bdud sde choms / /sha chen khrag zhag chen po yi/ /gtor ma rgya mtsho mchod par bzhes/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dam tshig dang / /thugs rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ /ces gtso bo'i thugs dam bskul/skyo/shar phyogs rab 'jigs dur khrod nas/ /phyogs skyong rgyal po 'jigs byed pa/ /dri za 'dul mjad gzhin rje'i sku/ /ma mo srin po'i tshogs dang bcas/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snom la//rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ shar phyogs kyi dod du/ lho phyogs/ dri za'i dod du/ grul bum/ zhes 'don pa spo sa la gzhan rnams 'dra/ de bzhin du/ nub phyogs/ klu rnams/ byang / gnod sbyin/ shar lho/me lha/ lho nub/ srin po/ nub byang / rlung lha/ byang shar/ 'byung po/ steng phyogs/tshangs pa/ 'og phyogs/ sa bdag /ces pa'o/ /hu/ gshin rje gshed kyi rnam 'phrul las/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /phyogs skyong bcu po'i 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ / bdag ni rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i thugs kyi sras/ / gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ / bsam pa byang chub sems kyis brlan/ /rgyar ni ye shes rdo rje 'chang / /gzi byin sku gsung thugs kyi skyed/ /don ni 'gro ba yongs kyi don/ /las ni sangs rgyas kun gyi las/ /bka' ni dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'/ /phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ kha chen khrag zhag chen po yi/ /gtor ma rgya mtsho mchod par bzhes/ /sdang ba'i dgra —267—

————judang gnod pa'i bshegs/ /zhes sogs gong bzhin/ bar 'dir nus shing spro na/ gshin rje pho brgyad mo brgyad dang / lha srid sde brgyad kyi bskul ba rnams lha'i nga rgyal gyi gdengs ngang ldan pas bsgrub bo/ /de yan chad thugs dam/ bskul ba tsam/ yi/na la/ de nas las gtad dngos ni/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas la las gtad cing bsku‘gra ba ste/ sha khrag gi mchod pa tshan gcig batsha/mas/ gtor ma kha gsos dgra bshegs 'gugs 'dren dang / zhal du btab pa'i dmigs pa dras po dang bcas/ gtor sngags lan rma nga pos phul/ gong drag po'i mchod rdzas kyi skabs bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ sdong gsum 'di 'am sogs la 'don pa spo ste/ bcom ldan rdo rje sogs/ kyi dod du/ chos/ kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i tshogs/ /ma mo gshin rje srin po ngang / sgyu/dreg pa pho mo dpag med rnams/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bka' nod nas/ / /rngam sa pa'i stobs kyis bzhes nas kyang / /bsad bskrad dbye dang rmongs rengs/ kyis/ /'phrin las drag pos bsgrub po'i don/ /ma lus par ni grub par mdzod/ /o kā la rā pa sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra ar+gha pra tisnro sarba bisnrun sha krus/ mā ra ya hu phaṭa/ ces brjod cing rol mo'i bar de'i rigs 'gre/ mchod rdzas de rnams las gshin gyi gtor ma la btab/ bcom ldan chos rje sogs kyis bstod/ 'di nas lho yi zhes pa nas/'khor ra bcas 'dir ni bdag la dgongs/ /bdag la gnod pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /byad ma bsam sbyor ngan pa 'di/ /gson na 'gro ba yongs la gnod/ /dkon mchog gsum la rnam par 'tshe/ /dmigs kyi rnal 'byo ra yongs la sdang / /'di dag myur du bsgral ba'i phyir/ /chos rgyal 'khore bcas spyan drangs kyi/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'phrin las bsgrubs/ /bcom ldan ga tha/na rje gshe/da po'i bka'/ /chos kyi rgyal po dgongs su gsol/ /de ring drag po'i 'phrin las —268—

——————spo —————tho———————————— rde———rderderde——ge——————————— ka——————ni/ khyo/da kyi las su'os pa yin/ /lha dang bcas nga/'i 8'a snangs rten na/ ༈las ma lbes chos bzhin gcod pa khyod/ /pe/3rin na rje gas/da kyi bka' 'bor na/ /ba po/'a ‘nar / dam tshig bsrung ba khyod/ /las dang rkyen gyi 'chi ba yi/ /srog ri pa dbang byed bdag po khyod/ /de phyir las 'di khyod 'a/ gtad/ khyod kya tsho yel bar ni :smri/ bsru na te/ /tha mal sems can nyes med cing / /sto‘nan gyi bsku snye pa ba ma byas nga ra/ sgyu sla bur 'phrad pa'ang 'dzin byed na/ /nga yis gtad pa'i ‘pas 'di rnams/ /(snar smu4 dpal ga 'on nu'i bka' bzhin du/ /dam tshig phyag rgya mi/ga 'a/ bstan/ /dam tshig snying po rna bar bsgrags/ /rdo rje'i tha tshig snying 'a bzhag /dam rdzas ma chod pa phu swo nas kyang / /dam tshig 'phrin la/sa gnyer du sa tad / /la sa (ri di sngon du bskrub nga nga rigs/ /khyod kyis las 'di ma bsgrubs na/ /dal/na byo/chog gsum gyi brka/'a yang bcag /gshi/na rje gshe/da kyi dam yang bral/ /rang tho tha tsheg rang bis bslus/ /dam tshig grogs po bdag cag gī /re ba'i ngas ma pa gting nas bcad/ /de bas las 'di bsgrub par gyis/ /hūṃ/ 'cha bdag nag rnga/rdo lhe phyo sas kyi/ /rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas/ /srog la rngams pa'i gshi' rje ni/ /nas/ po'i ma he'i gdan steng du/ /ya las byung ba'i dbyug pa ri/ /thod pas mtshan ri/ 'a/sa byung ba/ /gting nas khros pa ma he'i ga ngo/nga / /za byed zhal gdangs/ rma che ba gtsigs/ khros pa'i spyan gsum dmar po 'khyu/ga /das skra dmar se ra gyen dubardzes/ /lag ga sku1na zhags pas dgra bgegs chings / /'a/ga g.yas dbyug pas rdul du rlog /chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i tshogs/ /bran dang bcas pas dus 'a bab/ /sha chen khrag zhag chen rje du de yi/ /ga sgyu hor ma rgya ma bye ma mchod par bzhes/ /rgya' —269—

bas bsgos pa'i dam tshig dang / /snying rjes dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /bdud dang sogs gong bzhin las/ thul zhig choms shig rnam par bshig /rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod/ /ces bskul te/bsdu na las gtad de tsam gyis kyang chog la/ yang cung zad rgyas pa la dga' na/ khyod kyi 'kho(ra gyi dkyil 'khore na/ /ya ma du ti zhes bya ba/ /lag na lcags kyu 'bar ba thogs/ /gang zhig 'gus sa par 'dod pa de/ /dbyugs pa tsam gyis 'gugs par byed/ /khyod la gnyer du gtad pa ni/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /gnod pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs/ /do nub khyod kyis bzung bar gyis/ /'di la dmigs kyi bas pa ba'i bsgrub bya yod na/khyod la gnyer du gtad pa ni/ /nai zhes bya'i yul khams na/ rus ni r+sha mo zhes bya/ /de yi ming ni nai mo/ /'di dag grogs dang bcas pa kun/ /de ring khyod kyis bzung bar gyis/ /zhes sogs brjod par bshad cing / bzung bar gyis zhes bsad par gyis/ /zhes pa'am/brlag par gyis/zhes nga rim/ bskrad par gyis/ sogs las dang mthun par sbyar ro/ /dkyus la yang / bdag cag 'khore dang bcas pa zhes pa skabs su gang bab tu 'don pa bsgyur bas chog go /gzhan yang 'kho ra gyi dkyil 'kho ra na/ /ka la pā sha zhes bya ba/ /lag na dus kyi zhags pa thogs/ /gang zhig 'dzin par 'dod pa de/ /btab pa tsam gyis 'dzin par byed/ khyod la gnyer du gtad pa na/ /sogs/ gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /ya ma daṇ+ḍi zhes bya ba/ /lag na be con nag po thogs/ /gang zhig bsad par 'dod pa de/ /phyar ba tsam gyis 'chi bar byed/ khyod la gnyer du sogs/ gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /ya ma da spyi zhes bya ba/ /za byed mche ba 'bar ba —270—

—————— ——ge—rde——— ————snye —————————spo——spo —————————————————— ——can/ /gang zhig za bar 'dod nga/ de/ gtsigs nga/ cam gya tsho za bar dbyad/ /byong la sogs/ gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khore na/ /kā la ra tri la sos/sa pa'i/ /gsod pa mo dang nag mo dang / /nam gru sha kā li la so/gas/ bud med tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ /la la las kyi me long ca'/ /la la nad kyi rkya'/ pa thogs/ /la la mtshon gyi gru gu can/ /la la bdud kyi /khram ba thogs/ /la la shwa rde dkar nag can/ /la la lcags kyi dre'u rta zhon/ /la la bong bu gwa pa zhon/ / la la rlung nag 'tshu/ba ma zhon/ /la la chu bya nag po zhon/ /la la gnam gyi gung la rgyu/ /la la chu bo'i gzhung la rgyu/ /la la nyi ma'i zer la rgyu/ /kun kyang ga'an srog 'phrog pa ste/ khyod la gnyer du sogs/ gzhan yang nang gi dkyil 'i shebo ra na/ /ya ba ti dang phya sangs dang / /rmig pa ral pa tshar dgu sogs/ /la la rgyal po'i tshu'/ du gnas/ /la la blon po'i tshul du gnas/ kha cig dag ni ded dpon tshu' / /la la pho nya'i tshul du gnas/ /la la be con 'khore lo dang / /gsal shing mdung thung mtshon cha thogs/ /so so'i sde dpon mngag pa dang / /pho nya phyag brnyan bcas pa la/ /'phrin las gnyer du gtad pa ni/ /sogs gong bzhin/ de nas dam la bzhag pa ni/oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pā ri wā ra ar+gha pra titsā hu/ zhes pas dmar gyi ar+gha lan gsum sgreng /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'gru/ba/ /gal te dam tshig 'das gyur na/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje khros nas kyang / / snying ga nas ni rig sdo/gas par 'gyu/rder/ /de bas dam la ma 'da' rwa nig /o badz+ra u da ka hū ཾ ṭha ṭha ṭha/ zhes nang mchod nas mna' chu blud/ hū/ sngon gyi tha tshig dran bya'i phyir/ /rdorje tha tshig 'di bsnan —271—

———rde——————rderdeng/sa / /mi phyed rdo rje'i tha tshig 'di/ khyod kyi snying la gnas par 'gyur/ /o badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes snying khang rdo rje bzhag go /ba'i pa/ gtor zor 'phang ba ni/ de nas lugs gcig la maṇ+ḍal gyi gtso bo tshom bu bsgrub pa po rang nyid kyi spyi bor bzhag pa'am/ yi dam/ gyi gtor ma la phul/ gzhan gyi lha tshogs rnams gtor ra/'i myom/ gru/khar sbar bas mos la/ so sor lcags mkhar dang po ston na rje'i gtor ma la 'debs/rme rtan ra kyi ma/chod pa rnams kyang so so'i gtor ma/ la bsdu ba'i lag len snang ba glo bur las bcol gyi po/tor ma'i skabs de bzhin yin zhing / rtsa ba'i gtor chog rnams byed na/ maṇ+ḍal rjes chog gi dus bsdus rnga/sa chog pas/ dam can bsrung ma'i sprul gzhi rnams der bzhugs shing / sprul pa las ma/khan dang bcas pa phyir bskyod pa yin no/ /de yan chad sgrub khang du byed pa'i lugs so/ /las gshi/na gyi las gtad sgrub khang gi sgo drung du byed pa dang / gtor ma gtong sar byed pa yod par yang mi 'gal lo/ /gang ltar yang phud gtor bas sna drangs/ dar 'phyar zhing / rol mo dang bcas pa'i phyi bzhin du/sngon la las gshi/na gyi gtor ma/ de rjes lcags mkhar dang / btab gtor sogs khyer/ bsgrub pa ngo sa de dag gi phyi bzhin du 'gro la/ gtor skyel ba zhu ba can gyis byed pa lag len la yod pas grub na bya/ ma tha' gcig tu ma nges/ zor gyi gnas su phyin la/ dang por/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sbyo bi shwa so gas sngags kyis bla ma/ yi dam chos skyong rnam sa la phud gtor/ de nas sngags nge/sa sde brgyad spyi la gtor/ yang sngags der zor lam na gnas rnga/'i 'byung ngo/ rnams la phul/ de dag tu rgyun rol bya/ de nas bden nga/ mang du bdar zhing 'di skad ces/ chos lugs rgyal bar gyur cig chos min rgyal ma gyur/ /sangs rgyas rgyal bar gyur cig mu/stegs rgyal ma gyur/ /lha rngams rgyal bar gyur cig lha min rgyal ma gyur/ /sgrub po rgyal bar gyur cig dgra bgegs rgyal ma gyur/ /sangs/ kyis ni bdud pham mdzad/ /chos ma yin ni chos —272—

—kyis the'u tsho /dge 'dun gyis ni rtsags pham/ / dbang pos lha min pham par gyur/ /pe/chen na rje gshed po'i lha tshogs kyis/ /dgra bgegs thams cad pham par mdzad/ /rigs sngags bden pa'i mas 'di ni/ /thogs pa med rnga/ra 'khru/rdeb par yeg rdeg /ces rig pa ngar dang lda myo rnga/sa brjod/ de nas zor lam dbye ba la gtor rme/ zhes sa/tang na legs shing / bsdu na slar yang gser skyem cam zhig gtor la/ nga ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /'jam dpal /bros pa gshin rje gshed/ / dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /de ring drag po'i zor 'phen gya tsho/ / bstan pa yongs kyi bsrung ma dang / /sems can phan byed dge la spro/ /dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba yi/ /'byu nga po thams cad sku bskyod cig /de ring drag po'i sngags kyi zor/ /sde brgyad rnams la mi/ 'phen no/ /rung phrag dog ma mdzad cig /lam na gnas nga/ gzhan dub/lder gas/ /gnas gzhan bskyod par mi nus na/ /mtho ba rnams ni zhabs bskum zhig /dma' ba rnams ni dba'i chum 'ig /bar ma rnams ni sku zur zhig /bag med rnams ni bag mdzod cig /zor (snang/ sdang ba'i nga/gra 'a/ ya/ /zor 'di gnod pa'i bgegs la ya/ /gnod byed byad ma'i snying la ya/ /zhes brjod/ bar 'dir spro na thun zor gyi rigs ci 'dod 'phangs pas chog /de nas gtor ma bsku pa ba ni/ zlog pa tsam gyi ched du yin tsha hūm̐ ya bya bla ma yi dam lha tshogs kyi/ /do nub zor gyi las mdzod cig /gshin rje gshe/rded kyi lha tshogs kyis/ /do nub /dar/ can chos skyong bsrung ma yis / /do nub: /'a sa kyi gshin rje 'khordo ra bcas kyis/ /do nub: /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyis/ /yed nub: /yul lha gzhi bdag gnyan ngo/ yis/ /donub pror gyi las mdzod cig /khro bo'i rgyal po khyed rnams ni/ /ma g.yel 'phrin —273—

spo—spo spyo spo 4 spo ga pa spo——las dus la bab/ /rkyen nga 'a thams cad dgra la sbyo /gnod pa'i bsegs kyi steng du sbyo /ngan pa bzlog la rtsub po bsgyur/ /chos kyi rgyal po sku bskyod la/ /sdeng bi ngan sngags dgra la bsgyur/ /zlog go drag po'i dpung gis bzlog /bskyur ro ltas ngam cho 'phrul bskyur/ /rdzas sngags 'khra/pa 'khor phyi la bzlog /ya pa ti ni mi sku bskyong la/ /shar gyi ngan sngags: /myos byed 'bar ba bye /lco yi: /ā r+ya ma rtsa /nub kyi nga phyo /ral ba tshar dgu tsha byang bi ngan sgro sto/mis nga/mar la da tshes sas: /phyegs rma/tshams ngan ngu /tsa muṇ+ḍa ni sku: /'og thi ngan sngags: /so gas grong ba 'phyo/ bdud g.yos mun ltar 'thibs pa bzlog /sri langs me lngar 'bar ba bzlopo/ /da che/ sri ba/ra chad byed nga/ bzlog /klu ya mnan gtad byed pa bzlog /rgyal shi re spyo 'bos 'a/ sogs bzlos /btsan gyi zhags pa skyong ba bzlos /yam shud 'gong hro'i kand pa bzlog /gzhan gyi bsam sbyo ra ngan pa yi/ /sbod gtong dmod mo'i rigs rnams bzlog /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig dang / /mtshan ltas ngan kra tha che/sa cang/ bzlog /ye 'bras gsum brgya drug cu dang / /nad rigs ba'i brgya rtsa bzhi bzlos /rmi lam ngan pa thams cad nga/nga / /bakhegs ras sa stong phras brgyad cu mas sa/ /sde brgyad rngams kyi skrod gtong dang / /cho//ba tā 'grom dang ro langs dang / /rgyal bsen bar chad byed pa bzlog /bdag cas/ bstan pa skyong ba la/ /'gal rkyen byed pa thams chi cad bzlog /bdud kyi :dram ༈spa dgra la bsgyur/ /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la da /thams cu cang sa chod pa'i brgegs la bya /snga nga gra dar ba thams cad zlog /phyi dgra rtsom pa thams cang bzlog /da dgra nga cho༈ khu nga/ thams rbod bzlog /sngang ba'i sa gsum stongs par gyis / /chos dbyings rung du —274—

dag par mdzod/ /ces pa'i mthar gtor zor 'phang ba dngos ni/ rol mo'i sgra drag po ngang bcas dang por las gshin gyi gtor ma zor du 'phang / lcags mkhar dang / btab gtor so sor sku1da na/ lcags mkhar kha sbub du brdab/ btab gtor rnams phyi nas rim pas 'phang yang bsang las gtso che ba yin na/ hu ya sbyo/ nas/ bgegs kyi steng du rje/ /zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ma rungs gtum po sdig pa can/ /dbon mchog gsum la gnod byed dang / /rdo rje slob dpon smod pa dang / /sems can yongs la 'tshe byed cing / /theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang / /gsang sngags rgyud la 'phya byed pa/ khyad par rnal 'byore bdag cag la/ /gnod cing bar chad byed pa 'di/ /yul phyogs gang na gnas kyang rung / /spyod tshul ji ltar ston yang rung / /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul ldan pa yi/ /chos rgyal gzhin rje 'khore bcas dang / /phyogs skyong bcu yi sna drangs te/ /srid gsum dmag gis dgra bgegs chom/ /'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad phob cig /drag pos mtshon cha'i char phob cig /cho 'phrul ltas ngan thams cad phob/ /mdza' bshe/sa nye ba kun dang phrol/ /lcags kyus drongs la zhags pas chings/ /yan lag mtshon chas gtubs la sod/ /rgyu ma nang khrol thang la pho /don snying dbang po lnga yi tshogs/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po'i zhal du thob/ /sde brgyad rngams pa'i pho nya 'gyed/ /pho rgyud rnams ni sha la ze ( /ma mo'i tshogs rnams khrag la 'thung / /gzugs phung bshig la rngam shes spor/ /bsde/ chen dbyings su sgrol bar mdzorwa da/ /bsdu na de tsam gyi chog /cung zad spros pa 'a dga' na/dmo da pa'i tshegs bcad gzhan yang yod de logs su sbyar ba las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar zor bskul te/ de nas zor rnams gong bzhin 'phangs/ dgra bo'i rnam shes mar me bsad pa snye ltar song / gnas lus longs spyo da thal bar brlag —275—

par bsam mo/ /de nas zor rjes ni/ zor 'a/ma gcod pa'i dmigs pa byas nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis rting mnan te nang du 'ong /gsum nga/ rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams spa gso/ gong gnas yo byin rlabs kyi skabs sam drag po'i mchod rdzas kyi skabs ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ gong du bshad pa'i tshigs bcad sngags ngang bcas nga/ gong 'og gang rung gcas sbyar nas/ ma/chod yon nas/ rol mo'i bar 'bul/ yi dam chos skyong rnam/sa kyi snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar la nang mchod 'bul/ de nas rol chen dang bcas / sa zugs sdi 'a segs drug po ni/ /nas/ dud kha mun can khyod la 'dud//ces pa/tre bar brjod/ rme rtsog sbyi myo rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /ces pa nas / ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'du1da/ /kyi bar 'dud bstod nyi shu bya zhing / shes shing spro na dbyangs dang bcas te bya/ bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ spro na gzhan yang bstod pa ji ltar rigs pas bstod do// ga tshe bcam ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs rnam/sa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor ra dang bcas pa thams cang bang/ga la dgo/ngas su gsol/ bdag cag rnams kyi sngo rdon gyi 'a /sa las sdo/ra nga/ dang / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad dang / gad myo dang / bar chad thams cad zhi bar ma/dzad du gsol tshe dang bsod nams dang dang/la dang 'byor pa tha ra/sa cad gong nas khrong du 'phel zhing rgyas par ma/dzad du gsol/ dbang phyug nga che/ nga/ phun sum tshogs nga sa/ 'gro ba thams/ cad byang chub 'a/ ya nga nga/ga par sa theg ca nga nga/nga / snga nga ba dang sa dug pa ri/ru sems can zhi bas mi/ 'du'/ ba rnams drag po'i las kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub dam/ nga/ ma/ lus pa stsa'/ du gsol/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos —276—

sum cu rtsa bdun yongs su rdzogs pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rang bzhin rnam par dkar ba'i lam rgyud la skye bar mdzad dug sol/ sems can thams cad kyi bdud dpa nyon rmo/ngas pa rtsa ba dang dri mar bcas pa thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du gzhom par rma/dzad du sa sa la/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang theg pa bde ba dang / lam bde ba nga/nga / 'ju ga pa bde bas thob par mdzad du gsol/ ji srid go 'phang mchog de nyid ma thob ba'i bar du yang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las/ 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad thob par ma/dzad du gsol/ ces pa 'a spya —ra pa sa gsol ba yang nas yang du gdab bar bya'o/ /ye se brgya pa ci nus bzlas pas lhag cha nga ba bska nga / ma 'byor ra ba dang nyam/sa pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni//bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal/ ba/ /de yang mgon pos bzang nga/ra mdzod/ /gang yang bdag blo rngo/ngas pa yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pe / /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// /mgon khyod de kun bzod nga ra mdzod/ / pa rnyed yongs su ma shes/ dang / /gang ya nga nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis ba//de kun gtso bos bzod rma dzad rigs/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can ngon kun ma/dzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub gams 'a/rde/ /sangs rgyas yu' du gshegs nas kyang tsā /slar yang 'byo myo pa mdzad du gso'// /ces nga/3ma/ bdag la dngos grub mchog stsa'/ lags/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsal// /sems can kur la ci 'dod par/ /dngos grub bla na meng/ pa'ang stsa'// /slar yang gshegs nga ra ma jad rnga/'i phyir/ /rang gi gnas gshegs badz+ra mu /myos dza ya dza ya/ su dza ya/ bi shwa rū pa —277—

dh+wa ri gasnro ga smos bhā wa na/ kṛ ta rnye na/ ta thā ga:spyi sarba bud+dhā :bi sa rdza ya/ ma ma kar ma ku ru swāhā/ zhes gtor mgron dang / sngar rdul tshon gyi maṇ+ḍal gshegs gsol ma zin na skabs 'ji/ra ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dza hu ba3to dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim/bris sku la brtan bzhugs spyi dang mthun par bya/ rang gi dpral bar skye yi nas/ lhe bar sa rnams kyis rgyas btab par gyur/ ces brjod la/ smon lam bkra shis gang 'grub cig bya'o//gtor chog rgyas pa 'di dang 'brel bar tshogs kyi 'khor lo'am/ dpa' bo'i ston mo gal che ba yin pa las/ drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma bsngos grub ma thag tu byed pa thob thang yin na'ang / lag len mi bde tshwa sa deng sang mi byed la/ gtor zor 'phangs zin nas/ rjes chog ma byas pa'i bar der 'khor lo'i mchod pa bya ba'am/ yang na gtor chog dang 'brel ba'i bya ba dang mtha' dag grub/ las rjes kyang bsdus zin nas slar brtsams kyang rung ngo / /'bi/ dag gi man ngag ni gzhan du 'chad par 'gyur zhing /gshin rje gshed dmar nag la 'don pa spo tshul dang /zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi las dang 'brel ba'i bya ba rnam/sa kyang 'di rnams la rjes su dpags te shes par bya'o// //'dir smras pa/thabs las dug kyang bdud rtsir gyur/ / mkhri'i sbyor bas lcags kyang gser/ /'chi ster dbyug gu'i ye shes chas/ /'dod pa kun 'grub ngo mtshar rmad/ /dpal ldan rgyud chen gsang ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /dngos grub kun 'byung yid bzhin nor rnyed pa/ /bdud las rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan rtser mchod pas / /phun tshogs 'gro snye pa phan bde'i rgyur gyur cig /ces dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar drus cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor chog gi ngag 'don khams gsum zil gnon zhes bya ba 'ji yang ma/nga pos bskul ba'i ngor/ 7 rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o// //dar rgyas/ 'phel/ mthi la//—278—

lde'u rdo thung gzhan la med pa'i /khyad ye chas dgra bgegs ṭa/na 'jo dums/ zhen/ bya ba bzhu / ga po//dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed khros rnga 'i rgyar po 'a phya ga 'chal 'o / /sa shan rnge gshed ngo 'i bsnye na pa/ song zhing / mgon nag bi snying ngo 'bu gru dra sa pa'i bzla/sa dra cis sa rnga / red bya'o/ /drug cu ce ba 'e sna dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyogs gang yang rung ba cig tu/ chos/ 'byung gru sa su rma mtha' me ris bsar zhing / rma/chu la rdo rje sngon po'i phreng ba yo da nga cig bya/ dbus su nyi gdan 'a gri gug 'bri ba'am / nas nag gi tshom bu 'god/ nas nas rjen btags kā// sran zhos /bra bo/ rdo phye/ lta sas rmye / rak+ta ngang chang sogs bsres pa'i gtor rma/ gru gsum rtsa ba'i phyo gas5 kyi zur gsu ra du mi ma myos mchan nga/ la / du ka khrag ro so/la bsres pas byugs// ltas sa stod du bkod pa/ yungs kar dang / sde tshe'i gang bu/ raka po thing gi tsher ma dug khrag bis rna/ pa cung zad btsugs / ma/tha' la drag po'i ma/chod ru rdzogaber gyis gru gsum/ du bskor/ 'jis rten 'das gtor lnga tshar gyi ra/dun du mgor po/'i bska pa gtor chi nga pa 'a/ gtor mda' dang dar nag btsugs pa cig kyang bsham sa/ mchod gtor rnam/sa byin rlabs/ ma rmo/'i sdebs la/ dmigs pa byas pas chog go/ce ba'i ga rtar chos thi chos rgyal la sa gsan gyi gtor bsngo so nga mtshams/ tseX( āXkhyuX/ lan bdun tsam gyis rma ha ka (pa'i gtor ma/ byin rlabs la gso /ning /mchod pa byin rlabs bsdus pa cig kyang bya/ dkyil 'khor bas ngas/ sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/bsrung 'khor gyi nang du dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhi snyel/ rdo rje'i brag ri gru gsum/ gyi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du paX las pad+ma dang / re las nyi rma/'i gang myo la/ hre —27/)—

las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bam chen gyi steng du gtso bo'i thugs ka nas hū yig nag po me 'bar ba spros te 'khod/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/sems can gyi don byas/ byin rlabs nus mthu rnams tshur 'dus hu la thim/yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po mahā kā la/ sku mdog dus kyi mun pa ltar ches gnag pa/ sbom zhing thung ba/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/gtum zhing khros pa/ 'tsham pa las 'das pa'i khro gtum drag shul can/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis/ g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs shing drag tu bzhad pa/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra kham nag 'bar zhing 'jings pa/ stag lpags dang / sbrul dang mi mgos brgyan pa/ me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus na/ pad nyi mi ro'i gdan la bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa'o/ /dpral bar o/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hū/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mgon po mahā kā la 'khor dang bcas pa/ o badz+ra sa mā dza lan gsum/ rdo rje 'chang bi spyan snga sa /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di sa /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gyi/ /gnyis su med par gshegs su gsol/ e hu hi/ mahā kā la ye/ hū/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs dam tshig nyer 'ongs pa/ /bskyed pa'i dam tshig byin rlabs phyir/ /thugs rjes byon la brtan par bzhugs/ /sa ma ya ti gri dza hū ba ho rang ngam/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas dbang gi lha rnams spros/ dam rdzas dang / mchod pa'i sprin phung stibs te/ cha byad sna tshogs dang bcas pas/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ gshin rje —280—

———gshe/da pos dbu rgyan/ o badz+ra mahā kā la ya/ ar+gha pra titsā swāhā/ nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ shā sa na lan gsum gyis 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi gtor ma phul/ o mahā kā la ya hu hū phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ tse( ā hū/ pañtsa a mṛ ta 'a hi/ lan gsum dang / shā sa na tshar gcig gis bdud rtsi 'bul/ nang mchod gtor ma la bran/ o mahā kā la ya/ sarba ṭa : ca/ mā ra ya mahā ma sa ji hi/ mahā rak+ta sku hi/ lan gsum/ shā sa na tshar gcig brjod pas rak+ta 'bul/ gtor ma la khrag gis bran no/ /ha ha ho ho hū hu zhes gsungs par gyur/ de nas thod pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ shā sa na'i mthar/ sa ma ya stu/ sa ma ya ho zhes sbyar ba lan gsum gyis dam la bzhag /dpal nag po chen po khyod kyis/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar/ ji ltas khas blangs dam bcas pa bzhin/ rnal 'byor ra pa bdag gis ji ltar bcol ba'i 'phrin las thams cad grub par mdzod cig/ces brjod/bdud rtsi dang rak+ta bsres pa gtor ma la bran/ hū ring po bdun/ lko pañtsa a mṛ ta u ta ka ṭha ṭha ṭha hū/ lan gsum/ bzhan rje gshed po deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /bdag kyang dam las mi 'da' yi/ khyod kyang dam las ma 'da' cig /de rjes/ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can/ /zhes pa nas/ dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /dpal 'bar nag po chen po yis/ /bdag la dgos pa'i don thams cad/ /bsam pa bzhin du sgrub pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar mdzod/ /ces brjod/ o mahā kā la ya hu hu phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs ji ltar 'os pa bzlas so/ /de nas ye shes mgon po nyid las mgon du bsgyur nas/ lko mahā kā la gu ṇa hri da dza dza zhes pa'ang ji ltar 'os pa bzla/ o mahā kā la dgra bo mā ra ya hu phaṭa/ces pa dang / shā sa na dang / de gnyis la drag po spu gri btags pa rnams kyang cung zad bzla'o/ /spu —281—

——— ——gri'i sngags ni/ tse ( /mahā kā la yak+ṣa/ mahā kā la sdor lde thum dza dgra rje༈/dam nyams kyi mgo lus pra pri phrol phrol/ trar/ rak+tas phye phye/ du bu du bu/ hre la khwa hi/ zhes pa'o/ /de rjes yig brgya lan gsum lnga bdun gyi bar bzlas/ nas/ sku'i dam tshig nyams pa rma/'u1la shwe⑥ bshags/ gsung gi: thugs kyaje rtsa sab 'a yan lag ga sku sa sung thugs dang rtsa ba yan 'a ga gi dam tshig 'gal ḍā5tru/rdel thams cad so sor bshags/ mtho'/ bsha/rdegs phu'/ myos tshangs nga/ rma/dzad dug sol/ dpal che shes ma/gon ngo/ nag po chan po 'khor dang bcas nga/thams cad kyis/ bdag la dngos gru/ba kyi gtong grogs dang / mthu stobs thogs pa med pa bcu phya5rde ba dang / phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad mi mthun nga/'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang / bsrung ba dang / bzlog pa ma/dzad dug sol/ sngon gyi las/ las byung ba dang / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad gdon byur chags la sogs nga/ rkyen ngan thams cad dbyings su zhi zhing / phyi la bzlog nga/ra mdzang du gsol/ khyad par du yang nges don bstan nga/'i bdag po dang la jo nang nga/'i bstan pa ngar zhing rgyas la yun ring duganas nga/ dang / rten 'brel thams cad legs phyogs su bsgrigs nas khams gsum tham/sa cang/ dbang du 'du ba dang / tshe dang bsong nams dang/la 'byo ra tha gru/sa cad rgyas sheng 'phel bar ma/dzad gsol/ bdag cag rnams dang bstan pa la gnod nga/ra byed nga/'i dgra bags lo ga 'dra phyo/ byad ma bsam sbyor ngan pa can thams cad skad cig nyid la rdul du brlag par mdzad dug sol/ sarba sdo ni pa dra ba ni ba rwa ya phaṭa/ces las bco'/ gyi don du gso la ba gdab bo/ /mgon nag sgos kyi las tshogs byed na/ cwa bas 3dir bskang ba dang / ri das dang ma byon mas bskul ba sngon du 'gro bas ling ga sgrol ba rī snye —282—

byed mod kyi/ drug cu pa'i cha lag tu sbyor ba'i skabs 'dir ni bskang ba mi dgos la ling ga log pa'ang mi dgos kyi/ dkyus kyi ling ga sgrol ba dang / phyogs skyong la bsngo ba'i skabs der dmigs pas nan tan du byas pa tsam gyis chog /de skabs gtor ma/ la ling dum spron/ rak+ta gsar ba re blugs kyin 'dug /de rjes shā sa na bdun tsam bzla/ oṃ mahā kā la gu ṇa hri da gnod byed mā ra ya hu phaṭa/ ces dang / oṃ badz+ra kro dha mahā kā la ya/ sha chun tsit+ta kro ting dun dzazhes pa dang / sbu gri'i sngags ji ltar 'os pa ste drag tu bzla'o/ /de rjes/ glu( mahā kā 'a ar+gha nas shag le bar gyis mchod/ hū/ dpal ldan nag po nag po che' po ni/ /bskal pa'i me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /mi ro'i steng nas sku byung ba/ /mdog nag thung la gsus pa che/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i lha khyod kyi/ /dgra bgegs gdug nga myur du sgrol/ /g.yas kyi phyag gi gri gug gis/ /bstan la gnod pa'i snying rtsa gcod/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gi thod pa yis/ /dam nyams rnams kyi snying khrag gsol/ /mche ba'i zla tshes rab gtsigs pas/ /'jig rten ma lus za bar byed/ /spyan gsum me yi tsha tsha 'phro/ /gdug pa can rnams/ bsreg par byed/ /rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha khyod/ /bdud kun 'dul ba'i dmag dpon yin/ /dam nyams rnams kyi gshed ma mdzad/ /mna' zan rnams kyi srog dbugs len/ /chos 'khore yongs kyi bsrung ma ste/ /nag po gtum po las la byon/ /bla ma la mkhu sems can 'tshe//chos 'khor 'di la sdang ba rnams/ /ma lus ska da cig tsam/ gyis kyang / /da lta nyid du rings par khug /sha khrag nang /brol ma lus pa/ /dpa' bo chen pos myur du zo//de lus til tsam btubs nas kyang / khyod/ kyi zhal du gsol bar mdzod/ /gal te de ltar ma byas na/ /byod nyid dam tshig nyams 'gyur te/ /rdo rje 'chang gi bka' —283—

'das pas / /snying khrag sa la ltung bar 'gyu/ra/ /de bas dam tshig ma ri da' bar/ /gdug pa'i dgra 'di myur du sgrol/ /rme/hā kā la dgra bo'i srog la breng breng / rgyug lcu/ga ya ya/ zhes bstod bskul 'di lan gsum byed/ slar yang ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis gru ri/chod/ hū ཾ / lnga yi dmag dpon tshogs kyi bdag /gdug can ma lus 'joms mdzad pe / /sa/tum po drag po mthu rtsal che/ /nag po dam tshig can la bstod/ /dus la bab pa 'i tshe brtsol pa'i 'phrin las thogs pa med pa mdzod cig /ces bya/ zor 'phen pa'i gnas su zor rmi ma dbye ba dang / gtor bsku'/ song ba'i rjes la/ hū/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi//dus gsum/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /nas po /byod rni yin pa ste/ /gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /'og thi klu dang lha min 'joms/ /ral pa kham/ nag gyen du g.yengs/ /steng gi lha tshogs 'jigs par byed/ /spyan bgrad ljags 'gril bar gyi lha gdon sdigs/ /g.yas kyi gri gug dgra bgegs bdud la rdeg /g.yon pa gdug pa'i khrag bkang zhal du gsol/ /zhabs rdabs gnod sems can gyi lus 'a/ nyed/ /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum smod dang / /bla rma/ brnyas byed sems can 'tshe/ /bdag gis bsgo ba kun khug la/ /ling ga 'di la myur du chug /de yi sha zo khrag la 'thu/nga / /rus pa klad pa nang khrol zo/ /rigs/ brgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /mdza' ba kun da nga khrol 'a sa shos / 'a nga na 'di yi phyir 'brangs nas/ /til 'bru tsam/ du brlag par mdzod// /bdag gis bsgo ba ma nyan na/ /nag ngo/ khyod ni nyams par 'gyu/ra/ /de bas dam las ma 'da' bar/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces pas bskul ba yi na pa las/ ling ga 'di la myur du chug /ces pa 'i nga ga 'gugs 'dren gyi —28‘/—

skabs yin/ skabs 'dir/ zungs shing chings shig lha nga/nga phrol/ /zhes 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /chos rgyal gyi gtor ma'i sngon du 'di'i gtor ma 'ji 'phen te/ 'di skabs shā sa na drag tu bzla ba las/ dgra bgegs byad ma kha kha/ dgra bgegs byad ma 'a hi ji hi/zhes tre(gas ming spel bcug nas/ rjes tshogs rma chod kyi skabs dang / rjes chos gi skabs mi das sa pa nan tan gal che zhing / tshogs phud rdo/ sa na'i sngags kyis 'bul bskang gtor gsos/ la/ mchod pa'i skabs/ mahā kā la an+ta sogs dgos so/ /mgon nag dang / drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sa tor bzlog sbrel nas sgrub tshul bshad zin to// //dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed khros pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das hai ra ba'i bsnyen pa sngon du song / legs ldan drag po lha'i mgon po'i rtsa sngags drag sngags bskon ma bu dang bcas pa/ zhag nyer gcig tsam bzlas pa dang / te lo'i rtog pa che chung gi snying po yang khri phrag tsam re ma mtha' yang song ba dgos so /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs gang yang rung bar dkyil 'khore zla gam mthing /spa ( 〈lbo〉 cha rlung ) ris mtshon byed pa ṭas bskor ba'i nga kyil du chos 'byung gru gsum dam/ra nag me ris bskor bi/ de'i dbus su ro gdan la dbyug tho gcig 'bri/ chos 'byung gi rtse mo'i phyogs sam gtor gral la gtor ma nor bu mig gsum gyi gzugs can cig dang / chos 'byung gi mdun du 'phen gtor zan le ba gru gsum gyi steng du mdun du 'ug pa'i gdong / zur gnyis su glang gi gdong / sde'i steng du gtor ma gru gsum bkod/ zur mdun la btod pa yin de la rtse gsum ngar nag can btsugs/ yang na gru gsum gsum sgrigs byed pa'ang yod de tri hūṃ la rma/tshon zer/ de dug khrag gis byugs/ drag po'i mchod gtor gyis g.yon skor du bskor ro/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i cho gar bsha/da pa'i chos rgyal gyi gtor bsngo grub mtshams su 'bru gsum mang du brjod pas rma chod gtor byin rlabs kha gsos/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi —285—

thugs ka nas huX gcig spros pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su legs ldan lha'i mgon po drag po dbang phyug thal bas byugs pa/ sku mdog dang / rtsa zhal sngo skya/ g.yas dkar rgyab ser g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha ste zhal lnga po thams cad spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang / kha ṭāX ga /'og ma gnyis kyis ḍa ma ru dang bshor thod chang gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ stag lpags/ mi lpags/ glang lpags/ sprul dang / mgo phreng dang / thal bas brgyan pa/ ral ba'i thor tshugs la ga ṅga dang zla bas mdzes pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas khyu mchog dkar po'i gdan la gnas pa/g.yon gyi phyogs nas lha mo u ma dkar mo'am/ ser mos 'byud pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas legs ldan lha'i mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX ka pā la mā la a lang kṛ te shī ra huX hūX/ ā ga ste ya/ ā ga smo ya/ dkyi tra a swāhā/ zhes spyan drangs/ a mṛ tas bgegs bskrad/ dzaXhuX baX hoX oX āXru tra hūX hūX swāhā/ sa ma ya stuX/ lan gsum// oṃ ma he shwa ra sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ lha yi rgyal po mthu bo che/ /'jig rten gsum la dbang bsgyur ba/ /drag po mig gsum bde byed de/ /u ma'i bdag po khyod la bstong// /dpral bar oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar skyoX/ thugs ka nas dbang gi lha spros te/dbang bskur/rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbu rgyan/ka pā la mā la/zhes pa nas/ru tra a swāhā/ oX a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ oX āXru tra huX hūX swāhā/oX a na dzaX sa ma ya srog breng breng dza dzaX zhes pa brgya rtsa sogs ji ltar 'os pa dang / oX ru tra ma he shwa ra yo ga pra sha ma ma yo ga sirnyi da da hi me swāhā/ zhes pa'ang ci rigs —286—

bzlas shing / mahā de ba e ja/ u ma de bi e dza/ dhu pra ma dhu khrag ja/ dun+ta ma du dza/zhes drag sngags kyang bsnyen sngags la btags pa cung zad bzla/ spro na bsad thun gyi sngags/ kyang ci rigs pa bzla/ de rjes gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ mgon nag gi skabs ltar bshags nga/ dang /'dod gso la la 'don pa spo/ sde rjes// sdang dgra gdug pa can ma lus pa char gcod nga/'i 'phrin las rma/dzod cig /hūX gzheX zhes bskul bas/ legs ldem lha'i mgon ngo/ de nyid srin ngo/'i gzugs mi/ bzad par gyur te/ dbang phyug chen gro/ sku ma/ngog dam/ra ngo zha'/ gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum nga / g.ya sa mi ma/go rlon nga/sa/ mchan pa'i nga/byug tho 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'jin nga /shin tu bros pa rab tu 'jigs shing / dbu skra steng 'os bar gsu/rlo/ du 'jings nga// /bras tshen dang / thal/ chen dang / sprul dang / rmi sa dug pas brgyan nga// khro bo'i cha byad rdzas sa shing / g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis mi ro'i gdan la bzhus sa nga// 'a/bor srin ngo/ dang / srin cho/ dang / bya dang / gcan gzan du gdug pa'i tshogs/ kyis/ sko ra ba'o/ /mahā de ba da ṣa ra ra/ dgra bo mā ra ya/ tsit+ta hur thum/ na ma che hā bhā ta/ dgra bo chu ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa ci nus su bzlas/ 'di'i bslos kyi gtor bzlog la snyel nga 'dzi ye sna 'di byeng na 'bir bya/sde nas drag po'i gtor ma snyom dgra bgegs dgug gzhug gi ngam/gas pa/ yang / ra/nga byas rte/ rma/hā de ba da ṣa ra ra/ i dam ba ling ta/ kha kha khwa hi 'a hi/ sarba shā krus da ta da ha/ rnga/ ca nga/ tsa mā ra ya hūṃ nga/ṭa/ ces lan snyer gcig gas/ bsngos/ yang gong ba 'an sgyu gru/ chod bstod bya/ mai lha yi/ rgya snyel po rdzu 'phrul can/ /srid pa sa sum gyi byeng po ste/ /sde brgyad yongs/ kyi dam/ga dpon lags / khyod kyis mi/ thub gang yang me/da/ /lha min grong khyer 0/sum brtse gas bcom// /ma/dung rtse gsum pa gcig bskyod pas/ /sa gzhi chen ngo/ ring du —287—

'phangs/ /gdug pa can kun 'joms pa po /sgrub po rnal 'byor can rnams la//tshe dang blo gros dbang phyug ster/ /dam nyams kun gyi gshed ma mdzad/ khyu mchog rgyal mtshan las la ya/ /dgra bo'i dbugs la thum ri li li/ /dgra bo'i srog la hur thum dza/ /dgra bo'i mgo la ba ril li li/ /dgra bo'i snying la breng shag sbyo /dam nyams dgra bo'i phung bar mdzod/ /lha sngags thams cad gshed du phob/ /bsrung bzlog rang gshed rang la phob/ /dgra bgegs 'khor bcas thal bar rlog /khyod kyi 'khor ni mi srun te/ /log 'dren bgegs byed bsam mi khyab/ /dgra la ltas ngan cho 'phrul phob/ /god kha sna dgu thongs la shog /mdangs dang bla tshe phrogs la shog /mnga' thang longs spyod chom la shog /long bar gyis shig lkugs par gyis/ /nye tshan nang 'khru / gas dgra la thong / /mdza' grogs kun dang 'bon du chug /gtso 'khor dpon g.yog 'thab tu chug /rgya mtsho'i pha ma/thar sgrod la shog /gling bar mun nag chen por skyur/ /lha dang gnod spyin yi dwags dang / /klu dang srin po mi bzad pa/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro drag shul can/ /sde brgyad 'gong po ther 'bum rnams/ /da ltar nyid du las la bskul/ /dgra bo'i yul mkhar rmangs nas skyel/ /zhing dang lo thog snar ma chom/ /mi nad phyugs nad char ltar phob/ /bdud g.yos ri ltar nyil du chug /sri langs rlung ltar 'tshub tu chug /mtshon gyi bskal pa der thong zhig /nad dang mu ge'i dus la phob/ /bsad bskrad dbye dang rengs par mdzod/ /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la smyo /thams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la khyo /bsam ngan byad kha'i steng du lco /bzlog cig bsgyur cig sa ma ya/ /zhes bskul nas yang mchod bstod cig byas nas bzhag go /de nas —288—

gtor zor 'phen pa'i skabs/ las gzhin gyi gtor ma'i sngon la 'di 'phen dgos te/ thugs sngags nyid dam/ da ṣa ra ra ni drag tu bzla/ nang du 'khor nas nor bu'i dbyibs kyi gtor ma de/mtheb klu gcig gis gsos/ spyan 'dren gyi sngags la 65 kwa ze( btags pa lan gsum phul/mchod bstod rnams dmigs pa tsam gyis bya'o/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i las byed/ legs ldan lha'i rgyal po'i drag gtor dang /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor bzlog sbrel nas sgrub tshul bshad zin to// //dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed khros pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal gzhan rje gshed kyi drug cu rtsa bzhi'i cho ga'i yan lag tu/ dpal lha mo re ma ti'i gtor zor 'phen par 'dod na/ yi dam/ gyi bsnyen pa sngon du song ba dang / ma mo'i bsnyen pa mdor bsdus tsam zhig nges par song ba dgos/ drug cu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdun nam g.yon phyogs gang yang rung bar/ chos 'byung gru gsum smug nag me ri 'bar ba/ dbus su nyi gdan la mi ro dang ral gyi 'bri/ bskang gtor ni dmar po snying gzugs ma/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig byas la/ gtor gral dkyus la 'jug /'phen gtor rni zur gsum rtse mo rno ba/ dug khrag gis byugs shing kha dog nag pa/ rtse mo la shing gi ral gri dang / logs la zan nam 'jim pa'i kong bu gru gsum dgu'am bdun dug khrag gis bkang ba/ smyug rtsangs la bskyon te gtor ma la lag wen ltar btsugs/ drag po'i mchod pas bskor/ mdun du rak+ta'i ar+gha stegs bu mtho ba la bzhag/mtha' mchod pas bskor/ sgrig lugs la khyad med/ chos 'byung gi rtse mo'i thad der/ phur pa khro mo/'i zhal can nam/ rdo rje'i rtse mo'am/ rgya rma dud ma zhig phur gdan la bkod/ gtor ma de la nam mkha' dang dar nag gi ba dan btsugs na'ang legs/ dpal lha mo'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa 'grub na logs su yod/ mdor bsdus la dga' na 'di tsarnga/ gyis kyang 'grub ste/ rtsa ba'i gtor bsngo'i chos rgyal gyi gtor bsngo so nga ba'i mtshams su 'di bya ste/ dkyil 'khor —289—

—————rderdebasangs sbyangs/ hu las byung ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus/ /rlung dang me steng rak+ta'i rgya mtsho'i nang / /bhu las thod pa dgu brtse gas gzhal ya sa /bang /rgya mtsho'i mtha' bskor dmar nag brag ri'o/ /dbus su e las gru gsum smug nag 'bar/ /phyi nang kun tu 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /de dbus srin po'i bong bu rlung gi shugs/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i ba chen bsnol mar bcas/ /ga rda ba hū/ ti ra ba/ ma srur+ya maṇ+ḍal a/ de'i steng du rtso yig nag po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ 'khor 'das kyi nus mthu thams cad tshur 'dus/ smyo yig la thim/ o de bī mahā kā li hū/ gtso mo'i phyag rgya bya/ dpal ldan lha mo nag mo chen mo rje mo re ma tī/ gtso mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ sku mdog mthing nag ral pa mun ltar gtibs pa la rma bya'i mdongs kyis brgyan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ mi bzad pa'i mche ba rnon po gtsigs shing / 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra sgrog pa/ phyag g.yas pas ral gri me 'bar ba 'phya/ra bas/ bstan pa bsrung zhing dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa/ g.yon pas ka pā la gdug pa'i snying khrag dang bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pas/ sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol ba/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ sprul rigs bzhi'i ske rags dang /dbu'i steng du sprul mgo'i gdengs ka can/ snyan g.yas pa la seng ge /g.yon pa la dril bu/ zhabs la dbang gi lcags sgrog 'khro rnal ba/ khrag zhag gi thig le dang /sprul dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu brgyan dang / mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can/ lte ba nas nyi ma dang / spyi gtsug nas zla ba 'char ba/ me —290—

dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i sku mdun du dre'u ser skya rlung gi gshog pa can/ bse'i sga gdan dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du ma yig nag po/ de las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus te ma yig la thim/ rak+ṣa ma ni hū/ khol mo bdud kyi bu mo re ma tī nag mo ral pa kham ser ma/ rin po che'i rgyan can me stag 'phro ba/ re lde dang / gos nag dang / mi lpags gyon pa/ phyag g.yas pas bdud kyi khram shing dang / g.yon pas sho rde dkar nag 'dzin pa/nyi zla'i thod gdengs can/nad kyi kha rlangs 'thul ba/lcags kyi dra ba mig dgu rgyab tu thogs shing / mtshon gyi gru gu dang / byang dmar khres po dang / nad kyi rkyal ba 'chang ba'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu spros/ dpal gyi lha mo re ma tī 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza bh+yodur khrod dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /dpal ldan nag mo re ma tī/ /lha mo nag mo rma thu mo che/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /rnal 'byor gdung bas spyan 'dren na/ /mchi ma thul thul myur du byon/ /ma cig dpal ldan re ma tī/ /sgrub mchog bskyang phyir gshegs su gsol/ /lha mo dpal ldan nag mo khyod/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyi nang na dpal 'bar ma/ khyod ni ma mo stong gi dbus na bzhugs//dbang phyug chen po rnams la sring mo ste/ /nye bar dam tshig las rnams sgrub pa'i phyir/ /dngos grub stsole zhing bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ mahā kā li hu phaṭa/ ro ru tsa pa la a shug me hu/ ti ni tilga dza hu ba ho oṃ mahā kā li a bhi khri thu/ ka pā la tri snro me a chi rjo / ༵ti ༵sni /tshe mahā/ shi ༵ rni ༵rnyi//༵hūṃ ༵ rto ༵ sha lta 'ib / —291—

———— gyis mchod/ sbyo dpal ldan nag mo re ma tī/ /'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma//bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ /dgra 'dul chen mo khyod la 'dud/ /lko ā hū ha ho hi ma ma de bī mahā kā li re ma tī/ ba ling ta kha kha sku hi 'a hi/ a mṛ ta kha kha le le/ zhes lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ o ya mun+ta ka hu phaṭa/ ḍi ki nī mahā kā li/ya ka sha re ma tī/ ma ma shā krus/ a mu kā me tsa me da bha sa ma sa ru dhi dzi ba pri yam bka tri ni/ i dam ba ling gro hā kha kha khwa hi sku hi/ zhes pas rak+ta 'bul/ drag kro 'i gtor sngags kyang ‘red ka yin no/ /o ā hū gis dam rdzas gtor ma la sbran/ rang gi lce la'ang bzhag /rdo rje gsor zhing dam rgya bstan la/ ma ma sa ma ya/ mahā ka pā la sa ma ya/ mahā kā li kā ya sa ma ya/ mahā kā li lha ka sa ma ya/ mahā kā li tsit+ta sa ma ya/ mahā mu dra sa/ ma ya hūṃ/ces dam la bzhag go /o ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha/ ba twa si/ ro ru ro ru bi tilga ba twa si/ tsa pa la a shug me/ ri smye dza dza rje mo'i snying po gtso bor bzla'o/ /o ru ru be/ ro ru nu/ taṣ+ṭha ba to si/ rag mo tsi ta /ba rag ma hū sbyo ma ma trag rag sha kha mun tra ba tra ba tras/ rag sha tsi ta kha rag ma/ re ma tī sa ma ya/ pra ma ma hasta/ pra dun sbyo ru lu ru lu spyo dza ja khol rmo/'i bod rbad gcig tu dril ba 'di yang ci rigs bzla'o/ /mtshams 'dir yi ge brgya pa ci rigs bzlas/ sku'i dam chig nyams pa mthol 'e1 bshags/ /zhes sogs bshags pa bsdus pa bya/ 'dod don gsol gdab gong ltar 'don pa sngo'o/ /mchod 'phreng bsdu sa pa ni/ hu sbyo ma cig 'dod /bams dbang phyug ma/ khyed la bdag gis gus pas mchod/ /bsad pa'i sha dang khu ba'i khrag /myos pa'i chang dang mngar ba'i ro/ /zla rgyas zla khrom la sogs pa/ /ma la 'bul 'e1 bzhes su gsol/ /ma cig thugs dam skongs gyun nas/ /dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ /tsit+ta rtsa lags ma 292—

—————snye———rderde ————— rderderde ——————— rderdenyams dang / /'chi kha'i tshal thig dmar po dang / /mi dbang 'bras bu smin nga/ dang / /shing lo rlung khyer sar ma lhung / /snying dang rak+ta sman lnga sogs/ /ma la 'bul lo pa /ma cig thugs dam /dngos grub5 /mu la rak+ta rtsa ba'i khrag /chu dang ma 'dres dwangs ma'i khrag /mahā rak+ta khrag chen po/ /tsit+ta bsdus pa ba gyi khrag /khrag sna stong la sbyar ba 'di/ /ma la ‘'bul lo /ma cig ngu /dngos grub /'bras bu lnga ldan bdud rtsi dang / /go ro tsa na sprin chen dang / /mahā ma sa thal chen dang //rak+ta'i tshogs dang tsit+ta sbungs/ /sna tshogs dkyil 'a/bor mchod pa'i rdzas/ /ma la /ma cag ngu /dngos grub: /gzhan yang mchod pa ma lus pa/ /phyi dang nang ngang gsang ba'i rten/ /dam rdzas nyi shu rtsa lnga sogs/ /dngos su 'byo rder zhing bsam pa dang / /sems kyis dmi gas nas 'bul lags kyi/ /ma cig: /dngos grub dam pa stsal1rde du gso la/ /ma mo nag mo sa ta ku lu ku lu ha ha ha/ ma sa sku hi/ rak+ta /dī hi/ces pas mchod/ lha la dbang bsgyur lha mo dpal 'bar gru/// /sogs/ rigs bzhi lha mo bstod pas bstod do/ drug cu pa'i cha lag la yang lha cho/'i 'di la bar 'dir ling ga sgrol chog lhag ngo/ zhig nges nga ra dgos te/ sol bas bris pa'i 'brub khung zhig tu ling ga cig bcas la/ 'brub khung bskyed pa dang / ling ga dgug gzhug /khyu bhā wa nas/ ā be sha'i bar dkyus dang 'dra ba las/bka' sdod phyag brnyan dam can bsrung ma'i tshogs kyi/ zhes pa'i tshab tu/ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī 'khor ma mo mkha' 'gro sde brgyad dang bcas pa'i/ 'es 'don pa spo/ kwa la hwa pa' tshab tu/ o mahā kā li ye hu hu phaṭa/ ces 'jug /hu/ rnam par mi rtog thugs rje'i bdag /ces sogs dang / stong pa'i ngang las o / phaṭa/ /yongs su gyur las phur bu'i lha/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i me lce 'brigs/ /rtse cho gru —293—

gsum dbal gyi dbyibs/ /thor tor 'jam dpal gzhin rje gshed/ /dregs pa ma lus 'dul mdzad pa/ /sked pa chu srin kha yi steng / /gtso mo 'dod khams dbang po ni/ /gdug can ma lus thal bar brlog /drag shul thogs med dbal gyi rtser/ /'joms byed bdud mo re ma tī/ /logs la nag mo 'bum dang bcas//gnag pa'i dgra bo brlag par byed/ /da lta dgra la phur bus 'debs/ /snying gi gnas su ki la ya/ /lus ngag sems la gī la ya/ /dbang po drug la gī la ya/ /yan lag drug la gī la ya/ /rnam shes dbugs la ki la ya/ /tshe srog mdangs la gī la ya/ /zhes brjod nas/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ dang por phur bu la sngags bzlas la drod phyin par sgril/ de nas ling ga'i gnas thams cad du phur bu sgril ba dang / hṝXsgyiXs mgo drangs/oṃ ro ru sogs dang / re ma tī badz+ra gī li gī lwa ya/ huX dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ma ma rak+ta raka kha mu dra/ ru lu ru lu hūX sbyoX badz+ra gī li gī lā ya/ hūX dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces bzla bzhin du/ phur bus btab/ ral gris btubs te/ gtor ma la bstabs/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du 'bul/ khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po'i zhal du bstabs/ /dpal ldan re ma ti yi zhal du bstabs/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro stong gi zhal du bstabs/ /gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdangs la/ /gangs ri lta bu'i tshems gtsigs nas/ /glog dmar lta bu'i ljags skyong zhing / /sha khrag rgya mtsho zhal du bstabs/ kha chen ri ltar rtsigs pa kha raX ji hi/ /rak+ta'i chu bo stong phrag kha raX sku hi/ /don snying dbang po go ro tsa na sogs/ /sna tshogs phung por sbungs pa kha raX ji hi/ /zhes gyer la drag po'i gtor sngags bzla bzhin du rol chen ring du bskul lo/ /las la gtad bskul tshar gcig kho na byed na/ gtor ma 'phen khar byed pa yin/ lan gnyis byed na skabs 'dir —294—

yang bskul te/ gang ltar na'ang mdor bsdus 'di tsam bya ste/ hu ye bh+ya rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag cag gis/ /lha ru dkon mchog gsum po bsten/ /srid phugs dam/ pa'i chos la gtad/ /las su dam tshig gnyan po bsrung / /rtag tu gsang ba'i rnga chung brdungs//grogs su lha mo khyed sgrubs so/ /dka' ba dang du blangs/ nas khyed sgrubs so/ /lus sems rdul du brlags nas khyed sgrubs so/ /dben gnas zhwa ltar gon nas khyed sgrubs so/ /bsten cing sgrubs so dam can tshogs/ /bos pa'i dus su snyan ma sra/ /g.yabs pa'i dus su spyan ma gtul/ /rbad pa'i dus su bang ma bul/ /bcol ba'i dus su mthu ma chung / /dam nyams dgra bgegs sdig can 'di/ /da lta nyid du myur du khug/las kyi pho nya dus la khye/ /dam can tshogs ni sprin ltar gtibs/ /bka' sdod tshogs ni glog ltar 'khyus /rmu khabs dgra dang bgegs la thod/ /dal yams /gzer thabs: /mdze nad spyo 'bog dgra la thong / /dam tshig nyams pa'i dgra bgegs 'di'i/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag skya bo chod/ /sa yi lte phur nag po thon/ /las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas phul/ /'jigs pa'i mun pas mdun nas bsus/ kha nas khong khrag skyug tu chug /khong pa'i nang nas snying phyung zhig /dpral ba'i dbyings nas mig phyung zhig /ltag pa'i phyogs nas bdud chod cig /dgra bgegs srog rtsa myur du chod/ /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la sbyo /thams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la spyo /ma mo 'khor bcas dgra la smyo /ma mo 'khor bcas bgegs la smyo /sde brgyad thams cad dgra la spyo /dgra bo'i bla tshe thum hril lco /dgra bo'i tshe srog thum hril smyo /dgra bo'i dbugs rngub thum hril sbyo /dgra bgegs srog la breng breng rgyug /dgra bgegs snying la —295—

rbad shag smyo /zhes pa'o/ /chos rgyal gyi gtor ma'i sngon du 'di'i gtor zong 'phang ngo / /rjes chog gi skabs/ bskang gtor la mtheb kyu gcig gsos / 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas gtor sngags snga ma des 'bul/ mchod pa logs su mi dgos zhor gyis chog/ bstod pa ni yi dam gyi rjes su/ bstod thung sho lo ka gcig tsam logs su 'grub na'ang legs so/ / dpal gshin rje gshed po'i las byed gyi gtso mo drag shul can/ dpal lha mo re gru/ ti'i drag gtor dang / drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor bzlog sbrel nas sgrub tshul bshad zin to// //bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byeng/ chen po'i rnal 'byor sgom pa po la bka' sdod phyogs skyong gi gtor chog ni/ mchog sgrub pa'i skabs dang / 'phrin las rnam bzhi gang sgrub kyang dgos pa yin la/ sde la yang rgyas pa drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / bsdus pa rtsa ba'i gtor chog gnyis yod/chos rgyal las kyi gshin rje'i gtor ma'i skor rnams gshin rje nyid kyi sgos sgrub yin pa'i phyir/ spyi babs kyi go ba la/drug cu rtsa bzhi dang 'bral med du dgos pa'i cho ga min yang /drag po gtso che ba'i skabs su/ gshin rje las la gtad byed pa shin tu gal che ba'i phyir/ man ngag lag len gyi rgyun du/drug cu bzhi'i drag gtor mdzad phyin/ las gshin gyi gtor bsngo dang las gtad nges par mdzad pa yin/ sde la'ang las gshin gtso rkyang / lcam dral/ bcu gsum ma sogs sang byas kyang rung mod/ bcu gsu ma ma lta bur 'khor mang stobs che bar bzhed do/ /yang mgon nag re ma tī/ dbang phyug chen po ste gsum po 'di sa skya ngor rdzong gnyis/ zhal dge bo gsum sogs phyis byung bod kyi dmar nag 'jigs gsum par grags pa gzhan rnams la grags shin tu chung zhing / deng sang man ngag phyin ci ma log pa'i lag len kyang ye mi 'dug /gtor bzlog byed pa'i srol yang mi snang ngo / /nged kyi bla ma dam pa rigs sngags 'chang ba'i dbang phyug shī la su ga ra dang / de nyid kyi thugs sras gcung don grub legs pa'i zhal snga nas la/ 'di dag gi man ngag phyin ci ma log pa mang ri zhing / bzlas brjod —296—

kyi nus pa yang thon la/ 'di rnams kyi gtor bzlog kyang skabs 'ga' rer phyag len du mdzad pa'i rgyun yod pas/ bdag gis cung zad 'khums pa lags so/ /des na drug cu pa'i drag po'i gtor bzlog gi skabs su/ zur bka' lde thung bzhi las/ skabs 'dir las 'gas na 'chag thebs med/ spro na gzhan gsum po ji ltar 'os pa re sbyor te/ gal chen las stobs chen po dgos pa'i skabs bzhi kar 'a sdo/ba na shin tu legs/ bsgo tshems ni drug cu pa'i mdun du chos rgyal/ g.yas su mgon nag/g.yon du lha mo/ rgyab tu dbang phyug bsham pa'am / yang na mdun du bzhi car sgrig/yang na g.yas su gshin rje dang mgon po/ g.yon du lha mo dang dbang phyug sgrig kyang rung ngo / /de yang cho ga grwa ba thams cad kyis/ shes shing spro long yod na/ tham/sa cad kyi bzhi cer 'don/ de bzhin ma yin na lde thung tsho bzhi kar so sor sgrub kyang rung mod/ da lta lag len du 'debs rgyu la thams cad kyis bzhi kar yod na legs / de min na las gshin gyi skor rnams kun gyi phyogs gcig tu byas/ gzhan gsum po la so so'i bsnyen pa song ba res 'go byas nas/ so sor bgos te sgrubs kyang mi legs pa mi yong ngo / /bzhi car rim can du sgrub pa la yang rtsa ba'i gtor bsngo'i skabs/ so so'i rtsa ba'i gtor ma dang /drag po mchod pa'i skabs/ so so'i drag gtor byed pa sogs spel na yang legs mod/ lag len 'dzings shing mi bde ba'i nyen yod pas/ rtsa ba'i gtor chog gi skabs 'di kar/ lde thung phyi ma gsum po'i cho ga gzhan rnams rdzogs par byas/ gtor 'phen gyi dus/ so so'i bskul ba rnams kyi mthar gtor ma re re nas 'phen pa'am/ bskul ba rim can du bar ma chad par byas nas/ de rjes gtor ma dus gcig tu 'phen pa gnyis lag len gang bde bya/ zur bka' bzhi po snga phyi'i go rim la/ lha gtso che chung gi dbang du byas nas/ dang por dpal mgon nag dang / de rjes dpal lha mo/ de nas lha chen/de rjes gshin rjes rnams yin la/ rang gcig pu sgrub pa'i tshe/ rang nyid gang la gtso bor byed pa nge thog mar byas pas chog/de lta na yang deng sang chog grwa'i rigs la/ yi dam phyogs skyong chos rgyal —297—

————gsum po cho ga 'dres ma/ra 'byung bas/ 'bral mi rung gi dbang du byas/ chos rgyal gyi cho gas gzhung srong ste/ mi'i gtso bo'i rgyal po yin yang yi rge 'bri ba la yig ma/khan gtso zer ba'i dpe/ phyogs skyong gi de ma thag tu thog mar chos rgyal gyi gtor bsngo bya/ de song ba'i rjes su gzhan lde thung gsum po gang yang rung ba gcig gam/ gnyis sam// gsum ka'i cho ga rnams rdzogs nga ra bya'o/ /sde yang chos rgyal yan chod zin lhag ma rtsa ba'i gtor chog gi skabs lha che rim nas 'bul dgos pa/sa/ mgon nag/lha mo/ lha chen zhes pa'i rim pas 'bul/ gnyis su byed na mgron nag dang dbang phyug gam/ lha mo dang dbang phyug gam/ mgon nag dang lha mo zhes pa'i rim pa'i 'bul lo/ /bzhi ka la las bcol gtod dgos pas na las gshin gyi stong gsum ma'i skabs/ chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i tsho/gas/ /sangs rgyas phyag brnyan nag 2tri che/ /'dod khams bdag sma1 re ma/ tī/ /byed po mthu chen dbang phyug drag/ma mo gshi/na rje sogs te gang byed pa de dang de'i 'don pa bsgyur dgos/ gtor ma 'phen pa'i skabs lha che rim nas 'phen pa dang / chung rim nas 'phen pa dang / rang gang la gtso bor byed pa de thog mar 'phen pa dang / de 'dra de 'jug tu 'phen pa sogs lag len mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang / 'dir man ngag ni/ las sna ma mos 'dren rba 'i phyir/ thog mar lha cho/'i gtor ma 'phangs/ de rjes thun mong ma yin pa'i phyir/ mgon nag dang lha mgon gnyis 'phen dgos pa las/ji thog mar mgon nag 'phen pa gnad che/ de rjes gshin rje'i gtor ma 'phen te/ de dang drug cu rtsa bzhi par mchod par byed pa lag len gyi rgyun yin zhing drug cu rjes la 'phen dgos pas so/ /de yang gtor bskul gyi skabs/ las kyi gshin rje 'kho ra bcas kyis/ /do nub zor gyi las mdzod cig /lha chen dpal 'bar nag po yis/ /do nub : /lha mon ga mo srid gsum bdag /do nub: /legs ldan drag po lha chen yang / /do nub: /ces gang gang byed pa de de'i 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /yang / gnod pa'i bgegs kyi steng —298—

—spro— ————du bh+yo /zhes pe yan chad thun mo/nga ba yan la/ ngan pa bzlog sgo pa// zhes pa 'os/ chos dbyings ngang dung/ga par mdzod/ /ces/ rnga 'i bar brjong rnga/ ji bzlos pa tsam gyi stsabs yin bzlog pa tsam/ 'a lde thung sa/su che ngo so so'i bskul ba ya za ma byas pa/ra gang ra ma 'phangs nga/sa ches /bas da la sa yin na/ bgags kyi steng du bh+yo /zhes/ ji 'i rjes la / lnge thung gsum po'i bskul rnam sa rim/ can du song nas/ ma rungs gtum po sdig pa can/ /zhes se gas bya ste/ ngas / nga tshis byi ma ngajigashan rje phyogs skyong dang bcas pa 'i la sa bsku' yi na rnga/sa sdu / /bo bab bas ru pa nge lngar yin phya༈nga /bstan pa la gnod byed kyi steng du 'phang nga bos na/ bzlog pa tsam/ las bzlos ba rā nga/ spras sa pa/ ra pa gnad du che bas/ bgegs kyi steng du bh+ya /'es pa 'i rjes 'a / ngan pa bzug/ ri ras ༈ rog par mdzod/ kyi bar/ bzlog pa'i tshig rnam/sa rdzogs pa dang / lde thung gsu gru no so se'i na ra dang / ma 'u du blo pa ga/rngom/ po 'es sogs las kra/:/na rje phyogs skyong sbrags pa bsku rmi po ru/ snyeng je ze/ ri nyid yin no/ /deng sang gi sde dpon sogs/ skye bo :/ nag pa/ ying brtan med nga snang ri sa kyi zar lho/ la byed dgos byung na/ bshoms kyi spros nga/ dang / lus kyi rnam 'gyur dang / gre ba'i skang rgyangs chas gros rol mo sogs/ khrom shogs la gzab dgos kyi/ man ngag gi gnad ngang 'a ga spen ma 'khru/rde' ba dgos kyang mi dgos la/ byas kyang sgrub pa po rang la 'khu zlog che/ sdig can dar na bstan nga nga/nga sems can la gnod pa las med/ yon bdag gi ming can tshos kyang zog gis kho rang tsho rma go skor ba dang / las len rlam dag byas kra/'i dbye ba mi/ shes pas/ srung bzlog tshul bzhin byas nga/'i drin dran pa yang mi yong / a yu(ta ra'i rgyal khams su/ /mkhas pa las kyang spyon pa brin/ /bya ba yin/ mi de tshos rigs la phyi nang bar gsum thams cad nas/ rgyun du mgo ga sku1gas gtong mkhan zhig ka yong yang yong gi 'dug ste/ de ka 'a shes yang 'khor ba 'dug go /'dir lag len rnam grangs cig la/ zor 'phen mkhar dkyil 'khotshor bsdu ba'i srol 'dug pa/ drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dkyil 'kho rder ni/ rjes chog gi —299—

skabs su bsdu ba ma ga rtags/ 'dir mi bsdu bar rang legs shing / gzhan rnam/sa kyang spyir de dang 'dra cho/da/ go skabs/ yangs dog sogs dgag nga gos kyis bsdu bar spro na/ las mkhan tsam dang /sbos sgrub kyi zur 'debs tsam le na pas/ skabs 'dir bsdus kyang 'ga'/ ba chen po'ang med/ de lta na dang po bsgo/mas kyi dus bskangs gtor rnams gtor gru/'i dkyus la bsgo/mas pa kho na dgos/rjes la drag gtor rnam/sa pyi rol tu 'jon khar/ mchod bstod yig brgya bzod gsol byas te/ bris sku yo nga myo dkya rmi 'khor so so'i gtso bo rnams bris sku'i thugs kar stim/ gzhan rnams nam mkha' spar/ dkyal 'bor cang nga rma chod pa rnams bsdus te/ so so'i gtor ma la bstabs/ gtor ma'i lha zhal bskrur nga ngos tā/ smang mu ri 3dir zha' bsgyur ram// 'phen khar zhal bsgyur gang bde yin no// // nga nga nga pa snyel rngo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bdag bskyed sngon du song zhing / mdun bskyed yi dam skor kyi che—ba rnga sna/sa btang nas/ phyegs skyong gi rtsa ba'i gtor bsngo ni nges par byed dgos/ drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sko ra rnams dang / shar khyertogs rab 'jigs sogs/ phyogs skyong gi thugs dam bskul ba bor/ phyogs skyong bcu yi sna drangs te/ /zhes pa/ sde brgyad gtso bo'i sna drangs te//zhes nga ra 'don pa bsgyur ba lta bu rig pas dpyad/ rnge1 nya spro/ ba yang bzhag na/ drug cu pa ma yin pa'i chos rgyal las kyi gshin rje'i gtor bzlog kho nar 'gyur zhing / de bzhin du yi dam gyi skor dang phyogs skyong gi rtsa gtor rnams song ba'i rjes su/ las gshin gyi skor rnams spangs te/ yi ge 'di nang bzhin du ma gon nag kho na'i gtor zor 'phang pa dang / de bzhin du lha mgon dang / dpal lha mo re re'i skor rnams lag tu blangs na yang / de dang de'i gtor bzlog gam// bsad las su 'gyur bas ji ltar mos pa de bzhin du sgrub na/ don dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /re re rkyang ba byed pa'i skabs 'dir yang gtor ma rkyang ba 'phangs kyang chog /bzhi ka la zor sna thams cad 'gru/ba na rab/ ma 'gru ba na mgon po la phur zor/ lha mo la khrag zor/ dbang phyug la mda' zor dang rwa zor/ chos rgyal —300—

—— —— sgro—na—spro rderde—snye rderde—— rde sgron tho—spo— na— stong——ske rga tho spog——dzog—ye sgo————lnge——— rderderderderde—— sgordel thong skror rnams bsngags pa yar/ mchod 'phreng sto nga gsum smu 'og ma la 'dom nga bsngu ra ba sa pa du bshad pa de 'a dpags nas rig pas dpyad/ rma sen ngo/ dang lha cho la bskang shes sa re grub na 6zo tu legs/ chos rgyal dang lha mgon la bskang bso'am mchod 'phre nga rgyas ji 'i yi sa/ rnying meng cing gsar pa yang lha mgon la ma gru/thong / chos rgya'/ (ra snga ri dug mong/ kyang / 'ang sa nas la rma khon rngo 'i 'di 'don pa bsgyur na wo ngo / /de ya/nga 'di lta ste/ hūṃ/ ‘sna chen dpal 'bar 'kho/ra nga phyos la/ /bdag gis mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /phya nu/sa ba ྅ dus gsum 'jig lnge chetshokhams/ /snod bcud bde ba chen por spru'/༈/ /rig/ nga su chang pa meng kra/ yi / /ching 'ong bkod pa thams cad dang / /maṇ+ḍa pa me tos/ sna tshogs bkram/ /lnge mo sna tshogs 'bar ba 'dis/ /dpal ldan mgo myo ngo/'i thus sa dam bsgang / da gya 9 si/ shing ma spyadang lda' gyur nga/sa /bar chad thams cang ji se‘pa ba ngang rto /'ang nga kra 'i don kun sgrub mdzad cing / /chos rngu shebo rder skyong nga'i sna phra/na ri ca pa/0/ / mdzod/ ra spyad/ 'i ar+gha zhabs bsil dang / /dbang lnga'i me 'os/tshol chen spos / ljomang ngas chen tsho snang gsal mkhris pa'i dri/ /sha rus/sdi nga 5 /sne snas sa rbong mchod par ril bu0pre// /nga gyes thing hre ༈bar chad pa /'dod pa'i /chos 'a/lte bar /rta lug sa yang na khyi nag po sas sa/ /seng ge stag sogs gcan gzan dang / /'dab chas sa stsa/ tshogs phyus sa snyel drag ru / /rkang 'gro sna tshogs mchod par 'bul/ /dgyes shing : /bar chad: /'dong pa sgyu sna sdu /chos 'khor /zhwa nag gos nag stan nag dang / /mda' dar gre nyeng hres/ 'kho ra bcas/ /gri gug la sogs phyag mtshan dang / /sna tshogs mtshon chas thugs dam bskangs/ /dgyes shing : /bar chad/: /'dod nga 'i: /skros 'khar spya ba zas kra zang gyo sna tshogs kyi/ /zas mchog gtor ma rgya chen dang / /paṃ sa myos byed shing thos/ —301—
