———— sterderderderderderderderde spol ri — sde byu spo tho sto rderderderde spo byu spo—— tho tho byu sde——sprotshod+ku tho— la7spo— — tho pa snye rgyaspospo spordeso sa dra ༷ / /tshogs kyi mchong/ pa rgya rer 'bul/ /dgyes shing : /bar chad: /8dza do sno pa‘ lnge jo /che sa 'kho/rderderderderderderderderderder: /gsar rnying sha sna snying stsa'i tshogs/ /bsregs btsos brjes sdu'os sa ri 'a ltar ci brtsas sa/ /tres sna sna tshogs rgya mtshor bskyil/ /rus pa'i phung po rme/chong/ spra ra 'bul/ /nga/gyes/ 3nga : /bar chad: /(re dod nga/'tsha /chos 'khor: /dam rdzas mdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ rnyi/nus che/thu'i khyad par smar gya tshogs/ /'bras chang rgun cha dro btsos pa'i chang / /btu pa ba rgya mtsho mtshod nga 'bul/ /dgyes shing je /bar chang: //3jod pa'i: /chos rdo sna/pa nga: /mi lca/sas glang lpags sdi ga lpas sa sogs / /zho ba bu'i khyang par mtha' yas dang / ༈/sgrul dang rus rgyan ma bod phreng sogs/ /rgyan rngams thams cad skul 'bu mi spyo/ /dgyes shing : /bar chadangu 'a ngod pa'i: /chos 3bor: /khrag 'ag rgya dru rtso sho rje'i ri/ /dur khrong ‘re bar ba 'jigs pa'i gnas/bang nga/zang ga 'a' / meng po cug tshor/sa khang / /ji snyeng/ bzhugs pa'i gnas su sda bul / /dgyernga shrī ḍā/nga bye /'a ngo/da pri 'a 'cha /rmos 'a/bor /bran pa pho mo pho nya gyad/ /bud re/rja sna tsho thos rgyan gya rnga brgyan/ /nga/mam dngu/nga bo mtshon grangs las 'das/ /bang mdzong sna tshogs ma bon la 'bul/ /dgyes shing rgyo /bar chad pa /'dod pa' /skros ri khor /bdud/ rnam/sa tha gru/sa cad dpa' stong zhing / /dge rnams spro ba bskyeng/ nga/ ngang / /legs ldan ma/thu stobs bskyed nga/'i phyir/ /rol mo sgra dbyangs stsan la 'bul/ /dgyes shing : /bar chad /'dod pa' /chos la sku1rderderderderderderderder: /glud dang gzugs brnyan ji snyed dang / /yas stags mdos kyi khyad par dang / /spyan sa zas sa rnam pa du ma yis/ /sa dang bar snang khyab par 'bul/ /dgyes shing je /bar chad tsha /'dod pa'i /chos 'khor / ze /rten gtor chen po thugs kyi rten/ /nye —302—

snyegs spro gag ga rgya rgya rderderderde —spo——— rde —sgro——ba—spro—sne——— rderderde———snye spro spro spro—————rderderderderdebar bsnyen pa'i rgyun gtor dang / /rtags kyi gtor ma/4se las la bskul/ /dam/ rdzas gtor mas thugs dam bskangs/ /dgyes shing rgyo /bar chad /'dong nga/'i /chos 'kho rder: /gzhan yang mchod nga/'i yo byad kun/ /gzugs sgra dri re reg bya chos/ /dngos su bshams dang yid kyis spru'// /phyag rgya sngags dang bcas/ te 'bul/ /dgyes shing : /bar chad: /'dod pa'i: /skros 'a/bor /bzlas brjod ting 'dzin tshogs rnams dang / /sngags kyi nor bu khyed la 'bul/ /rnam dag rang bzhin lta ba'i mchog /rab tu yangs nga/'i klong duganas/ /dgyes shing mthu dang ldan gyur pas/ /bar chang thams cad sel ba ngang / /'ang da pa'i don kun sgrub mdzad cing / /chos 'khor skyong ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dang/la ldan ye shes mgon po mchod pa yis/ /nyams chags 'khu/ldog ma lus byang ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams ye shes longs spyod sogs/ /yang ngo'i zla ba lta bur rgyas par mdzod/ /ces nga/ bskang ba mdor bsdus pa'o/ /spyir zur bka' bzhi po 'di sgos su sgrub pa la/ yi dam tshad ldan gang gis bcun kyang rung mod/ khro bo chen po re lha ga par bsngags/ de'i nang nas kyang ske bas 'dir /skro rgyal gshin rje gshed bsngags/ de la yang las kyi ba / sbyo/rden rje dang / ma/ mo ni gshin rje gshe/rded po yongs kyi bka' nyan yin la/ mgon nag dang / lha mgon ni/ gtso bo'i 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad nyid kyi sgos kyi las mkhan lta bu yin te/ lnga ma/gron ni dkyil 'kho rder sprul dgos pa'i gdul bya'i gtso bo yin/ mgon po sna 'dul byed dkyil 'kho/rder gyi las ma/khan/ ro langs brgyad kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i yang ma bon po ni ye shes mgon po gang gis kyang wo mod kyi/ brgyud pa dang / byin rlabs dang / phyag len rgyun gcig pa ni/ rwa ba'i mgon nag 'di'o/ /las gshi/na rbe 'jam dpal kra/then na rje ba/hūṃ|rded gang la yang 'bral ba med pa'i las mkham yin la/ dpal lha mo yang —303—

——rdze ——shrī ya nā n+ta ka'i shar ga rab ma'i snam/ grangs su rig par bya/ rma/ mo rtsa ba'i lugs 'di rwa ba'i bka' bsrungs kyi sa/tso bo yin khro/ /zhes pa 'di gsar ma'i gshin rje ba rnams kyis nan tan du go dgos pa yod do /de lta ra na gtor chog khams gsum zil gnon gyi lhan thabs lde'u thung / gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos / dgra bgegs kun 'joms 'di yang / rwa'i rigs su skyes shing / 'jam dpal rdo rje grabs pa'i brka' brgyud 'dzin pa/ rwa le gsum pa ā nan gar+bhas sbyar ba'o// //〈a nan+da gar+bha ni kun dga' snying ngo mtshan gzhan tā ra nā tha'o//〉 zhus dag /ma ṅga la/

chen po'i chos stor la med mi rung gi gal po che/sgrub pa'i lag len gyi yi ge yang dag ge lte pa'/ /'jigs rma/dzang skor gyi yis char brdzu ba phyis kyi bsre snang can rta bal/ gcig las dga' ba ra gas/ 'ji la dkyil chog blo la byang ba gcig gis 'jug dgos te bla ma/ (la ma zhus par dpe klos sa tsam/ gyis ri/ rung ngo //dpo/ stu pes/tra/ tshan rdzo/shwa5/oX snya sti/ 'dir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems nga pa ri thams cad kyi bes rab ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ 'jam/ dang/la rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bsnyen nga/ sngor du song nas sgrub pa'i rigs rnams nyams/ su blang ba'i slo/ra ngag la/ sbyis bslang ba de sa'i cho ga lnge ga par gnas pa/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga/dkyi' nga spor sgrub pa/ mchod bstod sna bul ba/ bsgrus pa'i rnal 'byor/ rjes kyi bya ba ste rnam pa bdun 'a ru / rang ngo/ la sa bslang ba ri/ gtor ma sogs yo byad rnam/sa tshos sa/ nga ra sdus / shā n+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ stong nga/'i ngang la sa huX las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ sis mtshan pa las/ rang nyid bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ‘snang khu/ga5/sa rdo rje rgya rngim dang / g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs 8sna dza/ba can/khro bo'i cha byad tho/ ngas su rje khe/sa nga 'o/ /zhes nga/'am// yang na/ bdag nyid 'jigs mjad nyid du bskyed kyang chog /tseXr+sha badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūX phaṭa/ ces nga/'am// hiXsnriXtshar ga su ma/ brjod/ gtor ma ya mun+ta ka'am/ a/ mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā 'a/sa sbyangs/ tseX( —305 —

ā ༷0hūṃ ha ho/ daX lan rma/nga du brjod nga/sa/ byin gyis brlabs/ tseXṭo in+t+ra ya/ hruX'es nga/ nas/ h+pha dzo 0 kra/ṭa phaṭa swahwa ( 3 ba ra la na gsum dang / a/ ka ro rna lan bdun dang / la 'bar ma'i sngags kru phyo bdun gyis gtor rma phul/ skye( badz+ra a/'aX sru hā/ nas / skyed badz+ra ro / sna ā 0༷huX/ gi bar gyis/smu cheng/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnong spyin srin pa rim ga(nan rngo dos la/ /sa 'di bdas gis bslang ngar bgyi/ /nga kyal 'a/bor dan su du khyod kyis hṝ/4pa/ /'as la zho tra su ra/ gsol ba btab nas/ zol mo'i sga ngang nga cas/ nga sra ga sna ra dor ro/ ༈8'ang ra/ gtor ma/ ngang lhan cig rma ched ri 'ang nga4gru sa shing dor dgros/ la/ rma/cheng gtor bya myo rlabs kyangalbe na cis yi/myo zhing / bza' bca' 'bru sna gos sna glud gzugs/ jo/sas kyang gtor sa sung / sde nas —hūṃ/ra cha te snang za byi sa/ sa 'ar ra/ṇa la byas te dri bzang this thal pe 'a/ tshom bā sa kyi ga bkod/ che/dun du ma chod gtor ba tham sa/ bsngu na sa/'i lha cho dam chog nga bskye da sno/ dgos gsung na(snang snyelag le na ma dzang pa sgyu/na shas che sde/ tshor/ bu bas/ngas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang 'a sa baX las sa'i lnga cho/rta/yas/ra gyi rma nal zla dag can rdo zhe'/ sa cag phyag gnyis// g.yas dpang jo ra /spas 'e|na nga 'i phya kla/ rgya dang / sa/yo/na gser gye bu8/ pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa//dar dang rin ngo/ ches brgyan pa/ lte ba yo phyo chad sa/'i nga kyal 'bor nas 'thon nga//rang gi soྈ cho / gsum 'a oṃ ā ༷༷hūṃ/ rdo rje rtse gsu ra kyi phya/sa rgya sa ra brngabs / sa brog nas sa'i lha cho/ (se khro/ra dang bcas pa ba dro sa mā jaX jaXhuX paṃ stohā sde ra yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phro sa/ dbang gi lha/ ras sa lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ ba dro bru tho a bhi 'a tan / huX/ zhes gsu ngas shing bum/ nga zi chus/ dbang bsku/ra / sku sang / dri ma dag skyo chu' snye r+sha/ga ma/ ya ra (skud pa snyelas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis/ dbu brgyan/ bsdu sa pa/'i sta/bas / dbang bskur rgyas btab me/da kyang chog/ma chong pa/ rnam sa bsangs sbyangs rdu rī /'bru — 3()6 —

snye—gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma/ bsangs sbyangs/ tse rna ā ra ha ho hi sa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ pri thi lī ar+gha pra titsā swahā/ de bzhin du shasta 'a bar du sbyar/ lko mahā pri thi lī de lti/ lo ka mā ta re i da ba ling kha /ba khwa hi /nā lha/ lan bdun sogs kyes gtor ma phul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cang/ kyis/ /spyod khro/'i tshu' nga/nga khyad nga ra gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyong/ ni ngang nga du gyur/ khwakya seng se skyo ba pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de ba:rgon bangs gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas nas dkyil 'khod ra 'bri/ /lam/ gsu rme// geng ba'am ra sogs kyis/ mchod/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod kyis sa'i phyogs 'dir nga kya/la 'khor gyi las dang sngags kyi spyod pa ci dga' bar gyis shig ces gsungs nga ra gyur/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim par gyur/ myos badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha tilga zhes 'a na ma nga du brjod/ sa sbyang ba ni/ snu kha/ sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang ba'i na du gyur/ hū 'a/ hū/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang ba / tsan du gyur/ oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra kro dha pho phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa sogs brjod cing / yungs kar chu shing tha la rnams kyis gtor ro/ /de nas sa bzung ba ni/ de rnams phyags mas/ btab ste der ྈnga nyid 'dus la/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i bar du gtso rkyang ngam bcu gsum ma/'i sgrub thabs bzhin sgo smu/sa/ bdus spo sa btu' rte/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bdas la nga songs su sa so'// /bangs chi/ rdo rje zle yis / /'dir ni dkyil 'kho(ra bri bar bya/ /sangs rgyas 'a sabs kun 'byo na 'tshal/ /dngos grub ‘3dir ni yang dag stso༄ / /ces lan gsum/ gyis snyan mnan/ mchod nga/ ba4/mas shing bsangs sbya ngas/ stong nga 'i ngang las/ a las ra pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hū zhu ba 'a/sa byung ba'i ma chong yon zhes — 307 —

bsgo— — —tho pa nas/ ro'/ mo rnams bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ lko.ā hū/ lan brgyad sogs brjod/ bcu gsum ma'i sgrub pa byed na/ tho ba gshi na rje gshe da la sogs pa bzhi thugs ka nas spros/ lha dgu ro langs brgyad bskor ltar sgrub na/ yum rdo rje ro langs ma gcis thugs lo nas sprul te/ gang ltar yang / tse shesarba ta thā ga ta shrī badz+ra ste ra wa sa pā ri wā ra ar+gha pra titsā swāhā/ de bzhin du sha lta'i bar du sbyar ba phul te/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ /sogs kyis bstod/ gshi na rje 'joms pa'i dkyil ‘ma bar 'jigs/ sgyu/dkyi'/ 'khor kun gyi gtso bo ni/ /sdig pa thams cad zad mdzad pa/ /mgon pos dkyil 'kho7ra bri bar mdzod/ /ces gsol ba 'debs te/rme chod bstod gsol 'debs sbrags pa tshar gsum/ mam/ re re nas tshar gsum/ gsum gang bde bya/bcu gsum ma'i sgrub pa byed na/ tho ba rdo rje sogs kyis phyogs bzhi nas byed par bsams te/mchod bstod gsol 'a nge/bas sbrags pa tshar bzhi byed pa yin mod kyi/ bstod pa ni/ dgra nag le'u gnyis nga/ bzhin so so dang / phyogs bzhi'i gsol 'debs kyang gsang 'dus bzhin byas nas 'jus tu gshi/na rje 'joms pa sogs byed de/ 'dir rbi rdo rje ro langs mas 'jig rten pa'i lho phyogs kho na nas de dag byed de/ dmigs pa la thod ma spar gyi tsho sgo rim dur khrod nas so/ /de yang phyogs bzhi nas mi dgos kyi/ 'jig rten lho 'gru/ dkyi/ stor 'kho/ra gye shar kho na nas so / /'dir rgyud las/ bdag dang than tu mthun pa bzhi/ /zhes 'byu1nga bas thob thang slob ma'am/ sgrub grogs sam/ sgrub g.yo ga this sa sol ba 'debs/ pa/ yi na yang / de dag bas/ma pa ma dag na sgrub pa'i bar chad du 'gyur zhing /ci deng sa nga bsam / pa ngag la dam tshig gtsang ba dkon pas / dmigs pa gong bzhin byas nas/dngos su rang gis brjod do/ /o badz+ra u ta gri rang gi mig g.yas g.yon ma dang ṭa las nyi ma nga pa zla ba/ mis 'bras glu bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba/ rdo rje'i lta — 308 —

bas g.yas skor dang / g.yon skor du ltas nas/ bgegs rnams bsregs nga/ra gyur/ o badz+ra tre nyi ma ṭa/ kro dha rdzu sno hru kro dha pre sno a rkang rme/thil hūṃ las rdo rje rgya gram 'bar ba hū gis mchan par gyur/ rdo rje gsor/ dril bu bkrol/ hru ṭībazla bzhin du g.yas skor du skor ba byas nas/ slar yang dbus su 'gying ba dang bcas nga/sa/ hu/lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor byed/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ /lus gsum las skyes 'gas par bya/ /gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'/ /'jig par 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /drag ro'/ dang bcas 'e sna ri rdo bzlas/ rdo rje 'a myong zhes pa'i thad du/ 'kho7ra lo 'chang / zhes sogs rin chen/ nga/rla/ral gri la yang 'don pa spo'o/ /de nas srung ba ni/ phur bu bas ngas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hu las byung pa'i/ khro bo bgegs mthar byed/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can du gyur/ na ma sa man+ta kā ya nywa ka tsit+ta ba dz+nyā ṇa/ tse( ṭak+ki hū dza bgegs thams cad bkug ste 'brub khung gi dbus su bcug nga ra sdo/ra/ tse( gha gha drus gī khu5 ya hu phaṭa/ lan gsum/ bshes sa la phur bus btab/ tse( badz+ra kro dha ha na ha na a mṛ te hū phaṭa/ lan gsum tho bas brdungs / phur bu'i khro polas 'od zer 'phros/ bgegs lhag ma thams cad tshar bcad/ rdo rje'i rwa ba/dra ba/ gur/ bla re/ me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa mi phaṭa/ swāhā/ lko badz+ra bha snye wa hūṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ spros pa la dga' na phur bu bcu 'debs/ lag len rnam grangs la phur bu stong par sbyong ba'i sngags a kā zos byed nga yang yod do/ /sa chog dngos de tsam gyis chog kyang / slar yang gnas der 'grub na sbyin sreg byed pa — 309 —

dang/de pa 'grub na tshogs 'khor dang / nge/ yang ma grub na gtor chog rgyas pa re mdzad pa phyag len nges can yin no/ /gnyis pa lhag gnas ni/ sngo na 'gro gtor ma dang / dpal gtor lnga dang / tshom bu'i rgyu dang /mchod nga/'i yo byad rnams tshang bar bsags la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma// ya mun+ta kas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ tseX( ā hūX ha re rto hiXs byin gyis brlabs/ ma / ba' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags sam/tseX( in+t+ra ya/ sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ mchod spyin gtor ma 'ji bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub rtse/ga /rtsa ba nga rdza /brgyud par bcas pa'i da/pal ldan bla rma dam pa rnams kyi dgongs pa bskangs pa dang / de bzhin g.ye/gas/ pa sras dang bcas pa mtha' dag mnyes par bya ba dang / ma lus pa'i se mas can gyi khams rnams theg pa mchog gi bde ba la 'jog pa'i jon du/ dkyil 'bor thams cad kyi rgyal po srid pa gsu gru/ las rnam par rgyal ba/ bcom snan 'das gshin rje gshed dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs su sa sol te/ yang ngas par sgrub pa'i cho ga la 'jug par 'tshal na/ phyogs skyong ba bcu la sogs pa'i dkar dro/'i phyogs la rme/ngon par dga' ba'i tshogs rnam sa kyis bar chang srung ba dang /'phri myo las rnam rnga/ bzhi sgrub cing dngos grub kye gdong grob/sa da myo / pa rma/dzad du gsol/ nag ngo/'i phyogs la mngon par das 'a ba'i 'byung ngo 'i tshogs rnam/sa sa'i lte phyas sa 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig//ces rol cho/'i sgri/ dang bcas te byi ra dor/ hruXzhuXngang bgegs ma/thar byed kyi gzungs bzlas la bshegs bskrang/ ya nga gnas dang lo byad bsangs sbyangs/ gnas lang stong pa'i ngang las bhuX la sa byung pa/'i dur /brong/ —3/(/—

'bar ba'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs blo / / rja gas pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa phyi rol srung ba'i la bor los yongs subaskor ba'i nang du/ a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ o.ā nyu zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub nga/'i mchong ye(na/ 6༈ba1sa bsil/ me ta rtog /bdug spos/ rma/ra me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs nga smu chod pa'i sprin gyi phung po rlams sha myo tu rnam par dag pa dbang sgyur ba'i rngam rig bi rang bzhan zag pa med pa 'i ye/ shes dang / smon lam rgya mtsho'i mthu las grub pa/ phyogs bcu rab 'khya rme sa nam ngam ba 'a gtos thar/sa cad yongs su gang ba/ srid pa ji srid kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad pa/ 'jug par gyur/ sgro badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ dwa hūm̐/ mo badz+ra put+pa//ā hūṃ/ dhu pe/ā lo ke /ga rnye/ nai wi te/ sha dha ā/0hū/ oṃ ā rū nga ba dz+nyā si'u/ de nga zhan du/ shabha/ga rnye/ nās/ sparnye/ o.a dharma dha tu badz+ra hūṃ/ tshi bsdu sna rje ra ṇ+ḍi ta sogs/ ‘pan po sur pyis rol cho 'i byin dbab bo/ dku' ri/ 'khor gyi sa gzhi la ba byung lnga dang / bdud rtsi ྅ dang / khrag chen bsres/ pas byugs/ 3 dgu dzo re ma/ bcu gsum gang yi na nga nga / lha'i bzhugs gtses dang ra bru myo nga/ra dri bzang bis tshom/ bu bkod/ gzhan phyag mtshan gyi ga myos tham/sa/ cad du this re/ re ci tsam bya/thams cang la yi ge 'bru gsum/ brjod/ skyabs 'gro naru/ brtsam sa te/ dkyil 'khor snyer bsdu 'i bar 0dag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ 'dir sa cheg ma/ ri te gtas sa ga 'an rnams kyi skabs su ma/dun bskyed bcu gsum ma byed pa la bdag bskyed gtse rkyang gis byas kyang rung sde sa tse rkyang ngang lha ba/ce gsum 'ang ma/ ga yin/ bcu gsum ma sgom/sa kyang gtse rkyang la bsdu sa nas rma/dur bskyed sgrub dgos so/ /bzlas pa yang mang du bya/ de nas mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs) / stong pa' ngang la sa chos — sgo) / / —

'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la zhes pa nas/ huX hūX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ de'i dbus su bhuX las mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa/phyogs thams cad dur khrod chen pos yongs su khyab pa'i dbus su/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i kha dog lta bu'i steng du/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar/ raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūX las rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin zhes pa nas/ lta ba yang mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ de nas sku las spros pa'i phyag mtshan gyi tshogs phyi rol tu 'khod pa ni/ nang gi rim pa la/ shar du mgo bo nas/ gsal shing gis phug pa'o/ /phyi'i rim pa la shar gyi g.yas su gri gug dang / 'phang mdung dang /gtun shing / g.yon du chu gri dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / lcags kyu rnams so/ /lho'i g.yas su dgra sta dang / mda' dang / kha ṭāX ga /sa/yon du dbyug tho dang / 'khor lo dang / zhags pa rnams so/ /nub kyi sa yas su rdo rje dang / cang te'u dang / phub/ g.yon du gzhu dang / dril bu dang / rlung ras rnams so/ /byang gi g.yas su sdigs 'dzub dang / ba dan rtse gsum pa dang / glang po che'i pags pa/ g.yon pa tho ba dang / mdung dang / me thab rnams so/ /de'i phyi rim la phyogs bzhi dang / mtshams bzhir rab song chen po brgyad kyi gdan la/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bhi yig nag po dang bcas pa brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ ro langs 'jigs byed chen po brgyad sku mdog nag po/ rab tu khros shing spyan gsum pa/ phyag na gri gug dang / thod pa'am/ ral gri dang / thod pa 'dzin pa/—312—

gcer bu rgyan spangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ ka ha ka ha ha la ha la zhes ljags brkyang zhing drag tu bzhad pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa rnams su gyur/ yang na ro langs rnams/ stag lpags/ sprul rgyan/ mgo 'phreng sogs khro bo spyi dang mtshungs par byas kyang rung ngo / /lha bcu gsum ma ltar na gzhal yas khang bskyed/ nang gi re mig la phyag mtshan gyi steng du snye las gti mug gshin rje gshed sogs/sgo bzhir ya las tho ba gshin rje gshed sogs bskyed/ grwa nang ma'i thod pa dang / phyi'i ro langs bzhi/ phyag spo gyi sdebs la bskyed do/ /'phros do myo no/ /de nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' gdod nas grub pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu mes pas bskor ba/ badz+ra sa mā dzaX hiXsgyiXs bgegs bskrad/ jaXrigaX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'em/ mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa mā dzaX daXsgyiXs bsangs/ a lheX nas sha lta'i bar gyis ma/chod/oX badz+ra ang ku sha dzaX nas/ staṇ+ḍi hoX'i bar gyis dgug gzhug bya/ ma/chod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong nga 'i ngang las/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la zhes pa nas/ dharmā dh+wa tu hūṃ/ dzi te/ zhes pa'i bar dngos gzhi'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs phyi mchod phul/ sngags gsum gyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pa lan gsum/ gsum mam bdun bdun gyis nang mchod phul/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /zhes pa nas/ mun chen khyod la 'dud/ /ces pa'i bar dang / 'jam dpal mkha' las 'byung ba'i gser rme dog can/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod do/ /'dir cho ga'i yan lag tu ni bum sgrub mi dgos —313—

———sprospro rdekyang / spyin sreg dang gsang byed sogs la mkho che ba'i phyir bum pa sta gon bzhin du bum sgrub byed gsung zhing lag len du yang mdzad pa'i srol gda' ste/ spro na dkyil chog tu shes par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma rnams sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ gtor rma dang po dkyil 'khor la 'bul te/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hu las byung ba'i zhes pa nas// yid la 'dod pa kun skobaXspru/rdeb ga rngon ga /ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ gtor ma gnyis nga dpal nag po chen po lcam dra'/ so/gas ye shes/ kyi spyan dang lngan pa'i chos skyong rnams la gtor chog 3 ra phul / gsum/ pa phyogs skyong rnams 'a/ 'bul ba ngang / bzhi pa sa ro/na rje chos/ kyi rgyan pa rngo la 'bul ba rni/ sgru ba thabs su nga shad pa ba 'ar yi na nga/ 'a/sa/ mthar/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i da che/ can sru nga ma'i tshogs rnams kyi 'es pa nas/ oṃ khyod kyas/ sems can 'es sogs kyi ma thar/ skyes/ dza ya dza ya sogs gshegs gso/ la dang / sems can thams cad bde gyur cis /ces sogs/ smon 'a ma btab/ spos/ dang bcas pa'i rdor dra ru pa 'dzin pa/sa rā na sas myo nga bab ge/ra ri bya sta/ bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni/ /rigs snga gas rgya pa por phyag 'tshal bstod/ /snying rje'i yid kyis dkyil 'khor 'bri/ /de pyir byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod/ /dgongs shig sangs rgyas sde dang tshogs/ /gang gzhan sngags kyi lnga tshogs dang / /lha rnams bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /nga/kyil 8sel/ra 'di la byin rlabs dang / /dngos grub dam pa stsal/rde bar mdzod/ /ces 'a/na gsum/ khus/spru la sogs pas rma chong/ ga ja / gas sgra 95rde tre du gas sde mig ce1rde ni/ /'es sogs dang / dur brod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ /sogs kyis bstod/ lko badz+ra u tigri'es/ dang / rdo rje sa tsug gtor gyi phyag rgyas nam mkhar bteg /slar yang mchod bstod snga rma 0'in byas la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor she — 3 14 —

lha tshogs rnams/ ji srid spyan ma drangs kyi bar du steng gi nam rme/kha spro zhen 0 4 bzhugs nas bsrung ba chen po mdzad pa dang / nang par dkyil 'khotshor byin gyis rlob pa dang / bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal/ du ga tre du'// hiXsgyiXlan gsum dang / bdud rtsi 'khyi/la ba'i sngags lan bdun gyis bsrung ba byas la bzhag go /gsum pa dkyil 'khe/ra zhag gi cho ga ni/ nangs par snga bar langs nas this/ tsho'i 5/mas mkhos su phebs par bya ste/ de yang sgrub pa'i 'dra 'bag zhag bdun sogs dus yun thung ngu tsam yin na/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'kho1ra bsngags par 'dod/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis nas zla drug bi bar du byed pa rnams la ni/ chu tshon kho na bsngags shing / sgrub pa lan gsum du rtsom pa zla ba bco brgyang la sogs pa byed pa la ni/ zla ba drug drug nas dkyil 'khor gsar du 'bri dgos te/ sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor ra gcig zla ba drug las lhag par 'jog pa ma bsha/da cing de dag so sor ma byas myo lan gsum du mi 'gro bas so/ /'ji la rdul tshon gyi dong/ du chu tshon byed pa ma gtogs/ this tshon gyi skro ga dbang chog bzhin byas kyang legs shing / rtos bdun gyi rkang 'grel 'a sogs pa rwa lugs dang /skyo lugs kyi yi/ga rnying mang po'i dngos bstan gyi nga gongs pa 'ang yin cho/ /'on kya pa ma na ngas bi yi ge ltar lag len 'di bzhin mdzad de/ las this ye thig so sor byed na/ las this bsangs sbya ngas /hūṃ las byung ba'i las thig tu mos/ oX āXbisnrun+ta kṛ ta hūX phuraX phaṭa swāhā/ brgya rtsa ngang nye snying ci 'os bzlas nas/ bgegs mthar byed kyi ngo bor gyu/ra ji la / a/tshu 'es na sha lta' bar gyis/ mchod/ 'jigs nga 'i hū ཾ ༷ sgra nges sgrog cing / /so/gas kyis bsto nga ce sdi/nga bzla bzhen du thig gdab/ ya nga bla ma'i gsung sgros las sgrung nga/'i dkyil 'a/bor bsda sa pa skor ri rtsis pa tshun chad 'bri ba yin 'es kyang gsung gin kru dug /phyag len yang ci rigs ma jad cing rung —31kye —

———rdetsam ma yin mod kyi/ rgyud las gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan/ /zhes pa dang / sgo bsrung gyi ni mtshams rnams su/ /zhes sogs/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol rnams rgyas par gsungs nga sa/ 'grub na dkyil 'khom ra rdzogs par 'bri ba nyid gal che la/ rdo re'i nang ngam me ri'i phyi gang du 'bri yang rung ste/ dur khrod brgyad kyang rgyas par 'bri dgos so/ /de'i phyir de dang mtshungs pa'i las jis/ bdapa zin pa na/ yangs skud pa kha ngog sna lnga so so ra brkyang ste/ khrag chen dang bdud rtsi lnga cung zad byugs/ bsangs sbyangs/ o las byung ba'i thig skud dkar po rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo go hu las byung ba'i thig skud nag po mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo/ a 'a/sa byung ba'i thig skud ser po rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo go hru las byung ba'i thig skung dmar po'od dpag med kyi ngo bo/ a las byung ba'i thig skud ljang khu don yod grub pa'i ngo lnga1rnams su gyur/ myos ā hu hū phaṭa swāhā/ o ā o hū phaṭa rda/hā/ tseṭani/ tru si/ phaṭa swāhā/ tse( ni/ rdi/ h+pha/ phaṭa swāhā/ tseṅkani/ 65 hwa / phaṭa swāhā/ zhekha/ pa'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa re bzla zhing / sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid du mos nas / hi sgyi brgya rtsa brgyad kyis byin gyis brlabs/ ar+gha la so gas pas mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /sogs kyis bstod pa'am/ de nyid lnga pas bstod kyang rung / de nas thig skud bsgril ba'i sngas sa/ o.a no n+ya/ a nu ga ta/ sarba dharma pa ra spa ra/ a nu ga ta sarba dharmā a bya n+ta a nu pra bri giXsarba dharmā hu/ zhes pas bsgril ling / hū ཾ ljo spyo zhes thag sna gtad/ o ā badz+ra sa ma ya su tra ma ti gra ma chi/ zhes brjod cing tsā thig che brgyad nas brtsams te/ las thig thams cad kyi steng du 'debs tshul bya/nam mkhang gang ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ khyod kyis 'gro don mdzad dus lags//zhes yang yang brjod/ 'di sgrub pa po gcig pus byed pa'am/ grogs dang bcas kyang slob ma'i don — 316 —

du ma yin pas/ phyogs 'khrug la gyi nyes pa rtsi ba dang / thig skor sogs mi dgos gsungs so/ /gal te ye thig ngang las thig gcig gis byed na/ thog mar ye this gi cho gas thig chen brgyad so gas ji ltar 'os pa btab nas/ thig de nyid la/ bisnrin ta krita dang / ya man+ta bzlas nas/ ye thig nyid las thig tu bsgyur te 'debs pa yin no/ /dkyil chog spyi'i lugs) la// skolas thig la byin rlabs logs pa mi dgos pa shas che yang / 'dir ni bla ma'i man ngag gis nges par byeng do/ /de nas chu rnge ni nam rdul tshon rnam pa lnga la dmigs nas/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa 'i ngang las/tshon rtsi nag po ba las rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i po bo/ tshon rtsi dkar dzo la las sangs rgyas spyan ma'i ngo bo tshon rtsi ser po ma 'a sa nā/ ma ki'i ngo bo/tshon rtsi dmar po pa las gos dkar mo'i ngo go tshon rtsi ljang khu tā las sgrol ma'i lnga du lngas rnams su gyur/ tse( ā ba hu phaṭa swāhā/ o.ā la hū phaṭa swāhā/ tse( ā mā hu phaṭa swāhā/ tse( gi/ pā hu phaṭa swāhā/ tse( ya/ tā hū phaṭa swāhā/ 'es pa rnams brgya rtsa re bzla zhing /ar+gha nas/shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'khyu/nga ba lnga ni rnam dag lha/ /tshad med lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ /de bzhin gshe gas ma lnga yi dngos/ /de dag rnams la phyag 'tshal brnya(da/ /slar yang rtsa sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs te/ tse( badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hu/ mang du brjod/ sa stobadz+ra be+e ga a kra ma khru/ zhes thig gi nang du zhugs la hi hi zhes sgo'i rtsa thig gyis/ chos dbyings ye shes dag pa'i gnas/ /sems can khams rnams rab sgrol byed/ /rgyal ba 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid/ /de bzhin kra/zhegs pa kun gnas pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing / lha mtshan dgod pa ni/ rgyud las/ de dbus mi ro bri bar bya/ /zhes dang / sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhir/ ro langs chen po brgyad bri'o/ /zhes/ 'byung ba rnams 'dir ro langs brgyad skor ltar na/ bla ma'i man ngag gis gdan dgod pa yi na rno//— 317 —

bcu gsum ma ltar na/ re mig brgyad kyi mgo bo sogs kyang gdan du 'gyur zhing yang dbus su mi ro mgo ngang rkang lag bral ba/ zhes gong ma rnams kyis bshad pa ni/ re zhig zab don sbas pa'i phyi rgya tsam yin la/ ro langs mgo gsum pa sogs kyang mchog sgrub la pa yin/ dgra bo rims kyis 'debs pa sogs drag las sam/ zo langs sgrub pa'i dbang du byas par 'dod do/ /bcu gsum ma lta bu nag po'i kha skong can yin la/ byin rlabs nus mthu che zhing dge la bkra shis pa ni yin no//'on kyang nas ngo/ sogs rgyud gzhan gyi kha skong meng par rtog pa bdun pa'i bstan tshod kyi dgongs don rgyud rkyang rma na ngag snying gi thig le ni/ ro langs brgyad bstor nyid la brten dgos la/ de yang slob dpon mi bskyong pa dang / li la badz+ra dang / mal lugs sogs ci thod thod kyis kha bskang ba ma yin par/ rje btsun rdo rje grags pa'i man ngag lag len khrigs bkod dang snying la gab pa'i yig chung bdun gyi dgongs pa ltar lag len mdzad pa'i rgyun ni/ dbus kyi mi ro lha ma yin gdan yin pa ltar sgo mtshams kyi mi ro'am ro langs kyang dkyil 'bor gyi lha ro langs brgyad po rang en cig min/ gdan yin no zhes pas nges pa las so/ /des nas rgyud kyi dngos bstan gyi tshig ltar dbus sam sgo mtshams brgyad du mi ro ri cho bri ba'am/ rnam pa gcig tu na bri pa'i don legs par 'du byed pa la'ang 'jug pa sa/ sngon o rgyan kha che nyi 'og sogs kyi dur khrod chen por nang kyal 'khor 'bri ba na/ ba chen dngos su 'jog pa yin 'dug /bod du da lnga nge/ ltar rmi 'grub la / 'on kyang sha chen khrag chen bsres pa'i bag zan btsos pa la/ mi gzugs byas rte tsan dan dmar pos byugs pa'am/snang ma/ rngu la bcos pa sogs kyang rung zhing / de yang rtsig pa'i nang phan chad bris zin pa na/ dbus su pang/ nyi'i steng du/ lko hū hā/ zhes lan snyer brgyad bzlas pa sa mi ro yongs rdzos sa kyi gzugs brnyan dgod/ sngags bdun ni gdan spyi la dgos/ sngags nyer gcig ni byol so nga bcu drug dang lha chen lnga'i jon yin/ sgo bzhi grwa bzhir pad nya'i sadan med kyang — 318 —

chog /thig le dmar po re byas pa'i steng du/ eX( pre ta gi tsho / ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun bzlas pas shar sbor ro langs kyi gzugs gcig gdan gyi tshu'/du dgod/ de bzhir du lhor/ i rna pre ta bi nā/ste ka hūṃ phaṭa/ nub tu/ oṃ pre ta dz+wa la 'uX ri/ṭa/ byang du/ kru pra pre ta ut+pa ṭa chiX phaṭa/ 'er gcig bzlas/ rma/chams bzhir/ tseXsdo hūṃ 9༷5 hā/ zhes pa kho na la na bdun res dgod/grangs bdun la dag kla mi gsung / mi ro'i gzugs rnam sa la bub yin/ dbu ru kyi mi ze'i sdeng du ral gri 'a snye snying brgya rtsa/ hruXlgiX drug cu cam// ya/ ma rā ja/ nyer gcig bzlas rte/ rtse rmo gyen du brtad za sa bkod do/ /sgo rme/chams/ brgyad las sbo ba 'ar mi ro'i sdeng du/ hra hra hūṃ huX phaṭa phaṭa/ces pa snyer gcig re dang / ma chams bzhar/ oṃ ā ༷༷kha stonaX phaṭa hruXta/ zhes pa snyer gcig res/ phyag mchan ral gri'am/ gri gug gang rung re 'gong ngo/ /phyag rma chan gzhan rlams ni rab tu /ri bur ra/ dang / 'bring du ca ka 'i/ 'as da/ tha ma rdu'/ tshon 'e gru chu tsho5 gyis 'bri ba yin gsungs kyang 'bur ma yo da na legs/ re da myo phyi rma gnyis ngo/ 'bring tha'i dbya bra ri/ yong 'dra bar mngon cing / gang ྅ ra na'ang / nye snyi/nga bdun bdun bzla bzhin 'gong/ do/ /der ma/chan rma ྅'i rang bzhin du mo sa/ nga rī sa/dngos sam yid kyis ma/chod pa 'bul/ dur khrod rgyan gyis so/sas kyis bstod/ snye sdi nga gi ma/thar rak+ṣa rak+ṣa btags bsrung ba bya/ bdug spos dang ma ra me/ rgyun du 83bul/ de nas dkyi' 'bor snag ma rnam/sa bris la/ lhag chad kyi nyes pa spang ba'i don du/ dkyil 'bar gyi shar khyo/gas/ nas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol la / yis brgya mang du bzlas/ mchod pa/'i bu gru/ji nga/ brgyad kyang nam rme/kha ri mdzod kyi sngags kyis phul/ mched bum/ ngangs su meng 'e tsa ka shā 'ar / yi da kyis/ ngu 'a / sa rgyan gan gru/ rgyan sogs bkram/ mchod pa/'i yo byad thams cang chang bar bya'o/ /ba'i nga/ dkyil/ 'bor sgru ba pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma// gnas rngo byam rlabs/ skyabs sem sa rdor se/ma sa / nang mchod byin rlabs rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i tshogs/ zhing nas/ brtsa ma/sa/ dkyal la bar — 3/9—

bsdu ba'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms/ bum pa gcig la/ biljun ta kṛ ta dang / nye snying dang / 65 bhi ṣe ka'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa re bzlas la khrus bum bya/ sngar bum sgrub byas na 'di'i dod las bum gyis chog pas 'di mi dgos so/ /nyi ma thog ma'i thun dang ngo/ yin na/ zhi ba dang / zhi drag phyed ma dang / drag po'i sgo nas/ bgegs sbyang ba bod kyi lag len spyi dang 'dra bar bya/bar skabs su ltas 'tshub pa byung na'ang 'di byed dgos/ de min thun phyi ma dang nyi ma gnyis pa phan la mi dgos te/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags/ bzla bzhin rdo rje gsor bas bgegs bskrad pa tsam gyis chog /de rjes til sbyangs ni za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lugs bzhin gyis byur bsal/ de rjes khrus bum blangs nas khrus gsol bya ste/ de dag be lag len spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la zhes pa nas/ phaṭa swāhā/ de'i dbus su pa las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khe(ra gyi steng du/ bhu las 'khor lo bhu gyis mtshan pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin gzhal med khang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rin po che sna lnga las grub pa/ nang nas rim/ pa bzhin du/ nag ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du pha gu ser po la/ dra ba dang / dra phyed 'phyang ba/ steng mda' yab mchod rten gyi rnam pas mdzes pa/ pu sha'i khor yug la gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng ba/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres pa/ dbus su dkyil 'khor zlum ngo//mi mgo skam po'i ra ba zlum po 'dzul sgo bzhi las sgo gcig phye ba/ de'i nang re'u mig dgur gyur pa/ dbus kyi gzhi nag po'i steng / phyi nang gi sa gzhi — 320 —

thams do/ byed khrag zhag 'khrug pa/ steng ke rus kyi ka gdung gis phub pa/ g.yang gzhi'i bla bre dang / rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi la sogs pas brgyan pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang / rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu la/ mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams dang / sgo bzhi'i thad ka nas/ ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs nga/'i rta babs rnams kyi rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i 'bor lo dang / ri dwags dang / gdugs kyis mtshan pa/ 'khyams la mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu gtum drag la sogs pa nas/ sna tshogs pas gang bsku'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ dkyil 'kho/ra chen po'i dbus kyi re mig gtso bo'i gnas su/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i /spa dog ces pa nas/ bzhugs pa rnga/mas su gyur/ gyi bar sta gon gyi skabs dang 'dra/ de nas gtso bo la/ nye snying dang / snying po dang / rtsa sngags rnams lan bdun bdun bzlas / ro la ngas brgyad la/ ya mun+ta ka dang / skye( huX hruXsnriX lan bdun bdun nam gsum tsam bzlas/ gdan gyi ro langs brgyad la/ tseX( pre ta sdo/ 95 ka /sogs lnga'am gsum gsum bzlas pas/ de rnams ro ra ngas bud med kyi lus can/ gzhon cing sgeg nyam/sa dang ldan pa brgyad/ ro langs 'jigs byed chen po rnams kyi bzho/ na pa'i tshul du gyur/ phyag mchan gzhan rnams la'ang / snye snying lan bdun bdun bzlas/ dam chig gi dkyil 'khor du sgrub pa'o/ /bcu gsum ma/ lngar sgrub na sta rgon gyi rigs 'gre ba las lha bcu gnyis la rang sngags bdun bdun bzla/ phyag mtshan ro langs rnams la nye snying dang / thod pa la 'bru gsum bdun bdun bzla ba ni khyad par ro ces go bar bya'o/ /thams cad kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ mig tu khriX nas saX dkar po/ spyi bor oX nas 'khyil ba las gtso bo la mi/ bskyo da pa dang / ro langs 'jigs byed —321 —

chen po brgyad la/ 'jam dpa/la rdo rje 'jas sa byed phyag gnyis pa res dbu brgyan/ lkoX badz+ra nas/ lha rnye hoX de nas nyi ma thog ma'i thun dang po 'a sta gon gyi lha dang sre dgos te/ de yang / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkha' nas sta gon gyi lha dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ oX badz+ra sa mā dzaXhruXsgyiX lan gsum gyes phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ slar yang / hiXkhrilaX lan gsum gyis gur gyi sgo phye 'a nang du spyan drangs/ ya/nga gsum gyis mtshams bcing ngo / /oX badz+ra lwa su siX/ sogs kyis mchod/ e ku sha sogs kyis dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par bstim/ dkyi'/ 'khor byin gyis brlab pa'i don du sngags gsum ci rigs pa dang / yig brgya lan dgu bzla'o/ /lnga pa mchod bstod 'bul ba ni/ de nas slar yang rma/chod pa rgya cher bsham/ bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oX āXhūX zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oX badz+ra ar+ghaX sogs nas shasta'i bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis mchod pas kyang chog la/ cung zad spres/ pa la dga' na 'di skad ces sbyar te/ 'jam dpal khros pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /mi zad a rgyu'i rgyun chen po/ /phyi nang gsang ba rab sbyar ba/ /'bul gyis 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /oX badz+ra bhi ra wa maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wa ra an+taX pra titsā swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ mi zad a rta'i rgyun chen po/ /zhes pa'i dod du/ rdo rje chu gtsang khrus kyi rgyun/ /zhes dang /ar+ghaX gyi gnas su/ pu duX zhes 'don pa spo/ de bzhin du/ rdo rje me tog khang par brtsegs//—322—

lkoX badz+ra bhi gre wa sa rī ra lda ra badz+ra stseni/ āXhūX/ rdo rje bdug spos sprin skru a/so—'brigs/ /dhu pe// rdo rje 'bar ba'i : nga gsal gtams / /ā/ ri tshe snyom ke /rjo rje gdung se'/ dri/ zhim tshogs/ /ga rnye/ rdo rje bza' bca' rgya mtshor 'byil/ /mai rmi bye/ rdo rje zol mo'i sgra brgya nga// kha ༷ / badz+ra snyiṇ+ḍa ra ṇi ta 'es rol cher bya/ gos zung bsangs sbya nga tra / / stong pe 'i ngang 'a sa/ huX ‘pas/ byung ba'i lha rdzas/ kyi na bza' zas med bde ba'i reg bya dang lngan pa mkha' nga byangs thams cang gang bar gyur/ sna tshogs nga bang ngo/'i sa zhu ba'am rab bkra ya nga sto/ tsā/gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i/ /bos bzang rin chen bang ga blo sbyang byi ra ‘sna bul/ /bzod pa/ ngam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oX badz+ra bhi ra wa sa dī/ ri wā ra badz+ra bsta/ ye/ āXhūṃ/ oX sarba bid pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya hoX 'jal bu'i gling ngang gling gzhan ngag /'khor le rin chen gyis bkang nas/ /stong gsum 'a/ so gas de bzhin te/ /zhum/ pa me/nga nga/ra byas te 'bul/ /oX badz+ra bhi ra wa sa pā ri 3 ra tsakra rat+na hūṃ dzi te āXhuX/ de bzhin du sbya ra rte/ nor bu ram chen/ ma ṇi/ btsun cho/ rin chen/ wa snyi/ khyim bdag rin chen/ mahā tā/ glang kro/ rin chen/hasta/ rta ma chos rin chen/ a shwa/ dam/ga dngo/na rin chen/ khat+pa/ gzugs mdzes kyis ni rab bkang ste/ /rū pa ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi te ā ༷༷huX/ sgra rā na/ sha rto/dri zhim/ ga rnye/ ro mchog /ra sa/ reg bde/ spar she //chos kham sa bsde bas/dharma khyu tu kā ma gu ṇa hūṃ/ dzi te āXhūX/ rgyal ba lnga dag thod pa'i cod nga/na dang / /rigs drug rang bzhin ja sdus pa'i phyag rgya drug /byang phyogs rnam dag phyag mtshan tsho rtags rnams kyis/ /ye shes sku la mchom da cing brgyan pe ra bgyi/ /sarba a lang —323—

bsnyeg rde spro—sprospro———spo rgya gzi rderderde—spro—sto ka ra/ sbrul chun tshangs pa chen po'i mchod phyir thogs/ /ā li kā li rnam dag ma/gobo'i 'phreng / /gti mug chen po glang chen lpags pa'i gos/ /rngo/ rje gsum dngos phyag rgyas mnyes gyur cig khri badz+ra mu dra/ dngos grub chen po brgyad dang dbang phyug brgyad/ /nyer spyad gyur las srid zhi gnon phyir dang / /zhe sdang gshi/rden rje bsgra' ba'i dam tshig che/ /bcu drug cha rnams dag nga/sa ma/snyes gyur cig /nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ rnams kyi mtshan nas smos te/ 'bru/ gsu gru/ gyis nang mchod phul / yi ge bcu pa'i rme thar 'bru gsum sbyar ba la/na sa sum gyis gtso bo dang / lan sa cag gis re'u mig brgyad na gnas pa'i mtshan ma/'i lha dang / ya mun+ta ka /lan brgyad kyis zo 'a ngas brgyad la 'bul/ ya rme rā dza dang / ya mun+ta ka'i mthar /'bru gsum/ sbyar bas rnam/ bu la gnas pa'i mtshan ma'i lha rnam/sa la yang 'bul/ bar 'dir chos skyong 'jig rten 'das pa rnam/sa la'ang snye3bal/ lko kā la ru pa hū phaṭa/ dam ca' chos kyi rgyal jo/ gshin rje'i zhal du/ oṃ nga hā tsa mu rte / hu phaṭa/ srin mo chen mo tsa muṇ+ḍi/'i zhal du mchod nga/ dam pa 'bul lo/ /o ā hu / mo in+t+ra ya swāhā/ oṃ ā ri nu/ de ba tha du/ya mā ya/ lda ru ṇa ya/ ku be nā ya/ i shā nā ya/ isna ye / rne ri tre/ wa ya we/pra h+ma ṇa ya / o ba su dha ri ṇi swāhā/ o ā hū/ lha chen ngo/ brgyad/ klu chen ngo/ brgyad/ gza' chen ngo/rdzo brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdu na/ rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams kyi zhal du lko na hu/ gzhan yang gnod spyin/ srin ngo// 'byu/nga po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ spyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub nga/ rnams kyi 'al du slo ā ha sto/ 'grab rigs drug /la rma rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i rgyud tshim — 324 —

———— rderde———— khardenas/ myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skol ba dang ldan par gyur cig/o sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3ha/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hu/mi/ thung sgeg ngo sprin lta'i mdog /'od zer bye ba 'phrob bzhengs/ /mtshan ma bsgreng ba ma he'i zhal/ /gnyis med sbyor ba khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mi 'gyu/rder rdorje'i dbyings chen po/ /sgyu 'chi phrul rdo rje gsus po che/ khros shing rab tres cher 'khrugs nga// /'jigs byed 'jigs par byed la 'dud/ /yam/ 'a ga dgu yis chos ston zhal/ /stong nying bcu drug zhabs kyis ro' / /byang chub sbyogs/ chos sobazhi'i phyag /sgrib bral gcer bu khyod phyag 'tshal/ kham/sa ga sdo/rdem dbang phyug ma he'i 'a(ra// /bden gnyis rwa yis phyogs ku/ na gnon/ /sgo chags /krag 'dzag srin po'i zhal/ /rab zhi gzho/na nu'i zhal la 'du/da/ /sko sna gyur meng gzigs phyir byis nga/'i rgyan/ /mngon byang zur phud lnga yi thod/ /kun tu dus sa su ra/ci gzigs nga/'i zhal/ /ljags bskyong rdo rje'i dag la 'dud/ /srid nga/ gsum 'jo gru ri/sa gar gyis/ ro'// /zhi ba'i mtha sna ga chon dbu skyes 'bar/ /nyuphaṭa sgra yis ma rungs skrag /sa sus 'phya/nga gtum/ ngo rmo'i sku la (sna dud/ /thong/ pa/ 'i cod pan ye shes lnga/ /rma/go'aphreng rdo rje yi sge'i dngos/ /rngam ྅ 'i rigs kyi phyas rgya bzhi/ /dzil rgyan tshangs phya ra thogs la 'dud/ /ma/ rig gcod phyir gyi gug ste/ /bi dhi nga/ snyoms rnam rdos gcod/ /dran pa nyams 'joms gtun/rde shing 'phyar/ /chu gris srid nga/ gcod la 'dud/ /sgo gsum mnyes sel ka na ya/ /sta re bag chags sra ba gcod/ /lta ngan 'bigs nga/'i mdung ring po/ /mda' chen glongs mthar byed la 'dud/ /dbang ga sto gas kyu cher 'bar zhing / /dbyug tos 'a/sa kyi sgrib ji/ 'jo gru/sa/ la — 325 —

sgrog——— na ba— — spo chag—— spo tho rderderderde—pha— spo—spo— —tho rderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderdernatho— rderderderderde tho sto thong brdeṭā byang chub sem/sa rang ri bzhin/ /'bor los shes sgrib gcod la 'dung/ /roche/nyar/ ye she/sa rdo rje gsor/ /thobs ser sna phye gru/ra brlag /dngos grub brgyad sder ral gri phror/ /cang te'u ma/chog sgra sgrag la 'dud/ /brag chen thod pa dam tshig skyong / /sgrib kun bcad pa'i ra pa byung mgo /bdud kyi g.yul las rnam rgyal phub/ /kang bas rma chog sa/nas srol la 'dud/ /dngos kun ye shes zhags nga sa sko sna chang / /'jis rten gsum rgyal gas thabs can/ /sto nga nyid sor rtog rgyu rma ste/ /shes rab dri' bu 'a tre gel la 'dud/ /'phrin las kun 'ji/pe lag pa gdangs/ / bang ga me/da dur khrong bor ba'i ras/ /stong nyid rtogs pa/'i gsal thang dang / /'od gsal dre/ thab 'bar la 'du do/ /thod tshal snying brtse bdud rtsis brlan/ /bdud la cher sdas sa 'tshi mo bsgrengs/ /sku ban sum ro gcig rtse gsum 8ri phen/ /sgyu 'phrul rlung ras/ lkor la 8sna dud/ /bde chen ling ga rgyas nga/'i tshul/ //gti mug glang chen lpags rlon ye gya'/ /brkyang bskum/ gar gyi 'ang/chen ngo/sa/ /snye sna chen bgegs bcas gnon la 'dud/ /spya na ni nyi shu rtsa bdun dmar/ /ljas na/ 'gril zhal nas ha har nga/zhad/ /rme/cha myo ngang dpe byang/ yang dag lda na/ /'jigs mdzad sku la phyas/ 'tshal bstod/ /dngos grub brgyad ngo stsol rderderderderde ba dang / /gdon dang nang kun 'joms mdzad cing / /snga pab thams cad bol/ ba go /ro'/ngas brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ tsā/yi ge rnams las yang dag byung//sna tshogs mtshon cha'i dra ba dkrigs/ /mtshan ma'i lha rnams tham/sa cad la/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'kho(ji ba rnam shes brgyad dag pa/ /dur khrod gnas pa'i skur ston cang/ /sgrub la dngos grub kun stsol/rderderderderde ba/ /'khorang 326 —

bcas de la'ang phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byang chub phyogs chos gzhal med khang //bka' yi 'khor los bdud bzhi 'joms/ /rnam dag rten gyi dkul la bor snyel//bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dge ba yis/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam 'gro ba rnams/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang la/ /bde ba'i lam gyis 'god par shog /de ltar bstod pas ha ha hi hi hu hū ཾ he he zhes bzhad pa brgyad kyi gar mdzad par mos/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi sgo nas yongs su zhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor ra gyi gtso bor zhal du 'al bstan pa'i mdun gyi re mig gi gnas la 'kho7da par gyur/ ces pa'am/ yang na/ dbus kyi re mig gi gnas la/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun du la bod nga/ra sne/mas/ kyang rung ba las phyi ma pos legs so/ /'di la 'grel pa skor gsum/ sogs rwa lugs dang skyo lugs kyi yi ge spyi khyab rnams las/ lho'i re mig gi lag pa'i steng du bsgom zhes 'chad cing / 'jig rten gyi phyogs dang dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mthun par mdzad nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs kyang bcu gsum pa ltar na/ phra ma gshi/na rje gshe/da bzhugs phyogs sam/ gzhan la lho'i re mig phyag mtshan lag pa yod pa'i phyogs su/ /gtso bo'i zhal gzigs par bsha/da de man ngag gab pa'am/ snying gi slob ma ma yin pa la 'dra min mgo skor gyi bsha/da pa yam tsam yin/ des myo don nges pa can ni las dang dngos grub gang yang gtso bo nyid kyi stobs las 'khru/ba pa'i phyir/ gtso bo zhal gzigs phyogs dang / phyi (sna jig rten gyi phyogs bstun pas chog gi /gzhal yas /spang gi phyogs nges pa dang bstun mi dgos pas/ 'dir gtso bo 'jig rten lho phyogs la mngon du phyogs pa'i phyir/dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs 'jig rten pa'i lho la ston to/ /des na gzhal yas khang ni gtso bo'i rjes su 'brang gi /gtso bo ni gzhal yas khang gi rjes su mi 'brang ngo / /'dir drag po'i las la — 327 —

'jig rten lho phyogs su lta ba bzhin du/ rtsa ba'i sgrub pa la yang lhor blta ba yin pas rgyud 'dir phyogs kyi gtso bo lho phyogs yin par shes par bya'o/ /des na 'jig rten lho la dkyil 'khor gyi shar bstan pas gtso bo'i zhal shar gyi ma/go bo la bstan pa'o/ /las so so'i don du ni shar dkar/lho nag /nub dmar / byang ser du byas nas/ zhi ba la shar dang / rgyas pa la byang dang / dbang la nub ste 'jig rten gyi phyogs de dang de la gtso bo'i zhal bstan kyang legs la/ yang rtsa ba'i sgrub pa dang / mchog sgrub la lhor bstan pas 'gru/rdeb pa bzhin du las de dag kyang lho phyogs su blta bas mi 'khru/rdeb pa ma yin no/ /drus pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'dre/ra la/ dngos dang rjes kyi bya ba gnyis las dang po ni/ mdun bskyed gces bo'i thugs kar sgom/ stabs bde na/ rgyu'i 'jam dpal bsgom/sa nas/de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i tshul du sngags 'kho1ra bsgoms/ de lta bu dmigs pa mi gsal na/ 'jam dpal zhub las sngags 'khor ra du bsgoms te/ de la sngags 'khor ni/ rdorje nag po rtse dgu pa'am/ rtse lnga nga/ rwa gdengs pa/ khong stong duganas pa/ lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng dud bus su hu/ mtha' skor dung/nga por ya mun+ta ka dpa/ de'i phyi skor la snying po dang / de'i phyi skor la rtsa sngas sa rnams spyi dang mtshungs pa bskor zhing 'od 'bar ba zhig gsal btab/rang ga snying gar yang de 'dra ba bsgom/ de la sgrub pa'i skabs 'di dag tu thog mar nye snying dang / bar du snya pa po dang / mthar rtsa sngags bzla/ bzlas pa'i gtso bo snying po yi ge bcu pa yin/rgyud kyi rgyal po nyid las kyang / mnyam par ba 'ag pas yi ge bcu pa'i sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas kyang mtshon no/ /mos pa'i dbang gis nye snying gtso bor bzlas kyang rung rdeb tsam yin te/'jig rten 'das pa kho na gtso bor gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /drag las sgos kyis sgrub pa yin na/ rtsa — 328 —

sngags bzlas/ pa'ang gtso bor byed dgos la/ mchog sgrub pa'am/ ri sdu ba'i sgrub pa'i skabs 'dir/thun gyi 'jug tu zhor bzlas kyi tshul ji ltar 'os pa re bzla'o/ /gang ltar yang dang por nye snying bzla ba na/ gzhan gnyis po blos dor te/ nye snying las tsha zer 'phros/ rdo rje'i rwa gseb nas ya ra me lce ltar 'ur gyis 'bar/ rtsa zhal nas 'thon pa na/ 'od zer gyi thag pa zing zing ba mang po'i gseb na/ sngags 'bru sgra dang bcas shing me stag 'bar bas khengs pa phar spros te/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyal 'khor gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i rdo rje'i rwa myong nas zhugs/ hū ཾ yig nye snying gi sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas sngags 'bru rnams 'od du 'bar zhing / gtso bo'i sku la stobs dang bde ba rgyas/ thugs mchog tu mnyes par gyur/ yang gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon nye snying dang bcas pa 'a/sa/ phar spros pa kho na 'dra ba'i 'od zer sngags 'bru/ dang bcas pa rnams byung / bdag nyid kya tsho ma he'i zhal nas zhugs te/ snying ga'i sa bon nye snying dang bcas pa 'a/ thim pas/ yig 'bru 'od du 'bar/ bdag bskyed kyi lha stobs dang bde ba dang dga' ba rgyas par bsam/dmigs pa myur bul gyi dbye bas/ de lta bu lan gsum dang lnga sogs ji ltar 'os pa song ba na/rang gi zhal nas spros te mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar thim pa yang rgyun mi 'chad par 'jug cing / mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dang / sngags 'phreng 'og tu 'phros/ lte ba nas 'thon/ rang gi lte ba nas zhugs/rang gi snying ga'i rdo rje'i 'og rwa nas brgyud de sngags 'khor la thim par mos la/sngags brgya'am stong sogs bzlas/ yang de go spos te/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dang sngags 'phreng 'og tu 'phros lhe ba nas 'thon/ mdun bskyed kyi lte bar — 329 —

zhugs/ thugs ka'i sngags 'khore la thim pa rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / ya nga mdun gyi sngags 'khor las 'od dang sngags 'phreng byung / mdun bskyed kyi ma he'i zhal nas 'thon/ rang gi rtsa zhal du zhugs nas snying ga'i sngags 'khor la thim pa'ang rgyun mi 'chad par bsams shing / sngags brgya'am stong sogs bzla'o/ /'dir sngags kyi thag pa bzhi sbrag ces zer zhing / phar 'khor tshur 'khor gnyis kar dus mnyam du byed par 'dod pa zhig yod de/ sgom tshul mi bde bas lag len du mi mdzad do/ /bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa mchog sgrub tu byas pas phyis las tshogs thogs med du 'grub pa yin/ bsnyen pa'i dus nas dgra bsad kyi dmigs pa ga byed pa ni rang bsam pa ngan pa kho nar zad do/ /de nas snying po bzla bar 'dod na/dmigs pa ga 'an rnams de kho na dang 'dra ba las/ sngar nye snying gi sngags 'phreng de snying pho la thim/rnam pa snying po kho na la/ ngo bo snying po dang nye snying gnyis ka yin par mos dgos pa ni khyad par ro/ /rtsa sngags bzla tshul yang phal cher de dang 'dra ste/ dang por snying po'i sngags 'phreng rnams yi ge so gnyis pa la thim/ rnam pa rtsa sngags la rang bzhin sngags gsum char gyi gzhi mthun par mos nas bzlas pa byed dgos pa las/ rtsa sngags 'di 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sngags ltar bzla na/ de phyin chad kyi dmigs pa ni snga ma rnams dang 'dra/ 'jig rten pa ltar bzla na/ bdag dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ 'jig rten dregs pa thams cad kyi snying ga nas/ yig 'khru so gnyis bkug /bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i sngags 'khru rnams kyi zhabs nas thim/ 'o ma rnam par 'gyur ba zhor song ba bzhin du sngar sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi snying po kho na yin pa de/ da ni 'jig rten dregs pa rnams kyi srog gi snying por yang song bgo /snyam du mos/ thugs ka'i hu las thig le dmar tsher pa —330—

re spros te/ yi ge rnams kyi mgol thim pas/ dregs pa thams cad kyi srog dbang du/'dogs par bsam/ de nas dmigs pa/ ga 'an tham sa cad 'dra ba las/ rtsa zhal nas 'gro 'ong mi byed/ rang nyid kyi steng zhal dam/ra po'i zha'/ gyi sgo nas 'thon/ mdun bskyed kyi ste pa zhal du yas nga dang / tshur 'ong ba'i tshe yang de dang 'dra ste/ 'di tsam/ khyad par ro/ /de yang nye snying sto nga tsam/ song na/ hru sgyi lnga stong tsa myo4/ ya ma/ rā dza/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i tshul brgya dang 'jig rten pa'i lu gas brgya/ yongs/ dri' nyis brgya bzla ba lnga bus ma/tshon te/mang nyung de'i rig pas dpyad/ spyir ni sngags gsum po gang rung gcag kho nas kyang 'gru ba pa yi 6 mod/ lag len gyi rgyun la gsum kar bzla ba yin/ snying po la yang 'jis rtser 'angs ma/ snangs kyi lugs gnyis ka sbyor du rung rdeb cig dang snye snyi nga la yang de 'dra gcig go babs la yo nga rnge nga kung /phyag len la ni mi mdzad de/ nye snying dang yi ge bcu pa 'di dag 'jig rten 'das pa kho 'a pyas dra sa byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che zhing bkra shis la/ rtsa sngags la gnyis kar byas nga/sa 'a sa myur ba yin/sngags gsum kar la 'das ma 'das gnyis ka'i bzlas pa byas na/ 'jig rten pas shed byer ba'i rnam par song nas rtsub cing bkra mi shis par 'gro nyen yod gsungs/ yang de dag la man ngag gi gnad gal chen gcig ni/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i sngags bzla lugs kun (pa/ sngags dang ce(da zer las mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul te/ bdag mdun gyi lha dang / thugs ka'i sngags 'dra/rde la mchod par bsam/ sngags rnams zhal dang lte ba nas 'bor ba'i skabs/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas mchod sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'du/sa te thim par bsam dgos/ 'jig rten pa'i skabs/ 'od zer gyi rtse mo las bdud rtsi'i bum pa spros te/ dregs pa rnams kyi spyo bonas dbang bskur bas/ gnod sems zhi/ bde ba dang ldan par byas/ de rjes srog sngags bsdu — 331 —

— spo— 4 rde—spo — sprosposposgrospo—ga rderderderderdeb sogs byed pa gnad yin/ thud par sngags (bel dang lte ba nas 'khol ra ba'i skabs/ 'od zer dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa dang/ga tu meng/ nga/ spros/ 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang phyi ro'/ dres sa nga/ rnga/mas la phog pas/ bde ba thob cing dbang du bsdu sa/ 'od zer tshur bsdu ba'i dmi gas pa byed pa'ang gnad gcig go /rma/chog sgrub la 'bor gye bzlas nga med kyang chog cho da de/ phra mo las tshogs/ sgrub pa ‘ra 'khodzo ra gyi sngags kyang bzlas zho bzang bas / o ā②bha nyuphaṭa/ slo/ hra hra hu hruphaṭa phoṭa/ ces pa shar gyi ro langs dang /de bawo du/ o ā bhi hūṃ phaṭa/ o rdzu hro hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ lho phyogs dang / bhu nub phyogs dang / bhi byang phyo sa ru ngang / oṃ ā bho hu phaṭa hṝ hā/ shar lho dang / yang de bal du/ sto lto nung ngang/ s+ho sgyu byang dang / lko ā bha hū phaṭa hṝ hā/ byang shar gyi ro langs kyi sngags so/ /de pa/3ra du / gdan ro langs ma rnam/sa/ kyi sngags rbi/ o hṝ hā pho shrī phaṭa spru hā/ zhes pa kho na bzla sde/ de rmams thams cad la bdag bskyed dpa/ gtso po gnyis kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng rnams zhub las/ 'kho(ra de dang de dag gi sngags su gyur/gang la bzla ba'i 'khor de nyid kyi thugs kar yang nyi ma la bhe/ de'i mtha' skor du rang sngags kyi bskor ba bsgoms nas/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud bskul/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung / ro langs kyi thugs kar zhugs/sngags rnams la phog nga/sa bde ba thob cing dgyes par bsam/ yang de'i thugs ka nas sngags 'phreng byung / rang nyid kyi lte ba nas zhugs/ snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ dkyus su bshad pa 'di ro langs brgyad kar las kyi 'jigs byed pho brgyad mo brgyad du sgrub pa'i lugs yin/ gzhan ba/:rken rje pho mor sgrub pa dang / srin po pho mor sgrub pa dang /— 332 —

— dzi spo rna rde—lte spo rde— tsho spo sterderderde —ri rderde— spo rgya zhe rngo spo co spo chi spo rde —4— spo ring — rderde— sde tho d+kurderderderde—dbang phyus pho mor sgrub pa dang / srin ngo/ dang 'a sa kyi zug rejags byeng 'dus nga/ che/bon po rag jo/ra sngub pa'i lugs kyang yod de/ sgrub pa sa cag thi du rnga snga sgrub lugs so so'i 0zlas pa ga spyo sa pyed du rngi dra5sde la/ dus skabs so sor dkyil 'khe/ra 'o gas nga/ re bzhengs na sprub chul mi 'dra ba rngo so tham sa cad kyang gang zag sa cag gis sgrub tā ni rung ngo / /de lta ra na yang / rang bi skal ba rang gang 'tsham pa gcig te se rden bla ra 'am lngas pa'i chi sna la lung bstan the rte bsgrubs na legs so/ /8sprustorasgrub tshul mi 'dra ba de rnams ru pas don gyi katso ngo ni las kyi 'jas ru byeng pho mor sgru ba nga yi rme skro /rang lugs kyi sngags pa bong ma gru/nga po yang sgrub tshul tha dad nga dka pa' cher/ tshar re che ring nga nga sgyu ri srol yod de/ blo sna mangs la lang jo snyam/ cho da dwags le phyo mi nga pa'i nga thos pa ni yo da ngo/ /sto 5ngagar+sha/na rjer sgrub pa ngang / srin ngo ngang / dbang phyu pa/ ngang / gru gor por sgru rngo dzā/ rnga cho sa 'a sa ra pa ngang gi slos bsnyen re sngon du btang na les dra ༈ las hūṃ /rirnga pa rkang bye se brgya nga spyi ba pa rmi na/ sa sdu gro botse'i bsnyem pa song bas chog go gsu ngas/ ya nga sde rjes snangs ‘snang zi cho sa nga ra ‘ri ga tā ngas|tsha hwa gyu rayin yang / yig chung zur na yod nga/ ltar / skye si rtse na khug ngang / ngab/za dhu sa char ngo ngang / ri/ru kyi po khrigan rje ha la nag po dang / lha mo ye ma keg dang / sre tse ngo/ jo/ mo rmer/mu ci kyi nga zlas pa yang 4cha glo'u sgru no rtsebyed pa'i srol yod 'a// mthar surnya 'a sngags kyas/ bas po sa bstang sde/ gtso gro snye gra stu be brgya nga/ bdun dang / 'kho ra rngams 'a/ pan re ci rbo gru bzur pa/sa brngan pa/ra bya'o /gnyis pa bzlas nga/'i rjes kyi bya ba chi mchang sa ter te sde 4 nga ar+ghaṃ sogs rnyi che ched ngang 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod dang / hū ཾ / dur /brong rgyan so/gas kyis nga stong nas/ sa par cheg nga kyus kyi sngon du 'jam dpal rdo rje'i 'jags byed kyi sgo dra chos lha bshos kyi sa tar ma/ tshen rngo ‘2bur bar bya ste/ sde yang rgyud las/ mi la sogs pa bcu sa cas dang rdo bya rgong/ sogs la bcu gcis yong rmo da kyi/ lag len du zhabs 'og gi sros gzugs da ngos dang rma/sbin pa/ra: brgyang tshan sa zhes ༷tre myo ma rdzang — 333 —

—sgo rgya spong —spro tho— — ngo /sro 7 chags rnams kyi sha khrag rur pa bsres pa'i gzugs brnyan bya bar bzhed 'e bya chen po la sra/zho byang ma —/hral ba'o/ /rde das/ ma rnyed na bag zan btsos nga dang sha khrag bsreg shing srog chags de dang de'i ngo bor cho/sa / 'jig rten gyi phyo/gas/ dang bstum bes / shar du ce spyang lho ra ma hre/ /nub tu khyi sde ngong bu byang / shar rnyo ra lug dang srin por mi/ /rlung du rnga mo byang shar glang / /de dag re re yi sa yo na du/ /bya rgod shar dang 'ug pa/ lco/ /bya ro po/ nub dang khra ni byang / /re tso dbang ldan 'ol ba ni / rdo /jo nub ri skeg bzhad bkar rlung / 'es pa ru snar/ tham/sa cad ༄ nang du bltas te 'god pa bya 'a// nyen re bzhin na rma // thun re paṇa nan gzugs/ brnyan gsar pa tshar re 'bul ba yin na/ de dag bo nas/ chog gzhan ling ga mi dgros la/ sgru ba ri 'i dang por lan cig rnga po / mas pa de nyid thun re3ma/ na phyo/ rer mtheb kyu pra mos kha sa so ba tsam4 (pas mi byed myo/ 'dra/ba khung gcig tu li nga ga chung nga— sa cag kyang bsham/ mo༈ ༈sde tha bye nu 5nga gu gu ra gyis ba/dugs / nang ma/chod dang rak+tas/ bsangs/swa bhā snye was sbyang po// stong pa'i ngang snyo pas/ tse du yig rnams las byung pa'i hre(ga gzus/sa rnams phung po /༄ma tra/ dang skye mched ye yang tra/ su rdzogs pa/ nga/ma tshis gi snye2sto spyo da ma tshang ba med nga/ra gyur / nam mkha' ma/dzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgya lan gsum sogs kyi byan gyis nga rlabs/ re re 'a/ dmi gas myo ba 'bar ba'i sngags lan gsum/ gsum mdzad ri 'i rnge/la ya nga yod/ rkang ba'i brgyad ngo rnams rang sa zhan sems can thams cad kyi nyon ce|ngas brgyad dpa/ 'dabs chags brgyad pa rla/mas sdig pa'i las brgyad du mos / de la nyon mongs pa brgyad ni/ dug lnga lta ba the tshom g.yo sgyu'o/ /mi nga/ge ba brgyang ni/ mi dbe bcu las/ 'o(ga lta nyon mongs kyi sdebs la songs/brnab sems gces da sems gcig tu stso / mas pa'o/ /de ltar mos nas/ myos ā hu lan 'ga' re brjod/ de nas dgug gzhug1 bya ste/ na dru1rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas — 334 —

—snye——— khro—— ———pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / phyo gas bcu dus/ gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / lung dang rtogs nga sa bsdus pa dam pa'i chos rnams kyi tsha theg pa gsum la gnas pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi: yi dam dkyi snye pa 'khe(ra kyi lha rnams kyi: de bzhin bshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / la sa kyi rigs su zhugs nga/'i lha tshogs rnams kyi: snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang/ rigs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi: dus gsum kyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i khro rgyal chen po yon rje gshed ngo/'i lha tshogs rnams kyi: bka' sdod phyag brnyan dam can bsrung ma'i tshogs kyi: chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab 'a pa' kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i rnal 'ebyo ra pa bdag cag gi sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang / bden pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs kyas spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jig par byed pa/ sems can yongs la ga mod cing 'tshe ba/ mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med pa lnga la sogs nga sdig pa'i las la rtag tu spyod pa/ dkon mchog gsum la brnyas shing mtho 'tsham pa gru/ri rungs pa tham/sa cad dang / khyad par rnal 'dre1ra sgrub pa po bdag la zhes pa lta bu skabs su gang babs kyis mtshams sbyar nas/ dngos dang brgyud nga/'i sgo nas gnod par byed pa'i snga dgra lag la bdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da lta mngon du gyur pa'i las ngan gyi dgra bgegs/ dngos grub dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / bsam pa la bar du gcod par byed pa dang / thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pa la — 335 —

dhu/— ge ge lte ge ye stod dod dge zhen par sbub par byed pa dang/ tshe dang/ wor pa dang༄/ do bang phyug dang /bde ba dam pa la mi mthun par rtsom pa/ mdor na chos dang / 'byor pa'am/phan nga/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa 'a/ bar du gcod nga/ra byed pa gang yin pa de nga/sa tham/sa cad dang / gzhen yang phyogs bcu rab 'byams na gnas pa/ 'gro ba drug na gnas nga/'i sems can ma/ lus pa'i las ngan pa dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad sa nod byed gdug pa can gyi gzugs su bsgyur te/ de dag thams car zhags pas bcings/ lcas/sa kyus drangs/ thabs sna tshogs pas rab tu bsdi gas te skad cig /thang cig /yud tsam/ 'di nyid la gzugs brnyan 'di rngam/tre/ la mi 'tshor bar phob cig /hruXgaX'i ma/thar/ sarba pā paX na basnrun shā chus a kar+ṣa ya dzaXdzaX ṇi yaX dzaX tri yaX dzaX oṃ badz+ra aX gu sha jaX oX badz+ra pa sha hūX/ oX badz+ra spo ṭa baX/ oX badz+ra a be sha a/ zhes nga/ lan gsum dang / hruXsnriX'i ma/thar/ sdang ba dang gdug pa thams cad a kar+ṣa ya jaX zhes spel ba nyer gcig nas / brgya'i bar ji 3 ra 'os pa/ bzlas ngas dgug gzhus bya'o/ /de 'dra lan gsum byed/ khams gsum gyi nyon mongs/ nga/ ngang sdig nga/ rnam sa/ dgra bgegs kya mo rngam/ par bkug nas/ byol song bcu drus la bsti rme/ pa'i dmigs pa bya/ de rjes thun re'am zhag rer srog gzugs rnam/sa brje zhing 'bu/la na/ srog gzugs bcu drug po sgrol/ sgrub pa 'i 'go gzhug la/ kha gso/ ba rma/ gtogs sro ga sa zugs tshar gcig po des skyong na/ phur bu dang ngal gri thogs myos/ srog gzugs rnam/sa/ la brjeg pa'i tshul tsam byas nas / lung chung de la dngos su brtab ste bsgral lo/ /spros pa byed na phya ga mchan cho yang ri de bas te bzlas ngu/ ‘pa g.yel bar 'gro bas mi bya la/ phur bu ni spyi mthun yongs su grags pa lta ྈ yo/da 'e legs rmo da kyang / ma 'byor na lcags sam/ rus pa'am/ tsher ma/ —336—

can gyi shing la mgo bor 'dzin yod pa/ gzer bu'i rna gru/ pas kyangs zhing/ lab ye lang bas rkye —rung gsungs/ gang ltar ya nga bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phaṭa yi ga pas byung ba'i phur bu dang / huX yig las byung ba'i ral grir gyur/ oṃ hru paXzhuXbi kri tā na na sarba pā paX shā krus bisnrun gī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun bzlas te phur bus snying sar btab/ ya/nga oX hṝXsgyiXbi kri tā na na sarba rī/ paṃ// sarba shwa krus bisnrun mā ra ya ru/ ra ya thiX pho ṭa/lan bdun bzlas pa/'i mthar/ sngags de nyid bzla bzhin du thog ma/ra gzugs brnyan gyi mgri' pa nas bcad sde/ ra/thar dum/ bu mang por gtubs// nge rngams snrod gcig tu sbungs la/ ra lngas trung zang bran te/ stegs bu'i steng du bzhag /spro sa pa la mos na/ lha thar/sa cad kyi 'al/ sdo 'debs/ pa'i chig byang yang brjod/ bsdu na yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ badz+ra bhi ra ba a ti pa ti i daX ba ling la kha khwa hi ji hi riX hūX phaṭa/ ces dkyus la brgya rtsa sogs ngang las yin na la sa kyi grangs dang mthun par phul/ rje'i rjes su sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ gtor ma byin rlabs nas brtsa rma sa te/ gtor 'bul rgyas par bya'o/ /bdun pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ thun gyi rjes/ chog dang / nga ku pa/ 'bor snyer bsdu gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mchod pa gsar ba bshams shing / rnying nga dru5/sa ba gso/ byin rlabs bsdus pa gong bzhan bya/ ar+ghaX nas/ 'a lnga' bar gyis pyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa mdor bsdus rnam/sa byas la/bcom ldan 'ang/sa dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi ru dkun pa 'khor chen po'i lha phyugos rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'a/bor dang bcas pa thams cad bdag (pa nga bongs/ su sa so la/ bdag cag rnams kyi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang / 'dra/la gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad dang gdon dang bar chad tham4 / cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang / dpal/ dang —337—

———rde'abyor nga/ thams cad gong nas gong du 'phal zhing rgyas par mdzad dug sol/dbang phyug dam pa phun sum tshogs pas da tshe 'dra / ba thams cad byang chub la yang das nga ra gzhug pa dang / sdang ba dang gdug pa'i sems can zhi bas mi 'dul ba hrar/sa drag po'i 'phrin las kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ bdas dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub dam pa ma 'u/sa nga/ stsa'/rde du gsol/ byang chub kyi phya po/sa kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs su rdzogs pa dang/ pha rol tu phyin nga/ drug ga rang bzhin rnam/ nga ra dkar ba'i la ma rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/sa che/sa can thams cad kyi bdud dang nyon mongs ci rtsa ba dang dri mar bcas nga/ tha che4sa dud chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du gzhom par mdzad du gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ra rdzogasu 'phang theg nga ba/de ba nga/nga / lam/ bde ba dang / 'ja / ka nga/ bde bas thob par mdzad du gsol/ji sri da go 'pha nga rma chog de nyid ma thob nga/'i bar du yang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten la sa 'angs nga/'i phun sum/ tshogs nga/ thams cad thob par mdzad du gso'//zhes pa la/ so/gas pas gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bstang / ma ‘rngon byar pa ngang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis rbi// /bgyas nga/ dang ni bgyis stsal ba/ /sde yang mgon pas bzod par gru ri/dzod/ /gang yang bangs blo rngo/ngas nga/ yis/ /nyes bya cung zad sang bgyis nga// /gang phyir lus rbon skyabs yin phyir /mgon khyod de kun bzod par rme dzod/ /ma rted 3dzi/ngas/ su ra ri shes dang / /gang yang nus ga pa rme mchis nga sa/ /'dir chi bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun gtso bos bzod mdzang rigs/ /dkyil 'khror dang rten la sgrub pa ma thon bar daru rtag 338 —

pa'i brtan bzhugs bya/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub sngo/rde/ /sangs rgyas yul dub/'e/gas nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon nga/ra mdzad du gsol/ /ces pa'am/ bdag la dngos grub mchog ba3lnga'o4 lags/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu lci sko5rde/ /sems can kun la ci 'dod par/ /dngos grub bla na med pa'ang bstsal// /slar yang gshe/gas par mdzad pa'i phyir/ /rang gi gnas sa shegs badz+ra mu /zhes gtor mgron rnams spru/ḍā/gas/ yang gong ma 'ga' zhig ni dam can rnams ga kho/gas su ma sa so la bar dpang boratshobazhag kyang legs zer ba'ang snang ngo / /de rjes bdag ngang dkya' / 'kho1ra la srung bo ngang / smon lam dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brten no/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'a shen ra nyer bsdu ni/ sgrub pa thon pa'i skabs dgos pa yin te phal cher bshad rma thag pa'i rjes chog dang 'dra yang khyad par phra mo rnams dbang chog tu bsha/da pa bzhin te/'on kyang rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren mi mdzad go /de snye rte ra na skabs/ 'dir bkra shis yan chang—bya ste/ thun dang po'i cho ga'o/ /thun phyi ma rnams la/ bang ga bskyed rgyas par ma 'gru/ba kyang rung ste/ rang skad cig gis 'jigs mdzad chen po'i skur gas la bta0/ sngags gsum ngo gang 'os re bzlas nas rma dun bskyed kyi cho ga 'a 'jug pa sogs gzhen rnams 'dra blo/ /snyer sgrub kyi skabs 'dir/ sbyar sreg ji lngar 'os pa bsgrubs te/ rab tu nyin re 0'chi'am sbyin sreg lan re bya na/ thun ngang po 'arma gnyir pa mis sum rnga/'i 'jug gi thun mar sa gcig la bya/ thum tha gru/'i 'jug pa phyi ro' po/tor ma'i chul du sgrub bza gi sgo phyir drug cu rtsa bzhi re 'bul/ cang te'u snyen bro 'a/ zhing nang du 'ong ru༈ nas/ sngags gsum gyi mthar/ha ha hi hi he he ho ho zhes bzhad pa brgyang kyi nga ro dang bcas nas smor ba byed — 339 —

—snye——rdecing dkyil 'khel ra du zhugs par mos te/ de nas rjes chog rnams bya'o/ / 'bring du na/ zla ba drug lta bul yar sngo ma/ra ngo gnyis ka'i brgyad dang bcu dang bco lnga la sogs par sbyin sreg re bya la/ tha mas kyang thog ma/tha' bar gsum du sbyin sreg bya'o/ /gtor ma ni rab thun bzhi/ 'bring thun sa nyis/ tha ma srod dam nam phyed la re re'o gsung ste lha khu sho sa kyi dbang du byas pa yi na gtor chog dkyus de thun re bzhin dbos so /de ltar na bla ma gong ma rnams tshul snad la bsnyen sgrub sgrags ma/ zhes tha snyad sbyor la/ spyir 'di la nye bsnyen dang / nye sgrub ces bsnyen rnga/ che shos ngang / skrub nga chu nga nga/'e don yin pas/ bsnyen pa dang / sgrub pa gnyis ka'i cha 'dzin pa yi na no/ /‘sprug 'a zhis sgrub bsnyen 'es pa'i tha slang byed pa yod pa'ang 'di snyel zer na ni 'gal ba med kyi/ byi ru/ byung gi sgrub thabs bzhad sgra zer ba gcig na/ rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa'i skabs/ mdun na rten gang yang meng pa la/ skad cig gis lha mdun du spyan drangs nas/ dgra bsad kyi dmigs par rlom pa 'dra byed nga/ de la sgrub bsnyen zer zhing / rtsub ngo yod rdo drag la myur ba yin no/ /zhes smra ba ni man ngag med kyang / man ngag yod par rdzu ba ste skyo lugs kyi sgrub thabs cig mi/ga zur la thogs pas// de dang 'dra min byas par sna nga mod/ rtsub cing myur la re yang / ngal ba 'bras bu med par zad do/ /'a/ra yang yon tan gzhan re/da na rtsu ba nga bo na dgos nga cig yod/ de pasang gi sngags nga/ sgru/la che bas sgrub pa'i 'dra 'bag tsam rma sa/tags// sgrub rnga/ dngos las len du thebs nga/ra dka' rngo ri phyir/ deng song thi sgrub pa cal ga len du /3deb/sa rgyu la bsnyen sgrub ma 'ang 'a gal che shos yin sgo/ /de nas sgru0 pa dngos kyang pha'/ cher nge dang 'dra ba 'a sa/ 'dra 'bag lam du byed na/da rma gas nga 'i khyang nga ra smu/dun bskyeng kyi bzlas rnga 'i gong du bdag mdun bsres te/ bzlas pa'i skabs/ rang yi/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod de byin rlabs bsdu —)4() —

—— —ga spo ba nyid gtso bo yin la / yang rang nyid thugs ka nas phyir byung / khyad par gyi bsgo/rdes gtsang 'bul ba zhes pa lha bsgyu/rdes kyi gtor ma ma myo/ chad bya'o/ /rab tu thun bzhi'i thun mtsham/sa thams cad 'a sbyin sreg dang byi rol gtor ma gnyas ka 'chag med du bya/ rang gis rma lcogs shing grogs rnam dag cig yod na grogs kyis byas kyang rung rde/ ma tha yang 'ag re'i thun rma/tshams gang yang rung ba cig la/sbyin sreg lan re ni 'chag med dudagos / yo byad ye ma 'dzom zhing dmigs pa gsal na/ rdzas kyi spyin sreg ji ltar 'os pa byed cing / ting nge 8snadzin gyi spyin sreg thun bzhir bya'o gsungs te dmigs pa gsal bo dkon/ 'di zla phyed sogs byed na sgrub pa dngos la gnyid spong dgos pa'i tshab/mtshan mo'i dus grogs kyis sngags thun bzung bas chog go /sgrub chen gyi (3dra snabs chi dud pa'am/ snod dge zhing shis pa gcig tu sha chen la sa r+sha/sa pa dam rdzas ji ltar 'os nga bzhag nga/‘snam 'i /nga zhun myo/ra ram/ gi ha la sogs pa bzhag kyang ngung / sde dkyil 'khor gyi re mig dbus ma'am ma dun mar bkod/ gzhan/ sgrub pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ skrub rdzas nge bsangs sbyangs snga gas gsum ka'am// gang rung cag gi yig 'bru/'i phung por mos/ bzlas pa'i skabs // sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas snga/gas 'bru rgyun mi 'chang/ nga/ra spu phyo drangs / rdzas la bstim ni/ nga / thun 'jog pa'i tshe bsrung ba bya/ nub snga ma rnams la rjes rmos bi skabs gso la/ ba drag tu 'debs shing / zhal gyis bzhes par bsam nga lha ga po yi/na gzhan 'dra'o/ nā ba tha ma/ myom pye/da ngam//tho rngongs kyi dus su/ thun gro' mtsham/sa kyi phyi rol gtor ma song nas/ nang du 'engs/ te dngos/ grub stso la ba/ra gsol ba drag hu btab pa na/ khyod dngos grub ci 'dod ces gsung krar bsams/ 'chi ba med pa rdorje'i sku thob nga ra 'gyur ba/ rdo rje tshe'i dngos grub bcud len gyi mchog stsal/ dug sol zhes pa lta bus gso pa ba btab nga/sa/ sngar gya sgrub rdzas nge nyid nger byin gyis brlabs te/ gtso bo'i phyag g.yon nga sa rang nyid la — 34/ —

bas skor/ bar bsam/ sgrub rdzas lag gnyis kyis blangs te/ yi ge 'dra / gsum brjod bzhin du/bla ma dang dkyil 'khore gyi lha tshogs dang / phud sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la yid kyis phul/ sems can thams cad kyi dngos grub 'di thob par gyur cig snyam du rang gis zos shing 'thungs pa/ dngos grub de thob par mos pa bya/de rjes slar yang sbyin sreg dang / nang gtor bsdus tsam re bya/ yang na sgrub rdzas logs nga mi byed par de'i don du dkyil chog las 'byu/nga ba ltar gyi bum sgrub byas nas sgrub rdzas 'jog sar bur/ pa bkod/ dngos gzhi'i skabs dmigs pa sogs 'dra/ skabs 'dir rdzas kyi dngos grub len pa'i tshab du / bdag 'ju ga gi sgo nas bum dbang yongs rdzogs sam/ chu dbang tsam blangs pas kyang /dgos don snga ma dang 'dra ba las shin tu byin rlabs che ba yin/ 'on kyang rdzas kyi sgrub pa'i lag len mi nub pa'i phyir/ lag len snga gru ri/ de yang nges par mdzad do/ /de rjes sngon bzhin rjes chog dang / dkyil 'bor gshe/gas gsol bya/ slar ya nga snyi ma gzhan la dkyil 'khe/ra gyi shul der/ sbyar sreg dang gtor ma dang tshos sa 'bor la so gas nga/ bya'o/ /sgrub pa sgrub chen 'ji dag 'dra 'bag tsam/ yin yang / mthu stobs nus pa dang / tshe dang longs spyod snye sna phel ba sogs/ bya'o rlabs kyi tshan ka chen po 'byung ngo / /gal te bsnye na sgrub bsgrags ma la/ yo byad sogs yem /'byor na/ rung ma/gas pas dkyil 'khor ba sbom/sa/ dngos su bris sku tsam la brten kyang rlob na go /zhes gsung ngo / /de rnge ra zho tshu' redi ni/ las mtha' dag la thun cho/nga du 'jug pa dang / ma chog sgrub bam dngos grub sgrub nga/'i don yi na/ 'di'i steng du drag la sa kyi khyad chos 'ga' zhig bsnan te/ bsnyen sgrub sbrags ra/ ngang sgrub pa 9 tsas sbyor sogs byed chul ni/ 'grel nga skor gsum dang / la ga le myo khras sa bkod sos sa na gas 'a ba ltar shes nga gos mod kyi/ dgra bsad tsam la dkyil la bor chen po bzhengs te/ ba lcem sgru ba sprags ma zla drug sogs phyed rin mi chog go /bsden sgrub sbrags ma/ dang / sgrub pa sgru ba chan gyi — 342 —

skabs 'di dag snye pag len ston byed dam/ 'dra 'bag tsam gyi skabs yin yang rung rde/ nyer sgrub dang sgrub pa dang sgrub chen gsum dkyil 'khore bzhengs theng gcig bi steng nas byed du mi rung ste/ cho ga tha dad yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas re re bzhin nga ku' 'khor snga ma snga ma slo/zhegs su gsol myos/ phyi ma phyi ma'i dkyil 'kho ra gsar du bzhengs dgos pa yin rno/ /dkyus thog cig la nga kyil 'khor bzhengs sa khang pa gcig tu byed pa yin myo/ sa chos gcis gi sa brdung bar kha cig re dong la/ (lag len du ni rang gi sem/sa kyi dri ma/ sbyong ba'i gnad dang / dgas ngon tha ngad yan nga 'i/ phyir/ re re bzhin sa chog byed dgos zhes gsung ba lngar ma/dzad do /'jir dngos su bsha0 pa/'i sgrub pa 'i zim pa 'di rmams mchog sgrub ces bya ba yin te/ de yang rgyung 'di'i lugs la mchos ces/ pa phyas rgya no char po mcheg gi nga ngos grub kho na la bo dgos pa ma yi na/ dngos grub spyi la zer ba yin/ rdog bdum gyi rtos pa dang po'i mchog ces/ pa'i dgongs pa'ang 'di bo 'e yan rno/ /thog ra/ dgra bsang lnga bu'i las snye tshe ba re la yid dga' drangs te bsnyen sgrub rngar/sa byas su zin kyang / ske bas der las rte cung zang 'a lnga/ba srid mod/ ji skad du/ lnga ni mnyes par ma byas na/ /bangs nyid rnam ri/ra sun 'thun ya myo/ /'es pa snye sdar yu la chung 'ing bku : shis la/ dngos grub kyi rten snye sna brel 'gris nga ra mi 3gyur ro/ /mchog sgru ba kyi ngo myo du/ rtsa ba'i bsnyen sgrub 'di mchod pa 'a brtson pa/ dang bcas pas sgrub ru/ na/ga'i nas lha mnyes nga/'i rten 'brel gyis/ phyis las gang la sbyar yang 'a sdo/la sla zhing / 'a/ru/ stobs che 'khu ldog sogs bkra mi shis pa mi 'byung kru / sgrub pa dngos rme yin sgrub pa/'i 'dra 'bas tsam yin du chug kyang / phyis dngos grub thob pa'i rten 'bre'/ 'grig cing / da lnga 'phral du'ang la sa thams cang pa'i cho ga bzang por 'gyur ro/ /rtsa ba'i sgrub nga 'di rnam sa 'them/sa nga/ra so nga na/ phyis la sa sgrub pa'i tshe/ sngon gyi yig rnying rnams las gsal ba ru sngar/ rdul tshon gyi nga kun ra 'a/cor rar / nge yang ma/ 'gru/ba na/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'bor la brten nas/ snye bsnyen ngang / sgrub nga 'a sa sbyer — 34—snye —

rnams / zhag bdun phrag sogs ji ltar 'os par kyang legs par 'khru/ba la/ dkyil 'khe/ra rgyas pa 'cha' mi 'thub na/ maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung ngam/ thang ga'i drung du sbyin sreg /gtor ma/ 'khrul 'khor rnams bsgrubs pas kyang legs par 'byung ngo / /sgrub pa'i skabs 'dir gong ma rnams kyi yi ge na/rtsa ba dang yan lag gi sgrub pa'am/ dngos grub dang las phyogs re'i sgrub pa zhes so sor phye ba gsal po mi 'dug pas/ dbye ba 'di ltar byed pa mi rung ngo snyam pa'i log rtog gam/ yang na dbye ba 'di dgos phyin snga ma rnams kyis ma rga zhing nor nga'o snyam pa'i log rtog 'byung srid na/ de ni gnyis ka gru/ yin te/ dbye ba byed pa ri/ gtso bor rtog bdun nyid dang / gzhan yang bskyed rim gtso bor ston rnga /'i rgyud rnams kyi spyi'i dgongs pa yin zhing / yang sgos su bla ma dam pa'i man ngag zhal rgyun rgyud dang 'gre' pa la 'dzug tshugs su ngo sprod pa'i srol ka ma nyams/ pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'khrul pa dang 'dzol so ye med pa la/ byin rlabs dang / nus pa yong 'phro rgyun ma chad nga 'i nyams myong gis grub pa yin no/ /yig rnying byed pa po rnams kyis kyang ma go ba ta ma yin/ skye bo blo dman pa drag las kho na la sem/sa shor ba rnams kyi ngor/ dgra bsad 'ba' zhig la sbyar ba ltar byas nas de'i khog nas mchog sgrub 'don rgyu yin zhing / de bla ma'i zhal 'khrid la brten nas sgrub dgos pa yin yang / bar skabs nas gzung ba'i dge bshes kyi ming can dang / sngags chos shes 'dod chos thob la brtson pa'i 'dun nga/ che chung su 'dra ba cig yin yang / phal mo che zhig bla ma yun ring du bsden pa'i sgo nas/mnyes pa'i thabs ye mi byed pas gser dang 'dra ba'i 'dra men gyi dper song / zhal shes lag len gyi gnad rnams rim pas rtsa bas chad pa ltar song ba yin/ sngon gyi rig sngags 'chang rnams kyis/zhal shes dang thugs bcud thams cad yi ge 'god pa ga la zhig /'phral gyi lag len phra mo rnams kyang / ngag rgyud dang mthong ba rgyud pa kho na 'a gnas pa mang / des na gsang sngags kyi man ngag zab mo de ltar gab pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa ni/ dgos nges shes pa'i phyag srol yin pas/ gsal bor — 344 —

———— yi ge la mi 'god pa dang / 'dra mid mgo skor zhal rgyun dang 'dzug 'khrid kyi khungs tshol yang ri byung ba de/ sngon gyi rtsom pa po rnams mi mkhas pa yang min/ mkhas kyang bsam pa ngan pa'ang min/ yig rigs de dag ngan par yang mi 'gyur mod/ slob ma tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir/ bla ma la bsnyen bkur byed pa'i thabs yin no/ /yang phyis 'ga' zhig ltar rtsom/ pa pos thog ma nyid nas bla ma'i zhal lung ma thob par rig pa glegs bam las bklags pa dag gis/ rang bzo'i yi ge bkod pa dag la/slad nas gser chos dang snyan brgyud dang / zhal shes dang / 'dzug 'khrid kyis mi nga btags pas mi phan gyi/ sngon nas da lta'i bar rgyun ma chad pa'i zhal lung man ngag dgos so/ /rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i lag len la/ gcig tu rang gal che ba sgrub pa'i skor gyi lag len 3di dag yin yang /sgrub dkyil gyi yig cha gsar pa re thams cad kyis brtsams pas mang grags pa'i skyon dang / ma/ngon rtogs kyi bsha/da pa yam me ba yang mang po brtsams 'du/ga kyang / sgrub pa byed tshul gyi lag len ngag 'don bris pa ye ma mthong zhing / phal cher la de ltar dgos pa'i go ba tsam yang rmi/ snang bas/ 'dir phyogs tsam brjod pa yin no/ /zhes pa'ang 'jam/ dpal khro bo dang gnyis su rme da pa rtsa ba'i bla rma tshul khrims rnam rgyal dang / de'i thugs sras don grub legs pa'i bka' drin las gsung ngag dang phyag len gyi rim pa legs par thob pa rgyal spam/sa pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o// //sa cag /nus dag /mtho la//— 345 —

gsal bar sne(na pa'i ste/ba thabs rnge tshe rje 'bar/ /rje btsun rdo rje 'jig sa byed mnyes byed 'di/ /bris tshe cho 'phrul shu rdoX/gyur ci yang byung / /oṃ na mo mañdzu badz+re bhāX bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sgrub thabs rdo rje 'bar ba 'es bya ba/ bla ma/ dang 'jam nga/'i rdo rje rab tu khros nga/ 'a/ phyag 'cha'/ lo/ /'jam nga 'i rdo rje rang bzhin lngan cig skyes/ /kun tu rtog la rab khros je ra ba/ /dang/'a/ ldon bla ma rang rig bde ye shes// /'jo/ ba'i rme/thar byed 'joms la rab tu 'dud/ /brtas sa bra' lar kyang brtags kla 'i cho 'phrul ni/ /rtag tu shar (ji nga 'char nub ku'e bra' ba/ /sgyu ma'i rnge rje cir yang snang ba ngo// /rdo rje khro bos bdud kyi dkyil 'khror choms/ /dang po'i las/ can ngag gi rna' 'byor la/ /shin tā bo gru/sa/ rnga rnams la'ang yid bzhin gter/ /brjod bral 'dir rni brjod pa ra shar ba ‘kru ru// /sa dod ma'i nga pa' bo bskul ba'i chul 'di mtshar/ /'dir 83jam pa/'i rdo rje dpal 'jigs mjad chen ngo/ sgrub par 'dod pa'i sko5 sa dang po pas dur khrod la sogs par gsang ba'i bris/ sku dgram/ zhing / ma/ched pa/ dang gtor ma dag dam tshig dang rjes su mthun par ngang nams/ sngags pa kha lhor byo/gas/ pas bdud rtsi sa ༄ dag nga/ dang / bar gcod bsrung ba'i don du phyogs skyong gi gtor ma se/gas ra/ba na bya 'ing / rang nyid ro gdan la 'dug par bsam la/ skyabs 'gro sems chi ste rnger se ma sa kyi sgom/ bzlas bya/ skad cig gis rang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi snying gar na ru nga — 346 —
