nyi la hūX nag po rma chog tu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis/ bla ma mi bskyod nga/sa gtso bo'i cod pan du byas pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drang badz+ra sa mā dzaX na mo gu ru bhāX na mo badz+ra bhi ra ba maṇ+ḍal/ dz+nyāX rnam rtog dra ba rab bsal zhing / /ye shes rgya mtsho'i thugs mnga' ba/ /'jam/ dpal khro bo'i dkyil 'khor pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin bcas phyag 'tshal lo/ /oX badz+ra kā stsa huX / oṃ badz+ra mā le traX/ skye( badz+ra girti hiX tseX( badz+ra nirti āX oX badz+ra dhu pe huX/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha traX/ oX ba dz+nyā a 'e1 ke hiX glu te badz+ra ga rnye āX dkon mchog gsum/ 'a/ bdag skyabs sogs dang / chad med bzhi sgom pa spyi ltar bya/ oX swa bhā ba shu khyu / sa spru dharma swa bhā ba shud+dhi3lha/lkoX shu rgyu ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā lha t+pa ko3haX/ bdag dang lha dang chos thams/ cang spros med 'ong gsal nam mkha' lta bur bsam la 'chi ba sbyangs/ ༈/nga pa'i ngang las paX las sna ces gas pad+ma/ raX las nyi ma/ hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūX/ de las 'od 'phros rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur stug po bla bre phyi rol rdo rje'i mes/ gtams pa/ oX ba dro rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huX huX hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ de'i dbus su e las chos 'byung dkar po /spa gyen bstan gyi nang du dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung 'ing skyi ga ya' ba brgyang/ kyis bskor ba ste/ de dag na shing dang phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong dang chu dang me dang klu dang sprin dang mchod rten brgyad brgyad dang bcas pa/ ma mo srin gro sha za gshin rje ro langs la sogs pa /ri byung po'i tshogs 'a nga 'o nga du rgyu /zhing rta ha ha'i sgra nga/nga /ku co brag cha dang bcas pa/ lha nga tsho lhang bor /sna bod nga// ma/dung la skyen pa / / shang ri 'a/ dpyangs pa / mes tshig pa la sogs nga/'i ro sna tshogs dang / skang rus dang ro ma bo med sar byed cing tsā/ rus pa dang khrag dang sha dang klad nga 'thor ba ngang /—347—

dum bus /spebs nga/// bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs 'thab pa dang 'khru/ga pa nga ro 'don pa/ 'byung po rnams kyi spyod pa sna tshogs pas yid sgyur bar byed pa/dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang sgrub pa po dang grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnams dam tshig gis spyo da pa dang / 'jigs pa med pa thod rnga'i sgra dang bcas gar byed pa dang / mchod rja 4/ sna tshogs pas gang ba'i dbus na/ ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du pa'i kha dog can gyi steng du pad nyi'i gdan la/ a las zla ba gang ba la gnas/ pa'i dhī yongs su gyur pa las/ dri za dang rjes su mthun par rlung sem/sa dra mo'i snang ba 'jam/ dpal gzhon nu gur kum gzhon nu'i me tog rgyas pa ltar dam/ra ser/ phyag g.yas ral gri 'phya ra stabs/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs ma/jub mdzad pas utrul sngon po kha bye ba la gnas pa'i po ti bsnams pa/ zhi zhing sgeg nga// rgyan thams cad dang rma tshan dpe rdzogs nga// brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na tshong/ can/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i nga bu skra'i thor tshugs las 'phyang ba'i zur phud lnga sil le bun ne bas mdzes pa/ rdo rje sang na gyis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar a las bdun pa'i bdas pos las sa/ de la gnas nga/'i hū ཾ las 'od 'phros sa pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs/ pa/ sems dpa' rig ma khro bo la sogs nga/ spyan drangs pa/ sems can skye ba dang chos mthun nga/ra 'jam dpal zla ba nga/nga bcas pa/ / de thams cad nyi ma la thim nga/sa tsha zer 'bar ba/dpa ga tshang/ 'bum du khyab nga// yang de'i 'od zer gyis sngags 'phreng rnams spyan drangs/ te bstim pas/ hū nag po 'od zer lnga ldan du gyur/ yang na/ 'bum du khyab ji/'i steng du hu nag po 'es sogs bya/ de'i 'od kyis/ de kla 'in gshegs pa la — 348 —

sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi rnam par spyan drangs te thims pas/ hu de nyid rdo rje chen po mthing nag rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa/ 'od lnga 'bar ba/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa dang / rdo rje phra chomatha' yas pa spros/ sdang ba dpagadug pa rnams tshar gcad/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas 'a/ bkod/ zhing khams dag par byas/ de rnams dang 'jam dpa' rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor tshad med pa spyan drangs te/ de dag thams cad gcig tu gyur pa las/bdag nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bcom ldan 'angs rdo rje 'jigs byedag dus mtha'i sprin dang mun pa ltar gnag cing ngam za ba/ zhal dgu'i rtsa zhal mthing nag ma ce nag po shin tu khros pa'i gdong / rwa sngo bsangs shin tu rno zhing / rdorje'i me lce lhab lhab 'bar bas phyogs thams cad gnon nga// rwa'i g.yas zhal gsum mdun nas rim/ nga/sa sngon po dmar po ser po ste shin tu /bros pa/ rwa'i g.yon gyi zhal gsum mdun nas rim pas dkar po dud kha nag po ste dpa' zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ rwa gnyis kyi dbus su steng zhal dmar ngo/ 'al nas khrag 'dzag pa/ srin rdzo/ ltar ches 'jags shing ha ha phe zhes drag tu bzhad pa/de'i steng du 'jam/ dang/la ga 'on nu'i zhal ser mdog yid tsam khro zhing 'dzun/ga pa zur phud lnga ldan byis/ pa'i rgyan bzang pos spras pa/ zhal thams cad spyan gsum pa/ khro zhal thams cad rdo rje gad rnge/ drag tu rgod cing / kli phaṭa kyi sgra gnan/ du 'bod pa/ dgra bgegs kyi sha dang skang dang tshil za ba/ rnam par 'gyu/rder ba'i zhal/ khro gnyer bsdus pa'i 'gram nas 'bar ba'i smin ma 'khyog por bcus shing / nga mar la zlum/ nga/'i spyan gsum gsum sdang mig tu lta zhing zlog pa/ skra — 349 —

ser po gyen du 'bar pa me stag lta bu'i smin rdzi dang / sma ra dang ba sbu can/'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad sdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs pa/ mi bzad pa'i zhal mche ba bzhi bzhi dang bcas pa/ ljags 'gril ba/ 'jigs pa chen po dus kyi rlung dang 'brug stong ldir ba lta bu'i mtshams rngam gyi sgra'i gad rgyangs kyes bdud sde'i snying 'gas pa/ langs tsho la bab pa sku lus che zhing rags pa'i yan lag dang nying lag /spom/ thung hrags shing mkhreng bag can/ sgyu 'phrul rdorje gsus po che/ rab tu rgyas pa'i liṅga gyen du bsgreng ba/phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi'i dang po gnyis rdo rje gri gug dang thod khras bag tsam rdeg thabs kyi thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag mas rim bzhin bi dhi pa la/ brtun shing / chu spi/ ka na ya / sta re/ mdung rings/ mda'/ lcags kyu/ dbyug pa/ kha ṭāX ga /'khor lo/ rdo rje rtse lnga rnga// tho ba/ ral gri/ rnge'u chung rnams 'dzin pa/g.yon rnams kyi tshangs mgo /phub/ rkang pa/ thegs pa/ gzhu/ rgyu ma/ dril bu/lag pa/ ro ras/ skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa/ me thab/ thod tshal gyi kha phor bdud rtsis gang ba/ sdigs mdzub/ 'phan rtse gsum pa/ rlung gis bskyod pa'i ras rnams bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis kyi glang po che'i lpags rlon khrag 'dzag pa sto da g.yogs su byas pa'o/ /zhabs bcu drug g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i gyad chen po'i stobs kyis srid pa gsum g.yo zhing 'dar bar byed cing lhag par brjid pa'i stabs kyi bzhugs pa'i g.yas brgyad kyis/ mi/ ma he/glang / bong bu/ rnga mo/ khyi/ lug /wa rnams dang / g.yon brgyad kyis bya rgod/'ug/ pa/ khwa/ ne tso/ bong khra/ bya chen po/ ri skeg /bzhad rnams gachod pa/ de —35()—

rnams kyi 'og tu tshangs pa/ dbang po/ khyab 'ju ga/drag po ste bdung bzhi dang /ces gas kyi bdag po/ karti ka /nyi ma/ zla ba rnams kha sbub tu bskyel nas mnan pa/ gcer bu shin tu gtum pa/ 'jigs/ su drang ba'i thong skom lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa/ mi mgo khrag 'dzag nga brgya phyed rgyu rlon la brgyus pa'i do shal dang /klu brgyad dang / gdug pa'i sbrul nag rngo 'i mchod phyir thogs dang rus pa'i rgyan drug dang khrag dang (nag dang tha' / chen gyis spras nga// sprul nga/'i pho 2 dang ga tu me/da pa spro ba/ 'jig dus kyi me ltar drag tu 'bar zhing 'khrug pa/'i me dpung gi klong na bzhugs pa lta bar ya nga mi bzod nga/'i bdag nyid ྅ gyur/ oṃ/ swa bha sogs brjod sde bsten pa 'o/ /mis tu khriX dkar po sa snying / rbe bar dziX sngo na po phyag rdor /sna ra khaX ser po nam snying / lcer saX/ ngam/ra ngo/ 'jig rten dbang phyug /dpral bar skaX snye snang khu sgrib sel/ lte bar saX nga/por po kun bzang bi ngo bo ste/ 'er sgrub bo/ /dpra la bar oṃ dkar po/ ma/grin par āXdam ra ngo// thus sa kar hūṃ sngon ngo// sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin huX gi 'od zer mal 'a dbyings tham/sa rbod du son/ chos kyi dbyings las gdug nga/ ma lus pa 'du' ba'i pyir rgya'/ ba kun gyi ye shes kyi sku// 'jam dpal bro/ sa pa'i dkyil 'khor sang pa la phyogs/ bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas kyis bskor ba rmoX/ badz+ra sa mā jaX yang na/ 'aXha bha mahā rku dha ā ga smo a gas asma tā pū dza pra ti gra ṇ+ḍa n+tu pra nā dha me dhi ma sku ru swāhā/ hruXbluXs ngh+ru 'brangs/ gyes bgegs/ bskrad/ lwa su so/gas sngar bzhin nam/ hraXskyi/༷༷ta sos sa/ kyis ma/chong/jaXhūX baX hoXganyis su med nga ra thim/ sde ni sgrub kla 'o/ /dbang thi lha rigs lnga ba dro sa mā jaX sngar bzhin mchod/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gso/la/ 'es —351 —

gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /skye bas thob pa dbang bskur bas/ /ji ltar de bzhin bdag gis te/ /dag pa lha yi chu dbang bskur/ /oX badzo da kā bhi khiñtsa huX/ su ra ta stuX/ zhes dbang bskur/ dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ rdo rje'i khro bo'i mthu stobs dang 'phrin las/ thams cad la dbang ba byas/ chu'i dwangs ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las mi bskyod nga/sa dbu brgyan/ dzaXhūṃ sogs kyis thim/ yang na gong gi dza hūX nas sngar bzhin mchod zhes pa'i bar dor ba yang man ngag gi lugs gzhan no/ /rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya gnas gsum/ du gtugs hiXsgyiXgasum brjod/ rang gi snying gar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyi thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' huX yig ma ra me ltar 'bar ba rtag tu 'char bzhin pa ste/ sgrub pa chen po'o/ /sems dpa' gsum brtseg 'di gtso bo bskyed ma thag tu byeng pa'ang lugs gzhan no/ /ar+ghaX sogs sngar bzhin mchod/ oX sa rbu ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā bā t+pa ko3haX/ nang ma/chod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oX āXhūX/ zhes myangs/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra su bhā bā t+pa ko3haX/ thugs ka nas yid kyi rig ma mā ma gī spros/ snyoms par zhugs/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā gā na badz+ra swa bhā ba at+pa ko3haX/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ /sogs kyi bstod pa bya/ lkoX sa/rba ta thā ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra swa bhā bā t+pa ko3haX/ de nas man ngag ltar/ snying gar rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma sngags 'phreng ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rnams bkod la/ oX ya ma rā dzā sa do me ya ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya ya da yo ni ra ya snye ya ya snye yasnro ni rā ma ya huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ oX hiXsnriXbi kṛ tā na na hūX phaṭa/ lkoX ya mun+ta hūX phaṭa/ ci nus pa de srid du g.yeng ba med pas bzla'o/ /'di la ci rigs par oX a ra tsa na dhīX bzla ba'ang snang ngo / /bar bar du

—————————rderderderde—'a snye lha' sku la rtse gcig tu yid bzhag ces / de ya nga spangs rtogs kyi yon tan re re nas dran par byas te thams cad dang ldan pa'i/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes 'jam dpal khros pa ba / cu/rden rje gshed skyon kun spangs yon tan kun ldan dngos te nga'o snyam/ nga/'i nga rgyal dang /gsal snang la spyod tshul yang / thog mar spyi rags pa de la yang yang sgrim/ gsal dwangs je rdo9ga pa med pa'i ma he sno(rde zhal/ zhal dgu/ phyag so bzhi/ 'kha/rdes bcu drug pa/ snod thams cad 'od kyi gzhal yas khang / zhes brjod cing yang ya nga bas rma/sa/ der rags pa'i rlam pa la cung zad brtan pa na/ phra mo nas gsal gdab ste/ ma he sno(rde gdong mthing nag spyan gsum khra zlum zlum pa/ 'od dmar rdzobaskal pa'i me 'bar ba sko sna bu ches/ ngang / rwasngo bsangs rtsa ba khrom gnyer can/ bar 'ja' khugs rtse mo rno zul zul ba bes ngang / steng zhal dmar lam lam pa/ dmar tsher tsher ba nyi ma 'bum shar ba lta bu ha ha zhes drag tu bzhad pa zhes dang / 'jam dpal gyi zhal dmar ser smin pa nag khyug khyug pa/ spyan dkyus ring zhing bkra ba/ shangs gzengs mtho pa/ mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs nga// zhes sogs cha phra mo nas brjod cing sa sal btang1/ ces de nyid ra go pa kha cig 'dom/sa par ma/jad do/ /ye shes/ kyi rig ma 'a/ so gas/ pa'i thi bde dang / lnga'i nga rgyan la dang dkyil 'khor gyi gsal snang dang / de tham sa cad dang rang bzhin med pa la rnam par mi rtog pas 2jug pa ste/ 'di ni rna pa 'byor chen ngo/'i lha'i rnal 'dre rdor spyi'i gnad dam/ pa'o/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa ya ra sgom ste phyis bsha/nga par bya'o/ /rang bi snying sa nas 'od 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khe/ra/ de thams cad rang la thim/ bsrung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang zhes sam/ gzhal yang khang ma bskyed na bcas pa rang la thim/ rang ga zhal phyag lhag — 353 —

ma/'ang rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la bsdu/ rang phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal bya/ mig tu skru sogs dang /dpral bar o sogs bya/ dge ba bsngo/ gal te lha dgu sgom par 'dod na/ ya ra ba la su las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du chos 'byung dkar po'i nang du bhu las rnam snang / de las gzhal yas khang grub bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi mtshan nyid tshang zhing rgyan thams cad rdzogs pa/ nang gi lha snam shar sngo sto ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo bar ya la sogs bya/ gtso bo bskyed zin pa dang / sgo mtshams brgyad du pad nyi la ra brgyad la ro langs chen po ka ha ka ha dang pho pho ha la ha la gyi sgra sgrogs pa po ston na rje ltar khros pa/ mdog nag po mig gsum pa so rno ba gri thod 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang gi gar byed pa/ de nas/ mig tu skru/sogs bya ba snga ma ltar ro/ /ro langs mgo gsum lag gsum rkang gsum gar stabs zhes pa ni lugs gzhan no/ /rgyan thams cad rdzogs pa'i sgo mtshams brgyad du ro langs zhes sogs te khang pa dang lhan cig gi skad cig gis bskyed pa yang lugs gzhan no/ /phyag mtshan rdzegs pa'i dkyil wor ni/ lha snam byang ljang dbus sngon po gru bzhi pa'i steng rdo rje nag po'i rwa ba zlum po nang re mig nga/gu pa 'dzul sgo bzhi dang bcas shing / lho sgo phye ba gzhan rnams bcad pa/ dbus kyi re mig tu ya la sogs nas/ bdag nyid du gyur/ shar du mgo go lhor lag pa/ nub tu rgyu ma/ byang du rkang pa/ shar lhor thod pa/ lho nub tu thod tshal/ nub byang du ro ras/ byang shar du skyes bu gsal shing gis phug pa ste re mig rnams so /'khyam la shar du rim pas gri gug /'phang mdung / brtun shing / chu gri/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ lcags kyu/ lhor sta re/ mda'/dbyug pa/ kha ṭā ga /'khore 'e tho zhags pa/ nub tu rdo rje/ cang te lu phub/ gzhu—354—

dril bu/ rlung ras/ byang du sdigs mdzub/ 'phan rtse gsum pa/ glang lpags / tho ba/ mdung rings/ me thab/ sbo/ dang grwar ro langs sngar bzhin no/ /phyag mtshan sogs skyed nas dbus su ya sogs skyed de/ ro langs kyang rang rang bi mgo bo lag g.yon myo 'dzin nga yang /spa cig 'dod do/ /phyag mtshan 'e dgu'i dkyil 'khor ni/ gzhan/ rnams bcad nga/ dbus su khu sogs / bdag nyid du gyur/ re mig brgyad la shar nas o 'a hā sgyi bi/ me nas kṛ tā na na/ lha snam shar la yak+ṣi ya tsā ni rā ma ya/ sto(ra ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ nub tu ya me do ru ṇa yo nga/ ya / byang du ya da yo ni ra ya nā ya/ sgo bzhir ya mun ta ka /grwar bzhir hūṃ hū ཾ phaṭa phaṭa rnams yongs su gyur pa la sa/ shar du mgo bo sogs la/ lcags kyu/ ma he/ ba lang / zhags nga / phas /bong bu/ rlud rderas/ rnga mo/ khyi/ me thab/ lug /wa/ sgo ba'i ra bya rgod/ lug pa/ bya rogane ce/ khwa/ bya chen/ khyim bya/ bzhad/ 'di la'ang ro langs sngar bzhin no/ /ya nga rdo rje mgo bo nas/ rdo rje bzhad kyi bar gyi ming sbyar la thams cad sa yon thod pa g.yas rang ming gi phyag mtshan/ nag po ma he'i gdong cha lugs gtso bo lta bu zhes khyad par sbyar ba ga 'an snga ma/ lta bu ni zhe dgu'i dkyil 'khor te bsdus pa'o/ /gtso bo bskyed kra 'i rdo rje rwa lnga pa dang dgu pa ni 'di la gad/rma nga'o/ /dbus kyi le tshe'i nang du zhes pa dang / lha snam gyi dbus su zhes pa dang / gzhal yang khang mi bskyed pa'i phyo(gas la ma/chod rdzas sna then gas kyis gang ba'i dbus zhes sbyar te/ thams cad la khrag zhag 'khru / ga pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil du thod skam gyi ra ba zlum ngo/ sgo gcig lhor bstan pa steng keng rus kyis thog phyur bur phug pa'i rtse mor mche ba gtsigs nga 'i thod pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' — 355 —

rtse sde snye ge snye / ba'i rgyan thams cad pa de'i nang gi dbus su yaX la sogs pa sbyor brwa 'o chen po'igabazhed pa ste mi legs pa yang ma/ yin no/ /yang snga ma lta bu las tshogs bsog gi tshe snying gar nga/da zla la dhīX byed pa dang / stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung du yaX las rlung sogs/phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i 'khyu da rgya can/ thugs kar āXlas nyi ma de la ra caX las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i lte bar chi stoX gi 'od kyis rdo rje 'jigs/ byed 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ sngon bzhin mched/ rang la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/bdag nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa so gas snga phyog/ bzhin no/ /'di la zhabs5'og gi ri skeg gi chab tu khya gru/ bya'o/ /sngags ni gsum/ po dang / yi ge bcu bzhi pa yang ye/na nge/ gzhan yang cho ga de kho 'es 'jig byed zhal bzhi pa rtsa zhal sngar ltar g.yas nga/mar g.yo zho dkar ba/ rwa gnyis kyi nga bus su steng zha'/ khyi gdong dmar ser/ zhal tham sa cad spyan gsum/ rdo rje gad cho/ sogs/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rdo rje brtun sheng /ral gri/ 'khor lo/ cang tes g.yon kha ṭāX ga /thod pa/ gzhu/ zhags nga/ 'dzin pa/ zhabs/ bzhis nga dud bzhan/ rma/nan ji/ gcer bu sogs bya ste sngags ni sngar brnya na nga/ dang / oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sa r+bhe mo bhak+ṣa ya phaṭa/ 'ji gnyis dpa ri bo sa cag pa sde la sbyor la sa 'byung pa paṇ+ḍi ta chen rngo/ 'jirgis med 'byung gnas kyi bzhed pa ltar bkod nga yi na la/ gzhan rnams rtog bdun gyi nga/gongs nga/ lā li ta'i gzhung chung dang mthu stobs dbang phyug rwa ba'i ma/'e ngan gtso bor byas la/ 'u/ li ta'i gzhung che ba la'ang dang/nga kro ra byas pa ste/ skro bo bcu'i bsrung 'khor sogs yong mod/ 'og tu ston ho/ /yang 'dir rwa lo chen po rdo rje grags kyi man ngag las/ 'di ltar 'byung ste/pad nyi'i steng bdud bzhi'i steng du maX 'a sa ma he nag ngo/ rus rnga/'i rgyan can/ de'i steng du dhīXlas ra 'a gri dhīXs mtshan pa las 'jam/ dbyangs snga ra bzhin/ nyi ma/'i —356—

——— —snye ———snye—————rderderde'od kyis sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa‘spru thams zi cad kyi sku gsung thugs yi she 'bru gsum du spyan drangs te rang la thim pa las rang nyid 'bras bu rdorje 'chang zha95/ ga sdo/rdem/ phyag rdo sde khrig /'bas bzhi pa/ rtsa zha95/ ma/ he sogs/ sa yang/rde stso | /g.yon nga/kar ba/ phyas dang rngoganyis gri thod/ bar pa gnyis ri cang te'u kha ṭā ga/tha ma gnyis glang— po che'o lpags rle' zhes pa khyad nga/ra ro/ /gzhan yang bdud bzhi'i rdod du las kyi kra/phran na rje kha sbu ba tu bsgyel ba'i steng du sogs ngang / brgyan can/de'i steng du hrulas rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga rnga/ hu gis mtshan pa'i 'ong/ zer gyis gdug pa thams cad tshar sa cad/ snod bcud thams ci khyad dkyi/ (dri 'khe|rder du gyur/rang la thims/ yongs zu su/gyur pa las rang nyid so sas dang / zhal gcis/ phyag bzhi zhabs sa nyas nga / sngar gyi phyag bar pa gnyis/ bor ba la gzhen snga k+ṣi5 lnga ra ro/ /'di'i phyas tha ra bor ba yang phya ga gnas nga/'i sgrub thab ru/ te/ ga sgon na tham/sa cad bli snga rma ‘snang bo na lngar spyi ra ba yi/na mo/ /'di rna che/sa la yang / nga kyal 'bor snga rma/ lha ra stsar bas ma/nga ngo/ra 'gyur rta/ 'al dbu kla 'is nas su nge snrar sa so /de bas zho sang la cho/nu༈ pa de la nge spyin no/ /'e nga gu/ rgya zu pa bcu gsum rma sogs ni 'dor nge ra cam ngus ngom /khrub nga das ri bar ma/thong cibs /'dar rnge ba bri'o/ /de lngar lnga :rwa sa brgyad du phye ba sogs rma nga ngo/za 'gyur ro /bcu sa sum gyi dku snga 'char ya nga rnga che pa/ra ma ngag pa 'o 'es/ smra bar mi bya sde rtos pa bdum par bskyeng rir/ sang gsungs pa'i ngon thams cang tshang 'a//lha sa ma ya nga 3ji nying/ ngang ma thun pa'i rgyud kyis da ga par kha bskang ba'i ting nge 'dzim rgyas pa snge/ rdo rje slo pa dngo/myo chen po ye shes zhabs sogs kyi man ngag dang / rā li ta'i sa zhung ngang lhag nga/ra mthun pas sgom tā gre kas/ so/ /sgru ba thabs/ rdo rje sem/tre dpa' bsdu sa rnga ra gras sa nga 'i lus sa bcu bdun — 357 — ‘

ma ni yan lag phyi ma rnams spyi mthun la/ dang po'i rgyu rdor sems 'jam dpal mi mdzad pa/ dpal bde mchog gi sgrub thabs pū yi pa'i lugs dang mthun pa zhig ste / 'dir ni rtog bdun nyid kyi dgo/ngas pa brjod pa las sna/ de ni rgyud gzhan/ la brten pa rim/ man ngag 'ga' zhig tsam ste/ deng mi brjong pa kho na'o/ /ye shes zhabs kyi ma/na ngag ltar slob dpon ka rma/ la rak+ṣi tas/ sgru ba thabs byas nga bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor ya nga de lhar ro/ /'di ra smras pa/ stseni la bskyed pa 'i rim pa ci//de'i sbyang sa/'i'i rab dbye ci/ /rgyu dang de bzhin gong ma'i lam/ /'bras bu chos mthun dag kyang gang / /brjod pa/ ye shes tshogs gsog gis 'chi ba sbyong zhing 'od gas/la du byed/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor gyis sang du skye ba'i snod dang / rlung dang zla ba rlung sems phra cho / sa bon phyag ma/tshan dag sems kyi rgyu 'jam dpal ni/ bar do'i 'gro ba ngang / ye shes kyi sku/ nyi ma ni 'od gsal ba/dkyil 'khor bsdim pa ni bar ma'i srid nga 'gag pa'i tshu' / zla ba dang bcas pa'i 'jam dang la nyi rma/ la zhugs pa ri khu khrag dang sems gcig tu 'dres pa/ 'i ma yi ge rdo rje rnams ni mer re/ra po 'a so ci pa// spro bsdus sbyor ba ni/ 'byung ba bzhi'i stobs las gong nas rgong du 'phel ba/ rdo rje rtse lnga rnga 'i phyogs la/ rwa ni yan lag lnga dang nying lag nyer lnga'o/ /dgu nga la ni phung ngo lnga dang 'byung ba lnga 'o/ /sku rdzogs nga ni btsas pa/ nye bar bsgrub pa ni/ lus 'phe' ba/ sgrub pa ni lo bcu drug lon pa lte ra lus dang ngag dang yid dang bde ba rdzogs pa/ sgrub pa chen po ni rang gi gnas 'a dbang bskur thing / 'gro ba'i bya ba la gnas pa'o zhes nga 'di la phal cher ni sbyangs gzhi'i rab tu dbye ba dang / la la ni chos ma/tshungs pa dag ste/ de dag gi snang ba dang der zhen pa zlog pa ste/ gang dag de la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes su zhen pas kyang ngo / /ji ltar zhe na/ srid pa gsum po la sogs pa/'ang yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / mngon byang lngas rgyal ba'i sku 'gru/ba pa dang / sprul pa'i skus 'gro/ ba'i don spyod pa dang / de'i ye shes thams cad gcig tu gyur pa dpa/ dbang bskur thob pa rnams su'o/— 358 —

des na rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba yang / 'di dang 'dis dpag par nus so/ /'ji dag la zhal dang phyag la sogs pa rdul du snang ba dang / lus kyi cha shas tsam gyi nga rgyal ni rnam par das par mi 'gyur te/ ji skad bshad pa'i rnam par dag pa de dang / de'i nga rgyal bya ste/ 'di ltar 'bas rnams ni srin bu rkang mangs lta bu ma yin gyi/ dbang phyug brgyad dang / grub pa brgyad stsol ba'i thugs rje'i ye shes rnam pa der snang ba'o snyam pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar/ zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i tshul la/ 'khor ba'i tshul de dang de dag pa dang / 'bras bu de dang de dngos kyi nga rgyal ma 'gags par bsgom mo/ /'dir yang smras pa/ bskyed pa'i rim pa rmad byung zhig /de ring kun dga' snying pos bstan/ /yi ge nyung zhing don mang ba/ /'di yis blo nus dpog min nam/ /nyin re'am zla ba so so'am/ /yang na lo ni re rer ni/ /dbyug gu drug cu rtsa bzhir bcas/ /gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhir spyin/ /de yang 'pho ba re re la/ me rlung sa chu rgyu ba'i dbyug gu re re te drug cu rtsa bzhi las sa chu la dge ba dang me rlung la drag las sam dbang gi las bya ba dang / yang na/ zhag gcig la dkyil 'khor gyi bdag nyid kyi dbyug gu drug cu rtsa re re/ 'pho mtshams kyi ye shes kyi cha rnams la/ dbyug gu bzhir byas nas/de dag 'jig rten du dus kyi pho nya dang bar chad du 'gyur ba las/ nang gi rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis/ 'chi med rdo rje'i sku'i bar du bya ba'i phyir/ rnam 'gyur bsad bskrad zhi ba dang / rang bzhin dbang dgug rgyas sogs su byed pa nang gi nges pa ste/ de lta bu'i de nyid shes pas ga/nan don bya ba'am/ las dang po pas kyang gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi'i nges pas/ las tshogs bde blag tu 'grub pa ni de ltar yin la/ gtor ma phul bas rang yang mchog gi don de myur du 'grub pa'i rten 'brel zab mor 'gyur te/ 'di bya ba ni/ bris sku'i mdun du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang khrag chen po dang chang bsres pa'i dri bzang gi chus maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi bya/ der chos 'byung dkar po/ rtse mo rang la gha ba/ nang — 359 —

dam/ra ngo/sa byugs la/ dbus zlum skor le tshe dgu pa byas pa'i le tshe phyogs ma/dog /dbus su bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha grangs ji cam yod pa dang / le tshe brgyad la phyogs skyong bcu'i tshom bu dgod/ chos 'byung gi ga yas su 'das pa'i gtor ma che ba zhig thod pa'am snod gang yang rung bar bshams/ g.yon du 'byung po thams cad pa/ rgyab bam mdun gang ba der 'a sa kyi gshin rje gtor ma/ sde thams cad sha khrag sna tshogs pas spags te/ ba dan la so gas pas brgyan/ gtor ma'i rgyu zan sha khrag nya sgog tsong chang 'bru sna tshogs pa las bya/ snod gcig tu gshe/mas pa'am/ snod gzhan du drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma/'ang bzhi tshan nam bcu drug tshan ci rigs leng skabs dang bstun nga/ra khu thams/ dbyibs ni bod rnams las dang mthun pa'i dbyibs ‘snar rma jad par snang bas de ltar yang wo ngo / /de la 'dir sha khrag chang rnams rdzas kyi gtso bo yin no/ /de nas mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ dkyil 'bor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang 'a sa chos 'byung sogs yan lag bzhi rdzo gas par bskyed pa'am bsdu na/ siX gi 'od zer gyis dpal rdo rje 'jigs/ byed kyi dkyil 'khor oX hri ha bho sogs kyis mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du spyan drangs te bzhugs ces bya/ nge nas mchod yon sogs phyag rgya dang bcas nga bul rte/ oX hruXsgyiXha/ oX hūṃ hū ཾ ༷ phaṭa/ oX ku ma ra rū bī ni jaXdzaX oX hriXha lha phaṭa / oṃ di lta lo ca na bi kṛ tā na na mahā at+na bha hā sa na ji/ na da lta ya swāhā/ oṃ bi kri tā na na sdo ni satwa da ma ka gaXsaXgaX tseXr+sha kā la tsurdo pa sa rlu ṭa ཿ satwa da ma ka /mahā bhā ta a dhī pa ti i maX bā ling kṛ ha ṇa pa ta ye swāhā/ oX badz+ra sha rte āXhuX/ de dros snying po'i rma thar oX āXhūX btags te nang mchod ngo/ /yid kyi rig ma sprul pa phu'/ ste/ bde ba chen pos snyoms par zhugs/oX a nu rā ga'i sngags rgya bya/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang / /shel la tshon ni ji bzhin — 36()—

du/ /'dod yon lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho/ rol du gsol/ bsnams par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ /dges pa'i gar gyis rol par mdzod/ /reg bya 'gag pa med pa la/ /mig yor bzhin du rol du gsol/ /ho chags pa med bzhin chags par mdzod/ /o sarba pū dza sogs/ dur khrod rgyan gyi legs brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur bstan pa'i/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun chen khyod la 'dud/ /o sa spru ta thā ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra swa bhā bā t+pa ko3nya/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ya las rlung ra las me ka las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum la/ a las thod pa de'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga'i steng du/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ snyi ma me da ya las ye shes lnga/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas pa zhu ba'i spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar mi bskyod pas gtso byas pa'i rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par 'jug bzhin pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad rigs lnga'i rnam pas rang rang gi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i rkyen gyis bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsir zhu ste ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i chen por gyur/o ā hu ha ho hi 'di ni man ngag go /de'i nang bhu a dzi kha hu las sgron ma lnga/ la ma pa ta ba las bdud rtsi lngar gyur pa la/ rang rang gi yi ges mtshan pa/ de'i steng du oṃ ā hu rim pas brtsegs pa/ rlung sogs zhu zhing 'dres/ yig 'bru gsum gyi 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi lhar spyan drangs/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu zhing thim pas gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi sogs bya ba ni khyad par te — 361 —

lugs gzhan no/ /oX ya ma rā dza sogs dang / hruXsnriXdang / ya mun+ta ka'i mthar/ sarba bisnrun sha krun mā ra ya i daX bā liX kha kha 'a hi ji hi swāhā/ zhes pa bdun la sogs pas gtor ma 'bul/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ badz+ra bhi ra bā dhi pa ta ye i dam bā ling kha kha ji hi 'a hi hūX phaṭa/ zhes pa'ang gtor sngags so/ /de nas mchod bstod gsol ba btab/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo lcags kyu thogs pa spros pa rnams kyis phyogs skyong rnams bkug/yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ huX in+t+ra a dī nāX ā kar+ṣa ya dzaX phyogs bcu'i dkyil ge nar du 'khod/ phur bu bcu spros nas de rnams kyi spyi bo re bto/ hruXsgyiX'i mthar hūX in+t+ra a dī naX badz+ra gī la ya hūX phaṭa swāhā/ grub pa'i bcud kyis reg pa ltar thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis par gyur/ gong ltar skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis rlob/ dbang gi lha rigs lngas dbang bskur te/ gshin rje gshed kyis dbu brgyan/ dang por gtor ma lan gcig phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol gdab/ de nas tshan pa ji tsam bcad pa rnams so so la/ nang mchod gtor bsangs sbyangs 'khru gsum rlung dang bstun nas byin rlabs bya/ gtor ma dang grangs mnyam pa'i sngags rgyas phul/ar+ghaX sogs dang / oX āXhūX gis nang mchod/ bstod pa dang 'dod don gsol btab bsdus re bya la/ mthar mjug tu mchod bstod sogs bya/ de la/ oX in+t+ra ya hruX ya ma ya sgyiX ku be rā ya kṛ/ yī sha nā ya ta/ asne ya a/ ni ri t+ya na/ ba ya be na/ pra smi ya hūX/ ba sun+ta ri phaṭa/ sarba dh+wa te lco ha ha hi hi hūX hūX h+pha h+pha phaṭa swāhā/ 'di ni gtor sngags so/ /yang na/ oX bhu tsa rā rno/ ya pā tā la tsa rā naX/ mun khe tsa rā naX/ ta puṇ+ḍa dhi ga tā naX/ka dak+ṣi ṇa dhi ga ta naX/ hūX pañtsa mā dhi ga tā naX/ phaṭa ut+ta ra a dhi ga tā naX/ oX i hiXya snri ba/ bi khyo kṛ ko ta e na a na de huX sduXphaṭa sarba bhū te bhāX i maX ba liX kha —362—

kha khwa hi khwa hi huX phaṭa swāhā/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /gshin rje mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /bcom ldan 'das dang phyogs skyong tshogs/ /mchod spyin rgya chen 'dis tshims pas/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /phan dang bde la gegs byed pa'i/ /'gal rkyen bar chad phyi nang gsang / /skad cig nyid la ni wa ra ya phaṭa/ /mthun rkyen thams cad 'grub pa dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /zhes pa ni bstod pa dang 'dod don zhu ba'o/ /de nas/ snying ga'i 'od kyis/ chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje ge dur dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX oX hiXsgyiXsogs dang / ya ma rā dza sa pā ri wa ra kar+ṣa ya dzaX dam rgya bcas te/oX nas/ sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ya stuX/ dam la bzhag dbang bskur bas rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ lkoX kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūX/ i daX bā ling grihā kha kha ji hi ji hi/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ bcom lngan chos rje 'jam dbyangs spyan lam du/ /bdud 'dul bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /las kyi gshin rje ma mo mkha' 'gro ma/ /'byung po ro langs ci bgyi bka' nyan sogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam can ma lus la/ /bdag ni re ba'i sems kyis 'dud cing mchis/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin chen pos tshim gyur te/ /bstan dang sems can yongs la 'tshe/ /gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /snying nas byang chub mchog sgrubs pa'i/ /'phral dang yun gyi 'gal rkyen rnams/ /bzlog cing bskyur la rdul du rlogs/ /rnam 'gyur rnam dag —363—

chos kyi dbyings/ /mnyam nyid chen por drag sbyor mdzod/ /ces thal mo brdabs/thun gtor/ zor du 'phen pa phyir zlog gi cha shas su 'gyu/ra zhes skyo pa rnams phyag len du mdzad do//gshin rje gshed kyi yig brgya brjod/ kā la rū pa sa pa ri wā ra ga smo zhes sam/ yang na/dza ya rnga rdo ya sdo / ja / ya/ zhes sogs/ slar yang / bcom lngan 'das 'khe/ra bcas la mchod/dngos grub blangs/ bzod par gsol/ yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas pa bya/ myos dza ri ya dza ri ya sdo5 ja / ya bishwa ru pa dha ri gasnro gasnro su za na kṛ ta rnye na thā ga smos rlu budha ltob sadz+dza ya/ ma ma kasme ṭa/ ra kyi swāhā/ gtor mgron rnams gshe/gas/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ dge ba bsngo/ shis pa brjod do/ /'di ni phyi rol mchod pa/ gtor chog dang bcas pa shin tu bsdus pa ste rgyas par ga 'an du blta'o/ /mchod pa'i tshe rol mo sna tshogs pa brdung zhing / khyad par cang te'u thod pa'i rang bzhin te/ bstod pa dang / gtor ma bskyel ba na yang ngo / /gal te phyogs skyong bco lnga la ni gtor sngags kyang de ltar sbyor ro/ /'dir smras pa/ bcud len mchog gis reg na lcags kyang gser/ /sngags kyi mthu las dug kyang bdud rtsir 'khyu/ra/ /'chi ba ster byed dbyug gu'i ye shes cha/ /thabs mkhas sbyor las dngos grub rnam gnyis rgyu/ /da ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa shin tā zab mo 'thor thabs su gnas pa dag 'dir bsdu ste/ dang po sharnyi pa zhes grags pa thams cad mkhyen pa lta bu des mdzad pa'i tshogs 'khore du/ snying ga'i lte bar zla ba la chos 'gyung dmar po'i nang du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ spyi bo'i steng mtho gang tsam gyis dpags pa zla ba'i 'og tu lko mgo bo thur bstan/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ o dang zla ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung / spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ snying ga'i rdo rjer thim nas/ nus pa bde drod rlan dang bcas pa lus thar ri / rbod la khyab yang yang sgom zhing rdo rje la sems 'dzin/ 1 spyi bor bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rgyun zhal dgu so sor drangs/ mthar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la bstim pa yang yang sgom ste/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la gtso bor — 364 —

sems 'jog go 2 /yang dngos sam yid kyi rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i thig le yungs 'bru tsam rdo rje'i rtse mo'am shes rab kyi sna rtser sgom pa/ 3 yang man ngag nang gi rnal 'byor gyi skabs bstan te dang po gnyis ni bsam gtan gyi dug gzhil ba'i cho ga'i nges don yin la/ gzhan yang 'dir rdzogs rim phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bstan pa dang / spyod pa'ang tshogs 'bor gyis don gyis bstan to/ /'di rnams ye shes zhabs dang mthun no/ /rwa lo chen po'i bzhed pa'i de'i man ngag bcud thig sogs su 'byu1nga ba'i gdams pa sna tshogs pa dag bsdu na/ shin tu spros pa med pa zab mo'i dbyings lhan cig skyes pa'i man ngag ni/ rang sems spros med lhan skyes la/ spros bcas glo bur pa thams cad spangs te/ lhan skyes kyi ngang skyong ba/ rnam rtog gang byung mi 'thud pa dus skabs thams cad du de'i rgya dang ma bral ba 'di gsum la ma bcos pa/ rtsa ba med nga / rang thar zhes pa'i rma/tshan gsol te/ gzung 'dzin spros med mtshan mo rgyu ba'i man ngag go khu /yang thig le'i rnal 'byor bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel la/ steng gi sna sgor zla ba ma shaka tsam la rdo rje sngon po yungs 'bru tsam de la sems ngar bskyed de sgom pa dang / 5 gsang rtse'i bu kar zla ba rdo rje dmar skya yungs 'bru tsam la dang slod pa ste 'di gnyis kyis bying rgod kyang sel/ zab pa'i rnal 'byor/ 6 de brta myo na stong gsum yungs 'brur bsdud/ rdul phran gyis stong gsum khyab pa'i spro bsdu byed pa rgya che ba la brlab pa'i rnal 'byor zhes gsungs/ 7 yang rgyud kyi bzlas dmi/gas kyi nges jon/ rtog pa bzhi par/ de kho na nyid kyi spyor ba la shin tu mnyam par gzhag pa'i sngags pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i skabs su 'chad de/ man ngag ni/ rdzogs rim sems dpa' gsum brtsegs zhes bya/ de yang /bzlas pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus kyi ting nge 'dzin sem/sa dpa'/ hu de nyid dam/ de zhu ba'i thig le mdog khrag shas che na dkar po/ rlung shas che na dmar po/ snyoms na dkar dmar ro gsungs te don du dkar dmar ro/ /de'i 'od kyis rim gyis/ khyab mthar dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs mun khung — 365 —

sgron me bteg pa ltar gsal/ slar rim gyis rim gyis hu la bsdus pa ring du yid gtad/ de yang brtan brtan du yang yang bsgom/ yang sngar bzhin spros nas thams cad bsdus te ma he'i zhal du thim/ yang spros te gsal 'debs/ de ltar gsal snang nam thob kyi bar du bya ba ste rgya che ba la sems bzung ba'o/ 8 /yang snga ma ltar spros/ thams cad 'od du zhu bdag la thim/ rang ye shes sems dpa'/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ de na da/ ches phra bar bsdu/ de la sems brtan na/de yang yal ba'i mtha' bral la 'jog pa ni/ zab pa la bslab pa/ 9 yang skad cig gis spros nas snang stong dbyer med la 'jog pa zung 'jug la bslab pa'o/ 10 /de rnams ni ye shes zhabs dang mthun la/ phal che a ba dhū ti'i nang du bsgom pa shas che ba yin no/ /ma he'i zhal zhes pa'i nang don/rwa sgom pa ni lte bar nyi zla brtsegs pa la ma he'i gdong brgyad brtsegs pa'i/ steng ma'i rwa gang rung gi rtse'i nang du/ nā da'i re kha phra mo la sems 'dzin cing / chos thams cad spros pa dang bral ba'o zhes yang yang sgom/ 11 mtshan ma gyen 'greng gi rnal 'byor la rnal 'byor lam pas sgom pa ni lha sku 'ja' lus kyi lte ba'i khong stong du hu nag po/ de'i 'og tu ā dmar po rlung bum can bzung bas/'og rlung yar log na yi ge gnyis la thim/ de gnyis las 'od dmar nag gnyis sna bug nas glog 'gyu ba bzhin byung snang ba thams cad gsal/ sngar gyi lam nas yi ge gnyis la thim pa 'a sems 'jog pa/ sa bon la sems 'dzin pa/ 12 'od gnyis kyi snang ba thams cad zhu rang la bsdu/ rang yi ge de nā da'i bar du bsdus nas/ nā da je phra la sems 'dzin pa/ nā da la sems 'dzin pa'o/ 13/'di las rlung sems las su rung ba na/ chags lam las rgya brten pa'i mtshan ma gyen bsgreng bsgom/14 thig le 'gog pa mtshan ma gyen bsgreng zhes bya ba rlud 'ong ba bde ba/ 'gro ba sdug bsngal/ rgyu ba chad pa btang snyoms/ phyir rgyus nang du ma brgyus par rnam rtog rang bzhin gyis 'gag /spros nga/ nub pas de gnyis kyi bar de gnyis su sems gtad de/ ma bcos pa'i tshul gyis to de ba yid — 366 —

mig rlung gsum sna rtser hril gril ba ste/ bde ba'i ye shes rang shar ngang thig le rang 'gag su 'byung / ril ba zhags tshags kyi dpe dang 'dra'o/ 15 /bsam gtan gyi rtog par ba mo zhu ba dang /'o ma can gyi shing 'dzag pa'i nges don gzhan 'og nas 'byung ba dang 'dra la/ dang po 'og sgo la sbyar nas phyag rgya'i dwangs ma 'dren pa dang / phyi ma shing gi don rtsa dbu ma yin pas dbu ma'i nang du 'byung ba rnams sgom pa dang / ba gyi dod ha la byed pa lugs 'di pa'i khyad par te/ de rnams bde dgyes sogs dang mthun no/ 16 /'od gsal la sems dpa' gsum rtseg ni/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ji bzhin las/ sngags 'phreng mi bsgom/ ye shes sems dpa' dbu ma'i nang gi lte snying gar rung du bsgom/ hū gi 'od kyis rjes gzhig sgom mo/ /rwa pa gong ma rnams kyis 'jigs byed kyi 'pho ba bsgom pa'i gsal kha med/ phyi ma rnams dang / skyo pa rnams yi ge gcig pa zhig bsgom/ phyis kyi mkhas pa kha cig sa myu zhi'i lugs de mdzad mod/ de thams cad rgyud 'dir ni 'dis bstan med la/rdzogs rim dngos ma yin pas 'dir ma bris so/ /bla ma skyo pa'i man ngag zab mo rwa rtse sems 'dzin ni/ rang dpa' gcig chos 'byung dkar por gnas pa'i snying gar/ rgyu'i 'jam dpal pad dkar la gnas pa/ 'od dpungs 'khrigs pa/ rwa sngo bsangs dwangs gsal rtse rno zul ba'i nang du thig le dkar la 'tsher ba/ de las thig le'i rgyun byung / mgrin par gcig tu 'dres/ snying ga'i 'jam dpal gyi spyi bo nas thim pas/ lus sems bde bas khyab pa la sems gtad/ byang sems bde ba'i 'od dkar po liṅga rab tu rgyas pa nas yar byung / sku'i phyi yang khebs/ sems can thams cad la phog pas bde ba'i ngo bor gyur/ rang lha sku dngul chu'i thigs pa lta bu'i gsal dwangs 'tsher ba la sems 'jog pa'o/ 17 /mtshan mo rgyu ba ni dus rtag tu 'jigs byed kyi gsal snang dang / nga rgyal shugs che ba yud re de yang gsal stong rang shar tsam/ de tsam ma gtogs dmigs med nyid la bzhag /mtshan mo gcer bu gri thod 'dzin tshul bya/ sna rtser sems cher gtad/ nga rgyal brtan pos — 367 —

gom pa bdun tsam rgyu/ rnam rtog gang byung spros med du thag bcad/ 'jigs pa/ ya nga / bag tsha/g.yang sa me chu sogs thams cad la/ rang dang dbyer med du bsres nas/ cher gyis lta ba'i yid kyis thog rdzis/ bya/ de nas je ring du rgyu/ ma/thar gyang sogs la thogs pa med na thun mong gi dngos grub yud kyis 'gru/ba nga/ yin gsung / 18 gtum mo ni/ bsam gtan gyi rtog pa'i bu mo dbang du byed pa'i des don te/ rkang nga/ra rlung sngon po zla gam/ sum mdor me dmar po gru gsum/ snying gar sa ser po gru bzhi/ dpral bar zla ba gang ba chu'i rang bzhin rnams la ya ra ba la gyis mtshan pa/rlung kha sbyor bzung / rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ sa bsregs/ ba zhu ba gsang ba'i lu ldog byed pa'i 'bar 'dzag sgom pa'o/ 19 /co gru lo tsā ba chen po'i bzhed pas 'khor lo bzhi'i gtum mo sgom par bzhed nga/ ni shin tu legs shing / 'on kyang de'i dmigs pa dpyid thig yi ge bzhi pa nyid yin pas der blta'o/ 20 /de ltar zhang skyo rwa gsum ka'i lugs la'ang zab mo phyag rgya'i lam rgyas par 'byung mod/ 'dir mi 'chad la/ rnal 'byor gyi lam de tsam mo/ /mal gyo lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa nā ro pa'i man ngag da lta sa/ lugs su grags pa'i rdzogs rim 'di ni/ mtshan ma gyen 'greng gi nang don/ rdzogs rim/ zhig yin te / dngos ni lag pa'i phyag rgya la brten pa'i man ngag tu gtogs pa'o//de yang / rdo rje bslang ba rtag tu bya/ /zla ba nyi ma'i 'gro 'ongs dgag /g.yin du a ba dhū ti'i char/ /mi 'jug pa ni rlung yin no/ /mtshan mo dub/ smig rgyu srin bu me khyer/ mar me 'bar ba/ nyin mo/zla ba/ nyi ma// zla ba sngon po/ gzugs brnyan mthong ba/ sku gsum mthong ba/ de nas rdzogs pa'i sa/ngas rgyas nyid do/ /'di'i don rlung dbu mar ma bcings pas/ byang sems dbu mar mi chud/ de ltar na sdug bsngal 'byung / ting nge 'dzin mi/ skye/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog bskyed pa'i rten byed/ de dbu ma/ra chud pas gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog 'gag pa'i bar du byed/ de 'gags pas bde stong lhan cig skyes pa chos sku mngon du byed ces 'byung / 'dir rdo rje bslang ba'i lag len/ lag g.yas phyin tsho— 368 —

ka log tu phar bstan pa'i mtheb mdzub bar dog par snol ba'i bug pa rdo rje bcug la/ de'i rtsa bar bzhag pas rlung dang byang sems phar mi 'chor/ mig gnyis ma phye mi 'dza/ma pa/ nam mkha' la lta/ 'dzin med lhug pa gzhag /rgyu zhangs yar bskum steng rlung sna 'gul tsam drangs te mar mnan/rlung gtong ba na/ steng 'og gnyis ka dal bus slod/ de nas je drag je drag dgag ste bde stong mi rtog pa ma/chog skye ste srog rtsol lo/ /de ltar bsgom na rtags ni du ba sogs bcu snyel nyin mtshan so sor lnga lnga'o/ /sku gsum ni rang sems dang dngos po'i 'dres pa'i bde stong chos/ sku/ lus ring 'a tshon ltar yang ba longs sku/ ci ‘3dod pa'i rnam par 'char zhing ston pa sprul sku zhes pa lam/ dus so//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni 'bras dus kyi sku gsum myo 21 /'di na rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim thor bu pa brgyud pa so so'i gang ma ngag phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i 'al drad chen po byed pa dang /rgya gzhung tha dad la brten pa zhal phyag gi dag pa dang sbyar ba'i rdzogs rim chen po byed pa'ang 'dug cho da kyi/ man ngag thor bur bstan pa'i rdzogs rim bla ma ches snga rabs pa'i lugs 'di dag ches yid ches par snang ngo / /'dir rdzogs rim spyi 'gros ni 'dus pa dang mthun/ de'i nang gi yang zhab/sa lugs dang gsang ba grub pa sogs dang mthun shas che bar snang ngo / /'dir smras pa/ bde chen gcig pu'i dngos ni thun tshod zhal te ma myong ma'i snyems pa stug po dag la ches khros pa/ /dus mthu'i char sprin dkrigs khyod rdo rje'i gar gyis sa gsum 'dar mdzad sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus ngo/ che//lhan skyes stong nyid bcu drug bde stong ngo bo'i phyag ni byang chub phyogs cha'i mtshon gdengs thabs shes rwa/ /rtse mo rnon pos srid zhi'i ma/tha' gnon grub pa dbang phyug rnams kyi zhabs ni don gnyis mchog brnyes pa/ /de nyid sgrub thabs nges gsang bdud rtsi'i 'od/ /bcu drug khyim du rtag shar brjod bral che/ /ris med lhan skyes gnyis snang gdung sel ba/ /dpal ldan 'gyur med rdo rje'i rdzogs pa'i rim/ /de ltar na bar ma chad par rim pa gnyis la 'bad cing nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni — 369 —

zhu bde'i rnal 'byor gtso bor bya'o/ /de nas ye shes phebs nga ngang / ye shes la cung zad dbang ba dang / ye shes la ches dbang ba rnams su/ rim gyis dbang po smin nas gdod rdzogs pa'i rim/ pa la rtse gcig tu dril nas/ spyod pa spyad pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob bo/ /ga 'a te 'dir lha'i rnal 'byor dang bzlas pa las su rung ba mtshan ma/ brtan po shar ba'am/ de ma/ yin na sngags bye ba la sogs pa'am/ tha mar yang rgyud las gsungs pa bzhi 'gyur du bzlas la/ sbyin bsreg gis 'dod pa'i lha mgu bar byas pa zhig bis bya ste/ dkyil 'khor bris te sgru ba pa zhag bdun du bya ba/sngon du bsnyen sgrub sbrags pa zla ba drug tu byas pas yin te/ des kyang mtshan ma ma rnyed na de 'dra ba lan gsum du bya ste/ de la bcom ldan 'das zhal ston pa'am/ de lta bu'i mtshan ma sgra dang 'od 'byin pa dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis dngos su byin gyis rlob bo/ /de nas las thams cad thogs pa med par 'gyur la/ dngos grub rnams kyang sgrub par bya'o/ /des rig pa 'dzin pa ma grub na yang las kyi dngos grub gdon mi za bar gsungs so/ /gzhan du na/ dngos grub ni mi 'grub la/ las kyang thogs shing don chung ba tsam zhig 'grub po /zhes rig ste/ de yang / rgyud 'dir tshar bcad pa nyid gtso bor ston cing / las tshogs ni bsam gtan dang / sbyin bsreg dang / 'khrul 'khor gyi las tshogs gsum du 'du zhing / ting nge 'dzin la snang ba rnyed pa dang / bzlas brjod kyi mthu pa che ba dang / chung ba'i dbye ba ste gsum mo/ /dang po la bsad pa/ dbye ba/ skrod pa/ dgug pa/ dug bsal ba/ bud med zhu ba'i sbyor ba/skyes bu chen po dbang du byed pa rnams gsungs/gnyis pa la/ spyir sbyor ba'i cho ga gsungs pa'i rjes la bsad pa'i las gnyis/ dbye ba gnyis/ bskrad pa'i las bzhi/ mnan pa/ bu mo dbang du byed pa/ zhi bar byed pa/ rgyas par byed pa/dgug pa/ spyo bar byed pa/ de zhi ba/ rdzas dang rdzas ma yin pa bsgyur ba/ yul dbang du byed pa/— 370 —

dbang du byas nas bran du sgrub pa/ 'byor pa bskyed pa/ rgyal po dang 'jig rten dang / bud med rnams dbang du byed pa re re/ dbang du byed pa'i mchog/dgug pa'i mchog rnams bstan to/ /de rnams kyang sbyin bsreg byas pa'i dgos pa/ byed pa po/ gnas/ dus/ yul/ las bzhir 'dus pa'i rgyu mtshan/ thab khung / dgang blugs/ rdzas/ me rnams kyi rab byed/ phyi nang gsang ba'i spyin bsreg la sogs pa rnam sa grangs mang por shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa la bsad pa drug /bskrad pa lnga/ dbye ba bzhi/ rims kyis 'debs pa/ rengs pa/mnan pa/ dbang du byed pa/ 'gugs pa/ spyo bar byed pa/ bu mo rmongs shing 'gugs pa/ zhi ba'i las mdor bstan pa rnams gsungs/ thun mong gi dngos grub ral gri /mig sman/ sa 'og /ri lu/bcud len/ gter/ 'byung go ro langs/ sha za/ gnod sbyin/ gnod spyin mo/ klu la sogs pa ji snyed pa sgrub pa ste de rnams sgrub tshul dmar nag gi rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ las tshogs thun mong pa rnams kyang 'dra la/ thun mong ma yin pa sngar bshad pa de rnams so/ /de la 'khru' 'khor rkyang ba dang / sbrags ma'i 'khor lo bdun bsdus pa la re mig phyi brgyad nang brgyad de bcu drug /rgyas pa la phal cher nag po'i rgyud dang mthun/ yang rtog gsum nas bshad pa re mig bcu bdun pa de dag la las kyi dbye bas rnam pa mang por 'gyur zhing / sngar bstan pa'i 'khrul 'khor skabs kyi las tshogs la kha cig 'di ltar bzhed/ yi ge bcu pa'i drug ste bsad pa dang po/ rims kyis gdab pa gnyis pa/ rengs pa gsum pa/ bskrad pa gcig ste/ 'khor ra lo brten pa bzhi/ dbye ba gnyis ni ma bsten pa ste drug sho( /yi ge so gnyis pas las nyi shu ste zhi ba dbang dgug gsum la re re/ bsad pa gsum/ mtsho ni gyis phog pa/ de'i phyogs su bsdus pa ste gcig/bsgrad dbye rengs gsum la gsum gsum ste 'khor lo bsten pa'o/ /mi brten pa la bsad bskrad la gnyis gnyis ste nyi shu'o/ /zhes gsungs te rgyud kyi dngos bstan der gnas la/ man ngag gi 'khrul 'khor bdun sogs mdzad —371 —

pa'ang legs nga kho na'o/ /'di rnam/sa la rgyud gzhan ltar las tshogs spyi yi chos brgyad dang / bri gzhi/ snag tsha/ snyug gu /bri thabs kyi cho ga /bri ba dngos/ sgrubs pa/ 'khor lo las la sbyar ba/ rme/ grub pa spogs chog ste don brgyad dam/ thog mar tra4 la bri ba'i phyos sa la/ sngags bri ba/ btu ba/drang ba/ bsre ba dang / spo ba/ sgrub nga// sba ba zhes pa'i tshul gyis las la sbyor/ rtog gsum gyi tshul/ ngang / dmar ngo sogs dang thun mo/nga pa gnyis ka yang rtog bdun gyi dbongs par ni gnas par ma/ngon/ yi be bcu bdun gyi las bcu bdun sgrubs nga/ myo/ bris sa zha/ srog gzugs/ mtha' rten/spe' tshig /྅ sngags/ yi/ ge mgo ston tshul tha dad pa yod pa ltar bya zhing / khyad par drag po la kha sbyor dbye ba bzhe sne ye shes sems dpa'i dang / lus bsrung ba'i dang / snying dkar nag gi dang /sha rus /pa sbyo ra dbye ba dang / lha dang mi'i gsang sde bzhi dang dbye ba dang nyi ma bzhi pa'i las sbyor nga pa/ sngo sa chog gnyis la sngags kyang 'di ltar/ o ya ma nā ni ts+tsha ya skye ya yak+ṣi ya ra ni yo da ya ya da yer ṇa ru dor me ya ya me do sa dza rā ma ya hū phaṭa/ dgra bo mā ra ya hu phaṭa/ 'es pa dang / lko ya ma me da snye ya sme ni dzā sa do ru ṇa yo ni ra dgra bo mā ra ya pho phaṭa/ ya snye ma me da yo ni ra ya sme rā dzus do ru ṇa dgra bo mā ra ya hū phaṭa/ zhes pa'o/ /bzlas pa/ 'khor lo dang / spyin bsreg /gtor ma/ tshogs 'khor sogs gcig tu gril nas sgrub nga ra gsungs la/ 'khru la 'khore yang bla ma snga rabs pa mang po/ zhi ba 'jigs pa brgyad la skyob zhes sogs kyis rnam/ grangs mang por 'gyur bar bzhed pa yang / las kyi rgyud dang grogs bstan pa'i skabs yin pas shin tu mi 'thad pa yang ma yin la/ de ltar gang dgos pa'i dus su de dang de sgrub pa yin no/ /yang mchod sbyin dang / gtor ma dang / bzlas pa dang / sbyin bsreg dang /'khore lo dang / bsam gtan dang / las kyi kha skong ba ste las bdun gyis zhi drag sogs thams cad sgrub bo/ /de yang / bsnyen pa dang / bsnyen sgrub sbags ma sngon du song ba'am/ sgrub pa song bas las — 372 —

—stospo ga rde — — rgyas pa spospothosporna rderderderderde—dang ngo ga ( 'o rnams rgya cher sngon du btang nas / dras gro ri/ nyi ma bdun nam / bzhir bsgrubs 5sa mas la sbyor te/ kha lcor phyogs/ dur khrod kyi ras 'a/ dug la sogs/ pa drug byug la / snag cha 'a spri nga bsre/ rgyas pa'am / rtog gsum ltar bri ba 'gru// phyi/ brgyad rngang brgyang sogs/ gang ya nga rung ba bri/ tra gzhi la ma bris pa'i phyogs 'a// bsangs sbyangs / de nyid lha bcu bdun du bskyeng 4 na 'a kun ba'i rdzogs par byas/ mchod bstod gtor ma dbul/ la sa/ dang rma thun pa'i gdan la/ ming yig rnga5 sa sgrub byar bskyed/ dgug gzhus/rde bya/ rgo cha dang ‘sna 'a sas sa tsho pa dbral/ 5 nga mchod/ phyag bya par6/ stobs brjod/ grog mkhar bdun dang bsgrub bya'i rjes dang / bsang gci 'as lid+ma soྈ brgyang—pa byas la/ thod nga/ mtshan ngan kha sbyor steng rma la rme ble dkyil 'kho1rder ra gyis mtshan spra pre ra nga ṭa rnye mā/ ra na tshophaṭa/ de'i rgyab tu ri rab/ steng du dbang chen rgya gram dang nga cas pa/ 'og tu rlung la o kyai a tre sa ya a a rgyab tu sna tshogs rdorje bri/ lid+ma'i snying gar hru sgye pho ṭa :ri/nga rwas/rde chu mā ra ya kla ṭa/ nge 'es sder liṅga 'khor lo'i bar du bcug /'bor lo man ngag ba 'ar dril sto ro skra skya dra nga bus bkras / rgya gram/ gyis 'khor lo mi mthong bar du zhed kra ru// g.yon stsor ridzi nga pa /ga5 ma sgor ste nga / sde za 'ag ma ro/gi kla ྈ bcug /dgug gzhug bya/ mi rus kyi phur pa gnas lngar bsdeg /tshig rnams tsher che sa dang snang / dra ga po'i bsam gtan dang bcas nga sa thod nga ra bcug la/ sra da bus bsngams/ ga'u 'a bu ga na ru/ dusakhrag yungs kar sogs thun blugs/ byin rlabs mchong/ bsto da byas nas/ dur khrong kyi 'ag‘klo / re/ci me la so zhing sgrubs/ nyi ma/ bzhi nga/ 'jir sbyar tshol / mthar nge gshin rje'i gzugs kyi dz+nyā nga gar bcus 'a dur khrod du sba ba'ang dgos na bya'o/ /'dir las gzhan la snye brgyad lnge na pe dang ma brgyad ldan pa la sos sa pa'i sngags kyang 'a sa 'a zhig 8ri dong do/ /(h+phu sa tshogs chi la sa wen la ltos nga/ je dkyus/ 'dir mi 'dri'o/ /bar chad bsrung ba/ khro bo bcu'i bsrung zlog ni/ lā/ li ta 'tshos zhung du ri rab kyi rtser te nga/bus kyi khro bo rdorje sems dpa' zha'/ gsum phyag tsho drug nga/ra gyur pa de zhu bas chos 'byu/nga dā — 373 —

ma rod/ 'dir dbus kyi khro bo gnod mdzes 'og tu rdo rje sa 'og ces ming btags pa dang / gnod gru/dzes kyi/ phyag na rin chen lcags kyu pad+ma zhags pa bsnams pa ma gtogs 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs ji bzhin rte/ 'gu/ga gzhug rgyas btab sngags bzla ba rnams med do/ /'di la'ang man ngag bi phyir zlog 'ong bar mngon/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa zhes pa'i sgrub thabs su a mo gha chung bas gshed po zhal drug pa zhig la/ gshin rje brgyad kyis bskor ba'i srung zlog zhig kyang yod do/ /'jir ni grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi phyir zlog drug pa ltar sgom na/ shā n+ya ya sogs/ chos 'byung du pa ra hu 'a sa pad nyi sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'od zer las sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi sogs bsgom/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bhu las/ 'khor le rtsibs bcu pa ser ngo// lte bar nyi ma la rang sems hu/ de las hū bcu spros/ rtsibs bcur pad nyi la dbus kyi hū rang nyid zhe sdang gshin rje gshed nag po rdo rje thod dbyug bsnams pa/ bdud bzhi brdzis pa'i ma he nag po la gnas pa/ shar du gshin rje ba/shed sogs rdo rje gur ltar bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dgug gzhug rgyas btab sos sa sgru ba thabs ltar bya/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros/ gnod byed rnams brdungs shing bkug la/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyis thal bar brlag par bsams/phying zlog byed na/ khro bo thams cad zha'/ phyir bstan/ zhabs g.yas brkyang rab tu khros pas/ pho nya mtha' yas pa spros te dgra bo thams cad rlag par mdzad cing /ji tsam bsrung 'dod pa de tsam du/ dgra bo'i lha la sogs pa bar chad byed pa rnams kyis mig gi ltar yang med par bsams la/ tse( sbru sgyi bi kri tā na na sarba sha krus/ nā sha ya sta bha ya hu hū phaṭa phaṭa snya hā/ zhes pa dang / ya ma rā dza dang yi ge bcu nga bzlas la rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang mthun no/ /gi zhi ṣa rwa lugs zhes grags pa'i man ngag mchog de — 374—

yang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ma yin te/ gsang 'dus bo na yin pa'i phyir /snyes smri ba chi mi/ legang je/'dus pa zhabs lugs kyi gdams ngag nyid 'a brten mod/ khro bo ‘zhal sa cig phyag gnyis pa 'id kyis 'dus pa'i khro bo min par nges/ dpal 'dzir gyi 'di dang yang rjes su mthun nga dang gcig tu na rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa ste zhes gshed skor gyi rgyud kun 'dus pa la mngon du phyogs pas na/'dus pa'i bsrung 'khor yang 'di la shin tu rung ste lwa li tas mdzad nga/ bzhin no/ /de ru / na phyir zlog rgyas pa ni u zhi ṣa rwa lugs su shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na rma chog gi dnges grub ni bsgrub bya 'i gtso bo yin la/ de'i lam dngos ni rdzogs rim yin/ de'i yang sngon 'gro smin byed ni bskyed rim yin/ de la yang dbang thob cing dam tshig ldan nga/ dgos pa dang / dbang bskur ya nga dkyil 'kho/ra sngon du 'gro ba dang / las dang dngos grub gyi sgrub pa thams cad la yang dkyil 'bor dgos so/ /dbang po brtul pos bskyed rim brtan nas/ spyod pa spyad cing thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub rmas/la sa tshogs dang rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i don rgya cher spyod cing rdzogs rim/ bsgom cho// /gang zas gsum kas sngags grub nas las tshogs thams cad kyis 'gro ba'i don sgrub pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rgya chen pos kyang byed go /de yang snying rje chen po dang / bde chen byang chub kyi sems dang / 'khor gsum rang bzhin med par shes pa'i sgo nas/ lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyis 'gro don sgrub pa 'di ni gzhen du bskal par 'gro( phan spyod pa las kyang / bsod nams kyi tsho/gas ches lhag nga thabs kyi khyad par te/ de'i phyir las tshogs rgya' bas/ gsungs pa 'di dag /mu stegs byeng rnams kyi pas tshogs dang sngags rgyud rnams dang dgos pa 'dra bar ltar na/ de ltar mi rung ste sngags dang rgyud la 'phya ba ches sdig pa dang ldan pa'o/ /'dir las tsho rwags kyi dam tshig bstan pas gzhan/ rnams zur gyis bzung ngo / /de ltar shes nas las tshogs tsam la 'khya ma/sa nga/ dang / 'di dag drang don yin pas cir yang mi rung zhes ma gus pa'i nyes pa mi 'byung ngo / /de ltar na rgyud 'dir dbang bskur ba sto—— 375 —

snye—snye—tho—— ————sdirdzedam tshig thob la ma nyam/sa pa/ rim pa gnyis/ la mtshan ma nye bar dmigs kyi bar du 'bad/ de nas/ thun mong sgrub pa brtsams// de'i sgrub nga/ dang las/ la sbyar ba rtog pa dang po dang / nag po'i rgyud dang dam/ra po'i rgyud bzhin bya/ gal te ril mchas/ kho na 'dod na snga ma'i de nas rdzogs rim bde stong lhan skyes kyi rnam rol la gcig tu gril nas drod thob na/ spyod pa spyad pas mthar 'dod pa'i dngos grub ring por mi thogs par 'gru ba par 'gyur la/ thun mong 'don pas bskyed rim brtan nas/thog mar spyong kla dang / de nas sgrub pa bya ba yin no/ /'dir dam tshig gi bris sku dang / bsnyen pa ngang / sgrub pa dang / las tshogs byed pa ni gang gis kyang ma rig par bya/ rgyud kyi tshul thams cad kyang snod min rngu/ gsang ba gal che bar gsungs/ yul mtshan nyid tshang nges pa la snying rjes ma gtogs dras las bkag /mchog dang bstan 'gro'i don du 'gyu/ra des na dbang dgug byar rung sa66sna du zhi rgyas bo na la 'bad/ rgyud 'dir grogs bzhi dang / bcas te sgrub pa gsungs pa'i sprogs ni/ phyas rgya mo nus pa thob pa tsartsi kā so gas kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa/ dam tshig gcig pa dag yin la / bla ma rnams rnal 'khyo/ra nga nus pa thob pa bzhi yin par 'chad/ de lta bu rnyed dka' la/ga 'an gyis mthong na mi/ rung bas rang gcig pus sgrub pa yin no/ /de ltar na dngos grub rnam pa gnyis 'khru/ba par nges pas/ skye bu'i lus ngag yid kyi nus mthu ci yod lam 'di la dril na/ dal 'byo ra don ldan nga ra 'gyu/ra te/ skye ba 'di nyid kyis sangs rgyas 'es bya ba yin mo/ /'dir smras pa/rtog ge'i yul las 'das gyur cing / /lha dang drang srong rnam/sa rmongs pa'i/ /gnas 'dir rgyal pa rngam sa kyis rma/khyen/ /sngags dang rgyud (rid rmad du byung / /rgyud rgyal rgyal ba'i spyod yul nyid lags thang / /blo rmongs rmongs pa'i dra bar chung gyur pas/ /sgrub thabs thabs tshul rgya che 'dir smras la/ /'khrul tshe tshe rabs gzhan du sdi ga ma gyur/ /don mang don gsal tshig nyung nyung ja'i dag /legs bshad legs par mang thos thos pa'i mdzod/ /rnam dpyod rnam par rgyas gang gang 'di la/ /zhib — 376 —

mos zhib sbyo/da ngo ma/tshar mtshar ba yod/ /rgyud sde chu gter dpa' ldan dngos/ grub mtshor/ /mtsho chen las blangs man ngag yid bzhin nor/ /nor mchog ('gro ba'i re slong pyos/sa las rgya pa /rgyal mtshan rtse mor nam yang 'khor gyur cig /ces pa rni rgyal ba kun gyi ya ba ma//byen brtse'i gter thog ma me da pa nas byang chub dam pa brnyes kyang thugs rjes rgyal ba thams cad kyi sras su sku bstsa 5 pas 'gro ba thams cad sgro‘pa ba/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje khro bo rdo rje 'jigs/ byed ces bya ba bdag cag si ston pa shākya'i rgyal po gdul dka' 'dul ba'i phyir rlam pa/ra mi rtog pa'i thugs rjes khros pa/'i bcam ldan 'das kyi sgrub thabs nyung ngu'/ cho/sa pa rjes su 'dzim nga rdo rje 'bar ba zhes pa 'di ni/kun dag / ri snying po tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gnyis pa la sgrub sa nas bsar/ gtan sdi ngas su sbya ra ba'o/ /bzhus/ /di rgya yu // //

brdi/rba/ kla rbe thog gan/ bzhu / gas/bdam gas༈ nga/sa bzung zhing sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / /sa sbyang ba dang thab ni yo/ngas su 'cha'/ /mchod gtor bsreg rdzas bsham/sa shing bsang chu sgrub/ /thabs bskyed re/ sbar me/ lnga spyan 'dren rma chod/ /mdun bskyed rma chod bsto da bsreg rja sa/ 'bul ba dang / /gtor 'bul yig brgya bzong gsol gshegs su gso/'a / /drag po la chi mchod bstod song rjes su/ /pho nya spro dang leng ga bskye/da dgug sgrol/ /gsor ma'i 'jug tu drag pa'i bsku la yang bya/ /sbyin sreg 'di ni bsdu pa kho na'i lugs/ /ngang ngo tshong ma gas pas sa bzung ba rni/ bdag nyid dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen ngo/ra gyur/ nye snying lan bdun bzlas༈ gnyis pa sngon 'gro gtor ma ni/ dkyil chog dang gtor chog bzhan/ gsum pa sa sbyang ba ni/ tseX( āXthiX ha na ha na kro dha huX phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa bzla/ ba'i nga/ thab 'cha' ba rni/ rtsas sa pa'i thab baX bris pa'i thab gang byed kyang 'dra ste/ zhi pa la/che na khru gang dang chung na sor bcu gcig ge bar/ drag po la che na sor nyi shu nas chung na so/ra brgyad kyi bar bshang// thab kyi yo na tshul spyi dang 'dra/ lnga pa mchod gtor bsreg rja sa bsham pa ni rang gi g.yas phyogs su bsreg rdzas rnams sgrigs pa'am/ yang na mar khu dang yang ga'ang ma gtogs snrod gcig tu bsres/ rang gi g.yon du mchod yo na gyi snod dang bsang chu'i snod bzhas /lde'i 'phro la mchod pa rnams bsha/mas/ gtor ma gcig ga gru/ gnyis ji ltar bde bar ba 'ag /ra/ra khu ngang ya ma shing yang stabs bde sar bzhag /drug pa bsang chu snyel sogs nga/ bsgrub pa ni/ ku sha gcig bzung la/ oX badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na huX kla ṭa/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ ma/rkyor rdogs —378—

bzhin nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ a mṛ ta bzla zhing bsang chu gtor/ dkyil chog gam gtor chog bzhin gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya bsreg rdzas rnams la bstan la/oX oX swāhā/ oX ā swāhā/ oX shrī swāhā/ oX dziX swāhā/ oX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ nyes pa/ lan gsum gyis rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs/ bdun pa me sbar pa ni/ oṃ āXhūṃ/ oX badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūX gis me bcug /brgyad pa thab bskyed pa ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las hūX las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dmar jo zlum po/ mu ran kha khyer gyis bskor zhing / stegs bu'i gra la zla phyed rde rjes mcha myo/ pa/ pa/bla rgyas pa'i dbyibs can/ dwangs shing thogs/ nga/ med par gyur/ de'i nga/bus su raX las byung ba'i me dpung / me lha'i ngo bor gyur/ dgu pa me lha spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lco nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs te byon par gyur/ dbyug gu rtse gsum/ gyi phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing /oX tshur byon tshur byon 'byung bo che/ /lha yi drang srong braX ze mchog /bsreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'dir ni yang dag snyan par mjodi// /oX ṭak+ki huX dzaX a mṛ ta dang bsangs chus gtor/ dzaXhuX baX hoX bcu pa me lha mchod pa ni/ oṃ asna ye ā dī bya ā bi sha ā bi sha /mahā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya bdag gi sdig sgrib bar chad nad gdon bkra mi shis pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shan tang ku na kyi ye swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis nga gang blugs phul/ sngags sde kas yam shing ci rigs nga/ phul/ bcu gcig pa mdun bskyed ni/ yang bas ngas sbyangs/ 'bar ba me'i dbus su/ chos 'byung gru gsum zhes pa nas/ raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ riX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ces pa nas/ oX —379—

badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi hor 'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /bcu gnyis nga/ mchod bstod ni/ rgyas pa la spro na dkyil chog gi mchod 'phreng bzhin/ bsdus nga/ la nga ga' na/ snyad hi sgyi ha sogs kyi phyi mchod phul/snying po'i mthar 'khru gsum btags pe sa nang mchod dang / gzugs sgra la sogs drug 21ni/ /sogs yid ma chod dang / dur khrong/ rgyan gyis sogs kyis bstod/ bcu gsum nga bsreg rdza sa 'bul ba ni/ tse( hi sgyi bi kri tā myo na hū phaṭa/ lan gcig /tse( a sna ye swāhā/ lan bdun/ bdag gi sdis sgrib nad gdon bkra mi shis pa mtha' dag zhi bar mdzod cig swāhā/ zhes pa char gcis/ spel bas gru5 ra khu 'bul/ tso te a sna'i tshab tu/ tse( 2pe dhi bri k+ṣa ya swāhā/ yam shing ‘sna bul/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swāhā/ til/ tso rdzo badz+ra ā yur nye swāhā/ dur ba/ myos badz+ra ngu rdzong ya swāhā/ 'bras ma brugs pa/ tse( sarba sa pa te swāhā/ zho zan/ slong a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye snya hā/ ku sha /skye tshe badz+ra bi dza ye swāhā/ 'bras so ba/ tse( badz+ra be ga ya swāhā/ nas/ snyad badz+ra ma hā ba la ya swāhā/ sran ma/ tso tshe badz+ra lha sma ri swāhā/gro/ tse ( badz+ra a the sidha ye swāhā/ yungs dkar gyi sngags so/ /de rnams tshang ma 'dzom na rab/ma snye 'dzom na gang 'dzom 'dzom nas ji ltar rigs pa phul bas chog cing / bsreg rdzas thams cad gcig tu bsres rwa yin 'e/ sngags sde nga/ga btung la tshar gcig brjod pas 'bul/ de yan chad thog ma/'i bsreg rdzas 'bu' tshul tsam yi na 'ing / de nas grangs 'dzin pa ni/ snying po kho na bzla zhing 3ngul ba ste/ brgya brgya'i ma/tshams su/ bdag gi sdig sgrib ces sogs la sa sngags de yang brjod/ sde ji pa grangs 'dzen pa yin/ bsreg rdzas kyang kang 'byor yin/ 0cu ba'i pa gtor ma/ 'bu'/ ba :/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar shes par bya'o/ /bco lnga ri ni/ yi ga brgya ci rigs pa bzla'o/bcu drug pa bajo de gso/la ri/ sang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir lus can sgubs yin phyir/ /mgon khyod de kun —380—

bzod mdzad rigs/ /ma rnyed yongs spya ma tshang dang / /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ /bcu bdun pa gshegs gsol ni/ bdag la dngos grub mchog stsa'/ lags/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stso'i// /sems can kun la ci rigs par/ /dngos grub bla na med nga/'ang stsal// /slar yang g.ye/gas pa mdzad pa'i phyir/ /rang gi gnas gde/gas badz+ra mu /tso rdzo dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ sogs kyis gshe/gas su gsol/ bsdus pa 'di'i lus sa la/ me nyid la shar lho'i me lha spun drangs/ pas/ de 'id 'jig rten pa'i me lha dngos yin zhing / de bsangs sbyangs/ gams gyur pa las 'jig rte po — di dra/ pa'i me lha 'jigs byed chen po'i dam tshig par bskyed nas/ de man chad kyi cho ga'i 'phros dang / cho ga bsreg rdzas gtor ma thams cad me lha yi dam dbyer med pa la 'bul ba yin pas/ thog ma'i dgang blugs dang bud shing tsam ma gtogs/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha 'a mchod gtor gshegs gsol zur pa mi dgos pa'i lugs so/ /dang po dmi0/sa pas sa bzung ba/ gsum pa sa sbyang ba/bzhi ba thab bca' ba rnam sa kyang sngar grub grub pa'i rgyun la mi ra rdzong gas so// thos ma/ra 'di shes nas drag po'i snrin sreg la 'don nga/ bsgyur bas chog /pho rgon spro ba/ ling ga sgrol ba/ bstod bskul sogs drug cu pa'i cho ga nas blang bar bya/ bsreg rdzas kyi sngags rnam grang se so ba nge rmi nga bos so/ /cho ga'i 'jug tu smon lam dang bkra shis gang 'gru/ba bya/ zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smra sa/ /dge'o// //༈ na mo bhe ra wā ya/ sngar gyi de rnams 'a/ zur 'debs cung zad brjod na/ drag po la thab khung gru gsum rtse mo phar bstan pa/ kha khyer mu ran yang zhepasor gsum/ dbyibs gru gsum/ stegs bu gru bzhi/ thams cad myog po/—381—

bcad sngon po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ gsu ma gang rigs bya/ dkar po ser po mi rung ngo / /zhi ba'i thab la'ang bcad dmar ser ljang gsum gang rung byed/ nag po mi rung / sngon po rung mi rung gnyis yod/ rgyas pa las thams cad pa la pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu'i thab gru bzhi rung / thab kyi nang du pad+ma'i lte bar zhi ba la 'khore lo'am rdo rje dkar go yang na zhi ba'i rdo rje sngon pos kyang rung / drag po la gri gug ral gri khro bo'i rdo rje gsum 'dam la yin/ zhi ba las thams cad pa la zlum po pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu dang / zhi rkyang la rdo rje dkar po'i phreng ba kha khyer mu ྈna si dgos/ ma 'grub na tshom bu dang yid kyis bsam pa sogs 'dra/ dbang drag gnyis la/ mar shing ma gtogs bsreg rdzas thams cad gcig tu bsres nas 'bul ba gtso che/ zhi rgyas gnyis la thog mar lan gcig so sor 'bul ba gtso che/ lar gang mos yin/ drag po la ling ga bsgral ba'i ling ro dang / sha khrag chang tsher ma can gyi shing dang dug rigs sogs mi dgos kha med yin/bsreg rdzas g.yon du bshams shing / lag pa yang g.yon nga sa 'bul ba gtso che'o/ /bkra shis// //༈ na mo gu ru rgyas pa'i spyin sreg gi khyad par ni/ thab che na khru do nas/ chung na sor bcu drug gi bar bya/ bsreg rdza sa gtso bor/ dur ba dang / zho zan lhag par mang ba bya/ thab kyi chu dang mu ran sogs/ thab khru do 'a/ sor brgyad dang / khru gang la so ra bzhi dang / sor bcu drus/ pa la sor gsu ma du ma longs tsam du byed pa so sas rigs pas bcad/ thams cad dbyibs gru bzhi mdog ser po/ thab nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar rin po che 'bar ba/ ma grub na tshom bu ser po/ kha khyer mu ran la'ang rin po che'i 'phreng ba/ ma grub na yid kyis bsam/ bcad rnams dmar ngo/'am —382—

dkar po gang rung gis byed/ thab bskyed dus/ lko las byung ba'i thab khung ser po gru bzhi/ zhes 'don pa spo/ thab nang gi ye shes nga/ la mchod pa phul ba'i rjes su/ sku mdog phyag mtshan ma 'gyur ba la/ 'od zer ser ngo 'bar ba/ 'phro/ zhing bzhad la dgyes pa'i nyams can du/sdo/ra par sbom/ las sngags skabs bdag gi'am 'ji/ zhes bya ba'i 'am//bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams ye shes dang/la dang she 'byar ba thams cad sdo ( rme ku rngab e rna zhes 'don pa spos nas/ ga 'an thams cad 'i ba dang 3dra ba las/ bsreg rdzas kyang so sor 'bul ba nyid bzang ngo / /'o/ngas sbyo/da rgyas byed yin na/ nor bu nga pa zas nor phyugs gsum gyi char bab pa dang / tshe rgyas byed yin na bdud rtsi'i char bab pa bsam / re/ tog se ra po dang / shing 'bras sna tshogs dang / zas sna nor sna nas/ ci rigs pa ya nga 'bul lo/ /shing 'bras la/ tse ( shi pha la ye swāhā/ gzhan rnams la / myos ma hā shrī ye swāhā/ 'es pa 'i sngags kyis 'bul lo// bkra shis// //lho/ o snya sti/ dbang gi sbyin sreg byed na/ zhi ba dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ stegs/ bu mtshon byed gru bzhi'i dbus su/ thab khung zla gam bcad kha rang la bstan cing / de'i tshad la sor nyi shu'am/ thin tu chung na sor brgyad/ thab kyi mchu'am mu ran sor gsum/ stegs bu yang sor gsur/ pa rnams skor/ phyi nang thams cad dmar rgyang ngam/ stegs bu ser po kha khyer tshun chad dam/ra po byas kyang rung / bcad thams cad dkar po'am ser ngo gang mos bya/ thab nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar/ phyag mtshan/ pad+ma 'am/ mda' gzhu'am lcags kyu gang rigs cig 'bri/ de yang ma/ 'gru/ba na tshom bu dmar po bya/ kha khyer mu ran rnams la'ang 'gru/batshon mda'i gzugs kyi phreng ba bri ba'am/lcags kyu'i phreng ba 'bri/ bsdus pa la yid kyis bsam pa kho nas chog /mchod rdzas me tog dang zhal zas dang gtor ma rnams dmar po bya/ bsreg rdzas rang ngos kyi g.yon dang / rma/chod rdzas —383—

g.ya sa su bzhag /thab bskyed dus/ hi las byung ba'i dbang gi thab khung zla gam dmar po zhes 'don pa spo zhing / pad+ma rgyas pa'i dbyibs can zhes pa dor/ mdun bskyed mchod pa phul mtshams myos/ sku mdog sogs ma 'gyur pa la/ 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing chags pa'i nyams can du gyur par bsam/ bsreg rdzas kyi skabs su gzhan 'dra ba la/ til nas/yungs kar gyi bar bsreg rdzas so so'i sngags mi dgos/ bdag gi sdig sgrib sogs kyi dod la/khams gsum gyi skye 'gro thams cad bdag gis wa sha ma na ya ho / zhes pa'am bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi zhes pa lta bu ji ltar 'os pa sbyar/ mar khu dang bud shing la so sor byed/ gzhan gang 'bul yang rja sa sngags mi dgos/ khyad rnga/ra gyi dam rdzas me tog dmar po la chang gi kha spru btab pa 'bul ba ni khyad par ro/ /bkra shis// //༈ spyin sreg gi rdzas la/ zhi ba la yam shing / pa la sha /u dum ba ra/ku shā ri/ ka dam nga / pa sī/ blag sha /pa ḍa la sogs pa'i shing 'o ma can gyi rtse mo'i cha la byas pa/ lo ma gnyis pa/ shun pa dang / brlan dang bcas pa/ phra sbom mtheb chung tsam/ ring thung sor bcu gnyis pa tha gru sa cad mnyam par bcad pa/ yas mar gyi rtse mo gnyis la sbrang rtsi dang mar dang 'o mas byugs/ bdud rtsi dang dri bzang bran/ srin lag dang mthe bong gi rtsa ba nas bzungs la 'bul/shing rnying pas 'chi/ skyog pos skal ba ngan pa/ thung bus rig pa phral du nyams/lo ma med na tsha ba 'byung / sbom pos phun sum tshogs pa nyams/ skam pos gzhan yang mi 'dod pa sogs 'byung bas spang ba ni/ rnying lci phra dang skyog pa ni/ /ring thung lo ma med pa dang / /srog chags kyis zos brul ba dang / khun bral chag dang bu ga can/ /rtse mo gnyis ldan sbom pa spangs/ /zhes sor /rgyas pa —384—

———la yam shing ni rgyu zhi ba dang 'dra/ de yang dbus kyi cha las byas pa khru gang ba'o/ /dbang la zhi ba ltar ram/ yang na/ pri yang ku/ tsam pa ka /su nā ga /klu shing la/ la gu tsa/ a sho ka rnams dang / gzhan yang 'bras bu dang me tog ro skyur ba kha dog dmar po rnams kyi bar gyi cha las byas pa/ sor bcu pa'o/ /mngon spyod la/ nim pa/ seng ldeng / ko bi dā ra/ bhi lo ḍa ka /myos byed rlams dang / gzhan yang tsha ba/ tsher ma can/ ro kha ba'i shing dang / ro bsregs pa'i 'gal dum rnams kyi rtsa ba'i cha las byung ba/ bkas pa/ sor bcu pa/ rtse mo gnyis rno ba la/ dug dang khrag dang yungs dmar gyis bskus pa'i yam shing bya'o/las thams cad pa la ni/ ba la sha /u dum ba ra/ blag sha /seng ldeng / arka nu gro dha/ be'i ka ka /a mra/ sha sī/ kwa shā ri/ a pā ma rga/ a sha ta rnams gsar pa/ 'dzub gang pa/ drang po/ bdud rtsi dang bcas pa'i dri bzang gi chus bran pa/las dang rjes su mthun pa'i snum la sogs pas byugs pa'i yam shing ngo / /las thams cad pa la bsreg rdzas zhi ba dang / rgyas pa las nga5nad pa thams cad dang / gu gu' dang / sa la'i thang chu ste spos dkar yang bsreg go /rdo rje gur las/ zhi la me tog dkar po ste/ /ser po rgyas pa rdo rje la/ khros la me tog nag po ste/ /shin tu dmar ba dbang dgug la'o/ / zhes so/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/bud shing thab kyi dma' bar bya/ /nags kyi lci skam dag kyang rung / /srog chags ldan pa spang bar bya/ /zhes so/ /'od kyi snye ma las bsdus so/ /bkra shis// //༈ snga dro'i thun la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ yig brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam byed/ thun gzhan tsho la/ de tsho tshar gsum res chog /bzlas pa'i skabs —385—

rang gis bzlas pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nam mkha' khengs pas bzla rogs mdzad par mos/ ya mun+ta ka la 'bum phrag bdun/ hi ṣ+ṭi'abum/ phrag bcu bzla dgo/sa/ ya ma rā dza la bzla na 'bum phrag gsum/ thun mtshams su rang phyag gnyis pa gtso bo'i thugs ka nas spros par bsam/ gtor chog srod thun kho na la byas pas chog /rmi lam bzang bzang 'dra ba la dga' ba yang mi bya/ 'tshub pa byung na bla ma'i gsol 'debs dang / sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur shes nga la nan chags bya/ /bkra shis// //rmya/ rgyud 'di dbang phyug chen po 'dul ba'i phyir gsungs te/ de'ang sngon dbang phyug chen po dang lha mo dbu ma gnyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i dus su/ drang srong gcig sleng du byung ba la dbu ma khros te/ da lta'i gnas skabs 'dir slong ba 'di dang 'brel ba ma yin nam zer nas/ rang gi chos 'byung gi nang nas sa bon me'i drod dang 'dra ba yod pa brus nas/ de'i khar blug pas/ drang srong gi kha tshig ste/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram du kha bkrus pas/ sa bon yod pa la gzhon nu drug khrus byas nas spros pa las/ yid kyi bu gcig byung ba la/ gcig na re kha'i bu yin zer ba la/ drug ka mgu bar bya ba'i phyir gdong drug tu sprul/ pa las gzhon nu gdong drug tu grags so/ /de dang phyis lha ma yin gyi rgyal po ru tra pra ma gnyis/'dzam bu gling du 'thabs pa la/ ru tra rgyal de'i dus su ri rab kyi khong seng na dbang phyug chen po yod pas/ 'dzam bu gling du bu pham par shes nas/ de 'dod khams na dbang che ba yin pas/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i dmag dang / lha min gyi rta pa'i tshogs dang / sa steng gi nad brgyad dang / gdon brgyad kyi dmag drangs —386—

te/ ru tra pham par byas go /der ru tras 'jam pa'i rdo rje la skyabs su song bas/'jam pa'i rdo rjes sum cu rtsa gsum nga/'i gnyer bor phyag sum cu rtsa bzhir spru'//sa 'og gi lha min gyi gnyen por ma he'i gdong par sbrul/ sa steng gi nad brgyad gdon brgyad kyi gnyen por zhabs bcu drug sprul/ dbang phyug chen po'i gnyen ngo ra ling ga gyen du 'greng ba bstan nas/ 'jig byed kyi rgyud 'bum nga/ gsungs /rgyud sde rtsod ldan gyi 'dzam gling gi mi yis mi rtogs pas/ u rgyan gyi yul dharma bha dza chos kyi mdzod du mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rgyas btab nas 'o/ngas spyod pa la/ slob dpon lā li ta badz+ra sa u rgyan gyi dur khrod du rdo rje 'jigs/ byeng/ bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs nas/ mkha' 'gro'i ma'i phyag nas rteg bdun spyan drangs pa'i tshul ni sngar ltar rdo /zhal shes lag len rnams dang / gang dgos rnams phyogs gcig tu tā ra nā thas legs par bris pa'o) /dge 'o / /zhus dag/—387—

chen po'i tshogs mchod bzhugs/oX sru ji / bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i tshogs mchod ni/ ya mun kas bas ngas/ sla bhā was stong pa/ra sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las tshogs rdzas rnams kyi 'os tu yaX las rlung / raX las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa/ dpra la bar rang la bstan pa/ phyi dkar la nang dam/ra ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga/ zhu ba las byung ba'i tshogs rdzas zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oX āXhūX ha hoXhiX na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po/ rang bzhin rngam par dag pa skye ba med pa/mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa a li ka'i 'a ngo bo rnam nga/ra dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di nyid/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du ga ṇa na cakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye skyoX/ na mo thabs dang sogs grong bzhin sbyar/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du ga ṇa sogs / 'phran las kyi ring ri chos skyong bsrung ma sogs/ da rma/ tshig gi rtsa ba mched grogs rdo rje sprun grogs rnams kyi sos sa/ mi/ 'bral snying gi gzhal med khang //cho/sa gus gzhom med pho brang du/ / drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /bka' 'drin mnyam/ med dam pa rje/ /rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin bzhin 'thibs/ /'dir —388—

gshe/gas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /gnas khang 'di la byin phob la// tshogs rdzas 'di la bcu/da cig chug /'dir 'dus rnal 'khya/ra bdag cag la/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsole// /gu ru de ba 'a ki nī dz+nyā na a be sha ya a/ /stug po zhing khams 'jigs byed pa/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo 'bum sde'i dbus/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed bcom ldan 'das/ /zhe sdang rdo rje mi bskyod nga// /rnam 'phru/la mkha' la sogs/ mi g.yo 'og min nyams dga'i zhing / /dag pa'i bde stong mkha' spyod gnas/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bde bskyed yum/ /rdo rje ro langs mkha' 'gro'i ri gce| /rnam 'phru/la sogs/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i gnas//phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kun nas/ /gshi/na rje gshe/da po'i bka' nyan mchog /phyogs skyong gshin rje ma mo bcas/ /rnam 'phrul sogs/ (〈sbra〉 rtse bdud tshogs kun 'dul 'phrin las zhing / /dur khrod chen po gnas brgyad nas/ /bgegs 'joms 'dod don kun sgrub pa'i/ /chos skyong bsrung ma 'khor bcas kyi/ /rnam 'phru la sogs/) bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i rde tshogs/ /rigs kyi cod pan ldems se ldem/ /dar gyi cod pan pur ru sa /rgyan cha mang po khral la la//rol mo mang po dir ri ri/ /glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug /'khore tshogs 'bum sde shar ra ra/ /sgyu ma'i rang snang rjen ne ne/ /gtad med rig pa sal la 'a / /brjod med dbyings su thal la la/ /bde ba chen po'i khril li li/ /byin gyis rlob/ phyir gshe/gas su gsol/ /gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsole// /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chang sol/ /'khor gsum gnyis su med par 'dres/ /gu ru de ba ḍā gī nī dz+nyā na a be —389—

sha ya a/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por bltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi nga/nga gdol ba phag /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// a ho rma/hā su khaX/ bder gshegs chos la rin thang med/ /'dod chags la sogs dri rma bral/ //gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /a ho mahā su khaX/ de nas tshogs phud bcad la/ zhal zas ro brgya sogs dang / sngags gsum ka'am sting po'i mthar/ sarba bisnrun sha trun mā ra ya i daX ba ling ta kha /spa 'a hi /ji lha phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa lan lnga/ lkoX shrī mahā kā la ya/ shā sa na sogs lan gsum/ oX āXriX ha hoXhiXphe sogs/ oX kha kha 'a hi sku hi sogs mab 'a 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags lan gsum/ oX mchod do/ dman pa'i g.yul las rab 'das shing / /rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi/ /sgrib pa'i dri ma kun gsal zhing / /rtog pa kun las nges grol ba/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /ces tshogs phud phul/ 〈rang bzhin 'od gsal sogs/ 〉de nas tshogs la rol/mthar tshogs lhag bsdus te/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka dī la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i lhag ma'i gtor ma bzang zhing rgya che ba 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ lkoX āXhūX ha hoXhiX a kā ro sogs lan gsum/ phyi rol sgo drung na gnas pa'i 'byung bo 'chol ba'i tshogs dam tshig gi cho ga lta ba la mi dbang ba rnams la spyin no/ /rdo rje theg pa la gsang ba mchog gi rnal 'byor spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /oX u tsi ṭa ba ling ta bhak+ṣa si swāhā/(〈spru〉rtse zhes rol mo'i —390—

sgra dang bcas pa gtor ma/ phyir dor ro// ) de nas smon lam dang bkra shis nga 'o/ / ( 〈dza〉 rtse zhes pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// ) zhus dag / ( 〈ja〉 waṃ lus/ 'di ka la pa ru ma sleb kyang / /dad pa'i sem/sa la rigs ldan zhugs sam ci/ /shes rab gsum/ 'a/ blo gros sbyang min yang / /lhun po bzhengs las rgya mtsho rdol ba snyam/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'dir ri bad dge ba rnam par dkar ba'i mthus/ /bdag lus bor tshe dpal ldan sham+bha lar/ / rigs lda na rgyal po'i 'khor du les/sa skyes nas/ /dus 'khor bstan la bya ba byed par shog /ces pa 'di ni chos rje phyogs las snam rgyal gyis smon lam btab pa'o// // )—391—

na mo gu sa 'dir shin tu zab pa'i srung bzlog bshad par bya te/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du btang / oX hūṃ n+ya tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng / /bhuX las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu ser/ khong stong g.yas su drag tu 'khor/ /rtse mo rab rno lte ba dad / /rtsibs bcur pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan/ /dbus su bhuX las rang nyid ni/ /rdo rje gtsug tor spun ra los sgyur/ /ser po tshad skyob dkar po can/ /phyag g.yas 'khor ra lo g.yon sbrul zhags/ /thugs las hūX bcu phyogs bcur spros/ /rtsibs bcu'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ /shar du gshin rje mthar byed ni/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje tho ba phyar/ /lho phyogs shes rab mthar byed dkar/ /g.yas pa rdo rje be con bsnams/ /nub tu rta mgrin dmar po ni/ / phyag g.yas pad dmar 'dab brgyad 'bar/ /byang du bgegs mthar byed pa ni/ /rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs pa bsnams/ /byang shar mi g.yo ral gri ste/ /shar lho 'dod rgyal lcags kyu'o/ /lho nub dbyug sngon dbyug pa 'phyar/ /nub byang stobs chen rtse gsum sdigs/ /steng du hūX mdzad rang gi rgya/ /'og tu gnod mdzes ga stun shing 'dzin/ bro/ bo brgyad ni sku mdog nag /thams cad spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs/ /sma ra smin ma skra ser rdzes/ /rab tu mi sdug rngam la 'jigs/ /stags lpags sbrul dang mi mgos rgyan/ /phyag g.yon gnod byed tshogs la sdigs/ /g.yon rkyang stabs kyis me dpung bzhugs/ /mig tu khriX dkar sa snying dngos/ /rna —392—
