bar phyag rdor dzi nag po /sna la kha ser nam mkha'i snying / /lte la ga dmar 'jig rten dbang / /dpral bar sgrib ser ska ljang khu/ /lte bar kun bzang sa sngon po/ /o spyi bor sku yi rdo rje dkar/ /ā mgrin par gsung gi rdo rje dmar/ /hū thugs kar thugs kyi rdo rje mthing / /thugs ka'i hū las 'od zer 'phros/ /rang dang 'dra ba'i bsrung 'khor ni/ khro bo'i tshogs bcas mdun du byon/ /o badz+ra sa mā dza ar+gha la sogs pas rma chod/ dza hū ba hor dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa o badz+ra sa mā dza purmye la sogs pa lngas mchod/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang ba3/ra du ga tre dul/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam nas / sa ma ya shrī hū/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur te/ gshi/na rje mthar byeng 'a rnam par snang mdzad/ pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ yang / ar+gha la sogs pas ma/chod/ gzugs sgra la se(gas drug po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang / /shel la tshon ni ji bzhin du/ /'jo/da yon lnga dang cho ga rnam/sa la/ / rnal 'byor rtag tu spyo da par tre(ga /a la la ho/ rol du gsol/ bsnam/sa par mdzod/ /mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ /dgyes pa'i gar gyis rol bar mdzo da/ / reg bya 'gag pa med pa la/ /mig yor bzhin du rol tu gsol/ /ho chags pa med bzhin chags par ma/dzod/ /hū/khro bo zhe sdang gnas las skyes/ /gsod pa la sogs rtag tu rtson/ /bdud bzhi 'joms shing gdul dka' 'dul/ /'khor bcas rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas dmigs pa ni 'di lta ste/ gnod byed bdud bzhi mi gzugs can/ /dkar ser dmar nag bzhi ngo/ la/ /dgra dang byad ma bgegs kun thim/ /'khor —393—

lo'i rtse mos gcod par gyur// thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs bcu ser/ /sne / sku po bcu gcig rnams kyis brgyan/ / hūX dbus nyi zla kha sbyor nang / /sna tshogs thig le a yis mtshan/ /hūX las 'od 'phros sdig sgrib rnams/ /byad ma'i sgo dgu dag la thim/ /bsrung bya hūX gi nang du gzhug /shar du maX dkar lcor aX ser/ /nub tu raX dmar byang phyogs su/ /daX yig ljang nag dug bzhi'i dngos/ /rang dang bsrung bya'i dug kun thim/ /rtsibs kyi btubs nas phye mar klags/ /huX gi mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor/ /zhes brjod pa'am don bsam mo/ /de nas sngags 'di bzla te/ lkoX āXchu ṣa badz+ra tsakra brti sarba lo gī ka /lo kot+ta yan+t+ra man+t+ra tan+t+ra pra yo ga di nī sarba bi ṣa bi tsu rta ya bi rge rta ya/ ma ma kṛ te ye na ke na tsi ta kṛ tan+ta ni ka ri ta ni sarba bisnrun/ tshin+da tshin+da bhin+da bhin+da kaX pa ya kaX nga/ ya/ ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa bi dha nu ya bi dha nu/ sha ta sa ha sra/ sarba bi ṣa bi tsu rje ya bi cu ṇi ya/ uskyu ṣa badz+ra tsakra bsti bhuX bhuX bhuX rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūX huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla te srung ba'o/ /khro bo thams cad rab khros te/ /zhal ni phyi rol bstan par gyur/ /'khor lo g.yon tu drag tu 'khor ra/ /me rlung zhags pa lcags kyu yis/ /byad ma 'khrul 'khor ra lha sngags bcas/ /thal ba bzhin du rlag par gyur/ /srog snying huX gi rnam par bkug /rang sems hūX gi 'og tu mnan/ /sngags snga ma kho nas kyang rung la/ lde sgyur bar 'dod na/bhuX bhuX bhuX hūṃ huX huX su a tra ya ma bzlog bzlog phaṭa swāhā/zhes pa te ji ltar 'os pa bzla'o/ /rgyun gyi nyams len srung bzlog la de tsam gyis chog la/ huX hūX hūX gnod byed staX bha ya naX/ zhes pa dang / huX hūX hūX gnod byed mā ra ya phaṭa ces mtha' sgyur ba ni/ mnan pa dang bsad pa'i skabs su dgos te/ de'i man ngag ni yig rnying las shes par bya'o/ /mthar ar+ghaX la —394—

sogs pas mchod pa dang / khro bo zhe sdang sogs kyis bstod/ de nas 'od gsal du bsdu'am mi bsdu skabs dang sbyar/ bar 'dir bden stobs brjod cing / smod pa bdab par 'dod na/ rtsa ba dang rgyud bar bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong srung ma rnam sa kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyi mi/ khyab pa'i bden pa dang / kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / gsang sngags dang / rigs sngags dang /gzungs sngags cho ga dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyi/ su gang dag bdag cag dpon slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa dang / bstan pa spel bar byed pa la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa zhes sogs/ skabs su bab pa'i tshig 'don bskyur zhing 'tshams sbyar te/ sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / bsam pa dang spyor ba ngan pa byed pa'i dgra dang bgegs dang byad ma dang / de dag gi rgyab brten dang phyogs 'dzin pa thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o/ / ngag bcing bar bgyi'o/ /yid bcing bar bgyi'o/ /mthu rlag par gyur cig /stobs rlag par gyur cig /rdzu 'phrul rlag par gyur cig /des sgrubs pa'i sngags kyis de nyid rlag par gyur cig /des sgrubs pa/'i rdzas dang 'khrul 'khor gyis de nying/ 'joms par gyur cig /des sgrubs pa'i lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha la za zhing khrag la 'thung bar gyur cig /bdag cag la gnod byed —395—

———————snye—dgra bgegs gdug nga/ can 'di dag la/ de rnams nyid kyi bla ma dang yi dam dang srung ma rnams rang gshed du 'bab par gyur cig / de rnams nyid kyi srung ba dang bzlog pa dang / drag po'i 'a/sa byas pa thams cad rang gshed du 'bab par gyur cig /de rnams nyid kyi lha dang sngags dang / rim gro dang dge ba'i las bgyis pa thams cad kyang / de rnams nyid la rang gshed du 'bab par gyur cig /srid pa gsum gyi nad dang dug dang mtshon cha dang / nyon mo/ngas pa dang / la ru/ nga phyo/ pa dang / sdug bsngal thams/ cad dang / dgra bgegs byad ma 'di rnams/ la 'bab par gyur cig /kha kha khru hi /bā hi ma ra ma ra/ gro hā gro hā ban+ta ban+ta/ ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa/ nyi ma gcig la bsad par mdzod cig hu phaṭa/ bhasmi ku ru ye smye phaṭa/ sarba ni wa ra ṇa ya hū phaṭa/ ces thal mo rdab bo/ / bdag cag dngo/na slob rgyu sbyor ba dang bcas pas bsam sbyo ra dag pa rnams kyi tshe la bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cis/ /longs spyod la bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cis /dbang thang la bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /bsam pa'i don 'grub nga la bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /dam pa'i chos bzhin spyod pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad 'i bar gyur cig /gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /sngon gyi las 'a/sa gyur pa dang / 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum/ gyi bar chad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /chos dbyings stong pa nyid dang snying rje chen po'i dbyings/ su zhi bar gyur cig /dras po'i skabs zhi bar gyur cig la bzlog par zhes spo'o/ khro bo 3bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams —396—

cang/ kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlog /rnam shes chos kye nga/byings su sgro la/ /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /gdul dka' 'dul phyir dpa' po ni/ /shin tu gtum/ pa'i /bro gzugs kyis/ /ma dra5rde pa rnams tshar gcod tre|ga /gzhan yang smor lam ngang bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod do/ / 'es ur+sha ṣa rwa lugs kyi gdams ngag ces bya ba/ srung bzlog bsang sa sum gyi man ngas /ches zab rnga las/ kyang zab par mo da nga 'i nang nas ngag 'don snying po ma/do tsam byung ba 'di yang / rgyun gyi nyar sa len du smu/kho bar bas gru/sa nas/ tā ra nā thas nye bar brjong pa'o/ /ma se la/ /rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i spyi / rje pad+ma 'ang/nga / /gang 'dul sgros gar rton pa bzhi lde 'e mchog /hūṃ|sa rab rgyal mtshan zhabs la gus gsol 'a rebs/ /byin brlabs snying 'a zhugs par thugs rje gzis/sa/ /skye 'dir bdag gis zab rmo/ gsang chen theg /ku' bzang thugs kyi gsang bcud rdzogs pa che/ /mngon gyur khyang par nges don dbu rme 'i 'a ma/ /mtha' bral gnas —yugs myur du rtogs par sgo/ga /der brten phyi ma ra 'a sa 'bre'/ gang yod cing / /pad+ma 'od dang dpal ldan sham+bha lar/ /zab dgongs sngags ras sa 'dzin pa ra yongs 'phos nas/ /tshe der gsang chen legs mthar phyin gyur cig /ces nga/ra bzhengs ma‘sprun ngag nga bang yon tan bzang po'i 'es ngor ma tis smra sa pa'o/ /pas/da myoms stobs kyis lus 'di bor myo/ thag /pad+ma (da / /nga gnas gang 'dul rol pa'o sar/ /rnga ya/ba gling gi mnga' bdag dgyes bzhugs drung / /thugs sras dam pa 'i dbongs chen spyod gyur cig /ces pa'ang ma tis/ so// //—397—

dpe sgrog 'gan 'khur pa/ tshangs po/mdun shog mdzes 'god pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/pe5 du sna ri dzo / la8'an nil5/deb nga bzhi pa/༄༅/ /jo nang tā ra na tha'i gsung 'bum/( 12(45)dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs/:krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram/pe cin ma'o rin tshon khra par 'debs kung sis dpar btab/spyi lo 2008lo'i zla 4par par gzhi dang po bsgrisasaspyi lo 2008lo 'i zla 4par par thengs dang po btab/dpar grangs/ 001———15001bu2gyu978—7—80253——013—3(2 51gsung 'bum cha tshang ( deb 1—45yod ) la rin sgor/ 9 10 00
